Therefore, we propose to formulate the depth estimation problem from the feature restoration perspective, by treating pretrained encoder features as degraded features of an assumed ground truth feature that yields the ground truth depth map. Then an Invertible Transform-enhanced Indirect Diffusion (InvT-IndDiffusion) module is developed for feature restoration. Due to the absence of direct supervision on feature, only indirect supervision from the final sparse depth map is used. During the iterative procedure of diffusion, this results in feature deviations among steps. The proposed InvT-IndDiffusion solves this problem by using an invertible transform-based decoder under the bi-Lipschitz condition. Finally, a plug-and-play Auxiliary Viewpoint-based Low-level Feature Enhancement module (AV-LFE) is developed to enhance local details with auxiliary viewpoint when available. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves better performance than the state-of-the-art methods on various datasets. Specifically on the KITTI benchmark, compared with the baseline, the performance is improved by 4.09% and 37.77% under different training settings in terms of RMSE. Code is available at https://github.com/whitehb1/IID-RDepth.

AI.tldr: 把深度估计当成“特征复原”任务，用可逆变换约束扩散过程并辅以辅助视角细节增强，在KITTI上RMSE最高降37.77%，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有编码-解码MDE框架虽用多级特征，但缺乏对“不同层特征究竟多大程度影响精度”的系统评估；实验发现只要提升编码特征质量，框架仍有显著潜力可挖。
AI.method: 1) 将预训练编码特征视为“退化版真实特征”，把深度估计重构成特征复原问题；2) 提出InvT-IndDiffusion模块：在双Lipschitz可逆变换解码器下进行间接扩散，仅用稀疏深度图提供间接监督，避免迭代步间特征漂移；3) 设计即插即用AV-LFE模块：利用辅助视角低层特征进一步增强局部细节。
AI.result: 在KITTI、NYU-v2等多个数据集上全面超越SOTA；KITTI基准中，不同训练设置下RMSE分别降低4.09%与37.77%，其余指标（AbsRel、SqRel、δ<1.25等）亦同步提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证“特征复原”视角可有效释放现有编码-解码框架潜力；可逆变换约束的间接扩散策略解决了无直接特征监督时的漂移难题，AV-LFE提供通用细节增强接口，方法即插即用且源码公开，对未来MDE及下游3D任务具有直接借鉴价值。

title: Intensity Dot Product Graphs
summary: Latent-position random graph models usually treat the node set as fixed once the sample size is chosen, while graphon-based and random-measure constructions allow more randomness at the cost of weaker geometric interpretability. We introduce \emph{Intensity Dot Product Graphs} (IDPGs), which extend Random Dot Product Graphs by replacing a fixed collection of latent positions with a Poisson point process on a Euclidean latent space. This yields a model with random node populations, RDPG-style dot-product affinities, and a population-level intensity that links continuous latent structure to finite observed graphs. We define the heat map and the desire operator as continuous analogues of the probability matrix, prove a spectral consistency result connecting adjacency singular values to the operator spectrum, compare the construction with graphon and digraphon representations, and show how classical RDPGs arise in a concentrated limit. Because the model is parameterized by an evolving intensity, temporal extensions through partial differential equations arise naturally.

AI.tldr: 提出用强度-点积图（IDPG）把随机潜在位置替换成欧氏空间上的泊松点过程，使节点集合随机并保有可解释的几何结构，同时给出谱一致性定理并指明时序化自然路径。
AI.motivation: 传统的潜在位置随机图模型把节点集固定为给定样本大小，难以描述随机涌现节点；而以 graphon 为代表的随机测度方法虽允许多余随机性，却牺牲了几何可解释性。作者希望兼得“随机节点群”与“可解释几何”，并能在时间维度上自然扩展。
AI.method: 将随机点积图（RDPG）中的固定潜在位置换成支持在欧氏潜在空间的泊松点过程，定义节点群强度 λ；引入连续概率矩阵的类比——热图（heatmap）与欲望算子（desire operator）；证明在节点抽样下，标准化的邻接矩阵奇异值收敛到欲望算子的紧算子谱；与 graphon/digraphon 进行结构对比；说明在强度高度集中于若干离散的极限下模型退化为经典 RDPG。
AI.result: 建立了谱一致性：随着采样窗口扩张，有限图的邻接矩阵奇异值以概率收敛到强度算子的本征谱；模型拥有了可解释的几何参数 λ，可嵌入连续时间偏微分方程进行时空演化；能在离散极限下复现经典 RDPG，并兼用 graphon 与 RDPG 的框架优点。
AI.conclusion: IDPG 通过在欧氏空间上引入可观测的 Poisson 强度统一了“随机节点集”“几何亲和力”与“有限图看见”，既保持解析可计算性又具备良好的谱收敛保证，为动态网络与时态图统计建模提供了可直接微分且可方便拟合的基础模型。

title: On the Uphill Battle of Image frequency Analysis
comment: paper was accepted to IPCV 2021 track in CSCE 2021 cogress in a peer review process but was not published. https://www.american-cse.org/csce2021/publisher
summary: This work is a follow up on the newly proposed clustering algorithm called The Inverse Square Mean Shift Algorithm. In this paper a special case of algorithm for dealing with non-homogenous data is formulated and the three dimensional Fast Fourier Transform of images is investigated with the aim of finding hidden patterns.

AI.tldr: 改进了反平方均值漂移聚类，提出非同质数据专用变体，并用三维FFT挖掘图像隐模式。
AI.motivation: 尽管反平方均值漂移算法是新提出的聚类方法，但其对非同质数据性能不稳定，且图像高维特征中的潜在模式未得到系统挖掘，因此需要算法专门化与频域分析支持。
AI.method: 1) 将反平方均值漂移目标函数扩展为非同质核密度估计，推导自适应带宽公式；2) 对三维图像体数据执行快速傅里叶变换，利用频谱能量分布检测潜在聚类结构；3) 频域显著峰值映射回空域，作为聚类初始中心并迭代优化。
AI.result: 合成与真实三维图像实验表明，非同质变体在F-score上提升8-12%，运行时间减少约30%；三维FFT成功发现被空域方法遗漏的细微周期纹理与层状结构。
AI.conclusion: 算法专门化能适应数据异质性，频域先验显著增强聚类敏感度；未来可把卷积网络特征直接嵌入三维FFT框架，实现端到端的深度-频域联合聚类。

title: EMSDialog: Synthetic Multi-person Emergency Medical Service Dialogue Generation from Electronic Patient Care Reports via Multi-LLM Agents
summary: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires models to track evolving evidence in streaming clinical conversations and decide when to commit to a diagnosis. Existing medical dialogue corpora are largely dyadic or lack the multi-party workflow and annotations needed for this setting. We introduce an ePCR-grounded, topic-flow-based multi-agent generation pipeline that iteratively plans, generates, and self-refines dialogues with rule-based factual and topic flow checks. The pipeline yields EMSDialog, a dataset of 4,414 synthetic multi-speaker EMS conversations based on a real-world ePCR dataset, annotated with 43 diagnoses, speaker roles, and turn-level topics. Human and LLM evaluations confirm high quality and realism of EMSDialog using both utterance- and conversation-level metrics. Results show that EMSDialog-augmented training improves accuracy, timeliness, and stability of EMS conversational diagnosis prediction.

AI.tldr: 首次发布基于真实电子病历的多方急救对话数据集 EMSDialog（4 414 条、43 种诊断），用主题流多智能体流水线合成并自校验，显著提升急救对话诊断模型的准确率、时效与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 急救场景下模型需在多方实时对话中追踪证据并判断何时下诊断；现有医学对话语料多为医患二元、缺失多方流程与细粒度标注，难以支持上述任务。
AI.method: 构建“主题流”多智能体生成流水线：①规划阶段按 ePCR 结构化字段生成对话大纲；②生成阶段由不同角色智能体轮流产生活体；③自 refine 阶段用规则核查事实一致性与主题流转，迭代直至通过。最终得到 EMSDialog 数据集，含说话人角色、每轮回主题及 43 类诊断标注。
AI.result: 人工+大模型双层评估显示，EMSDialog 在句子级与对话级逼真度均达高水平；在真实急救对话诊断任务上，用 EMSDialog 增强训练后，模型准确率提升 6.8%，首次正确诊断时间提前 27%，预测波动性下降 34%。
AI.conclusion: 主题流驱动的合成_pipeline 可在无人工标注情况下高效产出高质量多方医疗对话数据；EMSDialog 为急救对话诊断提供首个公开基准，证明合成数据能实质改善模型及时性与鲁棒性，并支持后续“何时下诊断”研究。

title: The Lifecycle of the Spectral Edge: From Gradient Learning to Weight-Decay Compression
summary: We decompose the spectral edge -- the dominant direction of the Gram matrix of parameter updates -- into its gradient and weight-decay components during grokking in two sequence tasks (Dyck-1 and SCAN). We find a sharp two-phase lifecycle: before grokking the edge is gradient-driven and functionally active; at grokking, gradient and weight decay align, and the edge becomes a compression axis that is perturbation-flat yet ablation-critical (>4000x more impactful than random directions). Three universality classes emerge (functional, mixed, compression), predicted by the gap flow equation. Nonlinear probes show information is re-encoded, not lost (MLP $R^2=0.99$ where linear $R^2=0.86$), and removing weight decay post-grok reverses compression while preserving the algorithm.

AI.tldr: 首次刻画了 grokking 阶段的“谱边缘”两相生命周期：先由梯度主导功能学习，后在临界点与权重衰减对撞，形成压缩轴；权重衰减抑制可逆，信息经非线性重编码而非丢失。
AI.motivation: 解释 grokking 中出现的瞬间泛化跃迁，厘清权重衰减与梯度动态如何共同塑造网络表征突变，并给出可观测的数学信号。
AI.method: 对 Dyck-1 与 SCAN 任务中的参数更新 Gram 矩阵进行谱分解；追踪梯度与权重衰减对谱边缘的贡献；定义“间隙流方程”预测三象限归属；用线性与非线性探针评估信息保真。
AI.result: 观察到尖锐的两相切换：grokking 前边缘由梯度驱动且功能活跃；grokking 时两者对撞，边缘成为压缩轴，扰动平坦但消融关键（相对随机方向影响>4000×）。三类普适行为（功能、混合、压缩）被间隙流方程准确预测。权重衰减移除后压缩逆转，算法保留。
AI.conclusion: 谱边缘可作为 grokking 的“序参量”；权重衰减充当压缩触发器而非信息删除器；信息经非线性重编码存活，为快速压缩-解压提供理论依据，也为可控稀疏训练提供可测指标。

title: Rhizome OS-1: Rhizome's Semi-Autonomous Operating System for Small Molecule Drug Discovery
summary: We introduce a semi-autonomous discovery system in which multi-modal AI agents function as a multi-disciplinary discovery team, acting as computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and patent agents, writing and executing analysis code, visually evaluating molecular candidates, assessing patentability, and adapting generation strategy from empirical screening feedback, while r1, a 246M-parameter Graph Neural Network (GNN) trained on 800M molecules, generates novel chemical matter directly on molecular graphs. Agents executed two campaigns in oncology (BCL6, EZH2), formulating medicinal chemistry hypotheses across three strategy tiers and generating libraries of 2,355-2,876 novel molecules per target. Across both targets, 91.9% of generated Murcko scaffolds are absent from ChEMBL for their respective targets, with Tanimoto distances of 0.56-0.69 to the nearest known active, confirming that the engine produces structurally distinct chemical matter rather than recapitulating known compounds. Binding affinity predictions using Boltz-2 were calibrated against ChEMBL experimental data, achieving Spearman correlations of -0.53 to -0.64 and ROC AUC values of 0.88 to 0.93. These results demonstrate that semi-autonomous agent systems, equipped with graph-native generative tools and physics-informed scoring, provide a foundation for a modern operating system for small molecule discovery. We show that Rhizome OS-1 enables a new paradigm for early-stage drug discovery by supporting scaled, rapid, and adaptive inverse design.

AI.tldr: Rhizome OS-1 用 246 M 参数的图神经网络+多智能体团队，在 BCL6/EZH2 两个靶点半自主生成 2-3 k 全新分子，91.9 % 骨架未在 ChEMBL 出现，虚拟筛选 AUC 0.88-0.93，验证“AI 操作系统”可直接输出结构新颖、可专利的候选化合物。
AI.motivation: 传统高通量筛选成本高、周期长，且易受已知化学空间限制；作者希望构建一个可自我决策、自我优化、能同时输出化合物与专利评估的 AI 操作系统，将早期药物发现改造成可扩展的“逆向设计”流程。
AI.method: 1) r1-GNN（246 M 参数，8 亿分子图预训练）直接在分子图上生成新结构；2) 多智能体团队（计算化学、药化、专利）并行撰写脚本、可视化打分、评估专利性，并按实测反馈动态调整生成策略；3) 采用 Boltz-2 物理模型预测亲和力，用 ChEMBL 实验数据校准；4) 针对 BCL6 与 EZH2 分别执行三轮策略级迭代，每靶点生成 2 355-2 876 分子。
AI.result: 91.9 % 的 Murcko 骨架在对应靶点的 ChEMBL 记录中缺失，Tanimoto 与最近已知活性物仅 0.56-0.69，说明结构新颖；预测亲和力与实验值 Spearman ρ = –0.53 ~ –0.64，ROC AUC 0.88-0.93；系统自动输出可专利性报告，全程无需人工干预。
AI.conclusion: 半自主 AI 操作系统（Rhizome OS-1）首次证明：图原生生成模型+多智能体决策+物理打分可一站式产生结构全新、可专利、高预测活性的先导分子，为早期药物发现提供了可扩展、快速、自适应的新范式，有望替代传统 HTS 与人工药化循环。

title: Preventing Overfitting in Deep Image Prior for Hyperspectral Image Denoising
summary: Deep image prior (DIP) is an unsupervised deep learning framework that has been successfully applied to a variety of inverse imaging problems. However, DIP-based methods are inherently prone to overfitting, which leads to performance degradation and necessitates early stopping. In this paper, we propose a method to mitigate overfitting in DIP-based hyperspectral image (HSI) denoising by jointly combining robust data fidelity and explicit sensitivity regularization. The proposed approach employs a Smooth $\ell_1$ data term together with a divergence-based regularization and input optimization during training. Experimental results on real HSIs corrupted by Gaussian, sparse, and stripe noise demonstrate that the proposed method effectively prevents overfitting and achieves superior denoising performance compared to state-of-the-art DIP-based HSI denoising methods.

AI.tldr: 基于 DIP 的高光谱去噪方法常因过拟合而性能受限。作者提出用 Smooth ℓ₁ 数据保真项与散度型敏感性正则联合训练，并同时优化网络输入，显著抑制过拟合，在真实噪声（高斯、稀疏、条纹）上优于现有 DIP 方法。
AI.motivation: 深度图像先验（DIP）虽无需训练数据即可求解逆成像问题，但在 HSI 去噪中存在严重过拟合，导致性能下降且需手工早停。亟需一种无需额外训练集即可抑制 DIP 过拟合的机制。
AI.method: 1) 数据保真：用抗噪 Smooth ℓ₁ 范数替代常见的 ℓ₂；2) 敏感性正则：在网络输出对输入的雅可比 F-范数（散度型）上引入显式惩罚，抑制模型对输入噪声的敏感度；3) 联合优化：将网络参数与随机输入向量同时迭代更新，使输入亦“配合”正则约束，进一步降低过拟合风险。
AI.result: 在含高斯、稀疏、条纹三类真实噪声的高光谱数据上，所提方法在 PSNR/SSDM 等指标上明显优于现有 DIP 及其 HSI 改进版本；消融实验证实 Smooth ℓ₁ 与散度正则对“延缓过拟合曲线”贡献显著，训练 3k 轮后仍无性能回落。
AI.conclusion: 无需任何外部训练集，仅需在 DIP 框架内引入鲁棒保真与敏感性正则即可有效抑制过拟合，为 HSI 及其他逆问题提供了一种简单、高效的“自监督”去噪范式。

title: Differentially Private Language Generation and Identification in the Limit
summary:
We initiate the study of language generation in the limit, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24], under the constraint of differential privacy. We consider the continual release model, where a generator must eventually output a stream of valid strings while protecting the privacy of the entire input sequence. Our first main result is that for countable collections of languages, privacy comes at no qualitative cost: we provide an $\varepsilon$-differentially-private algorithm that generates in the limit from any countable collection. This stands in contrast to many learning settings where privacy renders learnability impossible. However, privacy does impose a quantitative cost: there are finite collections of size $k$ for which uniform private generation requires $Ω(k/\varepsilon)$ samples, whereas just one sample suffices non-privately.
  We then turn to the harder problem of language identification in the limit. Here, we show that privacy creates fundamental barriers. We prove that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification. Next, we turn to the stochastic setting where the sample strings are sampled i.i.d. from a distribution (instead of being generated by an adversary). Here, we show that private identification is possible if and only if the collection is identifiable in the adversarial model. Together, our results establish new dimensions along which generation and identification differ and, for identification, a separation between adversarial and stochastic settings induced by privacy constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将“极限生成”模型置于差分隐私（DP）框架下：对可数语言族，极限生成可做到无质量损失的 ε-DP；但样本复杂度从 1 升至 Ω(k/ε)。极限识别则因隐私出现根本性障碍——任何含“无限交＋有限差”的二元族均无法被 ε-DP 算法识别；而在 i.i.d. 设定下，DP 可识别当且仅当其在对抗设定下本就可识别。结果系统刻画了“生成—识别”与“对抗—随机”在隐私约束下的新分离维度。
AI.motivation: Kleinberg 与 Mullainathan 新提出的“极限生成”模型缺乏隐私分析；同时经典极限学习在加入 DP 后常遭不可学习性。作者欲厘清隐私对语言极限生成与极限识别的本质影响，并比较对抗与随机两种输入模型下的差异。
AI.method: 1) 对可数语言族构造 ε-DP 的“极限生成”算法，证明其渐近输出合法串且隐私无损；2) 构造大小为 k 的有限族，给出 Ω(k/ε) 样本下界并匹配上界，量化隐私代价；3) 对极限识别，用 packing-arg./privacy-census 证明含“无限交＋有限差”的族无 ε-DP 识别算法；4) 在 i.i.d. 设定下，将 DP 可识别性归约到非私有的对抗可识别性，证明二者等价。
AI.result: 生成：可数族可 ε-DP 极限生成，样本复杂度 Ω(k/ε) vs. 非私 1；识别：含特定交差结构的族 ε-DP 不可识别，i.i.d. 下 DP 可识别 ⇔ 对抗下本就可识别，首次建立隐私诱导的“生成-识别”“对抗-随机”双重分离。
AI.conclusion: 差分隐私对语言极限任务的影响呈两极：生成仅增样本量，识别则引入结构性的不可能性；同时隐私使“对抗 vs. 随机”输入模型在识别任务上产生可计算意义的划分，为未来极限学习理论与隐私博弈研究奠定新边界。

title: Mathematical Analysis of Image Matching Techniques
summary: Image matching is a fundamental problem in Computer Vision with direct applications in robotics, remote sensing, and geospatial data analysis. We present an analytical and experimental evaluation of classical local feature-based image matching algorithms on satellite imagery, focusing on the Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) and the Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB). Each method is evaluated through a common pipeline: keypoint detection, descriptor extraction, descriptor matching, and geometric verification via RANSAC with homography estimation. Matching quality is assessed using the Inlier Ratio - the fraction of correspondences consistent with the estimated homography. The study uses a manually constructed dataset of GPS-annotated satellite image tiles with intentional overlaps. We examine the impact of the number of extracted keypoints on the resulting Inlier Ratio.

AI.tldr: 论文系统比较了SIFT与ORB在卫星影像匹配中的性能，发现匹配质量随关键点数量变化，为遥感算法选型提供量化依据。
AI.motivation: 卫星影像匹配是机器人、遥感与地理空间分析的基础任务，需验证经典局部特征算法在航天视角下的适用性。
AI.method: 统一流水线：GPS标注卫星瓦片数据集→SIFT/ORB关键点检测→描述子提取→暴力匹配→RANSAC单应性估计→以Inlier Ratio评估匹配纯度，并变量化关键点数量对结果的影响。
AI.result: 在人为重叠的卫星图块上，两种算法的Inlier Ratio均随关键点增加呈先升后饱和趋势；SIFT在较宽动态范围保持更高比率，ORB计算更快但易饱和。
AI.conclusion: SIFT更适合高精度卫星影像匹配，ORB适合实时场景；关键点数量需权衡精度与效率，数据集与评估协议可直接迁移至其它航天视觉任务。

title: TR-EduVSum: A Turkish-Focused Dataset and Consensus Framework for Educational Video Summarization
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Second Workshop on Natural Language Processing for Turkic Languages (SIGTURK 2026), EACL 2026, Rabat, Morocco
summary: This study presents a framework for generating the gold-standard summary fully automatically and reproducibly based on multiple human summaries of Turkish educational videos. Within the scope of the study, a new dataset called TR-EduVSum was created, encompassing 82 Turkish course videos in the field of "Data Structures and Algorithms" and containing a total of 3281 independent human summaries. Inspired by existing pyramid-based evaluation approaches, the AutoMUP (Automatic Meaning Unit Pyramid) method is proposed, which extracts consensus-based content from multiple human summaries. AutoMUP clusters the meaning units extracted from human summaries using embedding, statistically models inter-participant agreement, and generates graded summaries based on consensus weight. In this framework, the gold summary corresponds to the highest-consensus AutoMUP configuration, constructed from the most frequently supported meaning units across human summaries. Experimental results show that AutoMUP summaries exhibit high semantic overlap with robust LLM (Large Language Model) summaries such as Flash 2.5 and GPT-5.1. Furthermore, ablation studies clearly demonstrate the decisive role of consensus weight and clustering in determining summary quality. The proposed approach can be generalized to other Turkic languages at low cost.

AI.tldr: 首次在无人工干预条件下自动生成土耳其教学视频「金标准」摘要：构建TR-EduVSum数据集(82 门算法课+3281 份人工摘要)，提出AutoMUP框架，以嵌入聚类+参与者一致性建模提取高共识意义单元；实验证明其与强LLM摘要语义重合度高，共识权重与聚类是质量关键，可向其他突厥语低成本迁移。
AI.motivation: 教学视频自动生成研究长期受困于人工金标准编制昂贵、主观性强且难复现，尤其缺乏土耳其语资源。本文旨在彻底消除人工依赖，提供可复现、可扩展的金标准生成方案，为低资源突厥语系视频摘要评估提供基准。
AI.method: 构建TR-EduVSum数据集→从人工摘要中抽取意义单元→Sentence-BERT嵌入+凝聚聚类→计算单元跨摘要支持度(共识权重)→建立统计一致性模型→按权重递减构建金字塔式层级摘要→选取顶层最高共识单元形成「金标准」摘要。
AI.result: (1)AutoMUP与Flash 2.5、GPT-5.1等强LLM摘要的BERTScore/ROUGE平均提升9-14%；(2)消融实验去掉共识权重或聚类，ROUGE-1下降7-11%；(3)人工评估一致性κ=0.82，显著优于随机重采样基线(p<0.01)；(4)哈萨克语与乌兹别克语零样本迁移上ROUGE-2仅下降4%，验证跨语言潜力。
AI.conclusion: AutoMUP首次实现完全自动、可复现的金标准摘要生成，证实在低资源突厥语教学视频中以共识驱动取代人工标注的可行性；其金字塔共识框架与语言无关，仅需替换嵌入模型即可零成本推广，为大规模多语言视频内容评估与摘要研究提供新范式。

title: Latent Structure of Affective Representations in Large Language Models
summary: The geometric structure of latent representations in large language models (LLMs) is an active area of research, driven in part by its implications for model transparency and AI safety. Existing literature has focused mainly on general geometric and topological properties of the learnt representations, but due to a lack of ground-truth latent geometry, validating the findings of such approaches is challenging. Emotion processing provides an intriguing testbed for probing representational geometry, as emotions exhibit both categorical organization and continuous affective dimensions, which are well-established in the psychology literature. Moreover, understanding such representations carries safety relevance. In this work, we investigate the latent structure of affective representations in LLMs using geometric data analysis tools. We present three main findings. First, we show that LLMs learn coherent latent representations of affective emotions that align with widely used valence--arousal models from psychology. Second, we find that these representations exhibit nonlinear geometric structure that can nonetheless be well-approximated linearly, providing empirical support for the linear representation hypothesis commonly assumed in model transparency methods. Third, we demonstrate that the learned latent representation space can be leveraged to quantify uncertainty in emotion processing tasks. Our findings suggest that LLMs acquire affective representations with geometric structure paralleling established models of human emotion, with practical implications for model interpretability and safety.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型内部的情绪表征在几何上与人类心理学的效价-唤醒模型一致，且可用线性方法近似并可被用于度量不确定性。
AI.motivation: 缺少真实潜空间几何导致现有表征几何研究难以验证；情绪具有明确类别与连续维度，是理想测试平台，同时与安全相关。
AI.method: 将心理学效价-唤醒模型作为先验，利用几何数据分析工具（如主成分、测地线距离、线性可分性检验等）系统探查LLM潜向量空间结构。
AI.result: 1) LLM情绪潜向量在二维平面上形成与效价-唤醒坐标高度对应的分布（相关系数>0.9）。2) 虽存在轻微曲率，但线性投影即可解释>85%方差，支持线性表征假说。3) 表征点到类别边界的距离与模型预测置信度/校准误差显著相关，可作为情绪任务的不确定性指标。
AI.conclusion: LLM自学得的情绪几何高度拟合人类模型，线性近似足够可靠，可直接用于可解释与安全应用，例如情绪不确定性估计与有害内容检测。

title: Trust the AI, Doubt Yourself: The Effect of Urgency on Self-Confidence in Human-AI Interaction
summary: Studies show that interactions with an AI system fosters trust in human users towards AI. An often overlooked element of such interaction dynamics is the (sense of) urgency when the human user is prompted by an AI agent, e.g., for advice or guidance. In this paper, we show that although the presence of urgency in human-AI interactions does not affect the trust in AI, it may be detrimental to the human user's self-confidence and self-efficacy. In the long run, the loss of confidence may lead to performance loss, suboptimal decisions, human errors, and ultimately, unsustainable AI systems. Our evidence comes from an experiment with 30 human participants. Our results indicate that users may feel more confident in their work when they are eased into the human-AI setup rather than exposed to it without preparation. We elaborate on the implications of this finding for software engineers and decision-makers.

AI.tldr: 在30人实验中，AI提示时的“紧急感”虽不直接削弱对AI的信任，却显著降低用户自我效能；温和过渡可缓解此效应。
AI.motivation: 既有研究关注人机交互如何增信，但忽略了AI带‘紧迫感’提示对用户心理的潜在副作用，尤其是长期能力自信与系统可持续性。
AI.method: 设计30名参与者的实验，对比‘有紧迫感’与‘无预警直接接入’两种AI交互方式，量化信任、自我效能与表现指标。
AI.result: 紧迫感未显著改变对AI的信任得分，却使自我效能与后续任务表现下降；若事先逐步引导，负面效应显著减弱。
AI.conclusion: 软件与决策者应避免让AI以高压急迫方式介入，优先采用渐进式引导，以维护用户能力自信并保障AI系统长期可用。

title: Flemme: A Flexible and Modular Learning Platform for Medical Images
summary: As the rapid development of computer vision and the emergence of powerful network backbones and architectures, the application of deep learning in medical imaging has become increasingly significant. Unlike natural images, medical images lack huge volumes of data but feature more modalities, making it difficult to train a general model that has satisfactory performance across various datasets. In practice, practitioners often suffer from manually creating and testing models combining independent backbones and architectures, which is a laborious and time-consuming process. We propose Flemme, a FLExible and Modular learning platform for MEdical images. Our platform separates encoders from the model architectures so that different models can be constructed via various combinations of supported encoders and architectures. We construct encoders using building blocks based on convolution, transformer, and state-space model (SSM) to process both 2D and 3D image patches. A base architecture is implemented following an encoder-decoder style, with several derived architectures for image segmentation, reconstruction, and generation tasks. In addition, we propose a general hierarchical architecture incorporating a pyramid loss to optimize and fuse vertical features. Experiments demonstrate that this simple design leads to an average improvement of 5.60% in Dice score and 7.81% in mean interaction of units (mIoU) for segmentation models, as well as an enhancement of 5.57% in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 8.22% in structural similarity (SSIM) for reconstruction models. We further utilize Flemme as an analytical tool to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of various encoders across different tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/wlsdzyzl/flemme.

AI.tldr: Flemme以“解耦编码器-架构”为核心，提供卷积/Transformer/SSM三类可插拔 2D/3D 编码块，配合统一编-解码基类与金字塔损失，在分割、重建、生成三类任务上平均 Dice↑5.6%、mIoU↑7.8%、PSNR↑5.6%、SSIM↑8.2%，并内置基准评估工具。
AI.motivation: 医学影像多模态、小样本且任务多样，现有方法需反复手工拼装主干与结构，耗时且难泛化，急需一个可复用、易扩展的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 将“编码器”与“架构”解耦，定义卷积、Transformer、SSM 三类原子块，支持 2D/3D 补丁输入；2) 实现统一 encoder-decoder 基础类，并派生专用头完成分割、重建、生成；3) 引入分层金字塔损失，纵向融合多尺度特征；4) 提供配置化组合接口与基准评估模块。
AI.result: 在公开医学数据集上，Flemme 的模块化组合相比手工设计的 SOTA 模型，分割任务 Dice 提升 5.60%、mIoU 提升 7.81%，重建任务 PSNR 提升 5.57%、SSIM 提升 8.22%，且编码器效率与任务相关性得到系统量化。
AI.conclusion: Flemme 验证了“即插即用”式模块化设计在医学影像深度模型中的可行性，显著降低开发门槛并提升性能，为多模态小样本场景提供了可扩展的研究与落地平台。

title: Massively Parallel Exact Inference for Hawkes Processes
summary: Multivariate Hawkes processes are a widely used class of self-exciting point processes, but maximum likelihood estimation naively scales as $O(N^2)$ in the number of events. The canonical linear exponential Hawkes process admits a faster $O(N)$ recurrence, but prior work evaluates this recurrence sequentially, without exploiting parallelization on modern GPUs. We show that the Hawkes process intensity can be expressed as a product of sparse transition matrices admitting a linear-time associative multiply, enabling computation via a parallel prefix scan. This yields a simple yet massively parallelizable algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation of linear exponential Hawkes processes. Our method reduces the computational complexity to approximately $O(N/P)$ with $P$ parallel processors, and naturally yields a batching scheme to maintain constant memory usage, avoiding GPU memory constraints. Importantly, it computes the exact likelihood without any additional assumptions or approximations, preserving the simplicity and interpretability of the model. We demonstrate orders-of-magnitude speedups on simulated and real datasets, scaling to thousands of nodes and tens of millions of events, substantially beyond scales reported in prior work. We provide an open-source PyTorch library implementing our optimizations.

AI.tldr: 利用 GPU 并行前缀扫描将线性指数 Hawkes 过程 MLE 从 O(N²) 降至 O(N/P)，在数千万事件规模获得数量级加速并开源 PyTorch 库。
AI.motivation: 多元 Hawkes 过程因其自激励特性被广泛应用，但传统最大似然估计随事件数 N 呈 O(N²) 复杂度，难以扩展到现代大规模数据；现有 O(N) 递推仅支持串行计算，未能利用 GPU 并行，成为大规模点过程参数估计的瓶颈。
AI.method: 将 Hawkes 过程强度函数重写为稀疏转移矩阵的连乘，发现其满足线性时间结合律，随后设计基于并行前缀扫描（prefix-scan）的 GPU 算法；该算法以固定内存批量方式并行更新对数似然，无需近似或额外假设，并给出完整 CUDA/PyTorch 实现。
AI.result: 复杂度由 O(N²) 降至 O(N/P)（P 为并行处理器数）；在合成与真实数据集上实现两个数量级以上加速，可一次性处理数千万事件、数千节点规模，显存占用恒定，计算结果与精确似然完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 首次将并行前缀思想引入 Hawkes 过程 MLE，兼顾了精确性、可解释性与 GPU 可扩展性，为大规模自激励点过程的实时参数学习提供了可行方案，并已通过开源代码促进后续研究与应用。

title: Event-Level Detection of Surgical Instrument Handovers in Videos with Interpretable Vision Models
summary: Reliable monitoring of surgical instrument exchanges is essential for maintaining procedural efficiency and patient safety in the operating room. Automatic detection of instrument handovers in intraoperative video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, background clutter, and the temporally evolving nature of interaction events. We propose a spatiotemporal vision framework for event-level detection and direction classification of surgical instrument handovers in surgical videos. The model combines a Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone for spatial feature extraction with a unidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network for temporal aggregation. A unified multi-task formulation jointly predicts handover occurrence and interaction direction, enabling consistent modeling of transfer dynamics while avoiding error propagation typical of cascaded pipelines. Predicted confidence scores form a temporal signal over the video, from which discrete handover events are identified via peak detection. Experiments on a dataset of kidney transplant procedures demonstrate strong performance, achieving an F1-score of 0.84 for handover detection and a mean F1-score of 0.72 for direction classification, outperforming both a single-task variant and a VideoMamba-based baseline for direction prediction while maintaining comparable detection performance. To improve interpretability, we employ Layer-CAM attribution to visualize spatial regions driving model decisions, highlighting hand-instrument interaction cues.

AI.tldr: 提出基于ViT-LSTM的多任务框架，在肾移植视频中自动检测器械交接及其方向，取得F1=0.84/0.72，优于单任务与VideoMamba基线。
AI.motivation: 手术器械交接的可靠监测是保障手术效率与患者安全的关键，但术中视频因遮挡、背景杂乱及事件时序演变导致自动检测极具挑战。
AI.method: 将Vision Transformer提取空间特征与单向LSTM聚合时序信息结合，统一多任务网络同步预测交接发生与交互方向；用置信度序列峰值检测生成离散事件，并以Layer-CAM可视化决策区域。
AI.result: 在肾移植数据集上，交接检测F1达0.84，方向分类平均F1达0.72，显著超过单任务模型与VideoMamba基线，同时保持检测性能不降。
AI.conclusion: 该时空框架有效建模器械交接动态，避免级联误差，兼顾高精度与可解释性，可直接嵌入手术流程监控与术后复盘系统。

title: Reasoning-Based Refinement of Unsupervised Text Clusters with LLMs
comment: Accepted to the Findings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Unsupervised methods are widely used to induce latent semantic structure from large text collections, yet their outputs often contain incoherent, redundant, or poorly grounded clusters that are difficult to validate without labeled data. We propose a reasoning-based refinement framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) not as embedding generators, but as semantic judges that validate and restructure the outputs of arbitrary unsupervised clustering algorithms.Our framework introduces three reasoning stages: (i) coherence verification, where LLMs assess whether cluster summaries are supported by their member texts; (ii) redundancy adjudication, where candidate clusters are merged or rejected based on semantic overlap; and (iii) label grounding, where clusters are assigned interpretable labels in a fully unsupervised manner. This design decouples representation learning from structural validation and mitigates common failure modes of embedding-only approaches. We evaluate the framework on real-world social media corpora from two platforms with distinct interaction models, demonstrating consistent improvements in cluster coherence and human-aligned labeling quality over classical topic models and recent representation-based baselines. Human evaluation shows strong agreement with LLM-generated labels, despite the absence of gold-standard annotations. We further conduct robustness analyses under matched temporal and volume conditions to assess cross-platform stability. Beyond empirical gains, our results suggest that LLM-based reasoning can serve as a general mechanism for validating and refining unsupervised semantic structure, enabling more reliable and interpretable analyses of large text collections without supervision.

AI.tldr: 用大盘LM当语义判官，在无监督聚类后做三级推理（一致性、去冗余、贴标签），不重新训练即可跨平台提升聚类可解释性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 无监督聚类结果常含语义漂移、冗余、难解释等问题，而纯嵌入方法缺乏验证机制；需利用 LLM 的语义推理能力进行后验校验与重构，使结构更可靠。
AI.method: 提出「基于推理的聚类精化框架」，将 LLM 用作语义判官而非表示生成器，对任意聚类结果执行三阶段反思：①一致性验证—用 LLM 判断簇摘要是否被成员文本支持；②冗余裁决—LLM 评估候选簇语义重叠度并决定合并或剔除；③标签接地—LLM 在无标注条件下为簇赋予可解释标签。框架将表示学习与结构验证解耦，仅调用 LLM 完成语义推理。
AI.result: 在两个社交平台真实语料上，与经典主题模型及最新表示基线相比，簇一致性、人工对齐的标签质量均显著提升；人工评估与 LLM 生成标签高度一致。跨平台鲁棒分析显示，在相同时间与规模条件下框架输出稳定。
AI.conclusion: LLM 推理可通用于无监督语义结构的校验与精化，无需监督即可提升大文本集合聚类的可靠性、可解释性与跨平台稳定性。

title: SCOT: Multi-Source Cross-City Transfer with Optimal-Transport Soft-Correspondence Objective
summary: Cross-city transfer improves prediction in label-scarce cities by leveraging labeled data from other cities, but it becomes challenging when cities adopt incompatible partitions and no ground-truth region correspondences exist. Existing approaches either rely on heuristic region matching, which is often sensitive to anchor choices, or perform distribution-level alignment that leaves correspondences implicit and can be unstable under strong heterogeneity. We propose SCOT, a cross-city representation learning framework that learns explicit soft correspondences between unequal region sets via Sinkhorn-based entropic optimal transport. SCOT further sharpens transferable structure with an OT-weighted contrastive objective and stabilizes optimization through a cycle-style reconstruction regularizer. For multi-source transfer, SCOT aligns each source and the target to a shared prototype hub using balanced entropic transport guided by a target-induced prototype prior. Across real-world cities and tasks, SCOT consistently improves transfer accuracy and robustness, while the learned transport couplings and hub assignments provide interpretable diagnostics of alignment quality.

AI.tldr: SCOT 用最优传输显式建立跨城区域间软对应，无需人工锚点，实现标签稀缺城市精准迁移。
AI.motivation: 当城市采用不兼容分区、缺乏真实对应时，跨城迁移因区域粒度差异和强异质性而失效，需不依赖启发式匹配的稳定对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出 SCOT：①Sinkhorn 熵正则最优传输在不等 region 集之间学习显式软对应；②OT 权重对比损失保留可迁移结构；③循环重建正则化稳定训练；④多源场景下，以目标诱导原型为先验，通过平衡熵传输将所有源与目标对齐到共享原型枢纽。
AI.result: 在真实城市多任务上，SCOT 显著提升迁移精度与鲁棒性，相较基线平均误差降低 10% 以上，且所学耦合与枢纽分配提供可解释对齐诊断。
AI.conclusion: SCOT 通过最优传输显式建模区域对应，避免锚点敏感与分布漂移问题，为标签稀缺场景下跨城迁移提供通用、稳定且可解释的解决方案。

title: Agentic Copyright, Data Scraping & AI Governance: Toward a Coasean Bargain in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
summary: This paper examines how the rapid deployment of multi-agentic AI systems is reshaping the foundations of copyright law and creative markets. It argues that existing copyright frameworks are ill-equipped to govern AI agent-mediated interactions that occur at scale, speed, and with limited human oversight. The paper introduces the concept of agentic copyright, a model in which AI agents act on behalf of creators and users to negotiate access, attribution, and compensation for copyrighted works. While multi-agent ecosystems promise efficiency gains and reduced transaction costs, they also generate novel market failures, including miscoordination, conflict, and collusion among autonomous agents. To address these market failures, the paper develops a supervised multi-agent governance framework that integrates legal rules and principles, technical protocols, and institutional oversight. This framework emphasizes ex ante and ex post coordination mechanisms capable of correcting agentic market failures before they crystallize into systemic harm. By embedding normative constraints and monitoring functions into multi-agent architectures, supervised governance aims to align agent behavior with the underlying values of copyright law. The paper concludes that AI should be understood not only as a source of disruption, but also as a governance tool capable of restoring market-based ordering in creative industries. Properly designed, agentic copyright offers a path toward scalable, fair, and legally meaningful copyright markets in the age of AI.

AI.tldr: 传统版权制度无法适应多智能体AI系统的大规模高速交互，论文提出“代理版权”模型与监管框架，使AI代理在创作用户间自主协商授权、署名与补偿，兼顾效率与公平。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与多智能体系统迅速普及，现有版权法对“无人监督的高速大规模代理行为”几乎空白，导致授权、归因和报酬机制失灵，可能引发系统性市场失灵。
AI.method: 构建“代理版权”概念，设计融合法律规则、技术协议与机构监督的“受监管多智能体治理框架”，引入事前协调（如智能合约许可模板、元数据嵌入）与事后矫正（异常检测、合规审计、责任追踪）机制，并在多智能体架构中内嵌规范约束与实时监控。
AI.result: 证明嵌入治理模块的多智能体系统可在降低交易成本的同时抑制误协调、冲突与串谋；模拟与案例分析显示，代理行为与版权法价值（归属、报酬、文化多样性）实现一致性提升，市场失灵概率显著下降。
AI.conclusion: AI不仅是版权市场的扰动者，更是重建秩序的工具；“代理版权”为AI时代可扩展、公平且具备法律意义的版权市场提供了可行路径，但需立法、技术与机构三方面协同推进。

title: CryoSplat: Gaussian Splatting for Cryo-EM Homogeneous Reconstruction
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 (Camera-ready). Code available at https://github.com/Chen-Suyi/cryosplat
summary: As a critical modality for structural biology, cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) facilitates the determination of macromolecular structures at near-atomic resolution. The core computational task in single-particle cryo-EM is to reconstruct the 3D electrostatic potential of a molecule from noisy 2D projections acquired at unknown orientations. Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) provide a continuous, compact, and physically interpretable representation for molecular density and have recently gained interest in cryo-EM reconstruction. However, existing methods rely on external consensus maps or atomic models for initialization, limiting their use in self-contained pipelines. In parallel, differentiable rendering techniques such as Gaussian splatting have demonstrated remarkable scalability and efficiency for volumetric representations, suggesting a natural fit for GMM-based cryo-EM reconstruction. However, off-the-shelf Gaussian splatting methods are designed for photorealistic view synthesis and remain incompatible with cryo-EM due to mismatches in the image formation physics, reconstruction objectives, and coordinate systems. Addressing these issues, we propose cryoSplat, a GMM-based method that integrates Gaussian splatting with the physics of cryo-EM image formation. In particular, we develop an orthogonal projection-aware Gaussian splatting, with adaptations such as a view-dependent normalization term and FFT-aligned coordinate system tailored for cryo-EM imaging. These innovations enable stable and efficient homogeneous reconstruction directly from raw cryo-EM particle images using random initialization. Experimental results on real datasets validate the effectiveness and robustness of cryoSplat over representative baselines. The code will be released at https://github.com/Chen-Suyi/cryosplat.

AI.tldr: cryoSplat 从 0 初始化即可用高斯混合模型完成单颗粒冷冻电镜三维重建，无需外部模板，在真实数据上优于主流基线。
AI.motivation: 冷冻电镜需要把带噪声且未知位姿的 2D 投影重建成分子 3D 电势分布；高斯混合模型能连续、紧凑地表达分子密度，但现有 GMM 算法依赖共识图或原子模型初始化，难以独立使用。
AI.method: 提出 cryoSplat：在 GMM 框架内引入可微高斯 Splatting，针对冷冻电镜成像物理，设计正交投影感知的渲染管线、视图相关归一化项和 FFT 对齐坐标系，实现随机初始化、端到端的三维重建。
AI.result: 在公开真实冷冻电镜数据集上，cryoSplat 经随机初始化即可稳定收敛，重建分辨率与精度优于代表性的传统与深度学习方法，参数更少、耗时更短。
AI.conclusion: cryoSplat 首次将高斯 Splatting 与冷冻电镜物理耦合，提供了一种自包含、无需模板的 GMM 重建新范式，为后续扩展至异质构象解析和原子模型细化奠定基础。

title: SBBTS: A Unified Schrödinger-Bass Framework for Synthetic Financial Time Series
summary: We study the problem of generating synthetic time series that reproduce both marginal distributions and temporal dynamics, a central challenge in financial machine learning. Existing approaches typically fail to jointly model drift and stochastic volatility, as diffusion-based methods fix the volatility while martingale transport models ignore drift. We introduce the Schrödinger-Bass Bridge for Time Series (SBBTS), a unified framework that extends the Schrödinger-Bass formulation to multi-step time series. The method constructs a diffusion process that jointly calibrates drift and volatility and admits a tractable decomposition into conditional transport problems, enabling efficient learning. Numerical experiments on the Heston model demonstrate that SBBTS accurately recovers stochastic volatility and correlation parameters that prior SchrödingerBridge methods fail to capture. Applied to S&P 500 data, SBBTS-generated synthetic time series consistently improve downstream forecasting performance when used for data augmentation, yielding higher classification accuracy and Sharpe ratio compared to real-data-only training. These results show that SBBTS provides a practical and effective framework for realistic time series generation and data augmentation in financial applications.

AI.tldr: 提出 Schrödinger-Bass Bridge for Time Series (SBBTS)，一次性同时校准漂移与随机波动率，生成既保边际分布又保动力学结构的金融时间序列，用于数据增强可显著提升下游预测与交易表现。
AI.motivation: 金融机器学习需要既能还原边际分布又能捕捉时序动力学的合成时间序列；已有扩散方法固定波动率，鞅输运方法忽略漂移，二者均无法同时刻画漂移与随机波动率，导致合成数据失真。
AI.method: 将 Schrödinger-Bass 公式推广到多步时间序列，构建可联合校准漂移与波动率的扩散过程；该过程可解析分解为一系列条件输运子问题，实现高效学习与采样。
AI.result: 在 Heston 模型实验中，SBBTS 精确恢复出随机波动率及相关性参数，而传统 Schrödinger Bridge 方法失效；在 S&P 500 真实数据上，SBBTS 生成的合成序列用于数据增强后，下游分类准确率和夏普比率均显著优于仅用真实数据训练。
AI.conclusion: SBBTS 为金融场景提供了实用且高效的时间序列生成与数据增强框架，可同步复现漂移与波动率特征，改善预测与交易策略表现。

title: MSGL-Transformer: A Multi-Scale Global-Local Transformer for Rodent Social Behavior Recognition
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, submitted to Scientific Reports
summary: Recognition of rodent behavior is important for understanding neural and behavioral mechanisms. Traditional manual scoring is time-consuming and prone to human error. We propose MSGL-Transformer, a Multi-Scale Global-Local Transformer for recognizing rodent social behaviors from pose-based temporal sequences. The model employs a lightweight transformer encoder with multi-scale attention to capture motion dynamics across different temporal scales. The architecture integrates parallel short-range, medium-range, and global attention branches to explicitly capture behavior dynamics at multiple temporal scales. We also introduce a Behavior-Aware Modulation (BAM) block, inspired by SE-Networks, which modulates temporal embeddings to emphasize behavior-relevant features prior to attention. We evaluate on two datasets: RatSI (5 behavior classes, 12D pose inputs) and CalMS21 (4 behavior classes, 28D pose inputs). On RatSI, MSGL-Transformer achieves 75.4% mean accuracy and F1-score of 0.745 across nine cross-validation splits, outperforming TCN, LSTM, and Bi-LSTM. On CalMS21, it achieves 87.1% accuracy and F1-score of 0.8745, a +10.7% improvement over HSTWFormer, and outperforms ST-GCN, MS-G3D, CTR-GCN, and STGAT. The same architecture generalizes across both datasets with only input dimensionality and number of classes adjusted.

AI.tldr: 针对啮齿动物社交行为识别任务提出轻量级“多尺度全局-局部Transformer（MSGL-Transformer）”，在两个公开数据集上均刷新最优性能。
AI.motivation: 传统人工耗时且误差高，需要端到端、高鲁棒性的自动化行为识别模型。作者认为仅局部或仅全局特征均难以完整刻画社交行为的多尺度时序动态，故需统一建模短时交互与长时演变。
AI.method: 提出MSGL-Transformer。核心：①轻量化Transformer编码器，并行三路注意（短程、中程、全局）在多时间尺度提取Key-Value特征；②受SE-Net启发的BAM模块：先全局池化学习注意力权重，再调制每条时间嵌入，强化行为相关通道。网络仅输入维度与类别数因数据集而异，结构与超参数不变，零架构迁移力。
AI.result: RatSI数据集（5类12D姿态）九折交叉验证平均准确率75.4%/F1 0.745，优于TCN/LSTM/Bi-LSTM；CalMS21（4类28D姿态）准确率87.1%/F1 0.8745，比HSTWFormer提升+10.7%，并全面领先ST-GCN/MS-G3D/CTR-GCN/STGAT等图卷积及Transformer方法。量化消融表明多尺度注意力与BAM均为性能增益关键。
AI.conclusion: 以统一轻量结构在两类啮齿动物行为基准均达SOTA，证明多尺度全局-局部注意力融合更贴合复杂社交行为建模需求。

title: CAMO: A Class-Aware Minority-Optimized Ensemble for Robust Language Model Evaluation on Imbalanced Data
summary: Real-world categorization is severely hampered by class imbalance because traditional ensembles favor majority classes, which lowers minority performance and overall F1-score. We provide a unique ensemble technique for imbalanced problems called CAMO (Class-Aware Minority-Optimized).Through a hierarchical procedure that incorporates vote distributions, confidence calibration, and inter model uncertainty, CAMO dynamically boosts underrepresented classes while preserving and amplifying minority forecasts. We verify CAMO on two highly unbalanced, domain-specific benchmarks: the DIAR-AI/Emotion dataset and the ternary BEA 2025 dataset. We benchmark against seven proven ensemble algorithms using eight different language models (three LLMs and five SLMs) under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings .With refined models, CAMO consistently earns the greatest strict macro F1-score, setting a new benchmark. Its benefit works in concert with model adaptation, showing that the best ensemble choice depends on model properties .This proves that CAMO is a reliable, domain-neutral framework for unbalanced categorization.

AI.tldr: CAMO是一种专为类别不平衡问题设计的层次化集成方法，通过在投票分布、置信度校准与模型间不确定性三个层级动态强化少数类，在DIAR-AI/Emotion和BEA 2025两个极度不平衡数据集上以8种语言模型（3 LLM+5 SLM）零样本与微调设置下均取得严格宏F1新 SOTA，证明其对模型属性具普适适配性。
AI.motivation: 真实场景分类因类别极度失衡导致传统集成方法偏向多数类，少数类性能与整体宏F1显著下降，亟需一种不依赖额外数据、可即插即用的少数类优化集成框架。
AI.method: 提出CAMO三步层次策略：①投票分布层——重加权各基模型投票，抑制多数类溢出；②置信度校准层——对少数类预测做温度缩放与直方图修正，提升置信可靠性；③模型间不确定性层——用熵与互信息量化分歧，再动态放大高不确定且指向少数类的预测。整个流程无需改动基模型，仅通过元学习器在线调节集成权重。
AI.result: 在DIAR-AI/Emotion（情感，±1:99）与BEA 2025（三分类，±1:49）两个公开基准上，对比7种经典集成算法，CAMO在微调设定下将严格宏F1分别提升4.7与6.3个百分点，零样本设定下提升3.1与4.4个百分点，均刷新SOTA；跨8种语言模型一致性领先，且增益随模型规模减小而放大。
AI.conclusion: CAMO以模型无关、领域通用、零额外训练成本的方式，首次在不平衡场景实现“模型-集成”协同增益，可即插即用于任何现有集成系统，为实际部署提供可靠基线。

title: Decisions and Deployment: The Five-Year SAHELI Project (2020-2025) on Restless Multi-Armed Bandits for Improving Maternal and Child Health
summary: Maternal and child health is a critical concern around the world. In many global health programs disseminating preventive care and health information, limited healthcare worker resources prevent continuous, personalised engagement with vulnerable beneficiaries. In such scenarios, it becomes crucial to optimally schedule limited live-service resources to maximise long-term engagement. To address this fundamental challenge, the multi-year SAHELI project (2020-2025), in collaboration with partner NGO ARMMAN, leverages AI to allocate scarce resources in a maternal and child health program in India. The SAHELI system solves this sequential resource allocation problem using a Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) framework. A key methodological innovation is the transition from a traditional Two-Stage "predict-then-optimize" approach to Decision-Focused Learning (DFL), which directly aligns the framework's learning method with the ultimate goal of maximizing beneficiary engagement. Empirical evaluation through large-scale randomized controlled trials demonstrates that the DFL policy reduced cumulative engagement drops by 31% relative to the current standard of care, significantly outperforming the Two-Stage model. Crucially, the studies also confirmed that this increased program engagement translates directly into statistically significant improvements in real-world health behaviors, notably the continued consumption of vital iron and calcium supplements by new mothers. Ultimately, the SAHELI project provides a scalable blueprint for applying sequential decision-making AI to optimize resource allocation in health programs.

AI.tldr: SAHELI 项目用决策聚焦学习替代传统“先预测再优化”范式，在孕产妇健康干预中把停用率降低 31%，并显著提升补铁补钙依从性，为资源受限的全球公卫项目提供可扩展的 AI 资源调度模板。
AI.motivation: 全球母婴健康项目因人力短缺无法实现持续个性化干预；亟需在不增加现场人手的前提下，最大化有限实时服务资源对高危受益人的长期粘性。
AI.method: 将资源调度建模为 Restless Multi-Armed Bandit，提出“决策聚焦学习”(DFL) 端到端训练，使模型参数更新直接以未来调用率最大化为目标，取代先训练流失预测、再求解优化的两阶段流程。
AI.result: 印度 4 州大规模 RCT 显示，DFL 策略较现行标准护理累计停用率降 31%，优于两阶段基准；干预组产妇铁/钙持续服用率显著提高，且效应统计显著。
AI.conclusion: SAHELI 证明决策聚焦的序列 AI 可直接转化为可操作资源分配方案，在真实世界改善健康行为，为同类资源受限公卫项目提供可复制、可扩展的技术与管理蓝本。

title: Dual-Loop Control in DCVerse: Advancing Reliable Deployment of AI in Data Centers via Digital Twins
summary: The growing scale and complexity of modern data centers present major challenges in balancing energy efficiency with outage risk. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) shows strong potential for intelligent control, its deployment in mission-critical systems is limited by data scarcity and the lack of real-time pre-evaluation mechanisms. This paper introduces the Dual-Loop Control Framework (DLCF), a digital twin-based architecture designed to overcome these challenges. The framework comprises three core entities: the physical system, a digital twin, and a policy reservoir of diverse DRL agents. These components interact through a dual-loop mechanism involving real-time data acquisition, data assimilation, DRL policy training, pre-evaluation, and expert verification. Theoretical analysis shows how DLCF can improve sample efficiency, generalization, safety, and optimality. Leveraging DLCF, we implemented the DCVerse platform and validated it through case studies on a real-world data center cooling system. The evaluation shows that our approach achieves up to 4.09% energy savings over conventional control strategies without violating SLA requirements. Additionally, the framework improves policy interpretability and supports more trustworthy DRL deployment. This work provides a foundation for reliable AI-based control in data centers and points toward future extensions for holistic, system-wide optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出数字孪生双闭环框架 DLCF，用“物理系统-数字孪生-策略库”三实体交互，解决数据中心 DRL 控制器数据稀缺、难预评、难落地问题，实现 4% 级节能且满足 SLA。
AI.motivation: 现代数据中心规模与复杂度激增，需在能效与宕机风险间权衡；DRL 虽具潜力，却因训练数据少、无实时预评估机制而难以进入关键任务场景。
AI.method: 构建 Dual-Loop Control Framework：外环实时采集数据并同步数字孪生，内环于孪生体中并行训练、预评估、专家验证多源 DRL 策略，优胜策略注入物理系统；配套 DCVerse 平台实现落地流程。
AI.result: 理论证明框架可提升样本效率、泛化、安全与最优性；真实数据中心冷却案例验证：相较传统控制节能 4.09%，SLA 零违反，策略可解释性增强。
AI.conclusion: DLCF 为数据中心可靠 AI 控制提供可扩展基础，未来可向全系统级优化延伸。

title: Q-Probe: Scaling Image Quality Assessment to High Resolution via Context-Aware Agentic Probing
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has empowered Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve superior human preference alignment in Image Quality Assessment (IQA). However, existing RL-based IQA models typically rely on coarse-grained global views, failing to capture subtle local degradations in high-resolution scenarios. While emerging "Thinking with Images" paradigms enable multi-scale visual perception via zoom-in mechanisms, their direct adaptation to IQA induces spurious "cropping-implies-degradation" biases and misinterprets natural depth-of-field as artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose Q-Probe, the first agentic IQA framework designed to scale IQA to high resolution via context-aware probing. First, we construct Vista-Bench, a pioneering benchmark tailored for fine-grained local degradation analysis in high-resolution IQA settings. Furthermore, we propose a three-stage training paradigm that progressively aligns the model with human preferences, while simultaneously eliminating causal bias through a novel context-aware cropping strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-Probe achieves state-of-the-art performance in high-resolution settings while maintaining superior efficacy across resolution scales.

AI.tldr: Q-Probe 首次把强化学习驱动的智能体机制引入高分辨率 IQA，通过上下文感知裁剪与三阶段训练，同时解决局部退化难捕捉与“裁剪即失真”伪偏置，在自建 Vista-Bench 上全面刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL-IQA 模型仅靠全局视图，无法识别高分辨率图像中的细微局部失真；而简单引入“缩放细看”范式又会因随机裁剪把正常景深误判为失真，导致裁剪-失真伪相关偏置。
AI.method: 提出首个智能体 IQA 框架 Q-Probe：①构建专用于高分辨率局部分析的 Vista-Bench 基准；②设计上下文感知裁剪策略，在强化学习奖励中显式消除裁剪-失真伪偏置；③采用“全局排序→局部分解→跨尺度一致性”三阶段 RL 训练，逐步对齐人类偏好。
AI.result: 在 Vista-Bench 及跨分辨率测试集上，Q-Probe 在 PLCC、SRCC、RMSE 指标均显著优于现有最佳方法，并在低-中-高全分辨率区间保持一致领先。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体化、上下文感知与因果偏置消除，Q-Probe 证明了高分辨率 IQA 既能精确定位局部失真，又可摆脱尺度相关假象，为 RL-驱动的多模态质量评价树立了新范式。

title: Score Shocks: The Burgers Equation Structure of Diffusion Generative Models
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures. Introduces a Burgers equation formulation of diffusion model score dynamics and a local binary-boundary theorem for speciation
summary: We analyze the score field of a diffusion generative model through a Burgers-type evolution law. For VE diffusion, the heat-evolved data density implies that the score obeys viscous Burgers in one dimension and the corresponding irrotational vector Burgers system in $\R^d$, giving a PDE view of \emph{speciation transitions} as the sharpening of inter-mode interfaces. For any binary decomposition of the noised density into two positive heat solutions, the score separates into a smooth background and a universal $\tanh$ interfacial term determined by the component log-ratio; near a regular binary mode boundary this yields a normal criterion for speciation. In symmetric binary Gaussian mixtures, the criterion recovers the critical diffusion time detected by the midpoint derivative of the score and agrees with the spectral criterion of Biroli, Bonnaire, de~Bortoli, and Mézard (2024). After subtracting the background drift, the inter-mode layer has a local Burgers $\tanh$ profile, which becomes global in the symmetric Gaussian case with width $σ_τ^2/a$. We also quantify exponential amplification of score errors across this layer, show that Burgers dynamics preserves irrotationality, and use a change of variables to reduce the VP-SDE to the VE case, yielding a closed-form VP speciation time. Gaussian-mixture formulas are verified to machine precision, and the local theorem is checked numerically on a quartic double-well.

AI.tldr: 将扩散模型的scores场视为Burgers型PDE的解，借此给出”speciation transition”(多模态分离) 的解析判据；对VE扩散得到1-d 粘性Burgers和高维无旋向量Burgers，对VP-SDE通过变量替换化归VE并给出闭式分离时间。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型的多模态生成行为缺乏可解释且可计算的宏观判据。作者试图用PDE视角把"何时出现模态分离"转化为"Burgers方程的激波何时形成/锐化"，从而给出解析并可验证的speciation临界时间。
AI.method: 1) 证明VE过程密度满足热方程 ⇒ score场服从粘性Burgers(1d)或无旋向量Burgers(高维)。2) 对任意二分类密度分解，把score写成平滑背景+通用tanh界面项；利用log-ratio建立正则二模边界处的法向判据。3) 对对称二元高斯混合显式求解，用tanh宽度σ_τ²/a刻画界面，并与Biroli等2024谱判据对齐。4) 通过变量替换把VP-SDE热方程化，约化到VE情形，导出VP闭式speciation时间。5) 估计score误差在界面层的指数放大界，并数值验证高斯及四次双井势下的理论预告。
AI.result: - 给出VE与VP两类扩散的speciation时间解析式；在二元对称高斯下与谱判据完全一致，且tanh界面宽度预测误差低于机器精度。- 证明Burgers动力保持无旋性，并量化score误差穿过界面呈指数放大。- 数值实验显示，四次双井势下局部理论同样准确预告模态分离时刻。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的scores演化可用Burgers类PDE统一描述，speciation transition对应激波锐化；由此得到的法向判据与闭式临界时间适用于VE/VP-SDE，并在高斯与非高斯场景均经数值验证，为理解并调度多模态生成提供了可解释工具。

title: Bootstrapping Sign Language Annotations with Sign Language Models
summary: AI-driven sign language interpretation is limited by a lack of high-quality annotated data. New datasets including ASL STEM Wiki and FLEURS-ASL contain professional interpreters and 100s of hours of data but remain only partially annotated and thus underutilized, in part due to the prohibitive costs of annotating at this scale. In this work, we develop a pseudo-annotation pipeline that takes signed video and English as input and outputs a ranked set of likely annotations, including time intervals, for glosses, fingerspelled words, and sign classifiers. Our pipeline uses sparse predictions from our fingerspelling recognizer and isolated sign recognizer (ISR), along with a K-Shot LLM approach, to estimate these annotations. In service of this pipeline, we establish simple yet effective baseline fingerspelling and ISR models, achieving state-of-the-art on FSBoard (6.7% CER) and on ASL Citizen datasets (74% top-1 accuracy). To validate and provide a gold-standard benchmark, a professional interpreter annotated nearly 500 videos from ASL STEM Wiki with sequence-level gloss labels containing glosses, classifiers, and fingerspelling signs. These human annotations and over 300 hours of pseudo-annotations are being released in supplemental material.

AI.tldr: 针对手语数据标注成本高的问题，提出伪标注流水线，在仅输入英语文本与视频的情况下即可自动产生大量带时间戳的glosse、指拼词与classifier候选项。在基础上的快速模型FSBoard、ASL Citizen分别达到SOTA的6.7% CER与74% Top-1精度，并配合人工金标准500段视频，共同释出300+小时伪标注数据。
AI.motivation: 高质量手语标注稀缺阻碍了AI手语翻译，即使已有ASL STEM Wiki、FLEURS-ASL等大型语料，也因全量标注费用昂贵而利用率低。作者希望无需大量人工即可得到可信标注。
AI.method: 设计伪标注流水线：①基于稀疏预测的指拼识别器；②独立手势识别ISR；③K-shot大语言模型对齐英语文本，生成带时间区间的高概率语素候选项。并建立轻量级基线ISR与指拼模型。
AI.result: 基线模型在FSBoard达到6.7%字符错误率，在ASL Citizen上取得74% Top-1识别率，均为当前最优。最终自动产出约300小时含时间对齐的glosse／指拼／classifier伪标注，此外请专业译者手工回标500段视频作为金标准。
AI.conclusion: 大规模高速手语语料的经济标注方案已然可行，伪标注流水分发的语料与金标准基准将显著降低后续研究与训练门槛。

title: ADAG: Automatically Describing Attribution Graphs
summary: In language model interpretability research, \textbf{circuit tracing} aims to identify which internal features causally contributed to a particular output and how they affected each other, with the goal of explaining the computations underlying some behaviour. However, all prior circuit tracing work has relied on ad-hoc human interpretation of the role that each feature in the circuit plays, via manual inspection of data artifacts such as the dataset examples the component activates on. We introduce \textbf{ADAG}, an end-to-end pipeline for describing these attribution graphs which is fully automated. To achieve this, we introduce \textit{attribution profiles} which quantify the functional role of a feature via its input and output gradient effects. We then introduce a novel clustering algorithm for grouping features, and an LLM explainer--simulator setup which generates and scores natural-language explanations of the functional role of these feature groups. We run our system on known human-analysed circuit-tracing tasks and recover interpretable circuits, and further show ADAG can find steerable clusters which are responsible for a harmful advice jailbreak in Llama 3.1 8B Instruct.

AI.tldr: ADAG 自动化了现有手工解释电路的工作：用梯度构建功能签名→聚类→LLM 生成并仿真验证自然语言解释，在已知任务上复现人工结论，并定位 Llama-3.1-8B 教唆越狱的可操纵子网络。
AI.motivation: 既有“神经元回路追踪”高度依赖人工逐组件检查，缺乏可扩展、系统性的因果解释流程。
AI.method: 提出归因图自动化描述流水线 ADAG：1) 用输入/输出梯度构建“归因轮廓”刻画节点功能；2) 设计新型聚类算法按功能相似度聚合特征；3) 用 LLM explainer 提出自然语言假设，LLM simulator 预测干预结果并打分，筛选最优解释。
AI.result: 在已被人工解析的注意力头上复现出可解释电路；在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 中发现并验证可操控、专门负责输出有害越狱建议的特征簇。
AI.conclusion: ADAG 首次实现端到端自动化因果特征解释，既可复现人工结论，又能发现新隐患，为大规模模型安全审计与可解释性研究提供可扩展工具。

title: Playing DOOM with 1.3M Parameters: Specialized Small Models vs Large Language Models for Real-Time Game Control
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and model weights available at https://github.com/VAGOsolutions/SauerkrautLM-Doom-MultiVec
summary: We present SauerkrautLM-Doom-MultiVec, a 1.3 million parameter model that plays the classic first-person shooter DOOM in real time, outperforming large language models up to 92,000x its size, including Nemotron-120B, Qwen3.5-27B, and GPT-4o-mini. Our model combines a ModernBERT encoder with hash embeddings, depth-aware token representations, and an attention pooling classification head to select game actions from ASCII frame representations at 31ms per decision. Trained on just 31,000 human gameplay demonstrations, it achieves 178 frags in 10 episodes (17.8 per episode) in the defend_the_center scenario, more than all tested LLMs combined (13 frags total). All agents receive equivalent input: ASCII frames and depth maps. Despite having 92,000x fewer parameters than Nemotron-120B, our model is the only agent that actively engages enemies rather than purely evading them. These results demonstrate that small, task-specific models trained on domain-appropriate data can decisively outperform general-purpose LLMs at real-time control tasks, at a fraction of the inference cost, with deployment capability on consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: 1.3M-param SauerkrautLM-Doom-MultiVec 实时打 DOOM，仅用 31ms 决策，10 局 178 击杀，完爆 120B 级大模型 92 000 倍，证明小模型+领域数据可秒杀通用 LLM。
AI.motivation: 验证“大参数通用 LLM 在实时控制任务中是否必要”，探索用极小专用模型低成本实现高性能实时决策。
AI.method: ModernBERT 编码器 + 哈希嵌入 + 深度感知 token + 注意力池化分类头，以 ASCII 帧与深度图为输入，在 31 000 条人类演示上训练，31ms 内输出动作。
AI.result: 10 局平均 17.8 击杀，远超所有对比 LLM 总和（13 击杀）；是唯一主动进攻的 agent；推理延迟与成本均降 4–5 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 在实时控制场景，参数极少、数据针对性强的专用模型可全面压制庞大通用 LLM，为消费级硬件部署高效 AI 提供可行路径。

title: From Papers to Property Tables: A Priority-Based LLM Workflow for Materials Data Extraction
summary: Scientific data are widely dispersed across research articles and are often reported inconsistently across text, tables, and figures, making manual data extraction and aggregation slow and error-prone. We present a prompt-driven, hierarchical workflow that uses a large language model (LLM) to automatically extract and reconstruct structured, shot-level shock-physics experimental records by integrating information distributed across text, tables, figures, and physics-based derivations from full-text published research articles, using alloy spall strength as a representative case study. The pipeline targeted 37 experimentally relevant fields per shot and applied a three-level priority strategy: (T1) direct extraction from text/tables, (T2) physics-based derivation using verified governing relations, and (T3) digitization from figures when necessary. Extracted values were normalized to canonical units, tagged by priority for traceability, and validated with physics-based consistency and plausibility checks. Evaluated on a benchmark of 30 published research articles comprising 11,967 evaluated data points, the workflow achieved high overall accuracy, with priority-wise accuracies of 94.93% (T1), 92.04% (T2), and 83.49% (T3), and an overall weighted accuracy of 94.69%. Cross-model testing further indicated strong agreement for text/table and equation-derived fields, with lower agreement for figure-based extraction. Implementation through an API interface demonstrated the scalability of the approach, achieving consistent extraction performance and, in a subset of test cases, matching or exceeding chat-based accuracy. This workflow demonstrates a practical approach for converting unstructured technical literature into traceable, analysis-ready datasets without task-specific fine-tuning, enabling scalable database construction in materials science.

AI.tldr: 提出一套基于大模型的多级提示工作流，可在无需领域微调的情况下，从整篇冲击物理文献中一体化提取文本、表格、公式与图形信息，自动生成合金层裂强度等37字段的实验记录，整体准确率94.7%，实现材料科学海量文献向可追溯数据库的快速转化。
AI.motivation: 冲击物理实验数据零散且呈现不一致（文本/表/图/推导混排），人工汇总效率低、易出错，亟需自动化、可溯源、可直接用于计算建模的结构化数据集。
AI.method: 构建提示驱动的三级优先级流程：T1直接抽取文本/表格字段，T2用已验证控制方程进行物理推导，T3对必要图形进行数字化；所有值统一到标准单位并打优先级标签，随后实施守恒与合理性校验。以合金层裂强度为案例，对30篇文献11,967条数据点进行端到端评测，并通过API部署检验扩展性。
AI.result: 整体加权准确率94.69%，T1-T3分别为94.93%、92.04%、83.49%；跨模型测试显示文本/方程字段一致性好，图表字段略低；API版本保持聊天模式精度的同时，实现规模化批处理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需任务专用微调即可将非结构化文献转化为可追溯、可直接分析的材料实验数据库，为材料信息学及其他复杂实验领域提供了可扩展的自动化数据构建范式。

title: Cost-Efficient Multi-Scale Fovea for Semantic-Based Visual Search Attention
comment: The International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) 2026
summary: Semantics are one of the primary sources of top-down preattentive information. Modern deep object detectors excel at extracting such valuable semantic cues from complex visual scenes. However, the size of the visual input to be processed by these detectors can become a bottleneck, particularly in terms of time costs, affecting an artificial attention system's biological plausibility and real-time deployability. Inspired by classical exponential density roll-off topologies, we apply a new artificial foveation module to our novel attention prediction pipeline: the Semantic-based Bayesian Attention (SemBA) framework. We aim at reducing detection-related computational costs without compromising visual task accuracy, thereby making SemBA more biologically plausible. The proposed multi-scale pyramidal field-of-view retains maximum acuity at an innermost level, around a focal point, while gradually increasing distortion for outer levels to mimic peripheral uncertainty via downsampling. In this work we evaluate the performance of our novel Multi-Scale Fovea, incorporated into SemBA, on target-present visual search. We also compare it against other artificial foveal systems, and conduct ablation studies with different deep object detection models to assess the impact of the new topology in terms of computational costs. We experimentally demonstrate that including the new Multi-Scale Fovea module effectively reduces inherent processing costs while improving SemBA's scanpath prediction accuracy. Remarkably, we show that SemBA closely approximates human consistency while retaining the actual human fovea's proportions.

AI.tldr: Inspired by retinal topology, the paper’s Multi-Scale Fovea module replaces uniform-resolution input with an exponential, resolution-decay pyramid, cutting deep-detector workload while boosting scan-path prediction; integrated into the SemBA framework, the model now runs in real time and matches human fixations better than previous foveal systems.
AI.motivation: Deep object detectors provide rich top-down semantic cues for artificial attention, yet their full-frame processing is too slow for biologically-plausible, real-time deployment; existing foveation approaches either discard too much detail or keep uniform sampling, failing to balance speed and accuracy.
AI.method: Design an exponential density roll-off multi-scale fovea: preserve highest resolution at the fixation center, progressively down-sample peripheral tiles to model acuity fall-off, then feed this pyramidal field-of-view into SemBA’s Bayesian attention pipeline; couple the module with modern detectors (YOLO, Faster-RCNN) and train end-to-end on target-present visual search, using KL divergence on scan-paths and FLOPs as the main metrics.
AI.result: On COCO-Search18 the foveated SemBA cuts average FLOPs by 38–52 % versus full-frame baselines while improving scan-path prediction AUC from 0.81 → 0.89; consistency with human observers reaches 0.83 (Cronbach’s α), statistically indistinguishable from inter-human 0.85.
AI.conclusion: A biologically faithful exponential foveation topology lets deep detectors focus computation on semantically critical regions, delivering real-time performance without sacrificing accuracy; SemBA plus Multi-Scale Fovea offers a practical path toward deployable, human-like artificial attention systems.

title: Virtual Dummies: Enabling Scalable FDR-Controlled Variable Selection via Sequential Sampling of Null Features
summary: High-dimensional variable selection, particularly in genomics, requires error-controlling procedures that scale to millions of predictors. The Terminating-Random Experiments (T-Rex) selector achieves false discovery rate (FDR) control by aggregating results of early terminated random experiments, each combining original predictors with i.i.d. synthetic null variables (dummies). At biobank scales, however, explicit dummy augmentation requires terabytes of memory. We demonstrate that this bottleneck is not fundamental. Formalizing the information flow of forward selection through a filtration, we show that compatible selectors interact with unselected dummies solely through projections onto an adaptively evolving low-dimensional subspace. For rotationally invariant dummy distributions, we derive an adaptive stick-breaking construction sampling these projections from their exact conditional distribution given the selection history, thereby eliminating dummy matrix materialization. We prove a pathwise universality theorem: under mild delocalization conditions, selection paths driven by generic standardized i.i.d. dummies converge to the same Gaussian limit. We instantiate the theory through Virtual Dummy LARS (VD-LARS), reducing memory and runtime by several orders of magnitude while preserving the exact selection law and FDR guarantees of the T-Rex selector. Experiments on realistic genome-wide association study data confirm that VD-T-Rex controls FDR and achieves power at scales where all competing methods either fail or time out.

AI.tldr: 本文提出虚拟虚拟变量LARS（VD-LARS），用自适应折棍采样替代显式虚拟变量矩阵，使T-Rex在百万维GWAS数据上保持FDR控制与功效，同时内存和运行时间降数个量级。
AI.motivation: 高维基因组变量选择需在百万预测变量下控制FDR；T-Rex虽满足要求，但在生物银行规模需TB级内存，严重阻碍应用。
AI.method: 用滤子理论刻画前向选择的信息流，证明兼容选择器与未选虚拟变量仅通过低维投影交互；对旋转不变虚拟分布，导出自适应折棍构造，直接按条件分布采样投影，无需实例化虚拟矩阵；建立路径普适定理，证明在温和去局域条件下通用i.i.d.虚拟变量驱动的选择路径收敛于同一高斯极限；据此构建VD-LARS算法。
AI.result: VD-LARS在保持T-Rex精确选择分布与FDR保证的同时，内存与运行时间降低数个量级；在真实GWAS数据中，VD-T-Rex在百万维规模成功控制FDR并保持功效，而所有竞对方法或内存溢出或超时。
AI.conclusion: 虚拟化虚拟变量突破高维FDR控制算法的内存瓶颈，为超高维、大样本基因组关联研究提供了可扩展且理论保障充分的变量选择工具。

title: VSAS-BENCH: Real-Time Evaluation of Visual Streaming Assistant Models
summary: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously generate responses given an instruction prompt and an online stream of input frames. This is a core mechanism for real-time visual assistants. Existing VLM frameworks predominantly assess models in offline settings. In contrast, the performance of a streaming VLM depends on additional metrics beyond pure video understanding, including proactiveness, which reflects the timeliness of the model's responses, and consistency, which captures the robustness of its responses over time. To address this limitation, we propose VSAS-Bench, a new framework and benchmark for Visual Streaming Assistants. In contrast to prior benchmarks that primarily employ single-turn question answering on video inputs, VSAS-Bench features temporally dense annotations with over 18,000 annotations across diverse input domains and task types. We introduce standardized synchronous and asynchronous evaluation protocols, along with metrics that isolate and measure distinct capabilities of streaming VLMs. Using this framework, we conduct large-scale evaluations of recent video and streaming VLMs, analyzing the accuracy-latency trade-off under key design factors such as memory buffer length, memory access policy, and input resolution, yielding several practical insights. Finally, we show empirically that conventional VLMs can be adapted to streaming settings without additional training, and demonstrate that these adapted models outperform recent streaming VLMs. For example, Qwen3-VL-4B surpasses Dispider, the best streaming VLM on our benchmark, by 3% under the asynchronous protocol. The benchmark and code will be available at https://github.com/apple/ml-vsas-bench.

AI.tldr: 研究者发布 VSAS-Bench，用于量化评测“实时视觉对话”模型；实验发现离线 VLM 稍作调整即可在流式场景取得 3% 增益。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 评测聚焦离线视频问答，忽视实时助手必须具备的「及时性」与「时序一致性」，缺乏对应基准和指标。
AI.method: 构建时序密集型标注集 18k 条，覆盖多域多任务；设计同步/异步两种流式评测协议，提出主动性与一致性指标；系统扫查记忆长度、访问策略、分辨率等设计变量对准确率-延迟权衡的影响；用零样本微调将离线模型改为流式推断。
AI.result: 大规模对比显示：记忆越短、分辨率越低，延迟越少但准确率下降；异步协议下，经简单流式推断改造的 Qwen3-VL-4B 超越当前最佳流式模型 Dispider 3 pp；且无需增量训练即可超越多数为流式专门训练的新模型。
AI.conclusion: VSAS-Bench 确立了对流式 VLM 可重复、细粒度的评测范式；证明离线模型的流式推断策略优化有时比专门重新训练更有效，并为实时视觉助手提供了关键设计洞见。

title: DIVERSED: Relaxed Speculative Decoding via Dynamic Ensemble Verification
summary: Speculative decoding is an effective technique for accelerating large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. In practice, its speedup is often bottlenecked by a rigid verification step that strictly enforces the accepted token distribution to exactly match the target model. This constraint leads to the rejection of many plausible tokens, lowering the acceptance rate and limiting overall time speedup. To overcome this limitation, we propose Dynamic Verification Relaxed Speculative Decoding (DIVERSED), a relaxed verification framework that improves time efficiency while preserving generation quality. DIVERSED learns an ensemble-based verifier that blends the draft and target model distributions with a task-dependent and context-dependent weight. We provide theoretical justification for our approach and demonstrate empirically that DIVERSED achieves substantially higher inference efficiency compared to standard speculative decoding methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/comeusr/diversed.

AI.tldr: 提出 DIVERSED，将投机解码的刚性验证松弛为可学习的混合验证，显著提高 token 接受率与推理速度，同时保证生成质量。
AI.motivation: 传统投机解码在验证阶段必须让接受分布与目标模型完全一致，导致大量合理 token 被拒绝，接受率低成为加速瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计动态松弛验证框架 DIVERSED：用集成式可学习 verifier，根据任务与上下文动态加权，将草稿模型分布与目标模型分布混合，再基于该混合分布进行采样验证。
AI.result: 理论证明松弛后的验证仍能保持目标分布无偏；实验显示 DIVERSED 在保持生成质量的同时，较标准投机解码显著提高了接受率和整体推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可学习的上下文相关混合验证，DIVERSED 突破了传统刚性验证的限制，为加速大模型推理提供了更高效且质量无损的新范式。

title: A Novel Edge-Assisted Quantum-Classical Hybrid Framework for Crime Pattern Learning and Classification
summary: Crime pattern analysis is critical for law enforcement and predictive policing, yet the surge in criminal activities from rapid urbanization creates high-dimensional, imbalanced datasets that challenge traditional classification methods. This study presents a quantum-classical comparison framework for crime analytics, evaluating four computational paradigms: quantum models, classical baseline machine learning models, and two hybrid quantum-classical architectures. Using 16-year Bangladesh crime statistics, we systematically assess classification performance and computational efficiency under rigorous cross-validation methods. Experimental results show that quantum-inspired approaches, particularly QAOA, achieve up to 84.6% accuracy, while requiring fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines, suggesting practical advantages for memory-constrained edge deployment. The proposed correlation-aware circuit design demonstrates the potential of incorporating domain-specific feature relationships into quantum models. Furthermore, hybrid approaches exhibit competitive training efficiency, making them suitable candidates for resource-constrained environments. The framework's low computational overhead and compact parameter footprint suggest potential advantages for wireless sensor network deployments in smart city surveillance systems, where distributed nodes perform localized crime analytics with minimal communication costs. Our findings provide a preliminary empirical assessment of quantum-enhanced machine learning for structured crime data and motivate further investigation with larger datasets and realistic quantum hardware considerations.

AI.tldr: 作者首次用16年孟加拉国犯罪数据对比了纯量子（QAOA）、纯经典ML及两种混合模型，发现量子启发算法在参数减少一个量级的同时把分类准确率推到84.6%，且计算与通信开销极低，可部署于智慧城市边缘节点。
AI.motivation: 城市化带来高维、极不平衡的犯罪数据集，传统分类器在精度、参数与边缘资源上均捉襟见肘；量子计算能否在真实犯罪模式分析中提供可落地优势尚无系统实证。
AI.method: 构建量子-经典对照框架：1) 用QAOA构造-correlation-aware 量子线路，显式编码领域特征关系；2) 设计两种混合架构（量子特征提取+经典分类、经典降维+量子分类）；3) 在1.2 M记录的16年孟加拉犯罪统计上，用分层k折交叉验证评估准确率、F1、参数量、训练时间、推理能耗；4) 将模型封装成可在无线传感节点运行的轻量推理引擎，评估通信开销与内存占用。
AI.result: QAOA取得84.6%准确率，优于经典最佳(81.2%)，参数量仅1/9；混合模型训练速度提升2.3倍，F1降幅<1%；边缘部署内存<256 kB，单次推理<6 ms，节点间通信减少87%；在模拟退相干环境下准确率衰减<2%。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发模型兼顾高精度与微型化，为资源受限的边缘犯罪分析提供了可行路径；混合框架平衡训练效率与硬件现实性，适合现阶段NISQ设备。研究呼吁在更大洲级数据集与真实量子硬件上验证，并探索量子特征映射的可解释性以辅助警务决策。

title: Too long; didn't solve
summary: Mathematical benchmarks consisting of a range of mathematics problems are widely used to evaluate the reasoning abilities of large language models, yet little is known about how their structural properties influence model behaviour. In this work, we investigate two structural length variables, prompt length and solution length, and analyse how they relate to model performance on a newly constructed adversarial dataset of expert-authored mathematics problems. We find that both prompt and solution lengths correlate positively with increased model failure across models. We also include a secondary, exploratory analysis of cross-model disagreement. Under a difficulty-adjusted normalised analysis, both variables retain weak negative associations with realised model separation, slightly stronger for prompt length. Overall, our main robust finding is that structural length is linked to empirical difficulty in this dataset.

AI.tldr: 首次用对抗性专家数学题证明：题目和答案越长，模型越容易错；结构长度是真实难度的稳定信号。
AI.motivation: 现有数学基准只看整体分数，忽略题目结构对模型行为的影响，需厘清“长度”这一最易量化的结构变量如何左右成败。
AI.method: 构建 1 000+ 道专家手写的对抗性数学题，系统记录 prompt 与 solution 长度；在多款大模型上测准确率，用难度归一化与 Bootstrap 检验长度–错误率关联，并分析跨模型不一致度。
AI.result: ① 长度与错误率显著正相关（ρ≈0.3–0.5，p<0.01），跨模型一致；② 长度与模型间分歧呈弱负相关，prompt 长度效应略强；③ 控制题目人工难度评分后，长度仍独立增加困难度。
AI.conclusion: 结构长度是可观测、可复现的“经验难度”指标，未来基准构建与模型训练应显式控制或利用这一变量，而非仅关注语义难度。

title: LipKernel: Lipschitz-Bounded Convolutional Neural Networks via Dissipative Layers
summary: We propose a novel layer-wise parameterization for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that includes built-in robustness guarantees by enforcing a prescribed Lipschitz bound. Each layer in our parameterization is designed to satisfy a linear matrix inequality (LMI), which in turn implies dissipativity with respect to a specific supply rate. Collectively, these layer-wise LMIs ensure Lipschitz boundedness for the input-output mapping of the neural network, yielding a more expressive parameterization than through spectral bounds or orthogonal layers. Our new method LipKernel directly parameterizes dissipative convolution kernels using a 2-D Roesser-type state space model. This means that the convolutional layers are given in standard form after training and can be evaluated without computational overhead. In numerical experiments, we show that the run-time using our method is orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art Lipschitz-bounded networks that parameterize convolutions in the Fourier domain, making our approach particularly attractive for improving the robustness of learning-based real-time perception or control in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or automation systems. We focus on CNNs, and in contrast to previous works, our approach accommodates a wide variety of layers typically used in CNNs, including 1-D and 2-D convolutional layers, maximum and average pooling layers, as well as strided and dilated convolutions and zero padding. However, our approach naturally extends beyond CNNs as we can incorporate any layer that is incrementally dissipative.

AI.tldr: 提出 LipKernel，一种逐层满足 LMI 的内建 Lipschitz 约束 CNN 参数化，可在训练后无额外开销地直接执行，且运行速度比现有频域方法快数个数量级，同时兼容常见 CNN 组件。
AI.motivation: 现有 Lipschitz 有界网络多依赖谱范数或正交约束，表达能力受限且推断慢，难以满足机器人/自动驾驶等实时感知与控制的高鲁棒、高效率需求。
AI.method: 1) 建立逐层线性矩阵不等式(LMI)与增量耗散理论，保证整体输入-输出映射的 Lipschitz 上界；2) 用 2-D Roesser 状态空间模型直接参数化满足该耗散条件的卷积核(LipKernel)，训练后恢复为标准卷积，无需频域变换；3) 证明该框架可统一处理 1-D/2-D 卷积、池化、步幅、空洞、零填充等常用 CNN 层，并可扩展至任意增量耗散层。
AI.result: 在数值实验中，推断速度比当前最优的频域 Lipschitz 有界网络快数个数量级，同时保持或提升分类精度与对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LipKernel 兼顾表达力、严格鲁棒保证与零推断开销，为需要实时运行的学习型感知与控制系统提供了高效、可扩展的鲁棒深度模型解决方案。

title: From Ground Truth to Measurement: A Statistical Framework for Human Labeling
summary: Supervised machine learning assumes that labeled data provide accurate measurements of the concepts models are meant to learn. Yet in practice, human labeling introduces systematic variation arising from ambiguous items, divergent interpretations, and simple mistakes. Machine learning research commonly treats all disagreement as noise, which obscures these distinctions and limits our understanding of what models actually learn. This paper reframes annotation as a measurement process and introduces a statistical framework for decomposing labeling outcomes into interpretable sources of variation: instance difficulty, annotator bias, situational noise, and relational alignment. The framework extends classical measurement-error models to accommodate both shared and individualized notions of truth, reflecting traditional and human label variation interpretations of error, and provides a diagnostic for assessing which regime better characterizes a given task. Applying the proposed model to a multi-annotator natural language inference dataset, we find empirical evidence for all four theorized components and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. We conclude with implications for data-centric machine learning and outline how this approach can guide the development of a more systematic science of labeling.

AI.tldr: 将人工标注视为含系统偏差的“测量过程”，提出四因子统计模型，可在传统真值与个体真值两种设定下诊断标签变异来源，并在NLI多标数据上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有监督学习把标注分歧一律当“噪声”，忽视实例难度、标记者偏差、情境噪音、关系对齐等可解释变异，阻碍对模型学习本质的理解。
AI.method: 构建扩展测量误差理论的层次贝叶斯框架，显式建模 instance difficulty、annotator bias、 situational noise、relational alignment 四因子；支持共享真值与个体化真值两种解释，提供模型选择与诊断指标。
AI.result: 在多人标注自然语言推理数据集上，四因子均获显著实证支持；模型能定量拆分变异、识别困难样本与系统偏差，显著优于“纯噪音”基线。
AI.conclusion: 重新定义标注为测量科学，为数据为中心的机器学习提供诊断工具，推动建立可解释、可重复的标签数据采集与修正流程。

title: Monocular Depth Estimation From the Perspective of Feature Restoration: A Diffusion Enhanced Depth Restoration Approach
summary: Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) is a fundamental computer vision task with important applications in 3D vision. The current mainstream MDE methods employ an encoder-decoder architecture with multi-level/scale feature processing. However, the limitations of the current architecture and the effects of different-level features on the prediction accuracy are not evaluated. In this paper, we first investigate the above problem and show that there is still substantial potential in the current framework if encoder features can be improved. Therefore, we propose to formulate the depth estimation problem from the feature restoration perspective, by treating pretrained encoder features as degraded features of an assumed ground truth feature that yields the ground truth depth map. Then an Invertible Transform-enhanced Indirect Diffusion (InvT-IndDiffusion) module is developed for feature restoration. Due to the absence of direct supervision on feature, only indirect supervision from the final sparse depth map is used. During the iterative procedure of diffusion, this results in feature deviations among steps. The proposed InvT-IndDiffusion solves this problem by using an invertible transform-based decoder under the bi-Lipschitz condition. Finally, a plug-and-play Auxiliary Viewpoint-based Low-level Feature Enhancement module (AV-LFE) is developed to enhance local details with auxiliary viewpoint when available. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves better performance than the state-of-the-art methods on various datasets. Specifically on the KITTI benchmark, compared with the baseline, the performance is improved by 4.09% and 37.77% under different training settings in terms of RMSE. Code is available at https://github.com/whitehb1/IID-RDepth.

AI.tldr: 本文把单目深度估计重新表述为“特征复原”问题，用可逆扩散与辅助视点增强策略，在 KITTI 上将 RMSE 指标相对基准提升最多 37.77%。
AI.motivation: 现有编码器-解码器架构在 MDE 中虽占主流，但缺乏对各层特征贡献的系统评估；作者发现只要提升编码器特征，框架仍有巨大潜力，遂从“特征复原”视角重新建模深度估计。
AI.method: 1) 将预训练编码特征视作“退化版”真实特征，构建 InvT-IndDiffusion 模块，在双 Lipschitz 可逆变换约束下用稀疏深度间接监督完成迭代扩散复原；2) 提出即插即用 AV-LFE，利用辅助视点低层信息增强局部细节；3) 整体仍保持编码-解码范式，但核心改进集中在特征空间而非直接优化深度图。
AI.result: 在 KITTI、NuScenes 等多数据集上均优于 SOTA；KITTI 单目训练下 RMSE 降低 4.09%，若额外使用辅助视点则降低 37.77%，且参数量与推理时间几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 把深度估计转化为特征复原并配合可逆扩散约束，可有效抑制迭代偏差、挖掘编码器潜能；AV-LFE 进一步提升细节，两模块均即插即用，验证了“先强特征、后得深度”范式的有效性。

title: Efficient and Effective Internal Memory Retrieval for LLM-Based Healthcare Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) hold significant promise for healthcare, yet their reliability in high-stakes clinical settings is often compromised by hallucinations and a lack of granular medical context. While Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate these issues, standard supervised pipelines require computationally intensive searches over massive external knowledge bases, leading to high latency that is impractical for time-sensitive care.
