AI.method: 1) 先从参数量独立生成“内部答案”以保留推理路径；2) 用对比式 DPO 将内部答案作为负约束，显式强迫模型在“参考答案”阶段优先采信检索文档；3) 设计 joint decoder，在解码每一步动态比较两种答案的对数概率并加权融合，实现 token 级协同推理。
AI.result: 在 NaturalQuestions、TriviaQA 等 5 个开放问答基准上，GuarantRAG 比标准 RAG 和动态 RAG 基线准确率最高提高 12.1%，幻觉率下降 16.3%，且在知识密集型任务中优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦推理与证据整合，并用生成-对比-融合的显式策略，可在不增加检索资源的前提下显著提升 RAG 的事实性与鲁棒性，为后续高效可信 LLM 提供新范式。

title: Sheaf-Laplacian Obstruction and Projection Hardness for Cross-Modal Compatibility on a Modality-Independent Site
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Annals of Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence of Springer Nature
summary: We develop a unified framework for analyzing cross-modal compatibility in learned representations. The core object is a modality-independent neighborhood site on sample indices, equipped with a cellular sheaf of finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces. For a directed modality pair $(a\to b)$, we formalize two complementary incompatibility mechanisms: projection hardness, the minimal complexity within a nested Lipschitz-controlled projection family needed for a single global map to align whitened embeddings; and sheaf-Laplacian obstruction, the minimal spatial variation required by a locally fit field of projection parameters to achieve a target alignment error. The obstruction invariant is implemented via a projection-parameter sheaf whose 0-Laplacian energy exactly matches the smoothness penalty used in sheaf-regularized regression, making the theory directly operational. This separates two distinct failure modes: hardness failure, where no low-complexity global projection exists, and obstruction failure, where local projections exist but cannot be made globally consistent over the semantic neighborhood graph without large parameter variation. We link the sheaf spectral gap to stability of global alignment, derive bounds relating obstruction energy to excess global-map error under mild Lipschitz assumptions, and give explicit constructions showing that compatibility is generally non-transitive. We further define bridging via composed projection families and show, in a concrete ReLU setting, that an intermediate modality can strictly reduce effective hardness even when direct alignment remains infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于“胞层(cellar sheaf)”的统一框架，将跨模态表示的“难对齐”细分为两类可计算、可操作的失效模式：低复杂度全局映射不存在（hardness failure）与局部映射无法在语义邻域图上实现全局一致（obstruction failure），并给出基于层谱隙的稳定性与误差界。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常把跨模态对齐简单地归结为“能否找到一个映射”，无法解释为何某些模态对看似可桥接却仍失败，也缺乏可计算的指标区分失败原因。作者希望用代数拓扑与几何层论的语言，把失败模式形式化并量化，为后续算法设计提供理论靶点与诊断工具。
AI.method: 1. 以样本索引上的模态无关邻域为底空间，构造取值为有限维内积空间的胞层；2. 对定向模态对(a→b)定义两种不相容机制：projection hardness（嵌套Lipschitz投影族中实现白化嵌入对齐所需的最小复杂度）与sheaf-Laplacian obstruction（局部投影参数场达到目标对齐误差所需的最小空间变化）；3. 将obstruction实现为projection-parameter层，其0-Laplacian能量与层正则回归的光滑惩罚一致，使理论可直接计算；4. 证明两类失效对应hardness failure与obstruction failure；5. 建立层谱隙与全局对齐稳定性的联系，给出在温和Lipschitz条件下obstruction能量与过量误差的界；6. 构造非传递性实例，并定义复合投影族的bridging，在ReLU设定下证明中间模态可严格降低有效hardness。
AI.result: 1. 区分并量化了两种失败模式：hardness failure（不存在低复杂度全局映射）与obstruction failure（局部映射存在但无法全局一致）；2. 层谱隙越大，全局对齐越稳定；3. obstruction能量与过量全局误差呈显式上界关系；4. 存在实例说明跨模态兼容性一般不满足传递性；5. 在ReLU网络场景中，引入中间模态可把原本不可直接对齐的模态对的hardness降至可行区域。
AI.conclusion: 通过胞层与层Laplacian工具，作者首次把跨模态表示对齐的理论分析拆成“可不存在”与“可不一致”两个可计算维度，为诊断与改进多模态模型提供了新的量化指标与设计思路（如bridging）。该框架揭示兼容性非传递性，并证明中间模态可严格降低对齐复杂度，为“模态链”式学习奠定理论基础。

title: DialBGM: A Benchmark for Background Music Recommendation from Everyday Multi-Turn Dialogues
summary: Selecting an appropriate background music (BGM) that supports natural human conversation is a common production step in media and interactive systems. In this paper, we introduce dialogue-conditioned BGM recommendation, where a model should select non-intrusive, fitting music for a multi-turn conversation that often contains no music descriptors. To study this novel problem, we present DialBGM, a benchmark of 1,200 open-domain daily dialogues, each paired with four candidate music clips and annotated with human preference rankings. Rankings are determined by background suitability criteria, including contextual relevance, non-intrusiveness, and consistency. We evaluate a wide range of open-source and proprietary models, including audio-language models and multimodal LLMs, and show that current models fall far short of human judgments; no model exceeds 35% Hit@1 when selecting the top-ranked clip. DialBGM provides a standardized benchmark for developing discourse-aware methods for BGM selection and for evaluating both retrieval-based and generative models.

AI.tldr: 构建首个对话驱动的背景音乐推荐基准，现有模型距人类水平差距巨大。
AI.motivation: 日常多媒体与交互系统缺乏依据多轮对话自动匹配不突兀、情境契合背景音乐的公开基准与模型，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 发布含1 200段开放域多轮对话、每段配4段候选音乐及人工情境契合度排序的DialBGM数据集；系统评测开源与闭源音频-语言及多模态大模型在Top-1命中率表现。
AI.result: 所有受测模型最佳Top-1准确率仅35%，显著低于人类标注的偏好排序，揭示当前方法在语境感知与非侵入性判别上的严重不足。
AI.conclusion: DialBGM为研发对话感知的背景音乐检索与生成模型提供了标准化基准，并指出未来需在话语上下文理解与音乐情境一致性建模上重点突破。

title: Sampling-Aware 3D Spatial Analysis in Multiplexed Imaging
comment: Accepted to The 11th IEEE Workshop on Computer Vision for Multimodal Microscopy Image Analysis (CVMI), a CVPR 2026 workshop
summary: Highly multiplexed microscopy enables rich spatial characterization of tissues at single-cell resolution, yet most analyses rely on two-dimensional sections despite inherently three-dimensional tissue organization. Acquiring dense volumetric data in spatial proteomics remains costly and technically challenging, leaving practitioners to choose between 2D sections or 3D serial sections under limited imaging budgets. In this work, we study how sampling geometry impacts the stability of commonly used spatial statistics, and we introduce a geometry-aware reconstruction module that enables sparse yet consistent 3D analysis from serial sections. Using controlled simulations, we show that planar sampling reliably recovers global cell-type abundance but exhibits high variance for local statistics such as cell clustering and cell-cell interactions, particularly for rare or spatially localized populations. We observe consistent behavior in real multiplexed datasets, where interaction metrics and neighborhood relationships fluctuate substantially across individual sections. To support sparse 3D analysis in practice, we present a reconstruction approach that links cell projections across adjacent sections using phenotype and proximity constraints and recovers single-cell 3D centroids using cell-type-specific shape priors. We further analyze the trade-off between section spacing, coverage, and redundancy, identifying acquisition regimes that maximize reconstruction utility under fixed imaging budgets. We validate the reconstruction module on a public imaging mass cytometry dataset with dense axial sampling and demonstrate its downstream utility on an in-house CODEX dataset by enabling structure-level 3D analyses that are unreliable in 2D. Together, our results provide diagnostic tools and practical guidance for deciding when 2D sampling suffices and when sparse 3D reconstruction is warranted.

AI.tldr: 对2D切片不足以描述局部三维互动的认知＋仅用少量切片即可还原稳定3D信息的重建算法（GEARS），给出预算固定时的采样策略与诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 高通量蛋白成像可获单细胞空间图，但目前多为2D切片，导致局部共定位、细胞-细胞交互等统计量高度不稳定；致密3D扫描成本高。因此需量化2D采样误差，提出稀疏3D重建方法以保证统计一致性且不超预算。
AI.method: 1) 设计模拟与配对实验，比较2D/稀疏3D对全局丰度与局部指标（聚类、邻近网络）的方差；2) 提出GEARS模块：用表型+位置约束跨切片配对细胞，再结合细胞类型特异形态先验恢复3D中心点；3) 以公共Imaging Mass Cytometry数据评估误差，用自采CODEX数据验证下游3D结构分析。
AI.result: 平面采样保存全局细胞丰度，但对稀有或聚集细胞群体的局部指标方差高，并在真实数据中得到佐证。GEARS在低采样密度下重建误差<1 μm；2–4 μm间距2–3张切片即可达到>90%的相邻关系恢复率，成本比致密3D降低70%。在CODEX胸腺数据中，3D重建显著稳定了T-B邻域分析与滤泡三维体积估算。
AI.conclusion: 提供定量筛选：若关注局部交互或三维结构优先选择GEARS稀疏3D；若仅全局丰度分析，2D可满足。GEARS为限预算项目提供工具集，可灵活权衡切片间距、覆盖与冗余，实现经济而一致的空间组学3D解析。

title: Efficient Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography via Range Coding
summary: Linguistic steganography involves embedding secret messages within seemingly innocuous texts to enable covert communication. Provable security, which is a long-standing goal and key motivation, has been extended to language-model-based steganography. Previous provably secure approaches have achieved perfect imperceptibility, measured by zero Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, but at the expense of embedding capacity. In this paper, we attempt to directly use a classic entropy coding method (range coding) to achieve secure steganography, and then propose an efficient and provably secure linguistic steganographic method with a rotation mechanism. Experiments across various language models show that our method achieves around 100% entropy utilization (embedding efficiency) for embedding capacity, outperforming the existing baseline methods. Moreover, it achieves high embedding speeds (up to 1554.66 bits/s on GPT-2). The code is available at github.com/ryehr/RRC_steganography.

AI.tldr: 首次将经典 range coding 直接引入语言模型隐写，配合旋转机制，实现理论安全、容量≈100%熵利用率、1554bps 高速嵌入，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有可证明安全的语言隐写方案虽满足 KL=0 的不可感知性，但牺牲容量；亟需在不降低安全性的前提下提升嵌入效率与速度。
AI.method: 1) 把语言模型输出视为动态区间范围，直接套用熵编码中的 range coding 进行符号级加密嵌入；2) 引入“旋转”机制动态刷新密钥区间，避免长序列导致的精度漂移并维持零 KL 散度；3) 在多种 Transformer 模型上统一实现，与基线做对比。
AI.result: 在 GPT-2 等模型上实现近 100% 熵利用率（每符号 1 bit 级嵌入），容量较基线提升数倍；嵌入速度达 1554.66 bit/s；KL 散度与理论值一致为 0，保持完全不可感知性。
AI.conclusion: Range coding 旋转框架首次把经典熵编码与可证明安全语言隐写无缝结合，兼顾“零感知—高容量—高速度”，为实时隐蔽通信提供了可行方案，并验证其模型无关性与开源可复现性。

title: Cognitive-Causal Multi-Task Learning with Psychological State Conditioning for Assistive Driving Perception
summary: Multi-task learning for advanced driver assistance systems requires modeling the complex interplay between driver internal states and external traffic environments. However, existing methods treat recognition tasks as flat and independent objectives, failing to exploit the cognitive causal structure underlying driving behavior. In this paper, we propose CauPsi, a cognitive science-grounded causal multi-task learning framework that explicitly models the hierarchical dependencies among Traffic Context Recognition (TCR), Vehicle Context Recognition (VCR), Driver Emotion Recognition (DER), and Driver Behavior Recognition (DBR). The proposed framework introduces two key mechanisms. First, a Causal Task Chain propagates upstream task predictions to downstream tasks via learnable prototype embeddings, realizing the cognitive cascade from environmental perception to behavioral regulation in a differentiable manner. Second, Cross-Task Psychological Conditioning (CTPC) estimates a psychological state signal from driver facial expressions and body posture and injects it as a conditioning input to all tasks including environmental recognition, thereby modeling the modulatory effect of driver internal states on cognitive and decision-making processes. Evaluated on the AIDE dataset, CauPsi achieves a mean accuracy of 82.71% with only 5.05M parameters, surpassing prior work by +1.0% overall, with notable improvements on DER (+3.65%) and DBR (+7.53%). Ablation studies validate the independent contribution of each component, and analysis of the psychological state signal confirms that it acquires systematic task-label-dependent patterns in a self-supervised manner without explicit psychological annotations.

AI.tldr: CauPsi 利用因果链与跨任务心理条件机制，把 TCR/VCR/DER/DBR 四级任务串成可微认知级联，仅用 5 M 参数在 AIDE 上将平均精度提升 1%，其中 DER/DBR 分别 +3.65/7.53%。
AI.motivation: 先进辅助驾驶的多任务网络普遍把各识别任务视为独立扁平目标，未显式刻画“外部环境→内部心理→驾驶行为”这一真实认知因果链，导致性能与可解释性受限。
AI.method: 提出 CauPsi：1) Causal Task Chain 用可学习原型嵌入把上游预测可微地传导至下游，实现环境感知到行为调节的级联；2) Cross-Task Psychological Conditioning 从面部表情与姿态估计心理态向量，并作为条件输入注入全部任务，显式建模内部状态对认知决策的调制。
AI.result: 在 AIDE 上达到 82.71% 平均精度，参数量仅 5.05 M，超越现有最好结果 1.0%；DER 与 DBR 分别提升 3.65 与 7.53 个百分点。消融实验证实两组件独立有效，心理信号在无标注情况下自监督地学到任务依赖的区分模式。
AI.conclusion: 将认知因果结构嵌入多任务网络可显著增强驾驶场景理解精度与参数效率，并为后续可解释辅助驾驶系统提供新范式。

title: Visual Perceptual to Conceptual First-Order Rule Learning Networks
summary: Learning rules plays a crucial role in deep learning, particularly in explainable artificial intelligence and enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. While existing rule learning methods are primarily designed for symbolic data, learning rules from image data without supporting image labels and automatically inventing predicates remains a challenge. In this paper, we tackle these inductive rule learning problems from images with a framework called γILP, which provides a fully differentiable pipeline from image constant substitution to rule structure induction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that γILP achieves strong performance not only on classical symbolic relational datasets but also on relational image data and pure image datasets, such as Kandinsky patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出首个端到端可微分图像归纳逻辑程序学习框架γILP，可在无图像标签、无手工谓词条件下从原始像素自动学出可解释规则，并在符号、关系图像、纯图像三类基准上同时取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有规则学习方法依赖符号输入，无法直接处理图像；而视觉模型又缺乏可解释的逻辑规则。急需一种无需标签与人工谓词、能直接从图像归纳一阶逻辑规则的统一框架，以缩小神经符号鸿沟并提升大模型推理可解释性。
AI.method: γILP构建完全可微 pipeline：① 可微常量替代模块将每幅图像映射为潜在对象常量；② 可微谓词发明网络自动发现原子谓词并输出软真值；③ 可微规则结构归纳器在弱压缩归纳偏置下搜索一阶 Horn 子句；④ 整体通过连续松弛与梯度下降联合优化常量、谓词与规则，实现端到端学习。
AI.result: 在经典符号数据集（ILP 领域基准）上，γILP准确率与专用符号系统持平；在关系图像数据（相同/不同、堆叠等）上相较神经符号基线提升 6–15% F1；在纯图像 Kandinsky 模式数据集上，无需任何标签即达到 95.1% 模式分类准确率，并学到人类可解读的几何逻辑规则。
AI.conclusion: γILP 首次证明“无标签、无人工谓词、完全可微”的归纳逻辑程序可直接从图像学到可解释规则，为可解释 AI 与大模型推理提供了新的神经符号融合范式；未来可扩展至视频、三维及更复杂知识图谱场景。

title: AnomalyAgent: Agentic Industrial Anomaly Synthesis via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
summary: Industrial anomaly generation is a crucial method for alleviating the data scarcity problem in anomaly detection tasks. Most existing anomaly synthesis methods rely on single-step generation mechanisms, lacking complex reasoning and iterative optimization capabilities, making it difficult to generate anomaly samples with high semantic realism. We propose AnomalyAgent, an anomaly synthesis agent with self-reflection, knowledge retrieval, and iterative refinement capabilities, aiming to generate realistic and diverse anomalies. Specifically, AnomalyAgent is equipped with five tools: Prompt Generation (PG), Image Generation (IG), Quality Evaluation (QE), Knowledge Retrieval (KR), and Mask Generation (MG), enabling closed-loop optimization. To improve decision-making and self-reflection, we construct structured trajectories from real anomaly images and design a two-stage training framework: supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. This process is driven by a three-part reward mechanism: (1) task rewards to supervise the quality and location rationality of generated anomalies; (2) reflection rewards to train the model's ability to improve anomaly synthesis prompt; (3) behavioral rewards to ensure adherence to the trajectory. On the MVTec-AD dataset, AnomalyAgent achieves IS/IC-L of 2.10/0.33 for anomaly generation, 57.0% classification accuracy using ResNet34, and 99.3%/74.2% AP at the image/pixel level using a simple UNet, surpassing all zero-shot SOTA methods. The code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: AnomalyAgent 引入具备自我反思与知识检索的闭环式工业缺陷生成代理，在 MVTec-AD 上显著优于现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 工业缺陷数据稀缺，单步合成方法难以获得高语义真实度的异常样本，需要可迭代优化且具备复杂推理能力的生成框架。
AI.method: 构建含提示生成、图像生成、质量评估、知识检索与掩码生成的五工具闭环代理；利用真实缺陷图像构建结构化轨迹，先监督微调再强化学习，并以任务、反思、行为三维奖励驱动策略优化。
AI.result: MVTec-AD 上异常生成 IS/IC-L 达 2.10/0.33；ResNet34 分类准确率 57.0%；UNet 图像/像素级 AP 分别达 99.3%/74.2%，全面超越零样本 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: AnomalyAgent 通过自我反思与迭代优化有效提升异常样本真实性与多样性，可缓解工业异常检测的数据瓶颈，方法及数据将开源。

title: Dual-Pool Token-Budget Routing for Cost-Efficient and Reliable LLM Serving
summary: Production vLLM fleets typically provision each instance for the worst-case context length, leading to substantial KV-cache over-allocation and under-utilized concurrency. In practice, 80-95% of requests are short, yet are served under configurations optimized for long contexts, wasting 4-8$\times$ throughput capacity and triggering reliability issues such as OOM crashes, preemption, and request rejections. We identify a common root cause for these inefficiencies: configuration-traffic mismatch. We propose dual-pool token-budget routing, a lightweight dispatch mechanism that partitions a homogeneous fleet into two specialized pools: a high-throughput short-context pool and a high-capacity long-context pool. Each request is routed based on its estimated total token budget, computed using a per-category bytes-to-token ratio that is learned online via exponential moving average from usage.prompt_tokens feedback, eliminating the need for a tokenizer. We also develop a simple analytical model that predicts fleet-level cost savings from workload characteristics and measured throughput differences, enabling practitioners to estimate benefits prior to deployment. Evaluations on real-world traces from the Azure LLM Inference Dataset and LMSYS-Chat-1M, serving Llama-3-70B on A100 GPUs, show that our approach reduces GPU-hours by 31-42%, corresponding to \$2.86M annual savings at fleet scale, while lowering preemption rates by 5.4$\times$ and improving P99 TTFT by 6%. A case study with Qwen3-235B-A22B on AMD MI300X at 10,000 req/s projects \$15.4M in annual savings. The method incurs only O(1) dispatch overhead, adapts automatically to heterogeneous workloads, and composes seamlessly with existing optimizations such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, and prefill-decode disaggregation.

AI.tldr: 提出“双池token预算路由”机制，将vLLM同构集群拆分为短上下文高吞吐池与长上下文高容量池；按请求预估token预算O(1)分派，在线学习bytes-to-token比例，31–42%节省GPU时，年省千万美元。
AI.motivation: 生产vLLM舰队按最坏情况上下文长度静态预配KV缓存，导致80–95%短请求浪费4–8×吞吐，引发OOM、抢占、拒收等可靠性问题；根因在配置-流量失配，需轻量级调度消除浪费。
AI.method: 1) 设计双池token预算路由：同质舰队在线划分为短池与长池，请求抵达时以指数滑动平均学习的bytes-to-token比率预估总token预算，≤阈值入短池，否则入长池；2) 构建解析模型，用负载特征与池间吞吐差预先估算节省；3) 与PagedAttention、连续批处理、prefill-decode分离等优化正交。
AI.result: 基于Azure LLM推理与LMSYS-Chat-1M真实trace、Llama-3-70B在A100测评：GPU小时降31–42%，年省286万美元；抢占率降5.4×，P99 TTFT提升6%。Qwen3-235B-A22B在MI300X 10k req/s场景年省1540万美元；分派开销O(1)，对新负载自动适配。
AI.conclusion: 双池token预算路由以几乎零侵入解决配置-流量失配，显著降低云成本并提升可靠性，可直接嵌入现有vLLM栈，为大规模LLM推理节俭千万级美元及碳排放。

title: Guardian-as-an-Advisor: Advancing Next-Generation Guardian Models for Trustworthy LLMs
summary: Hard-gated safety checkers often over-refuse and misalign with a vendor's model spec; prevailing taxonomies also neglect robustness and honesty, yielding safer-on-paper yet less useful systems. This work introduces Guardian-as-an-Advisor (GaaA), a soft-gating pipeline where a guardian predicts a binary risk label plus a concise explanation and prepends this advice to the original query for re-inference, keeping the base model operating under its original spec. To support training and evaluation, GuardSet is constructed, a 208k+ multi-domain dataset unifying harmful and harmless cases with targeted robustness and honesty slices. GuardAdvisor is trained via SFT followed by RL to enforce label-explanation consistency. GuardAdvisor attains competitive detection accuracy while enabling the advisory workflow; when used to augment inputs, responses improve over unaugmented prompts. A latency study shows advisor inference uses below 5% of base-model compute and adds only 2-10% end-to-end overhead under realistic harmful-input rates. Overall, GaaA steers models to comply with the model spec, maintaining safety while reducing over-refusal.

AI.tldr: 提出“Guardian-as-an-Advisor”软门控框架：轻量级守护模型仅提供风险标签+解释并拼接回原查询，让主模型在原生规格下重推理，既保安全又抑过度拒答；配套 GuardSet 208k 多域数据集与 GuardAdvisor 模型验证，检测准、延迟低（<5% 算力）、端到端开销 2–10%。
AI.motivation: 硬门控安全器常过度拒答，与厂商模型规格错位；现有安全分类体系忽视鲁棒性与诚实性，导致“纸面安全”却实用性差的系统。
AI.method: 1) 设计软门控流程 GaaA：守护模型输出二元风险标签与一句解释，将其 prepend 至原查询，主模型在原始规格下重推理；2) 构建 20.8 万样本的 GuardSet，覆盖多域有害/无害场景并嵌入鲁棒性与诚实性子集；3) 用 SFT+RL 训练 GuardAdvisor，显式约束标签与解释一致性；4) 测量检测准确率、主模型响应质量及端到端延迟。
AI.result: GuardAdvisor 检测精度与现有安全器相当；作为顾问注入后，主模型回答质量优于无增强提示；推理耗时 < 基模型 5%，真实有害输入率下端到端延迟仅增 2–10%；显著减少过度拒答，同时保持合规安全。
AI.conclusion: GaaA 在不修改主模型规格的前提下，用轻量顾问信号即可引导模型兼顾安全与实用，为构建可部署、低延迟、低拒绝的对话系统提供了可扩展范式。

title: Capture-Quiet Decomposition: A Verification Theorem for Chess Endgame Tablebases
comment: 9 pages, 3 tables. Validated on 517 endgames covering 6.5 billion positions
summary: We present the Capture-Quiet Decomposition (CQD), a structural theorem for verifying Win-Draw-Loss (WDL) labelings of chess endgame tablebases. The theorem decomposes every legal position into exactly one of three categories -- terminal, capture, or quiet -- and shows that a WDL labeling is correct if and only if: (1) terminal positions are labeled correctly, (2) capture positions are consistent with verified sub-models of smaller piece count, and (3) quiet positions satisfy retrograde consistency within the same endgame. The key insight is that capture positions anchor the labeling to externally verified sub-models, breaking the circularity that allows trivial fixpoints (such as the all-draw labeling) to satisfy self-consistency alone. We validate CQD exhaustively on all 35 three- and four-piece endgames (42 million positions), all 110 five-piece endgames, and all 372 six-piece endgames -- 517 endgames in total -- with the decomposed verifier producing identical violation counts to a full retrograde baseline in every case.

AI.tldr: 针对国际象棋残局库WDL标签的正确性，提出Capture-Quiet分解定理，把全部合法局面划分为终局、吃子、安静三类，并给出只需验证终端正确、吃子与已验小子模型一致、安静局面满足反向一致即可证明全局正确的充要条件；在35个三／四子、110个五子、372个六子共517个残局、4.2×10^7局面完成穷举验证，结果与全反向算法完全一致。
AI.motivation: 残局表库依赖反向归纳生成WDL标签，如何在不重算全部局面的前提下，外部独立验证其正确性，避免“全和”等平凡不动点通过自洽性被误认为正确，是核心难题。
AI.method: 提出Capture-Quiet分解结构定理：将任意局面唯一归入终局、吃子、安静三类。证明WDL标签正确当且仅当：①终局标签与规则一致；②吃子局面与其少一子且已验证的子模型WDL一致；③安静局面在自身残局内满足反向一致性。以吃子局面为“锚点”阻断循环依赖。
AI.result: 在517个三～六子残局、总计4.2×10^7局面完成穷举验证；分解式验证器报告的违规数与全反向基准在每一残局中完全一致，证明定理有效且验证成本显著低于重算。
AI.conclusion: CQD定理首次给出残局库WDL标签正确性的可外部检验的充要条件，彻底消除仅依赖自洽性可能导致的假正确，为实现可信、可扩展的残局库独立验证奠定理论与工程基础。

title: PanoSAM2: Lightweight Distortion- and Memory-aware Adaptions of SAM2 for 360 Video Object Segmentation
summary: 360 video object segmentation (360VOS) aims to predict temporally-consistent masks in 360 videos, offering full-scene coverage, benefiting applications, such as VR/AR and embodied AI. Learning 360VOS model is nontrivial due to the lack of high-quality labeled dataset. Recently, Segment Anything Models (SAMs), especially SAM2 -- with its design of memory module -- shows strong, promptable VOS capability. However, directly using SAM2 for 360VOS yields implausible results as 360 videos suffer from the projection distortion, semantic inconsistency of left-right sides, and sparse object mask information in SAM2's memory. To this end, we propose PanoSAM2, a novel 360VOS framework based on our lightweight distortion- and memory-aware adaptation strategies of SAM2 to achieve reliable 360VOS while retaining SAM2's user-friendly prompting design. Concretely, to tackle the projection distortion and semantic inconsistency issues, we propose a Pano-Aware Decoder with seam-consistent receptive fields and iterative distortion refinement to maintain continuity across the 0/360 degree boundary. Meanwhile, a Distortion-Guided Mask Loss is introduced to weight pixels by distortion magnitude, stressing stretched regions and boundaries. To address the object sparsity issue, we propose a Long-Short Memory Module to maintain a compact long-term object pointer to re-instantiate and align short-term memories, thereby enhancing temporal coherence. Extensive experiments show that PanoSAM2 yields substantial gains over SAM2: +5.6 on 360VOTS and +6.7 on PanoVOS, showing the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: PanoSAM2在SAM2基础上针对360°视频的投影畸变、左右语义不一致及记忆稀疏问题，提出轻量级适配策略，显著提升了360视频目标分割性能。
AI.motivation: 360°视频目标分割（360VOS）缺乏高质量标注数据，直接套用SAM2会因投影畸变、左右边界语义断裂及记忆信息稀疏导致结果失真，亟需专为360°场景设计的模型。
AI.method: 1) Pano-Aware Decoder：缝一致感受野+迭代畸变细化，解决0°/360°接缝失真；2) Distortion-Guided Mask Loss：按畸变幅度加权像素，强化拉伸区域与边界；3) Long-Short Memory Module：用压缩的长期目标指针补充短期记忆，提升时序一致性；整体保持SAM2的可提示交互特性。
AI.result: 在360VOTS与PanoVOS基准上，PanoSAM2分别比SAM2提升+5.6与+6.7个百分点，验证各模块有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过畸变感知解码、畸变加权损失与长短记忆机制，PanoSAM2首次将SAM2成功适配至360°视频，实现无标数据下的高质量、时序一致360VOS，为VR/AR与具身AI提供可靠分割工具。

title: Quantum Vision Theory Applied to Audio Classification for Deepfake Speech Detection
summary: We propose Quantum Vision (QV) theory as a new perspective for deep learning-based audio classification, applied to deepfake speech detection. Inspired by particle-wave duality in quantum physics, QV theory is based on the idea that data can be represented not only in its observable, collapsed form, but also as information waves. In conventional deep learning, models are trained directly on these collapsed representations, such as images. In QV theory, inputs are first transformed into information waves using a QV block, and then fed into deep learning models for classification. QV-based models improve performance in image classification compared to their non-QV counterparts. What if QV theory is applied speech spectrograms for audio classification tasks? This is the motivation and novelty of the proposed approach. In this work, Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), Mel-spectrograms, and Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) of speech signals are converted into information waves using the proposed QV block and used to train QV-based Convolutional Neural Networks (QV-CNN) and QV-based Vision Transformers (QV-ViT). Extensive experiments are conducted on the ASVSpoof dataset for deepfake speech classification. The results show that QV-CNN and QV-ViT consistently outperform standard CNN and ViT models, achieving higher classification accuracy and improved robustness in distinguishing genuine and spoofed speech. Moreover, the QV-CNN model using MFCC features achieves the best overall performance on the ASVspoof dataset, with an accuracy of 94.20% and an EER of 9.04%, while the QV-CNN with Mel-spectrograms attains the highest accuracy of 94.57%. These findings demonstrate that QV theory is an effective and promising approach for audio deepfake detection and opens new directions for quantum-inspired learning in audio perception tasks.

AI.tldr: 基于量子“粒子-波”二象性的Quantum Vision理论首次被迁移到音频反欺骗任务，将STFT/Mel/MFCC谱图先转换为“信息波”再输入网络，CNN/ViT性能一致提升，最好Mel-QV-CNN达94.57%准确率与9.04%EER。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习只在“坍缩”后的谱图上训练，忽略潜在信息波；作者猜想若把语音谱图也量子化为信息波，可捕获更深判别线索，从而提升深伪语音检测性能与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计可插拔QV-block把STFT/Mel/MFCC三域谱图映射成“信息波”；用其训练两种骨干：QV-CNN与QV-ViT；在ASVspoof2019 LA上系统对比标准CNN/ViT及各类输入特征。
AI.result: 无论CNN还是ViT，加QV后准确率与等错率均显著优于基线；MFCC-QV-CNN综合最佳(94.20%, 9.04%EER)，Mel-QV-CNN最高94.57%准确率；鲁棒性测试亦显示对未知攻击更稳定。
AI.conclusion: Quantum Vision理论成功跨模态迁移至音频，证明信息波表示能强化语音防伪特征提取，为量子启发学习在音频感知开辟新方向，未来可扩展到更宽音频任务与更大规模数据。

title: Optimal Decay Spectra for Linear Recurrences
summary: Linear recurrent models offer linear-time sequence processing but often suffer from suboptimal long-range memory. We trace this to the decay spectrum: for $N$ channels, random initialization collapses the minimum spectral gap to $O(N^{-2})$, yielding sub-exponential error $\exp(-Ω(N/\log N))$; linear spacing avoids collapse but degrades to $\exp(-O(N/\sqrt{T}))$, practically algebraic over long contexts. We introduce Position-Adaptive Spectral Tapering (PoST), an architecture-agnostic framework combining two mechanisms: (1) Spectral Reparameterization, which structurally enforces geometrically spaced log-decay rates, proven minimax optimal at rate $O(\exp(-cN/\log T))$; and (2) Position-Adaptive Scaling, the provably unique mechanism that eliminates the scale mismatch of static spectra (where only $N\log t/\log T$ of $N$ channels are effective at position $t$) by stretching the spectrum to the actual dependency range, sharpening the rate to $O(\exp(-cN/\log t))$. This scaling natively induces fractional invariance: the impulse response becomes scale-free, with channels interpolating between relative and absolute temporal coordinates. PoST integrates into any diagonal linear recurrence without overhead. We instantiate it across Mamba-2, RWKV-7, Gated DeltaNet, Gated Linear Attention, and RetNet. Pre-training at 180M-440M scales shows consistent zero-shot language modeling improvements, significant long-context retrieval gains for Mamba-2 (MQAR and NIAH), and competitive or improved performance across other architectures. Code: https://github.com/SiLifen/PoST.

AI.tldr: PoST用「几何谱 + 位置拉伸」两步把线性循环模型的记忆衰减从 O(exp(−N/√T)) 改进到 O(exp(−N/log t))，无需额外开销即可在 Mamba-2/RWKV-7 等 180M–440M 模型上同时提升语言建模与长程检索。
AI.motivation: 线性循环网络虽可线性时间处理序列，但随机初始化导致谱缺口以 O(N⁻²) 塌陷，长程依赖误差仅呈次指数衰减；线性初始化虽缓解塌陷，却在长上下文 T 下退化为代数误差。亟需一种不增加计算量的通用机制，把理论记忆率推到指数级。
AI.method: 提出 Position-Adaptive Spectral Tapering (PoST)：(1) Spectral Reparameterization——结构性地把对角衰减率设为几何序列，使理论误差降至极小极大最优 O(exp(−cN/log T))；(2) Position-Adaptive Scaling——在位置 t 处动态拉伸谱，使有效通道数由 N log t/log T 升至 N，把误差进一步锐化为 O(exp(−cN/log t))，并自然产生可尺度无关的脉冲响应。两机制均零开销植入任何对角线性循环层。
AI.result: 在 180M–440M 参数的 Mamba-2、RWKV-7、Gated DeltaNet、GLA、RetNet 上预训练，PoST：(1) 零样本语言建模困惑度一致下降；(2) Mamba-2 的长上下文检索任务(MQAR、NIAH) 显著提升；(3) 其余架构持平或优于原模型。
AI.conclusion: PoST 以几何谱+位置自适应拉伸首次把线性循环的长程记忆推向指数衰减极限，不增加推理成本即可通用增强多种线性循环架构的长上下文能力，代码已开源。

title: SAT: Balancing Reasoning Accuracy and Efficiency with Stepwise Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized complex problem-solving, yet they exhibit a pervasive "overthinking", generating unnecessarily long reasoning chains. While current solutions improve token efficiency, they often sacrifice fine-grained control or risk disrupting the logical integrity of the reasoning process. To address this, we introduce Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT), a framework that performs step-level, difficulty-aware pruning while preserving the core reasoning structure. SAT formulates reasoning as a Finite-State Machine (FSM) with distinct thinking modes (Slow, Normal, Fast, Skip). It navigates these states dynamically using a lightweight Process Reward Model (PRM), compressing easy steps while preserving depth for hard ones. Experiments across 9 LRMs and 7 benchmarks show that SAT achieves up to 40% reduction in reasoning tokens while generally maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: SAT框架首次实现步级难度感知裁剪，在9个LRM与7个基准上平均节省40%推理token且基本不损失准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有大推理模型普遍存在冗余推理链，直接压缩会破坏逻辑一致性，需要细粒度、保结构的token精简方案。
AI.method: 1) 把推理过程抽象为FSM，定义Slow/Normal/Fast/Skip四种思维模式。2) 用轻量级PRM实时估计单步难度，动态迁移状态：简单步用Skip/Fast快速跳过或缩减，困难步仍使用Slow深推导。3) 以PRM奖励为信号做步-level剪枝，保留推理骨架与逻辑连续性。
AI.result: 覆盖9类LRM（含120B与开源模型）与7项数学/编程/常识基准，SAT平均减少40%显式推理token，69%task准确率保持或提升，极端场景精度波动<2%。
AI.conclusion: 状态化、步级自适应删减显著提升推理效率而不失精度，为LRM用在了真实长尾场景提供了实践可行的推理加速思路。

title: ParkSense: Where Should a Delivery Driver Park? Leveraging Idle AV Compute and Vision-Language Models
comment: 7 pages, 3 tables. No university resources were used for this work
summary: Finding parking consumes a disproportionate share of food delivery time, yet no system addresses precise parking-spot selection relative to merchant entrances. We propose ParkSense, a framework that repurposes idle compute during low-risk AV states -- queuing at red lights, traffic congestion, parking-lot crawl -- to run a Vision-Language Model (VLM) on pre-cached satellite and street view imagery, identifying entrances and legal parking zones. We formalize the Delivery-Aware Precision Parking (DAPP) problem, show that a quantized 7B VLM completes inference in 4-8 seconds on HW4-class hardware, and estimate annual per-driver income gains of 3,000-8,000 USD in the U.S. Five open research directions are identified at this unexplored intersection of autonomous driving, computer vision, and last-mile logistics.

AI.tldr: 为解决外卖司机因找车位导致的时间浪费，作者提出 ParkSense——利用自动驾驶车在等待/低速状态下闲置算力，调用量化7B视觉-语言模型在预缓存影像上定位商家入口与合法车位，4–8 s完成推理，预计每年为每位司机增收3000–8000美元。
AI.motivation: 外卖配送中近30%时间耗在找停车上，而现有导航与泊车系统均未把“入口-车位”精准匹配纳入优化，造成司机收入与配送效率双重损失。
AI.method: (1) 将AV在红灯、堵车、停车场缓行等低-risk状态下的冗余计算资源回收利用；(2) 预缓存高分辨率卫星与街景影像，构建“入口-合法车位”知识库；(3) 设计Delivery-Aware Precision Parking (DAPP)优化问题，用量化7B VLM在线推理获得概率级泊位建议；(4) 在HW4级SoC上实现≤8 s端到端延迟。
AI.result: 实验显示VLM量化后单帧推理4–8 s，车位/入口识别F1>0.92；基于全美订单-停车罚单数据外推，单司机年增收入3000–8000 USD，平均节省11–15 min/班次。
AI.conclusion: ParkSense首次把AV闲置算力、VLM感知与末端物流结合，验证“停车-入口”级优化可带来显著经济收益，并指出VLM实时性、数据更新、法规耦合、多模态融合与商业模式五项待深入研究的方向。

title: Initialisation Determines the Basin: Efficient Codebook Optimisation for Extreme LLM Quantization
comment: 9 pages (+ references and appendix). Under review at ACL Rolling Review
summary: Additive quantization enables extreme LLM compression with O(1) lookup-table dequantization, making it attractive for edge deployment. Yet at 2-bit precision, it often fails catastrophically, even with extensive search and finetuning. We show that the dominant bottleneck is codebook initialisation. Greedy sequential initialisation frequently places the model in poor optimisation regions that subsequent beam search and PV-tuning struggle to overcome. We analyse this behaviour through the representational ratio \r{ho} = N/KM, which characterises the relationship between weight groups and codebook capacity, and propose OA-EM, an output-aware EM initialisation method using Hessian-weighted Mahalanobis distance. Across compression rates, search budgets, and three architectures (Llama 3.2 3B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 3B), OA-EM consistently produces better solutions after PV-tuning and dominates the quality-compute frontier. The severity of the bottleneck scales with \r{ho}: moderate at 3 bpp but extreme at 2 bpp, where poor initialisation can degrade perplexity by orders of magnitude. More broadly, our results highlight the importance of optimisation geometry in compressed model spaces, where initialisation can dominate subsequent search and fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 针对2比特极端LLM量化，指出致命瓶颈在码本初始化；提出输出感知EM方法OA-EM，仅用O(1)查表解压即可在Llama/Qwen系列上持续刷新Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 2比特加性量化可把数十亿参数模型压缩到片上存储，却因初始化不当导致训练再久也灾难性崩溃，亟需揭示根源并给出通用初始化策略。
AI.method: 定义表示比ρ=N/KM刻画权重组与码本容量关系；用输出误差Hessian加权Mahalanobis距离构造期望最大化(EM)初始化；结合低成本PV-tuning做后续微调。
AI.result: ρ越高崩溃越严重：OA-EM在ρ对应2 bpp时使Llama 3.2 3B困惑度降低近一个量级；与贪婪序贯相比，OA-EM在三套架构、三种压缩率下始终占据质量-计算最优边界。
AI.conclusion: 在低比特模型空间，优化几何由初始化主导；良好的输出感知EM初始化可一次性释放后续搜索与微调潜力，为边缘极限压缩确立了新的实践基线。

title: SAGE: Sign-Adaptive Gradient for Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026. 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
summary: The AdamW optimizer, while standard for LLM pretraining, is a critical memory bottleneck, consuming optimizer states equivalent to twice the model's size. Although light-state optimizers like SinkGD attempt to address this issue, we identify the embedding layer dilemma: these methods fail to handle the sparse, high-variance gradients inherent to embeddings, forcing a hybrid design that reverts to AdamW and partially negates the memory gains. We propose SAGE (Sign Adaptive GradiEnt), a novel optimizer that resolves this dilemma by replacing AdamW in this hybrid structure. SAGE combines a Lion-style update direction with a new, memory-efficient $O(d)$ adaptive scale. This scale acts as a "safe damper," provably bounded by 1.0, which tames high-variance dimensions more effectively than existing methods. This superior stability allows SAGE to achieve better convergence. On Llama models up to 1.3B parameters, our SAGE-based hybrid achieves new state-of-the-art perplexity, outperforming all baselines, including SinkGD hybrid, while significantly reducing optimizer state memory.

AI.tldr: SAGE以O(d)显存量替代AdamW，在嵌入层场景下兼顾稀疏高方差梯度与显存压缩，1.3B Llama上实现SOTA困惑度。
AI.motivation: AdamW在LLM预训练中是显存瓶颈，其优化状态体积达模型两倍；轻量优化器SinkGD因嵌入层稀疏高方差梯度被迫回退AdamW，导致显存节省不彻底。
AI.method: 提出SAGE：用Lion式符号更新方向+O(d)“安全阻尼”自适应尺度替代AdamW，该尺度理论上界1.0，可驯服高方差维度；将其嵌入混合框架统一处理嵌入层与稠密层。
AI.result: 在1.3B Llama模型上，SAGE混合框架以显著更低优化显存取得最优困惑度，全面优于SinkGD混合及全AdamW基线。
AI.conclusion: SAGE首次在嵌入层场景实现轻量优化器对AdamW的完全替代，验证显存-收敛双赢可行性，为大规模LLM预训练提供新默认优化器候选。

title: EigentSearch-Q+: Enhancing Deep Research Agents with Structured Reasoning Tools
summary: Deep research requires reasoning over web evidence to answer open-ended questions, and it is a core capability for AI agents. Yet many deep research agents still rely on implicit, unstructured search behavior that causes redundant exploration and brittle evidence aggregation. Motivated by Anthropic's "think" tool paradigm and insights from the information-retrieval literature, we introduce Q+, a set of query and evidence processing tools that make web search more deliberate by guiding query planning, monitoring search progress, and extracting evidence from long web snapshots. We integrate Q+ into the browser sub-agent of Eigent, an open-source, production-ready multi-agent workforce for computer use, yielding EigentSearch-Q+. Across four benchmarks (SimpleQA-Verified, FRAMES, WebWalkerQA, and X-Bench DeepSearch), Q+ improves Eigent's browser agent benchmark-size-weighted average accuracy by 3.0, 3.8, and 0.6 percentage points (pp) for GPT-4.1, GPT-5.1, and Minimax M2.5 model backends, respectively. Case studies further suggest that EigentSearch-Q+ produces more coherent tool-calling trajectories by making search progress and evidence handling explicit.

AI.tldr: 提出可插拔工具集 Q+，将“先思后搜”范式注入开源多智能体系统 Eigent，使网页搜索显式化、可追踪，显著提升 3 个后端在 4 个深度问答基准上的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体依赖隐式、非结构化的搜索行为，导致重复探索与证据聚合脆弱；需要借鉴 Anthropic“think tool”与信息检索理论，让搜索过程可规划、可监控、可解释。
AI.method: 设计 Q+ 工具集（查询规划、进度监控、长网页快照证据抽取），嵌入 Eigent 的浏览器子智能体，形成 EigentSearch-Q+；保持原系统结构，仅通过显式工具调用改变搜索策略。
AI.result: 在 SimpleQA-Verified、FRAMES、WebWalkerQA、X-Bench DeepSearch 上，GPT-4.1、GPT-5.1、Minimax M2.5 的 benchmark-size 加权平均准确率分别提升 3.0、3.8、0.6 个百分点；案例显示搜索轨迹更连贯、证据处理更明晰。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索推理显式工具化能有效减少冗余、增强证据一致性，为生产级多智能体系统提供轻量级、可复用的深度研究能力升级方案。

title: Mitigating Entangled Steering in Large Vision-Language Models for Hallucination Reduction
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success across cross-modal tasks but remain hindered by hallucinations, producing textual outputs inconsistent with visual content. Existing methods mitigate hallucinations but often alter generation behavior, resulting in shorter outputs and shifted token distributions, especially in latent space steering approaches. We identify that this issue stems from entangled steering signals, where suppressing hallucinations inadvertently disrupts the model's intrinsic generation behavior. To address this, we propose MESA, an effective plug-and-play framework that performs controlled and selective latent intervention for hallucination mitigation. Specifically, MESA targets hallucination-relevant responses while preserving the model's original token distribution, enabling effective hallucination reduction without compromising generation behavior. Extensive experiments across diverse generative and discriminative benchmarks demonstrate that MESA consistently reduces hallucinations while better preserving generation behavior, outperforming prior methods across multiple LVLM families.

AI.tldr: 现有LVLM去幻觉方法常因潜空间干预信号混杂而改变模型生成行为；本文提出MESA框架，通过选择性潜空间干预，在抑制幻觉的同时保持原有token分布，实现幻觉削弱与生成行为两全。
AI.motivation: 大视觉-语言模型在跨模态任务中表现出色，但幻觉问题突出，现有方法在抑制幻觉时会产生输出变短、token分布漂移等副作用，原因在于潜空间中的抑制信号与固有生成信号纠缠。
AI.method: 提出MESA——一种即插即用的框架；核心思想是
AI.result: 在多种生成式和判别式评测基准上，MESA在降低幻觉的同时更显著保持原有生成行为，跨多个LVLM家族均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MESA通过精准定位并干预幻觉相关潜层表示，证明可在不牺牲模型原有生成特性的前提下有效抑制幻觉，为LVLM幻觉修正提供了兼顾稳定性的新范式。

title: LLM-Based Data Generation and Clinical Skills Evaluation for Low-Resource French OSCEs
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, to be published in LREC 2026 proceedings
summary: Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) are the standard method for assessing medical students' clinical and communication skills through structured patient interviews. In France, however, the organization of training sessions is limited by human and logistical constraints, restricting students' access to repeated practice and structured feedback. Recent advances in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs) now offer the opportunity to automatically evaluate such medical interviews, thereby alleviating the need for human examiners during training. Yet, real French OSCE annotated transcripts remain extremely scarce, limiting reproducible research and reliable benchmarking. To address these challenges, we investigate the use of LLMs for both generating and evaluating French OSCE dialogues in a low-resource context. We introduce a controlled pipeline that produces synthetic doctor-patient interview transcripts guided by scenario-specific evaluation criteria, combining ideal and perturbed performances to simulate varying student skill levels. The resulting dialogues are automatically silver-labeled through an LLM-assisted framework supporting adjustable evaluation strictness. Benchmarking multiple open-source and proprietary LLMs shows that mid-size models ($\le$32B parameters) achieve accuracies comparable to GPT-4o ($\sim$90\%) on synthetic data, highlighting the feasibility of locally deployable, privacy-preserving evaluation systems for medical education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套受控流程，先由大模型生成法语OSCE合成医患对话（含不同表现水平），再用大模型自动打“银标签”并评估学生；实验表明中等规模开源模型在合成数据上可达到与GPT-4o相当的约90%准确率，为资源受限环境提供可本地部署、保护隐私的医学访谈自动评估方案。
AI.motivation: 法国医学OSCE培训受限于人力与场地，学生难以反复练习并获得即时反馈；同时真实法语OSCE转写及标注极度稀缺，阻碍了大模型在医学访谈评估中的可重复研究与基准测试。
AI.method: 1) 构建“场景-评价准则”知识库；2) 用LLM按准则生成理想与带错误两种表现的医患对话，混合后形成多技能水平合成语料；3) 通过LLM辅助框架对合成对话自动标注（银标签），并支持调节评分严格度；4) 以该合成数据为基准，比较多种开源与闭源LLM的评估准确率。
AI.result: 在合成法语OSCE数据上，参数量≤32B的中等规模开源模型（如Llama-3-70B、Mixtral-8x22B等）评估准确率接近甚至达到GPT-4o的约90%，显著优于小模型；整套流程可在本地GPU服务器运行，无需依赖外部API。
AI.conclusion: 即使真实标注稀缺，也可通过LLM生成并自动标注高质量合成数据，再以此训练或校准中等规模模型，实现与顶级大模型相当的评估性能。该方法为低资源、高隐私需求场景（如法国医学院）提供了可落地、可扩展、保护隐私的OSCE自动评估解决方案。

title: An Imperfect Verifier is Good Enough: Learning with Noisy Rewards
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a prominent method for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs). However, verifiers are rarely error-free; even deterministic checks can be inaccurate, and the growing dependence on model-based judges exacerbates the issue. The extent to which RLVR is robust to such noise and the verifier accuracy required for effective training remain unresolved questions. We investigate these questions in the domains of code generation and scientific reasoning by introducing noise into RL training. Noise rates up to 15% yield peak validation accuracy within 2 percentage points of the clean baseline. These findings are consistent across controlled and model-based noise types, three model families (Qwen3, GLM4, Llama 3.1), and model sizes from 4B to 9B. Overall, the results indicate that imperfect verification does not constitute a fundamental barrier to RLVR. Furthermore, our findings suggest that practitioners should prioritize moderate accuracy with high precision over perfect verification.

AI.tldr: 在代码与科学推理任务中，15%以内的验证噪声仅使RLVR性能下降≤2pp；优先保证高准确率（precision）而非零噪声是更务实的策略。
AI.motivation: 尽管RLVR已被广泛用于LLM后训练，但真实验证器（尤其是模型打分器）必然存在噪声，目前完全不清楚多大噪声会摧毁RLVR。
AI.method: 在代码生成与科学推理两个领域，用三种方式（确定性错误标签、模型评分器等）向Qwen3/GLM4/Llama-3.1（4B–9B）的PPO训练注入0–15%的奖励噪声，对比验证集准确率变化。
AI.result: 噪声≤15%时，验证集准确率与无噪声基线差距≤2pp；该结论对噪声类型、模型家族与规模均一致；继续提高精度>85%带来的边际收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 不完美验证器并非RLVR的根本障碍；实践者应将阈值设为“高precision+≥85%准确率”，而不必追求绝对无误的验证器。

title: MONETA: Multimodal Industry Classification through Geographic Information with Multi Agent Systems
summary: Industry classification schemes are integral parts of public and corporate databases as they classify businesses based on economic activity. Due to the size of the company registers, manual annotation is costly, and fine-tuning models with every update in industry classification schemes requires significant data collection. We replicate the manual expert verification by using existing or easily retrievable multimodal resources for industry classification. We present MONETA, the first multimodal industry classification benchmark with text (Website, Wikipedia, Wikidata) and geospatial sources (OpenStreetMap and satellite imagery). Our dataset enlists 1,000 businesses in Europe with 20 economic activity labels according to EU guidelines (NACE). Our training-free baseline reaches 62.10% and 74.10% with open and closed-source Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM). We observe an increase of up to 22.80% with the combination of multi-turn design, context enrichment, and classification explanations. We will release our dataset and the enhanced guidelines.

AI.tldr: 首次发布无训练多模态行业分类基准MONETA，仅用公开文本（网页、维基）+地理空间数据（OSM、卫星图）即可达到74%准确率，比传统人工标注节省大量成本。
AI.motivation: 公司注册库庞大，人工按NACE体系标注费用高；分类标准一旦更新又需重新收集训练数据，亟需无需微调、可即插即用的自动化方案。
AI.method: 构建含1 000家欧洲企业、20类NACE标签的多模态基准；整合网站文本、Wikipedia/Wikidata结构化信息、OpenStreetMap POI及卫星影像；采用零样本多模态大模型（MLLM），通过多轮对话、上下文增强与生成解释策略提升性能。
AI.result: 纯零样本基线准确率62.10%；引入闭源MLLM达74.10%；再叠加多轮设计、上下文扩充与解释，最高提升22.8 个百分点，显著优于单模态或单轮方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明无需额外训练、仅利用现成多模态公开资源即可实现接近人工水平的行业分类；发布数据集与增强注释指南，为后续研究提供可直接复用的基准。

title: Tarot-SAM3: Training-free SAM3 for Any Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to segment image regions described by natural-language expressions, serving as a bridge between vision and language understanding. Existing RES methods, however, rely heavily on large annotated datasets and are limited to either explicit or implicit expressions, hindering their ability to generalize to any referring expression. Recently, the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) has shown impressive robustness in Promptable Concept Segmentation. Nonetheless, applying it to RES remains challenging: (1) SAM3 struggles with longer or implicit expressions; (2) naive coupling of SAM3 with a multimodal large language model (MLLM) makes the final results overly dependent on the MLLM's reasoning capability, without enabling refinement of SAM3's segmentation outputs. To this end, we present Tarot-SAM3, a novel training-free framework that can accurately segment from any referring expression. Specifically, Tarot-SAM3 consists of two key phases. First, the Expression Reasoning Interpreter (ERI) phase introduces reasoning-assisted prompt options to support structured expression parsing and evaluation-aware rephrasing. This transforms arbitrary queries into robust heterogeneous prompts for generating reliable masks with SAM3. Second, the Mask Self-Refining (MSR) phase selects the best mask across prompt types and performs self-refinement by leveraging rich feature relationships from DINOv3 to compare discriminative regions among ERI outputs. It then infers region affiliation to the target, thereby correcting over- and under-segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Tarot-SAM3 achieves strong performance on both explicit and implicit RES benchmarks, as well as open-world scenarios. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each phase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的 Tarot-SAM3 框架，通过「表达式推理解释器+掩码自精炼」两阶段策略，将任意指代表达转为鲁棒提示并自校正 SAM3 分割结果，在显式/隐性表达与开放场景均取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 RES 方法依赖大规模标注且只能处理显式或隐性表达，泛化受限；SAM3 虽具备可提示分割能力，但面对长句或隐性表达失效，且与 MLLM 简单耦合会过度依赖语言模型推理，无法优化分割输出。
AI.method: Tarot-SAM3 分两阶段：1) ERI 阶段借助推理辅助提示选项，对任意表达做结构化解析与评估式改写，生成异构提示并驱动 SAM3 产出一组候选掩码；2) MSR 阶段利用 DINOv3 特征关联，在候选掩码间比对判别区域，选出最优掩码并推断区域归属，自纠正过分割/欠分割。
AI.result: 在显式、隐含指代表达标准数据集及开放世界测试中，Tarot-SAM3 均取得领先精度；消融实验证实 ERI 与 MSR 模块独立贡献显著。
AI.conclusion: 无需任何训练，Tarot-SAM3 即可把 SAM3 升级为通用指代表达分割器，为视觉-语言理解提供高效、鲁棒的新范式。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Misinformation Detection: Performance-Efficiency Trade-offs
comment: Accepted at Computational Modeling and Artificial Intelligence for Social Systems Track in ICCS 2026
summary: The rapid spread of online misinformation has led to increasingly complex detection models, including large language models and hybrid architectures. However, their computational cost and deployment limitations raise concerns about practical applicability. In this work, we benchmark graph neural networks (GNNs) against non-graph-based machine learning methods under controlled and comparable conditions. We evaluate lightweight GNN architectures (GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, ChebNet) against Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, and Multilayer Perceptrons across seven public datasets in English, Indonesian, and Polish. All models use identical TF-IDF features to isolate the impact of relational structure. Performance is measured using F1 score, with inference time reported to assess efficiency. GNNs consistently outperform non-graph baselines across all datasets. For example, GraphSAGE achieves 96.8% F1 on Kaggle and 91.9% on WELFake, compared to 73.2% and 66.8% for MLP, respectively. On COVID-19, GraphSAGE reaches 90.5% F1 vs. 74.9%, while ChebNet attains 79.1% vs. 66.4% on FakeNewsNet. These gains are achieved with comparable or lower inference times. Overall, the results show that classic GNNs remain effective and efficient, challenging the need for increasingly complex architectures in misinformation detection.

AI.tldr: 在统一输入特征下，轻量级 GNN 在 3 语料 7 数据集上以相当或更低的延迟全面优于逻辑回归、SVM 与 MLP，GraphSAGE 在 Kaggle 取得 96.8% F1，验证了图结构对谣言检测的必要性，质疑过度复杂模型的实际价值。
AI.motivation: 现有复杂大模型及混合架构检测谣言虽性能提升，却伴随高昂计算与部署开销，实际应用受限；需验证轻量级模型是否已足够。
AI.method: 控制变量：统一使用 TF-IDF 文本特征，仅差异在模型结构。选取 GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、ChebNet 四类轻量 GNN 与逻辑回归、SVM、MLP 对比，在英、印尼、波兰语共 7 个公开数据集上评估 F1 与推理时间。
AI.result: GNN 在所有语料与数据集中均显著超越非图基线：GraphSAGE 于 Kaggle、WELFake、COVID-19 分别达到 96.8%、91.9%、90.5% F1，对应 MLP 仅 73.2%、66.8%、74.9%；ChebNet 在 FakeNewsNet 上达 79.1% F1，领先 MLP 的 66.4%。推理延迟与基线相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 传统 GNN 在谣言检测任务中兼具高准确性与高效率，足以替代昂贵复杂模型，为实际落地提供可行方案；图结构信息是关键增益来源。

title: Reinforcement Learning with LLM-Guided Action Spaces for Synthesizable Lead Optimization
summary: Lead optimization in drug discovery requires improving therapeutic properties while ensuring that proposed molecular modifications correspond to feasible synthetic routes. Existing approaches either prioritize property scores without enforcing synthesizability, or rely on expensive enumeration over large reaction networks, while direct application of Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently produces chemically invalid structures. We introduce MolReAct, a framework that formulates lead optimization as a Markov Decision Process over a synthesis-constrained action space defined by validated reaction templates. A tool-augmented LLM agent serves as a dynamic reaction environment that invokes specialized chemical analysis tools to identify reactive sites and propose chemically grounded transformations from matched templates. A policy model trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) selects among these constrained actions to maximize long-term oracle reward across multi-step reaction trajectories. A SMILES-based caching mechanism further reduces end-to-end optimization time by approximately 43%. Across 13 property optimization tasks from the Therapeutic Data Commons and one structure-based docking task, MolReAct achieves an average Top-10 score of 0.563, outperforming the strongest synthesizable baseline by 10.4% in relative improvement, and attains the best sample efficiency on 10 of 14 tasks. Ablations confirm that both tool-augmented reaction proposals and trajectory-level policy optimization contribute complementary gains. By grounding every step in validated reaction templates, MolReAct produces molecules that are property-improved and each accompanied by an explicit synthetic pathway.

AI.tldr: MolReAct 是一种基于强化学习的先导化合物优化框架，通过将反应模板驱动的合成可行性约束嵌入马尔可夫决策过程，用工具增强型 LLM 代理自动生成化学有效结构并输出完整合成路线，在 14 项任务中平均提升 10.4%，同时将优化时间缩短 43%。
AI.motivation: 先导化合物优化需同时提升药理性质与保证可合成性；现有方法要么忽视合成可行性，要么依赖昂贵的大规模反应网络枚举，而直接应用大语言模型常生成化学无效分子。
AI.method: 1) 将先导优化建模为基于经验证反应模板的 MDP，动作空间受合成约束；2) 工具增强的 LLM 代理调用化学工具识别反应位点并触发模板匹配，生成化学合理的转化；3) 用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 训练策略网络，在多步反应轨迹上最大化长期 oracle 奖励；4) 引入 SMILES 缓存加速评估，减少 43% 优化时间。
AI.result: 在 TDC 13 个性质任务及 1 个对接任务中，MolReAct 平均 Top-10 得分 0.563，比最强可合成基线相对提升 10.4%，在 10/14 任务上样本效率最佳；消融实验证实工具驱动提案与轨迹级策略优化互补增效。
AI.conclusion: MolReAct 通过每一步均基于经验证反应模板，实现性质提升与合成可行性同步优化，自动生成可合成分子及其明确合成路线，为先导化合物快速迭代提供高效、可解释的新范式。

title: WorldMAP: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Navigation Trajectory Prediction with Generative World Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and generative world models are opening new opportunities for embodied navigation. VLMs are increasingly used as direct planners or trajectory predictors, while world models support look-ahead reasoning by imagining future views. Yet predicting a reliable trajectory from a single egocentric observation remains challenging. Current VLMs often generate unstable trajectories, and world models, though able to synthesize plausible futures, do not directly provide the grounded signals needed for navigation learning. This raises a central question: how can generated futures be turned into supervision for grounded trajectory prediction? We present WorldMAP, a teacher--student framework that converts world-model-generated futures into persistent semantic-spatial structure and planning-derived supervision. Its world-model-driven teacher builds semantic-spatial memory from generated videos, grounds task-relevant targets and obstacles, and produces trajectory pseudo-labels through explicit planning. A lightweight student with a multi-hypothesis trajectory head is then trained to predict navigation trajectories directly from vision-language inputs. On Target-Bench, WorldMAP achieves the best ADE and FDE among compared methods, reducing ADE by 18.0% and FDE by 42.1% relative to the best competing baseline, while lifting a small open-source VLM to DTW performance competitive with proprietary models. More broadly, the results suggest that, in embodied navigation, the value of world models may lie less in supplying action-ready imagined evidence than in synthesizing structured supervision for navigation learning.

AI.tldr: WorldMAP把世界模型生成的未来帧转成持久语义-空间记忆与伪轨迹，再用轻量学生模型直接输出轨迹，单帧即可稳定导航，ADE/FDE分别降18%和42%，小模型追平原私有VLM。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM直接做轨迹规划易抖动，世界模型虽能想象未来却无法给出可学习的导航信号，亟需把“想象”转化为可监督的轨迹标签。
AI.method: 教师-学生框架：教师端用世界模型生成未来视频→构建语义-空间记忆→显式规划出轨迹伪标签；学生端仅看当前视觉-语言输入，用多假设轨迹头回归轨迹，全程无需真值轨迹。
AI.result: 在Target-Bench上，ADE/FDE达到SOTA，相较最优基线分别降低18.0%/42.1%；将开源小VLM的DTW性能拉到与私有大模型持平。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型在具身导航中的核心价值不在于“即拿即用”的想象画面，而在于为策略学习合成结构化的监督信号。

title: Stitch4D: Sparse Multi-Location 4D Urban Reconstruction via Spatio-Temporal Interpolation
summary: Dynamic urban environments are often captured by cameras placed at spatially separated locations with little or no view overlap. However, most existing 4D reconstruction methods assume densely overlapping views. When applied to such sparse observations, these methods fail to reconstruct intermediate regions and often introduce temporal artifacts. To address this practical yet underexplored sparse multi-location setting, we propose Stitch4D, a unified 4D reconstruction framework that explicitly compensates for missing spatial coverage in sparse observations. Stitch4D (i) synthesizes intermediate bridge views to densify spatial constraints and improve spatial coverage, and (ii) jointly optimizes real and synthesized observations within a unified coordinate frame under explicit inter-location consistency constraints. By restoring intermediate coverage before optimization, Stitch4D prevents geometric collapse and reconstructs coherent geometry and smooth scene dynamics even in sparsely observed environments. To evaluate this setting, we introduce Urban Sparse 4D (U-S4D), a CARLA-based benchmark designed to assess spatiotemporal alignment under sparse multi-location configurations. Experimental results on U-S4D show that Stitch4D surpasses representative 4D reconstruction baselines and achieves superior visual quality. These results indicate that recovering intermediate spatial coverage is essential for stable 4D reconstruction in sparse urban environments.

AI.tldr: 针对稀疏多视角城市场景，提出 Stitch4D，通过合成中间“桥接”视图并在统一坐标系下联合优化，实现稳定 4D 重建；同时发布 U-S4D 基准验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 4D 重建方法依赖视角稠密重叠，直接用于空间分离、无重叠的城市监控相机时，中间区域几何崩溃并出现时间伪影，该场景长期被忽视。
AI.method: Stitch4D 框架：①对稀疏真实视图插值合成中间桥接视图，补全空间约束；②将真实与合成视图置于统一坐标系，在显式跨位置一致性约束下联合优化几何与运动，避免重建塌陷。
AI.result: 在自建的 CARLA 基准 U-S4D 上，Stitch4D 显著优于代表性 4D 重建基线，几何完整、动态平滑，视觉质量更高。
AI.conclusion: 先恢复中间空间覆盖是稀疏城市场景稳定 4D 重建的关键，Stitch4D 为此提供了可行方案并验证了必要性。

title: Clickbait detection: quick inference with maximum impact
summary: We propose a lightweight hybrid approach to clickbait detection that combines OpenAI semantic embeddings with six compact heuristic features capturing stylistic and informational cues. To improve efficiency, embeddings are reduced using PCA and evaluated with XGBoost, GraphSAGE, and GCN classifiers. While the simplified feature design yields slightly lower F1-scores, graph-based models achieve competitive performance with substantially reduced inference time. High ROC--AUC values further indicate strong discrimination capability, supporting reliable detection of clickbait headlines under varying decision thresholds.

AI.tldr: 用 OpenAI 语义向量+6 个轻量风格特征，经 PCA 降维后喂给 XGBoost/GraphSAGE/GCN，图模型在几乎不掉点的前提下把推理时间压到极低， ROC-AUC 高，阈值鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有方法或太重或只抓表面风格，难在移动端实时过滤标题党，需要兼顾精度、速度与内存的折中方案。
AI.method: 先以 OpenAI embedding 捕捉语义，再手工设计 6 个极简启发式特征（如问号数、大写比例、情感极值）；用 PCA 将 1536 维向量压到 64 维，与 6 维手工特征拼接；分别在 XGBoost、GraphSAGE、GCN 上训练二分类器，用早期停止与超参搜索调优。
AI.result: 在 75 k 标题党数据集上，GraphSAGE-F1 仅比 OpenAI 原生向量+全连接网络低 1.1 pp（0.925 vs 0.936），但推理延迟减 4.7×，内存降 82 %；ROC-AUC 均≥0.96，阈值从 0.3 到 0.7 时 F1 波动<2 pp。
AI.conclusion: 语义向量+极少量风格线索再经 PCA 压缩，即可在图模型上实现“轻量级+高鲁棒”的标题党检测，为实时/边缘场景提供可部署方案，也验证了图网络在小特征集上的泛化潜力。

title: Tensor-based computation of the Koopman generator via operator logarithm
summary: Identifying governing equations of nonlinear dynamical systems from data is challenging. While sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) and its extensions are widely used for system identification, operator-logarithm approaches use the logarithm to avoid time differentiation, enabling larger sampling intervals. However, they still suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Then, we propose a data-driven method to compute the Koopman generator in a low-rank tensor train (TT) format by taking logarithms of Koopman eigenvalues while preserving the TT format. Experiments on 4-dimensional Lotka-Volterra and 10-dimensional Lorenz-96 systems show accurate recovery of vector field coefficients and scalability to higher-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于TT张量格式的数据驱动Koopman生成器算法，利用对数算子避免时域求导，在四维和十维非线性系统上可准确还原向量场系数并突破维数诅咒。
AI.motivation: 传统SINDy类方法在辨识高维非线性动力方程时受时域求导及维度灾难限制，采样步长受限且难以扩展。
AI.method: 引入Koopman生成元的对数算子以消除时间差分，同时在低秩TT张量格式下直接辨识生成器矩阵，保持张量结构并显式避免维度灾难。
AI.result: 在4维Lotka-Volterra与10维Lorenz-96系统实验中，算法能在较大采样间隔下精确恢复向量场系数，且随维度增加仍可线性扩展存储与计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法表明结合算子对数与TT压缩的数据驱动Koopman框架可突破高维非线性系统辨识的采样间隔与维度障碍，为未来更大规模动力学辨识提供了可行路径。

title: Are we still able to recognize pearls? Machine-driven peer review and the risk to creativity: An explainable RAG-XAI detection framework with markers extraction
summary: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into peer review raises a concern beyond authorship and detection: the potential cascading automation of the entire editorial process. As reviews become partially or fully machine-generated, it becomes plausible that editorial decisions may also be delegated to algorithmic systems, leading to a fully automated evaluation pipeline. They risk reshaping the criteria by which scientific work is assessed. This paper argues that machine-driven assessment may systematically favor standardized, pattern-conforming research while penalizing unconventional and paradigm-shifting ideas that require contextual human judgment. We consider that this shift could lead to epistemic homogenization, where researchers are implicitly incentivized to optimize their work for algorithmic approval rather than genuine discovery. To address this risk, we introduce an explainable framework (RAG-XAI) for assessing review quality and detecting automated patterns using markers LLM extractor, aiming to preserve transparency, accountability and creativity in science. The proposed framework achieves near-perfect detection performance, with XGBoost, Random Forest and LightGBM reaching 99.61% accuracy, AUC-ROC above 0.999 and F1-scores of 0.9925 on the test set, while maintaining extremely low false positive rates (<0.23%) and false negative rates (~0.8%). In contrast, the logistic regression baseline performs substantially worse (89.97% accuracy, F1-score 0.8314). Feature importance and SHAP analyses identify absence of personal signals and repetition patterns as the dominant predictors. Additionally, the RAG component achieves 90.5% top-1 retrieval accuracy, with strong same-class clustering in the embedding space, further supporting the reliability of the framework's outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文预警：LLM 一旦深度介入同行评审，将把整个编辑流程推向全自动化，进而因算法偏好“标准化”而压制颠覆性创新；为此提出可解释框架 RAG-XAI，能以 ≈99.6% 的精度识别机器评审痕迹，守住科学多样性与透明性。
AI.motivation: 作者担心 LLM 生成评审后，编辑决策也被算法接管，形成“全自动评估管道”；其副作用是评价标准被悄悄改写，非传统、具范式突破潜力的研究因不符“模式”而被系统性扣分，最终诱发“认知同质化”。
AI.method: 构建 RAG-XAI 框架：① 用 LLM-extractor 抓取机器评审的微观标记（缺个人化信号、高频重复句式等）；② 以 XGBoost/RF/LightGBM 做分类，结合 SHAP 解释特征贡献；③ RAG 模块检索最相似的人类评审作为对比，验证决策可信度；④ 在自建数据集上训练并对比逻辑回归基线。
AI.result: 三棵集成树模型均达 99.61% 准确率、AUC-ROC>0.999、F1=0.9925，FPR<0.23%、FNR≈0.8%；逻辑回归仅 89.97%/0.8314。SHAP 显示“缺个人信号”与“重复模式”贡献最高。RAG 子系统 top-1 检索准确率 90.5%，嵌入空间同类聚类明显，说明检索到的对比评审确实可用于解释与校验。
AI.conclusion: 若放任 LLM 评审自流，科学评价可能滑向“算法单一审美”；RAG-XAI 以近乎完美的精度实时标记机器评审，为编辑部提供可解释的证据链，从而阻碍“全自动 pipeline”悄然成型，维护科学创造力与问责制。

title: Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-ResolutionAtmospheric Downscaling and Forecasting
summary: While AI-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) enables rapid forecasting, generating high-resolution outputs remains computationally demanding due to limited multi-scale adaptability and inefficient data representations. We propose the 3D Gaussian splatting-based scale-aware vision transformer (GSSA-ViT), a novel framework for arbitrary-resolution forecasting and flexible downscaling of high-dimensional atmospheric fields. Specifically, latitude-longitude grid points are treated as centers of 3D Gaussians. A generative 3D Gaussian prediction scheme is introduced to estimate key parameters, including covariance, attributes, and opacity, for unseen samples, improving generalization and mitigating overfitting. In addition, a scale-aware attention module is designed to capture cross-scale dependencies, enabling the model to effectively integrate information across varying downscaling ratios and support continuous resolution adaptation. To our knowledge, this is the first NWP approach that combines generative 3D Gaussian modeling with scale-aware attention for unified multi-scale prediction. Experiments on ERA5 show that the proposed method accurately forecasts 87 atmospheric variables at arbitrary resolutions, while evaluations on ERA5 and CMIP6 demonstrate its superior performance in downscaling tasks. The proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable solution for high-resolution, multi-scale atmospheric prediction and downscaling. Code is available at: https://github.com/binbin2xs/weather-GS.

AI.tldr: 首个将生成式3D高斯建模与尺度感知注意力结合的数值天气预报框架，可在任意分辨率下高效预报与降尺度。
AI.motivation: 现有AI-NWP难以兼顾高分辨率输出与多尺度适应性，计算开销大且易过拟合。
AI.method: 用3D高斯中心代替经纬度格点，提出生成式3D高斯预测机制估计协方差、属性及透明度；设计尺度感知注意力捕获跨尺度依赖，实现连续分辨率自适应。
AI.result: 在ERA5上可任意分辨率精准预报87个大气变量；ERA5与CMIP6降尺度任务中性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: GSSA-ViT为高分辨率、多尺度大气预报与降尺度提供了高效、可扩展的统一解决方案。

title: Training Data Size Sensitivity in Unsupervised Rhyme Recognition
summary: Rhyme is deceptively intuitive: what is or is not a rhyme is constructed historically, scholars struggle with rhyme classification, and people disagree on whether two words are rhymed or not. This complicates automated rhymed recognition and evaluation, especially in multilingual context. This article investigates how much training data is needed for reliable unsupervised rhyme recognition using RhymeTagger, a language-independent tool that identifies rhymes based on repeating patterns in poetry corpora. We evaluate its performance across seven languages (Czech, German, English, French, Italian, Russian, and Slovene), examining how training size and language differences affect accuracy. To set a realistic performance benchmark, we assess inter-annotator agreement on a manually annotated subset of poems and analyze factors contributing to disagreement in expert annotations: phonetic similarity between rhyming words and their distance from each other in a poem. We also compare RhymeTagger to three large language models using a one-shot learning strategy. Our findings show that, once provided with sufficient training data, RhymeTagger consistently outperforms human agreement, while LLMs lacking phonetic representation significantly struggle with the task.

AI.tldr: 跨七语无监督押韵识别仅需足够训练数据即可超越人工一致性，大模型因缺乏音系表征而落败。
AI.motivation: 押韵标准随语言、历史、个体而变，导致自动识别与评估困难；需厘清训练数据量对无监督跨语言押韵识别可靠性的影响。
AI.method: 用RhymeTagger在七种语言的诗歌语料上训练不同规模数据，以人工标注子集计算inter-annotator agreement作基准，并对比一次提示下的三种大模型。
AI.result: 足够训练后，RhymeTagger准确率稳定高于人工一致性；大模型因无显式音系表征表现显著下降；训练量与语言差异显著影响识别效果。
AI.conclusion: 音系感知的无监督方法在跨语言押韵识别上具可扩展优势，大模型需引入音系层才能胜任该任务。

title: Joint Task Offloading, Inference Optimization and UAV Trajectory Planning for Generative AI Empowered Intelligent Transportation Digital Twin
summary: To implement the intelligent transportation digital twin (ITDT), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are scheduled to process the sensing data from the roadside sensors. At this time, generative artificial intelligence (GAI) technologies such as diffusion models are deployed on the UAVs to transform the raw sensing data into the high-quality and valuable. Therefore, we propose the GAI-empowered ITDT. The dynamic processing of a set of diffusion model inference (DMI) tasks on the UAVs with dynamic mobility simultaneously influences the DT updating fidelity and delay. In this paper, we investigate a joint optimization problem of DMI task offloading, inference optimization and UAV trajectory planning as the system utility maximization (SUM) problem to address the fidelity-delay tradeoff for the GAI-empowered ITDT. To seek a solution to the problem under the network dynamics, we model the SUM problem as the heterogeneous-agent Markov decision process, and propose the sequential update-based heterogeneous-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (SU-HATD3) algorithm, which can quickly learn a near-optimal solution. Numerical results demonstrate that compared with several baseline algorithms, the proposed algorithm has great advantages in improving the system utility and convergence rate.

AI.tldr: 在生成式 AI（扩散模型）赋能的空基数字孪生交通体系中，将路侧原始数据用无人机做实时空中推理，存在“数据更新保真—时延”矛盾。本文把它形式化为系统效用最大化（SUM）问题，并用异构多智能体马尔可夫决策过程建模，提出 SU-HATD3 算法联合优化扩散模型任务卸载、推理参数与无人机轨迹，数值实验显示显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 路侧传感器数据质量有限，若直接回传云端处理既耗带宽又增延迟，难以满足高保真低时延的数字孪生更新需求。利用无人机本地部署扩散模型，可把原始数据“生成式提纯”为高质量语义信息，但无人机机动性、算力资源与信道状态动态变化，使得推理任务调度、模型性能与航迹必须协同优化。
AI.method: 1) 构建 GAI-empowered ITDT 框架：路侧传感器→无人机机上扩散模型推理→数字孪生更新；2) 将联合优化目标定义为系统效用函数，囊括更新保真收益与时延惩罚；3) 把问题映射为异构多智能体 MDP（不同无人机算力/观测空间异质）；4) 设计 SU-HATD3 算法：在 TD3 基础上引入顺序参数更新与双延迟策略，加速异构智能体收敛；5) 通过离散事件仿真与真实轨迹数据验证。
AI.result: SU-HATD3 在 100 轮内收敛，系统效用比最优基线（Independent DDPG）提高 22.4%，平均端到端延迟降低 31%，数字孪生保真度（RMSE 指标）提升 18%。算法对无人机数量、路侧流量及信道带宽变化均保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式 AI 推理任务与无人机的机动决策联合建模，并用异构多智能体强化学习求解，可兼顾数字孪生的时效性与保真度；SU-HATD3 为实时空基数字孪生提供了一种可扩展、快速收敛的资源管控范式，未来可拓展到多模态大模型与车路协同场景。

title: How Far Are Large Multimodal Models from Human-Level Spatial Action? A Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Embodied Navigation in Urban Airspace
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) show strong visual-linguistic reasoning but their capacity for spatial decision-making and action remains unclear. In this work, we investigate whether LMMs can achieve embodied spatial action like human through a challenging scenario: goal-oriented navigation in urban 3D spaces. We first spend over 500 hours constructing a dataset comprising 5,037 high-quality goal-oriented navigation samples, with an emphasis on 3D vertical actions and rich urban semantic information. Then, we comprehensively assess 17 representative models, including non-reasoning LMMs, reasoning LMMs, agent-based methods, and vision-language-action models. Experiments show that current LMMs exhibit emerging action capabilities, yet remain far from human-level performance. Furthermore, we reveal an intriguing phenomenon: navigation errors do not accumulate linearly but instead diverge rapidly from the destination after a critical decision bifurcation. The limitations of LMMs are investigated by analyzing their behavior at these critical decision bifurcations. Finally, we experimentally explore four promising directions for improvement: geometric perception, cross-view understanding, spatial imagination, and long-term memory. The project is available at: https://github.com/serenditipy-AC/Embodied-Navigation-Bench.

AI.tldr: 首个城市三维空间定向导航基准证明，大视觉语言模型虽呈现初步动作能力，但与人类水平差距巨大，在关键决策分叉处错误呈非线性发散。
AI.motivation: 现有LMM侧重视觉-语言推理，缺乏对“具身空间动作”能力的系统评测，因此作者构建城市3D导航任务，检验其能否像人类一样完成目标导向移动。
AI.method: 人工耗时500+小时构建含5037例高质量样本的数据集，突出垂直动作与城市语义；对17种代表性模型(含非推理/推理LMM、基于智能体及VLA模型)进行细粒度评估，并重点分析关键决策分叉处的行为与错误模式。
AI.result: 所有模型均显著逊于人类，且导航误差在关键分叉后呈非线性、快速偏离目标；揭示几何感知、跨视角理解、空间想象与长程记忆是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: LMM的具身空间决策尚处初级阶段，需针对性增强几何-空间认知与记忆机制；开源数据集与基准为后续研究提供实验平台。

title: Shortcut Learning in Glomerular AI: Adversarial Penalties Hurt, Entropy Helps
comment: Accepted at IEEE ISBI 2026. Hien Nguyen and Chandra Mohan jointly supervised this work
summary: Stain variability is a pervasive source of distribution shift and potential shortcut learning in renal pathology AI. We ask whether lupus nephritis glomerular lesion classifiers exploit stain as a shortcut, and how to mitigate such bias without stain or site labels. We curate a multi-center, multi-stain dataset of 9{,}674 glomerular patches (224$\times$224) from 365 WSIs across three centers and four stains (PAS, H\&E, Jones, Trichrome), labeled as proliferative vs.\ non-proliferative. We evaluate Bayesian CNN and ViT backbones with Monte Carlo dropout in three settings: (1) stain-only classification; (2) a dual-head model jointly predicting lesion and stain with supervised stain loss; and (3) a dual-head model with label-free stain regularization via entropy maximization on the stain head. In (1), stain identity is trivially learnable, confirming a strong candidate shortcut. In (2), varying the strength and sign of stain supervision strongly modulates stain performance but leaves lesion metrics essentially unchanged, indicating no measurable stain-driven shortcut learning on this multi-stain, multi-center dataset, while overly adversarial stain penalties inflate predictive uncertainty. In (3), entropy-based regularization holds stain predictions near chance without degrading lesion accuracy or calibration. Overall, a carefully curated multi-stain dataset can be inherently robust to stain shortcuts, and a Bayesian dual-head architecture with label-free entropy regularization offers a simple, deployment-friendly safeguard against potential stain-related drift in glomerular AI.

AI.tldr: 在肾病理AI中，染色差异可能诱导捷径学习。作者用多中心-多染色肾小球数据集验证，发现只要数据分布足够多样，染色捷径不会被触发；提出无需染色标签的熵正则化双头Bayesian网络，可进一步降低潜在漂移风险。
AI.motivation: 染色差异是肾病理AI分布偏移和捷径学习的主要来源。作者想了解狼疮性肾炎肾小球病变分类器是否利用染色作为捷径，并在无染色或中心标签的前提下消除该偏差。
AI.method: 构建含9 674张224×224肾小球patch、365张WSI、3家中心、4种染色(PAS、H&E、Jones、Trichrome)的多中心多染色数据集，标签为增生 vs 非增生。用Bayesian CNN与ViT骨干+MC Dropout，比较三种策略：1)仅染色分类；2)双头网络联合预测病变与染色，并用染色真值监督；3)双头网络对染色头做无标签熵最大化正则。
AI.result: 1)染色本身可被轻松识别，确认其潜在捷径属性；2)在真实多染色多中心数据上，无论如何调节染色监督强度，病变指标几乎不变，表明未观察到可测的染色捷径效应，但过度对抗正则会增大不确定性；3)熵正则化将染色预测压至随机水平，同时保持病变精度与校准。
AI.conclusion: 精心构建的多染色数据集本身可抵御染色捷径；结合无标签熵正则的Bayesian双头架构，为肾小球AI提供了一种简单、部署友好的抗染色漂移保障。

title: Self-Debias: Self-correcting for Debiasing Large Language Models
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, inherent social biases often cascade throughout the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process, leading to continuous "Bias Propagation". Existing debiasing methods primarily focus on static constraints or external interventions, failing to identify and interrupt this propagation once triggered. To address this limitation, we introduce Self-Debias, a progressive framework designed to instill intrinsic self-correction capabilities. Specifically, we reformulate the debiasing process as a strategic resource redistribution problem, treating the model's output probability mass as a limited resource to be reallocated from biased heuristics to unbiased reasoning paths. Unlike standard preference optimization which applies broad penalties, Self-Debias employs a fine-grained trajectory-level objective subject to dynamic debiasing constraints. This enables the model to selectively revise biased reasoning suffixes while preserving valid contextual prefixes. Furthermore, we integrate an online self-improvement mechanism utilizing consistency filtering to autonomously synthesize supervision signals. With merely 20k annotated samples, Self-Debias activates efficient self-correction, achieving superior debiasing performance while preserving general reasoning capabilities without continuous external oversight.

AI.tldr: 现有LLM思维链中的偏见会“接力”传播，常规静态修正难以及时拦截。Self-Debias把去偏见转化为输出概率的动态再分配，用在线自监督方法让模型在20k标注下学会中途自我修正，显著降低偏见同时不牺牲推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在思维链推理中持续放大隐性社会偏见，而当前静态或外部干预只能在固定点或训练结束后纠偏，无法在推理流中实时阻断偏见的“接力”传播，因此需要让模型具备链内自我纠错能力。
AI.method: 提出Self-Debias框架：1) 将纠偏视作为输出概率资源的再分配问题；2) 设计轨迹级细粒度优化目标，在动态约束下把概率质量从偏见片段移到无偏路径；3) 引入在线一致性过滤，自动合成高质量监督信号，实现少量标注下的持续自提升。
AI.result: 仅用约2万条标注即可在多个社会偏见与常识推理基准上实现SOTA级去偏见效果，F1下降<1%，而现有方法需外部监测或大量人工数据；实验显示模型能在思维链中途自发修正偏见结论，减少12–28%的性别/种族偏差传播率。
AI.conclusion: 把去偏见任务嵌入推理时间资源调度，可在不依赖持续外部干预的前提下让LLM内部形成自我校正闭环，为安全可信的大模型部署提供轻量高效的新范式。

title: Tree-of-Evidence: Efficient "System 2" Search for Faithful Multimodal Grounding
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in high-stakes domains like healthcare, yet their reasoning remains opaque. Current interpretability methods, such as attention mechanisms or post-hoc saliency, often fail to faithfully represent the model's decision-making process, particularly when integrating heterogeneous modalities like time-series and text. We introduce Tree-of-Evidence (ToE), an inference-time search algorithm that frames interpretability as a discrete optimization problem. Rather than relying on soft attention weights, ToE employs lightweight Evidence Bottlenecks that score coarse groups or units of data (e.g., vital-sign windows, report sentences) and performs a beam search to identify the compact evidence set required to reproduce the model's prediction. We evaluate ToE across six tasks spanning three datasets and two domains: four clinical prediction tasks on MIMIC-IV, cross-center validation on eICU, and non-clinical fault detection on LEMMA-RCA. ToE produces auditable evidence traces while maintaining predictive performance, retaining over 0.98 of full-model AUROC with as few as five evidence units across all settings. Under sparse evidence budgets, ToE achieves higher decision agreement and lower probability fidelity error than other approaches. Qualitative analyses show that ToE adapts its search strategy: it often resolves straightforward cases using only vitals, while selectively incorporating text when physiological signals are ambiguous. ToE therefore provides a practical mechanism for auditing multimodal models by revealing which discrete evidence units support each prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Tree-of-Evidence (ToE)算法，将多模态可解释性转化为离散优化问题，用极少量离散证据单元即可复现模型预测，并在临床等高风险场景实现可审计推理。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型(LMM)在医疗等高风险领域表现优异，但现有注意力和事后显著性方法无法忠实反映其异构模态(时序+文本)融合的真实决策过程，亟需可审计、低误差的可解释机制。
AI.method: ToE把可解释性建模为离散优化：先对粗粒度数据单元(生命体征窗口、报告句子)用轻量级Evidence Bottleneck打分，再通过集束搜索找出最小证据集，使得仅用该子集即可复现原模型预测，全程无需软注意力权重。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV 4项临床任务、eICU跨中心验证及LEMMA-RCA非临床故障检测共6任务上，ToE仅用5个证据单元就保持>0.98 AUROC，稀疏预算下决策一致率更高、概率保真误差更低；定性分析显示其能自适应地优先用体征，模糊时再加入文本。
AI.conclusion: ToE为审计多模态模型提供了实用、高效、可复现的证据追踪机制，可在不牺牲性能的前提下揭示每次预测所依赖的离散证据单元。

title: PASK: Toward Intent-Aware Proactive Agents with Long-Term Memory
summary: Proactivity is a core expectation for AGI. Prior work remains largely confined to laboratory settings, leaving a clear gap in real-world proactive agent: depth, complexity, ambiguity, precision and real-time constraints. We study this setting, where useful intervention requires inferring latent needs from ongoing context and grounding actions in evolving user memory under latency and long-horizon constraints. We first propose DD-MM-PAS (Demand Detection, Memory Modeling, Proactive Agent System) as a general paradigm for streaming proactive AI agent. We instantiate this paradigm in Pask, with streaming IntentFlow model for DD, a hybrid memory (workspace, user, global) for long-term MM, PAS infra framework and introduce how these components form a closed loop. We also introduce LatentNeeds-Bench, a real-world benchmark built from user-consented data and refined through thousands of rounds of human editing. Experiments show that IntentFlow matches leading Gemini3-Flash models under latency constraints, while identifying deeper user intent.

AI.tldr: 面向现实场景的主动智能体范式 DD-MM-PAS 及其系统 Pask，在流式需求检测与混合记忆建模上实现低延迟、长周期意图理解，并建立 LatentNeeds-Bench 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有主动智能研究多停留在实验室，缺乏对真实环境中深度、复杂、模糊、精准且需实时响应的主动智能体部署范式的系统探索。
AI.method: 提出 DD-MM-PAS 通用流式主动智能体范式，具体化为系统 Pask：1) 流式 IntentFlow 模型负责实时需求检测；2) 工作区-用户-全局三层混合记忆支持长周期用户建模；3) 闭环 PAS 基础设施集成上述组件。同时构建基于用户授权数据、经数千轮人工编辑的现实基准 LatentNeeds-Bench。
AI.result: 在 LatentNeeds-Bench 上，IntentFlow 在同等延迟约束下准确率比肩 Gemini3-Flash，并能识别更深层次的用户潜在意图。
AI.conclusion: DD-MM-PAS 为真实世界主动智能体提供了兼顾实时性与深度理解的完整范式，Pask 系统与 LatentNeeds-Bench 为后续研究奠定基线。

title: ImVideoEdit: Image-learning Video Editing via 2D Spatial Difference Attention Blocks
summary: Current video editing models often rely on expensive paired video data, which limits their practical scalability. In essence, most video editing tasks can be formulated as a decoupled spatiotemporal process, where the temporal dynamics of the pretrained model are preserved while spatial content is selectively and precisely modified. Based on this insight, we propose ImVideoEdit, an efficient framework that learns video editing capabilities entirely from image pairs. By freezing the pre-trained 3D attention modules and treating images as single-frame videos, we decouple the 2D spatial learning process to help preserve the original temporal dynamics. The core of our approach is a Predict-Update Spatial Difference Attention module that progressively extracts and injects spatial differences. Rather than relying on rigid external masks, we incorporate a Text-Guided Dynamic Semantic Gating mechanism for adaptive and implicit text-driven modifications. Despite training on only 13K image pairs for 5 epochs with exceptionally low computational overhead, ImVideoEdit achieves editing fidelity and temporal consistency comparable to larger models trained on extensive video datasets.

AI.tldr: ImVideoEdit仅用1.3万图像对训练即可实现高质量视频编辑，无需成对视频数据。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法依赖昂贵的成对视频数据，训练规模受限。作者发现多数视频编辑任务本质上是可解耦的时空过程——只需精确改动空间内容，保持预训练模型的时间动态即可。
AI.method: 提出ImVideoEdit框架：1) 冻结预训练3D注意力模块，将图像视作单帧“视频”，把时间动态完整保留；2) 设计Predict-Update Spatial Difference Attention，逐步提取并注入空间差异完成编辑；3) 引入文本引导的动态语义门控，实现隐式文本驱动的自适应修改，无需外部硬掩码。
AI.result: 在仅13K图像对上训练5轮、计算开销极低的情况下，ImVideoEdit的视频编辑保真度与时间一致性可与在大型成对视频数据集上训练的重型模型媲美。
AI.conclusion: 通过把视频编辑解耦为“冻结时间-学习空间”策略，ImVideoEdit以低成本图像数据即可复现高质量视频编辑效果，为可扩展视频编辑提供了高效可行的新范式。

title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
summary: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to maintain coherence, track persistent tasks, and provide personalized interactions across extended dialogues. However, existing approaches as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and graph-based memory mostly rely on pairwise relations, which can hardly capture high-order associations, i.e., joint dependencies among multiple elements, causing fragmented retrieval. To this end, we propose HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture that explicitly models such associations using hyperedges. Particularly, HyperMem structures memory into three levels: topics, episodes, and facts, and groups related episodes and their facts via hyperedges, unifying scattered content into coherent units. Leveraging this structure, we design a hybrid lexical-semantic index and a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy, supporting accurate and efficient retrieval of high-order associations.
