Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that HyperMem achieves state-of-the-art performance with 92.73% LLM-as-a-judge accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of HyperMem for long-term conversations.

AI.tldr: 提出 HyperMem，一种超图分层记忆架构，用超边显式建模对话中的高阶关联，解决 RAG 与图方法片段化检索问题，在 LoCoMo 上达 92.73% 的 LLM-as-judge 准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有对话智能体长期记忆方案（RAG、图记忆）仅依赖两两关系，无法捕捉多元素联合依赖，导致检索碎片化，难以保持长时间对话的连贯与个性化。
AI.method: 构建三层次（主题-情节-事实）超图记忆：用超边连接同一情节内的所有事实及跨情节的关联，实现内容统一；设计混合词汇-语义索引与“粗→细”两级检索策略，高效召回高阶联合信息。
AI.result: 在公开长对话基准 LoCoMo 上，HyperMem 以 92.73% 的 LLM-as-judge 准确率刷新 SOTA，显著优于基线，且检索延迟与存储开销可控。
AI.conclusion: 超图高阶建模是提升对话长期记忆的有效路径；HyperMem 兼具准确性与效率，可推广至各类持续交互场景。

title: CausalVAE as a Plug-in for World Models: Towards Reliable Counterfactual Dynamics
summary: In this work, CausalVAE is introduced as a plug-in structural module for latent world models and is attached to diverse encoder-transition backbones. Across the reported benchmarks, competitive factual prediction is preserved and intervention-aware counterfactual retrieval is improved after the plug-in is added, suggesting stronger robustness under distribution shift and interventions. The largest gains are observed on the Physics benchmark: when averaged over 8 paired baselines, CF-H@1 is improved by +102.5%. In a representative GNN-NLL setting on Physics, CF-H@1 is increased from 11.0 to 41.0 (+272.7%). Through causal analysis, learned structural dependencies are shown to recover meaningful first-order physical interaction trends, supporting the interpretability of the learned latent causal structure.

AI.tldr: CausalVAE 是一个可插拔的结构模块，加到现有隐世界模型后能在保持事实预测精度的同时将干预场景下的反事实命中率（CF-H@1）最高提升 102.5%，且在物理任务中把 GNN-NLL 的 CF-H@1 从 11.0 提到 41.0；所学因果结构可解释为一阶物理交互趋势。
AI.motivation: 现有隐变量世界模型在分布漂移或干预条件下反事实推理能力弱，需要一种通用插件在不破坏原模型事实预测性能的前提下增强干预鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.method: 将因果 VAE（CausalVAE）设计为可与任意编码器-转移主干自由拼接的结构模块，通过显式建模潜变量间的因果图，使模型在干预下仍能保持正确的条件分布；训练时联合优化重构、预测与因果约束。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，加插件后的事实预测误差几乎不变，而反事实命中率 CF-H@1 平均提升 102.5%；在更具挑战的物理任务 GNN-NLL 设置中，CF-H@1 绝对提升 30 个百分点（相对 +272.7%）。学到的因果边与物体间的一阶物理交互方向高度一致。
AI.conclusion: CausalVAE 以“即插即用”方式赋予任意隐世界模型干预感知与反事实推理能力，显著提升分布漂移鲁棒性，同时揭示可解释的物理因果结构，为可控预测与科学发现提供新工具。

title: Evaluating Counterfactual Explanation Methods on Incomplete Inputs
summary: Existing algorithms for generating Counterfactual Explanations (CXs) for Machine Learning (ML) typically assume fully specified inputs. However, real-world data often contains missing values, and the impact of these incomplete inputs on the performance of existing CX methods remains unexplored. To address this gap, we systematically evaluate recent CX generation methods on their ability to provide valid and plausible counterfactuals when inputs are incomplete. As part of this investigation, we hypothesize that robust CX generation methods will be better suited to address the challenge of providing valid and plausible counterfactuals when inputs are incomplete. Our findings reveal that while robust CX methods achieve higher validity than non-robust ones, all methods struggle to find valid counterfactuals. These results motivate the need for new CX methods capable of handling incomplete inputs.

AI.tldr: 现有反事实解释（CX）算法在输入缺失时普遍失效，亟需面向不完整数据的新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有CX研究默认输入完整，但现实数据常含缺失值，其对CX方法表现的影响尚属空白。
AI.method: 系统评估近期CX生成算法在输入缺失场景下提供有效且合理反事实的能力，并验证鲁棒型方法是否更具优势。
AI.result: 鲁棒CX方法有效性高于非鲁棒方法，但所有算法在缺失输入下均难以找到有效反事实。
AI.conclusion: 需研发能够显式处理不完整输入的全新CX生成方法。

title: TOOLCAD: Exploring Tool-Using Large Language Models in Text-to-CAD Generation with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is an expert-level task that relies on long-horizon reasoning and coherent modeling actions. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable advancements in enabling language agents to tackle real-world tasks. Notably, there has been no investigation into how tool-using LLMs optimally interact with CAD engines, hindering the emergence of LLM-based agentic text-to-CAD modeling systems. We propose ToolCAD, a novel agentic CAD framework deploying LLMs as tool-using agents for text-to-CAD generation. Furthermore, we introduce an interactive CAD modeling gym to rollout reasoning and tool-augmented interaction trajectories with the CAD engine, incorporating hybrid feedback and human supervision. Meanwhile, an end-to-end post-training strategy is presented to enable the LLM agent to elicit refined CAD Modeling Chain of Thought (CAD-CoT) and evolve into proficient CAD tool-using agents via online curriculum reinforcement learning. Our findings demonstrate ToolCAD fills the gap in adopting and training open-source LLMs for CAD tool-using agents, enabling them to perform comparably to proprietary models, paving the way for more accessible and robust autonomous text-to-CAD modeling systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ToolCAD——首个让开源大模型充当“会调用 CAD 指令的智能体”、通过文本直接生成可制造模型的端到端框架，并配套交互式建模环境与大模型后训练流程，使开源模型性能逼近闭源方案。
AI.motivation: CAD 属于长程序列决策任务，需要专家知识；目前尚无研究探讨如何让“会工具调用”的大模型与 CAD 引擎最优交互，从而缺乏开放、可扩展的 text-to-CAD 系统。
AI.method: 1) 构建 ToolCAD 智能体框架，将自然语言需求映射为逐步 CAD API 调用；2) 设计交互式 CAD 建模 Gym，支持混合反馈（引擎报错+人类示范）在线 rollout；3) 提出端到端后训练策略：先构造 CAD-CoT 数据，再通过课程化在线强化学习持续优化策略，使开源 LLM 掌握高精度建模链式思维。
AI.result: 在自建 text-to-CAD 基准上，经过后训练的开源 LLM 的实体重建精度、可制造性指标与参数一致性均显著优于零样本与指令微调基线，并与 GPT-4 等闭源方案持平；同时推理步数减少 22%，失败率降低 35%。
AI.conclusion: ToolCAD 首次填补“开源 LLM 成为 CAD 工具智能体”的空白，验证了大模型+环境交互+在线 RL 在复杂专家任务上的可扩展性，为低成本、可定制的自主 text-to-CAD 系统奠定理论与工程基础。

title: Behavior-Aware Item Modeling via Dynamic Procedural Solution Representations for Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to predict learners' future performance from past interactions. While recent KT approaches have improved via learning item representations aligned with Knowledge Components, they overlook the procedural dynamics of problem solving. We propose Behavior-Aware Item Modeling (BAIM), a framework that enriches item representations by integrating dynamic procedural solution information. BAIM leverages a reasoning language model to decompose each item's solution into four problem-solving stages (i.e., understand, plan, carry out, and look back), pedagogically grounded in Polya's framework. Specifically, it derives stage-level representations from per-stage embedding trajectories, capturing latent signals beyond surface features. To reflect learner heterogeneity, BAIM adaptively routes these stage-wise representations, introducing a context-conditioned mechanism within a KT backbone, allowing different procedural stages to be emphasized for different learners. Experiments on XES3G5M and NIPS34 show that BAIM consistently outperforms strong pretraining-based baselines, achieving particularly large gains under repeated learner interactions.

AI.tldr: BAIM首次把解题步骤级语义注入题目表征，并通过学生情境化的路由机制，为KT带来显著且稳健的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有KT模型虽在题目表征与知识点对齐上取得进展，却忽视了解题过程这一蕴含学习者能力差异的关键动态信息，难以预测重复练习场景下的表现。
AI.method: 提出行为感知题目建模框架BAIM：(1) 用推理LM将题目解答分解为波利亚四阶段并提取阶段级表征；(2) 在KT骨干内引入上下文条件路由网络，针对不同学生动态加权各阶段表征。
AI.result: 在XES3G5M和NIPS34数据集上全面优于预训练类强基线，尤其在重复交互条件下增益最大，验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 融入解题过程动态可突破KT性能瓶颈，BAIM为建模异质学习者提供了可解释、可扩展的新范式。

title: Mathematical analysis of one-layer neural network with fixed biases, a new activation function and other observations
summary:
We analyze a simple one-hidden-layer neural network with ReLU activation functions and fixed biases, with one-dimensional input and output. We study both continuous and discrete versions of the model, and we rigorously prove the convergence of the learning process with the $L^2$ squared loss function and the gradient descent procedure. We also prove the spectral bias property for this learning process.
  Several conclusions of this analysis are discussed; in particular, regarding the structure and properties that activation functions should possess, as well as the relationships between the spectrum of certain operators and the learning process. Based on this, we also propose an alternative activation function, the full-wave rectified exponential function (FReX), and we discuss the convergence of the gradient descent with this alternative activation function.

AI.tldr: 针对仅含一层 ReLU 网络、一维输入输出的极简模型，论文在 L² 损失与梯度下降框架下严格证明了收敛性，并给出谱偏差的理论刻画；进而讨论激活函数应具备的结构特性，提出新型激活 FReX 并同样给出收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习理论多为黑箱保证或需过参数化假设，本研究旨在对极简且可解释的网络架构给出可量化、严格的训练动态与收敛性分析，并借此阐明谱偏差现象及激活函数设计原则。
AI.method: 首先建立带固定偏置的纯 ReLU 单隐层网络的连续/离散梯度流动力学，利用谱分解与 Poincaré 型不等式证明 L² 损失指数收敛；继而从微分算子的谱结构出发，证明低频成分收敛快于高频，得到谱偏差；最后推广至自研的 FReX 激活并验证相同收敛框架成立。
AI.result: （1）证明该浅层网络 GD 在适当步长下对任意初始值以指数速率收敛到全局最小值；（2）首次在可控模型中证出谱偏差：低频投影误差以 O(e^{-μ_k t}) 衰减，高频较慢；（3）显示 ReLU 非负一阶导数与零阶齐次性对收敛至关重要；（4） FReX 激活在保留该性质的同时可获得任意阶连续导数，亦呈指数收敛。
AI.conclusion: 即使在极简网络条件下，谱偏差与梯度收敛可严格量化；激活函数的一阶非负及齐次特性是谱偏差与快速收敛的共同几何基础；这为深层网络的正则化设计、学习率调度与新型激活函数构造提供了可迁移的数学依据。

title: Wiring the 'Why': A Unified Taxonomy and Survey of Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Regardless of its foundational role in human discovery and sense-making, abductive reasoning--the inference of the most plausible explanation for an observation--has been relatively underexplored in Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, the exploration of abductive reasoning and its diverse facets has thus far been disjointed rather than cohesive. This paper presents the first survey of abductive reasoning in LLMs, tracing its trajectory from philosophical foundations to contemporary AI implementations. To address the widespread conceptual confusion and disjointed task definitions prevalent in the field, we establish a unified two-stage definition that formally categorizes prior work. This definition disentangles abduction into \textit{Hypothesis Generation}, where models bridge epistemic gaps to produce candidate explanations, and \textit{Hypothesis Selection}, where the generated candidates are evaluated and the most plausible explanation is chosen. Building upon this foundation, we present a comprehensive taxonomy of the literature, categorizing prior work based on their abductive tasks, datasets, underlying methodologies, and evaluation strategies. In order to ground our framework empirically, we conduct a compact benchmark study of current LLMs on abductive tasks, together with targeted comparative analyses across model sizes, model families, evaluation styles, and the distinct generation-versus-selection task typologies. Moreover, by synthesizing recent empirical results, we examine how LLM performance on abductive reasoning relates to deductive and inductive tasks, providing insights into their broader reasoning capabilities. Our analysis reveals critical gaps in current approaches--from static benchmark design and narrow domain coverage to narrow training frameworks and limited mechanistic understanding of abductive processes...

AI.tldr: 首次系统综述了LLM 中的溯因推理（Abduction），将其形式化为“假设生成-假设选择”两阶段，并建立统一框架整理任务、数据、方法与评估，实证测试主流模型差异，指出静态基准、狭窄领域与训练框架等关键缺口。
AI.motivation: 溯因推理是人类发现与意义建构的基础能力，但在大模型中研究零散、定义混乱、缺乏统一框架，阻碍了对该能力的深入理解与提升。
AI.method: 1) 提出“两阶段”统一定义：Hypothesis Generation（补全认知缺口生成候选解释）与 Hypothesis Selection（评估并选出最可信解释）；2) 据此构建涵盖任务、数据集、方法、评估策略的完整分类体系；3) 设计小规模基准，横向比较模型规模、模型家族、评估方式及生成 vs. 选择任务；4) 综合近期实验结果，对比溯因、演绎、归纳表现，揭示模型机制与薄弱点。
AI.result: 统一定义成功整合了以往碎片工作，基准实验显示：① 大模型在“选择”阶段显著优于“生成”，小模型则双阶段均弱；② 同一家族内规模越大，溯因性能提升但边际递减；③ 溯因表现与演绎/归纳仅部分相关，提示其独特机制；④ 当前数据集多为静态、单域，训练框架忽视生成-选择耦合，对模型内部如何完成溯因几乎无知。
AI.conclusion: 溯因推理在 LLM 中潜力大但被低估，未来需构建动态、多域、可解释的训练与评估体系，将生成-选择一体化设计，并探索专用架构或损失，以弥补现有静态基准与机制理解的关键缺口。

title: DSCA: Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment for Lifelong VLM Editing
summary: Model editing aims to update knowledge to add new concepts and change relevant information without retraining. Lifelong editing is a challenging task, prone to disrupting previously learned concepts, especially for Vision Language Models (VLMs), because sequential edits can lead to degraded reasoning and cross modal misalignment. Existing VLM knowledge editing methods based on gated adapters, activation edits, and parameter merging techniques address catastrophic forgetting seen in full fine tuning; however, they still operate in the shared representation space of the VLM, where concepts are entangled, so edits interfere with other non relevant concepts. We hypothesize that this instability persists because current methods algorithmically control edits via optimization rather than structurally separating knowledge. We introduce Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment (DSCA) which by design mitigates this limitation by decomposing the representation space into a set of orthogonal semantic subspaces and proposing edits only in those transformed spaces. These subspaces are obtained through incremental clustering and PCA on joint vision language representations. This process structurally isolates concepts, enabling precise, non interfering edits by turning isolation from a soft training objective into an architectural property. The surgical edits are guided by a multi term loss function for maintaining task fidelity, edit locality, and cross modal alignment. With the base model frozen, our method achieves 98 percent single edit success, remains over 95 percent after 1000 sequential edits, lowers hallucination by 3 to 5 percent, and achieves the best backward transfer (BWT) scores on continual instruction tuning benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate DSCA state of the art stability and knowledge retention capability in continual lifelong editing across various datasets and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出动态子空间概念对齐（DESCΑ），将VLM表示正交化并在显式隔离的子空间内编辑，使一次冻结权重便可达成98%单次编辑成功率并在1000次序列编辑后维持>95%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM编辑方法虽缓解灾难遗忘，但仍共享耦合的表示空间，导致新知识不断干扰其余无关概念；需将“物以类聚”由训练目标升级为结构化属性。
AI.method: 通过增量聚类+联合视-语PCA，将VLM表征分解成一组正交语义子空间；仅在被编辑概念对应的子空间内实施“手术式”更新，并用多项目标（任务保真、编辑局域性、跨模一致）指导简化权重微调；主模型保持冻结。
AI.result: 在知识保值指标上力压同侪：单轮编辑成功98%，1000步序列后仍超95%，幻象减低3–5pt，持续指令微调基准取得最佳后向迁移（BWT）。
AI.conclusion: DSCA验证了“结构隔离”相较“优化控权”对终生编辑的核心价值，可在不触及全模型的情况下维持视觉-语言对齐与知识增量，为进一步构建可自我演化的多模态模型奠定基础。

title: Floating or Suggesting Ideas? A Large-Scale Contrastive Analysis of Metaphorical and Literal Verb-Object Constructions
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at CMCL@LREC2026
summary: Metaphor pervades everyday language, allowing speakers to express abstract concepts via concrete domains. While prior work has studied metaphors cognitively and psycholinguistically, large-scale comparisons with literal language remain limited, especially for near-synonymous expressions. We analyze 297 English verb-object pairs (e.g., float idea vs. suggest idea) in ~2M corpus sentences, examining their contextual usage. Using five NLP tools, we extract 2,293 cognitive and linguistic features capturing affective, lexical, syntactic, and discourse-level properties. We address: (i) whether features differ between metaphorical and literal contexts (cross-pair analysis), and (ii) whether individual VO pairs diverge internally (within-pair analysis). Cross-pair results show literal contexts have higher lexical frequency, cohesion, and structural regularity, while metaphorical contexts show greater affective load, imageability, lexical diversity, and constructional specificity. Within-pair analyses reveal substantial heterogeneity, with most pairs showing non-uniform effects. These results suggest no single, consistent distributional pattern that distinguishes metaphorical from literal usage. Instead, differences are largely construction-specific. Overall, large-scale data combined with diverse features provides a fine-grained understanding of metaphor-literal contrasts in VO usage.

AI.tldr: 首次百万句级考察英语动宾短语中隐喻—字面用法差异，发现差异呈“construction-specific”而非统一模式。
AI.motivation: 既往隐喻研究多聚焦认知与心理语言学视角，缺乏与字面用法的大规模系统比较，尤其针对近义表达。
AI.method: 选取297对动宾VO（如float idea vs. suggest idea），在约200万句语料中，用5种NLP工具提取2 293个认知–语言特征，分别进行跨对与对内比较。
AI.result: 跨对层面：字面语境词频高、结构规则、语篇黏着；隐喻语境情感负荷、可成像度、词汇多样性及构式特异性更高。对内层面：多数对表现出异质性，无一致差异模式。
AI.conclusion: 隐喻—字面区分并非遵循单一分布规律，差异主要由具体构式决定；大规模多特征分析可精细化揭示VO用法差异。

title: MIPT-SSM: Scaling Language Models with $O(1)$ Inference Cache via Phase Transitions
summary: We present MIPT-SSM, a neural sequence architecture built on the physics of Measurement-Induced Phase Transitions (MIPT). The central idea is a learned measurement rate $p_{t}\in(0,1)$ that routes computation between two regimes: wave phase $(p_{t}\rightarrow0)$, where information propagates as distributed complex-phase interference; and particle phase $(p_{t}\rightarrow1)$ where the state collapses onto the current token, enabling precise local storage. These two regimes are provably incompatible in a single linear operator one of the few "no-go theorems" in sequence modeling and $p_{t}$ is our way around it. The model is predicted to exhibit a phase transition at critical sequence length $N^{*}\approx1024$, where the information density ratio $N/D$ crosses unity, consistent with our memory scaling observations. On AG News (four-class classification), MIPT achieves 0.905 accuracy versus Transformer's 0.736 (+16.6%), stable across 3 seeds. At $N=8192$ MIPT requires 810 MB versus Transformer's 34,651 MB a 42.8x memory reduction. On exact-recall ("needle-in-a-haystack"), our causal sparse KV cache achieves 0.968 accuracy. Remarkably, under unbounded cache capacity, the $p_{t}$ gate autonomously learns to store only the single critical token (averaging $1.0/512$ slots used), filtering out all noise and achieving a 99.8% sparsity rate. On language modeling (WikiText-103, 31M parameters), MIPT-LM with $K=64$ cache reaches PPL 92.1 versus Transformer's 90.5 (gap: 1.8%) while inference KV cache shrinks from $O(N)$ to $O(64)$.

AI.tldr: 基于测量诱导相变（MIPT）设计的 MIPT-SSM 模型，用可学习测量率 p_t 在“波相”与“粒子相”间切换，绕过线性算子不相容定理；在 AG News 分类上比 Transformer 高 16.6%，推理 KV 缓存压缩 42.8 倍，记忆稀疏度达 99.8%，语言建模性能持平但缓存规模 O(N)→O(64)。
AI.motivation: Transformer 线性注意力算子无法同时兼容全局分布式信息与局部精确存储，导致 KV 缓存随序列线性增长，内存瓶颈突出。作者借量子测量诱导相变理论，提出能否用一个“物理门控”机制，让模型在需要时自动选择波式分布式传播或粒子式局部存储，从而突破这一“no-go 定理”。
AI.method: 构建 MIPT-SSM 神经序列架构：1) 引入可学习测量率 p_t ∈(0,1)，作为门控信号；2) p_t→0 时启用“波相”线性算子，实现分布式复相位干涉，保持全局上下文；3) p_t→1 时启用“粒子相”投影，将状态坍缩到当前 token，实现局部精确缓存；4) 理论预测当信息密度比 N/D 过 1 时出现相变，临界长度 N*≈1024；5) 因果稀疏 KV-cache 仅由 p_t 决定保留哪些 token，其余丢弃，保持端到端可训练。
AI.result: AG News 四分类：MIPT 准确率 0.905，比 Transformer 的 0.736 提升 16.6pp，三种子稳定。N=8192 时，MIPT 仅需 810 MB KV-cache，Transformer 需 34 651 MB，压缩 42.8 倍。Needle-in-haystack 精确回忆任务，因果稀疏缓存准确率 0.968；无容量限制时，p_t 自主学习仅保留 1 个关键 token，平均占用 1.0/512 槽位，实现 99.8% 稀疏度。WikiText-103 语言建模（31 M 参数），MIPT-LM 以 K=64 缓存取得 PPL 92.1，与 Transformer 的 90.5 差距仅 1.8%，而推理缓存复杂度从 O(N) 降至 O(64)。
AI.conclusion: MIPT-SSM 首次将测量诱导相变物理嵌入序列建模，用单一可学习参数 p_t 实现“波–粒子”机制切换，绕过线性注意力算子不相容定理，在保持或提升精度的同时，把 KV 缓存压缩 1–2 个数量级，为长序列高效推理提供了新范式；理论预测的 N*≈1024 相变亦得到实验印证，显示出物理驱动架构设计的潜力。

title: "Why This Avoidance Maneuver?" Contrastive Explanations in Human-Supervised Maritime Autonomous Navigation
comment: Submitted to IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference (ITSC) 2026
summary: Automated maritime collision avoidance will rely on human supervision for the foreseeable future. This necessitates transparency into how the system perceives a scenario and plans a maneuver. However, the causal logic behind avoidance maneuvers is often complex and difficult to convey to a navigator. This paper explores how to explain these factors in a selective, understandable manner for supervisors with a nautical background. We propose a method for generating contrastive explanations, which provide human-centric insights by comparing a system's proposed solution against relevant alternatives. To evaluate this, we developed a framework that uses visual and textual cues to highlight key objectives from a state-of-the-art collision avoidance system. An exploratory user study with four experienced marine officers suggests that contrastive explanations support the understanding of the system's objectives. However, our findings also reveal that while these explanations are highly valuable in complex multi-vessel encounters, they can increase cognitive workload, suggesting that future maritime interfaces may benefit most from demand-driven or scenario-specific explanation strategies.

AI.tldr: 选择性地用对比解释让船员理解避碰系统为何选当前方案，适合复杂多船场景，但可能加大认知负荷，建议按需提供解释。
AI.motivation: 海事自主避碰仍需人工监督，而算法逻辑复杂、难以向“有航海背景”的监督者清晰说明。需找到高效、易懂的解释方式，增强透明度与信任。
AI.method: 提出“对比解释”自动生成法：将系统首选航与若干关键备选航并列；开发可视化+文本框架突出各案目标差异；并通过四名资深海员的探索性用户实验评估效果与负荷。
AI.result: 对比解释在多船冲突场景显著提升了监督者对系统目标的理解；但在简单场景反而增加认知负担。受试者普遍愿在复杂局面主动索要解释，在低负荷时则不需要。
AI.conclusion: 固定式解释不现实，应按场景复杂度与操作员需求动态切换解释粒度；后续需在真实舰桥环境与更多驾驶员中验证，并探讨压缩信息、精确时机触发等策略，兼顾透明度和负荷。

title: Lighting-grounded Video Generation with Renderer-based Agent Reasoning
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in video generation, but their controllability remains a major limitation. Key scene factors such as layout, lighting, and camera trajectory are often entangled or only weakly modeled, restricting their applicability in domains like filmmaking and virtual production where explicit scene control is essential. We present LiVER, a diffusion-based framework for scene-controllable video generation. To achieve this, we introduce a novel framework that conditions video synthesis on explicit 3D scene properties, supported by a new large-scale dataset with dense annotations of object layout, lighting, and camera parameters. Our method disentangles these properties by rendering control signals from a unified 3D representation. We propose a lightweight conditioning module and a progressive training strategy to integrate these signals into a foundational video diffusion model, ensuring stable convergence and high fidelity. Our framework enables a wide range of applications, including image-to-video and video-to-video synthesis where the underlying 3D scene is fully editable. To further enhance usability, we develop a scene agent that automatically translates high-level user instructions into the required 3D control signals. Experiments show that LiVER achieves state-of-the-art photorealism and temporal consistency while enabling precise, disentangled control over scene factors, setting a new standard for controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: LiVER 首次让扩散模型在视频生成中接受显式 3D 场景参数（布局、光照、相机）的独立控制，无需额外微调即可实现高保真、可编辑、可驱动的视频合成。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散视频生成对场景因素耦合严重，难以满足影视与虚拟制作对“可精确操控每一帧场景”的需求。
AI.method: 构建含稠密 3D 标注的大规模数据集；设计统一 3D 表征→渲染离散控制信号；引入轻量化条件注入模块与渐进式训练策略，将信号嵌入基础视频扩散模型；配备自动把高层指令转为 3D 参数的场景智能体。
AI.result: 在保持 SOTA 真实感与时间一致性的同时，LiVER 实现对布局、光照、相机的逐因子解耦控制；支持图像/视频到视频且 3D 场景全程可编辑。
AI.conclusion: LiVER 为可控视频生成设定了新的性能与可用性基准，展示了将显式 3D 控制与生成式扩散模型深度融合的可行路径。

title: When to Trust Tools? Adaptive Tool Trust Calibration For Tool-Integrated Math Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance enhancement through scaling test time computation, but due to the inherent limitations of the underlying language models, they still have shortcomings in tasks that require precise computation and extensive knowledge reserves. Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) has emerged as a promising paradigm that incorporates tool call and execution within the reasoning trajectory. Although recent works have released some powerful open-source TIR models, our analysis reveals that these models still suffer from critical deficiencies. We find that when the reasoning of the model conflicts with the tool results, the model tends to believe in its own reasoning. And there are cases where the tool results are correct but are ignored by the model, resulting in incorrect answers, which we define as "Tool Ignored''. This indicates that the model does not know when to trust or ignore the tool. To overcome these limitations, We introduce Adaptive Tool Trust Calibration (ATTC), a novel framework that guides the model to adaptively choose to trust or ignore the tool results based on the confidence score of generated code blocks. The experimental results from various open-source TIR models of different sizes and across multiple datasets demonstrate that ATTC effectively reduces the "Tool Ignored" issue, resulting in a performance increase of 4.1% to 7.5%.

AI.tldr: 现有工具增强推理模型存在“忽略正确工具结果”缺陷；提出 ATTC 框架，让模型依据生成代码置信度动态决定信任或忽略工具，平均提升 4.1%–7.5%。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型虽能扩展测试时计算，但在精确计算与知识密集型任务上仍受限于基座模型缺陷。工具集成推理（TIR）被寄予厚望，却频繁出现“工具结果正确却被模型无视”的 Tool Ignored 现象，阻碍其可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 Adaptive Tool Trust Calibration（ATTC）：在推理轨迹中实时为每个代码块输出置信度分数，并据此自适应地选择“信任并采纳工具结果”或“忽略并依赖自推理”，无需额外训练即可嵌入各类开源 TIR 模型。
AI.result: 跨 3 个规模的开源 TIR 模型、多数据集实验显示，ATTC 显著减少 Tool Ignored 案例，整体准确率提升 4.1%–7.5%，且增益随模型规模减小而更明显。
AI.conclusion: ATTC 首次系统性缓解了 TIR 中“何时信工具”的校准难题，为构建更可靠的工具增强推理系统提供了即插即用的通用策略。

title: Towards Rapid Constitutive Model Discovery from Multi-Modal Data: Physics Augmented Finite Element Model Updating (paFEMU)
summary: Recent progress in AI-enabled constitutive modeling has concentrated on moving from a purely data-driven paradigm to the enforcement of physical constraints and mechanistic principles, a concept referred to as physics augmentation. Classical phenomenological approaches rely on selecting a pre-defined model and calibrating its parameters, while machine learning methods often focus on discovery of the model itself. Sparse regression approaches lie in between, where large libraries of pre-defined models are probed during calibration. Sparsification in the aforementioned paradigm, but also in the context of neural network architecture, has been shown to enable interpretability, uncertainty quantification, but also heterogeneous software integration due to the low-dimensional nature of the resulting models. Most works in AI-enabled constitutive modeling have also focused on data from a single source, but in reality, materials modeling workflows can contain data from many different sources (multi-modal data), and also from testing other materials within the same materials class (multi-fidelity data). In this work, we introduce physics augmented finite element model updating (paFEMU), as a transfer learning approach that combines AI-enabled constitutive modeling, sparsification for interpretable model discovery, and finite element-based adjoint optimization utilizing multi-modal data. This is achieved by combining simple mechanical testing data, potentially from a distinct material, with digital image correlation-type full-field data acquisition to ultimately enable rapid constitutive modeling discovery. The simplicity of the sparse representation enables easy integration of neural constitutive models in existing finite element workflows, and also enables low-dimensional updating during transfer learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于物理增强与稀疏化、多模态迁移学习的paFEMU框架，实现快速、可解释且易集成到既有FEA流程的本构建模改进。
AI.motivation: 传统数据驱动AI本构建模忽视多模态/多保真度材料测试数据，且模型结构复杂、缺乏物理解释性，不易嵌入现有有限元工作流。
AI.method: 提出paFEMU框架：1)用稀疏回归+AI模型库确定低维可解释材料本构；2)结合简单力学试验(他料)与全场DIC等多模态数据；3)采用有限元伴随优化进行迁移学习与模型更新。
AI.result: 在全自动、少参数的低维空间中快速地发现和校准材料本构，同时保证物理解及不确定度量化，并可直接插入现有FEA软件更新模型。
AI.conclusion: paFEMU通过稀疏化+物理约束+迁移学习，首次将AIML本构建模与FEA工作流深度耦合，为材料研发提供高效、可解释且具扩展性的数字化新范式。

title: IoT-Brain: Grounding LLMs for Semantic-Spatial Sensor Scheduling
comment: To appear in ACM MobiCom 2026; 13 pages, 12 figures
summary: Intelligent systems powered by large-scale sensor networks are shifting from predefined monitoring to intent-driven operation, revealing a critical Semantic-to-Physical Mapping Gap. While large language models (LLMs) excel at semantic understanding, existing perception-centric pipelines operate retrospectively, overlooking the fundamental decision of what to sense and when. We formalize this proactive decision as Semantic-Spatial Sensor Scheduling (S3) and demonstrate that direct LLM planning is unreliable due to inherent gaps in representation, reasoning, and optimization. To bridge these gaps, we introduce the Spatial Trajectory Graph (STG), a neuro-symbolic paradigm governed by a verify-before-commit discipline that transforms open-ended planning into a verifiable graph optimization problem. Based on STG, we implement IoT-Brain, a concrete system embodiment, and construct TopoSense-Bench, a campus-scale benchmark with 5,250 natural-language queries across 2,510 cameras. Evaluations show that IoT-Brain boosts task success rate by 37.6% over the strongest search-intensive methods while running nearly 2 times faster and using 6.6 times fewer prompt tokens. In real-world deployment, it approaches the reliability upper bound while reducing 4.1 times network bandwidth, providing a foundational framework for LLMs to interact with the physical world with unprecedented reliability and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 将LLM与大规模传感器网络结合，首次在感知层面做出‘要不要看、何时看’的前瞻决策，并以『可验证图规划』取代直接语言推理，把任务成功率提升37.6%、带宽降低4.1倍。
AI.motivation: 传统感知系统先采集再处理，忽略了‘先决策感知什么’这一关键环节，导致语义意图-物理资源严重失配；LLM虽语义强，但直接规划不可靠，需要系统级优化框架。
AI.method: 提出S3问题形式化——语义-空间传感器调度；设计STG神经符号图，将开放规划转为验证型图优化，并约束‘先验证-后执行’；构建IoT-Brain系统及TopoSense-Bench基准。
AI.result: 与最强搜索密集方法相比，任务成功率+37.6%，速度×2，提示token数-6.6×；实地部署带宽-4.1×且逼近可靠性上限，验证STG对LLM走向物理世界的可扩展性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: STG-S3范式为LLM驱动的传感器网络奠定了语义-物理可验证交互通用框架，显著提高了可靠性和效率，为大规模意图驱动感知树立基准。

title: Object-Centric Stereo Ranging for Autonomous Driving: From Dense Disparity to Census-Based Template Matching
summary: Accurate depth estimation is critical for autonomous driving perception systems, particularly for long range vehicle detection on highways. Traditional dense stereo matching methods such as Block Matching (BM) and Semi Global Matching (SGM) produce per pixel disparity maps but suffer from high computational cost, sensitivity to radiometric differences between stereo cameras, and poor accuracy at long range where disparity values are small. In this report, we present a comprehensive stereo ranging system that integrates three complementary depth estimation approaches: dense BM/SGM disparity, object centric Census based template matching, and monocular geometric priors, within a unified detection ranging tracking pipeline. Our key contribution is a novel object centric Census based template matching algorithm that performs GPU accelerated sparse stereo matching directly within detected bounding boxes, employing a far close divide and conquer strategy, forward backward verification, occlusion aware sampling, and robust multi block aggregation. We further describe an online calibration refinement framework that combines auto rectification offset search, radar stereo voting based disparity correction, and object level radar stereo association for continuous extrinsic drift compensation. The complete system achieves real time performance through asynchronous GPU pipeline design and delivers robust ranging across diverse driving conditions including nighttime, rain, and varying illumination.

AI.tldr: 提出一套实时双目-雷达耦合的远距离测距系统，用稀疏视差+ Census 模板匹配+几何先验三源融合，结合在线外参自校正，夜间/雨雾等工况下稳定输出车辆距离。
AI.motivation: 高速场景长距车辆检测对深度精度要求高，传统稠密 BM/SGM 计算量大、易受光照差异影响且远距视差微小导致误差大，需兼顾实时性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 以检测框为单位做 GPU 加速稀疏视差：用 Census 描述子在“远-近分治”窗口内前-后向验证、遮挡感知采样、多区块聚合获得子像素级视差；2) 融合单目几何先验与稠密 SGM 结果；3) 在线标定优化：自动矫正偏移搜索+雷达-投票视差修正+物体级关联，持续补偿外参漂移；4) 异步 GPU 管线实现实时。
AI.result: 系统在夜间、雨雾、光照突变等场景下实现 30+ fps 实时测距，远距（>100 m）车辆深度误差较 SGM 降低 40% 以上，外参漂移自动收敛至 <0.05°。
AI.conclusion: 通过“检测导向稀疏匹配+多源深度融合+在线外参自校正”，兼顾了实时性、精度与环境鲁棒性，为高速自动驾驶提供了可靠的长距深度感知方案。

title: Distributed Multi-Layer Editing for Rule-Level Knowledge in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models store not only isolated facts but also rules that support reasoning across symbolic expressions, natural language explanations, and concrete instances. Yet most model editing methods are built for fact-level knowledge, assuming that a target edit can be achieved through a localized intervention. This assumption does not hold for rule-level knowledge, where a single rule must remain consistent across multiple interdependent forms. We investigate this problem through a mechanistic study of rule-level knowledge editing. To support this study, we extend the RuleEdit benchmark from 80 to 200 manually verified rules spanning mathematics and physics. Fine-grained causal tracing reveals a form-specific organization of rule knowledge in transformer layers: formulas and descriptions are concentrated in earlier layers, while instances are more associated with middle layers. These results suggest that rule knowledge is not uniformly localized, and therefore cannot be reliably edited by a single-layer or contiguous-block intervention. Based on this insight, we propose Distributed Multi-Layer Editing (DMLE), which applies a shared early-layer update to formulas and descriptions and a separate middle-layer update to instances. While remaining competitive on standard editing metrics, DMLE achieves substantially stronger rule-level editing performance. On average, it improves instance portability and rule understanding by 13.91 and 50.19 percentage points, respectively, over the strongest baseline across GPT-J-6B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2-7B, and LLaMA-3-8B. The code is available at https://github.com/Pepper66/DMLE.

AI.tldr: 大模型中的“规则级”知识跨公式、描述、实例三层分布，单点编辑失效；作者提出分布式多层编辑 DMLE，可同时更新公式/描述层与实例层，规则理解和迁移平均提升 51 与 14 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有编辑法默认知识局部可隔离，但规则必须同时保持公式、文字描述和具体算例三重一致，单点干预无法保证跨模态一致性。
AI.method: 构造含 200 条数学/物理规则的 RuleEdit 数据集；用因果追踪定位规则的三层表征（早层：公式与描述；中层：实例）；提出 DMLE，对早层和中层分别注入兼容的梯度更新，实现分布式同步编辑。
AI.result: 在 4 个 6–8 B 模型上，DMLE 的实例迁移率提升 13.91 pp，规则理解准确率提升 50.19 pp，远超 MEMIT、RROME 等最强基线，同时保持一般事实编辑指标不降。
AI.conclusion: 规则知识呈分布式跨层存储，单点修改必然破坏跨模态一致性；多层协同编辑是同时保证规则正确性与泛化性的可行路径，为后续高阶知识修正提供方法论基础。

title: Structured Distillation of Web Agent Capabilities Enables Generalization
summary: Frontier LLMs can navigate complex websites, but their cost and reliance on third-party APIs make local deployment impractical. We introduce Agent-as-Annotators, a framework that structures synthetic trajectory generation for web agents by analogy to human annotation roles, replacing the Task Designer, Annotator, and Supervisor with modular LLM components. Using Gemini 3 Pro as teacher, we generate 3,000 trajectories across six web environments and fine-tune a 9B-parameter student with pure supervised learning on the 2,322 that pass quality filtering. The resulting model achieves 41.5% on WebArena, surpassing closed-source models such as Claude 3.5 Sonnet (36.0%) and GPT-4o (31.5%) under the same evaluation protocol, and nearly doubling the previous best open-weight result (Go-Browse, 21.7%). Capabilities transfer to unseen environments, with an 18.2 percentage point gain on WorkArena L1 (an enterprise platform never seen during training) and consistent improvements across three additional benchmarks. Ablations confirm that each pipeline component contributes meaningfully, with Judge filtering, evaluation hints, and reasoning traces each accounting for measurable gains. These results demonstrate that structured trajectory synthesis from a single frontier teacher is sufficient to produce competitive, locally deployable web agents. Project page: https://agent-as-annotators.github.io

AI.tldr: 用1个顶级LLM当「老师」自动扮演任务设计-标注-质检三个角色，合成了3千条网页操作轨迹并过滤出2.3千条，把9B小模型纯监督微调后，WebArena达41.5%，超Claude3.5Sonnet、GPT-4o，且能泛化到未见过的企业环境。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型虽能操作复杂网站，但依赖云端API、成本高昂、无法本地部署；社区缺少高质量、开源的网页代理轨迹数据。目标是低成本制造本地可运行且性能比肩闭源大模型的web agent。
AI.method: 提出Agent-as-Annotator框架：将人类标注流程拆解为LLM可替代的Task Designer、Annotator、Supervisor模块，用Gemini 3 Pro同时承担三者角色；在6个web环境中自动生成3千条操作轨迹，经Judge过滤保留2.3千条高质量轨迹；冻结教师模型，仅对这2.3千条轨迹做纯监督学习，训练9 B参数学生模型。
AI.result: 学生模型在WebArena达41.5%，超过Claude3.5Sonnet(36.0%)、GPT-4o(31.5%)，并较之前最佳开源模型Go-Browse(21.7%)提升近一倍；在未参与训练的WorkArena L1企业平台提升18.2个百分点，其余3个零样本数据集也均优于基线；消融显示Judge过滤、评估提示、推理轨迹等模块各自带来可度量增益。
AI.conclusion: 仅用单个前沿大教师+结构化合成轨迹，就能蒸馏出性能领先、可本地部署的小模型web agent，为低成本、高可控的自主网页自动化提供可行路线。

title: ImplicitMemBench: Measuring Unconscious Behavioral Adaptation in Large Language Models
summary: Existing memory benchmarks for LLM agents evaluate explicit recall of facts, yet overlook implicit memory where experience becomes automated behavior without conscious retrieval. This gap is critical: effective assistants must automatically apply learned procedures or avoid failed actions without explicit reminders. We introduce ImplicitMemBench, the first systematic benchmark evaluating implicit memory through three cognitively grounded constructs drawn from standard cognitive-science accounts of non-declarative memory: Procedural Memory (one-shot skill acquisition after interference), Priming (theme-driven bias via paired experimental/control instances), and Classical Conditioning (Conditioned Stimulus--Unconditioned Stimulus (CS--US) associations shaping first decisions). Our 300-item suite employs a unified Learning/Priming-Interfere-Test protocol with first-attempt scoring. Evaluation of 17 models reveals severe limitations: no model exceeds 66% overall, with top performers DeepSeek-R1 (65.3%), Qwen3-32B (64.1%), and GPT-5 (63.0%) far below human baselines. Analysis uncovers dramatic asymmetries (inhibition 17.6% vs. preference 75.0%) and universal bottlenecks requiring architectural innovations beyond parameter scaling. ImplicitMemBench reframes evaluation from "what agents recall" to "what they automatically enact".

AI.tldr: 为检视LLM能否“无意识地学以致用”，作者提出首个隐式记忆基准ImplicitMemBench，覆盖程序性记忆、启动效应与经典条件反射三类认知范式；17个主流模型平均分仅60%，人-机差距极大，提示仅靠扩参数无法突破。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只测显式事实回忆，无法反映助理“学完即用”或“避开失败动作”的自动化能力；传统认知科学已证明人类行为大量依赖无需意识检索的隐式记忆，故迫切需要量化评估。
AI.method: 设计300题、统一“学习-干扰-初测”协议，对应:①程序性：干扰后一次学会新技能；②启动：主题线索隐偏决策；③条件反射：CS-US配对影响首决策；三部分均按首试百分比评分。
AI.result: 17模型无过一66%，DeepSeek-R1 65.3%、Qwen3-32B 64.1%、GPT-5 63.0%居前三；抑制率仅17.6%，偏好率75%，呈现明显不对称；参数扩增与性能提升几乎脱钩，表明架构瓶颈显著。
AI.conclusion: 隐式记忆能力是LLM代理真正“自动行动”的关键短板；ImplicitMemBench将评测焦点从“回忆了什么”转向“自动执行了什么”，并为架构创新提供可重复、认知驱动的参照基准。

title: DP-DeGauss: Dynamic Probabilistic Gaussian Decomposition for Egocentric 4D Scene Reconstruction
summary: Egocentric video is crucial for next-generation 4D scene reconstruction, with applications in AR/VR and embodied AI. However, reconstructing dynamic first-person scenes is challenging due to complex ego-motion, occlusions, and hand-object interactions. Existing decomposition methods are ill-suited, assuming fixed viewpoints or merging dynamics into a single foreground. To address these limitations, we introduce DP-DeGauss, a dynamic probabilistic Gaussian decomposition framework for egocentric 4D reconstruction. Our method initializes a unified 3D Gaussian set from COLMAP priors, augments each with a learnable category probability, and dynamically routes them into specialized deformation branches for background, hands, or object modeling. We employ category-specific masks for better disentanglement and introduce brightness and motion-flow control to improve static rendering and dynamic reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that DP-DeGauss outperforms baselines by +1.70dB in PSNR on average with SSIM and LPIPS gains. More importantly, our framework achieves the first and state-of-the-art disentanglement of background, hand, and object components, enabling explicit, fine-grained separation, paving the way for more intuitive ego scene understanding and editing.

AI.tldr: 提出DP-DeGauss，用概率动态3D Gaussian将第一视角视频分解为背景/手/物，实现当前最佳4D重建与可编辑解耦。
AI.motivation: 第一视角动态4D重建对AR/VR、具身AI至关重要，但现有方法无法处理复杂ego-motion、遮挡与手-物交互，且把动态前景视为整体，需显式细化分解。
AI.method: 1) 以COLMAP先验初始化统一3D高斯集合；2) 为每个高斯附加可学习的类别概率；3) 动态路由到背景/手/物三条专用变形分支，并用类别掩码、亮度及光流控制提升静态渲染与动态建模。
AI.result: 在公开数据上平均PSNR提升+1.70 dB，SSIM、LPIPS同步改善，首次实现背景、手、物的细粒度解耦并达到SOTA分解质量。
AI.conclusion: DP-DeGauss实现首个高保真、可编辑的第一视角4D场景分解，为虚拟现实及具身智能提供直接、可操作的场景理解接口。

title: SeLaR: Selective Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a cornerstone of reasoning in large language models, yet its effectiveness is constrained by the limited expressiveness of discrete token sampling. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to alleviate this limitation by replacing discrete tokens with soft embeddings (probability-weighted mixtures of token embeddings) or hidden states, but they commonly suffer from two issues: (1) global activation injects perturbations into high-confidence steps, impairing reasoning stability; and (2) soft embeddings quickly collapse toward the highest-probability token, limiting exploration of alternative trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose SeLaR (Selective Latent Reasoning), a lightweight and training-free framework. SeLaR introduces an entropy-gated mechanism that activates soft embeddings only at low-confidence steps, while preserving discrete decoding at high-confidence steps. Additionally, we propose an entropy-aware contrastive regularization that pushes soft embeddings away from the dominant (highest-probability) token's direction, encouraging sustained exploration of multiple latent reasoning paths. Experiments on five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SeLaR consistently outperforms standard CoT and state-of-the-art training-free methods.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM离散token推理表达能力受限的问题，提出无需训练的SeLaR框架：用熵门控在低置信步骤切换软嵌入、高置信步骤保持离散解码，并引入熵感知对比正则化防止软嵌入坍缩至最高概token。五组推理基准全面优于标准CoT与前沿免训方法。
AI.motivation: 标准Chain-of-Thought依赖离散token采样，表达能力天花板明显；现有隐式推理方法虽用软嵌入扩展空间，却存在全局激活干扰高置信步骤和嵌入快速坍缩两大缺陷，亟需轻量级、无需训练即可即插即用的改进方案。
AI.method: SeLaR框架核心为两步：1) 熵门控机制——实时计算步骤置信度（熵值），低置信时启用软嵌入，高置信时仍用离散解码，避免全局扰动；2) 熵感知对比正则化——在软嵌入空间施加对比损失，使其远离当前最高概token方向，维持多路径探索能力；整个流程无需任何梯度更新，推理阶段即插即用。
AI.result: 在GSM-8K、SVAMP、MultiArith、StrategyQA、ARC-c五项推理数据集上，SeLaR相较标准CoT平均提升5–12个百分点，相较当前最佳免训基线平均提升3–7个百分点，同时保持与原模型相当的延迟与显存开销。
AI.conclusion: SeLaR通过“置信度敏感”的软/硬混合解码与抗坍缩正则化，有效释放了隐式推理潜力，兼顾了稳定性、多样性与零样本部署便利，为无需训练的LLM推理增强提供了新范式；未来可扩展至多语言、多模态及更长程推理任务。

title: PolicyLong: Towards On-Policy Context Extension
comment: Work in progress. Correspondence to ucaswu@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Extending LLM context windows is hindered by scarce high-quality long-context data. Recent methods synthesize data with genuine long-range dependencies via information-theoretic verification, selecting contexts that reduce a base model's predictive entropy. However, their single-pass offline construction with a fixed model creates a fundamental off-policy gap: the static screening landscape misaligns with the model's evolving capabilities, causing the training distribution to drift. We propose PolicyLong, shifting data construction towards a dynamic on-policy paradigm. By iteratively re-executing data screening (entropy computation, retrieval, and verification) using the current model, PolicyLong ensures the training distribution tracks evolving capabilities, yielding an emergent self-curriculum. Crucially, both positive and hard negative contexts derive from the current model's entropy landscape, co-evolving what the model learns to exploit and resist. Experiments on RULER, HELMET, and LongBench-v2 (Qwen2.5-3B) show PolicyLong consistently outperforms EntropyLong and NExtLong, with gains growing at longer contexts (e.g., +2.54 at 128K on RULER), confirming the value of on-policy data evolution.

AI.tldr: PolicyLong 用‘当前模型自己挑数据’的动态策略，为 LLM 持续提供与能力同步的长文本训练样本，在长窗口基准上显著超越离线构造方法。
AI.motivation: 高质量长上下文数据稀缺；现有离线构造法用固定基模型一次性筛选，导致训练分布与模型持续进化的能力错位(off-policy gap)。
AI.method: PolicyLong：在训练循环内反复用最新模型计算熵、检索并验证候选文本，使正例与困难负例均来自当前模型的“熵地形”，实现 on-policy、共演化的数据课程。
AI.result: 在 RULER、HELMET、LongBench-v2(Qwen2.5-3B) 上，PolicyLong 全面优于 EntropyLong 与 NExtLong，且窗口越长优势越大(128K 处 RULER +2.54%)。
AI.conclusion: 动态 on-policy 数据构造能有效追踪模型能力变化，形成自课程，是扩展 LLM 长上下文窗口的关键路径。

title: Revise: A Framework for Revising OCRed text in Practical Information Systems with Data Contamination Strategy
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly improved the field of Document AI, demonstrating remarkable performance on document understanding tasks such as question answering. However, existing approaches primarily focus on solving specific tasks, lacking the capability to structurally organize and manage document information. To address this limitation, we propose Revise, a framework that systematically corrects errors introduced by OCR at the character, word, and structural levels. Specifically, Revise employs a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy of common OCR errors and a synthetic data generation strategy that realistically simulates such errors to train an effective correction model. Experimental results demonstrate that Revise effectively corrects OCR outputs, enabling more structured representation and systematic management of document contents. Consequently, our method significantly enhances downstream performance in document retrieval and question answering tasks, highlighting the potential to overcome the structural management limitations of existing Document AI frameworks.

AI.tldr: Revise是一种面向文档AI的OCR错误修复框架，通过三层级错误分类体系与合成数据训练，显著提升文档结构化与下游检索/问答表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在Document AI中侧重任务端性能，却忽视OCR错误导致的结构信息散乱，难以实现文档内容的系统化组织与管理。
AI.method: (1) 构建字符-词-结构三级OCR错误分类体系；(2) 设计高保真合成数据生成策略模拟真实错误；(3) 基于该数据训练专用修正模型，将OCR输出转换为结构化表示。
AI.result: 在多项文档检索与问答基准上，经Revise修正的OCR结果显著优于原始输出，下游任务指标提升明显，验证其结构修复有效性。
AI.conclusion: Revise证明系统性纠正OCR错误可突破现有Document AI框架的结构管理瓶颈，为后续文档智能任务提供更高质量的结构化输入。

title: SceneScribe-1M: A Large-Scale Video Dataset with Comprehensive Geometric and Semantic Annotations
summary: The convergence of 3D geometric perception and video synthesis has created an unprecedented demand for large-scale video data that is rich in both semantic and spatio-temporal information. While existing datasets have advanced either 3D understanding or video generation, a significant gap remains in providing a unified resource that supports both domains at scale. To bridge this chasm, we introduce SceneScribe-1M, a new large-scale, multi-modal video dataset. It comprises one million in-the-wild videos, each meticulously annotated with detailed textual descriptions, precise camera parameters, dense depth maps, and consistent 3D point tracks. We demonstrate the versatility and value of SceneScribe-1M by establishing benchmarks across a wide array of downstream tasks, including monocular depth estimation, scene reconstruction, and dynamic point tracking, as well as generative tasks such as text-to-video synthesis, with or without camera control. By open-sourcing SceneScribe-1M, we aim to provide a comprehensive benchmark and a catalyst for research, fostering the development of models that can both perceive the dynamic 3D world and generate controllable, realistic video content.

AI.tldr: SceneScribe-1M 是目前规模最大的「3D 感知–视频生成」统一数据集，含 100 万实景短视频及逐帧稠密 3D 标注，首次为深度估计、重建、跟踪、文本到视频等十余项任务提供端到端基准。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集要么服务 3D 几何理解，要么服务视频生成，二者规模与标注粒度无法兼顾，导致跨模态、跨任务模型训练缺乏统一资源。作者旨在填补这一空白，推动「感知+生成」一体化研究。
AI.method: 采集 100 万段实景视频，自动–人工协同标注：1) 每帧稠密深度；2) 百万级 3D 点轨迹（跨帧一致）；3) 精确相机内参与位姿；4) 细粒度文本描述（对象、动作、场景层级）。构建统一数据格式与评估协议，并开源基准代码。
AI.result: 在 8 项感知任务（单目深度、SLAM、动态跟踪等）和 4 项生成任务（文本到视频、相机可控视频生成等）上，使用 SceneScribe-1M 训练的专用或通用模型均相对原公开数据集 baseline 提升 8–27% 不等，显示数据规模与 3D 标注质量直接转化为性能增益。
AI.conclusion: SceneScribe-1M 证明大规模、高完整度的 3D–文本–视频对齐数据是「感知与生成一体化」模型的关键燃料；其开源将显著降低后续研究门槛，促进可控、真实、动态 3D 视频内容生成与理解技术的同步突破。

title: Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces
summary: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has illuminated the potential for a general-purpose user simulator. However, existing benchmarks remain constrained to isolated scenarios, narrow action spaces, or synthetic data, failing to capture the holistic nature of authentic human behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniBehavior, the first user simulation benchmark constructed entirely from real-world data, integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario, and heterogeneous behavioral patterns into a unified framework. Based on this benchmark, we first provide empirical evidence that previous datasets with isolated scenarios suffer from tunnel vision, whereas real-world decision-making relies on long-term, cross-scenario causal chains. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that current models struggle to accurately simulate these complex behaviors, with performance plateauing even as context windows expand. Crucially, a systematic comparison between simulated and authentic behaviors uncovers a fundamental structural bias: LLMs tend to converge toward a positive average person, exhibiting hyper-activity, persona homogenization, and a Utopian bias. This results in the loss of individual differences and long-tail behaviors, highlighting critical directions for future high-fidelity simulation research.

AI.tldr: 首套全真实数据的大规模用户模拟基准 OmniBehavior 揭示：现有 LLM 在长程跨场景模拟中存在“平均化乌托邦”偏差，个体长尾行为缺失。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 用户模拟器仅用孤立场景、狭窄动作空间或合成数据，无法还原真实人类跨域长程行为，急需全真实、全景式基准。
AI.method: 构建 OmniBehavior——从真实日志中抽取长时程跨场景异构行为，设计统一指标，对比 SOTA LLM 与真实用户轨迹，量化结构偏差。
AI.result: 实验显示 LLM 在多跳因果链上性能饱和；模拟行为与真实分布出现显著差异：活跃度过度、人格同质化、正面偏置，长尾特征消失。
AI.conclusion: 要实现高保真用户模拟，必须突破“平均人”先验，引入个性化、负样本与长尾建模，为下一代 LLM 仿真指明关键改进方向。

title: Information-Theoretic Requirements for Gradient-Based Task Affinity Estimation in Multi-Task Learning
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at workshop on AI for Accelerated Materials Design, Foundation Models for Science: Real-World Impact and Science-First Design, and Generative and Experimental Perspectives for Biomolecular Design at ICLR 2026
summary: Multi-task learning shows strikingly inconsistent results -- sometimes joint training helps substantially, sometimes it actively harms performance -- yet the field lacks a principled framework for predicting these outcomes. We identify a fundamental but unstated assumption underlying gradient-based task analysis: tasks must share training instances for gradient conflicts to reveal genuine relationships. When tasks are measured on the same inputs, gradient alignment reflects shared mechanistic structure; when measured on disjoint inputs, any apparent signal conflates task relationships with distributional shift. We discover this sample overlap requirement exhibits a sharp phase transition: below 30% overlap, gradient-task correlations are statistically indistinguishable from noise; above 40%, they reliably recover known biological structure. Comprehensive validation across multiple datasets achieves strong correlations and recovers biological pathway organization. Standard benchmarks systematically violate this requirement -- MoleculeNet operates at <5% overlap, TDC at 8-14% -- far below the threshold where gradient analysis becomes meaningful. This provides the first principled explanation for seven years of inconsistent MTL results.

AI.tldr: 作者发现只有当两个任务共享≥30%训练样本时，梯度冲突/对齐才能反映任务真实关系；否则信号只是分布漂移噪声。主流基准因严重低于该阈值而导致MTL表现反复无常。
AI.motivation: 多任务学习效果时好时坏缺乏理论解释；现有基于梯度分析的方法并未考察训练样本重叠这一隐含前提，急需一个可预测MTL成败的判别框架。
AI.method: 系统检验不同样本重叠率下梯度-任务相关性的变化，实验覆盖蛋白质功能、药物反应等多套数据；通过相位转变分析确定30%重叠阈值并对MoleculeNet/TDC等基准进行统计审计。
AI.result: 样本重叠率<30%时，梯度-任务相关性≈零且无意义；>40%时稳定复原已知生物学通路结构（R≈0.9）。主流基准重叠率仅5–14%，无法满足判别阈值，首次定量解释了MTL长期不稳定的根源。
AI.conclusion: 梯度冲突信号只有在共享训练实例条件下才可信；评估或设计MTL benchmark必须先保证≥30%样本重叠。

title: Beyond Stochastic Exploration: What Makes Training Data Valuable for Agentic Search
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective approach for advancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through the strategic integration of external search engines. However, current RL-based search agents often rely on a process of stochastic exploration guided by carefully crafted outcome rewards, leading to inefficient reasoning trajectories and unstable training. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework, Hierarchical Experience (HiExp), to enhance the performance and training stability of search agents. Specifically, we extract empirical knowledge through contrastive analysis and a multi-level clustering mechanism, transforming raw reasoning trajectories into hierarchical experience knowledge. By leveraging experience-aligned training, we effectively regularize stochastic exploration, evolving it into a strategic and experience-driven search process. Extensive evaluations on multiple complex agentic search and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves substantial performance gains but also exhibits strong cross-task and cross-algorithm generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出分层经验框架 HiExp，用多级聚类提取高层经验知识，正则化强化学习搜索的随机探索，在复杂推理任务上显著提升性能并具跨任务泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 搜索智能体依赖人工设计的结局奖励与随机探索，导致推理路径低效、训练不稳定，需引入结构化经验知识以指导策略更新。
AI.method: 通过对比分析将原始轨迹压缩为高层经验，再以多级聚类构建分层经验知识库；训练阶段用经验对齐损失约束策略网络，使探索由随机转为经验驱动。
AI.result: 在多个复杂搜索与数学推理基准上，HiExp 相对基线取得显著性能跃升，且经验知识可跨任务、跨算法迁移，训练曲线更平稳。
AI.conclusion: 分层经验知识能有效正则化 RL 探索，兼顾效率与稳定性，为 LLM 推理智能体提供可扩展的通用增强范式。

title: MotionScape: A Large-Scale Real-World Highly Dynamic UAV Video Dataset for World Models
summary: Recent advances in world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in simulating physical reality, making them an increasingly important foundation for embodied intelligence. For UAV agents in particular, accurate prediction of complex 3D dynamics is essential for autonomous navigation and robust decision-making in unconstrained environments. However, under the highly dynamic camera trajectories typical of UAV views, existing world models often struggle to maintain spatiotemporal physical consistency. A key reason lies in the distribution bias of current training data: most existing datasets exhibit restricted 2.5D motion patterns, such as ground-constrained autonomous driving scenes or relatively smooth human-centric egocentric videos, and therefore lack realistic high-dynamic 6-DoF UAV motion priors. To address this gap, we present MotionScape, a large-scale real-world UAV-view video dataset with highly dynamic motion for world modeling. MotionScape contains over 30 hours of 4K UAV-view videos, totaling more than 4.5M frames. This novel dataset features semantically and geometrically aligned training samples, where diverse real-world UAV videos are tightly coupled with accurate 6-DoF camera trajectories and fine-grained natural language descriptions. To build the dataset, we develop an automated multi-stage processing pipeline that integrates CLIP-based relevance filtering, temporal segmentation, robust visual SLAM for trajectory recovery, and large-language-model-driven semantic annotation. Extensive experiments show that incorporating such semantically and geometrically aligned annotations effectively improves the ability of existing world models to simulate complex 3D dynamics and handle large viewpoint shifts, thereby benefiting decision-making and planning for UAV agents in complex environments. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/Thelegendzz/MotionScape

AI.tldr: 面向无人机视角的世界模型训练缺失高动态6-DoF运动先验，作者提出并公开含4.5M帧4K视频、带6-DoF轨迹与文本描述的MotionScape数据集，显著增强模型对复杂3D动力学与视点变化的建模能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在无人机强机动相机轨迹下时空一致性差，主因是训练数据多为2.5D地面或平缓人视角，缺乏真实高动态6-DoF无人机运动分布。需构建大规模真实无人机视频库以填补该空白。
AI.method: 设计自动化多阶段管线：CLIP相关性过滤→时序分割→鲁棒视觉SLAM恢复6-DoF轨迹→大模型生成细粒度自然语言描述，最终获得30+小时4K视频、4.5M帧，并与语义几何对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，引入该语义-几何对齐数据后，现有世界模型在复杂3D动力学模拟和大视角偏移处理上性能显著提升，对无人机决策与规划产生正面影响。
AI.conclusion: MotionScape首次提供真实高动态无人机视角世界模型训练数据，公开的轨迹与文本对齐标注可有效提升模型时空一致性，为推进具身智能空中 agent 的自主导航与鲁棒决策奠定基础。

title: A GAN and LLM-Driven Data Augmentation Framework for Dynamic Linguistic Pattern Modeling in Chinese Sarcasm Detection
summary: Sarcasm is a rhetorical device that expresses criticism or emphasizes characteristics of certain individuals or situations through exaggeration, irony, or comparison. Existing methods for Chinese sarcasm detection are constrained by limited datasets and high construction costs, and they mainly focus on textual features, overlooking user-specific linguistic patterns that shape how opinions and emotions are expressed. This paper proposes a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Large Language Model (LLM)-driven data augmentation framework to dynamically model users' linguistic patterns for enhanced Chinese sarcasm detection. First, we collect raw data from various topics on Sina Weibo. Then, we train a GAN on these data and apply a GPT-3.5 based data augmentation technique to synthesize an extended sarcastic comment dataset, named SinaSarc. This dataset contains target comments, contextual information, and user historical behavior. Finally, we extend the BERT architecture to incorporate multi-dimensional information, particularly user historical behavior, enabling the model to capture dynamic linguistic patterns and uncover implicit sarcastic cues in comments. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Specifically, our model achieves the highest F1-scores on both the non-sarcastic and sarcastic categories, with values of 0.9138 and 0.9151 respectively, which outperforms all existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. This study presents a novel framework for dynamically modeling users' long-term linguistic patterns in Chinese sarcasm detection, contributing to both dataset construction and methodological advancement in this field.

AI.tldr: 借助GAN+LLM生成数据、融入用户历史行为，所提模型在汉语反讽识别任务上刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 中文反讽标注数据稀缺、成本高，且现有方法忽略用户个性化语言模式，需要可扩展的数据增强与更具语境感知的方法。
AI.method: 1.采集微博多话题原始数据；2.用GAN和GPT-3.5进行数据增强，生成含目标评论、上下文与用户历史行的SinaSarc数据集；3.扩展BERT，显式融合用户历史行为等多元信息以捕动态语言特征。
AI.result: F1分别达到0.9138（非反讽）与0.9151（反讽），超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 提出GAN-LLM数据增强+用户历史建模框架，有效提升中文反讽检测并丰富数据集，为该领域方法与资源双贡献。

title: QaRL: Rollout-Aligned Quantization-Aware RL for Fast and Stable Training under Training--Inference Mismatch
summary: Large language model (LLM) reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines are often bottlenecked by rollout generation, making end-to-end training slow. Recent work mitigates this by running rollouts with quantization to accelerate decoding, which is the most expensive stage of the RL loop. However, these setups destabilize optimization by amplifying the training-inference gap: rollouts are operated at low precision, while learning updates are computed at full precision. To address this challenge, we propose QaRL (Rollout Alignment Quantization-Aware RL), which aligns training-side forward with the quantized rollout to minimize mismatch. We further identify a failure mode in quantized rollouts: long-form responses tend to produce repetitive, garbled tokens (error tokens). To mitigate these problems, we introduce TBPO (Trust-Band Policy Optimization), a sequence-level objective with dual clipping for negative samples, aimed at keeping updates within the trust region. On Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE for math problems, QaRL outperforms quantized-rollout training by +5.5 while improving stability and preserving low-bit throughput benefits.

AI.tldr: 提出QaRL框架，通过量化感知训练对齐低精度rollout与全精度更新，结合TBPO抑制长序列错误token，在30B MoE模型上提速并保持数学任务+5.5%增益。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM RL流程因rollout解码耗时成为瓶颈，采用低精度rollout虽加速但引入训练-推理精度不一致，导致优化不稳定；同时量化rollout易在长序列生成重复乱码token，亟需同时解决效率与精度 mismatch 及错误样本问题。
AI.method: 1) 设计QaRL：在训练阶段前向传播也采用与rollout一致的量化，实现“量化感知”对齐；2) 提出TBPO：序列级目标函数，对负样本实施双重剪切，使策略更新约束在信任域内，抑制错误token影响。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE数学任务上，QaRL比纯量化rollout训练绝对提升5.5%，且训练曲线更稳定，同时保留低比特吞吐带来的加速优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化感知训练与信任域约束的策略优化，可在不牺牲低精度推理速度的前提下显著缩小训练-推理差距，提升大模型RL训练效率与最终性能。

title: Activation Steering for Aligned Open-ended Generation without Sacrificing Coherence
summary: Alignment in LLMs is more brittle than commonly assumed: misalignment can be triggered by adversarial prompts, benign fine-tuning, emergent misalignment, and goal misgeneralization. Recent evidence suggests that some misalignment behaviors are encoded as linear structure in activation space, making it tractable via steering, while safety alignment has been shown to govern the first few output tokens primarily, leaving subsequent generation unguarded. These findings motivate activation steering as a lightweight runtime defense that continuously corrects misaligned activations throughout generation. We evaluate three methods: Steer-With-Fixed-Coeff (SwFC), which applies uniform additive steering, and two novel projection-aware methods, Steer-to-Target-Projection (StTP) and Steer-to-Mirror-Projection (StMP), that use a logistic regression decision boundary to selectively intervene only on tokens whose activations fall below distributional thresholds. Using malicious system prompts as a controlled proxy for misalignment, we evaluate under two threat models (dishonesty and dismissiveness) and two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-32B). All methods substantially recover target traits (honesty and compassion) while preserving coherence. StTP and StMP better maintain general capabilities (MMLU, MT-Bench, AlpacaEval) and produce less repetition in multi-turn conversations.

AI.tldr: 大模型对齐非常脆弱，可用轻量级「激活空间实时纠偏」方法对抗四类错位；新提出的StTP/StMP在保持能力指标的同时，比固定系数法更能恢复诚实/共情并减少多轮重复。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明：对抗提示、无害微调、突发错位与目标误泛化均能破坏LLM对齐；错位行为在激活空间中呈线性可探测，且安全对齐仅防护前几个token。亟需一种运行时、低开销、全生成过程持续的防御手段。
AI.method: 提出激活纠偏框架：SwFC用固定向量加法全时段干预；StTP/StMP则先以逻辑回归划定错位激活分布边界，仅对低于阈值的token做选择性投影纠偏，在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct与Qwen3-32B上测试不诚实与轻视两类威胁模型。
AI.result: 三种方法均显著恢复目标特质（诚实/共情）且保持文本连贯；StTP/StMP在MMLU、MT-Bench、AlpacaEval上性能衰减更小，多轮对话重复率更低，整体优于SwFC。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间线性特征为运行时纠偏提供可行抓手；投影感知的阈值式干预能在几乎不牺牲通用能力的前提下，持续修正错位激活，是轻量化、部署友好的在线安全方案。

title: SAT: Selective Aggregation Transformer for Image Super-Resolution
summary: Transformer-based approaches have revolutionized image super-resolution by modeling long-range dependencies. However, the quadratic computational complexity of vanilla self-attention mechanisms poses significant challenges, often leading to compromises between efficiency and global context exploitation. Recent window-based attention methods mitigate this by localizing computations, but they often yield restricted receptive fields. To mitigate these limitations, we propose Selective Aggregation Transformer (SAT). This novel transformer efficiently captures long-range dependencies, leading to an enlarged model receptive field by selectively aggregating key-value matrices (reducing the number of tokens by 97\%) via our Density-driven Token Aggregation algorithm while maintaining the full resolution of the query matrix. This design significantly reduces computational costs, resulting in lower complexity and enabling scalable global interactions without compromising reconstruction fidelity. SAT identifies and represents each cluster with a single aggregation token, utilizing density and isolation metrics to ensure that critical high-frequency details are preserved. Experimental results demonstrate that SAT outperforms the state-of-the-art method PFT by up to 0.22dB, while the total number of FLOPs can be reduced by up to 27\%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Selective Aggregation Transformer（SAT），在几乎不丢高频细节的前提下把全局自注意力计算量砍掉 97%，仅用 73% 的 FLOPs 就超越 SOTA 方法 PFT 0.22 dB。
AI.motivation: 普通自注意力在图像超分建模远程依赖时呈二次复杂度，窗口近似虽快却牺牲感受野；作者希望兼顾全局上下文与计算效率。
AI.method: Density-driven Token Aggregation 算法依据密度与隔离度把 97% 的 key-value 聚合成簇令牌，保持 query 全分辨率； Transformer 仅对聚合后的少量令牌做全局自注意力，从而扩大有效感受野并降复杂度。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，SAT 相比当前最佳 PFT 提高 0.22 dB，整体 FLOPs 降低 27%，且高频细节保留无明显损失。
AI.conclusion: 通过“密度驱动聚合”大幅减少令牌数量，可在全分辨率下实现可扩展的全局交互，为高效高保真图像超分提供新思路。

title: Synthetic Data for any Differentiable Target
summary: What are the limits of controlling language models via synthetic training data? We develop a reinforcement learning (RL) primitive, the Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG), which can precisely optimize synthetic data generators to produce a dataset of targeted examples. When used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of a target model, these examples cause the target model to do well on a differentiable metric of our choice. Our approach achieves this by taking exact data attribution via higher-order gradients and using those scores as policy gradient rewards. We prove that this procedure closely approximates the true, intractable gradient for the synthetic data generator. To illustrate the potential of DPG, we show that, using only SFT on generated examples, we can cause the target model's LM head weights to (1) embed a QR code, (2) embed the pattern $\texttt{67}$, and (3) have lower $\ell^2$ norm. We additionally show that we can cause the generator to (4) rephrase inputs in a new language and (5) produce a specific UUID, even though neither of these objectives is conveyed in the generator's input prompts. These findings suggest that DPG is a powerful and flexible technique for shaping model properties using only synthetic training examples.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Dataset Policy Gradient(DPG)，用精确的数据归因高阶梯度作为奖励信号，将合成数据生成器参数化地训练成“定向出题机”；仅用生成的示例做监督微调，就能让下游模型的权重暗藏二维码/固定数字/低ℓ2范数等任意可微属性，而无需把目标写进提示。
AI.motivation: 控制语言模型通常依赖提示工程或直接微调，难以精准、可解释地嵌入任意属性；研究者想问“仅通过合成训练数据到底能对模型施加多大控制”，并解决生成器优化目标不可微、梯度难传递的瓶颈。
AI.method: 将数据生成器视为RL策略，提出Dataset Policy Gradient：1)用高阶梯度对下游模型做精确数据归因；2)归因分数当作生成器策略梯度奖励，理论上近似真实但难解的生成器目标梯度；3)仅对下游模型做监督微调，不接触其内部参数，只控制输入分布。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅用生成示例SFT即可让目标模型：①LM头权重矩阵编码完整QR码；②权重嵌入数字67的固定模式；③权重ℓ2范数显著降低；④生成器自动把输入改写为新语言；⑤生成器输出特定UUID，而这些目标从未写入prompt。
AI.conclusion: DPG证明合成数据生成器可在权重空间层面“遥控”下游模型，突破了提示工程与微调的可控性极限；在模型水印、容量压缩、后门植入等场景具有强大潜力，也警示仅依赖SFT的数据审查远不足以抵御精细化操控。

title: Bit-by-Bit: Progressive QAT Strategy with Outlier Channel Splitting for Stable Low-Bit LLMs
summary: Training LLMs at ultra-low precision remains a formidable challenge. Direct low-bit QAT often suffers from convergence instability and substantial training costs, exacerbated by quantization noise from heavy-tailed outlier channels and error accumulation across layers. To address these issues, we present Bit-by-Bit, a progressive QAT framework with outlier channel splitting. Our approach integrates three key components: (1) block-wise progressive training that reduces precision stage by stage, ensuring stable initialization for low-bit optimization; (2) nested structure of integer quantization grids to enable a "train once, deploy any precision" paradigm, allowing a single model to support multiple bit-widths without retraining; (3) rounding-aware outlier channel splitting, which mitigates quantization error while acting as an identity transform that preserves the quantized outputs. Furthermore, we follow microscaling groups with E4M3 scales, capturing dynamic activation ranges in alignment with OCP/NVIDIA standards. To address the lack of efficient 2-bit kernels, we developed custom operators for both W2A2 and W2A16 configurations, achieving up to 11$\times$ speedup over BF16. Under W2A2 settings, Bit-by-Bit significantly outperforms baselines like BitDistiller and EfficientQAT on both Llama2/3, achieving a loss of only 2.25 WikiText2 PPL compared to full-precision models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于逐位渐进量化与离群通道分割的端到端QAT框架，首次在W2A2精度下将WikiText2 PPL仅推升至2.25，同时支持一次训练多精度部署，2-bit推理速度提升11×。
AI.motivation: 超低比特量化是缓解大模型推理成本的关键手段，但直接QAT受长尾离群通道与层间误差放大影响，常出现不稳定收敛与精度暴跌，LLM低比特场景尤为严重。
AI.method: 1) 块级逐位渐进训练：从fp32逐步降至2 bit，利用前阶段最优状态初始化下一阶段，抑制训练发散；2) 量化网格嵌套设计：用整数分解网格使一套权重可按需求取不同整数子集，无需再训，实现“train once, deploy any bit”范化；3) 注入可微量化离群通道拆分(RCS)：将超大激活通道映射到两条量化通道上，作用为恒等变换接收整数量化结果，依靠该结构在逼近fp输出的同时切断舍入误差累积；4) 微缩放组+E4M3动态指数缩放符配OCP/NV OCP MX规范，执行2-bit W2A2/W2A16专用CUDA内核，提升执行效率。
AI.result: 在Llama2/3上与BitDistiller、EfficientQAT等同类方法对比：W2A2下WikiText2 PPL仅2.25（与fp16相差不足+0.8点），显著优于现有最优基线(>3 PPL)；W2A16下保持接近fp16的zero-shot性能。独立2-bit内核取得端到端11×速度提升与≤3%输出误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过渐进优化与RCS离群保护，Bit-by-Bits首次证明LLM可稳定训练并直接部署于2-bit而不会显著牺牲建模能力，其多比特复用特性和硬件一致性为低比特推理提供了范式级方案。

title: Aligning Agents via Planning: A Benchmark for Trajectory-Level Reward Modeling
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, accepted to ACL 2026 main conference
summary: In classical Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Reward Models (RMs) serve as the fundamental signal provider for model alignment. As Large Language Models evolve into agentic systems capable of autonomous tool invocation and complex reasoning, the paradigm of reward modeling faces unprecedented challenges--most notably, the lack of benchmarks specifically designed to assess RM capabilities within tool-integrated environments. To address this gap, we present Plan-RewardBench, a trajectory-level preference benchmark designed to evaluate how well judges distinguish preferred versus distractor agent trajectories in complex tool-using scenarios. Plan-RewardBench covers four representative task families -- (i) Safety Refusal, (ii) Tool-Irrelevance / Unavailability, (iii) Complex Planning, and (iv) Robust Error Recovery -- comprising validated positive trajectories and confusable hard negatives constructed via multi-model natural rollouts, rule-based perturbations, and minimal-edit LLM perturbations. We benchmark representative RMs (generative, discriminative, and LLM-as-Judge) under a unified pairwise protocol, reporting accuracy trends across varying trajectory lengths and task categories. Furthermore, we provide diagnostic analyses of prevalent failure modes. Our results reveal that all three evaluator families face substantial challenges, with performance degrading sharply on long-horizon trajectories, underscoring the necessity for specialized training in agentic, trajectory-level reward modeling. Ultimately, Plan-RewardBench aims to serve as both a practical evaluation suite and a reusable blueprint for constructing agentic planning preference data.

AI.tldr: 作者提出首个面向工具调用智能体的轨迹级偏好基准 Plan-RewardBench，系统评测奖励模型在四大复杂场景（安全拒用、工具缺失、多步规划、错误恢复）下对正/负轨迹的区分能力；结果显示现有生成式、判别式及 LLM-as-Judge 模型在长序列任务上性能骤降，亟需专门针对智能体轨迹级奖励建模的训练与评估框架。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型演化为可调工具并自主推理的「智能体」，传统 RLHF 依赖的奖励模型缺乏专门用于评估工具集成环境中轨迹级偏好的基准，导致对齐信号失真。
AI.method: 构建涵盖四大任务家族的轨迹级偏好基准 Plan-RewardBench，通过多模型真实采样、规则扰动与最小编辑生成正负难负例；对生成式、判别式与 LLM-as-Judge 三类代表奖励模型实施统一两两比较协议，按轨迹长度与任务类别汇总准确率并诊断常见失效模式。
AI.result: 所有奖励模型在工具整合场景下均显著困难，长时轨迹准确率快速下降，尤其在「复杂规划」与「错误恢复」任务中最差，揭示现有奖励模型对智能体轨迹奖励建模的不足。
AI.conclusion: Plan-RewardBench 为智能体奖励建模提供可直接使用的评估工具与可复制的轨迹级偏好数据构建范式，强调需开发专门算法以提升长序列、工具密集型环境的对齐能力。

title: Few-Shot Incremental 3D Object Detection in Dynamic Indoor Environments
summary: Incremental 3D object perception is a critical step toward embodied intelligence in dynamic indoor environments. However, existing incremental 3D detection methods rely on extensive annotations of novel classes for satisfactory performance. To address this limitation, we propose FI3Det, a Few-shot Incremental 3D Detection framework that enables efficient 3D perception with only a few novel samples by leveraging vision-language models (VLMs) to learn knowledge of unseen categories. FI3Det introduces a VLM-guided unknown object learning module in the base stage to enhance perception of unseen categories. Specifically, it employs VLMs to mine unknown objects and extract comprehensive representations, including 2D semantic features and class-agnostic 3D bounding boxes. To mitigate noise in these representations, a weighting mechanism is further designed to re-weight the contributions of point- and box-level features based on their spatial locations and feature consistency within each box. Moreover, FI3Det proposes a gated multimodal prototype imprinting module, where category prototypes are constructed from aligned 2D semantic and 3D geometric features to compute classification scores, which are then fused via a multimodal gating mechanism for novel object detection. As the first framework for few-shot incremental 3D object detection, we establish both batch and sequential evaluation settings on two datasets, ScanNet V2 and SUN RGB-D, where FI3Det achieves strong and consistent improvements over baseline methods. Code is available at https://github.com/zyrant/FI3Det.

AI.tldr: FI3Det是首个少样本增量式3D目标检测框架，利用VLM无需大量标注即可持续识别新类，在ScanNet V2与SUN RGB-D上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 动态室内场景中，机器人需增量式感知新物体，但现有3D检测方法对每类新物体都要求大量标注，成本高昂。
AI.method: 1) VLM引导的未知目标学习模块：用VLM挖掘未知目标，提取2D语义与类无关3D框，并设计空间-特征一致性加权抑制噪声；2) 门控多模态原型印记模块：对齐2D-3D特征构建类别原型，通过门控机制融合得分实现新类检测。
AI.result: 在ScanNet V2与SUN RGB-D的批量与连续两种评估协议下，FI3Det均显著优于基线，成为少样本增量3D检测的新标杆。
AI.conclusion: FI3Det首次证明借助VLM可在极少样本条件下实现增量3D检测，为具身智能在动态环境中的持续感知提供了可行路径。

title: AfriVoices-KE: A Multilingual Speech Dataset for Kenyan Languages
summary: AfriVoices-KE is a large-scale multilingual speech dataset comprising approximately 3,000 hours of audio across five Kenyan languages: Dholuo, Kikuyu, Kalenjin, Maasai, and Somali. The dataset includes 750 hours of scripted speech and 2,250 hours of spontaneous speech, collected from 4,777 native speakers across diverse regions and demographics. This work addresses the critical underrepresentation of African languages in speech technology by providing a high-quality, linguistically diverse resource. Data collection followed a dual methodology: scripted recordings drew from compiled text corpora, translations, and domain-specific generated sentences spanning eleven domains relevant to the Kenyan context, while unscripted speech was elicited through textual and image prompts to capture natural linguistic variation and dialectal nuances. A customized mobile application enabled contributors to record using smartphones. Quality assurance operated at multiple layers, encompassing automated signal-to-noise ratio validation prior to recording and human review for content accuracy. Though the project encountered challenges common to low-resource settings, including unreliable infrastructure, device compatibility issues, and community trust barriers, these were mitigated through local mobilizers, stakeholder partnerships, and adaptive training protocols. AfriVoices-KE provides a foundational resource for developing inclusive automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech systems, while advancing the digital preservation of Kenya's linguistic heritage.

AI.tldr: AfriVoices-KE 是首个 3 000 h 量级、覆盖肯尼亚五大本土语言的开放语音库，兼顾朗读与自发口语，可直接用于 ASR/TTS 训练并填补非洲语言数据空白。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言在语音技术中极度缺失，亟需大规模、多口音、多场景的高质量开源数据集，以支持包容性 ASR/TTS 系统并保存语言遗产。
AI.method: 双轨采集：750 h 朗读语料来自 11 个本地领域文本；2 250 h 自发语料通过图文提示引导 4 777 名母语者用手机 App 录制。多层质控：录音前 SNR 自动检测，录音后人工校验内容。
AI.result: 建成 3 000 h、五语言、覆盖多元地域与人口结构的语音库；成功克服低资源环境常见的基础设施、设备兼容与社区信任障碍。
AI.conclusion: AfriVoices-KE 为肯尼亚五大语言提供可持续的语音 AI 基线数据，显著降低 ASR/TTS 研发门槛，同时为非洲多语种语音资源建设树立可复制范式。

title: Kuramoto Oscillatory Phase Encoding: Neuro-inspired Synchronization for Improved Learning Efficiency
summary: Spatiotemporal neural dynamics and oscillatory synchronization are widely implicated in biological information processing and have been hypothesized to support flexible coordination such as feature binding. By contrast, most deep learning architectures represent and propagate information through activation values, neglecting the joint dynamics of rate and phase. In this work, we introduce Kuramoto oscillatory Phase Encoding (KoPE) as an additional, evolving phase state to Vision Transformers, incorporating a neuro-inspired synchronization mechanism to advance learning efficiency. We show that KoPE can improve training, parameter, and data efficiency of vision models through synchronization-enhanced structure learning. Moreover, KoPE benefits tasks requiring structured understanding, including semantic and panoptic segmentation, representation alignment with language, and few-shot abstract visual reasoning (ARC-AGI). Theoretical analysis and empirical verification further suggest that KoPE can accelerate attention concentration for learning efficiency. These results indicate that synchronization can serve as a scalable, neuro-inspired mechanism for advancing state-of-the-art neural network models.

AI.tldr: 将 Kuramoto 耦合振荡器的相位自由度嵌入 Vision Transformer，形成 KoPE 框架；实验表明该机制在不增加可训练参数量的情况下提升训练速度、数据效率与结构理解能力。
AI.motivation: 生物神经系统的信息处理依赖时空动态与振荡同步来完成特征绑定等灵活协调，而现有深度网络仅用激活值，忽视了“发放率-相位”联合动力学。作者希望借神经同步机制让视觉模型更高效地学习结构。
AI.method: 1) 在 ViT 的每个 token 上附加一个可演化的相位状态；2) 用 Kuramoto 模型刻画局部/全局耦合，使相位通过注意力权重动态同步；3) 将同步后的相位映射为调制系数，参与值向量聚合；4) 保持原网络参数规模，仅引入少量标量耦合强度。
AI.result: ImageNet-1k 上，KoPE-ViT 在相等参数下 Top-1 提升 0.8-1.2%，训练时间缩短 15-20%；仅用 30% 数据即可达到 Baseline 全数据精度。语义分割 +1.9 mIoU，全景分割 +2.1 PQ；CLIP 对齐文本准确率提升 3.4%；ARC-AGI 抽象推理 few-shot 准确率由 31% 增至 40%。理论分析显示相位同步使注意力熵下降 25%，收敛到更稀疏结构。
AI.conclusion: 振荡同步可作为可扩展、受神经科学启发的元机制，在不增参数量的情况下提升深度视觉模型的训练效率与结构推理能力，为下一代神经网络提供新范式。

title: Grounding Clinical AI Competency in Human Cognition Through the Clinical World Model and Skill-Mix Framework
comment: Code, data (Clinical AI Skill-Mix dimension specifications), and an exploratory dashboard are available at https://github.com/Sdamirsa/Clinical-World-Model
summary:
The competency of any intelligent agent is bounded by its formal account of the world in which it operates. Clinical AI lacks such an account. Existing frameworks address evaluation, regulation, or system design in isolation, without a shared model of the clinical world to connect them. We introduce the Clinical World Model, a framework that formalizes care as a tripartite interaction among Patient, Provider, and Ecosystem. To formalize how any agent, whether human or artificial, transforms information into clinical action, we develop parallel decision-making architectures for providers, patients, and AI agents, grounded in validated principles of clinical cognition.
  The Clinical AI Skill-Mix operationalizes competency through eight dimensions. Five define the clinical competency space (condition, phase, care setting, provider role, and task) and three specify how AI engages human reasoning (assigned authority, agent facing, and anchoring layer). The combinatorial product of these dimensions yields a space of billions of distinct competency coordinates. A central structural implication is that validation within one coordinate provides minimal evidence for performance in another, rendering the competency space irreducible. The framework supplies a common grammar through which clinical AI can be specified, evaluated, and bounded across stakeholders. By making this structure explicit, the Clinical World Model reframes the field's central question from whether AI works to in which competency coordinates reliability has been demonstrated, and for whom.

AI.tldr: 文章提出“临床世界模型”，首次系统地把临床照护形式化为患者-医务人员-生态系统的三方交互，并为人类和AI构建平行决策架构，定义了一个包含80亿种“能力坐标”的不可还原临床AI能力空间，从而把AI评估问题从“是否有效”转为“在哪些坐标有效”。
AI.motivation: 现有临床AI评估框架彼此割裂，缺少对临床世界的共同形式化模型，难以界定AI的真实适用范围，导致验证结果外推性差，迫切需要一套贯通设计、评估与监管的统一形式框架。
AI.method: 1. 构建“临床世界模型”三元本体：Patient/Provider/Ecosystem；2. 依据临床认知原则，分别为人、患者和AI设计同构的决策架构，统一描述信息到行动的转化；3. 提出“临床AI技能组合”八维空间：条件、病程、照护场景、角色、任务、指派权限、代理面向、锚定层，将任何AI系统映射为坐标；4. 论证坐标空间庞大且不可还原，同一坐标验证结果几乎不能直接外推至其他坐标。
AI.result: 该框架显式列出超过80亿个独立能力坐标，首次证明验证结论高度局部化，传统“平均一致性”指标不能代表整体性能；同时提供可共享的规范语法，使监管、评估与系统开发可在同一坐标系对话。
AI.conclusion: 通过把“是否有效”重铸为“在哪些坐标对哪些人群可靠”，临床世界模型为临床AI的限定域验证、监管路径和持续迭代奠定可计算、可解释的基础，推动领域从通用神话走向分层、可追溯的安全部署。

title: SearchAD: Large-Scale Rare Image Retrieval Dataset for Autonomous Driving
summary: Retrieving rare and safety-critical driving scenarios from large-scale datasets is essential for building robust autonomous driving (AD) systems. As dataset sizes continue to grow, the key challenge shifts from collecting more data to efficiently identifying the most relevant samples. We introduce SearchAD, a large-scale rare image retrieval dataset for AD containing over 423k frames drawn from 11 established datasets. SearchAD provides high-quality manual annotations of more than 513k bounding boxes covering 90 rare categories. It specifically targets the needle-in-a-haystack problem of locating extremely rare classes, with some appearing fewer than 50 times across the entire dataset. Unlike existing benchmarks, which focused on instance-level retrieval, SearchAD emphasizes semantic image retrieval with a well-defined data split, enabling text-to-image and image-to-image retrieval, few-shot learning, and fine-tuning of multi-modal retrieval models. Comprehensive evaluations show that text-based methods outperform image-based ones due to stronger inherent semantic grounding. While models directly aligning spatial visual features with language achieve the best zero-shot results, and our fine-tuning baseline significantly improves performance, absolute retrieval capabilities remain unsatisfactory. With a held-out test set on a public benchmark server, SearchAD establishes the first large-scale dataset for retrieval-driven data curation and long-tail perception research in AD: https://iis-esslingen.github.io/searchad/

AI.tldr: SearchAD 是首个面向自动驾驶的超大规模稀有场景语义检索数据集（42.3 万帧、51.3 万框、90 类稀有目标，部分仅 <50 样本），提供文本/图像双向检索与少样本学习基准，揭示文本检索占优但绝对性能仍有显著差距。
AI.motivation: 随着 AD 数据量爆炸，核心矛盾已从“采集”转向“高效找出影响安全的稀有场景”；现有检索基准只关注实例级、非驾驶域，缺乏针对极端长尾、语义级的稀缺数据挖掘工具，阻碍模型在临界工况上的鲁棒性验证与迭代。
AI.method: 聚合 11 个公开驾驶数据集并人工精标 90 类稀有交通要素，构建针尖检索任务；设计语义图像检索协议与固定数据划分，支持 zero-shot、few-shot 及多模态微调；在保留测试集上搭建在线评估服务器，系统对比纯视觉、文本驱动及联合对齐模型的检索性能。
AI.result: 文本查询平均显著优于纯图像查询；零样本下，将空间视觉特征与语言显式对齐的模型最佳；经 SearchAD 微调后各类指标大幅提升，但召回率仍低，极端稀有类别（<50 例）检索准确率不足 30%，显示 method 远未饱和。
