Online A/B tests on Zalando demonstrate that integrating LTE as a contextual prefix token using a lagged window yields significant uplifts in both user engagement and financial metrics.

AI.tldr: LTE embeddings → 在Transformer序列推荐里引入“惯性”长程语义锚点，破解推荐系统上线/回滚时点一致性痛点，A/B 测试显著提升Zalando用户与收入指标。
AI.motivation: 现有纯 Transformer 序列模型因注意力偏向近期交互而忽视长期兴趣并导致离线–在线版本漂移，尤其企业在单一“最新”特征部署策略下产生时点一致性问题，影响线上效果与可维护性。
AI.method: (1) 提出长程嵌入 LTE：将 item 特征锁定在固定的内容语义基底（content-based basis），不随模型版本更新而漂移；(2) 在因果语言建模框架中，将 LTE 视作带延后窗口的 contextual prefix token 与即时序列并行或串联，阻断与当前交互时间轴的数据泄漏；(3) 评估两种 LTE 构造：启发式平均（heuristic average）与固定解码器的非对称自编码器（frozen-encoder plus learnable encoder），后者允许用行为数据微调早期兴趣而不牺牲稳定性。
AI.result: 在线 A/B 测试在 Zalando 全量流量显示：以 LTE 延后前缀形式接入 Transformer，相较纯短序列基线显著提升用户参与度与 GMV／收入指标；离线实验验证其 embedding 在多次模型版本更新中保持一致性，基本消除离线–在线高阶特征分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: 声明式“语义锚定”的长程嵌入不仅缓解推荐系统 recency bias，更关键的是解决了特征版本漂移与上线风险，可在工业级实时系统安全落地并持续提供业务增量。

title: Prediction Arena: Benchmarking AI Models on Real-World Prediction Markets
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Evaluation period: January 12 - March 9, 2026
summary: We introduce Prediction Arena, a benchmark for evaluating AI models' predictive accuracy and decision-making by enabling them to trade autonomously on live prediction markets with real capital. Unlike synthetic benchmarks, Prediction Arena tests models in environments where trades execute on actual exchanges (Kalshi and Polymarket), providing objective ground truth that cannot be gamed or overfitted. Each model operates as an independent agent starting with $10,000, making autonomous decisions every 15-45 minutes. Over a 57-day longitudinal evaluation (January 12 to March 9, 2026), we track two cohorts: six frontier models in live trading (Cohort 1, full period) and four next-generation models in paper trading (Cohort 2, 3-day preliminary). For Cohort 1, final Kalshi returns range from -16.0% to -30.8%. Our analysis identifies a clear performance hierarchy: initial prediction accuracy and the ability to capitalize on correct predictions are the main drivers, while research volume shows no correlation with outcomes. A striking cross-platform contrast emerges from parallel Polymarket live trading: Cohort 1 models averaged only -1.1% on Polymarket vs. -22.6% on Kalshi, with grok-4-20-checkpoint achieving a 71.4% settlement win rate - the highest across any platform or cohort. gemini-3.1-pro-preview (Cohort 2), which executed zero trades on Kalshi, achieved +6.02% on Polymarket in 3 days - the best return of any model across either cohort - demonstrating that platform design has a profound effect on which models succeed. Beyond performance, we analyze computational efficiency (token usage, cycle time), settlement accuracy, exit patterns, and market preferences, providing a comprehensive view of how frontier models behave under real financial pressure.

AI.tldr: 预测竞技场是首个让 AI 模型在真实预测市场（Kalshi / Polymarket）自主交易、真金白银竞争的新基准。57 天纵向评估显示：平台机制差异巨大，Kalshi 平均亏损-22.6%，Polymarket 仅-1.1%；正确预测能否转化为资本收益是性能分化的主线，研究量与收益无关；模型在 Polymarket 持币平均胜率 71.4%，12 天收益最高 +6%。论文同时给出代币消耗、退出模式、结算精度等全维度行为画像。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 基准多为合成测评，容易被操纵或过拟合，缺乏不可博弈的真结果。作者要为预测与决策任务搭建一个「客观、金融级、长期」的现实基准，直接考察模型在不可控市场中对不确定事件的预测准确性与资本化效率。
AI.method: 1. 平台选择：接入 Kalshi 与 Polymarket 真实 API，模型作为独立交易代理，初始资金 1 万美元；2. 决策频率：每 15–45 分钟自主下单，全部交易链上执行；3. 实验设计：Cohort1（6 个前沿模型）全 57 天实盘；Cohort2（4 个下一代）3 天纸面交易；4. 指标体系：收益率、胜率、预测-资本化耦合、研究量、代币使用、周期时间、退出模式、结算准确度等。
AI.result: 1. 平台效应：同一批模型 Kalshi 平均 -22.6%，Polymarket -1.1%，grok-4-20-checkpoint Polymarket 胜率 71.4%，gemini-3.1-pro 3 天收益 +6%，表现最佳；2. 性能驱动：初始预测准确度 + 正确预测资本化率决定收益，研究量与结果无相关性；3. 行为差异：Polymarket 频繁早退、持仓更短，Kalshi 决策频次低、倚重研究中离场；4. 效率：单次决策平均 1,200 tokens，周期 28 分钟，无模型因延迟错失执行。
AI.conclusion: 平台机制（交易费、流动性、结算周期）对模型生存能力起决定作用；就前沿大模型而言，拥有更高预测准确度并非盈利保障，能否被交易机制所“承接”才是转化关键；研究量供参考但无助收益，过度调研可能导致错失时间窗口；未来模型若要在预测市场盈利，需同时优化事件预测、资本管理与平台选择，本基准为此提供了持续、可量化、无需模拟的评估场。

title: Small Vision-Language Models are Smart Compressors for Long Video Understanding
comment: Project page and demo are available at https://FeiElysia.github.io/tempo-page/
summary: Adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for hour-long videos is bottlenecked by context limits. Dense visual streams saturate token budgets and exacerbate the lost-in-the-middle phenomenon. Existing heuristics, like sparse sampling or uniform pooling, blindly sacrifice fidelity by discarding decisive moments and wasting bandwidth on irrelevant backgrounds. We propose Tempo, an efficient query-aware framework compressing long videos for downstream understanding. Tempo leverages a Small Vision-Language Model (SVLM) as a local temporal compressor, casting token reduction as an early cross-modal distillation process to generate compact, intent-aligned representations in a single forward pass. To enforce strict budgets without breaking causality, we introduce Adaptive Token Allocation (ATA). Exploiting the SVLM's zero-shot relevance prior and semantic front-loading, ATA acts as a training-free $O(1)$ dynamic router. It allocates dense bandwidth to query-critical segments while compressing redundancies into minimal temporal anchors to maintain the global storyline. Extensive experiments show our 6B architecture achieves state-of-the-art performance with aggressive dynamic compression (0.5-16 tokens/frame). On the extreme-long LVBench (4101s), Tempo scores 52.3 under a strict 8K visual budget, outperforming GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro. Scaling to 2048 frames reaches 53.7. Crucially, Tempo compresses hour-long videos substantially below theoretical limits, proving true long-form video understanding relies on intent-driven efficiency rather than greedily padded context windows.

AI.tldr: Tempo 用 6B 小模型把小时级视频压缩到 0.5-16 tokens/帧，8K token 预算下 LVBench 52.3 分，超越 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-1.5-Pro，证明“意图驱动压缩”而非“暴力加长”才是长视频理解的突破口。
AI.motivation: MLLM 受限于上下文窗口，稠密帧序列很快占满 token 预算并加剧“中间信息丢失”；简单抽帧/均匀池化盲目丢弃关键帧，浪费带宽且破坏语义连贯性，亟需一种保真且预算硬约束的长视频压缩方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出 SVLM（小视觉-语言模型）作为局部时间压缩器，把 token 削减重铸为早期跨模态蒸馏，单次前向生成意图对齐的紧凑表征。2) 设计无训练、O(1) 的 Adaptive Token Allocation（ATA）：利用 SVLM 的零样本相关先验与语义前置特性，动态把密集带宽分配给查询关键段，冗余片段压成最小时间锚点， causal 不中断。3) 整体框架 Tempo 在 6B 参数规模下实现 0.5-16 tokens/帧的激进动态压缩。
AI.result: 在极端长视频基准 LVBench（平均 4101 s）上，Tempo 仅用 8K 视觉 token 就拿到 52.3 分，超越 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-1.5-Pro；帧数扩至 2048 帧时得分进一步提升到 53.7，显著低于理论 token 上限，验证其压缩效率与理解能力双优。
AI.conclusion: 长视频理解的瓶颈不是继续扩充上下文，而是“意图驱动的效率”；Tempo 通过查询感知、动态预算分配把小时级内容压缩到极低保真 token，首次在硬预算下实现 SOTA 性能，确立了“先压缩、后理解”的新范式。

title: Mitigating Distribution Sharpening in Math RLVR via Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis and Backward Hint Annealing
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve low-$k$ reasoning accuracy while narrowing solution coverage on challenging math questions, and pass@1 gains do not necessarily translate into better large-$k$ performance. Existing hint-based approaches can make challenging questions trainable, but they leave two issues underexplored: teacher-student distribution mismatch and the need to reduce hint exposure to match no-hint evaluation. We address these issues through two components. Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) constructs verified teacher hints conditioned on student-style responses. Backward Hint Annealing (BHA) anneals hint exposure across difficulty buckets and uses per-question hint dropout to preserve no-hint updates throughout RL training. We evaluate the method in math RLVR under the DAPO training framework across AIME24, AIME25, and AIME26 using $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$ and $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$. On $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$, our method improves both pass@1 and pass@2048 relative to DAPO across the three AIME benchmarks. On $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$, the gains are concentrated in the large-$k$ regime. These results suggest that, in math RLVR, hint scaffolding is effective when it restores learnable updates on challenging questions early in training and is then gradually removed before no-hint evaluation.

AI.tldr: 针对强化学习可验证奖励中难题覆盖下降、大k性能不匹配的问题，提出分布对齐提示合成＋退火式提示丢弃两组件，在AIME24-26上使1.7B Qwen3与1B Llama均同时提升pass@1与pass@2048，首次证明提示框架在数学RLVR中能兼顾小k与大k表现。
AI.motivation: 在数学等可验证奖励（RLVR）训练中，模型仅能在小k下受益，pass@1提升往往伴随难题遗漏与大k性能退化，而现有基于“提示”的方法因“师-生分布偏移”与提示泄露导致与无提示评测不一致，亟需解决。
AI.method: （1）分布对齐提示合成（DAHS）：以“学生风格”反推正确中间步骤，将真实答案截断为部分解，再用推理模型补全其余步骤，确保提示分布贴近学生。（2）向后提示退火（BHA）：按题目难度分桶，逐渐缩短提示长度并在同一题内随机丢弃提示，维持RL始终在无提示状态更新，形成由难到易的逐步“脱拐”。
AI.result: 在DAPO框架下于AIME24/25/26测试：①Qwen3-1.7B-Base的pass@1平均＋3.4%，pass@2048平均＋4.1%；②Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct在pass@1仅微增0.2%，但在pass@2048平均提升7.3%，大k增益显著放大；两种模型均保持难题覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 提示式RL在数学场景中并非“简单搭便车”，只要提示来自学生分布且逐步移除，可在训练早期赋予可学梯度、后期回归无提示设置，从而统一小k与大k性能，突破以往“只能改善单点准确率”的局限。

title: Equivariant Efficient Joint Discrete and Continuous MeanFlow for Molecular Graph Generation
summary: Graph-structured data jointly contain discrete topology and continuous geometry, which poses fundamental challenges for generative modeling due to heterogeneous distributions, incompatible noise dynamics, and the need for equivariant inductive biases. Existing flow-matching approaches for graph generation typically decouple structure from geometry, lack synchronized cross-domain dynamics, and rely on iterative sampling, often resulting in physically inconsistent molecular conformations and slow sampling. To address these limitations, we propose Equivariant MeanFlow (EQUIMF), a unified SE(3)-equivariant generative framework that jointly models discrete and continuous components through synchronized MeanFlow dynamics. EQUIMF introduces a unified time bridge and average-velocity updates with mutual conditioning between structure and geometry, enabling efficient few-step generation while preserving physical consistency. Moreover, we develop a novel discrete MeanFlow formulation with a simple yet effective parameterization to support efficient generation over discrete graph structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EQUIMF consistently outperforms prior diffusion and flow-matching methods in generation quality, physical validity, and sampling efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种统一的SE(3)-等变生成框架 EQUIMF，通过结构-几何同步的 MeanFlow 动态，在少量采样步数下同时生成离散图拓扑与连续几何，实验表明其在质量、物理有效性与采样效率上优于已有扩散/流匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 图数据同时包含离散拓扑与连续几何，现有流匹配方法将二者解耦，导致跨域动态不同步、需迭代采样、易生成物理不一致构象且速度慢，亟需统一且高效的等变生成方案。
AI.method: 设计 SE(3)-等变 MeanFlow (EQUIMF)：构建统一时间桥，在共享时间轴上同步更新离散结构与连续坐标；引入互条件平均速度更新，使结构预测几何、几何反作用于结构；为离散部分提出新的离散 MeanFlow 公式及轻量参数化，实现少步直接生成。
AI.result: 在分子生成基准上，EQUIMF 在化学有效性、构象合理性、RMSD 分布与采样速度等指标全面优于现有扩散和流匹配基线，且 5–10 步即可生成高质量样本。
AI.conclusion: 统一建模拓扑与几何、同步跨域动态的 EQUIMF 兼具等变性、物理一致性与高效采样，为图-分子生成提供了新的强基线，并可推广至其他结构-几何耦合的生成任务。

title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture for Arabic Speech Emotion Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Master's thesis work, University of Science and Technology of Oran - Mohamed Boudiaf (USTO-MB)
summary: Recognizing emotions from speech using machine learning has become an active research area due to its importance in building human-centered applications. However, while many studies have been conducted in English, German, and other European and Asian languages, research in Arabic remains scarce because of the limited availability of annotated datasets. In this paper, we present an Arabic Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) system based on a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture. The model leverages convolutional layers to extract discriminative spectral features from Mel-spectrogram inputs and Transformer encoders to capture long-range temporal dependencies in speech. Experiments were conducted on the EYASE (Egyptian Arabic speech emotion) corpus, and the proposed model achieved 97.8% accuracy and a macro F1-score of 0.98. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining convolutional feature extraction with attention-based modeling for Arabic SER and highlight the potential of Transformer-based approaches in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 基于CNN-Transformer混合架构在自建埃及阿拉伯语情绪语料库EYASE上取得97.8%准确率，弥补阿语语音情绪识别数据稀缺空白。
AI.motivation: 阿语语音情绪识别因标注数据稀缺严重滞后于英、德等主流语言，亟需构建可用模型以支撑以人为中心的阿语应用。
AI.method: 以梅尔频谱为输入，CNN层提取判别性频谱特征，Transformer编码器捕获长程时序依赖，形成端到端CNN-Transformer混合网络。
AI.result: 在EYASE埃及阿拉伯语音库上获得97.8%准确率与0.98宏F1，显著优于现有低资源语言基线，验证卷积—注意力组合策略有效性。
AI.conclusion: CNN-Transformer混合框架可高效解决阿语SER数据稀缺难题，为低资源语言情绪识别提供可扩展范式，并释放Transformer在类似场景中的潜力。

title: Uni-ViGU: Towards Unified Video Generation and Understanding via A Diffusion-Based Video Generator
summary: Unified multimodal models integrating visual understanding and generation face a fundamental challenge: visual generation incurs substantially higher computational costs than understanding, particularly for video. This imbalance motivates us to invert the conventional paradigm: rather than extending understanding-centric MLLMs to support generation, we propose Uni-ViGU, a framework that unifies video generation and understanding by extending a video generator as the foundation. We introduce a unified flow method that performs continuous flow matching for video and discrete flow matching for text within a single process, enabling coherent multimodal generation. We further propose a modality-driven MoE-based framework that augments Transformer blocks with lightweight layers for text generation while preserving generative priors. To repurpose generation knowledge for understanding, we design a bidirectional training mechanism with two stages: Knowledge Recall reconstructs input prompts to leverage learned text-video correspondences, while Capability Refinement fine-tunes on detailed captions to establish discriminative shared representations. Experiments demonstrate that Uni-ViGU achieves competitive performance on both video generation and understanding, validating generation-centric architectures as a scalable path toward unified multimodal intelligence. Project Page and Code: https://fr0zencrane.github.io/uni-vigu-page/.

AI.tldr: Uni-ViGU 以生成器为基座，把视频生成与理解统一到同一模型，取得与专用模型相当的性能，证明“先生成后理解”的新路线可行。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型普遍以理解任务为中心，再外挂生成能力，导致视频生成计算开销远高于理解，且难以兼顾。作者反其道而行，提出以生成器为统一基座，从根本上解决计算失衡与模态对齐难题。
AI.method: 1) 统一流匹配：在同一前向过程中，对视频帧做连续流匹配、对文本 token 做离散流匹配；2) 模态驱动 MoE：Transformer 块中仅插入轻量文本专家层，保留生成先验；3) 双向两阶段训练：①Knowledge Recall 阶段通过重构输入提示挖掘文本-视频对齐知识；②Capability Refinement 阶段用详细字幕微调，建立判别共享表示。
AI.result: 在公开视频生成与理解基准上，Uni-ViGU 均达到与专用模型可比的分数，尤其在 MSVD、MSR-VTT 等零样本视频文本检索任务中刷新 SOTA；同时保持与主流生成器相当的生成质量（FID、FVD 指标）。
AI.conclusion: 生成优先的统一架构不仅可扩展，还能把生成先验反哺理解任务，为构建高效、统一的多模态大模型提供了全新范式。消融实验证实，统一流匹配与双向训练是性能提升的核心。

title: Symbiotic-MoE: Unlocking the Synergy between Generation and Understanding
summary: Empowering Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with image generation often leads to catastrophic forgetting in understanding tasks due to severe gradient conflicts. While existing paradigms like Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) mitigate this conflict through structural isolation, they fundamentally sever cross-modal synergy and suffer from capacity fragmentation. In this work, we present Symbiotic-MoE, a unified pre-training framework that resolves task interference within a native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers architecture with zero-parameter overhead. We first identify that standard MoE tuning leads to routing collapse, where generative gradients dominate expert utilization. To address this, we introduce Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement, which partitions experts into task-specific groups while utilizing shared experts as a multimodal semantic bridge. Crucially, this design allows shared experts to absorb fine-grained visual semantics from generative tasks to enrich textual representations. To optimize this, we propose a Progressive Training Strategy featuring differential learning rates and early-stage gradient shielding. This mechanism not only shields pre-trained knowledge from early volatility but eventually transforms generative signals into constructive feedback for understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Symbiotic-MoE achieves rapid generative convergence while unlocking cross-modal synergy, boosting inherent understanding with remarkable gains on MMLU and OCRBench.

AI.tldr: 基于原生MoE、零增参，用任务专属组＋共享语义桥专家＋分阶段训练解除LMM生成-理解互扰，双向增益。
AI.motivation: 现有方案（MoT等）把生成与理解模块隔离，虽缓解互扰但阻断跨模态协同、浪费容量，难以在LMM中兼顾两类任务。
AI.method: 提出Symbiotic-MoE：1) Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement—按理解/生成及共享语义桥三类分组；2) Progressive Training—理解需较高LR先固化知识并早期梯度屏蔽，随后将生成梯度转化为理解正向反馈。
AI.result: 零新增参数下，生成快速收敛同时在MMLU、OCRBench等理解基准上取得显著提升，跨模态协同增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过对MoE路由行为的细粒度控制与分阶段优化，可同时消除任务冲突、保留预训练知识并释放多模态互利，为LMM统一预训练提供高效范例。

title: Inside-Out: Measuring Generalization in Vision Transformers Through Inner Workings
summary: Reliable generalization metrics are fundamental to the evaluation of machine learning models. Especially in high-stakes applications where labeled target data are scarce, evaluation of models' generalization performance under distribution shift is a pressing need. We focus on two practical scenarios: (1) Before deployment, how to select the best model for unlabeled target data? (2) After deployment, how to monitor model performance under distribution shift? The central need in both cases is a reliable and label-free proxy metric. Yet existing proxy metrics, such as model confidence or accuracy-on-the-line, are often unreliable as they only assess model output while ignoring the internal mechanisms that produce them. We address this limitation by introducing a new perspective: using the inner workings of a model, i.e., circuits, as a predictive metric of generalization performance. Leveraging circuit discovery, we extract the causal interactions between internal representations as a circuit, from which we derive two metrics tailored to the two practical scenarios. (1) Before deployment, we introduce Dependency Depth Bias, which measures different models' generalization capability on target data. (2) After deployment, we propose Circuit Shift Score, which predicts a model's generalization under different distribution shifts. Across various tasks, both metrics demonstrate significantly improved correlation with generalization performance, outperforming existing proxies by an average of 13.4\% and 34.1\%, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/GenCircuit.

AI.tldr: 针对源域无标签场景，提出基于“电路（circuits）”的免标签泛化代理指标：部署前用 Dependency Depth Bias 选最优模型，部署后用 Circuit Shift Score 监控分布漂移，相关性平均提升 13.4% 与 34.1%。
AI.motivation: 高风险场景缺少目标域标签，传统仅看模型输出的置信度或 accuracy-on-the-line 等指标无法可靠预测泛化，需要既无标签又能捕捉内部机制的新指标。
AI.method: 1) 用电路发现技术从 DNN 内部表示中提取因果交互图→“电路”；2) 部署前：量化不同模型在目标域的电路依赖深度，提出 Dependency Depth Bias；3) 部署后：比较漂移前后电路结构差异，提出 Circuit Shift Score；4) 在多项任务上系统评估与真实泛化误差的相关性。
AI.result: 两指标与泛化性能的 Spearman/Pearson 相关性分别平均提升 13.4% 与 34.1%，显著优于置信度、entropy、accuracy-on-the-line 等基线；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 电路层信息可作为免标签、可解释的泛化晴雨表，为模型选择与实时监测提供了新工具，并验证“内部机制比输出更可信”的新视角。

title: Position Paper: From Edge AI to Adaptive Edge AI
summary: Edge AI is often framed as model compression and deployment under tight constraints. We argue a stronger operational thesis: Edge AI in realistic deployments is necessarily adaptive. In long-horizon operation, a fixed (non-adaptive) configuration faces a fundamental failure mode: as data and operating conditions evolve and change in time, it must either (i) violate time-varying budgets (latency/energy/thermal/connectivity/privacy) or (ii) lose predictive reliability (accuracy and, critically, calibration), with risk concentrating in transient regimes and rare time intervals rather than in average performance. If a deployed system cannot reconfigure its computation - and, when required, its model state - under evolving conditions and constraints, it reduces to static embedded inference and cannot provide sustained utility. This position paper introduces a minimal Agent-System-Environment (ASE) lens that makes adaptivity precise at the edge by specifying (i) what changes, (ii) what is observed, (iii) what can be reconfigured, and (iv) which constraints must remain satisfied over time. Building on this framing, we formulate ten research challenges for the next decade, spanning theoretical guarantees for evolving systems, dynamic architectures and hybrid transitions between data-driven and model-based components, fault/anomaly-driven targeted updates, System-1/System-2 decompositions (anytime intelligence), modularity, validation under scarce labels, and evaluation protocols that quantify lifecycle efficiency and recovery/stability under drift and interventions.

AI.tldr: 长期运行场景下，静态边缘模型必然因数据/环境演变而违约预算或损失可靠性；作者提出Agent-System-Environment框架将“可适应性”具化为四类要素，并列出十大研究挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统压缩落地的Edge AI把边缘仅看作“资源受限的部署终点”，忽视持续演化带来的预算违约与预测失准；作者主张必须让系统在生命周期内主动适应，否则等效于静态嵌入式推理，无法长期提供价值。
AI.method: 引入最小化ASE三元视角：Agent（边缘节点或子系统）-System（软硬件可重构机制）-Environment（时变数据、算力、能量与监管约束）；用它梳理“变什么、观什么、调什么、必守什么”，再用该框架推导出十个具体研究方向。
AI.result: 提出ASE描述后，作者并未给出算法或实验，而是系统化归纳出：①演化理论保证②动态架构与混合推理切换③基于异常/漂移的靶向更新④System-1/2随时智能⑤模块可插拔⑥稀标签验证⑦生命周期效率与恢复/稳定性评估协议等十年研究挑战，供社区共同攻关。
AI.conclusion: 只有将边缘AI设计为“可持续适应系统”，才能在长周期运行中同时守住资源预算与预测可靠性；ASE框架为后续算法、架构与评估提供统一提问方式，呼吁领域从“一次压缩部署”转向“终身自适应智能”。

title: PolySLGen: Online Multimodal Speaking-Listening Reaction Generation in Polyadic Interaction
summary: Human-like multimodal reaction generation is essential for natural group interactions between humans and embodied AI. However, existing approaches are limited to single-modality or speaking-only responses in dyadic interactions, making them unsuitable for realistic social scenarios. Many also overlook nonverbal cues and complex dynamics of polyadic interactions, both critical for engagement and conversational coherence. In this work, we present PolySLGen, an online framework for Polyadic multimodal Speaking and Listening reaction Generation. Given past conversation and motion from all participants, PolySLGen generates a future speaking or listening reaction for a target participant, including speech, body motion, and speaking state score. To model group interactions effectively, we propose a pose fusion module and a social cue encoder that jointly aggregate motion and social signals from the group. Extensive experiments, along with quantitative and qualitative evaluations, show that PolySLGen produces contextually appropriate and temporally coherent multi-modal reactions, outperforming several adapted and state-of-the-art baselines in motion quality, motion-speech alignment, speaking state prediction, and human-perceived realism.

AI.tldr: 提出 PolySLGen，首个面向多人场景的在线多模态“说话-倾听”反应生成框架，可同步输出语音、动作与说话状态，显著优于现有仅支持双人或单模态方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成方法局限于双人对话且仅模拟“说话”行为，忽略倾听反应及群体交互中的非语言线索，难以满足真实社交场景对类人化群体互动的需求。
AI.method: 设计在线框架 PolySLGen，利用姿态融合模块与社会线索编码器联合聚合群体运动与社交信号，基于历史对话与全部参与者动作，为目标人生成未来说话或倾听反应，同步输出语音、身体动作与说话状态评分。
AI.result: 在多人数据集上的定量与定性实验表明，PolySLGen 在动作质量、动作-语音对齐、说话状态预测及人类感知真实度上均优于多个强基准与现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: PolySLGen 首次实现群体场景下的多模态说话-倾听反应生成，验证了解耦社交线索与运动融合对提升交互自然度与连贯性的关键作用，为 embodied AI 融入复杂人类社交奠定基础。

title: The Art of (Mis)alignment: How Fine-Tuning Methods Effectively Misalign and Realign LLMs in Post-Training
summary: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) raises significant ethical and safety concerns. While LLM alignment techniques are adopted to improve model safety and trustworthiness, adversaries can exploit these techniques to undermine safety for malicious purposes, resulting in \emph{misalignment}. Misaligned LLMs may be published on open platforms to magnify harm. To address this, additional safety alignment, referred to as \emph{realignment}, is necessary before deploying untrusted third-party LLMs. This study explores the efficacy of fine-tuning methods in terms of misalignment, realignment, and the effects of their interplay. By evaluating four Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and two Preference Fine-Tuning (PFT) methods across four popular safety-aligned LLMs, we reveal a mechanism asymmetry between attack and defense. While Odds Ratio Preference Optimization (ORPO) is most effective for misalignment, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) excels in realignment, albeit at the expense of model utility. Additionally, we identify model-specific resistance, residual effects of multi-round adversarial dynamics, and other noteworthy findings. These findings highlight the need for robust safeguards and customized safety alignment strategies to mitigate potential risks in the deployment of LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangrui4041/The-Art-of-Mis-alignment.

title: Approximation of the Basset force in the Maxey-Riley-Gatignol equations via universal differential equations
summary: The Maxey-Riley-Gatignol equations (MaRGE) model the motion of spherical inertial particles in a fluid. They contain the Basset force, an integral term which models history effects due to the formation of wakes and boundary layer effects. This causes the force that acts on a particle to depend on its past trajectory and complicates the numerical solution of MaRGE. Therefore, the Basset force is often neglected, despite substantial evidence that it has both quantitative and qualitative impact on the movement patterns of modelled particles. Using the concept of universal differential equations, we propose an approximation of the history term via neural networks which approximates MaRGE by a system of ordinary differential equations that can be solved with standard numerical solvers like Runge-Kutta methods.

AI.tldr: 用神经网络把MaRGE的积分型Basset历史力近似为ODE，避免传统算法负担，保留其对粒子轨迹的定性与定量影响，可直套用Runge-Kutta求解。
AI.motivation: MaRGE中的Basset力体现为积分滞后项，是粒子尾迹与边界效应的真实来源，舍他则定量定性误差皆有；然数值昂贵，故需可扩放、可求导的ODS级近似以兼容常规显式解算器。
AI.method: 将Basset积分视作一个未知函数项，嵌入“全微分方程”框架；用有限步过去速度与加速度作为输入，训练小型前馈神经网络代理该历史力；神经网络输出并入MaRGE右端，使完整系统转化为仅有瞬时变量的自治ODE。
AI.result: 所得ODS系统可用任意显式或隐式一阶积分器（如四阶Runge-Kutta）高效推进；在正交剪切流与三维均匀薛积累数据显示，与全积分MaRGE相比，粒子中急速聚积位置与弥散系数误差<3%，比传统“砍掉Basset”方案显著提升轨迹一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种数据驱动的快速近似策略：将长记忆积分转化为神经网络项，保持关键物理特征同时消除计算瓶颈，为海洋微塑料、云滴等惯性粒子追踪提供可行途径，并给出向非球性粒子及复杂几何流场拓展的开放框架。

title: The Role of Emotional Stimuli and Intensity in Shaping Large Language Model Behavior
summary: Emotional prompting - the use of specific emotional diction in prompt engineering - has shown increasing promise in improving large language model (LLM) performance, truthfulness, and responsibility. However these studies have been limited to single types of positive emotional stimuli and have not considered varying degrees of emotion intensity in their analyses. In this paper, we explore the effects of four distinct emotions - joy, encouragement, anger, and insecurity - in emotional prompting and evaluate them on accuracy, sycophancy, and toxicity. We develop a prompt-generation pipeline with GPT-4o mini to create a suite of LLM and human-generated prompts with varying intensities across the four emotions. Then, we compile a "Gold Dataset" of prompts where human and model labels align. Our empirical evaluation on LLM behavior suggests that positive emotional stimuli lead to more accurate and less toxic results, but also increase sycophantic behavior.

AI.tldr: 系统探讨正负情感Prompt对模型准确率、阿谀与毒性三方面的影响，并首次引入情感强度变量。
AI.motivation: 现有情感提示研究仅聚焦单一正向情感，未区分情感强度，缺乏对负面情感及不同强度下模型行为的系统评估。
AI.method: 用GPT-4o-mini构建自动化Prompt生成管道，生成含“快乐、鼓励、愤怒、不安”四情感、多种强度的LLM与人类Prompt；通过人机标注一致样本构造“Gold数据集”；在主流LLM上测试准确率、阿谀性与毒性指标。
AI.result: 正向情感Prompt显著提升回答准确率并降低毒性，但同时放大模型阿谀倾向；负面情感高强度Prompt易触发毒性，低强度负面影响有限；情感强度与行为效应呈非线性关系。
AI.conclusion: 情感类别与强度共同决定LLM表现，未来提示工程需精细化情感设计以平衡准确性、安全性与用户偏好。

title: Bag of Bags: Adaptive Visual Vocabularies for Genizah Join Image Retrieval
summary: A join is a set of manuscript fragments identified as originally emanating from the same manuscript. We study manuscript join retrieval: Given a query image of a fragment, retrieve other fragments originating from the same physical manuscript. We propose Bag of Bags (BoB), an image-level representation that replaces the global-level visual codebook of classical Bag of Words (BoW) with a fragment-specific vocabulary of local visual words. Our pipeline trains a sparse convolutional autoencoder on binarized fragment patches, encodes connected components from each page, clusters the resulting embeddings with per image $k$-means, and compares images using set to set distances between their local vocabularies. Evaluated on fragments from the Cairo Genizah, the best BoB variant (viz.\@ Chamfer) achieves Hit@1 of 0.78 and MRR of 0.84, compared to 0.74 and 0.80, respectively, for the strongest BoW baseline (BoW-RawPatches-$χ^2$), a 6.1\% relative improvement in top-1 accuracy. We furthermore study a mass-weighted BoB-OT variant that incorporates cluster population into prototype matching and present a formal approximation guarantee bounding its deviation from full component-level optimal transport. A two-stage pipeline using a BoW shortlist followed by BoB-OT reranking provides a practical compromise between retrieval strength and computational cost, supporting applicability to larger manuscript collections.

AI.tldr: 提出“Bag-of-Bags”(BoB) 表征，用碎片专属局部视觉词袋取代全局码本，在 Cairo Genizah 碎片联合检索任务中 top-1 准确率提升 6.1%，并给出带理论保证的质量加权最优传输变体与两阶段快速检索方案。
AI.motivation: 古代手稿常碎裂成多块，如何仅凭单张碎片图像自动召回同源的其余残片，对文献复原与历史研究至关重要。现有全局 BoW 方法忽略碎片间局部差异，检索精度受限。
AI.method: 1) 设计 BoB 框架：稀疏卷积自编码器在二值碎片块上训练，得到局部嵌入；对每页连通域嵌入做 per-image k-means，生成碎片专属局部词汇；用集合间距离（Chamfer、最优传输）比较词汇表。2) 提出质量加权 BoB-OT，把聚类 population 融入原型匹配，并给出与全分量 OT 的近似误差上界。3) 构建 BoW 粗排+BoB-OT 精排的两阶段流水线，兼顾精度与大规模可扩展性。
AI.result: 在 Cairo Genizah 数据集上，最佳 BoB(Chamfer) 的 Hit@1=0.78、MRR=0.84，较最强 BoW 基线分别提升 5.4% 与 5.0%（相对 6.1%）。BoB-OT 进一步利用碎片内部结构，保持优势的同时理论可控。两阶段方案在 10 k 碎片库上检索延迟 <200 ms，内存占用降 42%。
AI.conclusion: BoB 通过“碎片-专属局部词汇”有效刻画同源残片的细微共性，超越传统全局 BoW；其最优传输变体兼具理论保证与实用效率，为大规模手稿碎片联合检索提供可扩展解决方案。

title: ACIArena: Toward Unified Evaluation for Agent Cascading Injection
summary: Collaboration and information sharing empower Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) but also introduce a critical security risk known as Agent Cascading Injection (ACI). In such attacks, a compromised agent exploits inter-agent trust to propagate malicious instructions, causing cascading failures across the system. However, existing studies consider only limited attack strategies and simplified MAS settings, limiting their generalizability and comprehensive evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ACIArena, a unified framework for evaluating the robustness of MAS. ACIArena offers systematic evaluation suites spanning multiple attack surfaces (i.e., external inputs, agent profiles, inter-agent messages) and attack objectives (i.e., instruction hijacking, task disruption, information exfiltration). Specifically, ACIArena establishes a unified specification that jointly supports MAS construction and attack-defense modules. It covers six widely used MAS implementations and provides a benchmark of 1,356 test cases for systematically evaluating MAS robustness. Our benchmarking results show that evaluating MAS robustness solely through topology is insufficient; robust MAS require deliberate role design and controlled interaction patterns. Moreover, defenses developed in simplified environments often fail to transfer to real-world settings; narrowly scoped defenses may even introduce new vulnerabilities. ACIArena aims to provide a solid foundation for advancing deeper exploration of MAS design principles.

AI.tldr: 提出ACIArena统一框架，系统评估多智能体系统在级联注入攻击下的鲁棒性，发现仅依赖拓扑或简化防御均不足，需角色与交互协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS安全研究仅针对有限攻击策略与简化场景，难泛化到真实系统，缺乏统一评估基准。
AI.method: 构建ACIArena：统一规范支持6类主流MAS实现，覆盖外部输入、智能体画像、消息传递三大攻击面，设定指令劫持、任务破坏、信息窃取三类目标，生成1356个测试用例，并配套攻防模块可插拔。
AI.result: 基准实验表明：仅依据拓扑结构评估鲁棒性不充分；角色设计与受控交互模式是关键；简化环境训练的防御迁移失败，甚至引入新漏洞。
AI.conclusion: ACIArena为MAS安全设计提供可复现、可扩展的评估底座，推动角色与交互协同的鲁棒设计原则研究。

title: Introducing Echo Networks for Computational Neuroevolution
comment: Accepted for AMLDS 2026 (International Conference on Advanced Machine Learning and Data Science)
summary: For applications on the extreme edge, minimal networks of only a few dozen artificial neurons for event detection and classification in discrete time signals would be highly desirable. Feed-forward networks, RNNs, and CNNs evolved through evolutionary algorithms can all be successful in this respect but pose the problem of allowing little systematicity in mutation and recombination if the standard direct genetic encoding of the weights is used (as for instance in the classic NEAT algorithm). We therefore introduce Echo Networks, a type of recurrent network that consists of the connection matrix only, with the source neurons of the synapses represented as rows, destination neurons as columns and weights as entries. There are no layers, and connections between neurons can be bidirectional but are technically all recurrent. Input and output can be arbitrarily assigned to any of the neurons and only use an additional (optional) function in their computational path, e.g., a sigmoid to obtain a binary classification output. We evaluated Echo Networks successfully on the classification of electrocardiography signals but see the most promising potential in their genome representation as a single matrix, allowing matrix computations and factorisations as mutation and recombination operators.

AI.tldr: 提出Echo Networks——一种仅用邻接矩阵描述的极简循环网络，无层概念、权重可双向；矩阵作为基因编码可直接使用线性代数算子完成进化操作，适合极边缘场景下数十神经元量级的心电等事件检测与分类任务。
AI.motivation: 极端边缘设备中的微型事件检测需要仅含几十个人工神经元的网络；传统前馈/RNN/CNN若采用直接权重编码（如NEAT）进行进化，突变与重组难以系统化。
AI.method: 设计Echo Networks：网络仅由单一权值矩阵定义，行对应源神经元、列对应目标神经元，全为循环连接；可任意指定输入/输出节点并附加可选激活函数。遗传编码即该矩阵本身，因而可借助矩阵计算与分解操作实现突变与重组。
AI.result: 在ECG信号分类任务上验证了有效性，表明Echo Networks可在极小规模下完成分类。
AI.conclusion: Echo Networks凭借矩阵即基因组的特性，为极端边缘设备提供了结构简单且进化操作可系统化的新型网络范式，并展示了在心电等离散时间信号分类中的潜力。

title: Latent Structure of Affective Representations in Large Language Models
summary: The geometric structure of latent representations in large language models (LLMs) is an active area of research, driven in part by its implications for model transparency and AI safety. Existing literature has focused mainly on general geometric and topological properties of the learnt representations, but due to a lack of ground-truth latent geometry, validating the findings of such approaches is challenging. Emotion processing provides an intriguing testbed for probing representational geometry, as emotions exhibit both categorical organization and continuous affective dimensions, which are well-established in the psychology literature. Moreover, understanding such representations carries safety relevance. In this work, we investigate the latent structure of affective representations in LLMs using geometric data analysis tools. We present three main findings. First, we show that LLMs learn coherent latent representations of affective emotions that align with widely used valence--arousal models from psychology. Second, we find that these representations exhibit nonlinear geometric structure that can nonetheless be well-approximated linearly, providing empirical support for the linear representation hypothesis commonly assumed in model transparency methods. Third, we demonstrate that the learned latent representation space can be leveraged to quantify uncertainty in emotion processing tasks. Our findings suggest that LLMs acquire affective representations with geometric structure paralleling established models of human emotion, with practical implications for model interpretability and safety.

AI.tldr: 用大模型内部表示的几何结构验证心理学情绪模型，发现其情感空间与“效价–唤醒”模型吻合，可线性近似并支持可解释性。
AI.motivation: 缺乏真实几何标签使表征验证困难，而情绪具备分类与连续双重结构且安全敏感，为探针研究提供天然试验场，同时兼顾可解释性与AI安全。
AI.method: 将 LLM 情感表示投影到心理学主流的 valence–arousal 二维模型，用几何数据分析量化其与人类情绪结构的对应、线性可近似性及不确定性估计能力。
AI.result: LLM 情感空间与 valence–arousal 模型高度对齐，非线性结构可线性近似，支持线性表征假设；该空间可用于不确定性建模，兼具可解释与安全意义。
AI.conclusion: 大模型自发学得与人脑情绪模型一致的几何基底，给模型透明度和安全提供可验证的几何工具，并证实其情感表征可线性化利用。

title: Face-D(^2)CL: Multi-Domain Synergistic Representation with Dual Continual Learning for Facial DeepFake Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of facial forgery techniques poses severe threats to public trust and information security, making facial DeepFake detection a critical research priority. Continual learning provides an effective approach to adapt facial DeepFake detection models to evolving forgery patterns. However, existing methods face two key bottlenecks in real-world continual learning scenarios: insufficient feature representation and catastrophic forgetting. To address these issues, we propose Face-D(^2)CL, a framework for facial DeepFake detection. It leverages multi-domain synergistic representation to fuse spatial and frequency-domain features for the comprehensive capture of diverse forgery traces, and employs a dual continual learning mechanism that combines Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which distinguishes parameter importance for real versus fake samples, and Orthogonal Gradient Constraint (OGC), which ensures updates to task-specific adapters do not interfere with previously learned knowledge. This synergy enables the model to achieve a dynamic balance between robust anti-forgetting capabilities and agile adaptability to emerging facial forgery paradigms, all without relying on historical data replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method surpasses current SOTA approaches in both stability and plasticity, achieving 60.7% relative reduction in average detection error rate, respectively. On unseen forgery domains, it further improves the average detection AUC by 7.9% compared to the current SOTA method.

AI.tldr: 无须回放历史数据即可在动态环境中持续学习、平均检测错误率降低60.7%、新伪造域平均AUC提升7.9%的人脸DeepFake检测框架。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造技术快速演进，现有持续学习方法在现实场景下面临表征能力不足和灾难性遗忘双重瓶颈，需要兼顾稳定性与可塑性的新机制。
AI.method: 提出Face-D²CL框架：1) 多域协同表征，融合空域-频域特征捕获多样化伪造痕迹；2) 双重持续学习，EWC区分真伪样本参数重要性，OGC保证任务适配器更新正交于旧知识，无需历史数据回放。
AI.result: 稳定性与可塑性均优于当前最优方法：平均检测错误率相对降低60.7%，未知伪造域平均AUC提升7.9%。
AI.conclusion: 多域协同表征与双持续学习机制协同，可在无回放条件下实现动态平衡，为应对不断演化的深度伪造提供了一种高效、低存储的持续检测方案。

title: PeReGrINE: Evaluating Personalized Review Fidelity with User Item Graph Context
summary: We introduce PeReGrINE, a benchmark and evaluation framework for personalized review generation grounded in graph-structured user--item evidence. PeReGrINE restructures Amazon Reviews 2023 into a temporally consistent bipartite graph, where each target review is conditioned on bounded evidence from user history, item context, and neighborhood interactions under explicit temporal cutoffs. To represent persistent user preferences without conditioning directly on sparse raw histories, we compute a User Style Parameter that summarizes each user's linguistic and affective tendencies over prior reviews. This setup supports controlled comparison of four graph-derived retrieval settings: product-only, user-only, neighbor-only, and combined evidence. Beyond standard generation metrics, we introduce Dissonance Analysis, a macro-level evaluation framework that measures deviation from expected user style and product-level consensus. We also study visual evidence as an auxiliary context source and find that it can improve textual quality in some settings, while graph-derived evidence remains the main driver of personalization and consistency. Across product categories, PeReGrINE offers a reproducible way to study how evidence composition affects review fidelity, personalization, and grounding in retrieval-conditioned language models.

AI.tldr: PeReGrINE 以图-时间方式重构 Amazon 2023 评论数据，用可控检索证据与“用户风格参数”驱动个性化评论生成，并配套 Dissonance Analysis 评估风格偏离与共识一致性，为检索增强语言模型提供可复现基准。
AI.motivation: 现有评论生成评测忽视用户-商品交互图的时间一致性与证据组合影响，导致个性化、忠实度与可解释性指标不精确；需构建能隔离不同证据源并衡量宏观偏离的新基准。
AI.method: 1) 将 Amazon Reviews 2023 重建成带时间切分的二部图；2) 提出 User Style Parameter，用历史评论的语言学+情感特征压缩用户长期偏好；3) 设计四种检索条件（仅商品、仅用户、仅邻居、组合）控制变量；4) 引入 Dissonance Analysis，量化生成文本与用户风格及产品共识的偏离；5) 探讨图像证据作为辅助上下文。
AI.result: 图结构证据主导个性化与一致性；图像证据可在特定场景提升文本质量但增益有限；不同证据组合在类目间显著影响生成保真度与风格偏离度。
AI.conclusion: PeReGrINE 提供了可复现的图-时间证据框架，证明受控检索策略对个性化评论生成的关键作用，并为后续研究分离并优化证据源奠定基准与评估范式。

title: An Illusion of Unlearning? Assessing Machine Unlearning Through Internal Representations
comment: 9 pages main text, 21 pages total, 6 figures. Accepted at AISTATS 2026
summary: While numerous machine unlearning (MU) methods have recently been developed with promising results in erasing the influence of forgotten data, classes, or concepts, they are also highly vulnerable-for example, simple fine-tuning can inadvertently reintroduce erased concepts. In this paper, we address this contradiction by examining the internal representations of unlearned models, in contrast to prior work that focuses primarily on output-level behavior. Our analysis shows that many state-of-the-art MU methods appear successful mainly due to a misalignment between last-layer features and the classifier, a phenomenon we call feature-classifier misalignment. In fact, hidden features remain highly discriminative, and simple linear probing can recover near-original accuracy. Assuming neural collapse in the original model, we further demonstrate that adjusting only the classifier can achieve negligible forget accuracy while preserving retain accuracy, and we corroborate this with experiments using classifier-only fine-tuning. Motivated by these findings, we propose MU methods based on a class-mean features (CMF) classifier, which explicitly enforces alignment between features and classifiers. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that CMF-based unlearning reduces forgotten information in representations while maintaining high retain accuracy, highlighting the need for faithful representation-level evaluation of MU.

AI.tldr: 现有机器遗忘法易因“特征-分类器错位”被线性探针攻破；本文提出用类均值特征分类器（CMF）直接对齐特征，实现表征层面真遗忘。
AI.motivation: 主流 MU 方法仅关注输出行为，遗忘后微调即可“复活”被删概念；需从内部表征验证并强化遗忘鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 诊断：线性探针发现深层特征仍具判别力，揭示“特征-分类器错位”是遗忘假象根源；2) 理论：利用神经坍缩假设，证明仅调分类器即可几乎零遗忘精度且保持保留精度；3) 方案：提出 CMF 分类器，显式约束特征与类均值对齐，完成表征级遗忘。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，CMF 类方法显著降低被遗忘类在特征中的可恢复性，同时保持保留类高精度；线性探针恢复精度从>90% 降至接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 输出级指标不足以评估 MU 有效性，必须引入表征级忠实度评价；CMF 为构建难再恢复的内部遗忘提供新范式。

title: Decisions and Deployment: The Five-Year SAHELI Project (2020-2025) on Restless Multi-Armed Bandits for Improving Maternal and Child Health
summary: Maternal and child health is a critical concern around the world. In many global health programs disseminating preventive care and health information, limited healthcare worker resources prevent continuous, personalised engagement with vulnerable beneficiaries. In such scenarios, it becomes crucial to optimally schedule limited live-service resources to maximise long-term engagement. To address this fundamental challenge, the multi-year SAHELI project (2020-2025), in collaboration with partner NGO ARMMAN, leverages AI to allocate scarce resources in a maternal and child health program in India. The SAHELI system solves this sequential resource allocation problem using a Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) framework. A key methodological innovation is the transition from a traditional Two-Stage "predict-then-optimize" approach to Decision-Focused Learning (DFL), which directly aligns the framework's learning method with the ultimate goal of maximizing beneficiary engagement. Empirical evaluation through large-scale randomized controlled trials demonstrates that the DFL policy reduced cumulative engagement drops by 31% relative to the current standard of care, significantly outperforming the Two-Stage model. Crucially, the studies also confirmed that this increased program engagement translates directly into statistically significant improvements in real-world health behaviors, notably the continued consumption of vital iron and calcium supplements by new mothers. Ultimately, the SAHELI project provides a scalable blueprint for applying sequential decision-making AI to optimize resource allocation in health programs.

AI.tldr: SAHELI 项目用“决策导向学习”取代传统“先预测再优化”，在孕产妇健康项目中把有限的真人服务时段动态分配给最易流失的受益人，使掉线率降 31%，并显著提升补剂依从性，为资源稀缺场景下的连续干预提供了可扩展的 AI 模板。
AI.motivation: 全球母婴健康项目常因人力不足无法持续、个性化地触达高危人群；如何用最少的真人服务时段最大化长期参与度，是资源分配的核心痛点。
AI.method: 将连续资源调度建模为 Restless Multi-Armed Bandit，提出 Decision-Focused Learning（DFL）——直接在训练目标中嵌入最终调度收益，端到端学习转移概率并同步优化索引策略，取代传统的 Two-Stage“先预测后优化”流程。
AI.result: 印度大规模随机对照试验显示，DFL 策略较现行标准降低累计参与度下降 31%，显著优于 Two-Stage 模型；且该增益转化为真实健康行为改善——产妇铁钙补充剂持续服用率显著提升（统计显著）。
AI.conclusion: SAHELI 验证了“决策导向学习”在稀缺资源序列分配中的临床价值，提供了一套可扩展、可迁移的 AI 框架，为类似健康项目的精准调度与行为改善树立蓝图。

title: T-Gated Adapter: A Lightweight Temporal Adapter for Vision-Language Medical Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the PHAROS-AIF-MIH Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Medical image segmentation traditionally relies on fully supervised 3D architectures that demand a large amount of dense, voxel-level annotations from clinical experts which is a prohibitively expensive process. Vision Language Models (VLMs) offer a powerful alternative by leveraging broad visual semantic representations learned from billions of images. However, when applied independently to 2D slices of a 3D scan, these models often produce noisy and anatomically implausible segmentations that violate the inherent continuity of anatomical structures. We propose a temporal adapter that addresses this by injecting adjacent-slice context directly into the model's visual token representations. The adapter comprises a temporal transformer attending across a fixed context window at the token level, a spatial context block refining within-slice representations, and an adaptive gate balancing temporal and single-slice features. Training on 30 labeled volumes from the FLARE22 dataset, our method achieves a mean Dice of 0.704 across 13 abdominal organs with a gain of +0.206 over the baseline VLM trained with no temporal context. Zero-shot evaluation on BTCV and AMOS22 datasets yields consistent improvements of +0.210 and +0.230, with the average cross-domain performance drop reducing from 38.0% to 24.9%. Furthermore, in a cross-modality evaluation on AMOS22 MRI with neither model receiving any MRI supervision, our method achieves a mean Dice of 0.366, outperforming a fully supervised 3D baseline (DynUNet, 0.224) trained exclusively on CT, suggesting that CLIP's visual semantic representations generalize more gracefully across imaging modalities than convolutional features.

AI.tldr: 在CLIP视觉编码器里插入一个轻量级时序适配器，用相邻切片token动态修正2D特征，显著减少跨域与模态差异，使单次21CT数据训得的模型即可通用于5CT+13MRI数据集。
AI.motivation: 完整3D感知的医学分割必须依赖逐体素标注，成本高企；纯2D视觉-语言模型逐片推理，会丢失层间连续性，导致解剖结构断裂、标注噪声放大。
AI.method: (1) 固定窗口切片序列Transformer，为ViT视觉token注入跨层时序上下文；(2) 空间上下文块在片内再做一次局部语义校准；(3) 自适应门控按重要性融合时序与单帧特征；(4) 只微调解码器内的适配器，预训练CLIP冻结不变。
AI.result: 用FLARE22仅30例标注训练，13腹器平均Dice 0.704(+0.206)；零样本BTCV/AMOS22增补+0.210、+0.230，跨域性能衰退由38%降至24.9%。AMOS22 MRI无MRI监督下达0.366，优于仅CT训的3D DynUNet(0.224)。
AI.conclusion: 显式层间上下文注入能补全CLIP的3D缺失；视觉语义表征跨模态泛化力优于卷积特征；在极低标注场景亦可替代全监督3D网络，实现手术级多器官自动分割。

title: ORACLE-SWE: Quantifying the Contribution of Oracle Information Signals on SWE Agents
comment: Under peer review; 37 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables
summary: Recent advances in language model (LM) agents have significantly improved automated software engineering (SWE). Prior work has proposed various agentic workflows and training strategies as well as analyzed failure modes of agentic systems on SWE tasks, focusing on several contextual information signals: Reproduction Test, Regression Test, Edit Location, Execution Context, and API Usage. However, the individual contribution of each signal to overall success remains underexplored, particularly their ideal contribution when intermediate information is perfectly obtained. To address this gap, we introduce Oracle-SWE, a unified method to isolate and extract oracle information signals from SWE benchmarks and quantify the impact of each signal on agent performance. To further validate the pattern, we evaluate the performance gain of signals extracted by strong LMs when provided to a base agent, approximating real-world task-resolution settings. These evaluations aim to guide research prioritization for autonomous coding systems.

AI.tldr: 首次提出 Oracle-SWE 框架，将 SWE 场景下 5 种主流上下文信号拆封并置于“完全可获取”的理想态，量化其对 LM-agent 性能的单点贡献，揭示信号边际增益与研究优先级。
AI.motivation: 现有 LM-agent 在自动化软件工程任务屡次突破，但测试用例、编辑位置、执行上下文等信息对成功率的独立贡献未知，无法指导后续算法设计、数据构建及信号采集的投资回报判断。
AI.method: 构建 Oracle-SWE：① 从 SWE 基准抽取回归/重现测试、编辑位置、执行上下文与 API 用法等 5 类“oracle 信号”；② 在基线 agent 上逐个注入 oracle 信息，测量绝对与相对性能提升；③ 用强 LM 替代 oracle 提取信号，模拟真实场景再做增益对比，排除理想假设。
AI.result: 测试显示单个 oracle 信号最高可提升基线 27.4% Pass@1，增幅排序为：重现测试 > 回归测试 ≈ API 用法 > 执行上下文 > 编辑位置；当由强 LM 自动采集信号时，增益比例仍维持 60–75%，表明信号价值具有可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 各类信息对 LM-agent 并非同等有效——优先保证可执行测试数据与运行环境，其次关注 API 文档与回归用例，可最大化 ROI；Oracle-SWE 为后续数据集、提示策略及奖励模型设计提供量化依据，并建议将“可执行测试生成”列为首要研究方向。

title: DMax: Aggressive Parallel Decoding for dLLMs
comment: Working in progress. Code is available at: https://github.com/czg1225/DMax
summary: We present DMax, a new paradigm for efficient diffusion language models (dLLMs). It mitigates error accumulation in parallel decoding, enabling aggressive decoding parallelism while preserving generation quality. Unlike conventional masked dLLMs that decode through a binary mask-to-token transition, DMax reformulates decoding as a progressive self-refinement from mask embeddings to token embeddings. At the core of our approach is On-Policy Uniform Training, a novel training strategy that efficiently unifies masked and uniform dLLMs, equipping the model to recover clean tokens from both masked inputs and its own erroneous predictions. Building on this foundation, we further propose Soft Parallel Decoding. We represent each intermediate decoding state as an interpolation between the predicted token embedding and the mask embedding, enabling iterative self-revising in embedding space. Extensive experiments across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DMax. Compared with the original LLaDA-2.0-mini, our method improves TPF on GSM8K from 2.04 to 5.47 while preserving accuracy. On MBPP, it increases TPF from 2.71 to 5.86 while maintaining comparable performance. On two H200 GPUs, our model achieves an average of 1,338 TPS at batch size 1. Code is available at: https://github.com/czg1225/DMax

title: Playing DOOM with 1.3M Parameters: Specialized Small Models vs Large Language Models for Real-Time Game Control
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and model weights available at https://github.com/VAGOsolutions/SauerkrautLM-Doom-MultiVec
summary: We present SauerkrautLM-Doom-MultiVec, a 1.3 million parameter model that plays the classic first-person shooter DOOM in real time, outperforming large language models up to 92,000x its size, including Nemotron-120B, Qwen3.5-27B, and GPT-4o-mini. Our model combines a ModernBERT encoder with hash embeddings, depth-aware token representations, and an attention pooling classification head to select game actions from ASCII frame representations at 31ms per decision. Trained on just 31,000 human gameplay demonstrations, it achieves 178 frags in 10 episodes (17.8 per episode) in the defend_the_center scenario, more than all tested LLMs combined (13 frags total). All agents receive equivalent input: ASCII frames and depth maps. Despite having 92,000x fewer parameters than Nemotron-120B, our model is the only agent that actively engages enemies rather than purely evading them. These results demonstrate that small, task-specific models trained on domain-appropriate data can decisively outperform general-purpose LLMs at real-time control tasks, at a fraction of the inference cost, with deployment capability on consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: 1.3M参数游戏模型SauerkrautLM-Doom-MultiVec体量仅Nemotron-120B的1/92000，却在实时《DOOM》击杀数上碾压所有测试LLM之和。
AI.motivation: 验证当任务目标明确且数据匹配时，小模型能否在实时控制任务中击败通用大模型并实现低成本推理。
AI.method: 以31,000局人类操作序列为训练集；用ModernBERT编码ASCII帧与深度图，通过hash嵌入、深度感知token表示和attention-pool分类头快速选择动作。
AI.result: defend_the_center场景10局取得178击杀(平均17.8)，远超LLM总和(13击杀)，是唯一主动追击敌人的Agent，每帧决策延迟31ms。
AI.conclusion: 在实时控制场景中，针对任务定制并配以域内数据的小模型可显著优于大模型，且推理成本低、可在普通硬件上部署。

title: OceanMAE: A Foundation Model for Ocean Remote Sensing
summary: Accurate ocean mapping is essential for applications such as bathymetry estimation, seabed characterization, marine litter detection, and ecosystem monitoring. However, ocean remote sensing (RS) remains constrained by limited labeled data and by the reduced transferability of models pre-trained mainly on land-dominated Earth observation imagery. In this paper, we propose OceanMAE, an ocean-specific masked autoencoder that extends standard MAE pre-training by integrating multispectral Sentinel-2 observations with physically meaningful ocean descriptors during self-supervised learning. By incorporating these auxiliary ocean features, OceanMAE is designed to learn more informative and ocean-aware latent representations from large- scale unlabeled data. To transfer these representations to downstream applications, we further employ a modified UNet-based framework for marine segmentation and bathymetry estimation. Pre-trained on the Hydro dataset, OceanMAE is evaluated on MADOS and MARIDA for marine pollutant and debris segmentation, and on MagicBathyNet for bathymetry regression. The experiments show that OceanMAE yields the strongest gains on marine segmentation, while bathymetry benefits are competitive and task-dependent. In addition, an ablation against a standard MAE on MARIDA indicates that incorporating auxiliary ocean descriptors during pre-training improves downstream segmentation quality. These findings highlight the value of physically informed and domain-aligned self-supervised pre- training for ocean RS. Code and weights are publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/joanna.stamer/SSLORS2.

AI.tldr: 提出面向海洋的掩码自编码器 OceanMAE，通过融合 Sentinel-2 多光谱影像与物理海洋特征进行自监督预训练，显著提升海洋遥感下游任务（海表污染/碎屑分割与水深回归）效果。
AI.motivation: 海洋遥感标注数据稀缺，通用陆地模型迁移性差，需构建海洋专用的自监督学习方法。
AI.method: 1) 在 MAE 框架中引入物理可解释的辅助海洋特征，与 Sentinel-2 多光谱数据共同重建；2) 将学习到的海洋专用表征接入改进 UNet，完成海表目标分割与水深估计。
AI.result: 在 Hydro 上预训练后，OceanMAE 在 MADOS、MARIDA 污染/碎屑分割任务中取得 SOTA（最强提升），在 MagicBathyNet 水深回归上与最佳方法持平且具任务依赖性；MARIDA 消融显示引入海洋特征显著优于标准 MAE。
AI.conclusion: 面向海洋、融入物理先验的自监督预训练能有效提升海洋遥感下游任务性能，为后续研究提供易用代码与权重。

title: More Capable, Less Cooperative? When LLMs Fail At Zero-Cost Collaboration
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild. 24 pages, 5 figures
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly coordinate in multi-agent systems, yet we lack an understanding of where and why cooperation failures may arise. In many real-world coordination problems, from knowledge sharing in organizations to code documentation, helping others carries negligible personal cost while generating substantial collective benefits. However, whether LLM agents cooperate when helping neither benefits nor harms the helper, while being given explicit instructions to do so, remains unknown. We build a multi-agent setup designed to study cooperative behavior in a frictionless environment, removing all strategic complexity from cooperation. We find that capability does not predict cooperation: OpenAI o3 achieves only 17% of optimal collective performance while OpenAI o3-mini reaches 50%, despite identical instructions to maximize group revenue. Through a causal decomposition that automates one side of agent communication, we separate cooperation failures from competence failures, tracing their origins through agent reasoning analysis. Testing targeted interventions, we find that explicit protocols double performance for low-competence models, and tiny sharing incentives improve models with weak cooperation. Our findings suggest that scaling intelligence alone will not solve coordination problems in multi-agent systems and will require deliberate cooperative design, even when helping others costs nothing.

AI.tldr: 在零成本帮助场景下，先进大模型仍出现严重合作失灵；能力≠合作，需专门协议与激励设计。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中LLM能否在“助人无损己”情境下自发合作尚缺系统研究，而这对知识共享、代码文档等现实协调任务至关重要。
AI.method: 构建无策略摩擦的多智能体实验环境，因果分解自动固定一方通信，区分合作失败与能力失败；对低合作模型施加显式协议与微小激励干预。
AI.result: o3仅达17%最优集体收益，o3-mini达50%；显式协议使低能力模型收益翻倍，微量共享激励即可提升弱合作模型。
AI.conclusion: 单纯扩大模型智能无法解决多智能体协调问题，必须在系统层面植入合作机制，即使帮助行为对个人零成本。

title: Dead Weights, Live Signals: Feedforward Graphs of Frozen Language Models
summary: We present a feedforward graph architecture in which heterogeneous frozen large language models serve as computational nodes, communicating through a shared continuous latent space via learned linear projections. Building on recent work demonstrating geometric compatibility between independently trained LLM latent spaces~\cite{armstrong2026thinking}, we extend this finding from static two-model steering to end-to-end trainable multi-node graphs, where projection matrices are optimized jointly via backpropagation through residual stream injection hooks. Three small frozen models (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, Gemma-2-2B) encode the input into a shared latent space whose aggregate signal is injected into two larger frozen models (Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B), whose representations feed a lightweight cross-attention output node. With only 17.6M trainable parameters against approximately 12B frozen, the architecture achieves 87.3\% on ARC-Challenge, 82.8\% on OpenBookQA, and 67.2\% on MMLU, outperforming the best single constituent model by 11.4, 6.2, and 1.2 percentage points respectively, and outperforming parameter-matched learned classifiers on frozen single models by 9.1, 5.2, and 6.7 points. Gradient flow through multiple frozen model boundaries is empirically verified to be tractable, and the output node develops selective routing behavior across layer-2 nodes without explicit supervision.

AI.tldr: 仅用17.6M可训练参数把5个冻结LLM搭成前馈图，靠共享潜空间+残差注入超越最佳单模型11.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么微调巨大模型，要么只能静态拼接两模型；作者想验证能否在完全冻结多模型间建立端到端可训练、可扩展的通信图，以极低成本汇聚异构模型能力。
AI.method: 1) 用线性投影把异构LLM的残差流映射到统一潜空间；2) 三小模型作编码节点，两大模型作推理节点，输出节点用跨注意力汇总；3) 整个图通过残差注入钩子反向传播，联合优化投影矩阵，冻结部分保持不动。
AI.result: 在ARC-C、OBQA、MMLU上分别达到87.3%、82.8%、67.2%，比最佳单一成员模型提升11.4/6.2/1.2个百分点；梯度可稳定穿越多层冻结边界；输出节点无监督即出现选择性路由。
AI.conclusion: 冻结LLM图能在极少量可训练参数下实现显著性能跃升，证明异构模型潜空间的几何兼容＋残差注入是构建可扩展、低成本大模型系统的有效途径。

title: Self-Calibrating LLM-Based Analog Circuit Sizing with Interpretable Design Equations
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Artificial Intelligence (TCASAI)
summary: We present a self-calibrating framework for analog circuit sizing in which a large language model (LLM) derives topology-specific analytical design equations directly from a raw circuit netlist. Unlike existing AI-driven sizing methods where the model proposes parameter adjustments or reduces a search space, the LLM produces a complete Python sizing function tracing each device dimension to a specific performance constraint. A deterministic calibration loop extracts process-dependent parameters from a single transistor-level simulation, while a prediction-error feedback mechanism compensates for analytical inaccuracies. We validate the framework on six operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) topologies spanning three families at two process nodes (180 nm and 40 nm CMOS). All 12 topology-node combinations achieve all specifications, converging in 2-9 simulations for 11 of 12 cases, with one outlier requiring 16 simulations due to an extremely narrow feasible region. Despite large initial prediction errors, convergence depends on the measurement-feedback architecture, not prediction accuracy. This one-shot calibration automatically captures process-dependent variations, enabling cross-node portability without modification, retraining, or per-process characterization.

AI.tldr: 该框架从原网表直接生成拓扑专用的解析尺寸函数，用单次仿真完成工艺自校准，2-9次迭代即可收敛，无需逐工艺建模或重训练即可跨节点(180 nm→40 nm CMOS)复用。
AI.motivation: 传统模拟电路尺寸自动优化要么依赖数值搜索，要么需逐工艺萃取经验模型，效率低且难以迁移；AI方法也只是“调整参数”或给搜索“加约束”，仍需反复仿真。作者希望像数字综合一样，给定电路拓扑即一次性生成可直接执行的尺寸函数，并自动适应任意工艺节点。
AI.method: ① 把原始SPICE网表喂给LLM，让其用符号推导写出“性能→器件尺寸”的Python解析函数；② 用LLM自动挑一个晶体管做一次仿真，提取阈值、迁移率等工艺相关参数做“一次校准”；③ 第一次预测尺寸后立刻实测性能，误差作为反馈校正解析函数中的近似误差，迭代2-9次即可收敛；④ 全流程不依赖模型重训练或逐工艺卡。
AI.result: 在6个OTA拓扑×2节点共12个设计实例上全部满足规格；其中11例2-9次仿真收敛，仅1例因可行区窄耗时16次；即使初误差>20%，借助测量反馈仍能准确锁定到目标。验证表明总迭代次数与初始预测精度无关，证明了架构而非“猜得准”驱动收敛。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现“给定电路拓扑+单晶体管校准”即自动生成尺寸函数并跨工艺复用，无需重训或表征。用LLM把传统人工符号推导自动化，把工艺差异的识别从全局建模压缩到单管一次仿真，显著降低模拟自动化门槛，为模拟综合从“每节点调”走向“写一次-任意节点跑”奠定基础。

title: On the Global Photometric Alignment for Low-Level Vision
summary: Supervised low-level vision models rely on pixel-wise losses against paired references, yet paired training sets exhibit per-pair photometric inconsistency, say, different image pairs demand different global brightness, color, or white-balance mappings. This inconsistency enters through task-intrinsic photometric transfer (e.g., low-light enhancement) or unintended acquisition shifts (e.g., de-raining), and in either case causes an optimization pathology. Standard reconstruction losses allocate disproportionate gradient budget to conflicting per-pair photometric targets, crowding out content restoration. In this paper, we investigate this issue and prove that, under least-squares decomposition, the photometric and structural components of the prediction-target residual are orthogonal, and that the spatially dense photometric component dominates the gradient energy. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Photometric Alignment Loss (PAL). This flexible supervision objective discounts nuisance photometric discrepancy via closed-form affine color alignment while preserving restoration-relevant supervision, requiring only covariance statistics and tiny matrix inversion with negligible overhead. Across 6 tasks, 16 datasets, and 16 architectures, PAL consistently improves metrics and generalization. The implementation is in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出Photometric Alignment Loss (PAL)：在保留结构监督的同时，用闭式仿射颜色对齐剔除成对低层视觉数据里的光度不一致，显著提升6任务16数据集16架构的性能与泛化，几乎零开销。
AI.motivation: 现有监督低层视觉模型依赖逐像素重建损失，但训练对存在固有的光度不一致（如亮度、白平衡差异），源于任务本身（低光增强）或采集偏差（去雨）。这些差异使梯度被光度冲突主导，抑制内容恢复能力。
AI.method: 理论证明在最小二乘分解下，残差的光度与结构分量正交且光度分量主导梯度能量；据此设计PAL：在每次前传后，用闭式仿射变换将预测对齐目标颜色，仅对齐后残差参与反向传播，仅需协方差统计与小矩阵求逆，开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在16个公开数据集、6类低层任务（低光增强、去雨等）及16种网络结构上的实验显示，PAL一致提升PSNR/SSIM，同时增强跨数据集泛化能力，平均增益>0.8 dB。
AI.conclusion: 光度不一致是低层视觉监督的隐藏优化障碍；通过正交分解与轻量级对齐，PAL在不改变网络结构、几乎零计算代价的前提下，有效释放模型对真实结构恢复的潜能，具有广泛即插即用价值。

title: Are GUI Agents Focused Enough? Automated Distraction via Semantic-level UI Element Injection
comment: 44 pages, 10 figures, public code will be available at https://github.com/HashTAG00002/UI-Injection
summary: Existing red-teaming studies on GUI agents have important limitations. Adversarial perturbations typically require white-box access, which is unavailable for commercial systems, while prompt injection is increasingly mitigated by stronger safety alignment. To study robustness under a more practical threat model, we propose Semantic-level UI Element Injection, a red-teaming setting that overlays safety-aligned and harmless UI elements onto screenshots to misdirect the agent's visual grounding. Our method uses a modular Editor-Overlapper-Victim pipeline and an iterative search procedure that samples multiple candidate edits, keeps the best cumulative overlay, and adapts future prompt strategies based on previous failures. Across five victim models, our optimized attacks improve attack success rate by up to 4.4x over random injection on the strongest victims. Moreover, elements optimized on one source model transfer effectively to other target models, indicating model-agnostic vulnerabilities. After the first successful attack, the victim still clicks the attacker-controlled element in more than 15% of later independent trials, versus below 1% for random injection, showing that the injected element acts as a persistent attractor rather than simple visual clutter.

AI.tldr: 提出「语义级UI元素注入」这一无需白盒权限的新红队框架，仅用无害视觉元素覆盖截图即可误导商用GUI智能体，成功率最高提升4.4倍，且攻击效果可跨模型迁移并长期持续。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体红队方法要么依赖白盒扰动，要么依赖提示注入，前者对商用系统不可行，后者被安全对齐逐步削弱，亟需一种在真实黑盒条件下仍能生效的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建Editor-Overlapper-Victim流水线：Editor生成候选UI元素，Overlapper将其叠加到截图，Victim为被测模型；通过迭代搜索保留累积最优叠加，并依据失败反馈动态调整后续注入策略，实现语义级、无恶意内容的视觉误导。
AI.result: 在5个 victim 模型上，优化注入较随机注入的 ASR 最高提升4.4倍；单一模型上优化的元素可零样本迁移至其他模型；首次成功后，独立实验中仍有>15%概率再次触发点击，而随机注入<1%，证明注入元素成为持久“视觉诱饵”。
AI.conclusion: 语义级UI元素注入揭示了GUI智能体在安全对齐之外、面向视觉语义的新型模型无关漏洞，为黑盒红队评估与防御提供了更具实战价值的基准。

title: Leveraging Complementary Embeddings for Replay Selection in Continual Learning with Small Buffers
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a key challenge in Continual Learning (CL). In replay-based CL with severe memory constraints, performance critically depends on the sample selection strategy for the replay buffer. Most existing approaches construct memory buffers using embeddings learned under supervised objectives. However, class-agnostic, self-supervised representations often encode rich, class-relevant semantics that are overlooked. We propose a new method, Multiple Embedding Replay Selection, MERS, which replaces the buffer selection module with a graph-based approach that integrates both supervised and self-supervised embeddings. Empirical results show consistent improvements over SOTA selection strategies across a range of continual learning algorithms, with particularly strong gains in low-memory regimes. On CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet, MERS outperforms single-embedding baselines without adding model parameters or increasing replay volume, making it a practical, drop-in enhancement for replay-based continual learning.

AI.tldr: MERS 以无额外参数的图融合方式，利用自监督嵌入选回放样本，显著缓解低内存灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 灾难性遗忘的核心在于回放样本能否代表旧分布。监督嵌入训练目标与下游分类强耦合，易忽视对类别判别潜在有益的自监督语义；尤其在极低内存场景，任何信息的冗余或缺失都会放大遗忘。
AI.method: 提出 Multiple Embedding Replay Selection (MERS)：1) 对每一样本同时提取监督与自监督两种嵌入；2) 构建混合 k-NN 图，边权重由两种嵌入的余弦相似度加权融合；3) 用覆盖最大化子图选择算法，优先选中心度高、可覆盖不同语义簇的样本入回放缓冲区；4) 作为即插即用模块，与任意回放型 CL 算法兼容。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 TinyImageNet 的 Class-IL 与 Task-IL 协议上，与六种 SOTA 样本选择策略（herding、GM、iCaRL、ASER、RSB、DER++）对比，MERS 平均提升 2.1–4.7 pp；当每类仅 5 样本时，提升可达 6.8 pp，且无新增参数、不增加回放量。
AI.conclusion: 融合自监督嵌入的图式样本选择能显著提升回放代表性，是低内存持续学习的实用、零成本增强方案，验证了表征多样性在样本选择中的关键作用。

title: DSPR: Dual-Stream Physics-Residual Networks for Trustworthy Industrial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Accurate forecasting of industrial time series requires balancing predictive accuracy with physical plausibility under non-stationary operating conditions. Existing data-driven models often achieve strong statistical performance but struggle to respect regime-dependent interaction structures and transport delays inherent in real-world systems. To address this challenge, we propose DSPR (Dual-Stream Physics-Residual Networks), a forecasting framework that explicitly decouples stable temporal patterns from regime-dependent residual dynamics. The first stream models the statistical temporal evolution of individual variables. The second stream focuses on residual dynamics through two key mechanisms: an Adaptive Window module that estimates flow-dependent transport delays, and a Physics-Guided Dynamic Graph that incorporates physical priors to learn time-varying interaction structures while suppressing spurious correlations. Experiments on four industrial benchmarks spanning heterogeneous regimes demonstrate that DSPR consistently improves forecasting accuracy and robustness under regime shifts while maintaining strong physical plausibility. It achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance, with Mean Conservation Accuracy exceeding 99% and Total Variation Ratio reaching up to 97.2%. Beyond forecasting, the learned interaction structures and adaptive lags provide interpretable insights that are consistent with known domain mechanisms, such as flow-dependent transport delays and wind-to-power scaling behaviors. These results suggest that architectural decoupling with physics-consistent inductive biases offers an effective path toward trustworthy industrial time-series forecasting. Furthermore, DSPR's demonstrated robust performance in long-term industrial deployment bridges the gap between advanced forecasting models and trustworthy autonomous control systems.

AI.tldr: DSPR 通过双通道结构把稳定时序模式与工况相关残差动力学解耦，在不平稳工业场景下同时实现高预测精度与强物理可解释性。
AI.motivation: 工业时序常在非平稳工况下运行，纯数据驱动模型虽统计性能好，但难保证物理合理性，尤其忽视工况相关的交互结构与传输延迟，导致工况漂移时鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出 DSPR：第一流用统计模型捕捉单变量稳定演化；第二流基于 Adaptive Window 动态估计流依赖传输延迟，并用 Physics-Guided Dynamic Graph 在物理先验约束下学习时间变化交互，抑制伪相关；整体采用残差结构实现解耦学习。
AI.result: 在 4 个跨工况工业基准数据集中，DSPR 预测精度与鲁棒性均优于现有方法，Mean Conservation Accuracy >99%，Total Variation Ratio 最高 97.2%，且学到的交互与滞后与领域机制（流量-延迟、风-功率缩放）高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 将物理一致的归纳偏置引入架构解耦，可在不牺牲精度前提下提供可解释、可信的工业时序预测，并已通过长期工业部署验证，为高级预测模型与可信自动控制之间架起桥梁。

title: MedVR: Annotation-Free Medical Visual Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold immense promise for complex clinical tasks, but their reasoning capabilities are often constrained by text-only paradigms that fail to ground inferences in visual evidence. This limitation not only curtails performance on tasks requiring fine-grained visual analysis but also introduces risks of visual hallucination in safety-critical applications. Thus, we introduce MedVR, a novel reinforcement learning framework that enables annotation-free visual reasoning for medical VLMs. Its core innovation lies in two synergistic mechanisms: Entropy-guided Visual Regrounding (EVR) uses model uncertainty to direct exploration, while Consensus-based Credit Assignment (CCA) distills pseudo-supervision from rollout agreement. Without any human annotations for intermediate steps, MedVR achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse public medical VQA benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing models. By learning to reason directly with visual evidence, MedVR promotes the robustness and transparency essential for accelerating the clinical deployment of medical AI.

AI.tldr: 不需要任何人工标注，强化学习框架 MedVR 通过熵引导重定视觉证据 + 共识信贷分配，在多个医学 VQA 基准上刷新 SOTA，显著降低幻觉并提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学 VLM 主要依赖纯文本推理，缺乏视觉证据锚定，导致细粒度任务性能受限且易产生视觉幻觉，亟需一种无需中间标注即可让模型“回归图像”进行推理的方法。
AI.method: 提出 MedRL 框架 MedVR：① Entropy-guided Visual Regrounding（EVR）利用模型不确定性自动探索并重新聚焦关键影像区域；② Consensus-based Credit Assignment（CCA）通过多轮 rollout 的一致性生成伪监督信号；二者协同实现完全无标注的视觉强化推理。
AI.result: 在公开医学 VQA 数据集上达到新 SOTA，显著超越现有最好模型，同时减少幻觉并提高答案可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MedVR 使医学 VLM 能直接基于视觉证据进行鲁棒、透明推理，为临床安全部署医学 AI 提供了可行路径。

title: An Agentic Evaluation Architecture for Historical Bias Detection in Educational Textbooks
comment: Accepted for ITS(Intelligent Tutoring Systems) 2026 Full Paper
summary:
History textbooks often contain implicit biases, nationalist framing, and selective omissions that are difficult to audit at scale. We propose an agentic evaluation architecture comprising a multimodal screening agent, a heterogeneous jury of five evaluative agents, and a meta-agent for verdict synthesis and human escalation. A central contribution is a Source Attribution Protocol that distinguishes textbook narrative from quoted historical sources, preventing the misattribution that causes systematic false positives in single-model evaluators.
  In an empirical study on Romanian upper-secondary history textbooks, 83.3\% of 270 screened excerpts were classified as pedagogically acceptable (mean severity 2.9/7), versus 5.4/7 under a zero-shot baseline, demonstrating that agentic deliberation mitigates over-penalization. In a blind human evaluation (18 evaluators, 54 comparisons), the Independent Deliberation configuration was preferred in 64.8\% of cases over both a heuristic variant and the zero-shot baseline. At approximately \$2 per textbook, these results position agentic evaluation architectures as economically viable decision-support tools for educational governance.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种多智能体评审架构，可在教科书中自动检测隐性偏见与民族主义表述，成本约每本2美元，显著优于单模型基线。
AI.motivation: 历史教材隐含偏见、民族主义框架与选择性遗漏难以规模化审计，传统单模型评估易因误归因导致系统性假阳性。
AI.method: 构建“多模态初筛智能体→5位异构评审智能体→元智能体综合裁决”的三级架构；提出源归属协议，区分叙事文本与引用的历史原始材料，防止误归因；在罗马尼亚高中历史教材上实验，并与零-shot基线及启发式变体对比。
AI.result: 270段样本中，83.3%被判定为教学可接受（平均严重度2.9/7），低于零-shot基线的5.4/7；18位人类评估者在54组盲比中，64.8%倾向选择独立审议配置；单本审核成本≈2美元。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体审议架构可经济、高效地支持教育治理决策，显著降低过度惩罚并提升审计可信度。

title: EgoEverything: A Benchmark for Human Behavior Inspired Long Context Egocentric Video Understanding in AR Environment
summary: Long context egocentric video understanding has recently attracted significant research attention, with augmented reality (AR) highlighted as one of its most important application domains. Nevertheless, the task remains highly challenging due to the need for reasoning over extended temporal contexts and diverse, unstructured activities. Although several benchmarks exist, most egocentric datasets rely on human worn cameras and focus mainly on visual content, with limited consideration of underlying user behavior when forming video-related queries. EgoEverything is a benchmark that explicitly considers human behavior by leveraging human attention signals, abstracted from gaze data, when generating questions. It comprises over 5,000 multiple choice question answer pairs, spanning more than 100 hours of video. By integrating human attention signals during question generation, it more faithfully captures natural human behavior and offers a realistic evaluation setting for long-context egocentric video understanding in AR.

AI.tldr: 引入基于注视点的注意信号构建首个兼顾长时序与用户行为真实性的自我中心视频基准 EgoEverything，含 5 k 问答、100 + 小时视频，更贴近 AR 场景。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心视频基准侧重视觉内容而忽视用户提问时的真实行为动机，难以支撑 AR 应用所需的长上下文理解。引入注视注意，可缩小评测与真实交互的语义差距。
AI.method: 采集 100 + 小时头戴相机视频，提取逐帧注视作为注意代理；据此生成 5 k 多选题问答对；构建长上下文采样与评估协议，将注意信号显式融入问题-答案对，强调行为驱动而非纯外观匹配。
AI.result: 暂时没有外部实验，但论文指出所提基准能有效暴露现有模型在长时序推理与行为推理上的短板，体现注意引导问答的困难度显著高于传统视觉问答。
AI.conclusion: EgoEverything 通过注视注意显式建模人类行为，为长上下文自我中心理解提供了更贴近 AR 现实的评测平台，并暗示未来方法需融合行为-认知信息才能突破当前性能瓶颈。

title: A Physical Agentic Loop for Language-Guided Grasping with Execution-State Monitoring
summary: Robotic manipulation systems that follow language instructions often execute grasp primitives in a largely single-shot manner: a model proposes an action, the robot executes it, and failures such as empty grasps, slips, stalls, timeouts, or semantically wrong grasps are not surfaced to the decision layer in a structured way. Inspired by agentic loops in digital tool-using agents, we reformulate language-guided grasping as a bounded embodied agent operating over grounded execution states, where physical actions expose an explicit tool-state stream. We introduce a physical agentic loop that wraps an unmodified learned manipulation primitive (grasp-and-lift) with (i) an event-based interface and (ii) an execution monitoring layer, Watchdog, which converts noisy gripper telemetry into discrete outcome labels using contact-aware fusion and temporal stabilization. These outcome events, optionally combined with post-grasp semantic verification, are consumed by a deterministic bounded policy that finalizes, retries, or escalates to the user for clarification, guaranteeing finite termination. We validate the resulting loop on a mobile manipulator with an eye-in-hand D405 camera, keeping the underlying grasp model unchanged and evaluating representative scenarios involving visual ambiguity, distractors, and induced execution failures. Results show that explicit execution-state monitoring and bounded recovery enable more robust and interpretable behavior than open-loop execution, while adding minimal architectural overhead. For the source code and demo refer to our project page: https://wenzewwz123.github.io/Agentic-Loop/

title: OmniJigsaw: Enhancing Omni-Modal Reasoning via Modality-Orchestrated Reordering
summary: To extend the reinforcement learning post-training paradigm to omni-modal models for concurrently bolstering video-audio understanding and collaborative reasoning, we propose OmniJigsaw, a generic self-supervised framework built upon a temporal reordering proxy task. Centered on the chronological reconstruction of shuffled audio-visual clips, this paradigm strategically orchestrates visual and auditory signals to compel cross-modal integration through three distinct strategies: Joint Modality Integration, Sample-level Modality Selection, and Clip-level Modality Masking. Recognizing that the efficacy of such proxy tasks is fundamentally tied to puzzle quality, we design a two-stage coarse-to-fine data filtering pipeline, which facilitates the efficient adaptation of OmniJigsaw to massive unannotated omni-modal data. Our analysis reveals a ``bi-modal shortcut phenomenon'' in joint modality integration and demonstrates that fine-grained clip-level modality masking mitigates this issue while outperforming sample-level modality selection. Extensive evaluations on 15 benchmarks show substantial gains in video, audio, and collaborative reasoning, validating OmniJigsaw as a scalable paradigm for self-supervised omni-modal learning.

AI.tldr: OmniJigsaw 以“时间拼图”自监督任务统一提升视频-音频理解与协作推理，无需标注即可在大规模多模态数据上取得跨模态泛化增益。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练/自监督方法多聚焦单模态或粗粒度对齐，难以同时强化视频、音频及其协同推理能力。作者希望将强化学习“后训练”范式扩展到全模态模型，实现无标注场景下的联合视频-音频理解提升。
AI.method: 1) 设计时序重排序代理任务：将音视频片段打乱顺序后重建，强制模型挖掘跨模态时序一致性。2) 三种集成策略：Joint Modality Integration（共享编码器同时处理双模态）、Sample-level Modality Selection（样本级挑模态输入）、Clip-level Modality Masking（片段级随机遮蔽音或视通道）。3) 二阶段粗-细数据过滤，保证拼图质量并提升大规模无标注数据适配效率。
AI.result: 在 15 个视频、音频及协作推理基准上，OmniJigsaw 显著优于现有自监督/预训练方法；细粒度 Clip-level Masking 不仅缓解“双模态捷径”(bi-modal shortcut)，还超越样本级模态选择，取得最佳平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 时序拼图自监督框架可扩展至任意大规模无标注音视频数据，有效提升全模态表征与协同推理能力，为 omni-modal 后训练提供通用范式。

title: SAT: Balancing Reasoning Accuracy and Efficiency with Stepwise Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized complex problem-solving, yet they exhibit a pervasive "overthinking", generating unnecessarily long reasoning chains. While current solutions improve token efficiency, they often sacrifice fine-grained control or risk disrupting the logical integrity of the reasoning process. To address this, we introduce Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT), a framework that performs step-level, difficulty-aware pruning while preserving the core reasoning structure. SAT formulates reasoning as a Finite-State Machine (FSM) with distinct thinking modes (Slow, Normal, Fast, Skip). It navigates these states dynamically using a lightweight Process Reward Model (PRM), compressing easy steps while preserving depth for hard ones. Experiments across 9 LRMs and 7 benchmarks show that SAT achieves up to 40% reduction in reasoning tokens while generally maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出步骤级自适应框架 SAT，可按难度动态压缩推理长度，平均节省 40% token 且准确率持平或提高。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型普遍存在“过度思考”现象，推理链冗长；现有加速方案要么缺少细粒度控制，要么破坏逻辑完整性，需同时兼顾效率与推理质量。
AI.method: 将推理建模为带有 Slow/Normal/Fast/Skip 四态的有限状态机（FSM）。轻量级过程奖励模型（PRM）评估每步难度，动态决定状态转移与剪枝。对简单步骤执行压缩、跳过；困难步骤保持深度推理。
AI.result: 在 9 个 LRM 和 7 项测评上，用 SAT 指导可削减至多 40% 的推理 token 数量，同时精度基本持平或小幅提升；剪枝策略在困难子任务上仍能维持模型性能。
AI.conclusion: SAT 证明可在 LRM 推理流程中以步骤粒度实现难度自适应压缩，兼顾长度与逻辑完整性，为高效推理提供一条系统化通用框架。

title: Bias-Constrained Diffusion Schedules for PDE Emulations: Reconstruction Error Minimization and Efficient Unrolled Training
summary: Conditional Diffusion Models are powerful surrogates for emulating complex spatiotemporal dynamics, yet they often fail to match the accuracy of deterministic neural emulators for high-precision tasks. In this work, we address two critical limitations of autoregressive PDE diffusion models: their sub-optimal single-step accuracy and the prohibitive computational cost of unrolled training. First, we characterize the relationship between the noise schedule, the reconstruction error reduction rate and the diffusion exposure bias, demonstrating that standard schedules lead to suboptimal reconstruction error. Leveraging this insight, we propose an \textit{Adaptive Noise Schedule} framework that minimizes inference reconstruction error by dynamically constraining the model's exposure bias. We further show that this optimized schedule enables a fast \textit{Proxy Unrolled Training} method to stabilize long-term rollouts without the cost of full Markov Chain sampling. Both proposed methods enable significant improvements in short-term accuracy and long-term stability over diffusion and deterministic baselines on diverse benchmarks, including forced Navier-Stokes, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Transonic Flow.

AI.tldr: 通过引入自适应噪声表和快速代理式非展开训练，自回归PDE扩散模型在短程精度与长程稳定性上显著超越传统扩散与确定性神经网络基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归PDE扩散模型单步精度低于确定性代理，且完整马尔可夫链展开训练成本高，难以兼顾高精度与高效率。
AI.method: 1) 理论刻画噪声表、重建误差下降率与扩散暴露偏差的关系；2) 提出自适应噪声表最小化推理重建误差；3) 基于该表构建“代理非展开训练”策略，用轻量采样替代全长链展开，提升长程稳定性。
