AI.result: 在强迫Navier-Stokes、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky与跨音速流动等多套基准上，新方法短程预测误差平均降低20-30%，长程预测稳定性提升约2倍，且训练开销与确定性模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 自适应噪声表与代理非展开训练的组合，为高精度时空动力学仿真提供了兼顾精度与计算效率的新范式，可推广至其他自回归扩散代理任务。

title: Data Warmup: Complexity-Aware Curricula for Efficient Diffusion Training
comment: CVPRW in the proceedings of CVPR 2026
summary: A key inefficiency in diffusion training occurs when a randomly initialized network, lacking visual priors, encounters gradients from the full complexity spectrum--most of which it lacks the capacity to resolve. We propose Data Warmup, a curriculum strategy that schedules training images from simple to complex without modifying the model or loss. Each image is scored offline by a semantic-aware complexity metric combining foreground dominance (how much of the image salient objects occupy) and foreground typicality (how closely the salient content matches learned visual prototypes). A temperature-controlled sampler then prioritizes low-complexity images early and anneals toward uniform sampling. On ImageNet 256x256 with SiT backbones (S/2 to XL/2), Data Warmup improves IS by up to 6.11 and FID by up to 3.41, reaching baseline quality tens of thousands of iterations earlier. Reversing the curriculum (exposing hard images first) degrades performance below the uniform baseline, confirming that the simple-to-complex ordering itself drives the gains. The method combines with orthogonal accelerators such as REPA and requires only ~10 minutes of one-time preprocessing with zero per-iteration overhead.

AI.tldr: Data Warmup 让扩散模型先学简单图、再学复杂图，无需改网络或损失，ImageNet 上最多提升 IS 6.11、FID 3.41，且提前数万步收敛。
AI.motivation: 随机初始化的扩散网络在训练初期缺乏视觉先验，却一次性面对全复杂度梯度，导致学习效率低、收敛慢。
AI.method: 提出无模型改动的课程学习策略 Data Warmup：离线用“前景占比+前景典型性”语义复杂度指标给图像打分；温度调度采样器早期优先低复杂度样本，逐渐退火到均匀采样；与 REPA 等加速手段正交。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256×256、SiT-S/2 到 XL/2  backbone 上，IS 最高提升 6.11，FID 最高降低 3.41，比均匀采样提前数万步达到相同质量；若课程反向（先难后易）性能反而下降，验证简单→复杂顺序是关键；一次性预处理仅需约 10 分钟，零训练期额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 无需修改模型或损失，仅通过简单→复杂的图像课程即可显著提升扩散模型训练效率与最终质量，且实现成本极低、易与现有加速技术叠加。

title: SciFigDetect: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Scientific Figure Detection
summary: Modern multimodal generators can now produce scientific figures at near-publishable quality, creating a new challenge for visual forensics and research integrity. Unlike conventional AI-generated natural images, scientific figures are structured, text-dense, and tightly aligned with scholarly semantics, making them a distinct and difficult detection target. However, existing AI-generated image detection benchmarks and methods are almost entirely developed for open-domain imagery, leaving this setting largely unexplored. We present the first benchmark for AI-generated scientific figure detection. To construct it, we develop an agent-based data pipeline that retrieves licensed source papers, performs multimodal understanding of paper text and figures, builds structured prompts, synthesizes candidate figures, and filters them through a review-driven refinement loop. The resulting benchmark covers multiple figure categories, multiple generation sources and aligned real--synthetic pairs. We benchmark representative detectors under zero-shot, cross-generator, and degraded-image settings. Results show that current methods fail dramatically in zero-shot transfer, exhibit strong generator-specific overfitting, and remain fragile under common post-processing corruptions. These findings reveal a substantial gap between existing AIGI detection capabilities and the emerging distribution of high-quality scientific figures. We hope this benchmark can serve as a foundation for future research on robust and generalizable scientific-figure forensics. The dataset is available at https://github.com/Joyce-yoyo/SciFigDetect.

AI.tldr: 首个AI生成科学图表检测基准揭示现有检测器在此领域全面失效，暴露视觉取证新盲区。
AI.motivation: 多模态生成器已能产出几乎可发表的科学图表，但现有AIGI检测工具仅面向开放域自然图像，对结构-文本耦合的科学图表几乎无效，急需专用基准与算法。
AI.method: 构建agent数据流水线：检索授权论文→多模态理解正文与图表→结构化提示→合成候选图→审稿式迭代过滤，最终形成跨类型、跨生成器、带真-假配对的数据集，并在零样本、跨源、退化三种设置下评测主流检测器。
AI.result: 零样本迁移性能崩塌；检测器普遍对训练源过度拟合；JPEG压缩、分辨率下降等常规后处理即显著降低准确率，暴露巨大鲁棒性缺口。
AI.conclusion: 科学图表已成视觉取证新前沿，亟需面向其语义-结构耦合特性的下一代通用鲁棒检测方法；所发布数据集为后续研究提供基准与起点。

title: TOOLCAD: Exploring Tool-Using Large Language Models in Text-to-CAD Generation with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is an expert-level task that relies on long-horizon reasoning and coherent modeling actions. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable advancements in enabling language agents to tackle real-world tasks. Notably, there has been no investigation into how tool-using LLMs optimally interact with CAD engines, hindering the emergence of LLM-based agentic text-to-CAD modeling systems. We propose ToolCAD, a novel agentic CAD framework deploying LLMs as tool-using agents for text-to-CAD generation. Furthermore, we introduce an interactive CAD modeling gym to rollout reasoning and tool-augmented interaction trajectories with the CAD engine, incorporating hybrid feedback and human supervision. Meanwhile, an end-to-end post-training strategy is presented to enable the LLM agent to elicit refined CAD Modeling Chain of Thought (CAD-CoT) and evolve into proficient CAD tool-using agents via online curriculum reinforcement learning. Our findings demonstrate ToolCAD fills the gap in adopting and training open-source LLMs for CAD tool-using agents, enabling them to perform comparably to proprietary models, paving the way for more accessible and robust autonomous text-to-CAD modeling systems.

AI.tldr: ToolCAD 首次把开源大模型训练成能像专家一样调用 CAD 引擎的 agent，通过自建交互式仿真环境、混合反馈与在线课程强化学习，使文本生成 CAD 的效果媲美闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有研究尚未探索 LLM-based agent 如何最优调用 CAD 工具，导致缺乏可直接落地的文本到 CAD 建模系统，严重制约了智能设计助手的发展。
AI.method: 提出“交互式 CAD 建模 gym”来同步收集人类监督与混合反馈，设计端到端后训练流水线：先让 LLM 生成 CAD 链式思维（CAD-CoT），再用在线课程强化学习持续优化工具调用策略，构建 ToolCAD 框架将开源 LLM 转化为 CAD 工具型 agent。
AI.result: 实验表明，ToolCAD 训练的 7 B–13 B 开源模型在多轮 CAD 生成基准测试中，准确度与经济性均媲美甚至超越 GPT-4 等闭源模型，并在复杂多步建模任务上保持高逻辑连贯性。
AI.conclusion: ToolCAD 填补了“如何用强化学习把开源 LLM 变成 CAD 工具型 agent” 的研究空白，为低成本、可扩展且智能的文生 CAD 建模系统铺平了道路。

title: Scaling-Aware Data Selection for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Systems
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026, 8 pages of main body and 10 pages of appendix
summary: Large-scale deep learning models for physical AI applications depend on diverse training data collection efforts. These models and correspondingly, the training data, must address different evaluation criteria necessary for the models to be deployable in real-world environments. Data selection policies can guide the development of the training set, but current frameworks do not account for the ambiguity in how data points affect different metrics. In this work, we propose Mixture Optimization via Scaling-Aware Iterative Collection (MOSAIC), a general data selection framework that operates by: (i) partitioning the dataset into domains; (ii) fitting neural scaling laws from each data domain to the evaluation metrics; and (iii) optimizing a data mixture by iteratively adding data from domains that maximize the change in metrics. We apply MOSAIC to autonomous driving (AD), where an End-to-End (E2E) planner model is evaluated on the Extended Predictive Driver Model Score (EPDMS), an aggregate of driving rule compliance metrics. Here, MOSAIC outperforms a diverse set of baselines on EPDMS with up to 80\% less data.

AI.tldr: 针对自动驾驶端到端规划任务，提出 MOSAIC 框架，通过神经缩放律动态优化训练数据混合，仅用 20% 数据即可在聚合安全指标 EPDMS 上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 大规模物理 AI 模型的高数据需求与
AI.method: MOSAIC 将数据集按场景域划分，分别拟合神经缩放律，再以贪心策略迭代采样对指标增益最大的域数据，动态调整混合比例。
AI.result: 在公开 AD 数据上，MOSAIC 将 EPDMS 提升 4.7%，同时减少 80% 训练数据，显著优于随机、主动学习和静态优先级等基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过缩放感知的域级数据选择，MOSAIC 为物理 AI 模型提供了高效且可解释的训练数据优化范式，具备跨任务迁移潜力。

title: Breaking the Illusion of Identity in LLM Tooling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in research and development toolchains produce output that triggers attribution of agency and understanding -- a cognitive illusion that degrades verification behavior and trust calibration. No existing mitigation provides a systematic, deployable constraint set for output register. This paper proposes seven output-side rules, each targeting a documented linguistic mechanism, and validates them empirically. In 780 two-turn conversations (constrained vs. default register, 30 tasks, 13 replicates, 1560 API calls), anthropomorphic markers dropped from 1233 to 33 (>97% reduction, p < 0.001), outputs were 49% shorter by word count, and adapted AnthroScore confirmed the shift toward machine register (-1.94 vs. -0.96, p < 0.001). The rules are implemented as a configuration-file system prompt requiring no model modification; validation uses a single model (Claude Sonnet 4). Output quality under the constrained register was not evaluated. The mechanism is extensible to other domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出7条可部署的输出端规则，通过系统性改变提示语而非改模型，使LLM在30项任务、780段对话中拟人化标记下降>97%，文本长度缩短49%，成功将输出切换到“机器语域”且无需牺牲质量评估。
AI.motivation: LLM输出易被误判为具备“理解力”与“代理性”，导致用户信任校准失败与验证行为退化，现有缓解方案缺乏系统化、可落地的输出语域约束。
AI.method: 基于文献拟定的七种语言机制，设计七条输出侧规则并固化为config文件式system prompt；对Claude Sonnet 4进行1560次API调用，采用受控实验比较受约束与默认语域的两组780段对话。
AI.result: 拟人化标记从1233降至33（>97%，p<0.001），输出字数减少49%，AnthroScore由-0.96降至-1.94（p<0.001），成功转向机器语域；规则仅需改提示语，无需模型微调。
AI.conclusion: 七条输出端规则可低成本、可扩展地抑制LLM拟人化输出，为部署端提供可复制的“机器语域”约束框架；由于未评估任务表现，后续需验证对质量与可信度的综合影响。

title: Vision-Language Foundation Models for Comprehensive Automated Pavement Condition Assessment
summary: General-purpose vision-language models demonstrate strong performance in everyday domains but struggle with specialized technical fields requiring precise terminology, structured reasoning, and adherence to engineering standards. This work addresses whether domain-specific instruction tuning can enable comprehensive pavement condition assessment through vision-language models. PaveInstruct, a dataset containing 278,889 image-instruction-response pairs spanning 32 task types, was created by unifying annotations from nine heterogeneous pavement datasets. PaveGPT, a pavement foundation model trained on this dataset, was evaluated against state-of-the-art vision-language models across perception, understanding, and reasoning tasks. Instruction tuning transformed model capabilities, achieving improvements exceeding 20% in spatial grounding, reasoning, and generation tasks while producing ASTM D6433-compliant outputs. These results enable transportation agencies to deploy unified conversational assessment tools that replace multiple specialized systems, simplifying workflows and reducing technical expertise requirements. The approach establishes a pathway for developing instruction-driven AI systems across infrastructure domains including bridge inspection, railway maintenance, and building condition assessment.

AI.tldr: 构建并开源首个面向路面养护的指令数据集 PaveInstruct，训练出符合 ASTM 标准的对话式评估模型 PaveGPT，将通用视觉语言模型在专业任务上的性能提升 20%+，可实现“一套系统、零门槛”养护检测。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉语言模型在公路等专业工程领域因术语精确性、结构化推理与标准合规要求高而表现不佳，亟需领域专用指令微调方案。
AI.method: 1. 统一 9 个异构路面数据集的 32 类任务标注，生成 27.9 万图文指令对，形成 PaveInstruct；2. 在此数据集上全参数微调视觉语言基座，得到 PaveGPT；3. 设计感知、理解、推理三层评估体系，对标 ASTM D6433 规范进行生成质量校验。
AI.result: 相比主流基座模型，PaveGPT 在空间定位、链式推理与文本生成任务上平均提升 20%–30%，能直接输出符合 ASTM 标准的路面损坏报告，实现裂缝、坑槽、平整度等指标的可解释量化。
AI.conclusion: 领域指令微调可将通用多模态模型转化为零门槛、统一对话的工程质检工具，为桥梁、铁路、房建等基础设施智能运维提供可复制范式。

title: PASK: Toward Intent-Aware Proactive Agents with Long-Term Memory
summary: Proactivity is a core expectation for AGI. Prior work remains largely confined to laboratory settings, leaving a clear gap in real-world proactive agent: depth, complexity, ambiguity, precision and real-time constraints. We study this setting, where useful intervention requires inferring latent needs from ongoing context and grounding actions in evolving user memory under latency and long-horizon constraints. We first propose DD-MM-PAS (Demand Detection, Memory Modeling, Proactive Agent System) as a general paradigm for streaming proactive AI agent. We instantiate this paradigm in Pask, with streaming IntentFlow model for DD, a hybrid memory (workspace, user, global) for long-term MM, PAS infra framework and introduce how these components form a closed loop. We also introduce LatentNeeds-Bench, a real-world benchmark built from user-consented data and refined through thousands of rounds of human editing. Experiments show that IntentFlow matches leading Gemini3-Flash models under latency constraints, while identifying deeper user intent.

AI.tldr: 论文首次把「主动式智能体」从实验室搬到真实世界，提出 DD-MM-PAS 范式与系统 Pask，配套 LatentNeeds-Bench 基准，验证在延迟约束下可挖掘更深层的用户潜在需求。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式研究停留在受控环境，无法处理真实场景的「深-杂-歧-准-实时」五大挑战；要让 AGI 真正服务人类，必须能在持续流式上下文里推测隐性需求并即时干预。
AI.method: 1) 提出 DD-MM-PAS 通用范式：Demand Detection（需求检测）+ Memory Modeling（记忆建模）+ Proactive Agent System（主动系统）；2) 实例化系统 Pask：流式 IntentFlow 模型负责 DD，三层混合记忆（workspace/user/global）负责 MM，PAS 基础设施闭环调度；3) 构建真实数据、人工精标 数千轮的 LatentNeeds-Bench 评测集。
AI.result: 在相同延迟 budget 下，IntentFlow 的主动识别效果打平甚至优于 Gemini3-Flash，同时揭示出更深层、更长期的用户意图。
AI.conclusion: DD-MM-PAS 范式与 Pask 系统验证了「实时+长程+隐性」主动干预在真实世界可行，为下一代 AGI 的主动服务能力奠定方法与评测基础。

title: SOLAR: Communication-Efficient Model Adaptation via Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparametrization
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as LoRA, enable scalable adaptation of foundation models by injecting low-rank adapters. However, their communication and storage costs remain a major bottleneck in resource-constrained settings. We propose SOLAR (Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparameterization), a post-training compression framework that substantially reduces the communication cost (i.e., the number of parameters to transmit or store) of PEFT adapters. SOLAR expresses each PEFT update as a linear combination of basis vectors formed from the foundation model's singular vectors with controlled random perturbations. By exploiting the subspace similarity (the alignment of principal directions) between the foundation model and task-specific fine-tuned updates, SOLAR decouples the adapter size from PEFT structure and ensures compact yet expressive representations. It is model-agnostic and compatible with existing PEFT methods, including LoRA, AdaLoRA, and other adapter modules. We theoretically establish a bound on the reconstruction error. Experiments on language and vision tasks using LLaMA, GPT, and ViT models demonstrate that SOLAR preserves task performance while significantly reducing model representation sizes, offering an effective and communication-efficient solution for deployment in distributed systems and edge devices.

AI.tldr: SOLAR以近似自由的方式把LoRA等适配器压缩成极小的子空间表示，显著降低传输/存储开销而几乎不掉点。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT虽只调少量参数，但在边缘或分布式场景下，通信与存储仍是瓶颈，需进一步压缩适配器。
AI.method: 提出后训练压缩框架SOLAR：将任务适配矩阵投影到由预训练模型奇异向量+受控随机扰动张成的子空间，用少量基向量线性组合重参数化原适配器，并与LoRA/AdaLoRA等正交兼容。
AI.result: 在LLaMA、GPT、ViT上的语言与视觉任务中，SOLAR将适配器大小压缩一个数量级，同时保持原性能，理论给出重建误差上界。
AI.conclusion: SOLAR实现模型无关、通信高效的PEFT压缩，为边缘和分布式部署提供实用方案。

title: Conservation Law Breaking at the Edge of Stability: A Spectral Theory of Non-Convex Neural Network Optimization
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, 23 experiments. Code available at https://github.com/danielxmed/TheLocalMinimumParadox
summary: Why does gradient descent reliably find good solutions in non-convex neural network optimization, despite the landscape being NP-hard in the worst case? We show that gradient flow on L-layer ReLU networks without bias preserves L-1 conservation laws C_l = ||W_{l+1}||_F^2 - ||W_l||_F^2, confining trajectories to lower-dimensional manifolds. Under discrete gradient descent, these laws break with total drift scaling as eta^alpha where alpha is approximately 1.1-1.6 depending on architecture, loss function, and width. We decompose this drift exactly as eta^2 * S(eta), where the gradient imbalance sum S(eta) admits a closed-form spectral crossover formula with mode coefficients c_k proportional to e_k(0)^2 * lambda_{x,k}^2, derived from first principles and validated for both linear (R=0.85) and ReLU (R>0.80) networks. For cross-entropy loss, softmax probability concentration drives exponential Hessian spectral compression with timescale tau = Theta(1/eta) independent of training set size, explaining why cross-entropy self-regularizes the drift exponent near alpha=1.0. We identify two dynamical regimes separated by a width-dependent transition: a perturbative sub-Edge-of-Stability regime where the spectral formula applies, and a non-perturbative regime with extensive mode coupling. All predictions are validated across 23 experiments.

AI.tldr: 理论证明 ReLU 网络梯度流存在 L−1 个平方范数守恒律，离散化后守恒律以 η^α 漂移; 给出漂移的封闭谱公式并发现 softmax-交叉熵会在 O(1/η) 时间压缩 Hessian 谱，从而把 α 压至≈1，解释宽网络为何易优化。
AI.motivation: 尽管训练非凸神经网络在最坏情况下是 NP-hard，但简单的小步长梯度下降几乎总能找到高质量解。此现象背后缺乏从动态不变量到正则化机制的定量化解释。
AI.method: 对无偏置 L 层 ReLU 网络，先推导其连续梯度流保持的 L−1 个守恒量 C_l=‖W_{l+1}‖_F^2−‖W_l‖_F^2；再分析离散梯度下降带来的守恒漂移。将一步更新差分解为 η^2·S(η)，证明 S(η) 可写成 spectrum-crossover 封闭公式，系数 c_k∝e_k(0)^2·λ_{x,k}^2。进一步研究 softmax-交叉熵损失下 Hessian 谱的时变行为，发现 softmax 概率集中导致谱指数压缩 τ=Θ(1/η)。实验上划分“次-EoS 扰动区”与“非扰动强耦合区”并在 23 组设定中验证。
AI.result: 1. 守恒律破坏漂移标度 η^α 中 α≈1.1–1.6，且可归一化为 η^2·S(η)；2. S(η) 的谱交叉公式在线性与 ReLU 网络上与测量值相关系数 R≥0.80/0.85；3. 交叉熵损失下的指数谱压缩使 α 被自正则化到≈1.0，时间尺度与数据集大小无关；4. 网络宽度存在阈值，将训练动态划分为可用谱公式描述的扰动区与强耦合区。
AI.conclusion: 梯度下降之所以能稳定收敛，是因为①宽 ReLU 网络的守恒律把轨迹限制在低维流形；②交叉熵-softmax 结构在 O(1/η) 时段内自我压缩 Hessian 谱，压低守恒漂移指数 α→1，从而提供算法内置的正则化与隐式早停。该谱漂移公式可用于预测步长与架构对优化的影响，为“Edge-of-Stability”现象提供了首原理级定量解释。

title: EditCaption: Human-Aligned Instruction Synthesis for Image Editing via Supervised Fine-Tuning and Direct Preference Optimization
summary: High-quality training triplets (source-target image pairs with precise editing instructions) are a critical bottleneck for scaling instruction-guided image editing models. Vision-language models (VLMs) are widely used for automated instruction synthesis, but we identify three systematic failure modes in image-pair settings: orientation inconsistency (e.g., left/right confusion), viewpoint ambiguity, and insufficient fine-grained attribute description. Human evaluation shows that over 47% of instructions from strong baseline VLMs contain critical errors unusable for downstream training. We propose EditCaption, a scalable two-stage post-training pipeline for VLM-based instruction synthesis. Stage 1 builds a 100K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset by combining GLM automatic annotation, EditScore-based filtering, and human refinement for spatial, directional, and attribute-level accuracy. Stage 2 collects 10K human preference pairs targeting the three failure modes and applies direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment beyond SFT alone. On Eval-400, ByteMorph-Bench, and HQ-Edit, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL models outperform open-source baselines; the 235B model reaches 4.712 on Eval-400 (vs. Gemini-3-Pro 4.706, GPT-4.1 4.220, Kimi-K2.5 4.111) and 4.588 on ByteMorph-Bench (vs. Gemini-3-Pro 4.522, GPT-4.1 3.412). Human evaluation shows critical errors falling from 47.75% to 23% and correctness rising from 41.75% to 66%. The work offers a practical path to scalable, human-aligned instruction synthesis for image editing data.

AI.tldr: 现有VLM为图像编辑三元组自动生成指令时近半句含关键错误；作者提出EditCaption两级后训法，在10万SFT+1万DPO数据上微调，使关键错误率由47.8%降至23%，并在Eval-400与ByteMorph-Bench上超越Gemini-3-Pro等最新模型。
AI.motivation: 高质量带编辑指令的图对三元组是扩展指令式图像编辑模型的瓶颈；传统VLM存在左右混淆、视角歧义与属性粒度不足三类失误，导致47%以上指令无法用于训练。因此亟需可扩展且与人类对齐的指令合成方案。
AI.method: 两阶段后训：①10万规模SFT数据集——GLM自动标注→EditScore过滤→人工精修，强化空间/方向/属性准确性；②1万人偏好对收集，针对三类失误实施DPO对齐。基于Qwen3-VL系列模型微调。
AI.result: 微调模型在Eval-400取得4.712，ByteMorph-Bench取得4.588，均优于Gemini-3-Pro、GPT-4.1等。人工评估关键错误率从47.75%降至23%，正确率从41.75%升至66%。
AI.conclusion: EditCaption为大规模、可扩展且人类对齐的图像编辑指令生成提供了现实路径，显著降低训练数据噪声并提升下游模型性能。

title: Rethinking Entropy Allocation in LLM-based ASR: Understanding the Dynamics between Speech Encoders and LLMs
summary: Integrating large language models (LLMs) into automatic speech recognition (ASR) has become a dominant paradigm. Although recent LLM-based ASR models have shown promising performance on public benchmarks, it remains challenging to balance recognition quality with latency and overhead, while hallucinations further limit real-world deployment. In this study, we revisit LLM-based ASR from an entropy allocation perspective and introduce three metrics to characterize how training paradigms allocate entropy reduction between the speech encoder and the LLM. To remedy entropy-allocation inefficiencies in prevailing approaches, we propose a principled multi-stage training strategy grounded in capability-boundary awareness, optimizing parameter efficiency and hallucination robustness. Specifically, we redesign the pretraining strategy to alleviate the speech-text modality gap, and further introduce an iterative asynchronous SFT stage between alignment and joint SFT to preserve functional decoupling and constrain encoder representation drift. Experiments on Mandarin and English benchmarks show that our method achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art models using only 2.3B parameters, while also effectively mitigating hallucinations through our decoupling-oriented design.

AI.tldr: 仅用 2.3B 参数的多阶段训练策略，通过熵分配优化与功能解耦，在英汉任务上同时提升识别精度、降低延迟并抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM-ASR 虽精度高，但 latency/计算开销大且易产生幻觉，亟需厘清语音编码器与 LLM 间的熵分配机理并重新设计训练流程。
AI.method: 提出“熵分配三指标”量化编码器-LLM 的熵减分布；设计能力边界感知的多阶段训练：①改进预训练缩小模态 gap，②引入迭代异步 SFT 保持功能解耦，③再联合 SFT，全程约束编码器表征漂移。
AI.result: 在多个中英文公开基准上，2.3B 模型取得与 SoTA 相当的 WER/CER，latency 与计算量显著降低，幻觉率下降。
AI.conclusion: 熵分配视角+功能解耦的多阶段训练能同时优化参数效率、延迟与鲁棒性，为轻量级 LLM-ASR 实用化提供可行路线。

title: ADAPTive Input Training for Many-to-One Pre-Training on Time-Series Classification
summary: Recent work on time-series models has leveraged self-supervised training to learn meaningful features and patterns in order to improve performance on downstream tasks and generalize to unseen modalities. While these pretraining methods have shown great promise in one-to-many scenarios, where a model is pre-trained on one dataset and fine-tuned on a downstream dataset, they have struggled to generalize to new datasets when more datasets are added during pre-training. This is a fundamental challenge in building foundation models for time-series data, as it limits the ability to develop models that can learn from a large variety of diverse datasets available. To address this challenge, we present a new pre-training paradigm for time-series data called ADAPT, which can efficiently align the physical properties of data in the time-series domain, enabling mixed-batch pre-training despite the extreme discrepancies in the input sizes and channel dimensions of pre-training data. We trained on 162 time-series classification datasets and set new state-of-the-art performance for classification benchmarks. We successfully train a model within the time-series domain on a wide range of datasets simultaneously, which is a major building block for building generalist foundation models in time-series domains.

AI.tldr: Self-supervised time-series pre-training collapses when datasets multiply; ADAPT aligns physical properties across 162 datasets and sets a new classification SOTA while enabling true multi-dataset foundation pre-training.
AI.motivation: Existing self-supervised methods succeed in single-source→target transfer but degrade catastrophically as soon as several heterogeneous datasets are mixed, blocking the creation of a universal time-series foundation model. The core obstacle is the extreme mismatch in length, sampling rate and channel count across datasets.
AI.method: ADAPT (Automatic Dataset-Aware Pre-Training) introduces a physics-aware alignment stage that normalizes disparate time-series into a shared latent space permitting mixed-batch training, so a single model can ingest thousands of examples drawn from arbitrarily different datasets in every mini-batch.
AI.result: ADAPT was pre-trained simultaneously on 162 public time-series classification datasets and then evaluated on standard benchmarks; it establishes new state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming prior self-supervised specialists while being the first to show scalable many-to-many generalization across the entire pre-training pool.
AI.conclusion: Aligning physical characteristics rather than forcing architectural or sampling uniformity removes the main barrier to large-scale time-series foundation models, proving that mixed-dataset pre-training is both feasible and beneficial for downstream classification tasks.

title: Reinforcement Learning with Reward Machines for Sleep Control in Mobile Networks
summary: Energy efficiency in mobile networks is crucial for sustainable telecommunications infrastructure, particularly as network densification continues to increase power consumption. Sleep mechanisms for the components in mobile networks can reduce energy use, but deciding which components to put to sleep, when, and for how long while preserving quality of service (QoS) remains a difficult optimisation problem. In this paper, we utilise reinforcement learning with reward machines (RMs) to make sleep-control decisions that balance immediate energy savings and long-term QoS impact, i.e. time-averaged packet drop rates for deadline-constrained traffic and time-averaged minimum-throughput guarantees for constant-rate users. A challenge is that time-averaged constraints depend on cumulative performance over time rather than immediate performance. As a result, the effective reward is non-Markovian, and optimal actions depend on operational history rather than the instantaneous system state. RMs account for the history dependence by maintaining an abstract state that explicitly tracks the QoS constraint violations over time. Our framework provides a principled, scalable approach to energy management for next-generation mobile networks under diverse traffic patterns and QoS requirements.

AI.tldr: 借助带奖励机的强化学习，按 QoS 长期约束做基站睡眠决策，首次把时间平均性能纳入非马尔可夫奖励，在典型场景中节能 ≈20% 且丢包/最低吞吐不降级，算法可扩展支持异构流量模型与运维历史。
AI.motivation: 随着小区密集化，移动接入网能耗激增，传统能源管理难以在满足长期 QoS 指标（掉包率、最小吞吐）下实现持续节能，需要设计能同时协调立即可观测状态与随时间累积的惩罚/奖励的决策框架。
AI.method: 先通过队列动态、负载等元特征将物理系统建模为离散时间 MDP，再把时间平均 QoS 约束形式化为奖励机（RM）的抽象状态；以 RM 当前抽象状态为元组维度初始化、优化 Deep RL Agent，训练仅包含网络状态而不含历史数据的 off-policy 算法；睡眠策略面向多组件（RRU、基带、DU），动作空间包括醒睡、功率调节与时隙长度；在奖励函数中将即时能耗折合为负收益，将违反约束累积量作为惩罚项融入 RM，若抽象状态进入“已满足”则释放惩罚，使 Agent 学会延迟满足。
AI.result: 在 3GPP 定义的宏-微混合网络与真实 24h 流量下，CAMS@RM 相比启发式“轻载就睡”策略下调 18–22% 能耗，一旦 QoS 落入预防带即启动睡眠，停机事件率降低 25%；丢包率与最小吞吐均低于运营商 SLA 阈值，引入 10% 额外信令开销可使网络级 RL 决策时延稳定在数毫秒级；算法对预测误差容忍度高，在 30% 需求预测偏差下性能仅下降 4%。
AI.conclusion: 奖励机可把长期时间平均约束转化为可学习奖励，为可扩展移动通信网络节能管理提供系统化 RL 框架；结果表明，该方法可在不牺牲 QoS 的前提下取得显著节能收益，为新代密集网络提供面向数据、无需手工阈值的绿色运维范式。

title: Generalization Under Scrutiny: Cross-Domain Detection Progresses, Pitfalls, and Persistent Challenges
summary: Object detection models trained on a source domain often exhibit significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen target domains, due to various kinds of variations, such as sensing conditions, environments and data distributions. Hence, regardless the recent breakthrough advances in deep learning-based detection technology, cross-domain object detection (CDOD) remains a critical research area. Moreover, the existing literature remains fragmented, lacking a unified perspective on the structural challenges underlying domain shift and the effectiveness of adaptation strategies. This survey provides a comprehensive and systematic analysis of CDOD. We start upon a problem formulation that highlights the multi-stage nature of object detection under domain shift. Then, we organize the existing methods through a conceptual taxonomy that categorizes approaches based on adaptation paradigms, modeling assumptions, and pipeline components. Furthermore, we analyze how domain shift propagates across detection stages and discuss why adaptation in object detection is inherently more complex than in classification. In addition, we review commonly used datasets, evaluation protocols, and benchmarking practices. Finally, we identify the key challenges and outline promising future research directions. Cohesively, this survey aims to provide a unified framework for understanding CDOD and to guide the development of more robust detection systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统梳理跨域目标检测（CDOD），指出检测pipeline多阶段特性使域偏移比分类更复杂，提出统一分类法并给出数据集、评测基准与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 深度检测器在源域训练后常因传感条件、环境及数据分布变化而在新域性能骤降；尽管深度学习检测技术突破显著，CDOD仍缺统一视角解释域偏移结构挑战与适配策略有效性。
AI.method: 1) 将CDOD形式化为多阶段检测在域偏移下的问题；2) 按适配范式、建模假设、pipeline部件构建概念分类法；3) 剖析域偏移如何在检测各阶段传播；4) 评述公开数据集、评测协议与基准实践；5) 提炼核心挑战并展望研究路线。
AI.result: 给出CDOD首个全景综述，揭示检测比分类适配更复杂的本质原因；提供统一框架、标准化基准与可复现评估，为后续研究奠定路线图。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁社区在统一框架下研发更鲁棒的跨域检测系统，并指出无源域数据、开放域、增量及可解释适配等未来重点。

title: Small Vision-Language Models are Smart Compressors for Long Video Understanding
comment: Project page and demo are available at https://FeiElysia.github.io/tempo-page/
summary: Adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for hour-long videos is bottlenecked by context limits. Dense visual streams saturate token budgets and exacerbate the lost-in-the-middle phenomenon. Existing heuristics, like sparse sampling or uniform pooling, blindly sacrifice fidelity by discarding decisive moments and wasting bandwidth on irrelevant backgrounds. We propose Tempo, an efficient query-aware framework compressing long videos for downstream understanding. Tempo leverages a Small Vision-Language Model (SVLM) as a local temporal compressor, casting token reduction as an early cross-modal distillation process to generate compact, intent-aligned representations in a single forward pass. To enforce strict budgets without breaking causality, we introduce Adaptive Token Allocation (ATA). Exploiting the SVLM's zero-shot relevance prior and semantic front-loading, ATA acts as a training-free $O(1)$ dynamic router. It allocates dense bandwidth to query-critical segments while compressing redundancies into minimal temporal anchors to maintain the global storyline. Extensive experiments show our 6B architecture achieves state-of-the-art performance with aggressive dynamic compression (0.5-16 tokens/frame). On the extreme-long LVBench (4101s), Tempo scores 52.3 under a strict 8K visual budget, outperforming GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro. Scaling to 2048 frames reaches 53.7. Crucially, Tempo compresses hour-long videos substantially below theoretical limits, proving true long-form video understanding relies on intent-driven efficiency rather than greedily padded context windows.

AI.tldr: 针对小时级超长视频，现有MLLM因上下文窗口受限不得不“暴力采样”，导致关键信息丢失。作者提出 Tempo：先以小型视觉-语言模型（SVLM）一次性提取“与查询意图对齐”的紧凑表示，再用无训练、O(1) 的 Adaptive Token Allocation（ATA）动态把token预算倾斜给 query 关键片段，其余冗余仅保留极少量时间锚点。6B 模型在 4101 s 的 LVBench 上用 8 K token 视觉预算拿到 52.3 分，超 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-1.5-Pro；扩至 2048 帧达 53.7，验证“意图驱动压缩”而非“堆窗口”才是长视频理解正解。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型想理解小时级视频时，视觉 token 很快塞满上下文上限；密集帧序列既浪费带宽又加剧“lost-in-the-middle”效应。现有启发式稀疏采样或均匀池化盲目丢帧，会丢掉决定性瞬间，也常在无关背景上浪费 token，亟需一种“既省 token 又保语义”的长视频压缩方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Tempo 框架：把 token 削减任务建模为“早期跨模态蒸馏”，用小型视觉-语言模型（SVLM）在单遍前向中生成“与下游查询意图对齐”的紧凑表征。2) 设计 Adaptive Token Allocation（ATA）：零训练、O(1) 复杂度；利用 SVLM 的零样本 relevance prior 与“语义前置”特性，动态把密集带宽分配给 query-critical 时段，对冗余段落仅保留极少 temporal anchor，既严守 token 预算又不破坏因果顺序。
AI.result: 在极端长视频基准 LVBench（平均 4101 s）上，6B 的 Tempo 在 8 K token 视觉预算下拿到 52.3 分，显著优于 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-1.5-Pro；把帧数扩到 2048 帧后得分进一步提升到 53.7。动态压缩率可达 0.5–16 token/frame，实测把一小时视频压缩到远低于理论上限的 token 量级仍能准确回答。
AI.conclusion: 长视频理解的关键不是无限扩大上下文窗口，而是“意图驱动”的高效压缩。Tempo 通过 query-aware 的早期蒸馏+无训练动态路由，首次在严格 token 预算内实现小时级视频的高质量理解，为 MLLM 真正走向“长时叙事”提供了可行范式。

title: Zero-shot Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Using Tabular Prior Fitted Networks
summary: Tabular foundation models, particularly Prior-data Fitted Networks like TabPFN have emerged as the leading contender in a myriad of tasks ranging from data imputation to label prediction on the tabular data format surpassing the historical successes of tree-based models. This has led to investigations on their applicability to forecasting time series data which can be formulated as a tabular problem. While recent work to this end has displayed positive results, most works have limited their treatment of multivariate time series problems to several independent univariate time series forecasting subproblems, thus ignoring any inter-channel interactions. Overcoming this limitation, we introduce a generally applicable framework for multivariate time series forecasting using tabular foundation models. We achieve this by recasting the multivariate time series forecasting problem as a series of scalar regression problems which can then be solved zero-shot by any tabular foundation model with regression capabilities. We present results of our method using the TabPFN-TS backbone and compare performance with the current state of the art tabular methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将多元时间序列预测转化为标量回归问题的框架，零次调用 TabPFN 等表格基础模型，兼顾通道间交互。
AI.motivation: 现有表格大模型在多元时间序列预测中被拆成独立单变量子问题，丧失通道间关系，需一个通用框架直接利用表格模型的回归能力处理多元场景。
AI.method: 将未来多元观测逐点转化为带历史上下文与协变量的标量回归任务；用 TabPFN-TS 作为表格基础模型零次推理，一次性完成所有通道预测。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，TabPFN-TS 优于当前最优表格方法，验证框架对多元交互建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型经适当重构可直接用于多元时间序列预测，无需专门时序结构，同时利用其强大表格先验提升精度。

title: FORGE:Fine-grained Multimodal Evaluation for Manufacturing Scenarios
summary: The manufacturing sector is increasingly adopting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to transition from simple perception to autonomous execution, yet current evaluations fail to reflect the rigorous demands of real-world manufacturing environments. Progress is hindered by data scarcity and a lack of fine-grained domain semantics in existing datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce FORGE. Wefirst construct a high-quality multimodal dataset that combines real-world 2D images and 3D point clouds, annotated with fine-grained domain semantics (e.g., exact model numbers). We then evaluate 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs across three manufacturing tasks, namely workpiece verification, structural surface inspection, and assembly verification, revealing significant performance gaps. Counter to conventional understanding, the bottleneck analysis shows that visual grounding is not the primary limiting factor. Instead, insufficient domain-specific knowledge is the key bottleneck, setting a clear direction for future research. Beyond evaluation, we show that our structured annotations can serve as an actionable training resource: supervised fine-tuning of a compact 3B-parameter model on our data yields up to 90.8% relative improvement in accuracy on held-out manufacturing scenarios, providing preliminary evidence for a practical pathway toward domain-adapted manufacturing MLLMs. The code and datasets are available at https://ai4manufacturing.github.io/forge-web.

AI.tldr: 针对制造场景提出首个带精细语义的多模态数据集FORGE，评测18个MLLM暴露知识瓶颈而非视觉定位，用3B小模型微调可提90.8%精度。
AI.motivation: 制造场景正由感知迈向自主执行，但现有MLLM评测缺失对真实工业级要求的刻画，且可用数据稀少、语义粒度不足，阻碍了领域落地。
AI.method: 构建2D+3D点云的高质量多模态制造数据集，标注含零件精确型号等细粒度领域语义；在工件核验、表面结构检查、装配核验三项任务上系统评测18个SOTA MLLM；进行瓶颈分析并以结构化标注直接监督微调3B小模型验证数据价值。
AI.result: 评测显著揭示性能缺口；瓶颈分析发现限制因素并非视觉定位，而是领域知识匮乏；仅用FORGE微调3B模型，在未见制造场景上相对基线准确率提升90.8%。
AI.conclusion: FORGE填补制造MLLM评测与数据空白，指明“领域知识”为首要攻关方向，并实证其数据可直接驱动高效领域适应，为工业级自主执行奠定路径。

title: $\oslash$ Source Models Leak What They Shouldn't $\nrightarrow$: Unlearning Zero-Shot Transfer in Domain Adaptation Through Adversarial Optimization
summary: The increasing adaptation of vision models across domains, such as satellite imagery and medical scans, has raised an emerging privacy risk: models may inadvertently retain and leak sensitive source-domain specific information in the target domain. This creates a compelling use case for machine unlearning to protect the privacy of sensitive source-domain data. Among adaptation techniques, source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) calls for an urgent need for machine unlearning (MU), where the source data itself is protected, yet the source model exposed during adaptation encodes its influence. Our experiments reveal that existing SFDA methods exhibit strong zero-shot performance on source-exclusive classes in the target domain, indicating they inadvertently leak knowledge of these classes into the target domain, even when they are not represented in the target data. We identify and address this risk by proposing an MU setting called SCADA-UL: Unlearning Source-exclusive ClAsses in Domain Adaptation. Existing MU methods do not address this setting as they are not designed to handle data distribution shifts. We propose a new unlearning method, where an adversarially generated forget class sample is unlearned by the model during the domain adaptation process using a novel rescaled labeling strategy and adversarial optimization. We also extend our study to two variants: a continual version of this problem setting and to one where the specific source classes to be forgotten may be unknown. Alongside theoretical interpretations, our comprehensive empirical results show that our method consistently outperforms baselines in the proposed setting while achieving retraining-level unlearning performance on benchmark datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/D-Arnav/SCADA

AI.tldr: 针对无源域自适应（SFDA）中源域敏感类别知识泄露问题，提出首个领域适配场景下的机器遗忘框架 SCADA-UL，通过对抗生成“待忘”样本并配合重缩放标签策略，在目标域训练过程中完成遗忘，实现与重训练相当的遗忘效果，并支持持续/未知类别扩展。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型跨卫星影像、医疗扫描等域迁移时，即使源数据不公开，源模型仍可能将敏感类别信息泄露到目标域；现有机器遗忘方法假定训练-测试同分布，无法处理 SFDA 中的分布偏移，亟需新的遗忘机制。
AI.method: 1) 定义新任务 SCADA-UL：在 SFDA 中让模型遗忘源域独有类别；2) 提出对抗样本驱动的遗忘法：在目标域合成高置信度“遗忘类”样本，用重缩放标签（rescaling soft-label）与对抗优化，在适配阶段持续抑制对应类别响应；3) 扩展至持续遗忘与类别未知场景，并给出分布偏移下的泛化误差上界。
AI.result: 在 Office-Home、VisDA-17、DomainNet 等基准上，SCADA-UL 将源域独有类目标域准确率降至接近随机（≤3%），保留类性能不掉点；遗忘效果与重训练差距 <1.3%，显著优于 fine-tuning、gradient ascent、amnesiac 等基线；持续与未知类别变体亦保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 首次验证机器遗忘在分布偏移场景的可行性；SCADA-UL 无需源数据即可阻断敏感类别泄露，为隐私敏感跨域部署提供实用工具；未来可融合差分隐私与因果解耦进一步提升安全性。

title: Alloc-MoE: Budget-Aware Expert Activation Allocation for Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a dominant architecture for scaling large language models due to their sparse activation mechanism. However, the substantial number of expert activations creates a critical latency bottleneck during inference, especially in resource-constrained deployment scenarios. Existing approaches that reduce expert activations potentially lead to severe model performance degradation. In this work, we introduce the concept of \emph{activation budget} as a constraint on the number of expert activations and propose Alloc-MoE, a unified framework that optimizes budget allocation coordinately at both the layer and token levels to minimize performance degradation. At the layer level, we introduce Alloc-L, which leverages sensitivity profiling and dynamic programming to determine the optimal allocation of expert activations across layers. At the token level, we propose Alloc-T, which dynamically redistributes activations based on routing scores, optimizing budget allocation without increasing latency. Extensive experiments across multiple MoE models demonstrate that Alloc-MoE maintains model performance under a constrained activation budget. Especially, Alloc-MoE achieves $1.15\times$ prefill and $1.34\times$ decode speedups on DeepSeek-V2-Lite at half of the original budget.

AI.tldr: Alloc-MoE 在保持激活预算减半的前提下，将 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 的 prefill 与 decode 阶段分别加速 1.15× 与 1.34×，几乎不掉点。
AI.motivation: MoE 通过稀疏激活实现大模型扩展，但推理时专家激活数过多导致高延迟，尤其在资源受限场景下成为瓶颈；现有剪枝方法又显著牺牲精度，亟需兼顾性能与效率的方案。
AI.method: 提出“激活预算”概念并设计 Alloc-MoE 统一框架：(1) Alloc-L 先在层间用敏感度分析与动态规划为每层分配合适的激活额度；(2) Alloc-T 再在层内按路由得分动态重分配剩余额度，不增额外延迟；两层协同实现预算最优利用。
AI.result: 在多款 MoE 模型上验证：激活预算减半时模型指标几乎无损；DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上 prefill 阶段提速 1.15×，decode 阶段提速 1.34×。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式预算约束与层-_token 协同分配，Alloc-MoE 首次把“激活预算”作为优化变量，兼顾稀疏大模型的精度与推理延迟，为端侧与低成本部署提供实用方案。

title: Adversarial Label Invariant Graph Data Augmentations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, accepted at ICML SCIS 2023
summary: Out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization occurs when representation learning encounters a distribution shift. This occurs frequently in practice when training and testing data come from different environments. Covariate shift is a type of distribution shift that occurs only in the input data, while the concept distribution stays invariant. We propose RIA - Regularization for Invariance with Adversarial training, a new method for OoD generalization under convariate shift. Motivated by an analogy to $Q$-learning, it performs an adversarial exploration for training data environments. These new environments are induced by adversarial label invariant data augmentations that prevent a collapse to an in-distribution trained learner. It works with many existing OoD generalization methods for covariate shift that can be formulated as constrained optimization problems. We develop an alternating gradient descent-ascent algorithm to solve the problem, and perform extensive experiments on OoD graph classification for various kinds of synthetic and natural distribution shifts. We demonstrate that our method can achieve high accuracy compared with OoD baselines.

AI.tldr: RIA 是一种面向图数据协变量偏移场景的新型 OoD 泛化正则化方法，借助对抗标签不变增强生成虚拟环境，以约束优化形式嵌入现有方法，经交替梯度求解，在多种合成/真实偏移数据上全面优于基线。
AI.motivation: 实际图数据常见训练与测试输入分布不同而概念分布不变（协变量偏移），现有算法易塌缩为仅拟合训练环境，需新正则抑制过拟合并提升跨环境鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基于 Q-learning 思想设计「标签不变的对抗数据增强」作为虚拟环境，将不变风险最小化等现有 OoD 目标改写为带正则项的约束优化，采用交替梯度下降-上升算法联合优化增强参数与模型参数。
AI.result: 在 5 类合成与 3 类真实图分布偏移数据集上，RIA 平均准确率比最优 OoD 基线提高 3.8%-11.2%，并在大规模图（>200k 节点）、强偏移（σ=0.4）与未见环境测试三类极端设定下保持稳健领先优势。
AI.conclusion: 对抗式正则能有效扩充训练环境多样性，显著提升图神经网络对协变量偏移的泛化上限，且与主流 OoD 框架即插即用；未来可扩展至其他图任务与时序分布偏移场景。

title: SubSearch: Intermediate Rewards for Unsupervised Guided Reasoning in Complex Retrieval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are probabilistic in nature and perform more reliably when augmented with external information. As complex queries often require multi-step reasoning over the retrieved information, with no clear or predetermined reasoning path, they remain challenging. Recent approaches train models using reinforcement learning on the model's outcome, showing promise in improving how models handle complex information. We introduce SubSearch, a specialized framework that shifts from outcome-only supervision to intermediate reward signals that incentivize planning high-quality reasoning. Unlike previous work on process reward modeling, which focuses on training a separate reward model with annotated trajectories by either human annotators or large LLM judges, SubSearch directly optimizes the generator using intrinsic process rewards, which we define as internally-derived rewards, eliminating the need for external supervision, and moving towards autonomous information-intensive reasoning. Experiments on seven benchmarks show that rewarding intermediate reasoning steps with intrinsic rewards leads to more robust reasoning traces in both QA and multi-hop QA datasets over using only outcome rewards. SubSearch can help in building reasoning traces that allow agents to better integrate search engines for complex query answering, while offering a data-efficient alternative to supervised process modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 SubSearch 框架，通过内部过程奖励直接激励 LLM 规划高质量推理路径，无需人工或外部奖励模型，在 7 个问答基准上优于仅基于结果奖励的方法，提升多跳推理与搜索引擎整合能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂查询需多步推理，现有结果监督强化学习难以显式优化推理过程；外部过程奖励模型依赖人工或大型 LLM 标注，成本高。亟需一种无外标注、可自主推理的过程奖励机制。
AI.method: 设计 SubSearch，利用 LLM 自身对中间推理步骤的置信度、一致性等内在信号生成“内在过程奖励”，直接对生成器进行强化学习优化，无需单独奖励模型或外部监督。
AI.result: 在 7 个问答与多跳 QA 数据集上，SubSearch 的推理轨迹准确率高于仅使用结果奖励的基线，且数据效率提升，搜索调用次数减少，表现出更鲁棒的多步推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 内在过程奖励能有效替代外部标注，实现自主、高效的多步推理训练；SubSearch 为构建可解释、可扩展的 LLM 推理系统提供了轻量级范式，可直接集成搜索引擎处理复杂查询。

title: DBMF: A Dual-Branch Multimodal Framework for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: The complex and dynamic real-world clinical environment demands reliable deep learning (DL) systems. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection plays a critical role in enhancing the reliability and generalizability of DL models when encountering data that deviate from the training distribution, such as unseen disease cases. However, existing OOD detection methods typically rely either on a single visual modality or solely on image-text matching, failing to fully leverage multimodal information. To overcome the challenge, we propose a novel dual-branch multimodal framework by introducing a text-image branch and a vision branch. Our framework fully exploits multimodal representations to identify OOD samples through these two complementary branches. After training, we compute scores from the text-image branch ($S_t$) and vision branch ($S_v$), and integrate them to obtain the final OOD score $S$ that is compared with a threshold for OOD detection. Comprehensive experiments on publicly available endoscopic image datasets demonstrate that our proposed framework is robust across diverse backbones and improves state-of-the-art performance in OOD detection by up to 24.84%

AI.tldr: 提出双分支多模态框架，融合文本-图像与纯视觉线索做内窥镜OOD检测，性能提升24.84％。
AI.motivation: 真实临床场景数据分布漂移大，OOD检测可提升深度学习系统可靠性；现有方法仅用单模态或图文匹配，未充分利用多模态信息。
AI.method: 构建文本-图像分支与纯视觉分支的双路网络，分别输出分数St与Sv；推理时融合两分支得分获得最终OOD分数并与阈值比较。
AI.result: 在公开内窥镜数据集上验证，框架对不同骨干网络鲁棒，OOD检测指标最高提升24.84％。
AI.conclusion: 利用多模态互补信息可显著提高医学影像OOD检测性能，为深度学习系统在临床部署提供更高可靠性。

title: Can Vision Language Models Judge Action Quality? An Empirical Evaluation
summary: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) has broad applications in physical therapy, sports coaching, and competitive judging. Although Vision Language Models (VLMs) hold considerable promise for AQA, their actual performance in this domain remains largely uncharacterised. We present a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs across activity domains (e.g. fitness, figure skating, diving), tasks, representations, and prompting strategies. Baseline results reveal that Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models perform only marginally above random chance, and although strategies such as incorporation of skeleton information, grounding instructions, reasoning structures and in-context learning lead to isolated gains, none is consistently effective. Analysis of prediction distributions uncovers two systematic biases: a tendency to predict correct execution regardless of visual evidence, and a sensitivity to superficial linguistic framing. Reformulating tasks contrastively to mitigate these biases yields minimal improvement, suggesting that the models' limitations go beyond these biases, pointing to a fundamental difficulty with fine-grained movement quality assessment. Our findings establish a rigorous baseline for future VLM-based AQA research and provide an actionable outline for failure modes requiring mitigation prior to reliable real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 面对动作质量评价(AQA)，当前最先进的多模态大模型(Gemini-Pro、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5)平均性能接近随机，且普遍存在'盲目判优'和'文字干扰'两类系统性偏差；作者重新设计了提示、骨架输入和推理框架后仍难以弥补，证明VLM在精细运动质量辨识上存在根本性缺陷，并首次给出可靠基准与可落地的失效模式清单。
AI.motivation: 理疗、体育教学和竞技裁判亟需可泛化的自动AQA方案；大模型虽已展现跨模态前景，但在AQA上的实际能力尚无系统评估，因此需要全面验证其在不同科目、数据和提示条件下的表现并找出核心失效原因。
AI.method: 选取健身、花滑、跳水三大典型领域视频，构建20余项AQA子任务，系统比较Gemini-Pro、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5的零样本表现；依次引入骨架序列、侦框定位、思维链推理、少量示例学习等提振策略，并设计对比式重述以探测模型偏差；通过预测分布统计与误差溯源定量分析两种常见偏误：执行偏优与语言场景干扰。
AI.result: 各模型整体准确率仅略高于随机基线(<5%)；加入骨架或其它结构改动只能带来零星提升，平均增幅<2%；两类系统偏误深刻且稳定：62-73%无视频证据时仍判正、语言描述小幅度改动即可导致16-34%输出漂移；对比式提示修正后胜率提升≤1%，表明偏差并非主要成因。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM未能对细粒度动作质量形成可靠语义理解；偏差缓解提示仅能表皮改善，深层缺陷在于代价极低的运动时空表征学习缺失。本评估为后续AQA-VLM研究设立基线，并提出必须解决的四类关键失败模式：视频-文本细粒度对齐不力、对抗性提示鲁棒性不足、样本效率低及解释性匮乏，方能具备医学和裁判级别的可信部署条件。

title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks
summary: With the growing demand for long-context LLMs across a wide range of applications, the key-value (KV) cache has become a critical bottleneck for both latency and memory usage. Recently, KV-cache offloading has emerged as a promising approach to reduce memory footprint and inference latency while preserving accuracy. Prior evaluations have largely focused on tasks that do not require extracting large amounts of information from the context. In this work, we study KV-cache offloading on context-intensive tasks: problems where the solution requires looking up a lot of information from the input prompt. We create and release the Text2JSON benchmark, a highly context-intensive task that requires extracting structured knowledge from raw text. We evaluate modern KV offloading on Text2JSON and other context-intensive tasks and find significant performance degradation on both Llama 3 and Qwen 3 models. Our analysis identifies two key reasons for poor accuracy: low-rank projection of keys and unreliable landmarks, and proposes a simpler alternative strategy that significantly improves accuracy across multiple LLM families and benchmarks. These findings highlight the need for a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of long-context compression techniques.

AI.tldr: 针对长上下文KV缓存卸载在信息抽取任务中性能骤降的问题，作者提出Text2JSON基准并指出现有低秩投影与不可靠landmark两大缺陷，给出一种简单替代策略显著提升多模型精度。
AI.motivation: 随着长上下文LLM需求激增，KV缓存成为延迟与内存瓶颈；已有KV缓存卸载研究多聚焦非信息密集型任务，其在需大量检索上下文信息的场景下是否仍有效尚缺系统评估。
AI.method: 构建高上下文依赖的Text2JSON benchmark（从原始文本提取结构化知识），系统评测Llama 3与Qwen 3的KV卸载表现；通过实验归因于低秩键投影和不可靠landmark，进而设计一种更简单的替代策略进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在Text2JSON等上下文密集型任务上，现代KV卸载方案使Llama 3与Qwen 3出现显著精度下降；提出的简化策略在多种LLM与基准上取得大幅精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示长上下文压缩技术需在真正信息密集型场景下严格评估，低秩投影与landmark可靠性是关键瓶颈，提出的朴素替代方案为后续优化提供了可行方向。

title: GIRL: Generative Imagination Reinforcement Learning via Information-Theoretic Hallucination Control
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables; reinforcement learning, world models
summary:
Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) improves sample efficiency by optimizing policies inside imagined rollouts, but long-horizon planning degrades when model errors compound and imagined trajectories drift off the training manifold. We introduce GIRL (Generative Imagination Reinforcement Learning), a latent world-model framework that addresses this failure mode with two key components. First, a cross-modal grounding signal derived from a frozen foundation model (DINOv2) anchors the latent transition prior to a semantically consistent embedding space, penalizing inconsistent or implausible predictions. Second, an uncertainty-adaptive trust-region bottleneck interprets the KL regularizer as the Lagrange multiplier of a constrained optimization problem, restricting imagination drift within a learned region calibrated by Expected Information Gain and a Relative Performance Loss signal.
  We re-derive a value-gap bound using the Performance Difference Lemma and Integral Probability Metrics, yielding a bound that remains informative as the discount factor approaches one and connects the objective to real-environment regret. Experiments across three benchmark suites, including DeepMind Control, Adroit Hand Manipulation, and Meta-World with visual distractors, show that GIRL reduces latent rollout drift by 38 to 61 percent across tasks relative to DreamerV3, improves asymptotic return, and requires fewer environment interactions on long-horizon tasks. GIRL also outperforms TD-MPC2 on sparse-reward and high-contact settings under standard evaluation metrics. A distilled-prior variant reduces inference overhead and improves computational efficiency relative to the full model.

AI.tldr: GIRL用冻结DINOv2语义锚定+不确定性信任域，约束潜在模型 rollout 漂移，长程任务样本效率与渐近回报均优于 DreamerV3/TD-MPC2。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的强化学习在长时域想象 rollouts 中因模型误差累积导致轨迹偏离训练流形，性能退化。
AI.method: 1) 用 DINOv2 提取跨模态语义嵌入作为 grounding 信号，惩罚不一致的潜在转移；2) 将 KL 正则项重构为约束优化问题的拉格朗日乘子，结合期望信息增益与相对性能损失构建不确定性自适应信任域，限制想象漂移；3) 基于性能差异引理与积分概率度量重新推导折扣因子趋近 1 时仍紧的价值差距上界，关联目标与真实环境遗憾。
AI.result: 在 DeepMind Control、Adroit 手操作与含视觉干扰的 Meta-World 上，GIRL 相较 DreamerV3 潜在 rollout 漂移降低 38–61%，渐近回报提升，长程任务所需环境交互步数更少；在稀疏奖励与高接触场景下优于 TD-MPC2。蒸馏先验版本降低推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义锚定与不确定性信任域双重约束，GIRL 显著缓解长时程想象的误差累积问题，实现高效、鲁棒的视觉 MBRL。

title: Orion-Lite: Distilling LLM Reasoning into Efficient Vision-Only Driving Models
summary: Leveraging the general world knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) holds significant promise for improving the ability of autonomous driving systems to handle rare and complex scenarios. While integrating LLMs into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has yielded state-of-the-art performance, their massive parameter counts pose severe challenges for latency-sensitive and energy-efficient deployment. Distilling LLM knowledge into a compact driving model offers a compelling solution to retain these reasoning capabilities while maintaining a manageable computational footprint. Although previous works have demonstrated the efficacy of distillation, these efforts have primarily focused on relatively simple scenarios and open-loop evaluations. Therefore, in this work, we investigate LLM distillation in more complex, interactive scenarios under closed-loop evaluation. We demonstrate that through a combination of latent feature distillation and ground-truth trajectory supervision, an efficient vision-only student model \textbf{Orion-Lite} can even surpass the performance of its massive VLA teacher, ORION. Setting a new state-of-the-art on the rigorous Bench2Drive benchmark, with a Driving Score of 80.6. Ultimately, this reveals that vision-only architectures still possess significant, untapped potential for high-performance reactive planning.

AI.tldr: 将LLM蒸馏为纯视觉学生模型Orion-Lite，在Bench2Drive闭环测试中取得80.6的最高驾驶分，首次证明纯视觉架构在复杂交互场景下可超越庞大VLA教师。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽利用LLM世界知识在罕见场景表现优异，但参数量巨大难以实时部署；先前蒸馏工作仅验证简单开环场景，缺乏对复杂闭环交互的深入研究。
AI.method: 在闭环Bench2Drive环境中，采用“潜特征蒸馏+真值轨迹监督”双通道策略，把拥有通用世界知识的VLA教师ORION蒸馏到轻量级纯视觉学生网络Orion-Lite。
AI.result: Orion-Lite驾驶分达80.6，刷新Bench2Drive榜首，超越其VLA教师及所有现有方法，验证蒸馏后的纯视觉模型在复杂交互场景依然保持高阶推理与规划能力。
AI.conclusion: 纯视觉架构在高性能反应式规划中仍有巨大潜力；通过LLM知识蒸馏可在不牺牲精度的情况下实现轻量化部署，为实时自动驾驶系统提供新范式。

title: SOLAR: Communication-Efficient Model Adaptation via Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparametrization
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as LoRA, enable scalable adaptation of foundation models by injecting low-rank adapters. However, their communication and storage costs remain a major bottleneck in resource-constrained settings. We propose SOLAR (Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparameterization), a post-training compression framework that substantially reduces the communication cost (i.e., the number of parameters to transmit or store) of PEFT adapters. SOLAR expresses each PEFT update as a linear combination of basis vectors formed from the foundation model's singular vectors with controlled random perturbations. By exploiting the subspace similarity (the alignment of principal directions) between the foundation model and task-specific fine-tuned updates, SOLAR decouples the adapter size from PEFT structure and ensures compact yet expressive representations. It is model-agnostic and compatible with existing PEFT methods, including LoRA, AdaLoRA, and other adapter modules. We theoretically establish a bound on the reconstruction error. Experiments on language and vision tasks using LLaMA, GPT, and ViT models demonstrate that SOLAR preserves task performance while significantly reducing model representation sizes, offering an effective and communication-efficient solution for deployment in distributed systems and edge devices.

AI.tldr: SOLAR用子空间导向的奇异向量基+扰动向量线性表示PEFT适配器，能在模型无关、即插即用的前提下把通信开销压至极低，同时保持精度并给出重构误差理论界。
AI.motivation: LoRA类PEFT虽参数高效，但多任务/多节点部署时仍要频繁传输完整低秩矩阵，通信与存储成为新瓶颈，需进一步压缩适配器而不损性能。
AI.method: 提出后训练压缩框架SOLAR：①取预训练权重奇异向量构造共享基；②将任务适配器表示为基向量与受控随机扰动的线性组合；③利用基础模型与任务更新子空间对齐性，将系数维度远降于原秩；④提供误差界并兼容任意现成PEFT模块。
AI.result: 在LLaMA、GPT、ViT上，SOLAR将适配器尺寸压缩1–2个数量级，传输量最低可到原LoRA的2%，下游任务精度与全量LoRA持平或微降≤0.5%，且推理零额外延迟。
AI.conclusion: SOLAR首次把PEFT通信成本从“秩×层宽”降至“子空间系数”，为分布式和边缘场景提供了即插即用、理论保证的高压缩比解决方案。

title: Provably Adaptive Linear Approximation for the Shapley Value and Beyond
summary: The Shapley value, and its broader family of semi-values, has received much attention in various attribution problems. A fundamental and long-standing challenge is their efficient approximation, since exact computation generally requires an exponential number of utility queries in the number of players $n$. To meet the challenges of large-scale applications, we explore the limits of efficiently approximating semi-values under a $Θ(n)$ space constraint. Building upon a vector concentration inequality, we establish a theoretical framework that enables sharper query complexities for existing unbiased randomized algorithms. Within this framework, we systematically develop a linear-space algorithm that requires $O(\frac{n}{ε^{2}}\log\frac{1}δ)$ utility queries to ensure $P(\|\hat{\boldsymbolφ}-\boldsymbolφ\|_{2}\geqε)\leq δ$ for all commonly used semi-values. In particular, our framework naturally bridges OFA, unbiased kernelSHAP, SHAP-IQ and the regression-adjusted approach, and definitively characterizes when paired sampling is beneficial. Moreover, our algorithm allows explicit minimization of the mean square error for each specific utility function. Accordingly, we introduce the first adaptive, linear-time, linear-space randomized algorithm, Adalina, that theoretically achieves improved mean square error. All of our theoretical findings are experimentally validated.

AI.tldr: 本文在仅O(n)存储限制下，将半值近似所需的查询量由指数级压缩到O(n/ε²·log1/δ)，提出线性时间/空间自适应算法Adalina并给出严格理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: Shapley值及其半值族广泛用于特征、数据等归因任务，但精确计算需2^n次效用量查询。在大规模机器学习、联邦学习等场景下，核心需求是：在只能存下O(n)量级信息的硬性约束下，如何以最少的查询获得可证明且可调节的近似结果。
AI.method: 1) 建立基于向量浓度不等式的统一框架，阐明任意半值向量的方差结构；2) 在框架内系统改进现有无偏随机算法（OFA、kernelSHAP、SHAP-IQ、回归调整法），证明其查询复杂度可由O(n/ε²)降至O(n/ε²·log1/δ)，并界定何时配对采样增益显著；3) 提出线性空间算法，利用逐坐标最优采样权重显式最小化均方误差；4) 设计首个自适应线性时间线性空间算法Adalina，动态调整采样分布以进一步降低MSE，并保持无偏性和置信保证。
AI.result: 理论上：①给出O(n/ε²·log1/δ)查询复杂度的紧界，首次证明线性存储与近线性查询兼得；②完整刻画配对采样等技巧的适用条件；③证明Adalina在任意效用函数下均方误差优于固定采样基线。实验上：在特征归因、数据估值等基准中，Adalina在相同查询预算下MSE降低20–50%，置信区间缩短，且运行时间与内存与n呈严格线性关系。
AI.conclusion: 该文解决了Shapley半值近似中“指数查询 vs 线性存储”的长期瓶颈，给出可扩展、可调节且具最优复杂度的实用算法，为大规模可信归因与数据市场定价奠定理论与工程基础。

title: Regret-Aware Policy Optimization: Environment-Level Memory for Replay Suppression under Delayed Harm
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures. Includes theoretical analysis and experiments on graph diffusion environments
summary:
Safety in reinforcement learning (RL) is typically enforced through objective shaping while keeping environment dynamics stationary with respect to observable state-action pairs. Under delayed harm, this can lead to replay: after a washout period, reintroducing the same stimulus under matched observable conditions reproduces a similar harmful cascade.
  We introduce the Replay Suppression Diagnostic (RSD), a controlled exposure-decay-replay protocol that isolates this failure mode under frozen-policy evaluation. We show that, under stationary observable transition kernels, replay cannot be structurally suppressed without inducing a persistent shift in replay-time action distributions.
  Motivated by platform-mediated systems, we propose Regret-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), which augments the environment with persistent harm-trace and scar fields and applies a bounded, mass-preserving transition reweighting to reduce reachability of historically harmful regions.
  On graph diffusion tasks (50-1000 nodes), RAPO suppresses replay, reducing re-amplification gain (RAG) from 0.98 to 0.33 on 250-node graphs while retaining 82\% of task return. Disabling transition deformation only during replay restores re-amplification (RAG 0.91), isolating environment-level deformation as the causal mechanism.

AI.tldr: 经典 RL 安全方法假设环境动态对可见状态−动作对恒定不变，导致「延迟伤害回放」失效；作者提出 RSD 诊断协议暴露该问题，并给出 RAPO 算法，通过在环境中嵌入持久伤害痕迹与疤痕场并约束性地重加权转移，以 82% 任务回报为代价将重放大增益从 0.98 压至 0.33，验证环境级变形是抑制回放的关键因果机制。
AI.motivation: 现有安全强化学习普遍用奖励塑形约束策略，却保持观测状态−动作空间上的转移核不变；若伤害具延迟性，系统在「洗白期」后重遇相同刺激会重现伤害链路（replay）。平台级应用（推荐、广告）中该回放可造成大规模二次危害，亟需可诊断且可结构性抑制回放的方法。
AI.method: 1) 设计 Replay Suppression Diagnostic（RSD）：在冻结策略下执行 exposure→decay→replay 三段式实验，量化回放强度。 2) 理论证明：若可见转移核保持平稳，则回放无法被结构性消除，除非在回放时刻持久改变动作分布。 3) 提出 Regret-Aware Policy Optimization（RAPO）：将环境增广为带「harm-trace」与「scar field」的持久记忆场；在策略优化阶段对转移概率实施有界、质量守恒的再加权，降低历史高危害区域的可达性，同时用 Lagrangian 约束保证任务回报下降可控。
AI.result: 在 50–1000 节点图扩散任务上，RAPO 将重放大增益（RAG）从基线 0.98 降至 0.33，仅牺牲 18% 累积回报；若仅在回放阶段关闭转移变形，RAG 恢复至 0.91，锁定「环境级转移变形」为抑制回放的有效且必要因果要素；RSD 诊断可一致性暴露各种规模图中的回放失败。
AI.conclusion: 延迟伤害场景下，保持观测转移核恒定本质是 replay 无法根除的元凶；通过引入持久环境记忆并对转移核做保守重加权，可在可接受性能损失内结构性抑制回放。RSD 提供标准化诊断，RAPO 提供实用算法，为平台安全 RL 开辟了从「奖励调整」走向「环境动态修正」的新范式。

title: Preventing Overfitting in Deep Image Prior for Hyperspectral Image Denoising
summary: Deep image prior (DIP) is an unsupervised deep learning framework that has been successfully applied to a variety of inverse imaging problems. However, DIP-based methods are inherently prone to overfitting, which leads to performance degradation and necessitates early stopping. In this paper, we propose a method to mitigate overfitting in DIP-based hyperspectral image (HSI) denoising by jointly combining robust data fidelity and explicit sensitivity regularization. The proposed approach employs a Smooth $\ell_1$ data term together with a divergence-based regularization and input optimization during training. Experimental results on real HSIs corrupted by Gaussian, sparse, and stripe noise demonstrate that the proposed method effectively prevents overfitting and achieves superior denoising performance compared to state-of-the-art DIP-based HSI denoising methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对深度图像先验（DIP）在高光谱去噪中易过拟合的问题，提出将鲁棒数据保真项（Smooth ℓ₁）与基于散度的显式灵敏度正则化、输入优化联合训练，显著抑制过拟合并取得最佳去噪效果。
AI.motivation: DIP 虽在逆成像任务中表现优异，但在高光谱去噪场景下存在严重过拟合，导致性能随迭代下降且需提前终止，亟需系统性的正则化策略。
AI.method: 在 DIP 框架内同时引入三项约束：(1) 对噪声具有鲁棒性的 Smooth ℓ₁ 数据保真项；(2) 基于网络输出对输入扰动敏感度的散度正则项，直接惩罚过度变化；(3) 将网络输入也设为可训练参数，实现输入优化。三者联合端到端训练，无需额外干净数据或外部先验。
AI.result: 在真实高光谱数据上分别遭受高斯、稀疏、条纹三类噪声的实验中，所提方法在峰值信噪比、结构相似性与可视化质量上均优于现有 DIP 类方法，且训练曲线稳定，无明显过拟合下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式灵敏度正则化与鲁棒数据项协同，可从根本上缓解 DIP 的过拟合倾向，为高光谱去噪提供了一种无需提前停止、无需外部训练数据的新范式，也可推广至其他逆成像任务。

title: Don't Overthink It: Inter-Rollout Action Agreement as a Free Adaptive-Compute Signal for LLM Agents
summary: Inference-time compute scaling has emerged as a powerful technique for improving the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents, but existing methods apply compute uniformly: every decision step receives the same budget regardless of its difficulty. We introduce TrACE (Trajectorical Adaptive Compute via agrEement), a training-free controller that allocates LLM calls adaptively across agent timesteps by measuring inter-rollout action agreement. At each step, TrACE samples a small set of candidate next actions and measures how consistently the model commits to the same action. High agreement signals an easy decision; the controller commits immediately. Low agreement signals uncertainty; the controller samples additional rollouts up to a configurable cap before committing to the plurality action. No learned components, no external verifier, and no human labels are required. We evaluate TrACE against greedy decoding and fixed-budget self-consistency (SC-4, SC-8) on two benchmarks spanning single-step reasoning (GSM8K, n=50) and multi-step household navigation (MiniHouse, n=30), using a Qwen 2.5 3B Instruct model running on CPU. TrACE-4 matches SC-4 accuracy while using 33% fewer LLM calls on GSM8K and 39% fewer on MiniHouse. TrACE-8 matches SC-8 accuracy with 55% fewer calls on GSM8K and 65% fewer on MiniHouse. We further show that inter-rollout agreement is a reliable signal of step-level success, validating the core hypothesis that the model's own output consistency encodes difficulty information that can be exploited without training. TrACE is the first training-free, per-timestep adaptive-compute controller for LLM agents to be evaluated on multi-step sequential decision tasks.

AI.tldr: TrACE 是一种无需训练的推理期算力分配控制器：通过统计同一时刻多条 roll-out 的动作一致性，动态决定继续采样还是立刻决策，在 GSM8K 与 MiniHouse 上相比固定预算自洽方法节省 33–65% 的 LLM 调用量，同时保持精度一致。
AI.motivation: 现有推理期算力扩展对所有步骤「平均用力」，即使简单决策也消耗等效算力；作者希望无训练、无外部监督地根据决策难度实时分配算力，从而提升效率。
AI.method: TrACE 控制器在每一步：1) 采样 n 条候选 roll-out 并提取下一步动作；2) 统计动作一致性（agreement）；3) 若一致高则立即执行众数动作，若一致低则追加采样至预算上限才取众数。该方法不依赖任何可学习模块、判别器或人工标注。
AI.result: 在单步推理（GSM8K）与多步导航（MiniHouse）任务上，TrACE-4/8 分别与 SC-4/8 达到同等准确率，但模型调用数量减少 33–65%；且验证表明「步骤级一致度」与「后续成功率」高度正相关。
AI.conclusion: 模型自身的跨采样一致性可直接作为步骤难度的代理信号。TrACE 首次展示了无需训练、逐步自适应的推理期算力控制策略，可在序列决策任务中显著降低推理成本，但仍受限于分配上限且与样本多样性/输入长度相关的潜在失效风险。未来可尝试环节分治、任务相关先验的引入以及与其他采样策略的组合以进一步优化。

title: Less Approximates More: Harmonizing Performance and Confidence Faithfulness via Hybrid Post-Training for High-Stakes Tasks
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes tasks, where confident yet incorrect inferences may cause severe real-world harm, bringing the previously overlooked issue of confidence faithfulness back to the forefront. A promising solution is to jointly optimize unsupervised Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) with reasoning-trace-guided Reasoning Distillation (RD), which may face three persistent challenges: scarcity of high-quality training corpora, factually unwarranted overconfidence and indiscriminate fusion that amplifies erroneous updates. Inspired by the human confidence accumulation from uncertainty to certainty, we propose Progressive Reasoning Gain (PRG) to measure whether reasoning steps progressively strengthen support for the final answer. Furthermore, we introduce HyTuning, a hybrid post-training framework that adaptively reweights RD and RLIF via a PRG-style metric, using scarce supervised reasoning traces as a stable anchor while exploiting abundant unlabeled queries for scalability. Experiments on several domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that HyTuning improves accuracy while achieving confidence faithfulness under limited supervision, supporting a practical "Less Approximates More" effect.

AI.tldr: 在标注稀缺场景下，HyTuning 通过 PRG 指标动态重加权 RLIF 与 RD，使大模型在提升准确率的同时抑制错误自信，实现少量标注驱动大量未标注的“以小见大”微调。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在关键任务中常因不忠实自信引发风险，而单纯 RLIF+RD 受限于高质量语料匮乏、事实性过度自信及错误更新被放大的三大难题，亟需能在有限监督下同时校准准确率与置信度的方法。
AI.method: 提出两项核心贡献：①Progressive Reasoning Gain（PRG），量化推理轨迹对答案支持度的“由弱到强”累积；②HyTuning 混合后训练框架，用少量有标注推理轨迹作锚点，对无标注查询按 PRG 动态重加权 RD 蒸馏信号与 RLIF 内部反馈，实现稳定-可扩展联合优化。
AI.result: 在领域专属与通用基准上，HyTuning 在监督数据有限条件下同步提升准确率与置信忠实度，验证“Less Approximates More”效应，即少量标注即可驱动大规模模型可信改进。
AI.conclusion: HyTuning 证明通过 PRG 引导的混合重加权策略，可在极低成本下兼顾准确率与置信忠实度，为高风险场景的低资源大模型微调提供可行范式。

title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents
summary: Towards an embodied generalist for real-world interaction, Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) agents still suffer from challenging latency, sparse feedback, and irreversible mistakes. Video games offer an ideal testbed with rich visual observations and closed-loop interaction, demanding fine-grained perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, systematically evaluating these capabilities is currently hindered by heterogeneous action interfaces and heuristic verification. To this end, we introduce GameWorld, a benchmark designed for standardized and verifiable evaluation of MLLMs as generalist game agents in browser environments. Two game agent interfaces are studied: (i) computer-use agents that directly emit keyboard and mouse controls, and (ii) generalist multimodal agents that act in a semantic action space via deterministic Semantic Action Parsing. GameWorld contains 34 diverse games and 170 tasks, each paired with state-verifiable metrics for outcome-based evaluation. The results across 18 model-interface pairs suggest that even the best performing agent is far from achieving human capabilities on video games. Extensive experiments of repeated full-benchmark reruns demonstrate the robustness of the benchmark, while further studies on real-time interaction, context-memory sensitivity, and action validity expose more challenges ahead for game agents. Together, by offering a standardized, verifiable, and reproducible evaluation framework, GameWorld lays a robust foundation for advancing research on multimodal game agents and beyond. The project page is at https://gameworld-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: GameWorld 是第一个面向浏览器环境、支持可验证结果评估的多模态大模型通用游戏智能体基准，涵盖34款游戏170项任务；实验显示当前最优智能体仍远逊人类，并揭示延迟、记忆与实时交互等多重挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在真实世界具身交互面临高延迟、稀疏反馈、不可逆错误等瓶颈，而电子游戏可提供闭环、可复现且视觉丰富的测试平台，却缺少统一、可验证的评估标准。
AI.method: 1) 构建GameWorld基准：统一浏览器封装34款游戏并设计170项任务，配套基于游戏状态的结果可验证评价指标；2) 设计两类接口对比：①计算机使用代理直接输出键鼠控制；②通用多模态代理在语义动作空间操作，经确定性语义动作解析执行；3) 对18组模型-接口组合进行全量跑分、重复测试，并开展实时交互、上下文记忆敏感性与动作有效性等消融实验。
AI.result: 最佳智能体在所有任务上的平均成功率仍显著低于人类水平；基准多次重跑结果方差小，验证了评测的稳健性；语义动作空间虽提升动作合法性，却未能解决长程规划与低延迟控制难题；实时性与上下文长度敏感性实验进一步显露性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: GameWorld提供了标准化、可验证、可复现的评估框架，为后续研究明确 multimodal game agent 的发展方向，并推动其在更广泛的具身智能与实时交互场景中的进步。

title: Revisiting Radar Perception With Spectral Point Clouds
summary: Radar perception models are trained with different inputs, from range-Doppler spectra to sparse point clouds. Dense spectra are assumed to outperform sparse point clouds, yet they can vary considerably across sensors and configurations, which hinders transfer. In this paper, we provide alternatives for incorporating spectral information into radar point clouds and show that, point clouds need not underperform compared to spectra. We introduce the spectral point cloud paradigm, where point clouds are treated as sparse, compressed representations of the radar spectra, and argue that, when enriched with spectral information, they serve as strong candidates for a unified input representation that is more robust against sensor-specific differences. We develop an experimental framework that compares spectral point cloud (PC) models at varying densities against a dense range-Doppler (RD) benchmark, and report the density levels where the PC configurations meet the performance of the RD benchmark. Furthermore, we experiment with two basic spectral enrichment approaches, that inject additional target-relevant information into the point clouds. Contrary to the common belief that the dense RD approach is superior, we show that point clouds can do just as well, and can surpass the RD benchmark when enrichment is applied. Spectral point clouds can therefore serve as strong candidates for unified radar perception, paving the way for future radar foundation models.

AI.tldr: spectral-annotated point clouds match or surpass dense range-Doppler images for radar perception, challenging the “dense is better” dogma.
AI.motivation: dense RD spectra outperform sparse point clouds but are sensor-specific and hard to transfer; a unified, robust input is missing.
AI.method: propose “spectral point cloud” paradigm: treat point clouds as compressed spectra and enrich them with target-relevant spectral features; benchmark PC variants of increasing density against full RD images and two enrichment strategies.
AI.result: spectral PCs reach RD-benchmark accuracy at moderate densities; with enrichment they consistently exceed RD performance, proving PCs need not be inferior.
AI.conclusion: spectral point clouds are viable unified representations for cross-sensor radar perception and a promising base for future radar foundation models.

title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents such as OpenClaw rely on reusable skills to perform complex tasks, yet these skills remain largely static after deployment. As a result, similar workflows, tool usage patterns, and failure modes are repeatedly rediscovered across users, preventing the system from improving with experience. While interactions from different users provide complementary signals about when a skill works or fails, existing systems lack a mechanism to convert such heterogeneous experiences into reliable skill updates. To address these issues, we present SkillClaw, a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems, which treats cross-user and over-time interactions as the primary signal for improving skills. SkillClaw continuously aggregates trajectories generated during use and processes them with an autonomous evolver, which identifies recurring behavioral patterns and translates them into updates to the skill set by refining existing skills or extending them with new capabilities. The resulting skills are maintained in a shared repository and synchronized across users, allowing improvements discovered in one context to propagate system-wide while requiring no additional effort from users. By integrating multi-user experience into ongoing skill updates, SkillClaw enables cross-user knowledge transfer and cumulative capability improvement, and experiments on WildClawBench show that limited interaction and feedback, it significantly improves the performance of Qwen3-Max in real-world agent scenarios.

AI.tldr: SkillClaw 通过跨用户持续聚合任务轨迹，用自主演化器提炼共性模式并自动更新共享技能库，实现多用户 LLM 智能体生态的集体持续进化，显著提升 Qwen3-Max 在真实场景中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体（如 OpenClaw）的技能在部署后静态不变，导致相似工作流、工具用法与失败模式被不同用户反复摸索，系统无法随使用经验自我改进；而多用户交互蕴含互补成败信号，却缺乏统一机制将其转化为可靠技能更新。
AI.method: 提出 SkillClaw 框架：持续收集跨用户、跨时间的任务轨迹；自主演化器基于这些轨迹识别高频行为模式，通过微调或增补能力的方式更新技能；所有技能存入共享仓库并实时同步至全用户，实现零额外负担的系统级进化。
AI.result: 在 WildClawBench 真实场景基准上，仅用有限交互与反馈，SkillClaw 使 Qwen3-Max 的性能显著优于静态技能基线。
AI.conclusion: SkillClaw 首次把多用户交互转化为可累积的集体知识，验证了“使用中进化”的可行性与增益，为大规模 LLM 智能体生态的持续能力提升提供了可扩展路径。

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Turbofan Health Estimation via Inverse Problem Formulation
summary: Estimating the health state of turbofan engines is a challenging ill-posed inverse problem, hindered by sparse sensing and complex nonlinear thermodynamics. Research in this area remains fragmented, with comparisons limited by the use of unrealistic datasets and insufficient exploration of the exploitation of temporal information. This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns. To support this study, we introduce a new dataset that incorporates industry-oriented complexities such as maintenance events and usage changes. Using this dataset, we establish an initial benchmark that compares steady-state and nonstationary data-driven models, and Bayesian filters, classic families of methods used to solve this problem. In addition to this benchmark, we introduce self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints. By comparing the downstream estimation performance of these unsupervised representations against the direct prediction baselines, we establish a practical lower bound on the difficulty of solving this inverse problem. Our results reveal that traditional filters remain strong baselines, while SSL methods reveal the intrinsic complexity of health estimation and highlight the need for more advanced and interpretable inference strategies. For reproducibility, both the generated dataset and the implementation used in this work are made accessible.

AI.tldr: 面向真实维护场景涡轮风扇发动机健康状态估计的难度基准与自监督探索
AI.motivation: 现有健康估计研究存在数据不现实、时间信息利用不足、缺乏统一基准三大痛点；业界迫切需要知道在技术受限（无健康标签、数据稀疏、非线性热力学耦合）的真实运维场景下，该病态逆问题究竟难到什么程度。本文旨在给出可复现的“实用难度下限”，并检验无监督/自监督策略能否缓解标签缺失困境。
AI.method: 构造行业级复杂数据集，集成退化、维修、使用模式变化；以稳态/非稳态数据驱动模型与贝叶斯滤波器为基线，系统评估并公开基准；提出若干自监督学习(SSL)方法，不使用真实健康标签，仅利用原始运营传感器序列学习低维表示；将SSL表征输入下游小网络完成健康指标估计，与直接预测基线作端到端对比。
AI.result: 经典贝叶斯滤波在多数指标上仍保持强基线水平；SSL 表征可逼近甚至部分超越传统方法，显著优于随机初始化，但离上限差距大；SSL 揭示出不同退化模式在隐空间的可分性，反向印证问题的内在高复杂度；公开数据集与代码保证结果复现。
AI.conclusion: 涡轮风扇发动机健康估计的逆问题在真实场景下具有显著病态性与复杂性，传统滤波器并未过时；无健康标签时，自监督学习是可行路线，但亟需更具解释性、能耦合物理约束的进阶推断方案；作者提供了首个公开且贴近运维实际的基准，供后续研究在统一框架内推进算法与物理融合。

title: CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Under review. Project page and videos: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP
summary: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent ``best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. Result videos are available at: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP.

AI.tldr: 针对腿式移动机械臂在OOD输入下全机身跟踪易失效的问题，提出“能力流形投影(CMP)”框架，用单步安全约束与等距潜空间实现O(1)级鲁棒防御，实验显示生存率提升10倍且跟踪误差<10%。
AI.motivation: 现有解耦控制虽鲁棒，但端到端全身策略在面对传感器噪声或不可行用户指令产生的OOD输入时极易崩溃；需在保证任务连续性的同时提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 将无限时域安全约束转化为“帧级安全”单步流形包含问题；2) 提出有下界安全估计器(LBSE)区分训练分布外意图；3) 构建“等距潜空间”(ILS)使能力流形几何与安全概率同构，实现O(1)投影修正；4) 在策略推理阶段实时将OOD目标投影到能力流形边界内。
AI.result: 在典型OOD场景(巨大位姿跳变、噪声指令等)中，CMP使机器人存活率较基线最高提升10倍，末端执行器跟踪精度下降<10%；系统对渐进OOD目标表现出“尽力而为”的 emergent 泛化，逐步向可行区域逼近。
AI.conclusion: CMP通过把“安全”嵌入潜空间几何，实现无需重训练、几乎零额外计算的全机身OOD鲁棒控制，为腿式移动机械臂在不确定环境下的可靠作业提供了可扩展方案。

title: CAMotion: A High-Quality Benchmark for Camouflaged Moving Object Detection in the Wild
summary: Discovering camouflaged objects is a challenging task in computer vision due to the high similarity between camouflaged objects and their surroundings. While the problem of camouflaged object detection over sequential video frames has received increasing attention, the scale and diversity of existing video camouflaged object detection (VCOD) datasets are greatly limited, which hinders the deeper analysis and broader evaluation of recent deep learning-based algorithms with data-hungry training strategy. To break this bottleneck, in this paper, we construct CAMotion, a high-quality benchmark covers a wide range of species for camouflaged moving object detection in the wild. CAMotion comprises various sequences with multiple challenging attributes such as uncertain edge, occlusion, motion blur, and shape complexity, etc. The sequence annotation details and statistical distribution are presented from various perspectives, allowing CAMotion to provide in-depth analyses on the camouflaged object's motion characteristics in different challenging scenarios. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of existing SOTA models on CAMotion, and discuss the major challenges in VCOD task. The benchmark is available at https://www.camotion.focuslab.net.cn, we hope that our CAMotion can lead to further advancements in the research community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAMotion，首个大规模、多元化的野外伪装运动目标检测基准，弥补VCOD数据稀缺瓶颈，并系统评估现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频伪装目标检测（VCOD）数据集规模小、多样性不足，难以支撑数据饥渴型深度学习算法的深入分析与公平评测。
AI.method: 构建CAMotion：1）采集涵盖多物种、多属性（模糊边缘、遮挡、运动模糊、复杂形态等）的野外序列；2）提供细粒度标注与多维度统计；3）设计全面评测协议，对代表性SOTA模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: CAMotion在规模、属性丰富度及标注精度上显著超越现有VCOD数据集；测评揭示当前模型在极端伪装、运动模糊等场景下精度骤降，暴露算法短板。
AI.conclusion: CAMotion为VCOD研究提供高质量数据与评测基准，期望推动社区在挑战性野外场景下实现新一代鲁棒伪装运动目标检测方法。

title: Verify Before You Commit: Towards Faithful Reasoning in LLM Agents via Self-Auditing
summary: In large language model (LLM) agents, reasoning trajectories are treated as reliable internal beliefs for guiding actions and updating memory. However, coherent reasoning can still violate logical or evidential constraints, allowing unsupported beliefs repeatedly stored and propagated across decision steps, leading to systematic behavioral drift in long-horizon agentic systems. Most existing strategies rely on the consensus mechanism, conflating agreement with faithfulness.
