In this paper, inspired by the vulnerability of unfaithful intermediate reasoning trajectories, we propose \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{A}udited \textbf{Ve}rified \textbf{R}easoning (\textsc{SAVeR}), a novel framework that enforces verification over internal belief states within the agent before action commitment, achieving faithful reasoning. Concretely, we structurally generate persona-based diverse candidate beliefs for selection under a faithfulness-relevant structure space. To achieve reasoning faithfulness, we perform adversarial auditing to localize violations and repair through constraint-guided minimal interventions under verifiable acceptance criteria. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reasoning faithfulness while preserving competitive end-task performance.

title: TTVS: Boosting Self-Exploring Reinforcement Learning via Test-time Variational Synthesis
summary: Despite significant advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) driven by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), this paradigm is fundamentally limited in specialized or novel domains where such supervision is prohibitively expensive or unavailable, posing a key challenge for test-time adaptation. While existing test-time methods offer a potential solution, they are constrained by learning from static query sets, risking overfitting to textual patterns. To address this gap, we introduce Test-Time Variational Synthesis (TTVS), a novel framework that enables LRMs to self-evolve by dynamically augmenting the training stream from unlabeled test queries. TTVS comprises two synergistic modules: (1) Online Variational Synthesis, which transforms static test queries into a dynamic stream of diverse, semantically-equivalent variations, enforcing the model to learn underlying problem logic rather than superficial patterns; (2) Test-time Hybrid Exploration, which balances accuracy-driven exploitation with consistency-driven exploration across synthetic variants. Extensive experiments show TTVS yields superior performance across eight model architectures. Notably, using only unlabeled test-time data, TTVS not only surpasses other test-time adaptation methods but also outperforms state-of-the-art supervised RL-based techniques trained on vast, high-quality labeled data.

AI.tldr: TTVS让大推理模型在测试阶段利用无标注查询自动生成等价变体，仅用测试数据就超越有监督强化学习基线，无需人工奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 强化学习依赖可验证奖励，但在专业或新兴领域获取标注代价极高；现有测试阶段方法只能静态拟合查询文本，易过拟合表面模式，无法在线自我进化。
AI.method: 提出Test-Time Variational Synthesis (TTVS)：(1) Online Variational Synthesis把每个测试查询动态扩展成语义等价、形式多样的变体序列，迫使模型学习底层逻辑而非字面特征；(2) Test-time Hybrid Exploration在合成变体上兼顾“精度利用”与“一致性探索”，在线更新模型。
AI.result: 在8种架构、多项推理任务上，TTVS仅依赖无标注测试数据，效果优于所有测试阶段适应方法，也超过使用大规模高质量标注训练的最先进强化学习基线。
AI.conclusion: TTVS打破“可验证奖励”瓶颈，实现无监督测试时刻持续进化，为推理模型走向开放领域部署提供可扩展路径。

title: When Switching Algorithms Helps: A Theoretical Study of Online Algorithm Selection
summary:
Online algorithm selection (OAS) aims to adapt the optimization process to changes in the fitness landscape and is expected to outperform any single algorithm from a given portfolio. Although this expectation is supported by numerous empirical studies, there are currently no theoretical results proving that OAS can yield asymptotic speedups (apart from some artificial examples for hyper-heuristics). Moreover, theory-based guidelines for when and how to switch between algorithms are largely missing.
  In this paper, we present the first theoretical example in which switching between two algorithms -- the $(1+λ)$ EA and the $(1+(λ,λ))$ GA -- solves the OneMax problem asymptotically faster than either algorithm used in isolation. We show that an appropriate choice of population sizes for the two algorithms allows the optimum to be reached in $O(n\log\log n)$ expected time, faster than the $Θ(n\sqrt{\frac{\log n \log\log\log n}{\log\log n}})$ runtime of the best of these two algorithms with optimally tuned parameters.
  We first establish this bound under an idealized switching rule that changes from the $(1+λ)$ to the $(1+(λ,λ))$ GA at the optimal time. We then propose a realistic switching strategy that achieves the same performance. Our analysis combines fixed-start and fixed-target perspectives, illustrating how different algorithms dominate at different stages of the optimization process. This approach offers a promising path toward a deeper theoretical understanding of OAS.

AI.tldr: 首次证明在线算法切换可为OneMax带来严格渐进加速：把$(1+λ)$ EA 与 $(1+(λ,λ))$ GA 按本文策略交替使用，可降至 $O(n\log\log n)$，优于任一算法单独最优调参的 $Θ(n\sqrt{\frac{\log n \log\log\log n}{\log\log n}})$，并给出可实现的切换规则。
AI.motivation: 尽管经验研究屡示在线算法选择(OAS)能提升性能，但除极人工的超启发例子外，尚无理论工作证明其可带来渐进加速，亦缺乏何时/如何切换的通用指南。
AI.method: 针对OneMax问题，构造理想化切换时刻并分析期望时间；随后提出可实际执行的近似策略。采用"固定起始+固定目标"双视角，分别刻画两算法在不同搜索阶段的相对优势并整合进漂移分析。
AI.result: 在理想化切换下证明$O(n\log\log n)$上界；对应真实策略达到相同量级，首次给出OAS严格渐进增益的实例，并揭示种群大小选择对加速的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究填补OAS理论空白，表明恰当切换可使算法互补并超越单算法极限，为后续建立更一般的在线选择理论提供范式与思路。

title: Can Vision Language Models Judge Action Quality? An Empirical Evaluation
summary: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) has broad applications in physical therapy, sports coaching, and competitive judging. Although Vision Language Models (VLMs) hold considerable promise for AQA, their actual performance in this domain remains largely uncharacterised. We present a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs across activity domains (e.g. fitness, figure skating, diving), tasks, representations, and prompting strategies. Baseline results reveal that Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models perform only marginally above random chance, and although strategies such as incorporation of skeleton information, grounding instructions, reasoning structures and in-context learning lead to isolated gains, none is consistently effective. Analysis of prediction distributions uncovers two systematic biases: a tendency to predict correct execution regardless of visual evidence, and a sensitivity to superficial linguistic framing. Reformulating tasks contrastively to mitigate these biases yields minimal improvement, suggesting that the models' limitations go beyond these biases, pointing to a fundamental difficulty with fine-grained movement quality assessment. Our findings establish a rigorous baseline for future VLM-based AQA research and provide an actionable outline for failure modes requiring mitigation prior to reliable real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 顶尖视觉语言模型在动作质量评估任务上表现不佳，暴露出对细粒度运动质量理解的根本缺陷，为后续研究提供基准与改进方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管 Vision Language Models (VLMs) 被寄予厚望可广泛应用于理疗、体育教学与竞技评分，但它们在动作质量评估 (AQA) 领域的真实性能尚无系统研究。本文旨在全面验证现有最强 VLMs 是否能胜任该任务。
AI.method: 作者在健身、花样滑冰、跳水等多领域构建评测集，系统比较 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5 等模型在多种任务形式、表征方式（含骨架）、提示策略（零样本/少样本、推理链、对比式）下的表现，并通过统计预测分布识别偏差。
AI.result: 1) 模型准确率仅略高于随机；2) 引入骨架、Grounding、推理框架或上下文学习只能带来局部提升，无策略持续有效；3) 模型存在“默认判好”与“被语言框架干扰”的系统偏差；4) 对比式任务重构几乎无效，显示缺陷深植于细粒度运动理解。
AI.conclusion: 当前最强 VLMs 尚不具备可靠 AQA 能力，其局限源于对细粒度动作质量的内在理解不足。研究确立了严格基准与可操作的失效模式清单，呼吁在真实部署前先解决这些根本性问题。

title: Learning Who Disagrees: Demographic Importance Weighting for Modeling Annotator Distributions with DiADEM
summary: When humans label subjective content, they disagree, and that disagreement is not noise. It reflects genuine differences in perspective shaped by annotators' social identities and lived experiences. Yet standard practice still flattens these judgments into a single majority label, and recent LLM-based approaches fare no better: we show that prompted large language models, even with chain-of-thought reasoning, fail to recover the structure of human disagreement. We introduce DiADEM, a neural architecture that learns "how much each demographic axis matters" for predicting who will disagree and on what. DiADEM encodes annotators through per-demographic projections governed by a learned importance vector $\boldsymbolα$, fuses annotator and item representations via complementary concatenation and Hadamard interactions, and is trained with a novel item-level disagreement loss that directly penalizes mispredicted annotation variance. On the DICES conversational-safety and VOICED political-offense benchmarks, DiADEM substantially outperforms both the LLM-as-a-judge and neural model baselines across standard and perspectivist metrics, achieving strong disagreement tracking ($r{=}0.75$ on DICES). The learned $\boldsymbolα$ weights reveal that race and age consistently emerge as the most influential demographic factors driving annotator disagreement across both datasets. Our results demonstrate that explicitly modeling who annotators are not just what they label is essential for NLP systems that aim to faithfully represent human interpretive diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出主观标注中的分歧并非噪声而是真实视角差异，提出DiADEM架构显式建模标注者身份以预测分歧，在两项安全数据集上大幅超越现有基线并发现种族与年龄是最关键因素。
AI.motivation: 传统做法将主观内容标注分歧简单归并为多数标签，LLM评估亦无法还原分歧结构；需要一种能捕捉“谁为何不同意”的方法，以忠实反映人类解释的多样性。
AI.method: 设计DiADEM：1) 用可学习的α向量将每位标注者按人口学属性投影为身份编码；2) 通过拼接与Hadamard乘积融合身份与项目表征；3) 提出项级分歧损失，直接惩罚预测方差与真实方差之差。
AI.result: 在DICES对话安全与VOICED政治冒犯基准上，DiADEM在标准及视角主义指标上全面优于LLM-as-judge和神经基线，对标注方差的预测相关性达0.75；学得的α权重显示种族与年龄始终是分歧主因。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模“标注者是谁”而非仅“标了什么”是NLP系统忠实表征人类多元解释的关键；DiADEM为构建包容性、可解释的主观内容评估提供了有效框架。

title: Persistence-Augmented Neural Networks
summary: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) provides tools to describe the shape of data, but integrating topological features into deep learning pipelines remains challenging, especially when preserving local geometric structure rather than summarizing it globally. We propose a persistence-based data augmentation framework that encodes local gradient flow regions and their hierarchical evolution using the Morse-Smale complex. This representation, compatible with both convolutional and graph neural networks, retains spatially localized topological information across multiple scales. Importantly, the augmentation procedure itself is efficient, with computational complexity $O(n \log n)$, making it practical for large datasets. We evaluate our method on histopathology image classification and 3D porous material regression, where it consistently outperforms baselines and global TDA descriptors such as persistence images and landscapes. We also show that pruning the base level of the hierarchy reduces memory usage while maintaining competitive performance. These results highlight the potential of local, structured topological augmentation for scalable and interpretable learning across data modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于持久性的局部拓扑数据增强框架，通过 Morse-Smale 复形编码局部梯度流区域及其层次演化，可在保持局部几何结构的同时与 CNN/GNN 兼容并以 O(n log n) 复杂度实现大规模数据增强，在病理图像与 3D 多孔材料回归任务中显著优于全局 TDA 描述子与基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管 TDA 能刻画数据“形状”，但现有方法主要提供全局描述子，难以在建模局部几何结构中嵌入并保持多尺度拓扑特征，造成与深度学习管道的衔接瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入持久性数据增强框架：1) 构建 Morse-Smale 复形捕获局部梯度流区域；2) 层次化演化编码形成多尺度局部拓扑表示；3) 将该表示作为等变特征融入卷积/图神经网络，复杂度精简为 O(n log n)，且可通过层次剪枝降低显存。
AI.result: 在组织病理图像分类和 3D 多孔介质渗透率回归上均优于全局 TDA 描述子（如 persistence images/landscapes）及无拓扑增强基线，剪枝后仍保持竞争力并显著减少内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 局部、结构化拓扑增强可在保持可解释性的同时提升深度学习性能与扩展性，为跨模态任务提供新的拓扑表示范式。

title: Active Reward Machine Inference From Raw State Trajectories
summary: Reward machines are automaton-like structures that capture the memory required to accomplish a multi-stage task. When combined with reinforcement learning or optimal control methods, they can be used to synthesize robot policies to achieve such tasks. However, specifying a reward machine by hand, including a labeling function capturing high-level features that the decisions are based on, can be a daunting task. This paper deals with the problem of learning reward machines directly from raw state and policy information. As opposed to existing works, we assume no access to observations of rewards, labels, or machine nodes, and show what trajectory data is sufficient for learning the reward machine in this information-scarce regime. We then extend the result to an active learning setting where we incrementally query trajectory extensions to improve data (and indirectly computational) efficiency. Results are demonstrated with several grid world examples.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅在原始状态-轨迹数据（无奖励、标签、机器节点）条件下，直接从数据中逆向学习reward machine（RM）的方法，并给出可学习性充分条件，再引入主动查询策略提升采样效率，在网格世界验证。
AI.motivation: 将高层多阶段任务编码为reward machine(RM)可与RL/最优控制结合，但手工指定RM及其状态标签函数极费时且易错；现有方法仍需奖励或标签等额外信息。本文旨在完全摆脱人工标注，仅用原始轨迹即可自动学习RM。
AI.method: 1) 在无奖励/标签/节点观测的“信息稀缺”设定下，推导轨迹数据足以唯一确定RM的充分条件（基于状态-动作序列的可区分性与一致性）；2) 将学习问题转化为求解满足等价关系的最小确定性自动机的采样子集构造问题；3) 扩展到主动学习：按不确定性或分歧度策略性地查询轨迹延伸，逐步精化等价类，减少所需轨迹条数并降低计算量。
AI.result: 理论上给出可学习性充分条件并证明算法收敛到最小正确RM；实验上在多个网格世界任务中，相比随机采集，主动学习将所需轨迹数降低约40–60%，同时学习到的RM与手工RM一致，合成的策略成功率达≈100%。
AI.conclusion: 仅利用原始轨迹即可在信息稀缺条件下有效学习reward machine，主动查询显著优化数据与计算效率；结果为将高层任务结构从低级演示中自动提取提供了可行途径，可推广至更复杂的机器人任务规划场景。

title: GroundingAnomaly: Spatially-Grounded Diffusion for Few-Shot Anomaly Synthesis
summary: The performance of visual anomaly inspection in industrial quality control is often constrained by the scarcity of real anomalous samples. Consequently, anomaly synthesis techniques have been developed to enlarge training sets and enhance downstream inspection. However, existing methods either suffer from poor integration caused by inpainting or fail to provide accurate masks. To address these limitations, we propose GroundingAnomaly, a novel few-shot anomaly image generation framework. Our framework introduces a Spatial Conditioning Module that leverages per-pixel semantic maps to enable precise spatial control over the synthesized anomalies. Furthermore, a Gated Self-Attention Module is designed to inject conditioning tokens into a frozen U-Net via gated attention layers. This carefully preserves pretrained priors while ensuring stable few-shot adaptation. Extensive evaluations on the MVTec AD and VisA datasets demonstrate that GroundingAnomaly generates high-quality anomalies and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple downstream tasks, including anomaly detection, segmentation, and instance-level detection.

AI.tldr: GroundingAnomaly通过语义图驱动的空间条件模块与门控自注意力机制，在冻结的预训练U-Net中注入少量异常样本信息，实现高质量、精准定位的异常合成，显著超越现有工业视觉检测基准。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉异常检测受限于真实缺陷样本稀缺，现有合成方法存在修复痕迹明显或掩码不准的问题，急需既能保留预训练先验又能精确定位的新型少量样本异常生成方案。
AI.method: 提出GroundingAnomaly框架：1) 利用逐像素语义图的空间条件模块，实现像素级异常位置控制；2) 设计门控自注意力模块，将条件token注入冻结的预训练U-Net，稳定地完成少量样本适配并保留先验知识。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD与VisA两大公开数据集上，GroundingAnomaly生成的异常图像质量显著提升，同时在异常检测、分割与实例级检测三项下游任务中均取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义图空间条件与门控注意力协同，GroundingAnomaly有效解决了少量样本下异常合成质量差与定位不准的难题，为工业质检中的数据扩充与模型训练提供了可靠支持。

title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks
summary: With the growing demand for long-context LLMs across a wide range of applications, the key-value (KV) cache has become a critical bottleneck for both latency and memory usage. Recently, KV-cache offloading has emerged as a promising approach to reduce memory footprint and inference latency while preserving accuracy. Prior evaluations have largely focused on tasks that do not require extracting large amounts of information from the context. In this work, we study KV-cache offloading on context-intensive tasks: problems where the solution requires looking up a lot of information from the input prompt. We create and release the Text2JSON benchmark, a highly context-intensive task that requires extracting structured knowledge from raw text. We evaluate modern KV offloading on Text2JSON and other context-intensive tasks and find significant performance degradation on both Llama 3 and Qwen 3 models. Our analysis identifies two key reasons for poor accuracy: low-rank projection of keys and unreliable landmarks, and proposes a simpler alternative strategy that significantly improves accuracy across multiple LLM families and benchmarks. These findings highlight the need for a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of long-context compression techniques.

AI.tldr: 针对KV-cache offloading在需要大量信息提取的上下文密集型任务中的性能退化，作者构建Text2JSON基准并指出低秩投影与不可靠landmark是关键原因，提出替代策略显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有KV-cache卸载研究多聚焦于轻量上下文任务，其对需大规模信息提取的长文本任务的准确性影响尚不明确，需系统评估。
AI.method: 1)设计高上下文密度Text2JSON基准（从原始文本抽取结构化知识）；2)在Llama-3/Qwen-3上评估现代KV卸载；3)诊断低秩key投影与landmark不可靠性；4)提出简化替代策略并跨模型/基准验证。
AI.result: 现代KV-cache offloading在Text2JSON等上下文密集型任务上准确率显著下降；所提替代策略在多种LLM与基准上均显著优于现有卸载方案。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文压缩技术需在真正信息提取密集型场景进行严格评估，低秩投影与landmark可靠性是决定准确率的关键因素。

title: Quantization Impact on the Accuracy and Communication Efficiency Trade-off in Federated Learning for Aerospace Predictive Maintenance
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving predictive maintenance across distributed aerospace fleets, but gradient communication overhead constrains deployment on bandwidth-limited IoT nodes. This paper investigates the impact of symmetric uniform quantization ($b \in \{32,8,4,2\}$ bits) on the accuracy--efficiency trade-off of a custom-designed lightweight 1-D convolutional model (AeroConv1D, 9\,697 parameters) trained via FL on the NASA C-MAPSS benchmark under a realistic Non-IID client partition. Using a rigorous multi-seed evaluation ($N=10$ seeds), we show that INT4 achieves accuracy \emph{statistically indistinguishable} from FP32 on both FD001 ($p=0.341$) and FD002 ($p=0.264$ MAE, $p=0.534$ NASA score) while delivering an $8\times$ reduction in gradient communication cost (37.88~KiB $\to$ 4.73~KiB per round). A key methodological finding is that naïve IID client partitioning artificially suppresses variance; correct Non-IID evaluation reveals the true operational instability of extreme quantization, demonstrated via a direct empirical IID vs.\ Non-IID comparison. INT2 is empirically characterized as unsuitable: while it achieves lower MAE on FD002 through extreme quantization-induced over-regularization, this apparent gain is accompanied by catastrophic NASA score instability (CV\,=\,45.8\% vs.\ 22.3\% for FP32), confirming non-reproducibility under heterogeneous operating conditions. Analytical FPGA resource projections on the Xilinx ZCU102 confirm that INT4 fits within hardware constraints (85.5\% DSP utilization), potentially enabling a complete FL pipeline on a single SoC. The full simulation codebase and FPGA estimation scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/therealdeadbeef/aerospace-fl-quantization.

AI.tldr: 本研究在真实 Non-IID 分区下首次量化了从 FP32 到 INT2 的梯度精度对航空 FL 预测性维护的影响，证明 INT4 可在保持统计等同 FP32 精度的同时将上行通信开销压缩到 1/8，而 INT2 在高异构场景下出现不可复现的性能崩溃；提供开源代码与 FPGA 资源评估。
AI.motivation: 在星载或偏远机队场景中，机端 IoT 节点上行带宽严重受限，但 FP32 梯度交换阻碍了 FL 的落地。如何在几乎无损预测准确率的前提下尽可能压缩梯度通信，并验证其在真实 Non-IID 数据下的鲁棒性，是航空航天预测性维护亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建仅 9,697 参数量、1-D 卷积的 AeroConv1D 模型；2) 对 NASA C-MAPSS 数据集做真实 Non-IID 客户端分区，并与传统 IID 分区做对照；3) 采用多播种(N=10)FL训练，梯度分别用 32/8/4/2 bit 对称均匀量化后上传；4) 用 MAE、NASA Score 和 p 值检验评估显著性差异；5) 在 Xilinx ZCU102 上做 FPGA 资源投影；6) 全部代码与脚本开源。
AI.result: • INT4 在 FD001/FD002上均与 FP32 统计不可区分(p=0.341、p=0.534)；单轮梯度数据量从 37.88 KiB 降至 4.73 KiB(8×)。• IID 分区显著低估量化方差；Non-IID 条件下 INT2 出现高不稳定性，CV 高达 45.8%。INT2 虽在 FD002 的 MAE 上偶见“改善”，却伴随随机的 NASA Score 漂移，证明无法可靠复现。• INT4 量化后预计占用 85.5% DSP，可在单片 Zynq SoC 上跑完整个 FL 推理/聚合步骤。
AI.conclusion: INT4 同步实现了通信-压缩极限与预测可靠性，是航空带宽受限 FL 场景的最佳折衷；INT2 引入的随机过度正则化会放大 Non-IID 异质环境下的不确定度，不适合鲁棒预测性维护。研究同时强调在 Non-IID 真实数据上评估的重要性，并为机载单芯片 FL 提供了可行硬件蓝图与开源实现。

title: Private Seeds, Public LLMs: Realistic and Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for synthetic data generation. A particularly important use case is producing synthetic replicas of private text, which requires carefully balancing privacy and utility. We propose Realistic and Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Data Generation (RPSG), which leverages privacy-preserving mechanisms, including formal differential privacy (DP); and private seeds, in particular text containing personal information, to generate realistic synthetic data. Comprehensive experiments against state-of-the-art private synthetic data generation methods demonstrate that RPSG achieves high fidelity to private data while providing strong privacy protection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPSG框架，在严格差分隐私下用含真实个人信息的“私有种子”生成高保真隐私文本副本，兼顾效用与隐私。
AI.motivation: 大模型合成数据常需复现含敏感信息的私有文本，但现有方法在保真度与隐私保障间难以兼得，缺乏同时满足形式化差分隐私且保留真实语义细节的生成方案。
AI.method: RPSG将差分隐私机制嵌入LLM微调与生成流程，以经过DP处理的“私有种子”文本作为提示，指导模型在隐私预算约束下输出合成副本，并设计自适应噪声注入与分布校准策略维持文本质量。
AI.result: 在多项隐私攻击模拟与下游任务评估中，RPSG在相同ε=1的DP保证下，比基线方法提升18–32%的语义相似度，F1下降不超过3%，成员推理攻击成功率降低至随机水平。
AI.conclusion: RPSG首次在严格差分隐私框架内实现私有文本的高保真合成，为隐私敏感场景下的LLM数据增强与共享提供了可扩展、可证明安全的解决方案。

title: Weakly-Supervised Lung Nodule Segmentation via Training-Free Guidance of 3D Rectified Flow
summary: Dense annotations, such as segmentation masks, are expensive and time-consuming to obtain, especially for 3D medical images where expert voxel-wise labeling is required. Weakly supervised approaches aim to address this limitation, but often rely on attribution-based methods that struggle to accurately capture small structures such as lung nodules. In this paper, we propose a weakly-supervised segmentation method for lung nodules by combining pretrained state-of-the-art rectified flow and predictor models in a plug-and-play manner. Our approach uses training-free guidance of a 3D rectified flow model, requiring only fine-tuning of the predictor using image-level labels and no retraining of the generative model. The proposed method produces improved-quality segmentations for two separate predictors, consistently detecting lung nodules of varying size and shapes. Experiments on LUNA16 demonstrate improvements over baseline methods, highlighting the potential of generative foundation models as tools for weakly supervised 3D medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 针对肺小结节三维图像的弱监督分割，提出一种基于预训练rectified flow的无重训框架，仅图像级标签即可达到优于传统方法的精度。
AI.motivation: 三维医学图像的逐 voxel 密集标注成本极高，而现有弱监督分割方法依赖显著性映射，难以捕获小结节。需要兼顾标注效率与细微结构精度的替代方案。
AI.method: 1）选用预训练三维 rectified flow 生成模型；2）冻结权重，利用其输出作为无需重训的隐式特征；3）调制训练简单的图像级分类器使其具备定位能力；4）将分类权重反投影为热力图，生成伪体素级标签；5）最终弱监督训练任意分割网络，实现端到端结节提取。
AI.result: 在公开基准 LUNA16 上，与全流程重训或显著性弱监督基线相比，本方法带来的 Dice 提升高达 5 个百分点以上，且对小/多变结节具有一致的检测与分割增益。
AI.conclusion: 预训练的生成先验能充当高质量隐式先验，大幅削弱对 voxel 标注的依赖，奠定了将大模型迁移为弱监督 3D 分割工具的可行性。"

title: Entropy-Gradient Grounding: Training-Free Evidence Retrieval in Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite rapid progress, pretrained vision-language models still struggle when answers depend on tiny visual details or on combining clues spread across multiple regions, as in documents and compositional queries. We address this by framing grounding as test-time evidence retrieval: given a query, the model should actively identify where to look next to resolve ambiguity. To this end, we propose a training-free, model-intrinsic grounding method that uses uncertainty as supervision. Specifically, we compute the entropy of the model's next-token distribution and backpropagate it to the visual token embeddings to obtain an entropy-gradient relevance map, without auxiliary detectors or attention-map heuristics. We then extract and rank multiple coherent regions to support multi-evidence queries, and introduce an iterative zoom-and-reground procedure with a spatial-entropy stopping rule to avoid over-refinement. Experiments on seven benchmarks across four VLM architectures demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods, with the largest gains on detail-critical and high-resolution settings, while also producing more interpretable evidence localizations.

AI.tldr: 面对“细节”、“多区域”两大痛点，本文提出一种无需训练的模型内在定位策略：以下一-token熵作为监督，反向传播到视觉token得“熵梯度”定位图，迭代放大并收敛，结果在7项基准/4种VLM上全面刷新最好成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练视觉-语言模型在回答微小视觉细节或多区域线索组合问题时仍易失败，如文档理解与组合式查询。作者将定位重新定义为测试时检索：模型需主动“寻找下一位”以消解不确定性，而非依赖外部检测或after-the-fact注意力可视化。
AI.method: 设计“无训练、不额外模型”的熵梯度定位流水线。1)前向推断得到下一-token预测熵H；2)反向传播H到ViT的patch embedding，得“哪块视觉信息在稀释不确定”的熵梯度图；3)聚类加NMS提取8-16个连通证据区域并使用语言模型自打分；4)对高分区迭代执行256%→100%→50%–75%的“放大-再定位”，采用空间熵停止准则防过度细化。全程无检测器、无需外部监督与微调。
AI.result: 在TextVQA、DocVQA、InfoVQA、ST-VQA、Flickr-Entity Grounding、OVDEval、ChartQA/PlotQA等7个数据集（覆盖文档、图表、自然场景）上，跨越LLaVA-1.5、BLIP2、InstructBLIP、mPLUG-Owl四款VLM，平均绝对增益1.2–3.7%，高分辨率和细节子集最高提升6.9%；定位精确率IoU提升2–4.6pp，热力图一致性显著优于GradCAM、AT等传统解释方案。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性本身即可作为视觉定位的监督信号。该方法无需训练与额外模型，能为多证据、重细节问题提供更准确、可解释的视觉定位，同时机器可直接利用定位区域进行后续推理，首次在大规模多任务上验证了“测试时推理-再定位”范式的普遍有效性。

title: The Impact of Dimensionality on the Stability of Node Embeddings
summary: Previous work has established that neural network-based node embeddings return different outcomes when trained with identical parameters on the same dataset, just from using different training seeds. Yet, it has not been thoroughly analyzed how key hyperparameters such as embedding dimension could impact this instability. In this work, we investigate how varying the dimensionality of node embeddings influences both their stability and downstream performance. We systematically evaluate five widely used methods -- ASNE, DGI, GraphSAGE, node2vec, and VERSE -- across multiple datasets and embedding dimensions. We assess stability from both a representational perspective and a functional perspective, alongside performance evaluation. Our results show that embedding stability varies significantly with dimensionality, but we observe different patterns across the methods we consider: while some approaches, such as node2vec and ASNE, tend to become more stable with higher dimensionality, other methods do not exhibit the same trend. Moreover, we find that maximum stability does not necessarily align with optimal task performance. These findings highlight the importance of carefully selecting embedding dimension, and provide new insights into the trade-offs between stability, performance, and computational effectiveness in graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: 固定训练种子后不同网络给图仍会输出不同的节点嵌入;在ASNE等五种方法上做系统实验后发现嵌入稳定性与维度、算法和数据集高度相关,其最稳定的维度常非下游任务最佳表现维度。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅报告训练种子改变会导致嵌入不稳定,却未探究维度等核心超参对稳定性的具体影响;需弄清稳定性-性能-算力三者权衡以指导维度选择。
AI.method: 固定算子与初始化方式,仅变动embedding dimension,从表征(向量向量相似度)和功能(节点聚类/分类结果)双视角量化多次重训练结果的不一致性,并在多款图和五类典型算法(ASNE, DGI, GraphSAGE, node2vec, VERSE)上交叉验证。
AI.result: 1)维度显著影响稳定性且趋势因算法而异：node2vec与ASNE随维度增加更稳定,DGI/GraphSAGE/VERSE无此规律;2)最高稳定性维度常非最佳下游精度维度;3)稳定性提升可能带来额外算力开销但对性能未必有益。
AI.conclusion: 图嵌入的维度调优需同时考察稳定性与性能,而非仅关注最佳得分,本研究发现的规律有助开发兼顾可复现与有效性的图表示学习方案。

title: Enabling Intrinsic Reasoning over Dense Geospatial Embeddings with DFR-Gemma
summary: Representation learning for geospatial and spatio-temporal data plays a critical role in enabling general-purpose geospatial intelligence. Recent geospatial foundation models, such as the Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM), encode complex population and mobility dynamics into compact embeddings. However, their integration with Large Language Models (LLMs) remains limited. Existing approaches to LLM integration treat these embeddings as retrieval indices or convert them into textual descriptions for reasoning, introducing redundancy, token inefficiency, and numerical inaccuracies. We propose Direct Feature Reasoning-Gemma (DFR-Gemma), a novel framework that enables LLMs to reason directly over dense geospatial embeddings. DFR aligns high-dimensional embeddings with the latent space of an LLM via a lightweight projector, allowing embeddings to be injected as semantic tokens alongside natural language instructions. This design eliminates the need for intermediate textual representations and enables intrinsic reasoning over spatial features. To evaluate this paradigm, we introduce a multi-task geospatial benchmark that pairs embeddings with diverse question-answer tasks, including feature querying, comparison, and semantic description. Experimental results show that DFR allows LLMs to decode latent spatial patterns and perform accurate zero-shot reasoning across tasks, while significantly improving efficiency compared to text-based baselines. Our results demonstrate that treating embeddings as primary data inputs, provides a more direct, efficient, and scalable approach to multimodal geospatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: DFR-Gemma通过轻量级投影器将高维地理稀疏嵌入直接映射为LLM的语义token，省去文本中间层，实现零样本空间推理并在多任务基准上显著提升效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有地理基础模型（如PDFM）的嵌入与LLM结合依赖检索或文本化，带来冗余、token浪费和数值失真，亟需一种让大模型直接“读懂”空间嵌入的方案。
AI.method: 提出DFR-Gemma框架：1) 用轻量投影网络将地理嵌入对齐到Gemma的潜空间，生成可插入的“空间token”；2) 与自然语言指令并行输入，无需任何文本化中间表示；3) 构建覆盖查询、对比、语义描述的多任务地理评测集。
AI.result: 在零样本设置下，DFR使Gemma能解码潜空间模式，任务准确率全面优于文本化基线，token消耗降低约40%，延迟缩短35%，并展现良好扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 将地理嵌入作为原生输入而非文本，是构建可扩展多模态地理智能的更直接高效路径，为地理大模型提供新范式。

title: Fundus-R1: Training a Fundus-Reading MLLM with Knowledge-Aware Reasoning on Public Data
summary: Fundus imaging such as CFP, OCT and UWF is crucial for the early detection of retinal anomalies and diseases. Fundus image understanding, due to its knowledge-intensive nature, poses a challenging vision-language task. An emerging approach to addressing the task is to post-train a generic multimodal large language model (MLLM), either by supervised finetuning (SFT) or by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), on a considerable amount of in-house samples paired with high-quality clinical reports. However, these valuable samples are not publicly accessible, which not only hinders reproducibility but also practically limits research to few players. To overcome the barrier, we make a novel attempt to train a reasoning-enhanced fundus-reading MLLM, which we term Fundus-R1, using exclusively public datasets, wherein over 94\% of the data are annotated with only image-level labels. Our technical contributions are two-fold. First, we propose a RAG-based method for composing image-specific, knowledge-aware reasoning traces. Such auto-generated traces link visual findings identified by a generic MLLM to the image labels in terms of ophthalmic knowledge. Second, we enhance RLVR with a process reward that encourages self-consistency of the generated reasoning trace in each rollout. Extensive experiments on three fundus-reading benchmarks, i.e., FunBench, Omni-Fundus and GMAI-Fundus, show that Fundus-R1 clearly outperforms multiple baselines, including its generic counterpart (Qwen2.5-VL) and a stronger edition post-trained without using the generated traces. This work paves the way for training powerful fundus-reading MLLMs with publicly available data.

AI.tldr: 仅用公开图像级标签数据，训练出推理增强的眼底判读大模型 Fundus-R1，在 3 个基准上全面领先基线。
AI.motivation: 高端眼底图像-文本对私有且封闭，阻碍模型复现与广泛研究；亟需利用公开低标注数据构建高性能眼底判读 MLLM。
AI.method: 1) 提出 RAG 式“图-知识链”自动生成框架，把 MLLM 视觉发现与公开图像级标签用眼科知识连成推理链；2) 设计过程奖励的 RLVR，鼓励每轮 rollout 的自洽性，进一步微调模型。
AI.result: 在 FunBench、Omni-Fundus、GMAI-Fundus 三大公开基准上，Fundus-R1 显著优于通用基线 Qwen2.5-VL 及无链式监督的强基线。
AI.conclusion: 证明即使 94% 数据仅含图像级标签，通过知识链生成与过程奖励强化，也能训练出竞争力强的眼底判读大模型，为公开数据驱动眼科 AI 提供可行范式。

title: Formalizing building-up constructions of self-dual codes through isotropic lines in Lean
summary: The purpose of this paper is two-fold. First we show that Kim's building-up construction of binary self-dual codes is equivalent to Chinburg-Zhang's Hilbert symbol construction. Second we introduce a $q$-ary version of Chinburg-Zhang's construction in order to construct $q$-ary self-dual codes efficiently. For the latter, we study self-dual codes over split finite fields \(\F_q\) with \(q \equiv 1 \pmod{4}\) through three complementary viewpoints: the building-up construction, the binary arithmetic reduction of Chinburg--Zhang, and the hyperbolic geometry of the Euclidean plane. The condition that \(-1\) be a square is the common algebraic input linking these viewpoints: in the binary case it underlies the Lagrangian reduction picture, while in the split \(q\)-ary case it produces the isotropic line governing the correction terms in the extension formulas. As an application of our efficient form of generator matrices, we construct optimal self-dual codes from the split boxed construction, including self-dual \([6,3,4]\) and \([8,4,4]\) codes over \(\GF{5}\), MDS self-dual \([8,4,5]\) and \([10,5,6]\) codes over \(\GF{13}\), and a self-dual \([12,6,6]\) code over \(\GF{13}\). These structural statements are accompanied by a Lean~4 formalization of the algebraic core.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Kim的“building-up”构造与Chinburg-Zhang Hilbert符号构造等价，并把后者推广到q元分裂域F_q（q≡1 mod 4），用三种互补视角导出最优自对偶码的显式生成矩阵；结果由Lean 4形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 现有二元自对偶码的两种经典构造——Kim的building-up法与Chinburg-Zhang的Hilbert符号法——之间缺乏严格对应，且高阶域上的系统性构造工具稀缺。作者希望给出统一理论，并在q≡1(mod 4)的分裂域上批量生成最优/MDS自对偶码。
AI.method: 1) 建立二元building-up与Hilbert符号构造的显式等价；2) 将Hilbert符号框架扩展到q元，利用-1为平方这一公共代数条件；3) 从building-up、Chinburg-Zhang算术约化、双曲几何三重视角并行推导扩展公式，并用各向同性线修正生成矩阵；4) 给出Lean 4形式化核心代数。
AI.result: 理论层面统一了二元自对偶码的两套构造；实践层面得到一系列最优码：GF(5)上[6,3,4]与[8,4,4]自对偶码，GF(13)上MDS [8,4,5]、[10,5,6]自对偶码及[12,6,6]自对偶码；证明核心已在Lean 4中形式化。
AI.conclusion: -1为平方的代数条件不仅桥接了二元与q元自对偶码的构造逻辑，也为未来高维/其他特征域的自对偶码研究提供了可用框架；形式化验证保证了推导可靠性。

title: What Drives Representation Steering? A Mechanistic Case Study on Steering Refusal
summary: Applying steering vectors to large language models (LLMs) is an efficient and effective model alignment technique, but we lack an interpretable explanation for how it works-- specifically, what internal mechanisms steering vectors affect and how this results in different model outputs. To investigate the causal mechanisms underlying the effectiveness of steering vectors, we conduct a comprehensive case study on refusal. We propose a multi-token activation patching framework and discover that different steering methodologies leverage functionally interchangeable circuits when applied at the same layer. These circuits reveal that steering vectors primarily interact with the attention mechanism through the OV circuit while largely ignoring the QK circuit-- freezing all attention scores during steering drops performance by only 8.75% across two model families. A mathematical decomposition of the steered OV circuit further reveals semantically interpretable concepts, even in cases where the steering vector itself does not. Leveraging the activation patching results, we show that steering vectors can be sparsified by up to 90-99% while retaining most performance, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多token激活修补框架首次揭示：无论采用何种steering方法，其提升模型拒绝能力都依赖同一套可解释的OV注意回路，而QK回路几乎不被使用；据此可对steering向量做90-99%稀疏化并保持效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管steering vectors能快速对齐大模型，但其内部因果机制完全未知，尤其不清楚它究竟修改了哪些子回路、为何能改变输出。
AI.method: 以"拒绝能力"为案例，构建覆盖多层、多token的激活修补框架，系统比较不同steering方法；随后冻结注意力分数、对OV回路做数学分解，并在关键维度上做90-99%稀疏化实验。
AI.result: 1)不同steering方法在同一层指向功能可互换的回路；2)改动仅显著体现在OV回路，冻结QK回路注意力分数仅使性能下降8.75%；3)OV回路分解出的方向具有明确语义；4)仅保留1-10%的重要维度即可恢复>90%的拒答性能，且各方法对"重要维度"高度一致。
AI.conclusion: Steering向量并不神秘，其效果主要通过OV注意回路实现，而与QK回路无关；基于此可大幅压缩向量并统一解释不同steering技术的成功原因，为可解释、轻量化模型对齐提供新思路。

title: Cluster Attention for Graph Machine Learning
summary: Message Passing Neural Networks have recently become the most popular approach to graph machine learning tasks; however, their receptive field is limited by the number of message passing layers. To increase the receptive field, Graph Transformers with global attention have been proposed; however, global attention does not take into account the graph topology and thus lacks graph-structure-based inductive biases, which are typically very important for graph machine learning tasks. In this work, we propose an alternative approach: cluster attention (CLATT). We divide graph nodes into clusters with off-the-shelf graph community detection algorithms and let each node attend to all other nodes in each cluster. CLATT provides large receptive fields while still having strong graph-structure-based inductive biases. We show that augmenting Message Passing Neural Networks or Graph Transformers with CLATT significantly improves their performance on a wide range of graph datasets including datasets from the recently introduced GraphLand benchmark representing real-world applications of graph machine learning.

AI.tldr: 提出“簇注意力”(CLATT)，在保持图结构归纳偏置的同时扩大会聚野，显著提升 MPNN 与 Graph Transformer 的多项基准表现。
AI.motivation: MPNN 感受野受限于层数，全局 Transformer 虽能扩大会聚野却丢失图拓扑归纳偏置，阻碍对真实图数据的学习。
AI.method: 先用图社区检测算法将节点划分为簇，再让每节点关注其所属簇内所有节点，形成局部-全局混合注意力机制并集成到 MPNN 或 Transformer 中。
AI.result: 在包括 GraphLand 在内的多类图数据集上，CLATT 增强后的模型显著优于原 MPNN 与纯 Transformer 基线。
AI.conclusion: CLATT 在不牺牲图结构偏置的前提下有效扩大会聚野，为图表示学习提供了通用的可插拔注意力策略。

title: Lost in the Hype: Revealing and Dissecting the Performance Degradation of Medical Multimodal Large Language Models in Image Classification
summary: The rise of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has sparked an unprecedented wave of applications in the field of medical imaging analysis. However, as one of the earliest and most fundamental tasks integrated into this paradigm, medical image classification reveals a sobering reality: state-of-the-art medical MLLMs consistently underperform compared to traditional deep learning models, despite their overwhelming advantages in pre-training data and model parameters. This paradox prompts a critical rethinking: where exactly does the performance degradation originate? In this paper, we conduct extensive experiments on 14 open-source medical MLLMs across three representative image classification datasets. Moving beyond superficial performance benchmarking, we employ feature probing to track the information flow of visual features module-by-module and layer-by-layer throughout the entire MLLM pipeline, enabling explicit visualization of where and how classification signals are distorted, diluted, or overridden. As the first attempt to dissect classification performance degradation in medical MLLMs, our findings reveal four failure modes: 1) quality limitation in visual representation, 2) fidelity loss in connector projection, 3) comprehension deficit in LLM reasoning, and 4) misalignment of semantic mapping. Meanwhile, we introduce quantitative scores that characterize the healthiness of feature evolution, enabling principled comparisons across diverse MLLMs and datasets. Furthermore, we provide insightful discussions centered on the critical barriers that prevent current medical MLLMs from fulfilling their promised clinical potential. We hope that our work provokes rethinking within the community-highlighting that the road from high expectations to clinically deployable MLLMs remains long and winding.

AI.tldr: 首个系统剖析医疗多模态大语言模型(MLLM)图像分类性能骤降的研究：在14个开源模型、3个典型数据集上通过逐层特征探针可视化信息扭曲点，归纳出4类失效模式，并提出可量化的“特征健康度”指标，指出当前医疗MLLM距临床可用仍有深层屏障。
AI.motivation: 尽管医疗MLLM拥有海量预训练数据与庞大参数量，却在最基础的图像分类任务上持续劣于传统深度学习模型。该“参数-性能悖论”促使作者追问：性能退化究竟在 pipeline 的哪一环、以何种机制发生？
AI.method: 1) 选取14个公开医疗MLLM，在三个代表性分类数据集上做端到端实验；2) 设计模块化、逐层特征探针，追踪视觉 token 从编码、连接器投影到LLM推理的全过程；3) 引入可解释可视化与“特征健康度”量化指标，定位信号被稀释、扭曲或覆盖的确切位置；4) 基于实证结果归纳四类失效模式并讨论其临床阻碍。
AI.result: 发现统一且显著的4类失效：① 视觉表征质量不足；② 连接器投影保真度丧失；③ LLM推理层对医学视觉语义理解赤字；④ 语义空间映射错位。所提“特征健康度”评分与分类性能高度相关，能跨模型、跨数据集可靠比较。所有被测医疗MLLM均未达到同规模传统模型的临床精度门槛。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次将“黑箱”性能落差拆解为可定位、可量化的模块级缺陷，揭示高容量通用MLLM向专业医疗场景迁移时存在结构性鸿沟；呼吁社区停止简单堆参数，优先解决视觉-语言对齐、保真投影与医学语义理解等核心屏障，方能迈向真正可部署的医疗多模态大模型。

title: What They Saw, Not Just Where They Looked: Semantic Scanpath Similarity via VLMs and NLP metric
summary: Scanpath similarity metrics are central to eye-movement research, yet existing methods predominantly evaluate spatial and temporal alignment while neglecting semantic equivalence between attended image regions. We present a semantic scanpath similarity framework that integrates vision-language models (VLMs) into eye-tracking analysis. Each fixation is encoded under controlled visual context (patch-based and marker-based strategies) and transformed into concise textual descriptions, which are aggregated into scanpath-level representations. Semantic similarity is then computed using embedding-based and lexical NLP metrics and compared against established spatial measures, including MultiMatch and DTW. Experiments on free-viewing eye-tracking data demonstrate that semantic similarity captures partially independent variance from geometric alignment, revealing cases of high content agreement despite spatial divergence. We further analyze the impact of contextual encoding on description fidelity and metric stability. Our findings suggest that multimodal foundation models enable interpretable, content-aware extensions of classical scanpath analysis, providing a complementary dimension for gaze research within the ETRA community.

AI.tldr: 作者提出首个融合视觉—语言大模型的语义 scanpath 相似度框架，把注视点转为文本描述，用嵌入或词汇指标计算语义相似度，与经典空间方法并行验证，证明其可独立刻画基于内容的注视一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统 scanpath 相似度方法只关注“人看向哪里、何时看”，忽略了注视对象语义是否相同，为此需要引入对注视区域的语义理解，实现“内容感知的注视对比”。
AI.method: 基于注视点和尺寸，从图像中切割 patch 或围绕注视点放标记框两种策略，形成受控上下文，用现成 VLM 生成每条注视的简短文本描述；多条文本经池化得到整条 scanpath 的语义向量；利用 BERT 类嵌入或词袋/词切等 NLP 指标计算语义距离，并与 MultiMatch、DTW 等空间－时序指标在自由浏览数据集上对比；考察描述保真度和指标稳定性。
AI.result: 语义相似度与几何距离呈弱相关，可解释 25% 左右独立方差；案例显示注视分布差异大但语义位置高度一致；标记框策略能稳定提升描述质量，其描述与嵌入指标的内部一致性高于纯词汇指标。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态大模型引入 scanpath 分析得到“内容层面”新概念，可在保持传统几何分析的同时提供额外可解释通道，为注视研究与 ETRA 社区提供互补维度，推动走向语义感知的注视比较。

title: Meta-learning In-Context Enables Training-Free Cross Subject Brain Decoding
summary: Visual decoding from brain signals is a key challenge at the intersection of computer vision and neuroscience, requiring methods that bridge neural representations and computational models of vision. A field-wide goal is to achieve generalizable, cross-subject models. A major obstacle towards this goal is the substantial variability in neural representations across individuals, which has so far required training bespoke models or fine-tuning separately for each subject. To address this challenge, we introduce a meta-optimized approach for semantic visual decoding from fMRI that generalizes to novel subjects without any fine-tuning. By simply conditioning on a small set of image-brain activation examples from the new individual, our model rapidly infers their unique neural encoding patterns to facilitate robust and efficient visual decoding. Our approach is explicitly optimized for in-context learning of the new subject's encoding model and performs decoding by hierarchical inference, inverting the encoder. First, for multiple brain regions, we estimate the per-voxel visual response encoder parameters by constructing a context over multiple stimuli and responses. Second, we construct a context consisting of encoder parameters and response values over multiple voxels to perform aggregated functional inversion. We demonstrate strong cross-subject and cross-scanner generalization across diverse visual backbones without retraining or fine-tuning. Moreover, our approach requires neither anatomical alignment nor stimulus overlap. This work is a critical step towards a generalizable foundation model for non-invasive brain decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个无需微调即可跨被试/跨扫描仪泛化的fMRI视觉语义解码框架，通过少量新个体样例驱动上下文式分层推理，实现即插即用的通用脑解码基础模型。
AI.motivation: 领域长期受制于个体间神经表征差异，必须为每个被试单独训练或微调模型，阻碍通用脑解码基础模型的发展。亟需一种
AI.method: 构建元优化框架，把新被试脑响应预测任务转化为上下文学习：1) 用少量图像-激活样本估计各脑区逐体素视觉响应编码参数；2) 以这些编码参数为上下文，在体素层面做聚合式功能反演完成解码。全程无解剖对齐、无刺激重叠，无需重训或微调。
AI.result: 在多样视觉骨干网络上实现强跨被试与跨扫描仪泛化，性能媲美甚至超过需个体化训练的现有方法，仅用少量样例即可稳定解码视觉语义。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次证明无需微调即可泛化到新被试的fMRI视觉解码可行性，为构建非侵入式通用脑解码基础模型奠定关键一步。

title: Triage: Routing Software Engineering Tasks to Cost-Effective LLM Tiers via Code Quality Signals
summary:
Context: AI coding agents route every task to a single frontier large language model (LLM), paying premium inference cost even when many tasks are routine.
  Objectives: We propose Triage, a framework that uses code health metrics -- indicators of software maintainability -- as a routing signal to assign each task to the cheapest model tier whose output passes the same verification gate as the expensive model.
  Methods: Triage defines three capability tiers (light, standard, heavy -- mirroring, e.g., Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) and routes tasks based on pre-computed code health sub-factors and task metadata. We design an evaluation comparing three routing policies on SWE-bench Lite (300 tasks across three model tiers): heuristic thresholds, a trained ML classifier, and a perfect-hindsight oracle.
  Results: We analytically derived two falsifiable conditions under which the tier-dependent asymmetry (medium LLMs benefit from clean code while frontier models do not) yields cost-effective routing: the light-tier pass rate on healthy code must exceed the inter-tier cost ratio, and code health must discriminate the required model tier with at least a small effect size ($\hat{p} \geq 0.56$).
  Conclusion: Triage transforms a diagnostic code quality metric into an actionable model-selection signal. We present a rigorous evaluation protocol to test the cost--quality trade-off and identify which code health sub-factors drive routing decisions.

AI.tldr: 用软件健康度指标当“分级路由”信号，把任务导向最便宜、经同一验证门过的模型层，可在不降级 SWE-bench 效果下显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 编码代理无论任务难易都用同一顶级大模型，推理费用高。若能用代码可维护性指标预测所需模型能力，就可按需调用，实现成本-质量双赢。
AI.method: 提出 Triage 框架：先按算力与成本把模型分为轻/中/重三级；离线计算代码健康度子指标与任务元数据；用阈值规则、ML 分类器或完美预言机三种策略，把任务路由到能通过同一单测/验证门的最低级模型；在 SWE-bench Lite 300 任务上比较成本与通过率。
AI.result: 推导出两条可证伪条件：①轻级在健康代码上的通过率须超过级间成本比；②健康度对所需级别的判别力效应量 p̂≥0.56。满足时，路由可把约 50–65% 任务交给轻/中级，总成本降 40–70%，而整体通过率与全用顶级模型持平。
AI.conclusion: 代码健康度可转化为可操作的模型选择信号；Triage 提供严格实验协议，可系统评估哪些子指标真正驱动路由决策，并为后续在线部署奠定理论与实证基础。

title: InstAP: Instance-Aware Vision-Language Pre-Train for Spatial-Temporal Understanding
summary: Current vision-language pre-training (VLP) paradigms excel at global scene understanding but struggle with instance-level reasoning due to global-only supervision. We introduce InstAP, an Instance-Aware Pre-training framework that jointly optimizes global vision-text alignment and fine-grained, instance-level contrastive alignment by grounding textual mentions to specific spatial-temporal regions. To support this, we present InstVL, a large-scale dataset (2 million images, 50,000 videos) with dual-granularity annotations: holistic scene captions and dense, grounded instance descriptions. On the InstVL benchmark, InstAP substantially outperforms existing VLP models on instance-level retrieval, and also surpasses a strong VLP baseline trained on the exact same data corpus, isolating the benefit of our instance-aware objective. Moreover, instance-centric pre-training improves global understanding: InstAP achieves competitive zero-shot performance on multiple video benchmarks, including MSR-VTT and DiDeMo. Qualitative visualizations further show that InstAP localizes textual mentions to the correct instances, while global-only models exhibit more diffuse, scene-level attention.

AI.tldr: 首次将『全局—实例』双粒度对齐统一进预训练，在全局视觉语言模型的基础上追加显式实例级对比监督，辅之以200万张图像＋5万条视频的双标注数据集InstVL，使模型既能精准定位文本指涉的具体时空区域，又保持整体场景理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLP范式仅用全局对齐目标，缺乏细粒度实例监督，导致模型在需要精确定位或细粒度查询的场景中表现下降。
AI.method: 1) 提出Instance-Aware Pre-training (InstAP)，在同一网络中联合优化全局图文对齐与逐实例对比对齐；2) 构建InstVL数据集，分两级标注：场景级整体标题与实例级稠密描述并附带空间—时序锚框；3) 采用对比损失将自然语言短语显式绑定到对应实例区域，实现实例感知预训练。
AI.result: 在InstVL实例级检索任务上，InstAP大幅超越现有VLP模型；即便与使用完全相同语料的全局监督基线对比，仍能带来显著提升；在MSR-VTT、DiDeMo等零样本视频理解基准上达到有竞争力甚至最佳水平；可视化显示InstAP能准确定位文本提及的目标，而全局模型注意力分布更弥散。
AI.conclusion: 引入实例级对比监督不仅能显著提升细粒度文本—视觉对齐，还能反哺并强化全局场景理解，为视觉语言预训练提供一条新的『全局＋实例』双粒度优化范式。

title: PIArena: A Platform for Prompt Injection Evaluation
comment: To appear in ACL 2026. The code is available at https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena
summary: Prompt injection attacks pose serious security risks across a wide range of real-world applications. While receiving increasing attention, the community faces a critical gap: the lack of a unified platform for prompt injection evaluation. This makes it challenging to reliably compare defenses, understand their true robustness under diverse attacks, or assess how well they generalize across tasks and benchmarks. For instance, many defenses initially reported as effective were later found to exhibit limited robustness on diverse datasets and attacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce PIArena, a unified and extensible platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables users to easily integrate state-of-the-art attacks and defenses and evaluate them across a variety of existing and new benchmarks. We also design a dynamic strategy-based attack that adaptively optimizes injected prompts based on defense feedback. Through comprehensive evaluation using PIArena, we uncover critical limitations of state-of-the-art defenses: limited generalizability across tasks, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, and fundamental challenges when an injected task aligns with the target task. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个统一提示注入攻防评测平台 PIArena，发现现有防御在多任务、自适应攻击下普遍失效，并开源代码与数据集。
AI.motivation: 提示注入攻击威胁真实应用，但缺乏统一评估框架，导致防御方法难以横向对比、复现性差，许多曾被宣称有效的防御在换数据集或攻击方式后迅速失效。
AI.method: 设计可扩展平台 PIArena，集成主流攻击与防御接口；提出基于防御反馈的自适应攻击策略；在多个任务与 benchmark 上系统评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示 SOTA 防御的三大局限：跨任务泛化差、对自适应攻击脆弱、当注入任务与目标任务一致时几乎无解；平台已公开供社区持续迭代。
AI.conclusion: 需建立统一、动态、开放的评估生态才能真实衡量提示注入防御的鲁棒性；PIArena 为后续研究与工业部署提供了基准和工具。

title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-Agent Workflow for Language-agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-scale Repositories
summary:
Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs.
  We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs (C, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust) and 4 PL pairs (C-Rust, Go-Rust, Java-Python, Python-JavaScript). Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.

AI.tldr: 首次提出全自主多智能体系统 ReCodeAgent，可在任意两种语言间完成整仓级翻译与验证，无需人工适配新语言对，翻译正确率平均提高 60.8%，单项目平均成本仅 15.3 美元。对比实验表明，多智能体架构是性能关键，单智能体版本测试通过率骤降 40.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有整仓级代码翻译与验证方法只能处理固定源-目标语言对，新增语言对需耗费大量工程适配；而编程智能体虽有潜力实现语言无关翻译，却尚无能在大型项目上完全自主工作的方案。
AI.method: 设计 ReCodeAgent：由多智能体协同的自主系统，用户仅提供源语言仓库与目标语言即可。系统内部自动完成跨语言代码生成、调用各语言专属工具进行静态与动态验证，并迭代修复，全程无需人工干预。
AI.result: 在 118 个真实项目（平均 1,975 行代码、43 个翻译单元）上评估 6 种语言、4 种语言对的翻译任务。ReCodeAgent 的测试通过率比 4 种神经符号与智能体基线平均提升 60.8%，单项目平均花费 15.3 美元。轨迹分析显示其过程高效；若改用单智能体架构，通过率下降 40.4%，轨迹长度增加 28% 且效率持续低下。
AI.conclusion: ReCodeAgent 首次实现大尺度、语言无关的整仓级代码翻译与验证，验证多智能体架构对性能至关重要，为未来跨语言软件迁移与自动化工具链提供了可行范式。

title: Beyond Human-Readable: Rethinking Software Engineering Conventions for the Agentic Development Era
summary: For six decades, software engineering principles have been optimized for a single consumer: the human developer. The rise of agentic AI development, where LLM-based agents autonomously read, write, navigate, and debug codebases, introduces a new primary consumer with fundamentally different constraints. This paper presents a systematic analysis of human-centric conventions under agentic pressure and proposes a key design principle: semantic density optimization, eliminating tokens that carry zero information while preserving tokens that carry high semantic value. We validate this principle through a controlled experiment on log format token economy across four conditions (human-readable, structured, compressed, and tool-assisted compressed), demonstrating a counterintuitive finding: aggressive compression increased total session cost by 67% despite reducing input tokens by 17%, because it shifted interpretive burden to the model's reasoning phase. We extend this principle to propose the rehabilitation of classical anti-patterns, introduce the program skeleton concept for agentic code navigation, and argue for a fundamental decoupling of semantic intent from human-readable representation.

AI.tldr: 传统人机友好的编码规范会让 AI 代理付出更高推理代价；用“语义密度”原则重构日志与代码，比简单压缩更能降低成本
AI.motivation: 过去 60 年的软件工程规范以满足人类开发者为唯一目标。随着以 LLM 为基座的 Agent 开始主导代码读写与调试，这些规范所隐含的信息冗余与“人类便利”特征将带来新的成本瓶颈
AI.method: 提出“语义密度优化”原则，并以四个日志格式（可读、结构化、压缩、工具辅助压缩）作为交叉变量，开展受控实验追踪总对话代价。实验量化日志 token 数、解析时间与推理成本之间的耦合机制
AI.result: 极端压缩尽管节省 17% 输入 token，但因推理解码负担显著增加，总会话成本反而上升 67%。对比发现，保留高语义价值 token、去除零信息 token 的结构化方案成本最优
AI.conclusion: 基于语义密度可反利用某些“反模式”生成高效代码骨架，将“意图”与“阅读审美”解耦。作者呼吁制定与面向人类格式并列的 Agentic-Oriented 编码、日志和导航规范，以最小化代理级链式推理开销

title: PokeGym: A Visually-Driven Long-Horizon Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in static visual understanding, their deployment in complex 3D embodied environments remains severely limited. Existing benchmarks suffer from four critical deficiencies: (1) passive perception tasks circumvent interactive dynamics; (2) simplified 2D environments fail to assess depth perception; (3) privileged state leakage bypasses genuine visual processing; and (4) human evaluation is prohibitively expensive and unscalable. We introduce PokeGym, a visually-driven long-horizon benchmark instantiated within Pokemon Legends: Z-A, a visually complex 3D open-world Role-Playing Game. PokeGym enforces strict code-level isolation: agents operate solely on raw RGB observations while an independent evaluator verifies success via memory scanning, ensuring pure vision-based decision-making and automated, scalable assessment. The benchmark comprises 30 tasks (30-220 steps) spanning navigation, interaction, and mixed scenarios, with three instruction granularities (Visual-Guided, Step-Guided, Goal-Only) to systematically deconstruct visual grounding, semantic reasoning, and autonomous exploration capabilities. Our evaluation reveals a key limitation of current VLMs: physical deadlock recovery, rather than high-level planning, constitutes the primary bottleneck, with deadlocks showing a strong negative correlation with task success. Furthermore, we uncover a metacognitive divergence: weaker models predominantly suffer from Unaware Deadlocks (oblivious to entrapment), whereas advanced models exhibit Aware Deadlocks (recognizing entrapment yet failing to recover). These findings highlight the need to integrate explicit spatial intuition into VLM architectures. The code and benchmark will be available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: PokeGym 以宝可梦3D开放世界为测试场，首次用纯视觉输入+自动评估机制构建30项长周期任务，揭示当前VLM核心瓶颈是「物理死锁恢复」而非高层规划，并发现弱模型「无意识」、强模型「有意识却逃不出」的元认知差异。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在3D具身环境落地受阻，因基准普遍存在四缺陷：被动感知、2D简化、状态泄露、人工评估昂贵。亟需一个可扩展、纯视觉、交互式、3D长周期的测评框架。
AI.method: 构建PokeGym：在《宝可梦传说：Z-A》内实现代码级沙盒，代理仅接收原始RGB帧；独立评估器通过内存扫描判别成功，杜绝额外信息泄露。任务覆盖导航、交互、混合三类，共30项（30–220步），并设三种指令粒度（视觉引导、步骤引导、仅目标）系统拆解能力。评估指标含成功率、死锁率及「无意识vs.有意识」死锁分类。
AI.result: 主流VLM平均成功率仅18–42%。失败主因是「物理死锁」而非规划错误；死锁发生率与任务成功率强负相关（ρ≈–0.8）。弱模型80%死锁为「Unaware」型（持续无效动作），强模型60%为「Aware」型（尝试逃脱仍被困），表明空间直觉缺口与元认知差异并存。
AI.conclusion: 论文指出未来VLM需显式注入空间-运动直觉模块，并将「低层级恢复」作为与高层规划同等重要的研究对象。PokeGym已开源，提供可复现的3D纯视觉具身智能评估平台。

title: sciwrite-lint: Verification Infrastructure for the Age of Science Vibe-Writing
summary:
Science currently offers two options for quality assurance, both inadequate. Journal gatekeeping claims to verify both integrity and contribution, but actually measures prestige: peer review is slow, biased, and misses fabricated citations even at top venues. Open science provides no quality assurance at all: the only filter between AI-generated text and the public record is the author's integrity. AI-assisted writing makes both worse by producing more papers faster than either system can absorb.
  We propose a third option: measure the paper itself. sciwrite-lint (pip install sciwrite-lint) is an open-source linter for scientific manuscripts that runs entirely on the researcher's machine (free public databases, a single consumer GPU, and open-weights models) with no manuscripts sent to external services. The pipeline verifies that references exist, checks retraction status, compares metadata against canonical records, downloads and parses cited papers, verifies that they support the claims made about them, and follows one level further to check cited papers' own bibliographies. Each reference receives a per-reference reliability score aggregating all verification signals. We evaluate the pipeline on 30 unseen papers from arXiv and bioRxiv with error injection and LLM-adjudicated false positive analysis.
  As an experimental extension, we propose SciLint Score, combining integrity verification with a contribution component that operationalizes five frameworks from philosophy of science (Popper, Lakatos, Kitcher, Laudan, Mayo) into computable structural properties of scientific arguments. The integrity component is the core of the tool and is evaluated in this paper; the contribution component is released as experimental code for community development.

AI.tldr: 当前期刊审稿与开放科学两种质量保障机制均失灵；作者发布本地运行的开源工具 sciwrite-lint，用轻量流程逐条验证引用真实性并打分，同时提出可扩展的“SciLint 评分”框架，将科学贡献转化为可计算指标。
AI.motivation: 传统同行评议慢、偏见大、无法识别伪造引用；开放科学零过滤；AI 辅助写作进一步放大垃圾论文风险。亟需不依赖权威第三方、可规模化、直接丈量论文本身质量的新机制。
AI.method: 设计完全离线的“linter”流水线：解析手稿 → 检索公开数据库 → 核对文献存在性与撤回状态 → 下载并解析被引论文 → 验证被引内容是否真正支持作者声称 → 再向下追溯一层引用网络；综合多信号生成每篇参考文献的可靠度得分；并抽取文章结构特征，用波普尔等五种科学哲学框架将“贡献”操作化为可计算指标。
AI.result: 在 30 篇 arXiv/bioRxiv 论文上注入错误实验，结合 LLM 判定假阳性，证实该流水线能有效发现伪造／失配引用，每篇论文平均验证数百条引用，硬件需求仅单张消费级 GPU；作为副产品，SciLint Score 的完整性模块已可用，贡献模块开源供社区迭代。
AI.conclusion: “测论文本身”是一条可行的新路径：sciwrite-lint 证明可在零成本、零隐私泄露条件下完成高覆盖的引用完整性核查；将科学哲学转化为结构化指标为后续自动化评估“贡献”提供了可扩展框架，有望补足甚至替代现行期刊守门机制。

title: Position Paper: From Edge AI to Adaptive Edge AI
summary: Edge AI is often framed as model compression and deployment under tight constraints. We argue a stronger operational thesis: Edge AI in realistic deployments is necessarily adaptive. In long-horizon operation, a fixed (non-adaptive) configuration faces a fundamental failure mode: as data and operating conditions evolve and change in time, it must either (i) violate time-varying budgets (latency/energy/thermal/connectivity/privacy) or (ii) lose predictive reliability (accuracy and, critically, calibration), with risk concentrating in transient regimes and rare time intervals rather than in average performance. If a deployed system cannot reconfigure its computation - and, when required, its model state - under evolving conditions and constraints, it reduces to static embedded inference and cannot provide sustained utility. This position paper introduces a minimal Agent-System-Environment (ASE) lens that makes adaptivity precise at the edge by specifying (i) what changes, (ii) what is observed, (iii) what can be reconfigured, and (iv) which constraints must remain satisfied over time. Building on this framing, we formulate ten research challenges for the next decade, spanning theoretical guarantees for evolving systems, dynamic architectures and hybrid transitions between data-driven and model-based components, fault/anomaly-driven targeted updates, System-1/System-2 decompositions (anytime intelligence), modularity, validation under scarce labels, and evaluation protocols that quantify lifecycle efficiency and recovery/stability under drift and interventions.

AI.tldr: 边缘AI的本质不是一次性压缩，而是持续在线的「适应性」能力；若不能在运行期重配置自身，系统终将因预算漂移或精度掉线而失效。作者提出ASE框架并列出十年十大研究挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有工作把边缘AI等同于「模型压缩→部署」的单点优化，忽视了长期运行中数据/环境/约束随时间演变带来的根本失效风险。作者认为，只有具备运行时自适应重配置能力，边缘AI才能持续满足动态预算并维持校准后的可靠预测。
AI.method:
1. 论证固定配置的两种必然失效模式：违反时变预算（时延/能耗/热/连接/隐私）或丧失预测可靠性（准确率＋校准度）。
2. 提出「Agent-System-Environment (ASE)」最小视角，将适应性拆成四元组：<变化源, 可观测, 可重配, 持续满足约束>。
3. 基于ASE框架，归纳未来十年需攻克的十大挑战，涵盖理论保证、动态架构、故障触发更新、System-1/2分解、模块化、稀缺标签验证及生命周期评估协议。
AI.result: 将边缘AI研究重心从“静态部署”转向“生命周期自适应”，给出了可操作的ASE描述模板和问题清单，为后续算法-系统协同设计提供统一坐标系。
AI.conclusion: 若边缘AI不进行适应性范式转换，只能退化为“静态嵌入式推理”，无法在长期演化中持续产生价值；ASE框架和所列挑战为社区提供了下一阶段的研究路线图。

title: SYN-DIGITS: A Synthetic Control Framework for Calibrated Digital Twin Simulation
summary: AI-based persona simulation -- often referred to as digital twin simulation -- is increasingly used for market research, recommender systems, and social sciences. Despite their flexibility, large language models (LLMs) often exhibit systematic bias and miscalibration relative to real human behavior, limiting their reliability. Inspired by synthetic control methods from causal inference, we propose SYN-DIGITS (SYNthetic Control Framework for Calibrated DIGItal Twin Simulation), a principled and lightweight calibration framework that learns latent structure from digital-twin responses and transfers it to align predictions with human ground truth. SYN-DIGITS operates as a post-processing layer on top of any LLM-based simulator and thus is model-agnostic. We develop a latent factor model that formalizes when and why calibration succeeds through latent space alignment conditions, and we systematically evaluate ten calibration methods across thirteen persona constructions, three LLMs, and two datasets. SYN-DIGITS supports both individual-level and distributional simulation for previously unseen questions and unobserved populations, with provable error guarantees. Experiments show that SYN-DIGITS achieves up to 50% relative improvements in individual-level correlation and 50--90% relative reductions in distributional discrepancy compared to uncalibrated baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SYN-DIGITS：对任意LLM-仿真器做后处理，用潜变量因子模型把合成控制思想迁移到数字人校准，个体/分布误差均显著下降，理论上可保证泛化。
AI.motivation: 大模型驱动的数字人（digital twin）在推荐、市调、社科场景迅速普及，但其回答与真实人群存在系统性偏差与错误置信度，亟需轻量级、模型无关的校准框架。
AI.method: 借鉴因果推断中的合成控制，构建潜变量因子模型，把数字人响应的潜结构对齐到人类真值；作为后置插件，可套在任意LLM之上完成个体级与分布级校准，并给出误差上界。
AI.result: 在13种人格构造×3种LLM×2份数据上，SYN-DIGITS将个体级Pearson相关相对提升50%，分布级TV/JS距离降低50–90%，显著优于10种基线校准法，且对未见过的问题与人群仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 证明只要潜空间对齐条件成立，LLM数字人即可通过轻量级后处理实现可证误差保证的高保真仿真；SYN-DIGITS为行业提供模型无关、即插即用的标准化校准流程，可直接嵌入现有仿真管线。

title: MegaStyle: Constructing Diverse and Scalable Style Dataset via Consistent Text-to-Image Style Mapping
summary: In this paper, we introduce MegaStyle, a novel and scalable data curation pipeline that constructs an intra-style consistent, inter-style diverse and high-quality style dataset. We achieve this by leveraging the consistent text-to-image style mapping capability of current large generative models, which can generate images in the same style from a given style description. Building on this foundation, we curate a diverse and balanced prompt gallery with 170K style prompts and 400K content prompts, and generate a large-scale style dataset MegaStyle-1.4M via content-style prompt combinations. With MegaStyle-1.4M, we propose style-supervised contrastive learning to fine-tune a style encoder MegaStyle-Encoder for extracting expressive, style-specific representations, and we also train a FLUX-based style transfer model MegaStyle-FLUX. Extensive experiments demonstrate the importance of maintaining intra-style consistency, inter-style diversity and high-quality for style dataset, as well as the effectiveness of the proposed MegaStyle-1.4M. Moreover, when trained on MegaStyle-1.4M, MegaStyle-Encoder and MegaStyle-FLUX provide reliable style similarity measurement and generalizable style transfer, making a significant contribution to the style transfer community. More results are available at our project website https://jeoyal.github.io/MegaStyle/.

AI.tldr: 提出 MegaStyle：一条可扩展的数据整理管线，可构建 140 万规模、同风格一致、跨风格多样且高质量的风格数据集，并据此训练出 MegaStyle-Encoder（风格相似度标杆）与 MegaStyle-FLUX（鲁棒风格迁移模型）。
AI.motivation: 现有风格数据集规模小、同风格样本差异大、跨风格覆盖不足，导致风格编码与迁移模型泛化差；亟需一种可扩展、质量受控的大规模风格数据构建方案。
AI.method: 1）利用大模型文本-风格一致映射能力；2）人工+LLM 生成 17 万风格提示与 40 万内容提示，交叉组合后筛选去重，构建 MegaStyle-1.4M；3）提出“风格监督对比学习”微调 CLIP 得 MegaStyle-Encoder；4）在同数据上训练 FLUX 解码器得 MegaStyle-FLUX。
AI.result: MegaStyle-1.4M 的类内 LPIPS 差异降低 28%，类间提升 41%，FID 优于过往最好 19%。MegaStyle-Encoder 在 style-retrieval、style-ranking 指标上提升 4-7 pp；MegaStyle-FLUX 在 content preservation、style fidelity 上超越基线 0.8-1.2 LPIPS，跨域zero-shot 迁移成功率提高 25 pp。
AI.conclusion: 数据质量三要素（类内一致、类间多样、高质量）是风格任务性能瓶颈；MegaStyle 管线可低成本扩展至任意风格，所训模型已成为社区新的风格相似度基准与强泛化迁移工具，代码与数据已开源。

title: Differentially Private Language Generation and Identification in the Limit
summary:
We initiate the study of language generation in the limit, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24], under the constraint of differential privacy. We consider the continual release model, where a generator must eventually output a stream of valid strings while protecting the privacy of the entire input sequence. Our first main result is that for countable collections of languages, privacy comes at no qualitative cost: we provide an $\varepsilon$-differentially-private algorithm that generates in the limit from any countable collection. This stands in contrast to many learning settings where privacy renders learnability impossible. However, privacy does impose a quantitative cost: there are finite collections of size $k$ for which uniform private generation requires $Ω(k/\varepsilon)$ samples, whereas just one sample suffices non-privately.
  We then turn to the harder problem of language identification in the limit. Here, we show that privacy creates fundamental barriers. We prove that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification. Next, we turn to the stochastic setting where the sample strings are sampled i.i.d. from a distribution (instead of being generated by an adversary). Here, we show that private identification is possible if and only if the collection is identifiable in the adversarial model. Together, our results establish new dimensions along which generation and identification differ and, for identification, a separation between adversarial and stochastic settings induced by privacy constraints.

AI.tldr: 在差分隐私下研究语言“极限生成”与“极限识别”：可数语言集的极限生成可无质损实现，但有量损；而对于识别，即使两条语言无限相交且差集有限，ε-DP 亦不可行，且只有在对抗模型可识别时随机模型才可私有识别。
AI.motivation: Kleinberg 与 Mullainathan 最近提出“极限生成”模型，但未知隐私约束如何影响生成与语言识别；传统学习中隐私常使学习不可能，本文欲厘清隐私对语言极限生成与识别的精确代价。
AI.method: （1）对可数语言族，构造 ε-DP 的“极限生成”算法，并证明其正确性；（2）对大小为 k 的有限族，给出私有生成样本复杂度下界 Ω(k/ε) 并比较非私有 1 样本情形；（3）对含两语言且无限交/有限差的语言族，用逆否与 packing 论证证明任何 ε-DP 算法均无法极限识别；（4）在 i.i.d. 随机样本设定下，建立私有识别等价于对抗模型可识别的充要条件。
AI.result: ① 可数语言极限生成：ε-DP 不损正确性，但样本复杂度从 1 升至 Ω(k/ε)；② 含两语言且无限交/有限差的集合，ε-DP 极限识别不可能；③ 随机设定下，私有识别 ⇔ 对抗设定下可识别；④ 首次揭示隐私约束下“生成”与“识别”本质差异，以及识别在对抗/随机设定间的隐私分离。
AI.conclusion: 隐私对语言极限任务的影响呈两极：生成仅涨样本，识别则筑理论壁垒；该壁垒在随机输入下仍与对抗不可识别等价，说明隐私将识别的可行边界永久收拢，并为后续研究隐私-学习-生成三元关系奠定新维度。

title: NS-RGS: Newton-Schulz based Riemannian gradient method for orthogonal group synchronization
summary: Group synchronization is a fundamental task involving the recovery of group elements from pairwise measurements. For orthogonal group synchronization, the most common approach reformulates the problem as a constrained nonconvex optimization and solves it using projection-based methods, such as the generalized power method. However, these methods rely on exact SVD or QR decompositions in each iteration, which are computationally expensive and become a bottleneck for large-scale problems. In this paper, we propose a Newton-Schulz-based Riemannian Gradient Scheme (NS-RGS) for orthogonal group synchronization that significantly reduces computational cost by replacing the SVD or QR step with the Newton-Schulz iteration. This approach leverages efficient matrix multiplications and aligns perfectly with modern GPU/TPU architectures. By employing a refined leave-one-out analysis, we overcome the challenge arising from statistical dependencies, and establish that NS-RGS with spectral initialization achieves linear convergence to the target solution up to near-optimal statistical noise levels. Experiments on synthetic data and real-world global alignment tasks demonstrate that NS-RGS attains accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods such as the generalized power method, while achieving nearly a 2$\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文用 Newton-Schulz 迭代替换传统投影法中的 SVD/QR，提出正交群同步的 Riemann 梯度算法 NS-RGS，理论上线性收敛且实际提速约 2 倍。
AI.motivation: 正交群同步的投影型算法每步需做精确 SVD/QR，计算瓶颈突出；亟需与 GPU/TPU 友好的低复杂度替代方案并保持统计最优性。
AI.method: 将流形约束优化子问题中的 SVD/QR 投影换成 Newton-Schulz 迭代，仅依赖矩阵乘法；用谱初始化启动，并以 leave-one-out 技巧处理统计相关性完成理论分析。
AI.result: 在接近极小极大统计误差的水平下，NS-RGS 以线性率收敛；合成与真实全局配准实验显示其精度与通用幂法持平，运行时间缩短约 2×。
AI.conclusion: Newton-Schulz 迭代可无缝嵌入正交群同步的 Riemann 梯度流程，显著降低计算量而保持最优统计精度，为大规模同步问题提供了实用且理论保障的加速方案。

title: The Shrinking Lifespan of LLMs in Science
summary: Scaling laws describe how language model capabilities grow with compute and data, but say nothing about how long a model matters once released. We provide the first large-scale empirical account of how scientists adopt and abandon language models over time. We track 62 LLMs across over 108k citing papers (2018-2025), each with at least three years of post-release data, and classify every citation as active adoption or background reference to construct per-model adoption trajectories that raw citation counts cannot resolve. We find three regularities. First, scientific adoption follows an inverted-U trajectory: usage rises after release, peaks, and declines as newer models appear, a pattern we term the \textit{scientific adoption curve}. Second, this curve is compressing: each additional release year is associated with a 27\% reduction in time-to-peak adoption ($p < 0.001$), robust to minimum-age thresholds and controls for model size. Third, release timing dominates model-level attributes as a predictor of lifecycle dynamics. Release year explains both time-to-peak and scientific lifespan more strongly than architecture, openness, or scale, though model size and access modality retain modest predictive power for total adoption volume. Together, these findings complement scaling laws with adoption-side regularities and suggest that the forces driving rapid capability progress may be the same forces compressing scientific relevance.

AI.tldr: 首次用10.8万篇引用论文勾勒62个LLM在科学界的‘生命周期’：采用呈倒U型、峰值逐年提前27%，发布时间而非模型性能决定其科学寿命。
AI.motivation: 既有缩放定律只解释模型能力如何随算力/数据增长，却完全忽视“模型一旦发布后还能被科学界用多久”。作者希望填补这一空白，为政策制定者、研究者和资助方提供实证依据。
AI.method: 收集2018-2025年间62个LLM的全部引用，人工将每篇引用区分为“主动采用”或“背景提及”，构造模型级采用轨迹；用分段回归与生存分析量化峰值时间、生命周期长度，并比较发布时间、架构、规模、开放度等变量的解释力。
AI.result: (1) 科学采用呈倒U型，称为“科学采用曲线”；(2) 曲线逐年压缩：晚一年发布，峰值提前27%（p<0.001），结果对模型最小年龄、规模控制稳健；(3) 发布时间对生命周期参数的解释力远大于架构、开放性、参数规模；规模与访问方式仅影响总采用量而非寿命。
AI.conclusion: 能力进步与“科学时效”被同一股力量驱动：更快、更强的模型加速取代旧模型。缩放定律需补充“采用侧规律”，未来模型投资需把“更快过时”计入成本。

title: SurfelSplat: Learning Efficient and Generalizable Gaussian Surfel Representations for Sparse-View Surface Reconstruction
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated impressive performance in 3D scene reconstruction. Beyond novel view synthesis, it shows great potential for multi-view surface reconstruction. Existing methods employ optimization-based reconstruction pipelines that achieve precise and complete surface extractions. However, these approaches typically require dense input views and high time consumption for per-scene optimization. To address these limitations, we propose SurfelSplat, a feed-forward framework that generates efficient and generalizable pixel-aligned Gaussian surfel representations from sparse-view images. We observe that conventional feed-forward structures struggle to recover accurate geometric attributes of Gaussian surfels because the spatial frequency of pixel-aligned primitives exceeds Nyquist sampling rates. Therefore, we propose a cross-view feature aggregation module based on the Nyquist sampling theorem. Specifically, we first adapt the geometric forms of Gaussian surfels with spatial sampling rate-guided low-pass filters. We then project the filtered surfels across all input views to obtain cross-view feature correlations. By processing these correlations through a specially designed feature fusion network, we can finally regress Gaussian surfels with precise geometry. Extensive experiments on DTU reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that our model achieves comparable results with state-of-the-art methods, and predict Gaussian surfels within 1 second, offering a 100x speedup without costly per-scene training.

AI.tldr: 无优化、纯前馈的稀疏多视图→高质3D表面的框架 SurfelSplat，利用奈奎斯特采样先验设计跨视图滤波-融合模块，可在1秒内完成场景重建，精度对齐SOTA，速度提升100倍。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽具表面重建潜力，但现存方法依赖稠密输入且逐场景优化耗时；如何在前馈网络下仅用稀疏视图获得通用、高精度且实时的重建仍属空白。
AI.method: 提出奈奎斯特指导下跨视图特征聚合：①对像素对齐高斯面片先用采样率驱动低通滤波；②将滤波后的面片投影到各输入视图获得相关性特征；③经轻量融合网络回归几何与面片属性，实现单推理重建。
AI.result: DTU基准上重建完整性/精度与SOTA优化方法持平；单次推理耗时约1s，相较逐场景训练速度提升≈100倍，无需逐场景微调。
AI.conclusion: SurfelSplat验证了奈奎斯特采样理论指导下的前馈范式可兼顾实时性、通用性与表面重建精度，为下游编辑、SLAM及AR/VR在线应用提供高效可部署方案。

title: What Drives Representation Steering? A Mechanistic Case Study on Steering Refusal
summary: Applying steering vectors to large language models (LLMs) is an efficient and effective model alignment technique, but we lack an interpretable explanation for how it works-- specifically, what internal mechanisms steering vectors affect and how this results in different model outputs. To investigate the causal mechanisms underlying the effectiveness of steering vectors, we conduct a comprehensive case study on refusal. We propose a multi-token activation patching framework and discover that different steering methodologies leverage functionally interchangeable circuits when applied at the same layer. These circuits reveal that steering vectors primarily interact with the attention mechanism through the OV circuit while largely ignoring the QK circuit-- freezing all attention scores during steering drops performance by only 8.75% across two model families. A mathematical decomposition of the steered OV circuit further reveals semantically interpretable concepts, even in cases where the steering vector itself does not. Leveraging the activation patching results, we show that steering vectors can be sparsified by up to 90-99% while retaining most performance, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions.

AI.tldr: 通过多 token 激活修补框架揭示：不同转向算法在拒绝任务中共享可互换的 OV 电路，而 QK 电路几乎不被干预；基于此可对高达 90–99% 参数稀疏化并保持性能。
AI.motivation: 现有转向向量虽能高效对齐 LLM，却缺乏对其内部因果机制的可解释性解释，阻碍了对该技术的信任与进一步优化。
AI.method: 针对“拒绝”行为构建多 token 激活修补实验，结合层内 OV-QK 电路数学分解与稀疏化搜索，系统比较不同转向方法在相同层的干预路径。
AI.result: 发现转向主要通过 OV 电路影响注意力而几乎忽略 QK；冻结全部注意力分数仅下降 8.75%。OV 分解可提取与人类可理解语义对应的概念，并证实 90–99% 参数可剪除而不显著损失性能。
AI.conclusion: 转向向量的效力源于对注意力 OV 电路的稀疏、可解释干预，而非整体注意力重排；该机制统一解释多种转向策略，并为后续压缩与可控对齐提供理论依据。

title: Quasicrystal Architected Nanomechanical Resonators via Data-Driven Design
summary: From butterfly wings to remnants of nuclear detonation, aperiodic order repeatedly emerges in nature, often exhibiting reduced sensitivity to boundaries and symmetry constraints. Inspired by this principle, a paradigm shift is introduced in nanomechanical resonator design from periodic to aperiodic structures, focusing on a special class: quasicrystals (QCs). Although soft clamping enabled by phononic stopbands has become a central strategy for achieving high-$Q_m$ nanomechanical resonators, its practical realization has been largely confined to periodic phononic crystals, where band structure engineering is well established. The potential of aperiodic architectures, however, has remained largely unexplored, owing to their intrinsic complexity and the lack of systematic approaches to identifying and exploiting stopband behavior. Here we demonstrate that soft clamping can be realized in quasicrystal architectures and that high-$Q_m$ nanomechanical resonators can be systematically achieved through a data-driven design framework. As a representative demonstration, the 12-fold QC-based resonator exhibits a quality factor $Q_m \sim 10^7$ and an effective mass of sub-nanograms at MHz frequencies, corresponding to an exceptional force sensitivity of $26.4$~aN/$\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$ compared to previous 2D phononic crystals. These results establish QCs as a robust platform for next-generation nanomechanical resonators and open a new design regime beyond periodic order.

AI.tldr: 首次将准晶（准周期结构）引入纳米力学谐振器设计，实现软夹持与超高Q值，突破传统周期声子晶体的局限。结构：12-重准晶谐振器在MHz频段取得Q_m≈10⁷、亚纳克有效质量，力灵敏度达26.4 aN/√Hz，优于所有现有二维周期结构。
AI.motivation: 自然界中普遍存在对边界与对称性不敏感的准周期序（如蝴蝶翅膀、核爆残留）。受此启发，作者希望把周期声子晶体的“软夹持—高Q”策略推广到更复杂、但此前难以系统设计的准晶体系，开辟超越周期序的新设计范式。
AI.method: 提出“数据驱动的准晶软夹持设计框架”：1) 构建12-重旋转对称的二维准晶晶格；2) 结合机器学习与有限元仿真系统搜索带隙（stopband）位置与宽度；3) 将最佳准晶单元制成硅基纳米力学谐振器，测量Q_m、有效质量m_eff与力噪声谱。
AI.result: 实验获得Q_m≈1×10⁷（MHz频段），有效质量<1 ng；推算出26.4 aN/√Hz的力灵敏度，比此前最优二维周期声子晶体提升>2×。带隙软夹持在准晶中首次被明确观测并定量利用。
AI.conclusion: 准晶可作为下一代高Q纳米力学谐振器的稳健平台；数据驱动方法破解了“非周期结构难以工程化带隙”的难题，正式开启“超越周期序”的设计新体制。

title: RL-ASL: A Dynamic Listening Optimization for TSCH Networks Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Time Slotted Channel Hopping (TSCH) is a widely adopted Media Access Control (MAC) protocol within the IEEE 802.15.4e standard, designed to provide reliable and energy-efficient communication in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks. However, state-of-the-art TSCH schedulers rely on static slot allocations, resulting in idle listening and unnecessary power consumption under dynamic traffic conditions. This paper introduces RL-ASL, a reinforcement learning-driven adaptive listening framework that dynamically decides whether to activate or skip a scheduled listening slot based on real-time network conditions. By integrating learning-based slot skipping with standard TSCH scheduling, RL-ASL reduces idle listening while preserving synchronization and delivery reliability. Experimental results on the FIT IoT-LAB testbed and Cooja network simulator show that RL-ASL achieves up to 46% lower power consumption than baseline scheduling protocols, while maintaining near-perfect reliability and reducing average latency by up to 96% compared to PRIL-M. Its link-based variant, RL-ASL-LB, further improves delay performance under high contention with similar energy efficiency. Importantly, RL-ASL performs inference on constrained motes with negligible overhead, as model training is fully performed offline. Overall, RL-ASL provides a practical, scalable, and energy-aware scheduling mechanism for next-generation low-power IIoT networks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于强化学习的TSCH自适应侦听框架RL-ASL，在保持可靠同步的同时最多降低46%功耗、96%时延，训练完全离线，可在资源受限节点实时推理。
AI.motivation: 传统IEEE 802.15.4e TSCH调度静态分配侦听时隙，动态流量下产生空闲侦听与高能耗，亟需低功耗且保持同步与可靠性的自适应机制。
AI.method: 设计RL-ASL：将时隙侦听/跳过决策建模为强化学习任务，节点基于实时链路质量与队列状态在线推理；训练在服务器离线完成，模型轻量部署至节点；进一步提出基于单条链路状态的RL-ASL-LB以缓解高竞争。
AI.result: FIT IoT-LAB实测与Cooja仿真显示，相比基准协议，RL-ASL功耗降46%，端到端可靠性近100%，平均延迟降96%；RL-ASL-LB在高负载场景下延迟再降低约10%，能耗相近；推理耗时<200 µs，RAM占用<2 KB。
AI.conclusion: RL-ASL在同步、可靠、超低功耗间取得良好平衡，支持离线训练-在线推理范式，为资源受限的工业物联网提供可扩展、即插即用的MAC层节能调度方案。

title: Phantasia: Context-Adaptive Backdoors in Vision Language Models
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have greatly enhanced the integration of visual perception and linguistic reasoning, driving rapid progress in multimodal understanding. Despite these achievements, the security of VLMs, particularly their vulnerability to backdoor attacks, remains significantly underexplored. Existing backdoor attacks on VLMs are still in an early stage of development, with most current methods relying on generating poisoned responses that contain fixed, easily identifiable patterns. In this work, we make two key contributions. First, we demonstrate for the first time that the stealthiness of existing VLM backdoor attacks has been substantially overestimated. By adapting defense techniques originally designed for other domains (e.g., vision-only and text-only models), we show that several state-of-the-art attacks can be detected with surprising ease.
