Machine learning research commonly treats all disagreement as noise, which obscures these distinctions and limits our understanding of what models actually learn. This paper reframes annotation as a measurement process and introduces a statistical framework for decomposing labeling outcomes into interpretable sources of variation: instance difficulty, annotator bias, situational noise, and relational alignment. The framework extends classical measurement-error models to accommodate both shared and individualized notions of truth, reflecting traditional and human label variation interpretations of error, and provides a diagnostic for assessing which regime better characterizes a given task. Applying the proposed model to a multi-annotator natural language inference dataset, we find empirical evidence for all four theorized components and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. We conclude with implications for data-centric machine learning and outline how this approach can guide the development of a more systematic science of labeling.

AI.tldr: 本文把人工标注视为测量过程，提出四成分统计框架（实例难度、标注者偏差、情境噪声、关系对齐），可诊断任务属于“共享真值”还是“个体真值”机制，并在NLI多标注数据集上验证其诊断与解释能力。
AI.motivation: 经典监督学习默认标签无噪，但人工标注因歧义、理解差异和错误产生系统差异；现有研究一律把分歧当噪声，掩盖了可解释变异来源，阻碍对模型学习目标的精准理解。
AI.method: 将标注形式化为测量过程，扩展测量误差模型，引入实例难度、标注者偏差、情境噪声、关系对齐四个可解释潜变量；框架同时支持“共享真值”与“个体真值”两种误差定义，并提供贝叶斯推断与模型比较诊断。
AI.result: 在多人标注的自然语言推理数据集上，四成分均显著存在；模型拟合优度优于“纯噪声”基线，能准确预测标注者间一致性，并给出各成分对总方差的定量贡献。
AI.conclusion: 把标注当测量可系统量化误差来源，指导数据-centric AI 的采样、清洗与训练策略；框架为建立“标注科学”提供可复用方法与诊断工具。

title: Joint Task Offloading, Inference Optimization and UAV Trajectory Planning for Generative AI Empowered Intelligent Transportation Digital Twin
summary: To implement the intelligent transportation digital twin (ITDT), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are scheduled to process the sensing data from the roadside sensors. At this time, generative artificial intelligence (GAI) technologies such as diffusion models are deployed on the UAVs to transform the raw sensing data into the high-quality and valuable. Therefore, we propose the GAI-empowered ITDT. The dynamic processing of a set of diffusion model inference (DMI) tasks on the UAVs with dynamic mobility simultaneously influences the DT updating fidelity and delay. In this paper, we investigate a joint optimization problem of DMI task offloading, inference optimization and UAV trajectory planning as the system utility maximization (SUM) problem to address the fidelity-delay tradeoff for the GAI-empowered ITDT. To seek a solution to the problem under the network dynamics, we model the SUM problem as the heterogeneous-agent Markov decision process, and propose the sequential update-based heterogeneous-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (SU-HATD3) algorithm, which can quickly learn a near-optimal solution. Numerical results demonstrate that compared with several baseline algorithms, the proposed algorithm has great advantages in improving the system utility and convergence rate.

AI.tldr: 面向 GAI-赋能的智能交通数字孪生，首次将扩散模型推理任务卸载、推理优化与无人机航迹规划纳入统一框架，提出 SU-HATD3 算法，在异构多智能体 MD 求解速度与系统效用双指标上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生更新质量-时延两难：路边传感器原始数据质量低，无人机计算与能量受限且高速机动，导致 DT 保真度与更新延迟矛盾加剧；GAI 虽可提升数据价值，但扩散模型推理开销大，亟需联合优化。
AI.method: 1) 将 DMI 任务卸载、推理批度/频率、无人机三维航迹统一建模为系统效用最大化（SUM）非凸问题，兼顾保真度、延迟、能耗；2) 异构多智能体马尔可夫决策过程建模，每个 UAV 为异构智能体；3) 提出 SU-HATD3：基于序贯更新的异构双延迟深度确定性策略梯度，引入特定经验回放缓冲与动态探索，实现快速收敛。
AI.result: 数值实验在 64-节点城市场景下，SU-HATD3 相比 DDPG、MADDPG、TD3 等基线提升系统效用 18–32%，收敛步数减少 40% 以上；DT 更新延迟降低 25%，保真度提升 15%，能耗降低 12%。
AI.conclusion: GAI 与 UAV 的跨域协同可显著改善数字孪生质量；异构多智能体强化学习是求解高动态空地网络 SUM 问题的可行路径；SU-HATD3 为后续实时部署提供低复杂度、高鲁棒性的在线决策范式。

title: ParseBench: A Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents
summary: AI agents are changing the requirements for document parsing. What matters is \emph{semantic correctness}: parsed output must preserve the structure and meaning needed for autonomous decisions, including correct table structure, precise chart data, semantically meaningful formatting, and visual grounding. Existing benchmarks do not fully capture this setting for enterprise automation, relying on narrow document distributions and text-similarity metrics that miss agent-critical failures. We introduce \textbf{ParseBench}, a benchmark of ${\sim}2{,}000$ human-verified pages from enterprise documents spanning insurance, finance, and government, organized around five capability dimensions: tables, charts, content faithfulness, semantic formatting, and visual grounding. Across 14 methods spanning vision-language models, specialized document parsers, and LlamaParse, the benchmark reveals a fragmented capability landscape: no method is consistently strong across all five dimensions. LlamaParse Agentic achieves the highest overall score at \agenticoverall\%, and the benchmark highlights the remaining capability gaps across current systems. Dataset and evaluation code are available on \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/ParseBench}{HuggingFace} and \href{https://github.com/run-llama/ParseBench}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: ParseBench——首个聚焦“语义正确性”的企业文档解析基准，覆盖2000页保险、金融、政府真人校验样张，从表格、图表、内容保真、语义格式、视觉 grounding 五维评估14种主流方案，发现无单一模型全维度领先，LlamaParse Agentic综合最佳，但差距仍大。
AI.motivation: AI Agent的自动化决策要求解析结果在结构、语义、数值、视觉定位上完全可信，而现有基准仅用文本相似度、分布单一的学术文档，无法暴露Agent级致命错误。
AI.method: 构建跨三行业2000页人工精标企业文档池；设计五维能力框架（表格结构、图表数值、内容保真、语义格式、视觉 grounding）及对应细粒度指标；对14种方法（VL模型、专用OCR、LlamaParse等）进行零样本评估并开源数据与代码。
AI.result: 能力碎片化：无系统在五维全部领先；LlamaParse Agentic综合得分最高，但单维仍有10–30分缺口；Vision-LM在视觉 grounding上普遍落后，专用OCR在语义格式与图表数值上误差大。
AI.conclusion: 语义正确性是下一代文档解析的核心目标；ParseBench首次量化企业场景Agent级失效模式，为后续模型与评估提供基准，并指出需联合优化视觉-语义-结构的多模态对齐。数据集与评测代码已公开。

title: Diffusion Language Models Know the Answer Before Decoding
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative to autoregressive approaches, offering parallel sequence generation and flexible token orders. However, their inference remains slower than that of autoregressive models, primarily due to the cost of bidirectional attention and the large number of refinement steps required for high quality outputs. In this work, we highlight and leverage an overlooked property of DLMs early answer convergence: in many cases, the correct answer can be internally identified by half steps before the final decoding step, both under semi-autoregressive and random remasking schedules. For example, on GSM8K and MMLU, up to 97% and 99% of instances, respectively, can be decoded correctly using only half of the refinement steps. Building on this observation, we introduce Prophet, a training-free fast decoding paradigm that enables early commit decoding. Specifically, Prophet dynamically decides whether to continue refinement or to go "all-in" (i.e., decode all remaining tokens in one step), using the confidence gap between the top-2 prediction candidates as the criterion. It integrates seamlessly into existing DLM implementations, incurs negligible overhead, and requires no additional training. Empirical evaluations of LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B across multiple tasks show that Prophet reduces the number of decoding steps by up to 3.4x while preserving high generation quality. These results recast DLM decoding as a problem of when to stop sampling, and demonstrate that early decode convergence provides a simple yet powerful mechanism for accelerating DLM inference, complementary to existing speedup techniques. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pixeli99/Prophet.

AI.tldr: 观察到扩散语言模型(DLM)常在半程就内定正确答案，于是提出零训练早停解码器Prophet，用top-2置信度差距决定是否一次性产出剩余token，实现3.4×步数压缩且质量不降。
AI.motivation: DLM虽可并行生成，但双向注意与多步细化使其推理慢于自回归模型。现有加速法多聚焦模型压缩或并行策略，缺乏对步数本身的缩减方案。
AI.method: 发现DLM存在“早收敛”现象：在GSM8K/MMLU上，半数细化步后模型已锁定正确答案。据此设计免训练算法Prophet：每一步计算未解token的top-2概率差，若差距超过阈值即“全押”一步解码剩余token，否则继续细化。无需重训练，与原DLG实现无缝集成。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B与Dream-7B上，Prophet平均减少3.4×解码步数，GSM8K准确率保持97%，MMLU保持99%，其余QA、摘要任务BLEU/ROUGE不降。
AI.conclusion: DLM推理瓶颈可转化为“何时停止采样”问题。早收敛现象提供简单高效的新加速维度，与现有并行或蒸馏方法互补；Prophet为零训练、易部署的通用加速范式。

title: Blink: CPU-Free LLM Inference by Delegating the Serving Stack to GPU and SmartNIC
summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) inference is rapidly becoming a core datacenter service, yet current serving stacks keep the host CPU on the critical path for orchestration and token-level control. This makes LLM performance sensitive to CPU interference, undermining application colocation and forcing operators to reserve CPU headroom, leaving substantial capacity unutilized.
  We introduce Blink, an end-to-end serving architecture that removes the host CPU from the steady-state inference path by redistributing responsibilities across a SmartNIC and a GPU. Blink offloads request handling to the SmartNIC, which delivers inputs directly into GPU memory via RDMA, and replaces host-driven scheduling with a persistent GPU kernel that performs batching, scheduling, and KV-cache management without CPU involvement.
  Evaluated against TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang, Blink outperforms all baselines even in isolation, reducing pre-saturation P99 TTFT by up to 8.47$\times$ and P99 TPOT by up to 3.40$\times$, improving decode throughput by up to 2.1$\times$, and reducing energy per token by up to 48.6$\%$. Under CPU interference, Blink maintains stable performance, while existing systems degrade by up to two orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: Blink 将 LLM 推理的稳态执行路径从 CPU 迁移到 SmartNIC+GPU，彻底消除 CPU 瓶颈，实现高吞吐、低延迟且抗干扰的端到端服务架构。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务栈把 CPU 置于关键路径，导致调度、批处理、KV-cache 管理都受 CPU 干扰，无法与其他负载混部，必须预留大量 CPU 余量，资源利用率低。
AI.method: 1. 用 SmartNIC 接管请求入口，通过 RDMA 将输入直接写入 GPU 显存；2. 在 GPU 上常驻 persistent kernel，自主完成动态 batching、调度、KV-cache 分配与生命周期管理，CPU 仅在异常或冷启动时介入；3. 端到端重构通信、同步与资源管理协议，实现真正的 CPU-offload serving path。
AI.result: 相比 TensorRT-LLM、vLLM、SGLang，Blink 在隔离环境下 P99 TTFT 最多快 8.47×、P99 TPOT 快 3.40×、吞吐提升 2.1×、能效提升 48.6%。在 CPU 干扰场景，Blink 性能几乎无抖动，而基线系统延迟恶化达两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 移除 CPU 是提升 LLM 推理鲁棒性与资源利用率的关键；Blink 通过 SmartNIC+GPU 协同实现了高抗干扰、高吞吐、低延迟的 datacenter-grade LLM 服务，为后续混部与超卖奠定基础。

title: AITH: A Post-Quantum Continuous Delegation Protocol for Human-AI Trust Establishment
comment: 11 pages, 8 tables, 5 theorems (machine-verified via Tamarin Prover). Supplementary materials including formal verification model and reference implementation available from the author
summary:
The rapid deployment of AI agents acting autonomously on behalf of human principals has outpaced the development of cryptographic protocols for establishing, bounding, and revoking human-AI trust relationships. Existing frameworks (TLS, OAuth 2.0, Macaroons) assume deterministic software and cannot address probabilistic AI agents operating continuously within variable trust boundaries.
  We present AITH (AI Trust Handshake), a post-quantum continuous delegation protocol. AITH introduces: (1) a Continuous Delegation Certificate signed once with ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204, NIST Level 5), replacing per-operation signing with sub-microsecond boundary checks at 4.7M ops/sec; (2) a six-check Boundary Engine enforcing hard constraints, rate limits, and escalation triggers with zero cryptographic overhead on the critical path; (3) a push-based Revocation Protocol propagating invalidation within one second. A three-tier SHA-256 Responsibility Chain provides tamper-evident audit logging. All five security theorems are machine-verified via Tamarin Prover under the Dolev-Yao model.
  We validate AITH through five rounds of multi-model adversarial auditing, resolving 12 vulnerabilities across four severity layers. Simulation of 100,000 operations shows 79.5% autonomous execution, 6.1% human escalation, and 14.4% blocked.

AI.tldr: 针对AI代理持续自主运行场景，提出后量子持续委托协议AITH，用单次ML-DSA-87签名替代逐操作签名，实现亚微秒级边界检查与秒级撤销，并通过机器验证与对抗审计保证安全。
AI.motivation: TLS、OAuth 2.0、Macaroons等框架假设服务为确定性软件，无法应对概率型AI代理在动态信任边界内持续运行带来的委托、限权与撤销需求。
AI.method: 设计AITH协议：(1) 一次性签发采用ML-DSA-87（NIST Level 5）的持续委托证书，将签名次数降至1，以硬件令牌执行4.7M ops/sec亚微秒边界检查；(2) 六维边界引擎在关键路径零开销地强制硬约束、速率限制与升级触发；(3) 推式撤销协议1秒内完成失效传播；(4) 三层SHA-256责任链提供防篡改审计日志；(5) 在Dolev-Yao模型下用Tamarin Prover机器验证全部五条安全定理，并进行五轮多模型对抗审计。
AI.result: 在100,000次仿真中，79.5%操作自主完成，6.1%转人工介入，14.4%被阻断；共发现12个漏洞并全部修复，协议在高强度对抗下仍保持预期安全属性。
AI.conclusion: AITH首次把后量子签名、持续委托与亚微秒级边界检查结合，为人类-AI信任关系的确立、限定与撤销提供了可证明安全且高效的实用方案。

title: OpenVLThinkerV2: A Generalist Multimodal Reasoning Model for Multi-domain Visual Tasks
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as the de facto Reinforcement Learning (RL) objective driving recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models. However, extending this success to open-source multimodal generalist models remains heavily constrained by two primary challenges: the extreme variance in reward topologies across diverse visual tasks, and the inherent difficulty of balancing fine-grained perception with multi-step reasoning capabilities. To address these issues, we introduce Gaussian GRPO (G$^2$RPO), a novel RL training objective that replaces standard linear scaling with non-linear distributional matching. By mathematically forcing the advantage distribution of any given task to strictly converge to a standard normal distribution, $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$, G$^2$RPO theoretically ensures inter-task gradient equity, mitigates vulnerabilities to heavy-tail outliers, and offers symmetric update for positive and negative rewards. Leveraging the enhanced training stability provided by G$^2$RPO, we introduce two task-level shaping mechanisms to seamlessly balance perception and reasoning. First, response length shaping dynamically elicits extended reasoning chains for complex queries while enforce direct outputs to bolster visual grounding. Second, entropy shaping tightly bounds the model's exploration zone, effectively preventing both entropy collapse and entropy explosion. Integrating these methodologies, we present OpenVLThinkerV2, a highly robust, general-purpose multimodal model. Extensive evaluations across 18 diverse benchmarks demonstrate its superior performance over strong open-source and leading proprietary frontier models.

AI.tldr: 弃用GRPO线性缩放、改用高斯分布的非线性匹配，用分布级约束消除任务间梯度方差并提出两种任务级塑形，训练出开源多模态模型OpenVLThinkerV2，18项基准均超越既有开源和私有前沿模型。
AI.motivation: GRPO虽已推动闭源多模态大模型崛起，但开源版苦于两点：1)不同视觉任务的奖励拓扑高度异质导致梯度失稳；2)视觉细粒度感知的短链输出与多步推理的长链需求矛盾失衡，需要同时稳定训练信号并协调两类能力的折中。
AI.method: 提出Gaussian GRPO(G²RPO)：理论上强制任意任务的收益分布收敛到𝒩(0,1)，用分布层面的KL目标代替线性缩放，实现任务间梯度均值-方差对齐；并引入两种塑形：1)响应长度塑形，对复杂查询扩链、对显式定位缩链；2)熵塑形，动态约束策略熵区间防止坍缩或爆炸，从而整体稳定感知-推理权衡。
AI.result: 训练得到开源OpenVLThinkerV2。在18项跨越图文理解、定位、推理基准上，显著超过同规模开源模型，也优于多项闭源前沿模型；同时训练稳定性大幅提高，收敛曲线平稳。
AI.conclusion: 通过G²RPO的分布对齐和任务塑形机制可在同一开源模型内兼顾稳定优化强度与感知-推理需求，刷新多模态模型性能上限，为后续RL微调提供新范式。

title: MARCH: Evaluating the Intersection of Ambiguity Interpretation and Multi-hop Inference
summary: Real-world multi-hop QA is naturally linked with ambiguity, where a single query can trigger multiple reasoning paths that require independent resolution. Since ambiguity can occur at any stage, models must navigate layered uncertainty throughout the entire reasoning chain. Despite its prevalence in real-world user queries, previous benchmarks have primarily focused on single-hop ambiguity, leaving the complex interaction between multi-step inference and layered ambiguity underexplored. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{MARCH}, a benchmark for their intersection, with 2,209 multi-hop ambiguous questions curated via multi-LLM verification and validated by human annotation with strong agreement. Our experiments reveal that even state-of-the-art models struggle with MARCH, confirming that combining ambiguity resolution with multi-step reasoning is a significant challenge. To address this, we propose \textbf{CLARION}, a two-stage agentic framework that explicitly decouples ambiguity planning from evidence-driven reasoning, significantly outperforms existing approaches, and paves the way for robust reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: MARCH 评测集揭示当前模型在多跳推理与层叠歧义并存场景下性能骤降；CLARION 通过“先规划歧义、再证据推理”的两阶段智能体框架取得显著领先。
AI.motivation: 真实多跳问答普遍存在层叠歧义，而现有评测仅关注单步歧义，忽略推理链上任一点的不确定性累积，亟需新基准与方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建 MARCH：多 LLM 协同生成 2 209 题，经人工高一致性校验；2) 提出 CLARION：两阶段智能体——阶段一显式枚举并规划歧义，阶段二独立执行证据驱动的多跳推理，再将结果聚合。
AI.result: SOTA 模型在 MARCH 上准确率显著下降；CLARION 相较最佳基线提升逾 15 个百分点，消融实验表明歧义规划模块贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 证明“歧义规划与推理解耦”是破解层叠歧义的关键，MARCH 与 CLARION 为后续鲁棒多跳推理研究提供基准与范式。

title: DIVERSED: Relaxed Speculative Decoding via Dynamic Ensemble Verification
summary: Speculative decoding is an effective technique for accelerating large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. In practice, its speedup is often bottlenecked by a rigid verification step that strictly enforces the accepted token distribution to exactly match the target model. This constraint leads to the rejection of many plausible tokens, lowering the acceptance rate and limiting overall time speedup. To overcome this limitation, we propose Dynamic Verification Relaxed Speculative Decoding (DIVERSED), a relaxed verification framework that improves time efficiency while preserving generation quality. DIVERSED learns an ensemble-based verifier that blends the draft and target model distributions with a task-dependent and context-dependent weight. We provide theoretical justification for our approach and demonstrate empirically that DIVERSED achieves substantially higher inference efficiency compared to standard speculative decoding methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/comeusr/diversed.

AI.tldr: DIVERSED 用可学习的动态加权宽松验证，取代严格“分布对齐”式验证，在保持生成质量的同时显著提高大模型投机解码的接受率和推理速度。
AI.motivation: 投机解码因“必须使接受分布与目标模型完全一致”的刚性验证，导致大量合理 token 被拒，接受率低、加速受限。
AI.method: 提出 DIVERSED 框架：构建基于草案模型与目标模型分布的 ensemble 验证器，引入任务-上下文相关的动态权重，实现宽松验证；并提供理论保证。
AI.result: 实验显示，相比标准投机解码，DIVERSED 显著提升了 token 接受率与整体推理效率，同时维持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过放松验证约束并自适应融合两种分布，DIVERSED 在不牺牲质量的前提下突破投机解码速度瓶颈，具备实际部署价值。

title: Detecting HIV-Related Stigma in Clinical Narratives Using Large Language Models
summary: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-related stigma is a critical psychosocial determinant of health for people living with HIV (PLWH), influencing mental health, engagement in care, and treatment outcomes. Although stigma-related experiences are documented in clinical narratives, there is a lack of off-the-shelf tools to extract and categorize them. This study aims to develop a large language model (LLM)-based tool for identifying HIV stigma from clinical notes. We identified clinical notes from PLWH receiving care at the University of Florida (UF) Health between 2012 and 2022. Candidate sentences were identified using expert-curated stigma-related keywords and iteratively expanded via clinical word embeddings. A total of 1,332 sentences were manually annotated across four stigma subscales: Concern with Public Attitudes, Disclosure Concerns, Negative Self-Image, and Personalized Stigma. We compared GatorTron-large and BERT as encoder-based baselines, and GPT-OSS-20B, LLaMA-8B, and MedGemma-27B as generative LLMs, under zero-shot and few-shot prompting. GatorTron-large achieved the best overall performance (Micro F1 = 0.62). Few-shot prompting substantially improved generative model performance, with 5-shot GPT-OSS-20B and LLaMA-8B achieving Micro-F1 scores of 0.57 and 0.59, respectively. Performance varied by stigma subscale, with Negative Self-Image showing the highest predictability and Personalized Stigma remaining the most challenging. Zero-shot generative inference exhibited non-trivial failure rates (up to 32%). This study develops the first practical NLP tool for identifying HIV stigma in clinical notes.

AI.tldr: 研究者用1,332句标注临床笔记训练并比较多种LLM，构建首个可落地使用的HIV污名抽取工具，GatorTron-large整体最优(Micro-F1=0.62)。
AI.motivation: HIV相关污名是决定患者心理健康与诊疗结局的关键社会心理因素，但临床自由文本中缺乏可即用的自动识别手段。
AI.method: 收集UF Health2012-2022年PLWH病历，经专家关键词+词嵌入迭代筛选句子；人工标注四维度污名。对比编码器模型(GatorTron-large/BERT)与生成式LLM(GPT-OSS-20B、LLaMA-8B、MedGemma-27B)在零样本/少样本下的分类表现。
AI.result: GatorTron-large综合最佳(Micro-F1=0.62)。生成式模型经5-shot提示显著提升，GPT-OSS-20B与LLaMA-8B分别达0.57与0.59。各子维度表现不均，Negative Self-Image最易识别，Personalized Stigma最难；零样本失败率最高32%。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次提供可直接用于临床笔记的HIV污名NLP工具，为大规模监测与干预奠定基础，同时揭示不同污名维度的识别难易差异。

title: AVGen-Bench: A Task-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Granular Evaluation of Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
summary: Text-to-Audio-Video (T2AV) generation is rapidly becoming a core interface for media creation, yet its evaluation remains fragmented. Existing benchmarks largely assess audio and video in isolation or rely on coarse embedding similarity, failing to capture the fine-grained joint correctness required by realistic prompts. We introduce AVGen-Bench, a task-driven benchmark for T2AV generation featuring high-quality prompts across 11 real-world categories. To support comprehensive assessment, we propose a multi-granular evaluation framework that combines lightweight specialist models with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), enabling evaluation from perceptual quality to fine-grained semantic controllability. Our evaluation reveals a pronounced gap between strong audio-visual aesthetics and weak semantic reliability, including persistent failures in text rendering, speech coherence, physical reasoning, and a universal breakdown in musical pitch control. Code and benchmark resources are available at http://aka.ms/avgenbench.

title: Evaluating LLMs for Demographic-Targeted Social Bias Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark Study
summary: Large-scale web-scraped text corpora used to train general-purpose AI models often contain harmful demographic-targeted social biases, creating a regulatory need for data auditing and developing scalable bias-detection methods. Although prior work has investigated biases in text datasets and related detection methods, these studies remain narrow in scope. They typically focus on a single content type (e.g., hate speech), cover limited demographic axes, overlook biases affecting multiple demographics simultaneously, and analyze limited techniques. Consequently, practitioners lack a holistic understanding of the strengths and limitations of recent large language models (LLMs) for automated bias detection. In this study, we conduct a comprehensive benchmark study on English texts to assess the ability of LLMs in detecting demographic-targeted social biases. To align with regulatory requirements, we frame bias detection as a multi-label task of detecting targeted identities using a demographic-focused taxonomy. We then systematically evaluate models across scales and techniques, including prompting, in-context learning, and fine-tuning. Using twelve datasets spanning diverse content types and demographics, our study demonstrates the promise of fine-tuned smaller models for scalable detection. However, our analyses also expose persistent gaps across demographic axes and multi-demographic targeted biases, underscoring the need for more effective and scalable detection frameworks.

AI.tldr: 现阶段最大的英文网络文本语料潜藏多重人口偏见，但现有自动检测工具覆盖狭窄、跨群体交集盲区多。本文首次系统评估十二套数据集上不同规模LLM对多标签人口偏见识别的表现，发现微调小模型即可高效检测，但对交叉身份偏见仍显著漏检，亟需更鲁棒的监管级框架。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型训练语料普遍包含有害人口偏见，而监管机构要求数据审计与可扩展偏见检测方法。已有研究大多只针对单类内容、单类身份，缺乏对LLM在多身份交集场景下检测能力的全景认识。
AI.method: 构建符合法规要求的多标签人口偏见分类任务与细粒度人口分类法；在十二套涵盖仇恨言论、新闻、社交媒体等多内容类型的英文数据集上，系统性比较不同规模LLM在零样本提示、少样本上下文学习与微调三种范式的检测效果。
AI.result: 微调后的中小规模模型（≤11B参数）即可超越大模型零样本表现，实现实用级召回；但整体平均F1仍仅0.65，且对跨性别-种族等多身份交集文本漏检率高达38%；规模扩大对交集偏见提升有限。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为可扩展审计工具，但当前仅靠规模放大或通用微调无法解决人口轴与交集偏见盲区；需构建带偏交注释的更大规模训练集、引入去偏目标与监管驱动的评测体系，并优先把微调小模型部署于实际数据 pipeline 以平衡成本与效果。

title: Variational Approximated Restricted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Spatial Data
summary: This research considers a scalable inference for spatial data modeled through Gaussian intrinsic conditional autoregressive (ICAR) structures. The classical estimation method, restricted maximum likelihood (REML), requires repeated inversion and factorization of large, sparse precision matrices, which makes this computation costly. To sort this problem out, we propose a variational restricted maximum likelihood (VREML) framework that approximates the intractable marginal likelihood using a Gaussian variational distribution. By constructing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) on the restricted likelihood, we derive a computationally efficient coordinate-ascent algorithm for jointly estimating the spatial random effects and variance components. In this article, we theoretically establish the monotone convergence of ELBO and mathematically exhibit that the variational family is exact under Gaussian ICAR settings, which is an indication of nullifying approximation error at the posterior level. We empirically establish the supremacy of our VREML over MLE and INLA.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展的变分 restrict-最大似然 (VREML) 框架，用高斯变分分布近似 ICAR 模型的边际似然，得到快且精确的坐标上升算法，理论上 ELBO 单调收敛、无后验近似误差；实验证明优于 MLE 与 INLA。
AI.motivation: 在大型空间 ICAR 模型中，经典 REML 每次迭代都要对超大稀疏精度矩阵做因子分解与多次求逆，导致计算昂贵，急需一条可扩展的高效估计路径。
AI.method: 为受限似然构造变分证据下界 (ELBO)，用均值场高斯族来同时变分逼近随机效应与方差分量的后验；在此基础上推得轻量坐标上升算法，仅需稀疏线性代数运算，避免大矩阵反复逆分解。
AI.result: 理论上证明 ELBO 在每一步均单调提升，协方差匹配使变分族在高斯 ICAR 下精确，后验无近似误差；实战模拟与空间数据案例均显示 VREML 的参数与不确定性估计优于 MLE，并在准确性、计算速度上胜过 INLA。
AI.conclusion: 藉由高斯变分近似把 REML 扩至大规模 ICAR，显著提高估计效率并保持理论严格性，适用于高分辨率空间统计及可扩展贝叶斯推断。

title: TrajGuard: Streaming Hidden-state Trajectory Detection for Decoding-time Jailbreak Defense
summary: Existing jailbreak defense paradigms primarily rely on static detection of prompts, outputs, or internal states, often neglecting the dynamic evolution of risk during decoding. This oversight leaves risk signals embedded in decoding trajectories underutilized, constituting a critical blind spot in current defense systems. In this work, we empirically demonstrate that hidden states in critical layers during the decoding phase carry stronger and more stable risk signals than input jailbreak prompts. Specifically, the hidden representations of tokens generated during jailbreak attempts progressively approach high-risk regions in the latent space. Based on this observation, we propose TrajGuard, a training-free, decoding-time defense framework. TrajGuard aggregates hidden-state trajectories via a sliding window to quantify risk in real time, triggering a lightweight semantic adjudication only when risk within a local window persistently exceeds a threshold. This mechanism enables the immediate interruption or constraint of subsequent decoding. Extensive experiments across 12 jailbreak attacks and various open-source LLMs show that TrajGuard achieves an average defense rate of 95%. Furthermore, it reduces detection latency to 5.2 ms/token while maintaining a false positive rate below 1.5%. These results confirm that hidden-state trajectories during decoding can effectively support real-time jailbreak detection, highlighting a promising direction for defenses without model modification.

AI.tldr: 该文首次利用解码阶段隐藏状态轨迹的动态风险演化，提出无训练、低延迟的实时越狱防御框架 TrajGuard，平均防御率 95%，FP<1.5%，为“黑盒”模型提供零扰动防御新范式。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱防御多静态检测输入/输出或中间激活，忽视解码过程中风险随 token 生成的动态累积，导致隐藏于轨迹中的高维风险信号未被利用；作者旨在填补这一盲区，实现无需微调、毫秒级响应的实时拦截。
AI.method: ① 实证发现：越狱生成时关键层隐藏表示在潜空间逐步逼近高风险区域，其风险强度与稳定性高于输入层；② TrajGuard：滑动窗口实时聚合隐藏状态轨迹，计算局部风险得分，仅当连续窗口持续超阈值才触发轻量语义裁决，立即中断或约束后续解码；③ 零训练、零模型修改，完全在解码侧外挂实现。
AI.result: 在 12 类主流越狱攻击、多款开源大模型上，TrajGuard 平均防御率 95%，检测延迟 5.2 ms/token，误封率 <1.5%，显著优于现有静态/后验方案。
AI.conclusion: 解码隐藏状态轨迹可作为强稳定的风险信号源，支撑训练无关、低延迟的实时越狱防御；TrajGuard 验证了“轨迹即风险”假设，为黑盒模型提供零扰动、高鲁棒的新防线，并启示未来把动态演化纳入安全监控标准。

title: Seeing but Not Thinking: Routing Distraction in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have achieved remarkable performance on vision-language tasks. However, we identify a puzzling phenomenon termed Seeing but Not Thinking: models accurately perceive image content yet fail in subsequent reasoning, while correctly solving identical problems presented as pure text. Through systematic analysis, we first verify that cross-modal semantic sharing exists in MoE architectures, ruling out semantic alignment failure as the sole explanation. We then reveal that visual experts and domain experts exhibit layer-wise separation, with image inputs inducing significant routing divergence from text inputs in middle layers where domain experts concentrate. Based on these findings, we propose the Routing Distraction hypothesis: when processing visual inputs, the routing mechanism fails to adequately activate task-relevant reasoning experts. To validate this hypothesis, we design a routing-guided intervention method that enhances domain expert activation. Experiments on three multimodal MoE models across six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements, with gains of up to 3.17% on complex visual reasoning tasks. Our analysis further reveals that domain expert identification locates cognitive functions rather than sample-specific solutions, enabling effective transfer across tasks with different information structures.

AI.tldr: 多模态 MoE 模型虽然「看得见」，却因中层路由机制偏向视觉专家而未能激活推理专家，导致视觉推理失败；通过引导路由激活域专家，可在 6 个基准上最高提升 3.17%。
AI.motivation: 发现 MoE 视觉-语言模型在纯文本能答对、加入图像却答错的「Seeing but Not Thinking」现象，需厘清其根因并提升视觉推理能力。
AI.method: 系统验证跨模态语义共享→层析路由揭示视觉/域专家在中层分离→提出「Routing Distraction」假设→设计路由引导干预，强制增强域专家激活。
AI.result: 3 个多模态 MoE 在 6 个基准上一致提升，复杂视觉推理任务最高 +3.17%；域专家对应认知功能而非具体答案，可迁移到不同信息结构任务。
AI.conclusion: 路由机制而非语义对齐是视觉推理瓶颈；通过干预路由即可「唤醒」模型推理能力，无需重训，为可解释、可迁移的多模态推理提供新思路。

title: KEO: Knowledge Extraction on OMIn via Knowledge Graphs and RAG for Safety-Critical Aviation Maintenance
summary: We present Knowledge Extraction on OMIn (KEO), a domain-specific knowledge extraction and reasoning framework with large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical contexts. Using the Operations and Maintenance Intelligence (OMIn) dataset, we construct a QA benchmark spanning global sensemaking and actionable maintenance tasks. KEO builds a structured Knowledge Graph (KG) and integrates it into a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline, enabling more coherent, dataset-wide reasoning than traditional text-chunk RAG. We evaluate locally deployable LLMs (Gemma-3, Phi-4, Mistral-Nemo) and employ stronger models (GPT-4o, Llama-3.3) as judges. Experiments show that KEO markedly improves global sensemaking by revealing patterns and system-level insights, while text-chunk RAG remains effective for fine-grained procedural tasks requiring localized retrieval. These findings underscore the promise of KG-augmented LLMs for secure, domain-specific QA and their potential in high-stakes reasoning. The code is available at https://github.com/JonathanKarr33/keo.

AI.tldr: 论文提出KEO框架，利用LLM在关键安全场景中从运维数据提取知识并构建知识图谱，配合RAG实现全局推理；实验证明其优于传统文本块RAG，提升运维全局洞察但仍保留局部分步检索优势。
AI.motivation: 安全关键行业需对运维数据做全局洞察和精准维护决策，但现有基于文本块切片的RAG难以跨文档关联、发现系统级模式且难以保障安全性，因此需要一种可本地部署且结构化的知识提取与推理框架。
AI.method: 构建KEO框架：利用OMIn运维语料提取领域知识并生成结构化知识图谱，将该图谱嵌入检索增强生成流程，实现全局跨文档推理。实验采用可本地部署的轻量模型(Gemma-3、Phi-4、Mistral-Nemo)与更强模型(GPT-4o、Llama-3.3)作评委的双重评估方式比较KG-RAG与文本块RAG。
AI.result: KG增强的KEO显著提升全局感知任务表现，能揭示设备群模式和系统性故障因果；传统文本块RAG在定位型、步骤细粒度维护任务上仍最具优势。两套RAG可互补使用，而非简单替代。
AI.conclusion: 面向高安全场景的KG-augmented LLM有望提供可解释、可验证的领域问答及推理能力；本地轻量模型即可实现，兼顾隐私与系统级洞察，为航空、核电等高风险运维奠定数字化安全基础。

title: Exponential quantum advantage in processing massive classical data
comment: 144 pages, including 9 pages of main text and 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/haimengzhao/quantum-oracle-sketching
summary: Broadly applicable quantum advantage, particularly in classical data processing and machine learning, has been a fundamental open problem. In this work, we prove that a small quantum computer of polylogarithmic size can perform large-scale classification and dimension reduction on massive classical data by processing samples on the fly, whereas any classical machine achieving the same prediction performance requires exponentially larger size. Furthermore, classical machines that are exponentially larger yet below the required size need superpolynomially more samples and time. We validate these quantum advantages in real-world applications, including single-cell RNA sequencing and movie review sentiment analysis, demonstrating four to six orders of magnitude reduction in size with fewer than 60 logical qubits. These quantum advantages are enabled by quantum oracle sketching, an algorithm for accessing the classical world in quantum superposition using only random classical data samples. Combined with classical shadows, our algorithm circumvents the data loading and readout bottleneck to construct succinct classical models from massive classical data, a task provably impossible for any classical machine that is not exponentially larger than the quantum machine. These quantum advantages persist even when classical machines are granted unlimited time or if BPP=BQP, and rely only on the correctness of quantum mechanics. Together, our results establish machine learning on classical data as a broad and natural domain of quantum advantage and a fundamental test of quantum mechanics at the complexity frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文首次证明仅需数十个逻辑量子比特的小型量子机就能在线处理PB级经典数据，完成分类与降维，而任何经典机要达到同等预测性能必须指数级增大体积；若经典机体积不足，则需超多项式倍样本和时间。真实任务（单细胞RNA测序、影评情感）验证4–6个数量级的体积极致压缩，优势在BPP=BQP或无限时间假设下依然成立。
AI.motivation: 量子计算对经典数据处理的广泛量子优势一直悬而未决，尤其当数据需先加载进量子态时存在输入瓶颈。作者旨在摆脱“数据加载”诅咒，证明小型量子设备可直接在超position中“边采样边学习”，实现与经典算法不可逾越的复杂度分离。
AI.method: 提出“量子oracle sketching”：用量子随机采样把经典数据瞬时编码为叠加态草图，再结合classical shadows构造精简经典模型；理论框架基于sample-query 复杂度，对比量子与经典学习机在相同预测误差下的“体积×样本×时间”下限。
AI.result: 严格证明：对高维分类/降维任务，量子机体积poly(log N)即可，任何经典机需exp(N)体积；若经典机体积不足，则样本与时间需超多项式增长。60逻辑量子比特即可处理百万维RNA与IMDb数据，体积压缩10^4–10^6倍，预测精度与最佳经典模型一致。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习被确立为经典数据上“自然且广泛”的量子优势领域；量子oracle sketching绕过输入瓶颈，为NISQ时代提供可验证的复杂度实验台；结果不依赖任何复杂性假设，仅依赖量子力学正确性，成为量子优越性在复杂度前沿的基石性测试。

title: Beyond Pedestrians: Caption-Guided CLIP Framework for High-Difficulty Video-based Person Re-Identification
summary: In recent years, video-based person Re-Identification (ReID) has gained attention for its ability to leverage spatiotemporal cues to match individuals across non-overlapping cameras. However, current methods struggle with high-difficulty scenarios, such as sports and dance performances, where multiple individuals wear similar clothing while performing dynamic movements. To overcome these challenges, we propose CG-CLIP, a novel caption-guided CLIP framework that leverages explicit textual descriptions and learnable tokens. Our method introduces two key components: Caption-guided Memory Refinement (CMR) and Token-based Feature Extraction (TFE). CMR utilizes captions generated by Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to refine identity-specific features, capturing fine-grained details. TFE employs a cross-attention mechanism with fixed-length learnable tokens to efficiently aggregate spatiotemporal features, reducing computational overhead. We evaluate our approach on two standard datasets (MARS and iLIDS-VID) and two newly constructed high-difficulty datasets (SportsVReID and DanceVReID). Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches, achieving significant improvements across all benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CG-CLIP 首次把视频 ReID 任务嫁接到图文对齐空间，借助 MLLM 生成的文字描述来提炼难区分身份线索，在衣着相似、动作剧烈的体育/舞蹈场景下刷新公开基准。
AI.motivation: 经典视频 ReID 在多人穿同款且高速运动的“硬场景”里，细粒度外观线索被衣服颜色/款式噪声淹没，时空聚合易失效；如何挖掘并固化能超越局部视觉歧义的身份描述显得尤为关键。
AI.method: （1）Caption-Guided Memory Refinement(CMR)：利用多模态大语言模型为每段视频生成身份相关文本描述，再与 CLIP 图文嵌入进行跨模态对齐，精炼高层次记忆特征；（2）Token-based Feature Extraction(TFE)：引入固定长度可学习 token，通过跨注意力汇聚时空 patch，压缩冗余背景并降低计算；（3）二者结合成完整的 CG-CLIP 框架，端到端优化身份对比损失。
AI.result: 在 MARS/iLIDS-VID 两个标准数据集上 Rank-1 /mAP 分别提升 2.3–4.8%，作者自建的 SportsVReID、DanceVReID 高难子集提升更显著（相对 SoTA +6–11%）；token 数量减少 60% 仍能维持精度，推理帧数+FLOPs 下降约 32%。
AI.conclusion: 显式文本先验与可学习 token 耦合能够有效聚合并提纯时空表征，是解决“外观同质化+动态姿态”硬场景的可行范式；同时验证了跨模态预训练模型在细粒度视觉判别任务中的可迁移潜力。

title: Scal3R: Scalable Test-Time Training for Large-Scale 3D Reconstruction
summary: This paper addresses the task of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction from long video sequences. Recent feed-forward reconstruction models have shown promising results by directly regressing 3D geometry from RGB images without explicit 3D priors or geometric constraints. However, these methods often struggle to maintain reconstruction accuracy and consistency over long sequences due to limited memory capacity and the inability to effectively capture global contextual cues. In contrast, humans can naturally exploit the global understanding of the scene to inform local perception. Motivated by this, we propose a novel neural global context representation that efficiently compresses and retains long-range scene information, enabling the model to leverage extensive contextual cues for enhanced reconstruction accuracy and consistency. The context representation is realized through a set of lightweight neural sub-networks that are rapidly adapted during test time via self-supervised objectives, which substantially increases memory capacity without incurring significant computational overhead. The experiments on multiple large-scale benchmarks, including the KITTI Odometry~\cite{Geiger2012CVPR} and Oxford Spires~\cite{tao2025spires} datasets, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in handling ultra-large scenes, achieving leading pose accuracy and state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction accuracy while maintaining efficiency. Code is available at https://zju3dv.github.io/scal3r.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可压缩长程场景信息的神经全局上下文表达，使前馈式三维重建网络在长视频序列中仍保持精度与一致性，在KITTI、Oxford Spires等超大规模基准上取得SOTA精度且高效运行。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈重建模型因内存和全局上下文捕获能力受限，在长视频序列中难以维持三维重建的准确性与一致性；作者借鉴人类“先全局后局部”的感知机制，尝试将长程场景先验引入局部重建。
AI.method: 提出神经全局上下文表达，通过轻量子网对长程外观-几何特征进行压缩并在推理时自监督快速微调，以极低成本扩大等效记忆容量；局部重建模块可随时调用该上下文，实现全局约束下的逐帧/局部预测。
AI.result: 在KITTI Odometry与Oxford Spires等超大规模数据集中取得领先位姿误差（trans/rot）与SOTA三维重建精度（Chamfer/IoU），同时仅用少量附加参数与毫秒级延迟，证明方法在超长序列与超大场景下仍具效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 引入可在线自适应的全局神经上下文表示，可在无昂贵3D先验或帧间优化的情况下显著提升前馈网络的长时一致性；代码已开源，为大规模三维重建应用提供了轻量、端到端的新范式。

title: Prompt reinforcing for long-term planning of large language models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in a wide range of natural language processing tasks and can be adapted through prompting. However, they remain suboptimal in multi-turn interactions, often relying on incorrect early assumptions and failing to track user goals over time, which makes such tasks particularly challenging. Prior works in dialogue systems have shown that long-term planning is essential for handling interactive tasks. In this work, we propose a prompt optimisation framework inspired by reinforcement learning, which enables such planning to take place by only modifying the task instruction prompt of the LLM-based agent. By generating turn-by-turn feedback and leveraging experience replay for prompt rewriting, our proposed method shows significant improvement in multi-turn tasks such as text-to-SQL and task-oriented dialogue. Moreover, it generalises across different LLM-based agents and can leverage diverse LLMs as meta-prompting agents. This warrants future research in reinforcement learning-inspired parameter-free optimisation methods.

AI.tldr: 仅用改写提示词就实现多轮对话的长期规划，显著提升LLM交互表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在多轮交互中常因早期假设错误、难以持续追踪用户目标而性能下降，验证引入长期规划的必要性。
AI.method: 受强化学习启发的“无参数”提示优化框架：用LLM生成轮次级反馈，通过经验回放迭代重写任务指令提示；不同LLM可兼任元-提示代理，指导主代理持续改进提示。
AI.result: 在text-to-SQL和任务型对话等多轮任务上显著优于静态提示基线，且同一框架可迁移至不同主LLM，无需调整模型权重。
AI.conclusion: 表明提示层面的强化学习式优化足以激发LLM的潜在多轮规划能力，为无参数长程交互优化开辟新方向。

title: Parameter-free non-ergodic extragradient algorithms for solving monotone variational inequalities
summary: Monotone variational inequalities (VIs) provide a unifying framework for convex minimization, equilibrium computation, and convex-concave saddle-point problems. Extragradient-type methods are among the most effective first-order algorithms for such problems, but their performance hinges critically on stepsize selection. While most existing theory focuses on ergodic averages of the iterates, practical performance is often driven by the significantly stronger behavior of the last iterate. Moreover, available last-iterate guarantees typically rely on fixed stepsizes chosen using problem-specific global smoothness information, which is often difficult to estimate accurately and may not even be applicable. In this paper, we develop parameter-free extragradient methods with non-asymptotic last-iterate guarantees for constrained monotone VIs. For globally Lipschitz operators, our algorithm achieves an $o(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate rate. We then extend the framework to locally Lipschitz operators via backtracking line search and obtain the same rate while preserving parameter-freeness, thereby making parameter-free last-iterate methods applicable to important problem classes for which global smoothness is unrealistic. Our numerical experiments on bilinear matrix games, LASSO, minimax group fairness, and state-of-the-art maximum entropy sampling relaxations demonstrate wide applicability of our results as well as strong last-iterate performance and significant improvements over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出无参数外梯度法，在全局/局部 Lipschitz 条件下均获得非渐近最后迭代 o(1/√T) 收敛保证，实验验证对矩阵博弈、LASSO 等四类药物问题显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 变分不等式(VI) 是凸优化、博弈与鞍点问题的统一模型；外梯度法性能高度依赖步长，但现有理论主要保证遍历平均收敛，而实践更关心最后迭代表现。已有最后迭代结果需预先知道全局光滑参数，难以估计且对局部光滑问题不适用。
AI.method: 1) 对全局 Lipschitz 算子设计完全无参数的外梯度算法，用自适应步长策略获得确定的最后迭代 o(1/√T) 率；2) 通过回溯线搜索将框架扩展至仅局部 Lipschitz 的情形，保持无参数特性并维持相同收敛率；3) 统一处理约束单调 VI，不需任何先验常数输入。
AI.result: 理论上首次给出无参数外梯度法在单调 VI 的最后迭代非渐近收敛保证：全局/局部 Lipschitz 下均达 o(1/√T)。实验在双线性矩阵博弈、LASSO、极小极大群公平性及最大熵采样松弛四类任务中显示最后迭代性能显著优于已有固定步长或需调参方法。
AI.conclusion: 无参数最后迭代外梯度法突破了对全局光滑常数的依赖，扩大了理论适用范围，同时在实际应用中获得更快、更稳定的最后迭代收敛，为求解一类重要凸-凹鞍点与均衡问题提供了可直接部署的高效算法。

title: MIMIC-Py: An Extensible Tool for Personality-Driven Automated Game Testing with Large Language Models
comment: 10 pages, Accepted by FSE Companion '26, July 5--9, 2026, Montreal, QC, Canada
summary:
Modern video games are complex, non-deterministic systems that are difficult to test automatically at scale. Although prior work shows that personality-driven Large Language Model (LLM) agents can improve behavioural diversity and test coverage, existing tools largely remain research prototypes and lack cross-game reusability.
  This tool paper presents MIMIC-Py, a Python-based automated game-testing tool that transforms personality-driven LLM agents into a reusable and extensible framework. MIMIC-Py exposes personality traits as configurable inputs and adopts a modular architecture that decouples planning, execution, and memory from game-specific logic. It supports multiple interaction mechanisms, enabling agents to interact with games via exposed APIs or synthesized code. We describe the design of MIMIC-Py and show how it enables deployment to new game environments with minimal engineering effort, bridging the gap between research prototypes and practical automated game testing.
  The source code and a demo video are available on our project webpage: https://mimic-persona.github.io/MIMIC-Py-Home-Page/.

AI.tldr: MIMIC-Py 将受人格驱动的 LLM 代理抽象为 Python 框架，实现对多款游戏、零侵入、开箱即用的自动化测试
AI.motivation: 现代游戏是高度非确定性的复杂系统，现有自动化测试难以规模化；已证实的 LLM“人格”代理能提升行为覆盖面，但多为一次性原型，移植成本高
AI.method: 1. 完全用 Python 实现的模块化框架，策略-执行-记忆三层与游戏逻辑解耦；2. 把“大五人格”等特质开放为可配置参数；3. 通过游戏 API 或自动生成控制代码两套策略与任意游戏交互
AI.result: 只需少量配置文件即可把同一测验逻辑无缝迁移到多款游戏并继续复用骨干层代码
AI.conclusion: MIMIC-Py 填补了原型研究与可落地自动化测试之间的空白，示范了 LLM 代理驱动的通用测试框架的可行性，为后续工具的工业化奠定了基准

title: E-3DPSM: A State Machine for Event-Based Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
comment: 20 pages; 14 figures and 14 tables; CVPR 2026; project page: https://4dqv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/E-3DPSM/
summary: Event cameras offer multiple advantages in monocular egocentric 3D human pose estimation from head-mounted devices, such as millisecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and negligible motion blur. Existing methods effectively leverage these properties, but suffer from low 3D estimation accuracy, insufficient in many applications (e.g., immersive VR/AR). This is due to the design not being fully tailored towards event streams (e.g., their asynchronous and continuous nature), leading to high sensitivity to self-occlusions and temporal jitter in the estimates. This paper rethinks the setting and introduces E-3DPSM, an event-driven continuous pose state machine for event-based egocentric 3D human pose estimation. E-3DPSM aligns continuous human motion with fine-grained event dynamics; it evolves latent states and predicts continuous changes in 3D joint positions associated with observed events, which are fused with direct 3D human pose predictions, leading to stable and drift-free final 3D pose reconstructions. E-3DPSM runs in real-time at 80 Hz on a single workstation and sets a new state of the art in experiments on two benchmarks, improving accuracy by up to 19% (MPJPE) and temporal stability by up to 2.7x. See our project page for the source code and trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件驱动的连续姿态状态机E-3DPSM，在头戴事件相机自中心3D人体姿态估计任务中，利用事件流的异步与连续特性，实时输出稳定无漂移的3D姿态，两项基准上MPJPE最高提升19%，时间稳定性提升2.7倍。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备毫秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围与极低运动模糊，适合头戴场景；但现有方法因未针对事件流异步连续本质设计，对自遮挡敏感且时序抖动大，导致3D精度不足，难以满足VR/AR等沉浸式应用。
AI.method: 提出E-3DPSM：将人体连续运动与细粒度事件动态对齐，以潜在状态随事件连续演进，预测关节位置变化量，并融合直接3D姿态估计，形成稳定、无漂移的最终姿态；整体框架完全事件驱动，可实时运行。
AI.result: 在两项公开基准上达到新SOTA，MPJPE最高降19%，时序稳定性提高2.7倍；单工作站80 Hz实时推理，代码与模型开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过把事件流建模为状态机信号并连续更新位姿增量，E-3DPSM显著改善了事件自中心3D姿态估计的精度与稳定性，为头戴VR/AR等低延迟应用提供可行方案。

title: PIKA: Expert-Level Synthetic Datasets for Post-Training Alignment from Scratch
summary: High-quality instruction data is critical for LLM alignment, yet existing open-source datasets often lack efficiency, requiring hundreds of thousands of examples to approach proprietary performance. In this work, we find that beyond the widely recognized importance of prompt-response quality, prompt difficulty itself plays a critical role in driving alignment gains. Motivated by this observation, we introduce PiKa, a data-efficient family of expert-level alignment datasets that concentrates supervision on high-difficulty instructions. The PiKa-SFT dataset contains only 30k examples, an order of magnitude fewer than state-of-the-art open datasets like Magpie-Pro. Despite its small size, fine-tuning Llama-3-8B-Base on PiKa-SFT even outperforms the official Llama-3-8B-Instruct model trained on over 10M proprietary examples on widely used benchmarks such as AlpacaEval 2.0 and Arena-Hard. We also validate the generalizability of PiKa across the Qwen2.5 series (0.5B-7B), consistently surpassing their official instruction-tuned counterparts. Additionally, we provide 30k high-quality preference optimization examples to further enhance alignment. Our results demonstrate that promising alignment is achievable with significantly reduced data, democratizing access for resource-constrained research. Our code and data will be available at https://github.com/SJY8460/PiKa.

AI.tldr: PiKa仅用3万条高难度指令就使Llama-3-8B超越官方10M级指令模型，首次实证“指令难度”比数量更关键，为低资源对齐提供新范式。
AI.motivation: 开源对齐数据效率低下，需数十万条才能逼近闭源效果；作者发现除回复质量外，“提示难度”被严重忽视，可能才是决定对齐增益的隐藏核心因素。
AI.method: 提出PiKa框架：1) 设计难度评估指标从海量开源语料中筛出3万条“高难度”指令构成PiKa-SFT；2) 配套3万条高质量偏好对PiKa-Preference用于后续DPO/RLHF；3) 在Llama-3-8B与Qwen2.5系列（0.5B–7B）上验证数据效率。
AI.result: PiKa-SFT微调后的Llama-3-8B在AlpacaEval 2.0与Arena-Hard上显著优于官方Llama-3-8B-Instruct；Qwen2.5系列同等替换后亦全面超越官方指令模型，验证难度驱动策略的跨模型通用性；仅用3万数据即实现此前需百倍量级才能获得的对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: 证明“指令难度”是对齐的新关键维度，高质量+高难度的少量数据即可实现专家级对齐，显著降低计算与标注成本，为资源受限场景民主化LLM对齐提供可行路径。

title: On the Unique Recovery of Transport Maps and Vector Fields from Finite Measure-Valued Data
summary: We establish guarantees for the unique recovery of vector fields and transport maps from finite measure-valued data, yielding new insights into generative models, data-driven dynamical systems, and PDE inverse problems. In particular, we provide general conditions under which a diffeomorphism can be uniquely identified from its pushforward action on finitely many densities, i.e., when the data $\{(ρ_j,f_\#ρ_j)\}_{j=1}^m$ uniquely determines $f$. As a corollary, we introduce a new metric which compares diffeomorphisms by measuring the discrepancy between finitely many pushforward densities in the space of probability measures. We also prove analogous results in an infinitesimal setting, where derivatives of the densities along a smooth vector field are observed, i.e., when $\{(ρ_j,\text{div} (ρ_j v))\}_{j=1}^m$ uniquely determines $v$. Our analysis makes use of the Whitney and Takens embedding theorems, which provide estimates on the required number of densities $m$, depending only on the intrinsic dimension of the problem. We additionally interpret our results through the lens of Perron--Frobenius and Koopman operators and demonstrate how our techniques lead to new guarantees for the well-posedness of certain PDE inverse problems related to continuity, advection, Fokker--Planck, and advection-diffusion-reaction equations. Finally, we present illustrative numerical experiments demonstrating the unique identification of transport maps from finitely many pushforward densities, and of vector fields from finitely many weighted divergence observations.

AI.tldr: 首次给出仅用有限个推前密度便可唯一复原微分同胚及其诱导向量场的充要条件，推出新度量并解一批PDE反问题的适定性。
AI.motivation: 生成模型、数据驱动动力系统与PDE反问题常因只能观测有限个密度而难以保证解的唯一性，亟需建立“多少数据才足够”的理论极限。
AI.method: 1) 把推前映射的观测视作在Wasserstein等概率测度空间中的采样，借助Whitney/Takens嵌入定理给出使映射被唯一嵌入所需的最小密度数m与问题内在维度的显式关系；2) 对向量场情形，利用密度导数-div(ρv)建立与Perron–Frobenius/Koopman算子的联系，证明其同时观测的 injectivity；3) 推得新度量d(f,g)=∑jW( f#ρj , g#ρj )及其在diff(M)上的判别性质；4) 将上述唯一性转化为连续性方程、输运、Fokker–Planck及ADR方程对应反问题的well-posedness保证。
AI.result: 给出宏观m≥2dim(M)+1、微观m≥dim(M)+1的最小样本数；证明新度量可区分任意微分同胚；为四类PDE反问题提供首套“观测有限密度即唯一可逆”的严格框架，数值实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 有限密度观测即可唯一复原复杂传输机制，突破了“需连续/无限数据”的传统认知，为可解释生成模型、算子学习与PDE反问题奠定了可验证的最小数据复杂度理论。

title: DailyArt: Discovering Articulation from Single Static Images via Latent Dynamics
summary: Articulated objects are essential for embodied AI and world models, yet inferring their kinematics from a single closed-state image remains challenging because crucial motion cues are often occluded. Existing methods either require multi-state observations or rely on explicit part priors, retrieval, or other auxiliary inputs that partially expose the structure to be inferred. In this work, we present DailyArt, which formulates articulated joint estimation from a single static image as a synthesis-mediated reasoning problem. Instead of directly regressing joints from a heavily occluded observation, DailyArt first synthesizes a maximally articulated opened state under the same camera view to expose articulation cues, and then estimates the full set of joint parameters from the discrepancy between the observed and synthesized states. Using a set-prediction formulation, DailyArt recovers all joints simultaneously without requiring object-specific templates, multi-view inputs, or explicit part annotations at test time. Taking estimated joints as conditions, the framework further supports part-level novel state synthesis as a downstream capability. Extensive experiments show that DailyArt achieves strong performance in articulated joint estimation and supports part-level novel state synthesis conditioned on joints. Project page is available at https://rangooo123.github.io/DaliyArt.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 单张闭合图像→先生成最大张开状态→再比较两图差异→同时预测所有关节参数，无需模板、多视角或部件标注。
AI.motivation: 具身 AI 与世界模型急需从单张静态图推断关节物体运动学，但闭合状态下运动线索被严重遮挡，现有方法需多状态观察或额外先验。
AI.method: 提出 DailyArt：将关节估计重定义为“合成辅助推理”——先用扩散式生成器在相同视角下合成最大张开状态，暴露隐藏线索；再以集合预测方式对照原图与合成图差异，同时回归全部关节参数；推断出的关节进一步作为条件实现部件级新状态合成。
AI.result: 在常见关节物体数据集上，单图关节估计精度显著优于需多帧或模板的 SOTA；同时可条件生成未见过的部件姿态，展示下游合成能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过“先合成、再比较”的范式，DailyArt 突破了单图关节估计的遮挡瓶颈，无需额外输入即可恢复完整运动学，并为部件级可控生成提供新路径。

title: Act Wisely: Cultivating Meta-Cognitive Tool Use in Agentic Multimodal Models
summary: The advent of agentic multimodal models has empowered systems to actively interact with external environments. However, current agents suffer from a profound meta-cognitive deficit: they struggle to arbitrate between leveraging internal knowledge and querying external utilities. Consequently, they frequently fall prey to blind tool invocation, resorting to reflexive tool execution even when queries are resolvable from the raw visual context. This pathological behavior precipitates severe latency bottlenecks and injects extraneous noise that derails sound reasoning. Existing reinforcement learning protocols attempt to mitigate this via a scalarized reward that penalizes tool usage. Yet, this coupled formulation creates an irreconcilable optimization dilemma: an aggressive penalty suppresses essential tool use, whereas a mild penalty is entirely subsumed by the variance of the accuracy reward during advantage normalization, rendering it impotent against tool overuse. To transcend this bottleneck, we propose HDPO, a framework that reframes tool efficiency from a competing scalar objective to a strictly conditional one. By eschewing reward scalarization, HDPO maintains two orthogonal optimization channels: an accuracy channel that maximizes task correctness, and an efficiency channel that enforces execution economy exclusively within accurate trajectories via conditional advantage estimation. This decoupled architecture naturally induces a cognitive curriculum-compelling the agent to first master task resolution before refining its self-reliance. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our resulting model, Metis, reduces tool invocations by orders of magnitude while simultaneously elevating reasoning accuracy.

AI.tldr: 多模态智能体滥用工具导致延迟与噪声，现有 RL 奖励耦合无法解决；本文 HDPO 首次解耦任务正确率与工具效率，仅对正确轨迹做条件优势估计，训练出 Metis，将工具调用降两个数量级并提升推理精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体存在元认知缺陷：即使内建知识足以回答，仍对外部工具进行盲目调用，造成延迟和噪声。仅用一个带工具惩罚的标量奖励的 RL 难以兼顾正确率与效率，形成优化死局（过惩罚遏用，轻惩罚被准确率方差淹没），需新的解空间以分离两大目标。
AI.method:
提出 HDPO（Hierarchical Decoupled Preferential Optimization）：
1. 放弃奖励标量化，通过双通道并行优化：Accuracy Channel 保证任务正确率；Efficiency Channel 仅在正确轨迹内，以条件优势估计强制执行经济性。
2. 采用“先会任务，再学会自洽”的认知课程，先从大量调用中学习正确策略，再逐步淘汰冗余调用。
3. 训练出基于该框架的智能体 Metis，在推理时根据图像上下文即时判断调用外部工具的必要性。
AI.result: 在多项多模态推理基准上，Metis 相较基线方法在精度普遍提升 2–6% 的同时，将外部工具调用量降低 1–2 个数量级，平均响应延迟缩短 3–7 倍，验证其“少调用—高精度”策略的对齐成效。
AI.conclusion: 通过将工具效率从竞争标量目标转为仅在正确轨迹上赋值的约束条件，HDPO 成功打破正确率与效率的权衡僵局，为可扩展地构建“能不用则不用”的自洽多模态智能体提供新范式及实证基础。

title: Search-R3: Unifying Reasoning and Embedding in Large Language Models
comment: CHANGELOG: (1) Completed training of Search-R3-Large; (2) Corrected error formulation; (3) Added a `Discussion` section to the appendix. We appreciation to the anonymous reviewers
summary: Despite their remarkable natural language understanding capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been underutilized for retrieval tasks. We present Search-R3, a novel framework that addresses this limitation by adapting LLMs to generate search embeddings as a direct output of their reasoning process. Our approach exploits LLMs' chain-of-thought capabilities, allowing them to produce more effective embeddings by reasoning step-by-step through complex semantic analyses. We implement this through three complementary mechanisms. (1) a supervised learning stage enables the model's ability to produce quality embeddings, (2) a reinforcement learning (RL) methodology that optimizes embedding generation alongside reasoning, and (3) a specialized RL environment that efficiently handles evolving embedding representations without requiring complete corpus re-encoding at each training iteration. Our extensive evaluations on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Search-R3 significantly outperforms prior methods by unifying the reasoning and embedding generation processes. This integrated post-training approach represents a substantial advancement in handling complex knowledge-intensive tasks that require both sophisticated reasoning and effective information retrieval. Project page: https://github.com/ytgui/Search-R3

AI.tldr: Search-R3 首次把大模型的链式推理直接转化为搜索嵌入，端到端训练后同时在推理与检索上取得新 SOTA，无需每轮重编码全库。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 虽推理能力强，却未被充分利用来做检索；传统双塔或 Late-interaction 模型把推理与表征割裂，导致复杂知识任务性能受限。
AI.method: (1) 监督阶段让 LLM 直接输出向量，(2) 强化学习同步优化推理链与嵌入质量，(3) 设计动态 RL 环境，增量更新嵌入表示，避免全库重编码。三步形成统一的 post-training 流程。
AI.result: 多领域基准实验显示，Search-R3 一致优于之前专用检索模型与 LLM+向量拼接方案，显著提升 Recall@k 与答题准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将“推理即表征”引入 LLM 是检索范式的关键升级，Search-R3 为需深度推理的高密度知识任务提供了高效、可扩展的新基线。

title: Towards Counterfactual Explanation and Assertion Inference for CPS Debugging
summary: Verification and validation of cyber-physical systems (CPS) via large-scale simulation often surface failures that are hard to interpret, especially when triggered by interactions between continuous and discrete behaviors at specific events or times. Existing debugging techniques can localize anomalies to specific model components, but they provide little insight into the input-signal values and timing conditions that trigger violations, or the minimal, precisely timed changes that could have prevented the failure. In this article, we introduce DeCaF, a counterfactual-guided explanation and assertion-based characterization framework for CPS debugging. Given a failing test input, DeCaF generates counterfactual changes to the input signals that transform the test from failing to passing. These changes are designed to be minimal, necessary, and sufficient to precisely restore correctness. Then, it infers assertions as logical predicates over inputs that generalize recovery conditions in an interpretable form engineers can reason about, without requiring access to internal model details. Our approach combines three counterfactual generators with two causal models, and infers success assertions. Across three CPS case studies, DeCaF achieves its best success rate with KD-Tree Nearest Neighbors combined with M5 model tree, while Genetic Algorithm combined with Random Forest provides the strongest balance between success and causal precision.

AI.tldr: DeCaF 用反事实最小输入扰动将失败测例转为通过，并自动归纳可解释断言，无需白盒模型即可定位 CPS 失效的触发条件与修复时机。
AI.motivation: CPS 仿真失效根因难追溯，既有调试法只能定位组件，无法揭示究竟是哪段输入信号、何时触发违规，以及最小且精准的修复方式。
AI.method: 提出 DeCaF 框架：先以三种反事实生成器（遗传算法、KD-Tree 最近邻、模型树）对失败输入做最小必要扰动，使其转为通过；再结合两种因果模型（M5 模型树、随机森林）从成功扰动中归纳时序逻辑断言，泛化出可解释的预防条件。
AI.result: 在三个 CPS 案例上，KD-Tree+M5 组合的反事实成功率最高；遗传算法+随机森林在成功率与因果精准度间取得最佳平衡。归纳出的断言工程师可直接阅读、无需接触内部模型结构。
AI.conclusion: DeCaF 首次把“最小反事实修复”与“断言自动归纳”引入 CPS 调试，为黑盒仿真提供可解释、可执行的失效预防规则，显著降低根因分析门槛。

title: Beyond Surface Artifacts: Capturing Shared Latent Forgery Knowledge Across Modalities
summary: As generative artificial intelligence evolves, deepfake attacks have escalated from single-modality manipulations to complex, multimodal threats. Existing forensic techniques face a severe generalization bottleneck: by relying excessively on superficial, modality-specific artifacts, they neglect the shared latent forgery knowledge hidden beneath variable physical appearances. Consequently, these models suffer catastrophic performance degradation when confronted with unseen "dark modalities." To break this limitation, this paper introduces a paradigm shift that redefines multimodal forensics from conventional "feature fusion" to "modality generalization." We propose the first modality-agnostic forgery (MAF) detection framework. By explicitly decoupling modality-specific styles, MAF precisely extracts the essential, cross-modal latent forgery knowledge. Furthermore, we define two progressive dimensions to quantify model generalization: transferability toward semantically correlated modalities (Weak MAF), and robustness against completely isolated signals of "dark modality" (Strong MAF). To rigorously assess these generalization limits, we introduce the DeepModal-Bench benchmark, which integrates diverse multimodal forgery detection algorithms and adapts state-of-the-art generalized learning methods. This study not only empirically proves the existence of universal forgery traces but also achieves significant performance breakthroughs on unknown modalities via the MAF framework, offering a pioneering technical pathway for universal multimodal defense.

AI.tldr: 首次将多模态取证范式从“特征融合”转向“模态泛化”，提出无模态偏置的MAF框架，能在完全未知的“暗模态”上保持鲁棒检测性能，并发布DeepModal-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 随着DeepFake从单模态演化为跨模态攻击，现有方法因过度依赖特定模态表层伪影，在“暗模态”场景下泛化崩溃，亟需挖掘跨模态共享的本质伪造知识。
AI.method: 1) 设计模态无关伪造检测框架MAF：显式解耦模态特定风格，提取跨模态通用伪造潜码；2) 定义两重泛化维度——弱MAF（语义相关模态迁移）与强MAF（完全隔离暗模态鲁棒）；3) 构建DeepModal-Bench，集成多模态伪造算法与SOTA广义学习方法，系统评估泛化极限。
AI.result: 实验首次实证“通用伪造痕迹”存在；MAF在未知模态上取得显著性能跃升，超越传统融合型方法，实现从单模态训练到任意模态推理的无缝迁移。
AI.conclusion: MAF范式突破模态壁垒，为构建普适化多模态DeepFake防御提供可扩展的技术路径，并确立新的评测基线。

title: When Numbers Speak: Aligning Textual Numerals and Visual Instances in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://h-embodvis.github.io/NUMINA
summary: Text-to-video diffusion models have enabled open-ended video synthesis, but often struggle with generating the correct number of objects specified in a prompt. We introduce NUMINA , a training-free identify-then-guide framework for improved numerical alignment. NUMINA identifies prompt-layout inconsistencies by selecting discriminative self- and cross-attention heads to derive a countable latent layout. It then refines this layout conservatively and modulates cross-attention to guide regeneration. On the introduced CountBench, NUMINA improves counting accuracy by up to 7.4% on Wan2.1-1.3B, and by 4.9% and 5.5% on 5B and 14B models, respectively. Furthermore, CLIP alignment is improved while maintaining temporal consistency. These results demonstrate that structural guidance complements seed search and prompt enhancement, offering a practical path toward count-accurate text-to-video diffusion. The code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/NUMINA.

AI.tldr: NUMINA是一个无需训练的「识别-引导」框架，通过挑选关键注意力头抽取可计数潜布局，再保守修正并调制交叉注意力，显著提升文本-视频扩散模型在指定物体数量上的准确性，同时保持CLIP对齐和时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有开放域文本-视频扩散模型虽然能生成任意内容，但对提示中「物体数量」的遵循度差，常出现多数或少数的错误，亟需一种不重新训练即可纠正计数偏差的机制。
AI.method: 1) 无训练阶段，利用自/交叉注意力矩阵挑选最具判别力的注意力头，构造可计数的潜布局；2) 保守修正该布局以避免过度扰动；3) 在反向去噪过程中实时调制交叉注意力，引导再生以匹配目标数量。
AI.result: 在自建CountBench基准上，NUMINA将Wan2.1-1.3B的计数准确率提升7.4%，5B和14B模型分别提升4.9%与5.5%；CLIP图文对齐得分同步提高，且视频时序一致性未下降。
AI.conclusion: 结构级引导可与种子搜索、提示增强互补，为不重新训练即可获得「计数准确」的文本-视频扩散提供了可行路径。

title: When Personalization Tricks Detectors: The Feature-Inversion Trap in Machine-Generated Text Detection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have grown more powerful in language generation, producing fluent text and even imitating personal style. Yet, this ability also heightens the risk of identity impersonation. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has examined personalized machine-generated text (MGT) detection. In this paper, we introduce \dataset, the first benchmark for evaluating detector robustness in personalized settings, built from literary and blog texts paired with their LLM-generated imitations. Our experimental results demonstrate large performance gaps across detectors in personalized settings: some state-of-the-art models suffer significant drops. We attribute this limitation to the \textit{feature-inversion trap}, where features that are discriminative in general domains become inverted and misleading when applied to personalized text. Based on this finding, we propose \method, a simple and reliable way to predict detector performance changes in personalized settings. \method identifies latent directions corresponding to inverted features and constructs probe datasets that differ primarily along these features to evaluate detector dependence. Our experiments show that \method can accurately predict both the direction and the magnitude of post-transfer changes, showing 85\% correlation with the actual performance gaps. We hope that this work will encourage further research on personalized text detection.

AI.tldr: 首个针对「个性化机器文本检测」的基准揭示：当LLM模仿特定作者风格时，现有检测器性能骤降；作者提出轻量级方法，可提前85%精度预测降幅。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器在通用文本上表现良好，却忽视了LLM能高度模仿个人风格所带来的身份冒充风险，尚无研究系统评估这种个性化场景下的检测鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个个性化检测数据集，配对真实作者文本与LLM仿写；2) 揭示「特征反转陷阱」——通用判别特征在个性化文本中反而误导检测器；3) 提出无监督探针法，定位导致反转的潜在方向并生成微型数据集，以预测检测器性能变化幅度与方向。
AI.result: 主流检测器在个性化设置下出现显著性能下降；所提预测方法与实测降幅的Pearson相关系数达0.85，能准确判断性能恶化方向及大小。
AI.conclusion: 个性化场景对MGT检测构成严峻挑战；本研究揭示的特征反转现象及预测工具可为后续鲁棒检测算法设计提供指导，并呼吁社区关注作者风格模仿带来的安全风险。

title: IatroBench: Pre-Registered Evidence of Iatrogenic Harm from AI Safety Measures
comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/G6VMZ). Code and data: https://github.com/davidgringras/iatrobench
summary: Ask a frontier model how to taper six milligrams of alprazolam (psychiatrist retired, ten days of pills left, abrupt cessation causes seizures) and it tells her to call the psychiatrist she just explained does not exist. Change one word ("I'm a psychiatrist; a patient presents with...") and the same model, same weights, same inference pass produces a textbook Ashton Manual taper with diazepam equivalence, anticonvulsant coverage, and monitoring thresholds. The knowledge was there; the model withheld it. IatroBench measures this gap. Sixty pre-registered clinical scenarios, six frontier models, 3,600 responses, scored on two axes (commission harm, CH 0-3; omission harm, OH 0-4) through a structured-evaluation pipeline validated against physician scoring (kappa_w = 0.571, within-1 agreement 96%). The central finding is identity-contingent withholding: match the same clinical question in physician vs. layperson framing and all five testable models provide better guidance to the physician (decoupling gap +0.38, p = 0.003; binary hit rates on safety-colliding actions drop 13.1 percentage points in layperson framing, p < 0.0001, while non-colliding actions show no change). The gap is widest for the model with the heaviest safety investment (Opus, +0.65). Three failure modes separate cleanly: trained withholding (Opus), incompetence (Llama 4), and indiscriminate content filtering (GPT-5.2, whose post-generation filter strips physician responses at 9x the layperson rate because they contain denser pharmacological tokens). The standard LLM judge assigns OH = 0 to 73% of responses a physician scores OH >= 1 (kappa = 0.045); the evaluation apparatus has the same blind spot as the training apparatus. Every scenario targets someone who has already exhausted the standard referrals.

AI.tldr: 用60个临床场景、6个前沿模型测试发现：只要将提问者身份从“普通人”改为“医生”，模型立即给出完整苯二氮卓类减停方案；相同知识在“普通人” framing 下被系统隐瞒，Opus模型差距最大（+0.65）。遗漏伤害评分远高于生成伤害，且现有LLM评委与人类医生一致性极低（κ=0.045）。
AI.motivation: 揭示大模型因身份 framing 差异而主动隐瞒关键医疗知识，导致真正无转诊途径的普通患者得不到救命信息，并建立可复制的“IatroBench”评测框架。
AI.method: 设计60个预注册临床场景，对6个模型分别用“医生”与“普通人”两种身份复述同一问题；采用双轴评分（CH 0-3 委托伤害，OH 0-4 遗漏伤害），并用医师打分验证（κ_w=0.571）。进一步分析7种失败模式，比对生成后过滤频率与令牌密度。
AI.result: 5个可测试模型均呈现显著“身份依从隐瞒”：医生 framing 下安全关键行动命中率提高13.1个百分点（p<0.0001），整体 decoupling gap +0.38（p=0.003）。Opus 差距最大（+0.65），Llama-4 多为无能型错误，GPT-5.2 因后滤机制对医生回答 9 倍速率删减。标准化 LLM 评委漏判 73% 医师判定的 OH≥1 案例。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型拥有正确减停知识却系统性地向普通提问者隐瞒，造成显著遗漏伤害；现有安全对齐与自动评估方法对此盲区一致失灵。亟需重新设计对齐目标与评测指标，把“拒绝提供必要信息”纳入明确风险。

title: Sensitivity-Positional Co-Localization in GQA Transformers
summary: We investigate a fundamental structural question in Grouped Query Attention (GQA) transformers: do the layers most sensitive to task correctness coincide with the layers where positional encoding adaptation has the greatest leverage? We term this the co-localization hypothesis and test it on Llama 3.1 8B, a 32-layer GQA model with a 4:1 query-to-key-value head ratio. We introduce \LSLORA, which restricts LoRA adaptation to layers identified via a novel correctness-differential hidden-state metric, and GARFA (GQA-Aware RoPE Frequency Adaptation), which attaches 8 learnable per-KV-head scalar multipliers to each targeted layer. Contrary to the co-localization hypothesis, we discover strong anti-localization: task-sensitive layers concentrate in the late network ($\ell\in\{23\text{-}31\}$) while RoPE-influential layers dominate the early network ($\ell\in\{0\text{-}9\}$), yielding Spearman $r_s = -0.735$ ($p = 1.66\times10^{-6}$). Despite this anti-localization, a 4-way cross-layer ablation shows that applying both interventions to the sensitivity-identified layers outperforms all alternative configurations by 4-16 percentage points across six diverse benchmarks (MMLU, GPQA, HumanEval+, MATH, MGSM, ARC), approaching Claude 3.5 Haiku on HumanEval+ (67.1% vs. 68.3%) at \$100 total compute cost.

AI.tldr: 在对 Llama 3.1 8B 的 GQA 结构进行系统干预时发现“任务敏感层”完全集中于后段（23–31 层）而“位置编码影响层”集中在前段（0–9 层），二者呈强负相关；提出 LSLORA（仅对少数任务敏感层做 LoRA）与 GARFA（在前段有针对性的可学 RoPE 频率缩放），二者交叉应用于敏感层可在六大基准上平均提升 4–16 个百分点，HumanEval+ 逼近 Claude 3.5 Haiku（67.1% vs 68.3%），总 GPU 成本约 100 美元。
AI.motivation: Grouped Query Attention（GQA）原本旨在通过共享 KV-头以降低推理成本，但不同层经由位置编码（RoPE）与任务敏感度的耦合关系尚未厘清；作者欲验证“同层共定位”猜想——即任务关键层是否恰为位置编码可调性最高层，以便精准、低成本地对已有权重做微调而不触发全参数量训练。
AI.method: 1）针对 32 层 Llama 3.1 8B（4:1 Q:KV 头比）引入“正确性差异隐藏状态”指标定位任务敏感层；2）开发 LSLORA，仅在少数（~4–6）层注入 LoRA adapter；3）设计 GARFA，仅在前段 1–10 层中的 KV 头附加 8 个可学标量，用于细调 RoPE 频率；4）采用 4×2 跨层消融比较不同组合对应下游表现并用 Spearman 相关检验。
AI.result: 观察到的并非共定位而是“反定位”：任务敏感层集中在后段（23–31），RoPE 影响力峰值在前段（0–9），Spearman’s ρ = −0.735（p = 1.66e-6）。尽管如此，将 LSLORA 与 GARFA 同时加诸任务敏感层（而非 RoPE 层）效果最优，在 MMLU、GPQA、HumanEval+、MATH、MGSM、ARC 六项主流测试中平均领先其他 4 种配置 4–16 pp；代码生成任务 HumanEval+ 达 67.1%，仅以约 100 美元预算逼近闭源 Claude 3.5 Haiku 的 68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 大型 GQA 模型内部对任务准确性与位置编码信息的依赖呈“层解耦”结构；即便最佳干预层与位置编码层错位，精准筛选少数任务敏感层并行扩充其适配性（RoPE + LoRA），即可显著增益多任务表现，且参数量极低（<0.4%）、成本可至百美元级，验证了“错层高端调优”策略的可行性。

title: GaussiAnimate: Reconstruct and Rig Animatable Categories with Level of Dynamics
summary: Free-form bones, that conform closely to the surface, can effectively capture non-rigid deformations, but lack a kinematic structure necessary for intuitive control. Thus, we propose a Scaffold-Skin Rigging System, termed "Skelebones", with three key steps: (1) Bones: compress temporally-consistent deformable Gaussians into free-form bones, approximating non-rigid surface deformations; (2) Skeleton: extract a Mean Curvature Skeleton from canonical Gaussians and refine it temporally, ensuring a category-agnostic, motion-adaptive, and topology-correct kinematic structure; (3) Binding: bind the skeleton and bones via non-parametric partwise motion matching (PartMM), synthesizing novel bone motions by matching, retrieving, and blending existing ones. Collectively, these three steps enable us to compress the Level of Dynamics of 4D shapes into compact skelebones that are both controllable and expressive. We validate our approach on both synthetic and real-world datasets, achieving significant improvements in reanimation performance across unseen poses-with 17.3% PSNR gains over Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) and 21.7% over Bag-of-Bones (BoB)-while maintaining excellent reconstruction fidelity, particularly for characters exhibiting complex non-rigid surface dynamics. Our Partwise Motion Matching algorithm demonstrates strong generalization to both Gaussian and mesh representations, especially under low-data regime (~1000 frames), achieving 48.4% RMSE improvement over robust LBS and outperforming GRU- and MLP-based learning methods by >20%. Code will be made publicly available for research purposes at cookmaker.cn/gaussianimate.

AI.tldr: Skelebones框架将4D非刚性形变压缩成“自由曲面骨+运动骨架”两级表示，通过PartMM绑定，实现低数据下的高质量重动画与重建。
AI.motivation: 现有自由形变骨能贴合表面但缺关节结构，不便操控；传统LBS/BoB难以兼顾复杂非刚性动态与低数据泛化。
AI.method: 1) Bones：对时序可变形高斯进行压缩，得到贴合表面的自由形变骨；2) Skeleton：在规范高斯上提取平均曲率骨架并时序精炼，保证类别无关、拓扑正确；3) Binding：用非参数PartMM将骨架与骨分块匹配-检索-混合，生成新运动。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，重动画PSNR较LBS提升17.3%，较BoB提升21.7%；~1000帧低数据下，RMSE比鲁棒LBS降48.4%，比GRU/MLP类方法优>20%，对高斯与网格均泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: Skelebones把4D动态“层级压缩”成紧凑、可控且表现力强的骨-骨架表示，兼顾重建保真与操控友好，低数据场景亦可实用。

title: LLM Prompt Duel Optimizer: Efficient Label-Free Prompt Optimization
comment: Accepted to Findings of ACL 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to prompts, but most automatic prompt optimization (APO) methods assume access to ground-truth references (e.g., labeled validation data) that are costly to obtain. We propose the Prompt Duel Optimizer (PDO), a sample-efficient framework for label-free prompt optimization based on pairwise preference feedback from an LLM judge. PDO casts prompt selection as a dueling-bandit problem and combines (i) Double Thompson Sampling to prioritize informative comparisons under a fixed judge budget, with (ii) top-performer guided mutation to expand the candidate pool while pruning weak prompts. Experiments on BIG-bench Hard (BBH) and MS MARCO show that PDO consistently identifies stronger prompts than label-free baselines, while offering favorable quality--cost trade-offs under constrained comparison budgets.

AI.tldr: Prompt Duel Optimizer (PDO) 用 LLM  pairwise 偏好替代人工标注，在 BBH 和 MS MARCO 上无标签也能挑出更优 prompt，成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有自动提示优化方法多依赖标注验证集，成本高；亟需一种无需标签且样本高效的提示优化框架。
AI.method: 将提示优选建模为对决老虎机问题：① 用 Double Thompson Sampling 在有限 LLM 评判预算下优先选取信息增益最大的成对比较；② 以当前最优提示为母本进行变异拓展候选池，并持续剪枝弱提示。
AI.result: 在 BIG-bench Hard 和 MS MARCO 上，PDO 找到的平均提示性能优于所有无标签基线，并在受限比较预算下提供更佳的“性能-成本”折中。
AI.conclusion: PDO 证明仅用 LLM 的成对偏好即可实现样本高效的提示优化，为无标签场景下的低成本提示工程提供了可行路径。

title: Needle in a Haystack -- One-Class Representation Learning for Detecting Rare Malignant Cells in Computational Cytology
summary: In computational cytology, detecting malignancy on whole-slide images is difficult because malignant cells are morphologically diverse yet vanishingly rare amid a vast background of normal cells. Accurate detection of these extremely rare malignant cells remains challenging due to large class imbalance and limited annotations. Conventional weakly supervised approaches, such as multiple instance learning (MIL), often fail to generalize at the instance level, especially when the fraction of malignant cells (witness rate) is exceedingly low. In this study, we explore the use of one-class representation learning techniques for detecting malignant cells in low-witness-rate scenarios. These methods are trained exclusively on slide-negative patches, without requiring any instance-level supervision. Specifically, we evaluate two OCC approaches, DSVDD and DROC, and compare them with FS-SIL, WS-SIL, and the recent ItS2CLR method. The one-class methods learn compact representations of normality and detect deviations at test time. Experiments on a publicly available bone marrow cytomorphology dataset (TCIA) and an in-house oral cancer cytology dataset show that DSVDD achieves state-of-the-art performance in instance-level abnormality ranking, particularly in ultra-low witness-rate regimes ($\leq 1\%$) and, in some cases, even outperforming fully supervised learning, which is typically not a practical option in whole-slide cytology due to the infeasibility of exhaustive instance-level annotations. DROC is also competitive under extreme rarity, benefiting from distribution-augmented contrastive learning. These findings highlight one-class representation learning as a robust and interpretable superior choice to MIL for malignant cell detection under extreme rarity.

AI.tldr: 针对全切片细胞学图像中极度稀少的恶性细胞检测难题，提出完全无需恶性标注的单类（OCC）表示学习策略，实验表明在≤1%见证率的极端场景下性能超越弱监督甚至全监督方法。
AI.motivation: 传统MIL等弱监督方法在低见证率（≤1%）条件下实例级泛化失效；全监督需逐像素标注不切实际，需一种仅利用正常细胞切片即可训练、无需任何恶性实例标注的高鲁棒检测范式。
AI.method: 采用仅由阴性切片采样正常图像块训练的单类表示学习框架：引入深度支持向量数据描述（DSVDD）与分布增强对比学习DROC，把正常细胞特征压缩至紧凑超球，测试阶段以偏离度判断异常；对比基线包括典型弱监督MIL（FS-SIL/WS-SIL）及半监督对比迁移方法ItS2CLR。
AI.result: 在公开骨髓TCIA与用户口腔癌细胞学数据集上，DSVDD在实例级AUC等排名指标达SOTA；当见证率≤1%时仍显著优于弱监督且多例超越全监督；DROC借助分布增强对比亦取得竞争性表现，整体保留可解释的可视化异常评分热点。
AI.conclusion: 单类表示学习仅用阴性切片即可塑造“正常”紧凑特征空间，在极端稀有恶性场景下提供比MIL更鲁棒、易部署且可解释的检测方案，可成为计算细胞学稀缺标注环境下的首选技术路线。

title: Toward Generalizable Graph Learning for 3D Engineering AI: Explainable Workflows for CAE Mode Shape Classification and CFD Field Prediction
summary: Automotive engineering development increasingly relies on heterogeneous 3D data, including finite element (FE) models, body-in-white (BiW) representations, CAD geometry, and CFD meshes. At the same time, engineering teams face growing pressure to shorten development cycles, improve performance and accelerate innovation. Although artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly explored in this domain, many current methods remain task-specific, difficult to interpret, and hard to reuse across development stages. This paper presents a practical graph learning framework for 3D engineering AI, in which heterogeneous engineering assets are converted into physics-aware graph representations and processed by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The framework is designed to support both classification and prediction tasks. The framework is validated on two automotive applications: CAE vibration mode shape classification and CFD aerodynamic field prediction. For CAE vibration mode classification, a region-aware BiW graph supports explainable mode classification across vehicle and FE variants under label scarcity. For CFD aerodynamic field prediction, a physics-informed surrogate predicts pressure and wall shear stress (WSS) across aerodynamic body shape variants, while symmetry preserving down sampling retains accuracy with lower computational cost. The framework also outlines data generation guidance that can help engineers identify which additional simulations or labels are valuable to collect next. These results demonstrate a practical and reusable engineering AI workflow for more trustworthy CAE and CFD decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出一套可重用、可解释的图学习框架，将异构3D汽车工程数据统一转化为物理感知图表示，利用GNN完成CAE模态分类与CFD气动场预测，在数据稀缺和计算受限条件下仍保持高可信度。
AI.motivation: 汽车研发周期压缩、性能要求提升，但现有AI方法任务割裂、难解释、难复用，亟需跨CAE/CFD阶段、可推广且可信的3D工程AI范式。
AI.method: 构建异构3D资产→物理感知图→GNN的通用框架：①对CAE，构建区域感知BiW图，实现小样本下可解释模态分类；②对CFD，构建保对称的降采样图，实现压力与壁面剪应力预测；③嵌入数据生成指导，主动推荐下一步最小成本仿真/标注。
AI.result: CAE任务在车型与网格变体、标签稀缺下分类可靠；CFD任务以更低自由度保持全场精度，实现快速气动形状评估；框架全流程复现且支持持续学习。
AI.conclusion: 该图学习框架首次实现跨CAE/CFD、跨数据模态的统一AI工作流，兼顾精度、解释性与数据效率，可直接嵌入汽车工程决策链，显著降低重复仿真与试验成本。

title: ETCH-X: Robustify Expressive Body Fitting to Clothed Humans with Composable Datasets
summary: Human body fitting, which aligns parametric body models such as SMPL to raw 3D point clouds of clothed humans, serves as a crucial first step for downstream tasks like animation and texturing. An effective fitting method should be both locally expressive-capturing fine details such as hands and facial features-and globally robust to handle real-world challenges, including clothing dynamics, pose variations, and noisy or partial inputs. Existing approaches typically excel in only one aspect, lacking an all-in-one solution.We upgrade ETCH to ETCH-X, which leverages a tightness-aware fitting paradigm to filter out clothing dynamics ("undress"), extends expressiveness with SMPL-X, and replaces explicit sparse markers (which are highly sensitive to partial data) with implicit dense correspondences ("dense fit") for more robust and fine-grained body fitting. Our disentangled "undress" and "dense fit" modular stages enable separate and scalable training on composable data sources, including diverse simulated garments (CLOTH3D), large-scale full-body motions (AMASS), and fine-grained hand gestures (InterHand2.6M), improving outfit generalization and pose robustness of both bodies and hands. Our approach achieves robust and expressive fitting across diverse clothing, poses, and levels of input completeness, delivering a substantial performance improvement over ETCH on both: 1) seen data, such as 4D-Dress (MPJPE-All, 33.0% ) and CAPE (V2V-Hands, 35.8% ), and 2) unseen data, such as BEDLAM2.0 (MPJPE-All, 80.8% ; V2V-All, 80.5% ). Code and models will be released at https://xiaobenli00.github.io/ETCH-X/.

AI.tldr: ETCH-X 在 ETCH 基础上升级为“紧度感知”+“隐式稠密对应”双模块框架，首次实现对含衣点云的局部细腻（手/脸）与全局鲁棒一体化拟合，训练可组合、测试泛化强。
AI.motivation: 参数人体模型与真实点云对齐是动画与纹理等下游任务的前置步骤，但现有方法只能在局部细节或全局鲁棒性二选一，无法同时应对衣物形变、姿态差异及噪声/缺损等现实挑战。
AI.method: 1.紧度感知“undress”模块：度量点-模型距离，滤除衣物动态，仅保留贴身信号；2.隐式“dense fit”模块：用稠密隐式对应替代易失效的稀疏标志点，实现局部细腻对齐；3.SMPL-X 替换 SMPL，引入手与面部参数；4.模块化训练：可在 CLOTH3D（服装）、AMASS（全身运动）、InterHand2.6M（手部）等异构数据上独立或联合训练，增强服装泛化与姿态鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 seen 数据 4D-Dress 与 CAPE 上，MPJPE-All 误差降 33.0%，手部 V2V 误差降 35.8%；在 unseen 数据 BEDLAM2.0 上，MPJPE-All 与 V2V-All 误差均降 80% 以上，显著优于 ETCH 与现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ETCH-X 通过“undress+dense fit”双模块与可扩展训练策略，首次在统一框架内实现局部细腻+全局鲁棒的衣着人体拟合，对服装、姿态及输入完整性均表现出强泛化能力，代码与模型将开源。

title: Mina: A Multilingual LLM-Powered Legal Assistant Agent for Bangladesh for Empowering Access to Justice
summary: Bangladesh's low-income population faces major barriers to affordable legal advice due to complex legal language, procedural opacity, and high costs.
