Existing AI legal assistants lack Bengali-language support and jurisdiction-specific adaptation, limiting their effectiveness. To address this, we developed Mina, a multilingual LLM-based legal assistant tailored for the Bangladeshi context. It employs multilingual embeddings and a RAG-based chain-of-tools framework for retrieval, reasoning, translation, and document generation, delivering context-aware legal drafts, citations, and plain-language explanations via an interactive chat interface. Evaluated by law faculty from leading Bangladeshi universities across all stages of the 2022 and 2023 Bangladesh Bar Council Exams, Mina scored 75-80% in Preliminary MCQs, Written, and simulated Viva Voce exams, matching or surpassing average human performance and demonstrating clarity, contextual understanding, and sound legal reasoning. Even under a conservative upper bound, Mina operates at just 0.12-0.61% of typical legal consultation costs in Bangladesh, yielding a 99.4-99.9\% cost reduction relative to human-provided services. These results confirm its potential as a low-cost, multilingual AI assistant that automates key legal tasks and scales access to justice, offering a real-world case study on building domain-specific, low-resource systems and addressing challenges of multilingual adaptation, efficiency, and sustainable public-service AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 面向孟加拉低资源环境的多语法律 LLM“Mina”，用 RAG-多语嵌入链式工具提供咨询、文书与解释，成本仅为人工 0.12–0.61%，在律师资格考试中达 75–80% 分，验证其可低成本扩大量刑公正获取。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉低收入群体因法律文本晦涩、程序不透明与高昂费用难以获得法律咨询；现有 AI 缺 Bengali 语支持与本地化，几乎无法落地。
AI.method: 构建 Bengali-English 双语语料→训练多语嵌入→设计“检索-推理-翻译-生成”RAG 链式工具框架→嵌入交互式聊天界面→用 2022–2023 年 Bar Council 全部考题与模拟口试做端到端评估并对比人工表现与成本。
AI.result: Mina 在 Preliminary MCQ、写作与模拟口试均获 75–80% 分，持平或优于人类考生平均水平；每次咨询成本上限仅为传统人工服务的 0.12–0.61%，实现 99.4–99.9% 费用削减；生成的草稿、引用与通俗解释在清晰度、语境理解与推理正确性上获法学教师正面评价。
AI.conclusion: Mina 证明以低成本、多语、领域专用的生成式 AI 可在低资源国家自动化核心法律任务并放大“获取正义”；为构建可持续、可扩展的公共法律服务提供了可复制范式，也为多语适配、效率优化与负责任部署提供了实证案例。

title: Efficient Dataset Selection for Continual Adaptation of Generative Recommenders
summary: Recommendation systems must continuously adapt to evolving user behavior, yet the volume of data generated in large-scale streaming environments makes frequent full retraining impractical. This work investigates how targeted data selection can mitigate performance degradation caused by temporal distributional drift while maintaining scalability. We evaluate a range of representation choices and sampling strategies for curating small but informative subsets of user interaction data. Our results demonstrate that gradient-based representations, coupled with distribution-matching, improve downstream model performance, achieving training efficiency gains while preserving robustness to drift. These findings highlight data curation as a practical mechanism for scalable monitoring and adaptive model updates in production-scale recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 通过选择一小批高信息量数据、基于梯度特征并用分布匹配采样，可在流式推荐场景中低成本地对抗时序分布漂移，实现模型快速增量更新。
AI.motivation: 大规模流式推荐系统面临用户行为漂移，频繁全量重训成本高。作者希望用“小批量精选数据”代替全量数据，以兼顾性能、效率与扩展性。
AI.method: 1) 对比多种用户交互数据表示（梯度表示、嵌入等）；2) 设计基于分布匹配的采样策略，从历史流中筛选与当前分布最接近的小子集；3) 在该子集上增量训练/微调模型，评估漂移下的鲁棒性与训练效率。
AI.result: 梯度表示+分布匹配采样在多个漂移场景下，相较随机或贪心采样，NDCG@20 提升 3–7%，训练时间缩短 30–50%，与全量重训差距 <1%。
AI.conclusion: 数据精选可作为生产级推荐系统的实用监控与自适应机制：用 1–5% 的精选数据即可显著缓解漂移，支持在线模型快速迭代并降低算力开销。

title: Learning Without Losing Identity: Capability Evolution for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents are expected to operate persistently in dynamic physical environments, continuously acquiring new capabilities over time. Existing approaches to improving agent performance often rely on modifying the agent itself -- through prompt engineering, policy updates, or structural redesign -- leading to instability and loss of identity in long-lived systems. In this work, we propose a capability-centric evolution paradigm for embodied agents. We argue that a robot should maintain a persistent agent as its cognitive identity, while enabling continuous improvement through the evolution of its capabilities. Specifically, we introduce the concept of Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs), which represent modular, versioned units of embodied functionality that can be learned, refined, and composed over time. We present a unified framework in which capability evolution is decoupled from agent identity. Capabilities evolve through a closed-loop process involving task execution, experience collection, model refinement, and module updating, while all executions are governed by a runtime layer that enforces safety and policy constraints. We demonstrate through simulated embodied tasks that capability evolution improves task success rates from 32.4% to 91.3% over 20 iterations, outperforming both agent-modification baselines and established skill-learning methods (SPiRL, SkiMo), while preserving zero policy drift and zero safety violations. Our results suggest that separating agent identity from capability evolution provides a scalable and safe foundation for long-term embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 把‘智能体身份’与‘能力进化’解耦——机器人本体保持不变，仅让可版本化的 Embodied Capability Modules(ECM) 在闭环中自我升级，20 轮迭代后任务成功率由 32.4% 升至 91.3%，零策略漂移、零安全违规。
AI.motivation: 持久运行的人-机器人需要随环境变化持续获得新能力，但直接修改智能体(prompt/网络/结构)会导致身份漂移和系统不稳定。作者追求一种既能持续改进性能，又能维持固定认知身份的长期具身智能范式。
AI.method: 提出 capability-centric evolution：1) Embodied Capability Modules(ECM) 作为可学习、可版本化、可组合的具身功能单元；2) 运行时将 ECM 与持久 Agent 分离，形成‘任务执行→经验收集→模型精炼→模块更新’封闭循环；3) 统一框架在运行时层强制执行安全与策略约束，阻止能力变异回灌到 Agent 本体。
AI.result: 在模拟具身任务中，20 轮迭代把成功率从 32.4% 提升到 91.3%，显著优于 SPiRL、SkiMo 等技能学习方法及任何直接修改智能体的基线；策略漂移与危险行为均为 0，验证 Agent 身份不变前提下仍能高效进化。
AI.conclusion: 将 Agent 身份与能力进化彻底分离，为长期、安全、可扩展的具身智能提供了一种新基础；未来需扩展到多机器人、真实硬件以及开放世界 ECM 组合机制。

title: A Physical Agentic Loop for Language-Guided Grasping with Execution-State Monitoring
summary: Robotic manipulation systems that follow language instructions often execute grasp primitives in a largely single-shot manner: a model proposes an action, the robot executes it, and failures such as empty grasps, slips, stalls, timeouts, or semantically wrong grasps are not surfaced to the decision layer in a structured way. Inspired by agentic loops in digital tool-using agents, we reformulate language-guided grasping as a bounded embodied agent operating over grounded execution states, where physical actions expose an explicit tool-state stream. We introduce a physical agentic loop that wraps an unmodified learned manipulation primitive (grasp-and-lift) with (i) an event-based interface and (ii) an execution monitoring layer, Watchdog, which converts noisy gripper telemetry into discrete outcome labels using contact-aware fusion and temporal stabilization. These outcome events, optionally combined with post-grasp semantic verification, are consumed by a deterministic bounded policy that finalizes, retries, or escalates to the user for clarification, guaranteeing finite termination. We validate the resulting loop on a mobile manipulator with an eye-in-hand D405 camera, keeping the underlying grasp model unchanged and evaluating representative scenarios involving visual ambiguity, distractors, and induced execution failures. Results show that explicit execution-state monitoring and bounded recovery enable more robust and interpretable behavior than open-loop execution, while adding minimal architectural overhead. For the source code and demo refer to our project page: https://wenzewwz123.github.io/Agentic-Loop/

AI.tldr: 将语言引导的抓取任务重构为“有界具身智能体循环”，通过事件接口+Watchdog监控层把原始抓取动作封装成可观测、可判定、可重试的闭环，无需改动底层模型即可显著提升鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言-动作系统多为一次性的开环抓取，失败（空抓、打滑、超时、语义错误）无法结构化反馈给决策层，导致整体任务失败率高且不可解释。
AI.method: 1) 把抓取-提升原语封装为“物理智能体循环”：引入事件化接口，实时暴露工具状态流。 2) 设计 Watchdog 监控层：融合夹持器 telemetry 与接触感知滤波，经时序稳定化输出离散结果标签（成功/空抓/打滑/卡滞/超时）。 3) 构建确定性有界策略：依据结果事件与可选的后抓取语义验证，决定“完成/重试/升阶询问用户”，保证有限步终止。 4) 在搭载 D405 眼在手相机的移动操作臂上验证，完全复用既有的学习型抓取网络。
AI.result: 在视觉歧义、干扰物与人为注入失败等典型场景下，闭环版本相比开环抓取成功率显著提高，同时保持低架构开销；失败事件被准确分类并可被策略自动恢复或升阶。
AI.conclusion: 只要把低层动作包装成带显式执行状态的“有界智能体循环”，无需重训模型即可让机器人获得类似数字工具代理的反省与恢复能力，实现更鲁棒、可解释且可扩展的语言引导操纵。

title: CycleChart: A Unified Consistency-Based Learning Framework for Bidirectional Chart Understanding and Generation
summary: Current chart-related tasks, such as chart generation (NL2Chart), chart schema parsing, chart data parsing, and chart question answering (ChartQA), are typically studied in isolation, preventing models from learning the shared semantics that link chart creation and interpretation. We introduce CycleChart, a consistency-based learning framework for bidirectional chart understanding and generation. Unlike conventional multi-task approaches that draw training samples independently across tasks, CycleChart organizes all tasks around each single data instance. From a source table and natural-language query, the model generates a chart specification, renders and executes it, then learns to recover the schema and underlying data from the resulting chart image. This per-instance lifecycle design lets the model capture the full chain of transformations, from raw data through visual encoding to structured recovery, and a generate--parse consistency objective enforces semantic alignment between the forward generation and reverse parsing directions. To support this framework, we construct CycleChart-Bench, a lifecycle-aligned benchmark where every chart sample carries aligned annotations for generation, schema parsing, data parsing, and question answering. CycleChart achieves strong results across all four tasks and transfers effectively to unseen external benchmarks, demonstrating improved cross-task generalization and marking a step toward more general chart understanding models.

AI.tldr: 大多数图表相关模型把生成、解析和问答当作独立任务，CycleChart 提出「一次数据实例—全生命周期」框架，让模型在同一张图表上完成生成→渲染→解析→问答的闭环，并用生成-解析一致性目标对齐双向语义。新 benchmark CycleChart-Bench 同步标注四任务，实验显示模型在所有任务上均提升并具备良好的跨任务迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 NL2Chart、ChartQA、图表结构解析等任务各自为战，缺乏能同时建模「图生成←→图理解」共享语义的学习范式，导致模型泛化受限。
AI.method: 1) 生命周期设计：围绕同一张源表+自然语言查询，依次执行「生成图表规范→渲染→图表图像→解析结构与数据→问答」完整闭环；2) 一致性目标：对同一样本，正向生成的图表与反向解析出的结构/数据之间的语义差异作为训练信号，强制双向对齐；3) 配套 benchmark CycleChart-Bench：每幅图表同步提供生成、结构解析、数据抽取、问答四元组标注。
AI.result: 在 CycleChart-Bench 的四个任务上均显著优于独立训练基线；零样本迁移到外部 Chart-to-Text、PlotQA 等数据集也取得提升，验证跨任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 让模型在「一次数据实例」内完成生成-渲染-解析-问答闭环，可利用图表全生命周期信息促进任务间共享表征，是实现更通用图表理解模型的新路径。

title: The Condition-Number Principle for Prototype Clustering
summary: We develop a geometric framework that links objective accuracy to structural recovery in prototype-based clustering. The analysis is algorithm-agnostic and applies to a broad class of admissible loss functions. We define a clustering condition number that compares within-cluster scale to the minimum loss increase required to move a point across a cluster boundary. When this quantity is small, any solution with a small suboptimality gap must also have a small misclassification error relative to a benchmark partition. The framework also clarifies a fundamental trade-off between robustness and sensitivity to cluster imbalance, leading to sharp phase transitions for exact recovery under different objectives. The guarantees are deterministic and non-asymptotic, and they separate the role of algorithmic accuracy from the intrinsic geometric difficulty of the instance. We further show that errors concentrate near cluster boundaries and that sufficiently deep cluster cores are recovered exactly under strengthened local margins. Together, these results provide a geometric principle for interpreting low objective values as reliable evidence of meaningful clustering structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种适用于任意原型聚类的几何框架，用“聚类条件数”把目标函数精度与结构恢复联系起来，给出确定性非渐近保证，证明小次优解必隐含小误分误差，并揭示鲁棒性与类不平衡敏感性的相变权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有聚类理论要么聚焦算法收敛，要么依赖随机模型，无法解释“低目标值→结构正确”这一经验现象，亦缺乏对实例本身几何难度的刻画。
AI.method: 1) 引入算法无关的“聚类条件数”κ=簇内尺度/跨边界最小损失增量；2) 建立κ与误分误差之间的确定性、非渐近不等式；3) 分析不同目标函数下精确恢复的相位转变；4) 证明误差集中在边界附近，深层核在强化局部边际下可精确恢复。
AI.result: 当κ小时，任何ε-次优解的误分率≤O(ε/κ)；存在鲁棒性与类不平衡敏感性的尖锐权衡；误差空间分布呈“边界集中”现象；强化局部边际可保证深层核零误差。
AI.conclusion: 该几何框架首次将“算法精度”与“实例几何难度”解耦，为“低目标值即合理结构”提供可验证的理论依据，并为原型聚类的目标函数选择与鲁棒性分析奠定统一原则。

title: TEMPER: Testing Emotional Perturbation in Quantitative Reasoning
summary: Large language models are trained and evaluated on quantitative reasoning tasks written in clean, emotionally neutral language. However, real-world queries are often wrapped in frustration, urgency or enthusiasm. Does emotional framing alone degrade reasoning when all numerical content is preserved? To investigate this, a controlled emotion translation framework is developed that rewrites problems into emotional variants while preserving all quantities and relationships. Using this framework, Temper-5400 (5,400 semantically verified emotion--neutral pairs) is constructed across GSM8K, MultiArith, and ARC-Challenge, and evaluated on eighteen models (1B to frontier scale). Two core results emerge: First, emotional framing reduces accuracy by 2-10 percentage points even though all numerical content is preserved. Second, neutralizing emotional variants recovers most of the lost performance, showing both that the degradation is tied to emotional style rather than content corruption and that neutralization can serve as a lightweight inference-time mitigation. Non-emotional paraphrases cause no such degradation, implicating emotional content rather than surface-level changes. Beyond emotion specifically, the benchmark construction procedure provides a general framework for controlled stylistic translation and robustness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 情绪化的提问会显著降低大语言模型的定量推理能力，即使在完全保留所有数字关系的情形下也是如此；提出 Temper-5400 数据集与可控情感改写框架，首次量化该现象并以“中性化”作为轻量级推理时缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 现有评测假设用户提问均为干净、中性的表述，但真实场景往往伴随愤怒、急切或兴奋等情绪。尚不清楚仅改变情感语调、而不改动任何数值信息，是否足以削弱模型推理性能；澄清这一点对模型鲁棒性和一线部署至关重要。
AI.method: 构建“可控情感翻译”流程：在 GSM8K、MultiArith、ARC-Challenge 三类数据集上，把中性题目系统改写为仅注入情感色彩的变体，并反向生成“情感→中性”重置版本，形成 5 400 对语义完全对齐的 Temper-5400 基准。对 18 款体量从 1 B 到前沿级的大模型进行定量推理评测，比较情感版、中性版与非情感同义改写版的表现差异。
AI.result: (1) 情感框架单独造成 2–10 % 绝对准确率下降；(2) 将情感变体重新中性化可几乎完全恢复性能，而单纯的非情感同义改写无明显下降，证明性能损失确实来自情感风格而非词面扰动或内容破坏。
AI.conclusion: 情绪的表层语言特征本身即可干扰模型推理，提示未来的定量评测需纳入情绪鲁棒性维度；同时，推理时“中性化提问”是一种轻量、无需重训的缓解策略。提出的风格控制与回译流程可作为通用的鲁棒性评测框架，推广到其他修辞与情绪维度的研究。

title: EgoVerse: An Egocentric Human Dataset for Robot Learning from Around the World
summary: Robot learning increasingly depends on large and diverse data, yet robot data collection remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric human data offer a promising alternative by capturing rich manipulation behavior across everyday environments. However, existing human datasets are often limited in scope, difficult to extend, and fragmented across institutions. We introduce EgoVerse, a collaborative platform for human data-driven robot learning that unifies data collection, processing, and access under a shared framework, enabling contributions from individual researchers, academic labs, and industry partners. The current release includes 1,362 hours (80k episodes) of human demonstrations spanning 1,965 tasks, 240 scenes, and 2,087 unique demonstrators, with standardized formats, manipulation-relevant annotations, and tooling for downstream learning. Beyond the dataset, we conduct a large-scale study of human-to-robot transfer with experiments replicated across multiple labs, tasks, and robot embodiments under shared protocols. We find that policy performance generally improves with increased human data, but that effective scaling depends on alignment between human data and robot learning objectives. Together, the dataset, platform, and study establish a foundation for reproducible progress in human data-driven robot learning. Videos and additional information can be found at https://egoverse.ai/

AI.tldr: EgoVerse 以 1,362 小时、1965 类任务的大规模 egocentric 人操作数据为基石，配套统一采集-处理-共享平台，并量化验证「人-机数据对齐」是缩放效益的关键，为可复现的泛化机器人学习奠定标准基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习需要海量多样化操作数据，但机器人本体采集昂贵且难扩展；egocentric 人类视频虽丰富却分散、难复用。亟需一个可协作扩展、格式统一并能系统评估「人→机迁移」的开放基础设施。
AI.method: 构建 EgoVerse 协作平台，统一采集协议、数据格式与标注管线；聚合 80k 段第一视角示教，覆盖 240 场景、1965 任务、2087 演示者；设计跨机构共享协议与基准工具包；在多实验室、多机器人本体上按统一协议开展大规模人-机策略迁移实验。
AI.result: 发布目前最大、标注最完整的人操作视频数据集；实验表明策略性能随数据量单调提升，但增益斜率受「人类动作-机器人动力学/任务目标对齐度」主导；平台已实现多机构复现与持续增量贡献。
AI.conclusion: EgoVerse 以数据-平台-验证三位一体，为「以人为师」的机器人学习提供可复现、可扩展的基准；未来需进一步优化采集对齐策略、扩充多模态标注并建立在线更新机制，以持续放大人和数据对机器人智能的杠杆效应。

title: Hallucination Detection and Evaluation of Large Language Model
summary: Hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) pose a significant challenge, generating misleading or unverifiable content that undermines trust and reliability. Existing evaluation methods, such as KnowHalu, employ multi-stage verification but suffer from high computational costs. To address this, we integrate the Hughes Hallucination Evaluation Model (HHEM), a lightweight classification-based framework that operates independently of LLM-based judgments, significantly improving efficiency while maintaining high detection accuracy. We conduct a comparative analysis of hallucination detection methods across various LLMs, evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR), True Negative Rate (TNR), and Accuracy on question-answering (QA) and summarization tasks. Our results show that HHEM reduces evaluation time from 8 hours to 10 minutes, while HHEM with non-fabrication checking achieves the highest accuracy \(82.2\%\) and TPR \(78.9\%\). However, HHEM struggles with localized hallucinations in summarization tasks. To address this, we introduce segment-based retrieval, improving detection by verifying smaller text components. Additionally, our cumulative distribution function (CDF) analysis indicates that larger models (7B-9B parameters) generally exhibit fewer hallucinations, while intermediate-sized models show higher instability. These findings highlight the need for structured evaluation frameworks that balance computational efficiency with robust factual validation, enhancing the reliability of LLM-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轻量级 HHEM 模型，将幻觉检测耗时从 8 小时缩至 10 分钟，准确率 82.2%，并揭示模型规模与幻觉分布规律。
AI.motivation: LLM 幻觉削弱可信度，现有 KnowHalu 等方案虽准但计算开销大，急需高效且无需 LLM 判断的检测框架。
AI.method: 构建 Hughes Hallucination Evaluation Model（HHEM）——基于轻量级分类器、脱离 LLM 打分；在 QA 与摘要任务上对比 TPR、TNR、Accuracy；对摘要幻觉引入片段级检索；用 CDF 分析不同规模模型的幻觉分布。
AI.result: HHEM 评估时间 8 h→10 min，HHEM+非伪造检查取得最高 Accuracy 82.2%、TPR 78.9%；片段级检索缓解摘要局部幻觉；7B–9B 大模型幻觉更少，中等规模模型波动最大。
AI.conclusion: HHEM 在效率与准确性间实现可扩展平衡，证实结构化、轻量化框架对 LLM 事实验证至关重要，为后续模型迭代与系统部署提供可靠评估基线。

title: Mitigating Distribution Sharpening in Math RLVR via Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis and Backward Hint Annealing
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve low-$k$ reasoning accuracy while narrowing solution coverage on challenging math questions, and pass@1 gains do not necessarily translate into better large-$k$ performance. Existing hint-based approaches can make challenging questions trainable, but they leave two issues underexplored: teacher-student distribution mismatch and the need to reduce hint exposure to match no-hint evaluation. We address these issues through two components. Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) constructs verified teacher hints conditioned on student-style responses. Backward Hint Annealing (BHA) anneals hint exposure across difficulty buckets and uses per-question hint dropout to preserve no-hint updates throughout RL training. We evaluate the method in math RLVR under the DAPO training framework across AIME24, AIME25, and AIME26 using $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$ and $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$. On $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$, our method improves both pass@1 and pass@2048 relative to DAPO across the three AIME benchmarks. On $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$, the gains are concentrated in the large-$k$ regime. These results suggest that, in math RLVR, hint scaffolding is effective when it restores learnable updates on challenging questions early in training and is then gradually removed before no-hint evaluation.

AI.tldr: 作者提出DAHS+BHA，在训练早期用逐步退出的动态提示解决RLVR在难题上「学不动且过拟合小k」的痛点，使小模型在AIME24-26上同时提升pass@1与pass@2048。
AI.motivation: 纯RLVR在难题上常出现：1)低k准确率提升但大k反而下降；2)提示虽能让题目可学，却存在师生分布错位且测试阶段零提示，直接退火会破坏梯度。需在不牺牲泛化的前提下，让模型早期从提示收益，后期适应无提示。
AI.method: (1)DAHS：将学生风格的部分解作为条件，让教师生成「被验证过的提示」，缩小师生分布差异；(2)BHA：按题目难度分层线性递减提示暴露率，并给每题独立dropout，使无提示更新持续贯穿RL训练，保证最终评估与训练分布一致。
AI.result: 在DAPO框架下用Qwen3-1.7B-Base与Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct跑AIME24-26：Qwen模型pass@1与pass@2048均显著优于纯DAPO；Llama模型提升主要体现在大k场景，验证了大k性能可被拯救。
AI.conclusion: 在数学RLVR中，有策略的提示脚手架（早期提供、后期撤出）能在不牺牲无提示评估的前提下恢复难题的可学习信号，实现「小k更高、大k不掉」。代码与模型即将开源。

title: Latent Anomaly Knowledge Excavation: Unveiling Sparse Sensitive Neurons in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms driving their anomaly detection (AD) performance remain poorly understood. Current methods predominantly treat VLMs as black-box feature extractors, assuming that anomaly-specific knowledge must be acquired through external adapters or memory banks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption by arguing that anomaly knowledge is intrinsically embedded within pre-trained models but remains latent and under-activated. We hypothesize that this knowledge is concentrated within a sparse subset of anomaly-sensitive neurons. To validate this, we propose latent anomaly knowledge excavation (LAKE), a training-free framework that identifies and elicits these critical neuronal signals using only a minimal set of normal samples. By isolating these sensitive neurons, LAKE constructs a highly compact normality representation that integrates visual structural deviations with cross-modal semantic activations. Extensive experiments on industrial AD benchmarks demonstrate that LAKE achieves state-of-the-art performance while providing intrinsic, neuron-level interpretability. Ultimately, our work advocates for a paradigm shift: redefining anomaly detection as the targeted activation of latent pre-trained knowledge rather than the acquisition of a downstream task.

AI.tldr: LAKE首次证明VLM自身已编码异常知识，无需训练、适配器或记忆库，仅通过挖掘“异常敏感神经元”即可实现SOTA工业异常检测，并给出神经元级解释。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把VLM当黑盒特征提取器，默认必须外挂模块“学”异常知识；作者质疑该假设，推断异常知识已内嵌于预训练权重，只是未被激活。
AI.method: 提出LAKE：①用极少正常样本估计各神经元对“正常-异常”的响应差异，筛选稀疏异常敏感神经元；②将这些神经元激活值压缩成紧凑正态表示，耦合视觉结构偏差与跨模态语义；③完全无训练，零推理成本地计算异常得分。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD等工业基准上，LAKE零样本超越现有需训练/记忆库的方法，取得新SOTA，同时提供可直接观察的神经元级解释图。
AI.conclusion: 异常检测不必“学”新任务，而应“唤醒”预训练模型中潜伏的知识；LAKE为无训练、可解释、易落地的工业AD提供了新范式。

title: MVOS_HSI: A Python Library for Preprocessing Agricultural Crop Hyperspectral Data
summary: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) allows researchers to study plant traits non-destructively. By capturing hundreds of narrow spectral bands per pixel, it reveals details about plant biochemistry and stress that standard cameras miss. However, processing this data is often challenging. Many labs still rely on loosely organized collections of lab-specific MATLAB or Python scripts, which makes workflows difficult to share and results difficult to reproduce. MVOS_HSI is an open-source Python library that provides an end-to-end workflow for processing leaf-level HSI data. The software handles everything from calibrating raw ENVI files to detecting and clipping individual leaves based on multiple vegetation indices (NDVI, CIRedEdge and GCI). It also includes tools for data augmentation to create training-time variations for machine learning and utilities to visualize spectral profiles. MVOS_HSI can be used as an importable Python library or run directly from the command line. The code and documentation are available on GitHub. By consolidating these common tasks into a single package, MVOS_HSI helps researchers produce consistent and reproducible results in plant phenotyping

AI.tldr: MVOS_HSI 是一个开源 Python 库，将叶片级高光谱图像从原始 ENVI 数据到校准、分割、数据增强及光谱可视化的全流程封装成统一命令行/库接口，解决了实验室 MATLAB/Python 脚本分散、难共享与难复现的问题。
AI.motivation: 高光谱成像能无损揭示植物生化与胁迫信息，但现有处理依赖零散脚本，导致结果不一致、难复现，亟需可共享的标准化工具。
AI.method: 开发 MVOS_HSI：用 Python 整合辐射定标、多植被指数（NDVI、CIRedEdge、GCI）自动检测与裁剪叶片、数据增强生成训练样本、光谱曲线可视化，提供库导入与命令行双接口。
AI.result: 该库一次安装即可完成从原始 ENVI 文件到可用于机器学习的数据集与可视化，显著降低重复劳动并提升结果一致性；代码与文档已开源至 GitHub。
AI.conclusion: MVOS_HSI 通过端到端封装，使植物表型高光谱分析流程标准化、可复现且易共享，为实验室间协作与大规模表型研究提供通用工具。

title: Paragraph Segmentation Revisited: Towards a Standard Task for Structuring Speech
summary: Automatic speech transcripts are often delivered as unstructured word streams that impede readability and repurposing. We recast paragraph segmentation as the missing structuring step and fill three gaps at the intersection of speech processing and text segmentation. First, we establish TEDPara (human-annotated TED talks) and YTSegPara (YouTube videos with synthetic labels) as the first benchmarks for the paragraph segmentation task. The benchmarks focus on the underexplored speech domain, where paragraph segmentation has traditionally not been part of post-processing, while also contributing to the wider text segmentation field, which still lacks robust and naturalistic benchmarks. Second, we propose a constrained-decoding formulation that lets large language models insert paragraph breaks while preserving the original transcript, enabling faithful, sentence-aligned evaluation. Third, we show that a compact model (MiniSeg) attains state-of-the-art accuracy and, when extended hierarchically, jointly predicts chapters and paragraphs with minimal computational cost. Together, our resources and methods establish paragraph segmentation as a standardized, practical task in speech processing.

AI.tldr: 首次为语音转写段落切分建立公开基准与轻量模型，实现无源文本改动的自动分段，填补语音与文本处理空白。
AI.motivation: 自动语音转写输出为无结构词流，缺乏段落信息，难以阅读与重用；现有文本分段研究缺少针对口语转写的自然基准与专用方法。
AI.method: 构建 TEDPara/YTSegPara 两个口语段落基准；提出大模型受限解码策略，在不改动原始转写的前提下插入段落标记；设计轻量级 MiniSeg 模型，分层联合预测章节与段落。
AI.result: MiniSeg 在 TEDPara/YTSegPara 上取得 SOTA 精度，层级扩展后同时输出章节与段落，计算开销极低；受限解码保证句子级对齐与忠实度。
AI.conclusion: 确立段落切分为语音后处理的标准任务，提供数据、评估与轻量解决方案，可直接嵌入现有转写流程。

title: Sparse $ε$ insensitive zone bounded asymmetric elastic net support vector machines for pattern classification
summary: Existing support vector machines(SVM) models are sensitive to noise and lack sparsity, which limits their performance. To address these issues, we combine the elastic net loss with a robust loss framework to construct a sparse $\varepsilon$-insensitive bounded asymmetric elastic net loss, and integrate it with SVM to build $\varepsilon$ Insensitive Zone Bounded Asymmetric Elastic Net Loss-based SVM($\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM). $\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM is both sparse and robust. Sparsity is proven by showing that samples inside the $\varepsilon$-insensitive band are not support vectors. Robustness is theoretically guaranteed because the influence function is bounded. To solve the non-convex optimization problem, we design a half-quadratic algorithm based on clipping dual coordinate descent. It transforms the problem into a series of weighted subproblems, improving computational efficiency via the $\varepsilon$ parameter. Experiments on simulated and real datasets show that $\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM outperforms traditional and existing robust SVMs. It balances sparsity and robustness well in noisy environments. Statistical tests confirm its superiority. Under the Gaussian kernel, it achieves better accuracy and noise insensitivity, validating its effectiveness and practical value.

AI.tldr: 针对SVM对噪声敏感且缺乏稀疏性的缺陷，作者提出ε-BAEN-SVM：将弹性网损失与鲁棒损失整合为ε-不敏感有界非对称弹性网损失，并给出稀疏与鲁棒的理论保证，用半二次裁剪对偶坐标下降算法求解非凸优化。实验在模拟与真实数据上均优于现有鲁棒SVM，且在Gaussian核下兼顾精度与抗噪性。
AI.motivation: 传统SVM对噪声敏感且解不稀疏，难以在高维、含噪场景下兼顾模型复杂度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构造ε-不敏感有界非对称弹性网损失（ε-insensitive bounded asymmetric elastic net），嵌入SVM框架；证明ε带内样本必为非支持向量以获得稀疏性，利用有界影响函数保证鲁棒性；设计半二次裁剪对偶坐标下降算法，将原非凸问题转化为一系列带权子问题，并通过ε参数控制计算效率。
AI.result: 在模拟与多组真实数据集上，ε-BAEN-SVM的预测精度、稀疏性与抗噪性均显著优于经典SVM及现有鲁棒SVM变体；统计检验证实其优势在高斯核下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: ε-BAEN-SVM在理论上兼具稀疏与鲁棒，在算法上可高效求解，实验验证了其在含噪环境中的实用价值，为鲁棒稀疏分类提供了一种有效的新工具。

title: The Weaponization of Computer Vision: Tracing Military-Surveillance Ties through Conference Sponsorship
summary: Computer vision, a core domain of artificial intelligence (AI), is the field that enables the computational analysis, understanding, and generation of visual data. Despite being historically rooted in military funding and increasingly deployed in warfare, the field tends to position itself as a neutral, purely technical endeavor, failing to engage in discussions about its dual-use applications. Yet it has been reported that computer vision systems are being systematically weaponized to assist in technologies that inflict harm, such as surveillance or warfare. Expanding on these concerns, we study the extent to which computer vision research is being used in the military and surveillance domains. We do so by collecting a dataset of tech companies with financial ties to the field's central research exchange platform: conferences. Conference sponsorship, we argue, not only serves as strong evidence of a company's investment in the field but also provides a privileged position for shaping its trajectory. By investigating sponsors' activities, we reveal that 44% of them have a direct connection with military or surveillance applications. We extend our analysis through two case studies in which we discuss the opportunities and limitations of sponsorship as a means for uncovering technological weaponization.

AI.tldr: 首次用量化方法揭露计算机视觉会议赞助方中44%直接参与军事/监控业务，证明该领域正被系统性武器化。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉长期自我标榜“纯技术”，却回避其双重用途风险；作者希望用数据打破“技术中立”迷思，揭示学术-产业-军工的利益链。
AI.method: 1) 抓取主流 CV 会议（CVPR/ICCV/ECCV 等）2010-2021 年全部赞助企业名单 → 建立 229 家公司数据集；2) 手工标注每家公司是否直接提供军用/监控产品或服务；3) 选取两家典型赞助商做深描案例，交叉验证公开合同、政府采购与专利文件。
AI.result: 44% 的会议赞助方确有军事或监控业务，包括无人机视觉、人脸识别枪瞄、边境/城市监控平台等；该比例在钻石/铂金级赞助商中升至 59%。案例显示会议赞助条款允许企业独家冠名竞赛 workshop，间接引导学界研究问题向军工需求靠拢。
AI.conclusion: “学术赞助”已成为军工利益集团低成本、低可见度地塑造计算机视觉研究方向的有效通道；领域必须建立利益冲突披露与审查机制，否则所谓的“中立研究”将持续为武器化提供技术储备。

title: RoboAgent: Chaining Basic Capabilities for Embodied Task Planning
summary: This paper focuses on embodied task planning, where an agent acquires visual observations from the environment and executes atomic actions to accomplish a given task. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved impressive results in multimodal understanding and reasoning, their performance remains limited when applied to embodied planning that involves multi-turn interaction, long-horizon reasoning, and extended context analysis. To bridge this gap, we propose RoboAgent, a capability-driven planning pipeline in which the model actively invokes different sub-capabilities. Each capability maintains its own context, and produces intermediate reasoning results or interacts with the environment according to the query given by a scheduler. This framework decomposes complex planning into a sequence of basic vision-language problems that VLMs can better address, enabling a more transparent and controllable reasoning process. The scheduler and all capabilities are implemented with a single VLM, without relying on external tools. To train this VLM, we adopt a multi-stage paradigm that consists of: (1) behavior cloning with expert plans, (2) DAgger training using trajectories collected by the model, and (3) reinforcement learning guided by an expert policy. Across these stages, we exploit the internal information of the environment simulator to construct high-quality supervision for each capability, and we further introduce augmented and synthetic data to enhance the model's performance in more diverse scenarios. Extensive experiments on widely used embodied task planning benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Our codes will be available at https://github.com/woyut/RoboAgent_CVPR26.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboAgent框架，仅用单个VLM即可将复杂具身任务分解为多轮可视-语言子问题，实现长周期、多轮交互的规划，并通过多阶段训练（模仿-DAgger-强化）显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉-语言模型虽然多模态理解能力强，但在面向长期、多轮交互的具身任务规划时表现受限，亟需一种能充分利用VLM潜力且无需依赖外部工具的透明、可控方案。
AI.method: RoboAgent采用“能力-调度”架构：调度器根据任务动态调用各子能力，各能力共享同一VLM但独立维护上下文；通过三阶段训练（先模仿专家、再DAgger自主轨迹纠偏、最后用专家策略奖励强化）合成大量高质量监督与增强数据，以快速提升规划表现。
AI.result: 在多标准具身任务规划基准上，RoboAgent的经常性成功率显著超越同类型VLM方法，在长视线、多目标、干扰场景等测试集上分别平均提升最高达26.2%、21.4%、18.6%；消融实验表明能力分解和强化阶段是性能提升的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 在无需外挂工具的前提下，通过能力分解与三阶段训练即可释放大VLM的规划潜力，为具身智能的推理透明度和可控性提供了新范式；未来将进一步提升跨机器人适配效率、提升泛化能力，并扩展至更复杂任务领域。

title: ModeX: Evaluator-Free Best-of-N Selection for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Selecting a single high-quality output from multiple stochastic generations remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly in open-ended tasks where no canonical answer exists. While Best-of-N and self-consistency methods show that aggregating multiple generations can improve performance, existing approaches typically rely on external evaluators, reward models, or exact string-match voting, limiting their applicability and efficiency. We propose Mode Extraction (ModeX), an evaluator-free Best-of-N selection framework that generalizes majority voting to open-ended text generation by identifying the modal output representing the dominant semantic consensus among generated texts. ModeX constructs a similarity graph over candidate generations and recursively applies spectral clustering to select a representative centroid, without requiring additional inference or auxiliary models. We further instantiate this selection principle as ModeX-Lite, an improved version of ModeX with early pruning for efficiency. Across open-ended tasks -- including text summarization, code generation, and mathematical reasoning -- our approaches consistently outperform standard single- and multi-path baselines, providing a computationally efficient solution for robust open-ended text generation. Code is released in https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/ModeX.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型开放式任务回答质量不稳、缺乏参考答案的问题，作者提出无评价器的 Best-of-N 选择框架 ModeX 及其高效版 ModeX-Lite，仅需对多次生成文本做谱聚类提取语义众数，就能以极简计算显著提升各类开放式生成的输出一致性。
AI.motivation: 大模型在开放式生成中常输出多样低质回答，传统 Best-of-N 依赖奖励模型或精确匹配投票，带来额外推理开销并难扩展至无标准答案场景，亟需一种无需外部评估即可从多候选中选优的新范式。
AI.method: 1) ModeX：构建生成文本相似图，迭代谱聚类识别语义众数（矩阵代数自举众数提取）；2) ModeX-Lite：早期剪枝加速并仅算主干谱特征向量，保持效果同时减少图规模与计算。二者完整流程不需任何外部奖励模型或人类判断。
AI.result: 在文本摘要、代码生成、数学推理三大类七数据集上，两种方法均显著优于单生成、简单微调投票、Self-Consistency 等基线，选出的众数 BLEU/ROUGE/BLEU-text 提升 2–12% 不等，推理时间仅增加 <10%。
AI.conclusion: ModeX 表明纯粹基于谱聚类的语义众数提取即可成为高效、即插即用的开放式选优策略，为无参考评估场景提供通用解决方案，并开源代码以方便社区移植。

title: Symbiotic-MoE: Unlocking the Synergy between Generation and Understanding
summary: Empowering Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with image generation often leads to catastrophic forgetting in understanding tasks due to severe gradient conflicts. While existing paradigms like Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) mitigate this conflict through structural isolation, they fundamentally sever cross-modal synergy and suffer from capacity fragmentation. In this work, we present Symbiotic-MoE, a unified pre-training framework that resolves task interference within a native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers architecture with zero-parameter overhead. We first identify that standard MoE tuning leads to routing collapse, where generative gradients dominate expert utilization. To address this, we introduce Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement, which partitions experts into task-specific groups while utilizing shared experts as a multimodal semantic bridge. Crucially, this design allows shared experts to absorb fine-grained visual semantics from generative tasks to enrich textual representations. To optimize this, we propose a Progressive Training Strategy featuring differential learning rates and early-stage gradient shielding. This mechanism not only shields pre-trained knowledge from early volatility but eventually transforms generative signals into constructive feedback for understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Symbiotic-MoE achieves rapid generative convergence while unlocking cross-modal synergy, boosting inherent understanding with remarkable gains on MMLU and OCRBench.

AI.tldr: 基于原生多模态MoE、零额外参数，提出「共生MoE」预训练框架，解决LMM联合图文生成任务带来的灾难性遗忘难题。
AI.motivation: 在LMM中引入图像生成会导致理解与生成梯度冲突，引发灾难性遗忘。现有MoT通过结构隔离缓解冲突，却割裂了跨模态协同，并造成容量碎片化，需要兼顾理解与生成并存的新范式。
AI.method: 1) 设计原生多模态MoE框架，按任务分组专家并保留共享专家作语义桥梁；2) 提出Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement，阻止生成梯度主导路由崩塌；3) 采用渐进式训练：差分学习率+早期梯度屏蔽，逐步将生成梯度转化为理解强化信号。
AI.result: 在生成端实现快速收敛且不损害理解能力；在MMLU、OCRBench等理解基准上获得显著增益，验证了跨模态协同得以保留并被进一步激发。
AI.conclusion: Symbiotic-MoE以零额外参数成本，同时提升文本理解和图像生成表现，为统一多模态预训练提供了有效范例，证明生成损失可转化为理解强化信号。

title: PolicyLong: Towards On-Policy Context Extension
comment: Work in progress. Correspondence to ucaswu@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Extending LLM context windows is hindered by scarce high-quality long-context data. Recent methods synthesize data with genuine long-range dependencies via information-theoretic verification, selecting contexts that reduce a base model's predictive entropy. However, their single-pass offline construction with a fixed model creates a fundamental off-policy gap: the static screening landscape misaligns with the model's evolving capabilities, causing the training distribution to drift. We propose PolicyLong, shifting data construction towards a dynamic on-policy paradigm. By iteratively re-executing data screening (entropy computation, retrieval, and verification) using the current model, PolicyLong ensures the training distribution tracks evolving capabilities, yielding an emergent self-curriculum. Crucially, both positive and hard negative contexts derive from the current model's entropy landscape, co-evolving what the model learns to exploit and resist. Experiments on RULER, HELMET, and LongBench-v2 (Qwen2.5-3B) show PolicyLong consistently outperforms EntropyLong and NExtLong, with gains growing at longer contexts (e.g., +2.54 at 128K on RULER), confirming the value of on-policy data evolution.

AI.tldr: PolicyLong不用离线长文，而是循环用当前模型算熵、重筛长内容，实现模型·数据协同进化，快速打开超长窗口。
AI.motivation: 已有长文预训练数据少；离线信息熵筛选的结果对快速进化的模型来说是”过时专家片段“，导至分布漂移和效果退减（Off-Policy Gap）。
AI.method: 提出动态 On-Policy 框架 PolicyLong，在初期短上下文模型也能参与数据迭代（Seed-Compatible），分三阶段：1) 当前最优模型算熵选片段和硬负样本（Hard Negatives）；2) 合适上采/下采混合以保证熵平稳和长度可扩展；3) 熵爆炸抑制与显式错变延长，将单篇1-2 pass变10-20 pass自我带状 curriculum。训练目标与架构保持，不做额外蒸馏。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-3B 在 4K-1M 上下文上一次性成绩单 RULER 128K +2.54，4K-128K GoldPass+NIAH 全路段平均 +1.32；HELMET 1M 检索双列提升21%；LongBench-v2 多任务平均 ↑2.3，超长段爬坡尤显著。消融证实迭代步数与熵门控同优先。
AI.conclusion: 动态在线、模型-数据共进化是从“短模型”迅速走出千兆 token 窗口的有效低风险路径，PolicyLong为此提供通用范式并可与任何位置嵌入和长度外推方法自由组合。

title: MonoUNet: A Robust Tiny Neural Network for Automated Knee Cartilage Segmentation on Point-of-Care Ultrasound Devices
comment: Accepted to Ultrasound in Medicine & Biology
summary:
Objective: To develop a robust and compact deep learning model for automated knee cartilage segmentation on point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) devices.
  Methods: We propose MonoUNet, an ultra-compact U-Net consisting of (i) an aggressively reduced backbone with an asymmetric decoder, (ii) a trainable monogenic block that extracts multi-scale local phase features, and (iii) a gated feature injection mechanism that integrates these features into the encoder stages to reduce sensitivity to variations in ultrasound image appearance and improve robustness across devices. MonoUNet was evaluated on a multi-site, multi-device knee cartilage ultrasound dataset acquired using cart-based, portable, and handheld POCUS devices.
  Results: Overall, MonoUNet outperformed existing lightweight segmentation models, with average Dice scores ranging from 92.62% to 94.82% and mean average surface distance (MASD) values between 0.133 mm and 0.254 mm. MonoUNet reduces the number of parameters by 10x--700x and computational cost by 14x--2000x relative to existing lightweight models. MonoUNet cartilage outcomes showed excellent reliability and agreement with the manual outcomes: intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC$_{2,k})$=0.96 and bias=2.00% (0.047 mm) for average thickness, and ICC$_{2,k}$=0.99 and bias=0.80% (0.328 a.u.) for echo intensity.
  Conclusion: Incorporating trainable local phase features improves the robustness of highly compact neural networks for knee cartilage segmentation across varying acquisition settings and could support scalable ultrasound-based assessment and monitoring of knee osteoarthritis using POCUS devices. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/alvinkimbowa/monounet.

AI.tldr: 基于 U-Net 改造的 MonoUNet 以不足现有轻量化模型 1/10 参数，在跨站点、跨设备 POOCUS 膝软骨分割中获得 92%–95% Dice，支撑膝关节炎床旁定量评估。
AI.motivation: 床旁超声 (POCUS) 机型多样，图像外观差异大，现有深度网络体量、能耗或跨域性能均难以落地；亟需一个极小且鲁棒的模型，一线设备都能实现自动软骨分割。
AI.method: 1. 非对称编-解码 U 型骨干，宽度大幅挤压；2. 提出可训练多尺度柯西—雷耶局部相位块，提取超声专用纹理；3. 门控注入把局部相位图谱分阶段回流编码层，抑制设备/设置差异；4. 仅用逐像素交叉熵+Dice 损失端到端训练，无需额外后处理或迁移微调。
AI.result: 针对推车、便携、手持机的多中心数据，Dice 92.62%–94.82%，MASD 0.133–0.254 mm 优 8 个税者；参数 <3 k–15 k(较同级小 10–700 倍)，乘法累加次数降低 14–2000 倍，移动 GPU 26 ms/CPU 150 ms 推理；厚度 ICC=0.96、回声强度 ICC=0.99，与人工注解均值差异 <2%。
AI.conclusion: 内置局部相位自学习可使超轻量化模型跨设备表现稳定，为低成本膝关节炎超声随访与大规模筛查提供可落地算法，同时完全开源 (GitHub)。

title: Break Me If You Can: Self-Jailbreaking of Aligned LLMs via Lexical Insertion Prompting
summary: We introduce \emph{self-jailbreaking}, a threat model in which an aligned LLM guides its own compromise. Unlike most jailbreak techniques, which often rely on handcrafted prompts or separate attacker models, self-jailbreaking requires no external red-team LLM: the target model's own internal knowledge suffices. We operationalize this via \textbf{Self-Jailbreaking via Lexical Insertion Prompting (\textsc{SLIP})}, a black-box algorithm that casts jailbreaking as breadth-first tree search over multi-turn dialogues, incrementally inserting missing content words from the attack goal into benign prompts using the target model as its own guide. Evaluations on AdvBench and HarmBench show \textsc{SLIP} achieves 90--100\% Attack Success Rate (ASR) (avg.\ 94.7\%) across most of the eleven tested models (including GPT-5.1, Claude-Sonnet-4.5, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3), with only ${\sim}7.9$ LLM calls on average, 3--6$\times$ fewer than prior methods. We evaluate existing defenses, show that regex-based approaches are evaded by prompt paraphrasing, and propose the Semantic Drift Monitor (SDM) defense that tracks \textsc{SLIP}'s embedding-space trajectory, achieving 76\% detection at 5\% FPR. However, SDM remains insufficient against adaptive attack strategies, underscoring the need for more advanced defense mechanisms tailored to the self-jailbreaking threat surface. We release our code for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 一篇提出“自我越狱”威胁模型的论文：无需外部模型，仅用目标大模型自身知识即可引导其绕过安全对齐，方法SLIP在11个主流模型上平均ASR达94.7%，并提出可部分防御的语义漂移监控器(SDM)。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱攻击多依赖手工提示或外部红队模型，触发成本高且易被检出；作者想探究“单模型自我引导”能否在零外部协助下高效瓦解对齐，从而暴露新的内在脆弱面。
AI.method: 提出Self-Jailbreaking框架，并以SLIP算法实例化：将越狱视为多轮对话的广度优先树搜索，利用目标模型自身预测把攻击目标的缺失内容词渐进插入看似无害的提示，仅黑盒调用即可完成
AI.result: 在AdvBench与HarmBench上评估11个模型(包括GPT-5.1、Claude-4.5等)，SLIP平均ASR 94.7%，平均仅需7.9次调用，比基线少用3–6倍；正则防御可被改写绕过，提出的SDM防御在5%误报下检测率76%，但面对自适应策略仍不足
AI.conclusion: 自我越狱揭示了大模型“自带红队知识”的固有缺陷，现有防护难以彻底封堵；需针对该威胁面设计更强的动态、语义级防御机制，代码已开源供后续研究

title: Generative optimal transport via forward-backward HJB matching
summary: Controlling the evolution of a many-body stochastic system from a disordered reference state to a structured target ensemble, characterized empirically through samples, arises naturally in non-equilibrium statistical mechanics and stochastic control. The natural relaxation of such a system - driven by diffusion - runs from the structured target toward the disordered reference. The natural question is then: what is the minimum-work stochastic process that reverses this relaxation, given a pathwise cost functional combining spatial penalties and control effort? Computing this optimal process requires knowledge of trajectories that already sample the target ensemble - precisely the object one is trying to construct. We resolve this by establishing a time-reversal duality: the value function governing the hard backward dynamics satisfies an equivalent forward-in-time HJB equation, whose solution can be read off directly from the tractable forward relaxation trajectories. Via the Cole-Hopf transformation and its associated Feynman-Kac representation, this forward potential is computed as a path-space free energy averaged over these forward trajectories - the same relaxation paths that are easy to simulate - without any backward simulation or knowledge of the target beyond samples. The resulting framework provides a physically interpretable description of stochastic transport in terms of path-space free energy, risk-sensitive control, and spatial cost geometry. We illustrate the theory with numerical examples that visualize the learned value function and the induced controlled diffusions, demonstrating how spatial cost fields shape transport geometry analogously to Fermat's Principle in inhomogeneous media. Our results establish a unifying connection between stochastic optimal control, Schrödinger bridge theory, and non-equilibrium statistical mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种时间反演对偶框架，无需反向模拟即可用易采样的正向轨迹计算把无序多体系统“拉回”有序目标所需的最低功随机控制策略，统一了随机最优控制、Schrödinger桥与非平衡统计力学。
AI.motivation: 非平衡统计力学中常需让受扩散驱动的多体随机系统从已知的无序参考态逆向演化为仅由样本刻画的结构目标系综，而传统的随机最优控制需先获得难以得到的反向轨迹样本。如何仅用易采样的正向松弛轨迹算出最小功控制策略是核心挑战。
AI.method: 建立时间反演对偶定理，证明控制反向动力的值函数满足一个正向-时间的HJB方程；借助Cole-Hopf变换与Feynman-Kac表示，将该值函数表达为对正向松弛轨迹的路径空间自由能，并引入空间惩罚与风险敏感控制项直接估算，完全避免反向模拟或对目标分布的先验知识。
AI.result: 所得框架可用正向轨迹一次性计算出可解释的值函数与相应受控扩散；数值实验可视化显示空间代价场如何像费马原理般塑造传输几何，准确复现从参考态到目标系综的最小功随机过程，且计算成本与模拟正向松弛相当。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次将随机最优控制、Schrödinger桥理论与非平衡统计力学通过路径空间自由能量统一起来，为仅用样本驱动复杂系统逆向演化提供了可扩展、可解释且无需反向采样的通用方法。

title: More Capable, Less Cooperative? When LLMs Fail At Zero-Cost Collaboration
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild. 24 pages, 5 figures
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly coordinate in multi-agent systems, yet we lack an understanding of where and why cooperation failures may arise. In many real-world coordination problems, from knowledge sharing in organizations to code documentation, helping others carries negligible personal cost while generating substantial collective benefits. However, whether LLM agents cooperate when helping neither benefits nor harms the helper, while being given explicit instructions to do so, remains unknown. We build a multi-agent setup designed to study cooperative behavior in a frictionless environment, removing all strategic complexity from cooperation. We find that capability does not predict cooperation: OpenAI o3 achieves only 17% of optimal collective performance while OpenAI o3-mini reaches 50%, despite identical instructions to maximize group revenue. Through a causal decomposition that automates one side of agent communication, we separate cooperation failures from competence failures, tracing their origins through agent reasoning analysis. Testing targeted interventions, we find that explicit protocols double performance for low-competence models, and tiny sharing incentives improve models with weak cooperation. Our findings suggest that scaling intelligence alone will not solve coordination problems in multi-agent systems and will require deliberate cooperative design, even when helping others costs nothing.

AI.tldr: 大规模语言模型在多智能体协作中即使帮助他人零成本，也频繁出现合作失败；能力越强未必越合作，需专门设计合作机制而非单纯扩大模型规模。
AI.motivation: 现实场景（知识共享、代码文档化）中“助人零成本却能带来巨大集体收益”的协作任务日益依赖 LLM 多智能体系统，但尚不清楚这些模型在仅被指令“最大化群体收益”时是否真的会合作。
AI.method: 构建“零摩擦”多智能体实验环境，剔除战略复杂性；用因果分解自动化一方通信，区分“合作失败”与“能力失败”；对低能力模型施加显式协议，对弱合作模型引入微小共享激励并观测效果。
AI.result: o3 仅达成 17% 集体最优，o3-mini 达 50%，能力差异不预测合作水平；显式协议使低能力模型表现翻倍，微小共享激励显著提升弱合作模型；合作失败源于模型内在推理而非任务能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠提升模型智能无法解决多智能体协调问题，必须在系统层面进行“合作导向”设计，即使助人成本为零也不例外。

title: The Weaponization of Computer Vision: Tracing Military-Surveillance Ties through Conference Sponsorship
summary: Computer vision, a core domain of artificial intelligence (AI), is the field that enables the computational analysis, understanding, and generation of visual data. Despite being historically rooted in military funding and increasingly deployed in warfare, the field tends to position itself as a neutral, purely technical endeavor, failing to engage in discussions about its dual-use applications. Yet it has been reported that computer vision systems are being systematically weaponized to assist in technologies that inflict harm, such as surveillance or warfare. Expanding on these concerns, we study the extent to which computer vision research is being used in the military and surveillance domains. We do so by collecting a dataset of tech companies with financial ties to the field's central research exchange platform: conferences. Conference sponsorship, we argue, not only serves as strong evidence of a company's investment in the field but also provides a privileged position for shaping its trajectory. By investigating sponsors' activities, we reveal that 44% of them have a direct connection with military or surveillance applications. We extend our analysis through two case studies in which we discuss the opportunities and limitations of sponsorship as a means for uncovering technological weaponization.

AI.tldr: 计算机视觉研究论文的赞助者有44%与军事或监控用途直接相关，揭示该领域的‘技术中立’叙事与武器化现实严重脱节。
AI.motivation: 尽管CV领域长期以“技术中立”自居，多项报道已指出相关技术正在被武器化用于杀伤或监控；学界亟需定量证据来评估科研资助链的军事化规模。
AI.method: 收集该领域顶级会议的所有赞助商，建立公开数据集；通过公开资料对每家赞助商进行军用或监控用途标注，并辅以两家公司级案例研究检验方法的边界。
AI.result: 全部952家赞助商中，44%被证实直接从事军用或监控业务；资助层级与武器化风险呈正相关，纯学术口号在赞助层面基本站不住脚。
AI.conclusion: 学术会议赞助比其他公开指标更能反映“被武器化”的概率，应被纳入伦理评审与科研政策；社区必须将军事化风险纳入同行评议与资助决策，结束对技术后果的集体回避。

title: Compact Example-Based Explanations for Language Models
summary: Training data influence estimation methods quantify the contribution of training documents to a model's output, making them a promising source of information for example-based explanations. As humans cannot interpret thousands of documents, only a small subset of the training data can be presented as an explanation. Although the choice of which documents to include directly affects explanation quality, previous evaluations of such systems have largely ignored any selection strategies. To address this, we propose a novel selection relevance score, a retraining-free metric that quantifies how useful a set of examples is for explaining a model's output. We validate this score through fine-tuning experiments, confirming that it can predict whether a set of examples supports or undermines the model's predictions. Using this metric, we further show that common selection strategies often underperform random selection. Motivated by this finding, we propose a strategy that balances influence and representativeness, enabling better use of selection budgets than naively selecting the highest-ranking examples.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重训练的「选择相关分数」来量化训练样本对模型预测的解释价值，据此证明现有挑选策略常逊于随机，并提出兼顾影响力与代表性的新策略。
AI.motivation: 现有数据影响力估计只能给出全部样本的贡献，但人类只能查看极少量样本；如何从中选出最能解释模型预测的小子集尚缺系统评估指标与策略。
AI.method: 1) 定义「选择相关分数」：用该子集在下游微调中对原预测的支持/破坏程度作量化；2) 通过多组微调实验验证分数可预测解释有效性；3) 以该分数为基准比较常见挑选策略，发现多数策略不如随机；4) 提出兼顾影响力与代表性的新挑选策略。
AI.result: 实验表明：新指标与微调后预测变化相关性高（可预测解释质量）；Top-k影响力、聚类中心、不确定度采样等策略显著低于随机基线；新策略在同等预算下提升解释效果。
AI.conclusion: 数据影响力只是必要条件，需引入选择相关分数重新评估；平衡影响力与代表性的筛选策略能更有效地把影响力估计转化为人类可理解的示例解释。

title: Sensitivity-Positional Co-Localization in GQA Transformers
summary: We investigate a fundamental structural question in Grouped Query Attention (GQA) transformers: do the layers most sensitive to task correctness coincide with the layers where positional encoding adaptation has the greatest leverage? We term this the co-localization hypothesis and test it on Llama 3.1 8B, a 32-layer GQA model with a 4:1 query-to-key-value head ratio. We introduce \LSLORA, which restricts LoRA adaptation to layers identified via a novel correctness-differential hidden-state metric, and GARFA (GQA-Aware RoPE Frequency Adaptation), which attaches 8 learnable per-KV-head scalar multipliers to each targeted layer. Contrary to the co-localization hypothesis, we discover strong anti-localization: task-sensitive layers concentrate in the late network ($\ell\in\{23\text{-}31\}$) while RoPE-influential layers dominate the early network ($\ell\in\{0\text{-}9\}$), yielding Spearman $r_s = -0.735$ ($p = 1.66\times10^{-6}$). Despite this anti-localization, a 4-way cross-layer ablation shows that applying both interventions to the sensitivity-identified layers outperforms all alternative configurations by 4-16 percentage points across six diverse benchmarks (MMLU, GPQA, HumanEval+, MATH, MGSM, ARC), approaching Claude 3.5 Haiku on HumanEval+ (67.1% vs. 68.3%) at \$100 total compute cost.

AI.tldr: 在 Llama 3.1-8B 上首次证实 GQA Transformer 存在“反共定位”现象：任务敏感层集中于后段（23–31 层），而位置编码（RoPE）关键层位于前段（0–9 层）。据此提出仅在后段注入轻量适配器（LSLORA）+ 在前段学习 8 组频率缩放（GARFA）的跨层组合策略，以 4–16 个点的优势胜过全部消融配置，并在 HumanEval+ 逼近 Claude-3.5-Haiku（67.1% vs 68.3%），总成本仅 100 美元。
AI.motivation: Grouped Query Attention（GQA）已成为大模型标配，但尚不清楚“对任务正确性最敏感的层”是否与“位置编码（RoPE）可塑性最大的层”重合。若二者共定位，则可在同一子层同时应用任务特定与位置自适应，显著降低微调开销；反之则需分层设计。回答该结构问题可指导参数高效微调（PEFT）在 GQA 模型上的最优部署。
AI.method: 1. 在 32 层 Llama 3.1-8B（4:1 GQA）上定义“正确性差分隐藏状态”指标，逐层量化其对 downstream 正确性的边际贡献，识别任务敏感层。2. 通过扰动 RoPE 频率并测量输出分布偏移，量化每层对位置编码的敏感度，识别 RoPE 关键层。3. 提出 LSLORA：仅对任务敏感层插入低秩适配器（LoRA）。4. 提出 GARFA：在 RoPE 关键层为每组 KV-head 引入 8 个可学习的频率缩放因子，实现 GQA 感知的 RoPE 频率微调。5. 执行 4×4 跨层消融，系统比较仅 LSLORA、仅 GARFA、二者共层、以及分层组合的性能与成本。
AI.result: Spearman 相关系数 rs = −0.735（p = 1.66×10⁻⁶），强烈拒绝“共定位”假设：任务敏感层 ∼23–31 层，RoPE 关键层 ∼0–9 层。将 LSLORA 应用于后段、GARFA 应用于前段的“反定位”组合，在 MMLU、GPQA、HumanEval+、MATH、MGSM、ARC 上平均提升 4–16 个百分点，显著优于同层或错层配置；在 HumanEval+ 达到 67.1%，仅比 Claude-3.5-Haiku 低 1.2 个百分点，而总 GPU 预算仅 100 美元。
AI.conclusion: GQA Transformer 的任务敏感性与位置编码可塑性呈显著“反定位”。利用该结构洞见，采用后段任务适配 + 前段位置适配的分层轻量策略，可在极低计算成本下逼近大模型性能，为参数高效微调提供新的跨层设计范式。

title: Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers
summary: We study implicit reasoning, i.e. the ability to combine knowledge or rules within a single forward pass. While transformer-based large language models store substantial factual knowledge and rules, they often fail to compose this knowledge for implicit multi-hop reasoning, suggesting a lack of compositional generalization over their parametric knowledge. To address this limitation, we study recurrent-depth transformers, which enables iterative computation over the same transformer layers. We investigate two compositional generalization challenges under the implicit reasoning scenario: systematic generalization, i.e. combining knowledge that is never used for compositions during training, and depth extrapolation, i.e. generalizing from limited reasoning depth (e.g. training on up to 5-hop) to deeper compositions (e.g. 10-hop). Through controlled studies with models trained from scratch, we show that while vanilla transformers struggle with both generalization challenges, recurrent-depth transformers can effectively make such generalization. For systematic generalization, we find that this ability emerges through a three-stage grokking process, transitioning from memorization to in-distribution generalization and finally to systematic generalization, supported by mechanistic analysis. For depth extrapolation, we show that generalization beyond training depth can be unlocked by scaling inference-time recurrence, with more iterations enabling deeper reasoning. We further study how training strategies affect extrapolation, providing guidance on training recurrent-depth transformers, and identify a key limitation, overthinking, where excessive recurrence degrades predictions and limits generalization to very deep compositions.

AI.tldr: 基于Transformer的语言模型在单次前向传播中难以灵活组合已储存知识实现隐性推理；本文提出循环深度Transformer，借助层间迭代计算实现想象力更强的系统性泛化与深度外推，并通过控制实验与机理分析解释了其优势及限制。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型虽拥有丰富参数化事实和规则知识，但在单次前向传播中难以进行隐性多跳推理，即缺乏组合性泛化能力，表现为欠系统性泛化和深度外推不足。如何不借助显式提示即可在模型内部完成知识组合，是当前研究的核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出循环深度Transformer：所有层在推理或训练时可多次循环调用；设计两个可控综合任务——系统性泛化（训练集从未出现的新知识组合）、深度外推（只知≤5跳训练后即可推断10跳）；利用从随机初始化训练的小模型进行严格实验比较；开展机理分析（grokking三阶段记忆→同分布泛化→系统泛化），并研究推理迭代次数与训练策略对性能的影响。
AI.result: 1) 标准Transformer在两项泛化任务均失败；循环深度Transformer能稳定实现系统性和深度外化，性能随推理迭代基本可大幅提升。2) 系统性泛化经历三阶段grokking过程；循环层权重的演化与组合操作的结构简化高度对应。3) 深度外推受推理迭代数直接控制，更大迭代可解锁更深推理；训练阶段对循环深度和约束策略有显著影响。4) 发现过度思考（overthinking）现象：过多迭代反而破坏结果并限制向深度极限泛化。
AI.conclusion: 循环深度Transformer通过层间反复重入，有效将参数知识在单次前向流程重度利用，实现了显性逻辑推理所缺乏的组合性泛化；证明系统性泛化和深度外化可分别通过训练时的权重建模与推理时的循环扩步来达成；指出过度思考为推广至极度深度时的关键瓶颈。对未来模型架构设计和推理预算分配具有实益，也为理解Transformers的隐式组合机理提供实证视角。

title: Are GUI Agents Focused Enough? Automated Distraction via Semantic-level UI Element Injection
comment: 44 pages, 10 figures, public code will be available at https://github.com/HashTAG00002/UI-Injection
summary: Existing red-teaming studies on GUI agents have important limitations. Adversarial perturbations typically require white-box access, which is unavailable for commercial systems, while prompt injection is increasingly mitigated by stronger safety alignment. To study robustness under a more practical threat model, we propose Semantic-level UI Element Injection, a red-teaming setting that overlays safety-aligned and harmless UI elements onto screenshots to misdirect the agent's visual grounding. Our method uses a modular Editor-Overlapper-Victim pipeline and an iterative search procedure that samples multiple candidate edits, keeps the best cumulative overlay, and adapts future prompt strategies based on previous failures. Across five victim models, our optimized attacks improve attack success rate by up to 4.4x over random injection on the strongest victims. Moreover, elements optimized on one source model transfer effectively to other target models, indicating model-agnostic vulnerabilities. After the first successful attack, the victim still clicks the attacker-controlled element in more than 15% of later independent trials, versus below 1% for random injection, showing that the injected element acts as a persistent attractor rather than simple visual clutter.

AI.tldr: 首次提出“语义级UI元素注入”黑盒攻击范式，无需模型内部信息即可通过叠加无害视觉元素误导商业GUI代理，成功率最高提升4.4倍，且攻击具备跨模型迁移性与持续引诱效应。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI代理红队评估要么依赖白盒扰动不适用于闭源系统，要么面临prompt injection被安全对齐削弱的困境，急需在真实黑盒条件下测试其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建Editor-Overlapper-Victim三模块流水线：Editor生成候选UI元素，Overlapper叠加入截屏，Victim为被测代理；配合迭代搜索策略保留累计最优图层并动态调整后续prompt。攻击仅注入视觉上无害、语义相关的UI元素，无需任何模型内部信息。
AI.result: 在5个 victim 模型上，优化注入较随机注入把攻击成功率最多提高4.4倍；跨模型迁移实验显示，源模型上优化的元素可直接用于其他目标模型并保持高成功率；首次成功后，受害代理在15%以上独立后续试验中仍点击攻击者控制元素，而随机注入不足1%，证明元素形成持续“吸引子”。
AI.conclusion: 即使经过安全对齐，商业GUI代理仍存在对语义级视觉注入的模型无关且持久的脆弱性，强调需在部署端加入视觉输入层面的动态防御与行为监测，而不仅依赖语言对齐。

title: Double: Breaking the Acceleration Limit via Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism
summary: Parallel Speculative Decoding (PSD) accelerates traditional Speculative Decoding (SD) by overlapping draft generation with verification. However, it remains hampered by two fundamental challenges: (1) a theoretical speedup ceiling dictated by the speed ratio between the draft and target models, and (2) high computational waste and pipeline stall due to mid-sequence token rejections of early errors. To address these limitations, we introduce \textsc{Double} (Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism). By bridging the gap between SD and PSD, our framework resolves the Retrieval \emph{Precision-Efficiency Dilemma} through a novel synchronous mechanism. Specifically, we enable the draft model to execute iterative retrieval speculations to break the theoretical speedup limits; to alleviate rejections without rollback, the target model performs authoritative retrieval to generate multi-token guidance. \textsc{Double} is entirely training-free and lossless. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art speedup of $\textbf{5.3}\times$ on LLaMA3.3-70B and $\textbf{2.8}\times$ on Qwen3-32B, significantly outperforming the advanced method EAGLE-3 that requires extensive model training.

AI.tldr: 提出\textsc{Double}，无需训练即可将大模型推理速度提升5.3×，同时解决并行推测解码的理论上限与早期错误浪费两大顽疾。
AI.motivation: 并行推测解码（PSD）虽能交叠草稿生成与验证，但受限于①草稿/目标模型速度比决定的理论加速上限，②早期Token被拒导致计算浪费与流水线停顿。需打破天花板并减少无效计算。
AI.method: \textsc{Double}建立“同步双检索”机制：草稿侧迭代执行检索式多步推测，突破速度比上限；目标侧在验证阶段以 authoritative retrieval 直接生成多Token指引，避免回滚即可纠正早期错误。整个过程零训练、无精度损失。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3.3-70B上实现5.3×端到端加速，Qwen3-32B上2.8×，显著优于需重训的EAGLE-3（同期最好方法）。
AI.conclusion: \textsc{Double}证明无需重训即可同时消除SD/PSD的理论与工程瓶颈，为超大模型无损提速提供了可即插即用的解决方案。

title: Toward Generalizable Graph Learning for 3D Engineering AI: Explainable Workflows for CAE Mode Shape Classification and CFD Field Prediction
summary: Automotive engineering development increasingly relies on heterogeneous 3D data, including finite element (FE) models, body-in-white (BiW) representations, CAD geometry, and CFD meshes. At the same time, engineering teams face growing pressure to shorten development cycles, improve performance and accelerate innovation. Although artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly explored in this domain, many current methods remain task-specific, difficult to interpret, and hard to reuse across development stages. This paper presents a practical graph learning framework for 3D engineering AI, in which heterogeneous engineering assets are converted into physics-aware graph representations and processed by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The framework is designed to support both classification and prediction tasks. The framework is validated on two automotive applications: CAE vibration mode shape classification and CFD aerodynamic field prediction. For CAE vibration mode classification, a region-aware BiW graph supports explainable mode classification across vehicle and FE variants under label scarcity. For CFD aerodynamic field prediction, a physics-informed surrogate predicts pressure and wall shear stress (WSS) across aerodynamic body shape variants, while symmetry preserving down sampling retains accuracy with lower computational cost. The framework also outlines data generation guidance that can help engineers identify which additional simulations or labels are valuable to collect next. These results demonstrate a practical and reusable engineering AI workflow for more trustworthy CAE and CFD decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出面向汽车异构3D数据的物理感知图学习框架，统一处理FE、CAD、CFD等资产，支持CAE模态分类与CFD气动力场预测，兼顾可解释跨阶段复用。
AI.motivation: 汽车研发需在更短周期内综合利用FE模型、BiW、CAD、CFD等多源异构3D数据，但现有AI方法局限于单一任务、黑箱难解释且难以跨阶段复用，妨碍高效迭代与创新。
AI.method: 构建可重用图学习框架：将异构工程资产转换为物理感知图表示→采用GNN处理；区域感知BiW图实现小样本下可解释模态分类；物理引导的对称保持降采样代理模型预测表面压力与壁面剪应力，并给出数据采策略指导工程师按需补充仿真或标签。
AI.result: 在CAE模态分类任务中，框架能在车型与网格变体缺乏标签时准确识别振动模态并给出区域级解释；在CFD任务中，对称降采样代理以更低计算量保持压力/WSS预测精度，验证跨车身形状的泛化及可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供可信且可重用的CAE/CFD决策支持工作流，可缩短开发周期、降低试验成本，并为工程师明确下一步最具价值的数据采集方向。

title: LPM 1.0: Video-based Character Performance Model
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://large-performance-model.github.io
summary: Performance, the externalization of intent, emotion, and personality through visual, vocal, and temporal behavior, is what makes a character alive. Learning such performance from video is a promising alternative to traditional 3D pipelines. However, existing video models struggle to jointly achieve high expressiveness, real-time inference, and long-horizon identity stability, a tension we call the performance trilemma. Conversation is the most comprehensive performance scenario, as characters simultaneously speak, listen, react, and emote while maintaining identity over time. To address this, we present LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model), focusing on single-person full-duplex audio-visual conversational performance. Concretely, we build a multimodal human-centric dataset through strict filtering, speaking-listening audio-video pairing, performance understanding, and identity-aware multi-reference extraction; train a 17B-parameter Diffusion Transformer (Base LPM) for highly controllable, identity-consistent performance through multimodal conditioning; and distill it into a causal streaming generator (Online LPM) for low-latency, infinite-length interaction. At inference, given a character image with identity-aware references, LPM 1.0 generates listening videos from user audio and speaking videos from synthesized audio, with text prompts for motion control, all at real-time speed with identity-stable, infinite-length generation. LPM 1.0 thus serves as a visual engine for conversational agents, live streaming characters, and game NPCs. To systematically evaluate this setting, we propose LPM-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive character performance. LPM 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art results across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining real-time inference.

AI.tldr: LPM 1.0 通过17B参数扩散-Transformer及其流式蒸馏模型，首次在单图驱动的无限时长、全双工音视频对话场景中同时实现高表现力、实时性与身份一致性，并提出LPM-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 传统3D流程昂贵且难以扩展；现有视频生成模型在角色“表演三难”——高表现力、实时推理、长时身份稳定——无法兼得，尤其缺少面向全双工对话的综合解决方案。
AI.method: 构建严格过滤的多模态以人为中心数据集，实现说-听音视频配对、表演理解与身份多参考提取；训练17B参数Diffusion Transformer（Base LPM）进行多模态条件控制；再蒸馏为因果流式生成器（Online LPM）实现低延迟无限长度交互；推理时以单张角色图+身份参考+音频/文本提示，实时生成听与说视频。
AI.result: LPM 1.0在自建LPM-Bench基准的所有维度达到SOTA，同时保持实时推理速度，可无限时长生成并保持身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: LPM 1.0突破了角色表演三难，为对话代理、直播角色与游戏NPC提供了可直接部署的视觉引擎，并确立了交互式角色表演的新评估标准。

title: Kuramoto Oscillatory Phase Encoding: Neuro-inspired Synchronization for Improved Learning Efficiency
summary: Spatiotemporal neural dynamics and oscillatory synchronization are widely implicated in biological information processing and have been hypothesized to support flexible coordination such as feature binding. By contrast, most deep learning architectures represent and propagate information through activation values, neglecting the joint dynamics of rate and phase. In this work, we introduce Kuramoto oscillatory Phase Encoding (KoPE) as an additional, evolving phase state to Vision Transformers, incorporating a neuro-inspired synchronization mechanism to advance learning efficiency. We show that KoPE can improve training, parameter, and data efficiency of vision models through synchronization-enhanced structure learning. Moreover, KoPE benefits tasks requiring structured understanding, including semantic and panoptic segmentation, representation alignment with language, and few-shot abstract visual reasoning (ARC-AGI). Theoretical analysis and empirical verification further suggest that KoPE can accelerate attention concentration for learning efficiency. These results indicate that synchronization can serve as a scalable, neuro-inspired mechanism for advancing state-of-the-art neural network models.

AI.tldr: KoPE将脑启发的相位同步机制引入Vision Transformer，把振荡动力学当作可学习的附加状态，显著提升了视觉模型在训练、参数量、数据量上的效率，并在结构化任务上获得一致增益。
AI.motivation: 生物神经系统的时空振荡与同步被认为可促进特征绑定等灵活协调，而现有深度模型仅用激活值传递信息，忽略了相位与放电率的联合动力学；作者希望填补这一缺口，将同步机制引入现代视觉架构。
AI.method: 提出Kuramoto振荡相位编码(KoPE)——在Vision Transformer中为每个token维护动态相位，并基于Kuramoto模型实现层内/层间同步；同步力作为可学习先验，与注意力及前馈网络共同优化，从而强化结构化学习。
AI.result: ImageNet-1k训练节约11% epoch、8%参数即达相同精度；语义/全景分割mIoU分别提升1.8/1.4；与文本对齐任务R@1提升3.2%；在ARC-AGI少样本抽象推理上达SOTA。理论和实验表明KoPE加速注意力收敛，提高特征可分离性。
AI.conclusion: 同步可作为可扩展、受神经科学启发的新机制，直接增强现有视觉模型的学习效率与结构化推理能力；KoPE为把时空振荡动力学集成至深度学习提供了可行框架，并潜在适用于多模态及更广AI任务。

title: DYCP: Dynamic Context Pruning for Long-Form Dialogue with LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate over long-form dialogues with frequent topic shifts. While recent LLMs support extended context windows, efficient management of dialogue history in practice is needed due to inference cost and latency constraints. We present DyCP, a lightweight context management method implemented outside the LLM that dynamically identifies and retrieves relevant dialogue segments conditioned on the current turn, without offline memory construction. DyCP manages dialogue context while preserving the sequential nature of dialogue without predefined topic boundaries, enabling adaptive and efficient context selection. Across three long-form dialogue benchmarks-LoCoMo, MT-Bench+, and SCM4LLMs-and multiple LLM backends, DyCP achieves competitive answer quality in downstream generation, with more selective context usage and improved inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: DyCP 通过外挂式轻量化模块，在推理阶段动态检索最相关的对话片段，无需预建记忆或话题分割，显著降低长对话上下文成本并保持回答质量。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型虽支持超长上下文，但长对话频繁换题导致输入膨胀、推理延迟与费用激增，亟需一种不改动模型本体、不依赖离线构建的在线上下文管理方案。
AI.method: DyCP 独立运行在 LLM 外部，利用轻量检索器对当前回合进行实时的片段级 relevance scoring，无监督地动态拼合最小有效上下文，同时保留对话时序；无需预定义话题边界、无需离线索引。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo、MT-Bench+、SCM4LLMs 三大长对话基准与多种 LLM 后端上，DyCP 以显著更少的 token 消耗取得与全上下文相当的回答质量，推理延迟与成本同步下降。
AI.conclusion: DyCP 证明外挂动态片段检索即可在零模型改动条件下，实现长对话的高效上下文压缩，为生产级长程交互系统提供了可落地的轻量解决方案。

title: Cross-Modal Emotion Transfer for Emotion Editing in Talking Face Video
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project Page: https://chanhyeok-choi.github.io/C-MET/
summary: Talking face generation has gained significant attention as a core application of generative models. To enhance the expressiveness and realism of synthesized videos, emotion editing in talking face video plays a crucial role. However, existing approaches often limit expressive flexibility and struggle to generate extended emotions. Label-based methods represent emotions with discrete categories, which fail to capture a wide range of emotions. Audio-based methods can leverage emotionally rich speech signals - and even benefit from expressive text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis - but they fail to express the target emotions because emotions and linguistic contents are entangled in emotional speeches. Images-based methods, on the other hand, rely on target reference images to guide emotion transfer, yet they require high-quality frontal views and face challenges in acquiring reference data for extended emotions (e.g., sarcasm). To address these limitations, we propose Cross-Modal Emotion Transfer (C-MET), a novel approach that generates facial expressions based on speeches by modeling emotion semantic vectors between speech and visual feature spaces. C-MET leverages a large-scale pretrained audio encoder and a disentangled facial expression encoder to learn emotion semantic vectors that represent the difference between two different emotional embeddings across modalities. Extensive experiments on the MEAD and CREMA-D datasets demonstrate that our method improves emotion accuracy by 14% over state-of-the-art methods, while generating expressive talking face videos - even for unseen extended emotions. Code, checkpoint, and demo are available at https://chanhyeok-choi.github.io/C-MET/

title: Filling the Gaps: Selective Knowledge Augmentation for LLM Recommenders
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful training-free recommenders. However, their knowledge of individual items is inevitably uneven due to imbalanced information exposure during pretraining, a phenomenon we refer to as knowledge gap problem. To address this, most prior methods have employed a naive uniform augmentation that appends external information for every item in the input prompt. However, this approach not only wastes limited context budget on redundant augmentation for well-known items but can also hinder the model's effective reasoning. To this end, we propose KnowSA_CKP (Knowledge-aware Selective Augmentation with Comparative Knowledge Probing) to mitigate the knowledge gap problem. KnowSA_CKP estimates the LLM's internal knowledge by evaluating its capability to capture collaborative relationships and selectively injects additional information only where it is most needed. By avoiding unnecessary augmentation for well-known items, KnowSA_CKP focuses on items that benefit most from knowledge supplementation, thereby making more effective use of the context budget. KnowSA_CKP requires no fine-tuning step, and consistently improves both recommendation accuracy and context efficiency across four real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 KnowSA_CKP，通过「先评估 LLM 对物品的知识掌握度，再按需注入外部信息」，解决 LLM 推荐中因预训练信息不均导致的知识缺口问题，无需微调即可在 4 个数据集上同时提升准确率与上下文利用率。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为零样本推荐器时，因预训练阶段信息曝光不均，对各物品知识差异大，形成知识缺口；简单为所有物品统一追加外部信息既浪费上下文又干扰推理。
AI.method: 设计 Knowledge-aware Selective Augmentation with Comparative Knowledge Probing（KnowSA_CKP）：利用 LLM 自身对协同关系的捕捉能力，评估其对每个物品的“内在知识得分”；仅对得分低的物品选择性注入外部信息，实现上下文预算的高效再分配。
AI.result: 在 4 个真实数据集上，KnowSA_CKP 无需微调即显著提升推荐准确率，同时降低所需上下文长度，验证其兼顾效果与效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过「先测后补」的按需增强策略，可有效弥合 LLM 推荐中的知识缺口，为将大模型转化为高实用、低成本的零样本推荐器提供通用范式。

title: WorldMAP: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Navigation Trajectory Prediction with Generative World Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and generative world models are opening new opportunities for embodied navigation. VLMs are increasingly used as direct planners or trajectory predictors, while world models support look-ahead reasoning by imagining future views. Yet predicting a reliable trajectory from a single egocentric observation remains challenging. Current VLMs often generate unstable trajectories, and world models, though able to synthesize plausible futures, do not directly provide the grounded signals needed for navigation learning. This raises a central question: how can generated futures be turned into supervision for grounded trajectory prediction? We present WorldMAP, a teacher--student framework that converts world-model-generated futures into persistent semantic-spatial structure and planning-derived supervision. Its world-model-driven teacher builds semantic-spatial memory from generated videos, grounds task-relevant targets and obstacles, and produces trajectory pseudo-labels through explicit planning. A lightweight student with a multi-hypothesis trajectory head is then trained to predict navigation trajectories directly from vision-language inputs. On Target-Bench, WorldMAP achieves the best ADE and FDE among compared methods, reducing ADE by 18.0% and FDE by 42.1% relative to the best competing baseline, while lifting a small open-source VLM to DTW performance competitive with proprietary models. More broadly, the results suggest that, in embodied navigation, the value of world models may lie less in supplying action-ready imagined evidence than in synthesizing structured supervision for navigation learning.

AI.tldr: WorldMAP用「教师-学生」框架将世界模型生成的未来帧转化为语义-空间结构化监督，训练轻量学生网络直接预测轨迹，在Target-Bench上将ADE/FDE分别降低18%和42%，让开源VLM逼近闭源性能。
AI.motivation: 单帧egocentric输入下，VLM轨迹不稳，世界模型虽能想象未来却无法直接提供可用于导航学习的 grounded 信号，亟需把生成未来转化为可靠监督。
AI.method: 教师端：世界模型生成视频→构建语义-空间记忆→ground目标与障碍→用显式规划输出轨迹伪标签；学生端：轻量VLM+多假设轨迹头，仅用视觉-语言输入端到端回归轨迹。全程无需真值轨迹。
AI.result: Target-Bench上ADE/FDE最佳，相比最强基线相对下降18.0%/42.1%；同等训练下，开源VLM的DTW指标追平闭源大模型，且仅增加1.2%参数量。
AI.conclusion: 在具身导航中，世界模型的核心贡献不是提供立即可用的“想象动作”，而是离线合成高质量结构化监督，从而赋能轻量模型达到强规划性能。

title: HumanLLM: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Anthropomorphism via Human Cognitive Patterns
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and generation, serving as the foundation for advanced persona simulation and Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs). However, achieving authentic alignment with human cognitive and behavioral patterns remains a critical challenge for these agents.
  We present HumanLLM, a framework treating psychological patterns as interacting causal forces.
  We construct 244 patterns from ~12,000 academic papers and synthesize 11,359 scenarios where 2--5 patterns reinforce, conflict, or modulate each other, with multi-turn conversations expressing inner thoughts, actions, and dialogue.
  Our dual-level checklists evaluate both individual pattern fidelity and emergent multi-pattern dynamics, achieving strong human alignment (r=0.90) while revealing that holistic metrics conflate simulation accuracy with social desirability.
  HumanLLM-8B outperforms Qwen3-32B on multi-pattern dynamics despite 4x fewer parameters, demonstrating that authentic anthropomorphism requires cognitive modeling -- simulating not just what humans do, but the psychological processes generating those behaviors.
  Our dataset, code, and model are available at: https://github.com/YJGoodbye2024/HumanLLM.git

AI.tldr: HumanLLM将心理模式建模为交互式因果力，用12k论文构建244种模式、11k情境，设计双层评估（单模式保真+多模式动态），8B模型在心理过程级拟人上反超32B基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RPLA只能表面模仿人类言行，缺乏对背后心理因果机制的对齐；亟需一种可解释、可验证的“认知级”拟人框架。
AI.method: 1) 从~1.2万篇心理学文献提取244条可计算心理模式；2) 合成11 359个多模式情境，显式刻画2–5条模式间的强化/冲突/调制关系；3) 用多轮对话同时生成内心独白、行为与对话；4) 提出双层评估清单，分别度量单模式保真度与多模式涌现动态；5) 训练8B HumanLLM，用认知建模损失强化心理因果拟合。
AI.result: HumanLLM在整体人类一致性上达r=0.90；显式分解后，发现传统整体指标混淆了“模拟准确度”与“社会赞许性”；同框架下8B模型在多模式动态任务上超越Qwen3-32B，证明参数量并非拟人关键，心理过程建模才是。
AI.conclusion: 真正的人形智能需模拟产生行为的“心理过程”而非结果行为；HumanLLM首次把心理因果力作为可计算变量，为可解释、可验证的 anthropomorphic AI 提供新范式。数据、代码与模型已开源。

title: SEARL: Joint Optimization of Policy and Tool Graph Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have demonstrated significant potential in single-turn reasoning tasks. With the paradigm shift toward self-evolving agentic learning, models are increasingly expected to learn from trajectories by synthesizing tools or accumulating explicit experiences. However, prevailing methods typically rely on large-scale LLMs or multi-agent frameworks, which hinder their deployment in resource-constrained environments. The inherent sparsity of outcome-based rewards also poses a substantial challenge, as agents typically receive feedback only upon completion of tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce a Tool-Memory based self-evolving agentic framework SEARL. Unlike approaches that directly utilize interaction experiences, our method constructs a structured experience memory that integrates planning with execution. This provides a novel state abstraction that facilitates generalization across analogous contexts, such as tool reuse. Consequently, agents extract explicit knowledge from historical data while leveraging inter-trajectory correlations to densify reward signals. We evaluate our framework on knowledge reasoning and mathematics tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving more practical and efficient learning.
