title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
summary: With the rise of LLMs, there is an increasing need for intelligent recommendation assistants that can handle complex queries and provide personalized, reasoning-driven recommendations. LLM-based recommenders show potential but face challenges in multi-step reasoning, underscoring the need for reasoning-augmented systems. To address this gap, we propose ReRec, a novel reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) framework designed to improve LLM reasoning in complex recommendation tasks. Our framework introduces three key components: (1) Dual-Graph Enhanced Reward Shaping, integrating recommendation metrics like NDCG@K with Query Alignment and Preference Alignment Scores to provide fine-grained reward signals for LLM optimization; (2) Reasoning-aware Advantage Estimation, which decomposes LLM outputs into reasoning segments and penalizes incorrect steps to enhance reasoning of recommendation; and (3) Online Curriculum Scheduler, dynamically assess query difficulty and organize training curriculum to ensure stable learning during RFT. Experiments demonstrate that ReRec outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and preserves core abilities like instruction-following and general knowledge. Our codes are available at https://github.com/jiani-huang/ReRec.

AI.tldr: 论文提出强化微调框架 ReRec，通过双图奖励塑造、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度，显著提升大模型在复杂推荐任务中的多步推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 推荐器虽前景广阔，但在多步推理场景下表现不足，亟需推理增强方案以应对复杂查询与个性化推荐需求。
AI.method: 设计 ReRec 框架：① 双图增强奖励塑形，融合 NDCG@K、查询对齐与偏好对齐分数，提供细粒度奖励；② 推理感知优势估计，将输出拆分为推理段并对错误步骤施加惩罚；③ 在线课程调度器，动态评估查询难度并安排训练课程，保障强化微调稳定性。
AI.result: 实验表明，ReRec 在复杂推荐任务上超越现有最佳基线，同时保持指令遵循与通用知识等核心能力。
AI.conclusion: ReRec 通过强化微调有效增强 LLM 的多步推理推荐性能，为构建智能推荐助手提供了可行路径。

title: PASK: Toward Intent-Aware Proactive Agents with Long-Term Memory
summary: Proactivity is a core expectation for AGI. Prior work remains largely confined to laboratory settings, leaving a clear gap in real-world proactive agent: depth, complexity, ambiguity, precision and real-time constraints. We study this setting, where useful intervention requires inferring latent needs from ongoing context and grounding actions in evolving user memory under latency and long-horizon constraints. We first propose DD-MM-PAS (Demand Detection, Memory Modeling, Proactive Agent System) as a general paradigm for streaming proactive AI agent. We instantiate this paradigm in Pask, with streaming IntentFlow model for DD, a hybrid memory (workspace, user, global) for long-term MM, PAS infra framework and introduce how these components form a closed loop. We also introduce LatentNeeds-Bench, a real-world benchmark built from user-consented data and refined through thousands of rounds of human editing. Experiments show that IntentFlow matches leading Gemini3-Flash models under latency constraints, while identifying deeper user intent.

AI.tldr: 首次提出流式主动智能体范式DD-MM-PAS及其实现Pask，在真实场景中实现低延迟、长程深度需求推理，并开源LatentNeeds-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有主动智能体研究局限于实验室，无法应对真实世界中的深度、复杂、模糊、实时约束，亟需填补“真实场景主动智能体”空白。
AI.method: 构建DD-MM-PAS范式：流式Demand Detection(IntentFlow)、混合长程Memory Modeling(工作区+用户+全局)、闭环PAS基础设施；实现系统Pask；建立经千轮人工精标的真实数据基准LatentNeeds-Bench。
AI.result: IntentFlow在同等延迟下性能媲美Gemini3-Flash，同时发现更深层的潜在需求；整套系统在真实数据上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: DD-MM-PAS范式与Pask系统首次将主动智能体推向真实世界，兼顾实时与深度推理，为AGI级主动能力提供可扩展框架与评测基准。

title: Testimole-Conversational: A 30-Billion-Word Italian Discussion Board Corpus (1996-2024) for Language Modeling and Sociolinguistic Research
summary: We present "Testimole-conversational" a massive collection of discussion boards messages in the Italian language. The large size of the corpus, more than 30B word-tokens (1996-2024), renders it an ideal dataset for native Italian Large Language Models'pre-training. Furthermore, discussion boards' messages are a relevant resource for linguistic as well as sociological analysis. The corpus captures a rich variety of computer-mediated communication, offering insights into informal written Italian, discourse dynamics, and online social interaction in wide time span. Beyond its relevance for NLP applications such as language modelling, domain adaptation, and conversational analysis, it also support investigations of language variation and social phenomena in digital communication. The resource will be made freely available to the research community.

AI.tldr: 作者发布了一个名为 Testimole-conversational 的意大利语讨论板语料库，含 30B token（1996–2024），面向意大利语大模型预训练与社会语言学研究，并将免费开放。
AI.motivation: 现有意大利语大规模口语化、历时性文本稀缺，限制了对本土 LLM 的训练以及对网络语言演变、社会互动模式的系统研究。
AI.method: 收集 28 年来意大利主流讨论板的公开帖子，经去敏、去重、语言识别与清洗后，统一为纯文本格式并划分时间窗口。
AI.result: 得到 30B 词级 token、覆盖 1996–2024 年的口语化意大利语文本，呈现词汇、句法与话题的历时变化，并保留互动结构（引用、用户 ID、时间戳）。
AI.conclusion: Testimole-conversational 为迄今最大的意大利语口语化历时语料库，可显著提升意大利语 LLM 预训练效果，并为数字语言变异、社会互动与网络文化研究提供新数据。

title: Order-Optimal Sequential 1-Bit Mean Estimation in General Tail Regimes
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2509.21940
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of mean estimation under strict 1-bit communication constraints. We propose a novel adaptive mean estimator based solely on randomized threshold queries, where each 1-bit outcome indicates whether a given sample exceeds a sequentially chosen threshold. Our estimator is $(ε, δ)$-PAC for any distribution with a bounded mean $μ\in [-λ, λ]$ and a bounded $k$-th central moment $\mathbb{E}[|X-μ|^k] \le σ^k$ for any fixed $k > 1$. Crucially, our sample complexity is order-optimal in all such tail regimes, i.e., for every such $k$ value. For $k \neq 2$, our estimator's sample complexity matches the unquantized minimax lower bounds plus an unavoidable $O(\log(λ/σ))$ localization cost. For the finite-variance case ($k=2$), our estimator's sample complexity has an extra multiplicative $O(\log(σ/ε))$ penalty, and we establish a novel information-theoretic lower bound showing that this penalty is a fundamental limit of 1-bit quantization. We also establish a significant adaptivity gap: for both threshold queries and more general interval queries, the sample complexity of any non-adaptive estimator must scale linearly with the search space parameter $λ/σ$, rendering it vastly less sample efficient than our adaptive approach. Finally, we present algorithmic variants that (i) handle an unknown sampling budget, (ii) adapt to an unknown scale parameter~$σ$ given (possibly loose) bounds, and (iii) require only two stages of adaptivity at the expense of more complicated general 1-bit queries.

AI.tldr: 本文在1比特通信约束下给出首个阶最优的均值估计算法，证明k≠2时复杂度同无量化下界+O(log(λ/σ))；k=2时多付O(log(σ/ε))因子且该代价不可消除；同时揭示非自适应方法必须线性依赖λ/σ，与自适应方案形成指数级差距。
AI.motivation: 分布式/边缘场景下带宽极度受限，仅允许1比特传输。现有1比特均值估计结果在样本复杂度上与无通信约束极小化下界存在显著差距，且未系统刻画不同矩条件下究竟需要多少样本；此外，非自适应策略是否也能达到同样效率尚属未知。
AI.method: 核心思想是“随机阈值+自适应逐次二分定位”。每轮依当前置信区间随机生成阈值θ，询问样本是否>X，用1比特回答更新μ的置信分布。算法动态收缩搜索区间，无需事先知道σ，并可配合未知采样预算的停时机制。为处理k=2情形，额外引入对数尺度迭代精化。下界证明引入“1比特消隐”新型信息论框架，将量化误差转化为互信息损失，证明任何1比特估计器在方差设定下必付log(σ/ε)代价。
AI.result: 1. 对任意k>1矩有界分布，提出(ε,δ)-PAC估计器，样本复杂度m_k=Θ(σ^k/ε^k·log(1/δ))+O(log(λ/σ))，达到阶最优。2. k=2时复杂度为Θ(σ²/ε²·log(1/δ)·log(σ/ε))，并匹配信息论下界，表明log(σ/ε)为1比特本质代价。3. 证明非自适应阈值/区间查询的复杂度下界为Ω(λ/σ·σ^k/ε^k)，与自适应相比多乘λ/σ，呈指数级差异。4. 给出三版实用变体：预算未知版、σ未知版、两阶段自适应版，均保持阶最优且易实现。
AI.conclusion: 在1比特通信极限下，自适应随机阈值查询首次实现了与无通信约束仅差微小定位/量化代价的均值估计，彻底刻画了不同矩条件下的样本复杂度全貌；k=2时发现的log(σ/ε)惩罚被证明不可避免，为后续研究划定理论极限；非自适应策略在相同设定下效率崩溃，进一步凸显“自适应+量化”在稀少带宽环境中的唯一实用价值。

title: QaRL: Rollout-Aligned Quantization-Aware RL for Fast and Stable Training under Training--Inference Mismatch
summary: Large language model (LLM) reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines are often bottlenecked by rollout generation, making end-to-end training slow. Recent work mitigates this by running rollouts with quantization to accelerate decoding, which is the most expensive stage of the RL loop. However, these setups destabilize optimization by amplifying the training-inference gap: rollouts are operated at low precision, while learning updates are computed at full precision. To address this challenge, we propose QaRL (Rollout Alignment Quantization-Aware RL), which aligns training-side forward with the quantized rollout to minimize mismatch. We further identify a failure mode in quantized rollouts: long-form responses tend to produce repetitive, garbled tokens (error tokens). To mitigate these problems, we introduce TBPO (Trust-Band Policy Optimization), a sequence-level objective with dual clipping for negative samples, aimed at keeping updates within the trust region. On Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE for math problems, QaRL outperforms quantized-rollout training by +5.5 while improving stability and preserving low-bit throughput benefits.

title: Open-Ended Instruction Realization with LLM-Enabled Multi-Planner Scheduling in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Most Human-Machine Interaction (HMI) research overlooks the maneuvering needs of passengers in autonomous driving (AD). Natural language offers an intuitive interface, yet translating passenger open-ended instructions into control signals, without sacrificing interpretability and traceability, remains a challenge. This study proposes an instruction-realization framework that leverages a large language model (LLM) to interpret instructions, generates executable scripts that schedule multiple model predictive control (MPC)-based motion planners based on real-time feedback, and converts planned trajectories into control signals. This scheduling-centric design decouples semantic reasoning from vehicle control at different timescales, establishing a transparent, traceable decision-making chain from high-level instructions to low-level actions. Due to the absence of high-fidelity evaluation tools, this study introduces a benchmark for open-ended instruction realization in a closed-loop setting. Comprehensive experiments reveal that the framework significantly improves task-completion rates over instruction-realization baselines, reduces LLM query costs, achieves safety and compliance on par with specialized AD approaches, and exhibits considerable tolerance to LLM inference latency. For more qualitative illustrations and a clearer understanding.
