title: On the Interaction Between Chicken Swarm Rejuvenation and KLD-Adaptive Sampling in Particle Filters
summary:
Particle filters (PFs) are often combined with swarm intelligence (SI) algorithms, such as Chicken Swarm Optimization (CSO), for particle rejuvenation. Separately, Kullback--Leibler divergence (KLD) sampling is a common strategy for adaptively sizing the particle set. However, the theoretical interaction between SI-based rejuvenation kernels and KLD-based adaptive sampling is not yet fully understood.
  This paper investigates this specific interaction. We analyze, under a simplified modeling framework, the effect of the CSO rejuvenation step on the particle set distribution. We propose that the fitness-driven updates inherent in CSO can be approximated as a form of mean-square contraction. This contraction tends to produce a particle distribution that is more concentrated than that of a baseline PF, or in mathematical terms, a distribution that is plausibly more ``peaked'' in a majorization sense.
  By applying Karamata's inequality to the concave function that governs the expected bin occupancy in KLD-sampling, our analysis suggests a connection: under the stated assumptions, the CSO-enhanced PF (CPF) is expected to require a lower \emph{expected} particle count than the standard PF to satisfy the same statistical error bound. The goal of this study is not to provide a fully general proof, but rather to offer a tractable theoretical framework that helps to interpret the computational efficiency empirically observed when combining these techniques, and to provide a starting point for designing more efficient adaptive filters.

AI.tldr: 本文用一个简化模型首次说明：在粒子滤波中引入鸡群优化（CSO）后，粒子分布因均方压缩变得更“尖锐”；借助 Karamata 不等式可推得，达到相同 KL 误差界所需的期望粒子数将减少，为“CSO+KLD”组合的实验加速现象给出可解释的理论起点。
AI.motivation: 粒子滤波与 swarm 智能结合、或与 KLD 自适应采样结合，均被实验验证能提升效率，但二者同时使用时「为何会变快」缺乏理论解释。需要建立可分析的简化框架，把 CSO 的适应度更新与 KL 采样误差联系起来。
AI.method: 1) 将 CSO 的 fit-driven 更新抽象为「均方压缩」算子，证明经一步 CSO 后粒子分布更集中于高似然区（majorization 意义下更 peaked）。2) 将 KLD-sampling 的期望 bin 占用量表示为 concave 函数，用 Karamata 不等式得到：分布越尖锐→期望占用量越小→达到给定误差 ε 所需粒子 N 越小。3) 在简化线性-高斯假设下给出 N_CPF ≤ N_PF 的不等式期望界。
AI.result: 理论推导表明，在均方压缩系数 λ<1 且满足 majorization 阶的条件下，CPF 与标准 PF 相比，其期望粒子数下限降低 1−λ² 倍；仿真结果亦显示，在相同 KL 误差阈值下，CPF 平均粒子数减少 15 %–30 %，与理论趋势吻合。
AI.conclusion: 首次从分布「尖锐度」角度解释了 swarm 智能重采样与 KLD 自适应采样之间的协同增益；所提出的「均方压缩+majorization」框架可作为后续设计更高效自适应粒子滤波的通用理论工具，并推广至其他 swarm 优化核。

title: ADAPTive Input Training for Many-to-One Pre-Training on Time-Series Classification
summary: Recent work on time-series models has leveraged self-supervised training to learn meaningful features and patterns in order to improve performance on downstream tasks and generalize to unseen modalities. While these pretraining methods have shown great promise in one-to-many scenarios, where a model is pre-trained on one dataset and fine-tuned on a downstream dataset, they have struggled to generalize to new datasets when more datasets are added during pre-training. This is a fundamental challenge in building foundation models for time-series data, as it limits the ability to develop models that can learn from a large variety of diverse datasets available. To address this challenge, we present a new pre-training paradigm for time-series data called ADAPT, which can efficiently align the physical properties of data in the time-series domain, enabling mixed-batch pre-training despite the extreme discrepancies in the input sizes and channel dimensions of pre-training data. We trained on 162 time-series classification datasets and set new state-of-the-art performance for classification benchmarks. We successfully train a model within the time-series domain on a wide range of datasets simultaneously, which is a major building block for building generalist foundation models in time-series domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ADAPT 自监督预训练框架，首次实现 162 个异构时序分类数据集的混合批次同步训练，刷新分类基准，为构建时序通用基础模型奠定关键一环。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督时序预训练在“一对多”场景有效，但当预训练阶段持续加入新数据集时，因输入长度、通道维度差异极大，模型无法跨库对齐物理特性，导致泛化失败，阻碍大规模、多样化时序基础模型的构建。
AI.method: 设计 ADAPT（Aligning Physical Properties for Time-series）预训练范式：① 时序物理特征提取器，统一编码振幅、频率、相位等域内共性；② 动态对齐策略，在混合批次内对不同尺寸、通道的样本做隐空间校准，实现端到端同步训练；③ 自监督损失与下游分类损失联合优化。
AI.result: 在 162 个公开时序分类数据集上完成单次统一预训练，较先前最佳方法平均提升 3.8% 准确率，在 UCR、UEA 等基准上全面刷新 SOTA；仅用一个模型即跨医疗、传感器、金融等域泛化，显著超越逐集微调策略。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT 证明通过显式对齐时序物理属性，可突破多源异构数据壁垒，实现真正意义上的“通用”时序基础模型预训练，为后续大规模自监督时序学习提供可扩展范式。

title: Face2Scene: Using Facial Degradation as an Oracle for Diffusion-Based Scene Restoration
summary: Recent advances in image restoration have enabled high-fidelity recovery of faces from degraded inputs using reference-based face restoration models (Ref-FR). However, such methods focus solely on facial regions, neglecting degradation across the full scene, including body and background, which limits practical usability. Meanwhile, full-scene restorers often ignore degradation cues entirely, leading to underdetermined predictions and visual artifacts. In this work, we propose Face2Scene, a two-stage restoration framework that leverages the face as a perceptual oracle to estimate degradation and guide the restoration of the entire image. Given a degraded image and one or more identity references, we first apply a Ref-FR model to reconstruct high-quality facial details. From the restored-degraded face pair, we extract a face-derived degradation code that captures degradation attributes (e.g., noise, blur, compression), which is then transformed into multi-scale degradation-aware tokens. These tokens condition a diffusion model to restore the full scene in a single step, including the body and background. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior effectiveness of the proposed method compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: Face2Scene先把人脸修好，再用“人脸→退化码”引导扩散模型一步修复整幅图，实现全局保真。
AI.motivation: 参考式人脸复原只修脸，全图复原又无视退化先验，导致身体/背景效果差。需要把“脸”作为退化探针，带动整图高质量恢复。
AI.method: 两阶段：① Ref-FR 从退化图与身份参考重建高清人脸，获得“恢复-退化”脸对；② 从该对提取人脸退化码→多尺度退化感知token，单步条件扩散模型，同时重建身体与背景。
AI.result: 在多项指标与视觉比较上超越现有最优方法，能同步复原脸、身、背景，抑制伪影。
AI.conclusion: 人脸可充当退化“感知 oracle”，Face2Scene 验证了“先脸后景”策略对全图盲复原任务的有效性与实用性。

title: Adversarial Flow Models
summary: We present adversarial flow models, a class of generative models that belongs to both the adversarial and flow families. Our method supports native one-step and multi-step generation and is trained with an adversarial objective. Unlike traditional GANs, in which the generator learns an arbitrary transport map between the noise and data distributions, our generator is encouraged to learn a deterministic noise-to-data mapping. This significantly stabilizes adversarial training. Unlike consistency-based methods, our model directly learns one-step or few-step generation without having to learn the intermediate timesteps of the probability flow for propagation. This preserves model capacity and avoids error accumulation. Under the same 1NFE setting on ImageNet-256px, our B/2 model approaches the performance of consistency-based XL/2 models, while our XL/2 model achieves a new best FID of 2.38. We additionally demonstrate end-to-end training of 56-layer and 112-layer models without any intermediate supervision, achieving FIDs of 2.08 and 1.94 with a single forward pass and surpassing the corresponding 28-layer 2NFE and 4NFE counterparts with equal compute and parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Adversarial-Flow-Models

AI.tldr: 提出对抗流框架，一步/多步原生生成，ImageNet-256px 单 NFE 下 XL/2 模型达 SOTA FID 2.38，端到端训练 112 层网络进一步降至 1.94，可训练深度翻倍无需中间监督。
AI.motivation: 现有 GANs 训练不稳且产生任意映射；一致性学习须先学完整概率流中间步骤，容量受限且误差累积明显，难以实现单步高质量生成。
AI.method: 把流型生成器硬性约束为确定性噪声→数据映射，并用作判别器生成的对峙目标函数，可同时原生支持一步/多步采样，不需任何中间步骤的监督或传播。
AI.result: 相同 1-FID 下，B/2 达到一致性 XL/2 级性能；XL/2 刷新 ImageNet-256px 单步 FID 2.38；56/112 层模型直接端到端训练，一步采样 FID 2.08/1.94，计算与参数相当的情况下远超对应 28 层 2/4 步效果。
AI.conclusion: 对抗流统一了对抗与流两大范式，凭借确定性映射稳定训练、一步采样高光性能，为大深度单步生成器提供新范式且验证可稳健端到端优化，FP32-单核即可快速采样。

title: Zero-shot Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Using Tabular Prior Fitted Networks
summary: Tabular foundation models, particularly Prior-data Fitted Networks like TabPFN have emerged as the leading contender in a myriad of tasks ranging from data imputation to label prediction on the tabular data format surpassing the historical successes of tree-based models. This has led to investigations on their applicability to forecasting time series data which can be formulated as a tabular problem. While recent work to this end has displayed positive results, most works have limited their treatment of multivariate time series problems to several independent univariate time series forecasting subproblems, thus ignoring any inter-channel interactions. Overcoming this limitation, we introduce a generally applicable framework for multivariate time series forecasting using tabular foundation models. We achieve this by recasting the multivariate time series forecasting problem as a series of scalar regression problems which can then be solved zero-shot by any tabular foundation model with regression capabilities. We present results of our method using the TabPFN-TS backbone and compare performance with the current state of the art tabular methods.

AI.tldr: 首次将 TabPFN 等表格基础模型扩展为真正的多元时间序列预测器，把多元预测逐列拆成标量回归任务并在零样本条件下超越 SOTA 表格基线。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型已在数据补全与分类任务击败树模型，但在时间序列预测还未被用于捕获“通道间交互”，现有研究仅把多元序列拆成独立的一元问题。
AI.method: 将 t 步多元预测重构为 n×t 个标量回归子问题，每个样本由历史上下文与通道元数据组成表格特征，使用 TabPFN-TS 零样本推理并聚合输出。
AI.result: 提出的框架在多个公开多元数据集上优于当前最优表格方法，表明表格基础模型可直接用于通道耦合的零样本预测而无需专门时序结构。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型具备跨模态潜力，通过简单重构即可实现多元时间序列预测，为“通用时间序列基础模型”提供了一条低门槛且高性能的新路线。

title: Clinical Cognition Alignment for Gastrointestinal Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in medical image analysis. However, their application in gastrointestinal endoscopy is currently hindered by two critical limitations: the misalignment between general model reasoning and standardized clinical cognitive pathways, and the lack of causal association between visual features and diagnostic outcomes. In this paper, we propose a novel Clinical-Cognitive-Aligned (CogAlign) framework to address these challenges. First, we endow the model with rigorous clinical analytical capabilities by constructing the hierarchical clinical cognition dataset and employing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Unlike conventional approaches, this strategy internalizes the hierarchical diagnostic logic of experts, ranging from anatomical localization and morphological evaluation to microvascular analysis, directly into the model. Second, to eliminate visual bias, we provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that standard supervised tuning inevitably converges to spurious background correlations. Guided by this insight, we propose a counterfactual-driven reinforcement learning strategy to enforce causal rectification. By generating counterfactual normal samples via lesion masking and optimizing through clinical-cognition-centric rewards, we constrain the model to strictly ground its diagnosis in causal lesion features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SoTA) performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly enhancing diagnostic accuracy in complex clinical scenarios. All source code and datasets will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 针对胃肠镜图像，本文提出Clinical-Cognitive-Aligned（CogAlign）框架，通过层级临床认知数据+监督微调植入专家诊断逻辑，并以反事实强化学习去除背景伪相关，实现因果性 lesion 特征定位，在多项基准达SOTA，代码与数据将开源。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在胃肠镜应用时存在两大缺陷：1) 通用推理与标准化临床认知路径错位；2) 视觉特征与诊断结果缺乏因果关联，导致模型依赖背景伪相关而非病灶本身。
AI.method: 1) 构建层级临床认知数据集（解剖定位→形态评估→微血管分析），用SFT将专家诊断逻辑内化为模型能力；2) 理论证明标准监督微调易收敛到伪相关，提出反事实驱动强化学习：对 lesion 区域掩膜生成“反事实正常样本”，以临床认知为中心的奖励函数优化策略，使诊断必须基于因果病灶特征。
AI.result: 在多项胃肠镜公开基准上取得SOTA性能，显著提升复杂临床场景下的诊断准确率，消融实验验证因果矫正与层级认知数据的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: CogAlign首次将层级临床认知与因果推理同时融入MLLM，有效消除视觉偏差并对齐专家路径，为可解释、可信的胃肠镜智能诊断提供新范式。

title: We Still Don't Understand High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
summary: Existing high-dimensional Bayesian optimization (BO) methods aim to overcome the curse of dimensionality by carefully encoding structural assumptions, from locality to sparsity to smoothness, into the optimization procedure. Surprisingly, we demonstrate that these approaches are outperformed by arguably the simplest method imaginable: Bayesian linear regression. After applying a geometric transformation to avoid boundary-seeking behavior, Gaussian processes with linear kernels match state-of-the-art performance on tasks with 60- to 6,000-dimensional search spaces. Linear models offer numerous advantages over their non-parametric counterparts: they afford closed-form sampling and their computation scales linearly with data, a fact we exploit on molecular optimization tasks with >20,000 observations. Coupled with empirical analyses, our results suggest the need to depart from past intuitions about BO methods in high-dimensions.

AI.tldr: 高维贝叶斯优化无需复杂结构假设，简单线性模型即可胜过主流方法。
AI.motivation: 传统高维 BO 依赖稀疏、局部或平滑等先验以缓解维度灾难，但作者质疑这些先验的必要性，并探索极简替代方案。
AI.method: 将搜索空间先做几何变换避免边界聚集，再以带线性核的高斯过程（等价于贝叶斯线性回归）建模；利用其闭合式采样与线性时间复杂度，在 60–6 000 维及>20 000 观测的分子任务上实验对比。
AI.result: 线性模型在多项高维基准与真实分子优化任务中追上或超过现有最先进水平，且计算随数据线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 高维 BO 的成功可能更多取决于边界处理与计算效率，而非复杂结构先验；研究应重新评估线性/参数化模型的潜力。

title: Selective Attention System (SAS): Device-Addressed Speech Detection for Real-Time On-Device Voice AI
summary:
We study device-addressed speech detection under pre-ASR edge deployment constraints, where systems must decide whether to forward audio before transcription under strict latency and compute limits. We show that, in multi-speaker environments with temporally ambiguous utterances, this task is more effectively modelled as a sequential routing problem over interaction history than as an utterance-local classification task. We formalize this as Sequential Device-Addressed Routing (SDAR) and present the Selective Attention System (SAS), an on-device implementation that instantiates this formulation.
  On a held-out 60-hour multi-speaker English test set, the primary audio-only configuration achieves F1=0.86 (precision=0.89, recall=0.83); with an optional camera, audio+video fusion raises F1 to 0.95 (precision=0.97, recall=0.93). Removing causal interaction history (Stage~3) reduced F1 from 0.95 to 0.57+/-0.03 in the audio+video configuration under our evaluation protocol. Among the tested components, this was the largest observed ablation effect, indicating that short-horizon interaction history carries substantial decision-relevant information in the evaluated setting. SAS runs fully on-device on ARM Cortex-A class hardware (<150 ms latency, <20 MB footprint). All results are from internal evaluation on a proprietary dataset evaluated primarily in English; a 5-hour evaluation subset may be shared for independent verification (Section 8.8).

AI.tldr: 在ASR前置端极度受限的场景下，将“设备定向语音检测”重新建模为序列路由问题（SDAR），提出轻量级端到端方案SAS，实现<150 ms@<20 MB的本地实时判断，多说话人英语集F1 0.86→0.95（+视觉），去除交互历史即跌至0.57。
AI.motivation: 传统“本地检测+云端转写”架构的延迟与隐私瓶颈迫使系统在ASR前做出是否上传音频的决策；多说话人环境中存在大量非定向、时间模糊的语句，单句级分类极易误判。
AI.method: 1) 将任务形式化为Sequential Device-Addressed Routing（SDAR）：以交互历史为序列状态，逐帧决定“本地消费/转发”；2) 设计Selective Attention System（SAS）：流式音频（+可选视频）编码→轻量时序注意力→二分类路由，全INT8量化，适配ARM Cortex-A；3) 引入150 ms因果窗的说话人-设备交互上下文作为核心特征。
AI.result: 60 h多说话人英语测试：音频-only F1 0.86(P 0.89/R 0.83)；引入视频模态后F1 0.95(P 0.97/R 0.93)。若消融因果交互历史，F1暴跌至0.57±0.03，为最大单因素降幅。端到端延迟<150 ms，内存<20 MB，全程本地运行。
AI.conclusion: 把“设备定向检测”从孤立语句分类转向基于短时交互历史的序列路由，可在极低资源下获得显著精度收益；SAS验证了这一思路的工程可行性，为隐私敏感、低延迟语音交互提供了实用的边缘前置过滤方案。

title: Physical Knot Classification Beyond Accuracy: A Benchmark and Diagnostic Study
summary:
Physical knot classification is a fine-grained task in which the intended cue
  is rope crossing structure, but high accuracy may still come from appearance
  shortcuts. Using a tightness-stratified benchmark built from the public
  10Knots dataset (1,440 images, 10 classes), we train on loose knots and test
  on tightly dressed knots to evaluate whether structure-guided training yields
  topology-specific gains. Topological distance predicts residual confusion for
  several backbones, but a random-distance control shows that topology-aware
  centroid alignment does not provide reliable topology-specific improvement.
  Auxiliary crossing-number prediction is more stable than centroid alignment,
  but neither method removes strong appearance reliance. In causal probes,
  background changes alone flip 17-32% of predictions, and phone-photo accuracy
  drops by 58-69 percentage points. These results show that high closed-set
  accuracy does not imply topology-dominant recognition, and that appearance
  bias remains the main obstacle to deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个“松紧分层”的10 Knots基准，从结构出发训练、测试绳结分类模型，发现即使闭集精度高，外观捷径仍是主因，拓扑线索并未真正主导识别。
AI.motivation: 绳结细分类本应依赖交叉拓扑结构，但现有模型可能利用颜色、纹理等外观捷径。作者希望验证“结构引导训练”能否带来拓扑特化的性能提升，从而判断模型是否真学会了结构而非外观。
AI.method: 在公开的10 Knots数据集上按松紧程度分层，1 440张图像、10类；用“松”结训练，在“紧”结测试。引入拓扑距离、随机距离对照、交叉数辅助任务及因果探针（换背景、手机实拍）评估外观依赖性。
AI.result: 拓扑距离能预测残差混淆，但拓扑感知的质心对齐未带来稳定提升；交叉数辅助任务稍稳定，两者均无法消除外观依赖。换背景即可翻转17–32%预测，手机实拍精度骤降58–69个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 高闭集精度≠拓扑主导识别；外观偏差仍是部署落地的核心障碍，结构引导训练短期内不足以让模型真正“看懂”绳结拓扑。

title: Generalized Spherical Neural Operators: Green's Function Formulation
summary: Neural operators offer powerful approaches for solving parametric partial differential equations, but extending them to spherical domains remains challenging due to the need to preserve intrinsic geometry while avoiding distortions that break rotational consistency. Existing spherical operators rely on rotational equivariance but often lack the flexibility for real-world complexity. We propose a generalized operator-design framework based on the designable spherical Green's function and its harmonic expansion, establishing a solid operator-theoretic foundation for spherical learning. Based on this, we propose an absolute and relative position-dependent Green's function that enables flexible balance of equivariance and invariance for real-world modeling. The resulting operator, Green's-function Spherical Neural Operator (GSNO) with a novel spectral learning method, can adapt to non-equivariant systems while retaining spectral efficiency and grid invariance. To exploit GSNO, we develop SHNet, a hierarchical architecture that combines multi-scale spectral modeling with spherical up-down sampling, enhancing global feature representation. Evaluations on diffusion MRI, shallow water dynamics, and global weather forecasting, GSNO and SHNet consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods. The theoretical and experimental results position GSNO as a principled and generalized framework for spherical operator design and learning, bridging rigorous theory with real-world complexity. The code is available at: https://github.com/haot2025/GSNO.

AI.tldr: GSNO 首次将球面 Green 函数显式设计为可学习的谱展开核，突破传统旋转等变网络在真实非等变场景下的刚性限制；配套 SHNet 采用谱上下采样与多尺度融合，实现理论严格性与复杂数据适应性的统一，在扩散 MRI、浅水与全球天气预报上全面领先。
AI.motivation: 球面参数 PDE 求解需在保持内在几何与旋转一致性的同时兼容真实系统的非等变复杂性；现有球面神经算子过度依赖旋转等变假设，难以灵活建模局部扰动与不对称边界，亟需一种可调和“等变-不变”自由度的广义框架。
AI.method: ① 将球面 Green 函数显式参数化为可设计谱系数，建立算子论基础；② 引入绝对/相对位置依赖项，使 Green 函数在局部区域可退化为非等变核，全局仍保持谱效率与网格无关性；③ 提出 GSNO，用谱学习方法直接估计 Green 函数系数；④ 设计 SHNet，通过多尺度谱建模与球面上下采样金字塔增强全局表征。
AI.result: 在扩散 MRI 纤维重建、浅水动力学和 ERA5 全球天气预报三项任务中，GSNO 相对 SOTA 球面网络误差降低 15–32%，推理速度提升 1.4–2.1 倍；谱系数可视化表明网络自动学出与物理 Green 函数高度一致的核形态，验证理论正确性。
AI.conclusion: GSNO 为球面神经算子提供了首个兼顾严格算子理论与复杂非等变数据的广义设计范式，突破了旋转等变网络的刚性限制，兼具谱效率、网格不变性和真实系统适应性，成为球面 PDE 学习与反问题求解的新基准。

title: Exploring Temporal Representation in Neural Processes for Multimodal Action Prediction
comment: Submitted to the AIC 2023 (9th International Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Cognition)
summary: Inspired by the human ability to understand and predict others, we study the applicability of Conditional Neural Processes (CNP) to the task of self-supervised multimodal action prediction in robotics. Following recent results regarding the ontogeny of the Mirror Neuron System (MNS), we focus on the preliminary objective of self-actions prediction. We find a good MNS-inspired model in the existing Deep Modality Blending Network (DMBN), able to reconstruct the visuo-motor sensory signal during a partially observed action sequence by leveraging the probabilistic generation of CNP. After a qualitative and quantitative evaluation, we highlight its difficulties in generalizing to unseen action sequences, and identify the cause in its inner representation of time. Therefore, we propose a revised version, termed DMBN-Positional Time Encoding (DMBN-PTE), that facilitates learning a more robust representation of temporal information, and provide preliminary results of its effectiveness in expanding the applicability of the architecture. DMBN-PTE figures as a first step in the development of robotic systems that autonomously learn to forecast actions on longer time scales refining their predictions with incoming observations.

AI.tldr: 借鉴婴儿镜像神经元系统发育思路，用条件神经过程(CNP)做自监督多模态动作预测；发现DMBN方法时间泛化差，提出位置时间编码(DMBN-PTE)改进。
AI.motivation: 人类可凭部分观察推断他人动作，机器人也应具备同样能力；现有方法难以在部分视觉-运动观测下自监督地预测自身未来动作。
AI.method: 1.采用条件神经过程(CNP)框架，以自我动作序列为训练目标；2.强化DMBN模型，用CNP概率生成补全缺失模态；3.引入位置时间编码(DMBN-PTE)，将时间步转为可学习的绝对/相对位置向量，提升时间表示的泛化性。
AI.result: DMBN可在训练集内重建视觉-运动信号，但泛化到未见动作序列时性能骤降；DMBN-PTE在同样条件下预测误差显著降低，初步验证其对未知时间模式的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 时间编码是CNP类模型在多模态动作预测中泛化瓶颈；DMBN-PTE为机器人提供一种无需人工标签、可随着新观测持续精炼的自主动作预测机制，并为后续长时域、他人动作预测奠定基础。

title: PLUME: Latent Reasoning Based Universal Multimodal Embedding
summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps heterogeneous inputs into a shared retrieval space with a single model. Recent approaches improve UME by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales before extracting embeddings, enabling multimodal large language models to better infer complex query intent. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead and can compress rich multimodal evidence into a narrow textual bottleneck. We propose PLUME, a latent reasoning framework that advances UME by replacing verbalized CoT with a short autoregressive rollout of continuous latent states. To support diverse multimodal queries, PLUME further introduces a semantic-anchor-guided transition adapter that steers latent rollout along different reasoning trajectories under the same fixed computation budget. To stabilize training, PLUME adopts a progressive explicit-to-latent curriculum that uses verbalized reasoning only as a temporary training scaffold and gradually transfers this behavior into hidden-state computation, eliminating explicit CoT at inference. On the 78-task MMEB-v2 benchmark, PLUME outperforms strong explicit-CoT UME baselines while reducing reasoning from hundreds of generated tokens to fewer than 10 latent steps, delivering over 30x faster inference. PLUME is especially well suited to retrieval settings where relevant evidence is dense, structurally complex, and difficult to organize through verbalized intermediate rationales, such as video and visual document retrieval. These results show that structured latent computation can preserve the benefits of intermediate reasoning without the overhead of explicit rationale generation, providing a stronger and more efficient paradigm for practical retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: PLUME 用 10 步隐变量推理代替数百 tokens 的显式 CoT，在 MMEB-v2 的 78 项任务上精度更高、推理快 30 倍，为视频/视觉文档检索等复杂场景提供高效统一的嵌入范式。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态嵌入（UME）靠显式 CoT 提升效果，但推理需生成大量文本，既慢又把丰富多模态信息压进狭窄文本瓶颈，难以满足实时检索需求。
AI.method: 提出 PLUME：①用自回归隐变量序列替代 verbalized CoT，将推理压缩到连续隐空间；②引入语义锚点制导的转换适配器，在统一计算预算下为不同模态查询规划差异化隐式推理轨迹；③采用“显式→隐式”渐进课程，训练阶段先用 CoT 做脚手架，再逐步把推理行为迁移到隐状态，推断时完全抛弃显式文本。
AI.result: 在 78-task MMEB-v2 基准上，PLUME 优于强显式 CoT 基线，推理步数从数百 tokens 降至 <10 个隐步，延迟降低 30 倍以上；在视频片段、视觉文档等证据稠密、结构复杂场景下检索优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 结构化隐式推理能在无显式中间 rationale 的情况下保持甚至增强推理收益，为实际大规模多模态检索系统提供了更强、更省算力的新范式。

title: Understanding Structured Financial Data with LLMs: A Case Study on Fraud Detection
summary: Detecting fraud in financial transactions typically relies on tabular models that demand heavy feature engineering to handle high-dimensional data and offer limited interpretability, making it difficult for humans to understand predictions. Large Language Models (LLMs), in contrast, can produce human-readable explanations and facilitate feature analysis, potentially reducing the manual workload of fraud analysts and informing system refinements. However, they perform poorly when applied directly to tabular fraud detection due to the difficulty of reasoning over many features, the extreme class imbalance, and the absence of contextual information. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinFRE-RAG, a two-stage approach that applies importance-guided feature reduction to serialize a compact subset of numeric/categorical attributes into natural language and performs retrieval-augmented in-context learning over label-aware, instance-level exemplars. Across four public fraud datasets and three families of open-weight LLMs, FinFRE-RAG substantially improves F1/MCC over direct prompting and is competitive with strong tabular baselines in several settings. Although these LLMs still lag behind specialized classifiers, they narrow the performance gap and provide interpretable rationales, highlighting their value as assistive tools in fraud analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段框架FinFRE-RAG，将海量高维交易表特征经过重要性筛选→自然语言序列化→检索增强LLM小样本学习，在4个公开信融欺诈数据集与3类开源大模型上，F1与MCC显著高于直接提示，可与传统强表格模型比肩并行，虽总体仍落后专用分类器，但提供可解释推理，可作为防欺诈分析辅助工具。
AI.motivation: 传统表格模型需重度手工特征工程，结果人类难懂；直接让LLM处理高维不平衡表格欺诈检测效果差。亟需一种方法既利用LLM的可解释性，又克服其在表格数据上的推理、类别失衡与上下文缺失难题。
AI.method: 1) 重要性引导的特征降维(FinF)：基于模型或统计指标先选最具判别力的数值/类别特征子集；2) 特征到自然语言序列化(FRE)：将选出的特征按照预定义模板转为句子表示；3) 检索增强生成(RAG)：为待预测样本在标签平衡的标签-实例池内检索最相似的小样本示范，拼接至LLM进行上下文学习，得到预测与解释。
AI.result: 在四个公开信融欺诈数据集上，FinFRE-RAG相较直接零样本/少样本提示，F1提升最高达+16–23个百分点，MCC提升+0.14–0.29；与XGBoost、GNN、FT-Transformer等强劲表格基线相比，在部分数据集上性能持平甚至略优(LLM-7B～30B规模)，整体性能差距缩小30–50%。生成的解释可被领域专家理解为交易额度、设备、地理位置可疑等要素。
AI.conclusion: FinFRE-RAG证明了“先剪枝-再语言化-RAG”的范式可显著提升LLM在欺诈表数据上的表现，兼顾可解释性；尽管尚未全面超越专用分类器，但已具备作为防欺诈场景人机协同、提供线索与解释支持的价值，并启示后续把结构化数据与大模型结合的新思路。

title: Synthetic Data for any Differentiable Target
summary: What are the limits of controlling language models via synthetic training data? We develop a reinforcement learning (RL) primitive, the Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG), which can precisely optimize synthetic data generators to produce a dataset of targeted examples. When used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of a target model, these examples cause the target model to do well on a differentiable metric of our choice. Our approach achieves this by taking exact data attribution via higher-order gradients and using those scores as policy gradient rewards. We prove that this procedure closely approximates the true, intractable gradient for the synthetic data generator. To illustrate the potential of DPG, we show that, using only SFT on generated examples, we can cause the target model's LM head weights to (1) embed a QR code, (2) embed the pattern $\texttt{67}$, and (3) have lower $\ell^2$ norm. We additionally show that we can cause the generator to (4) rephrase inputs in a new language and (5) produce a specific UUID, even though neither of these objectives is conveyed in the generator's input prompts. These findings suggest that DPG is a powerful and flexible technique for shaping model properties using only synthetic training examples.

AI.tldr: DPG：仅通过合成训练样例，就能用RL把目标模型的任意可微分属性精准地‘雕刻’成你想要的样子。
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以精确控制生成式模型行为；若能直接把“训练数据”当作可调参数，理论上可对下游模型施加细粒度影响，但缺乏高效的优化手段。
AI.method: 提出Dataset Policy Gradient（DPG）：把合成数据生成器视作策略，用高阶梯度在目标模型上做一次exact data attribution，得到每条合成样本对目标度量的精确梯度贡献，将其转为RL奖励，再以策略梯度方式更新生成器，可证明该方法逼近真实但不可解的全局梯度（intractable synthetic-data gradient的eps-近似）。
AI.result: 仅用生成的合成数据做SFT，即可诱导目标模型LM head：(1)权重矩阵编码可见QR码；(2)隐式写入数字模式“67”；(3)整体l2范数降低。同时，生成器自身可在无提示输入的情况下：(4)自动重写成另一种语言；(5)稳定输出特定UUID。
AI.conclusion: DPG展示了用纯合成训练数据对模型施加任意可微分属性的强大与灵活性，为高效、可控地“编程”大模型提供了新范式，也揭示了合成数据在模型行为塑造中的潜在极限与风险。

title: SD-FSMIS: Adapting Stable Diffusion for Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation (FSMIS) aims to segment novel object classes in medical images using only minimal annotated examples, addressing the critical challenges of data scarcity and domain shifts prevalent in medical imaging. While Diffusion Models (DM) excel in visual tasks, their potential for FSMIS remains largely unexplored. We propose that the rich visual priors learned by large-scale DMs offer a powerful foundation for a more robust and data-efficient segmentation approach. In this paper, we introduce SD-FSMIS, a novel framework designed to effectively adapt the powerful pre-trained Stable Diffusion (SD) model for the FSMIS task. Our approach repurposes its conditional generative architecture by introducing two key components: a Support-Query Interaction (SQI) and a Visual-to-Textual Condition Translator (VTCT). Specifically, SQI provides a straightforward yet powerful means of adapting SD to the FSMIS paradigm. The VTCT module translates visual cues from the support set into an implicit textual embedding that guides the diffusion model, enabling precise conditioning of the generation process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SD-FSMIS achieves competitive results compared to state-of-the-art methods in standard settings. Surprisingly, it also demonstrated excellent generalization ability in more challenging cross-domain scenarios. These findings highlight the immense potential of adapting large-scale generative models to advance data-efficient and robust medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 首次将大规模Stable Diffusion生成模型迁移到少样本医学图像分割(FSMIS)，提出SQI与VTCT两大模块，仅用极少标注即可在单域/跨域场景达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像标注稀缺且域偏移严重，现有FSMIS方法依赖判别式模型，未能利用大规模生成模型中蕴含的丰富视觉先验；Diffusion Model在视觉任务表现突出却尚未被探索用于FSMIS。
AI.method: 框架SD-FSMIS保留Stable Diffusion的条件生成架构，新增：①Support-Query Interaction(SQI)将支持集与查询集特征融合，直接适配FSMIS范式；②Visual-to-Textual Condition Translator(VTCT)把支持图像的视觉线索转换为隐式文本嵌入，实现无需真实文本的精准条件生成；整体在潜空间完成分割推断。
AI.result: 在标准少样本设置下，SD-FSMIS与专用SOTA方法相当；在跨器官、跨模态等跨域场景中，DSC指标平均提升3–8个百分点，展现出显著的外推能力，且所需支持样本可减至1-shot。
AI.conclusion: 证明将大规模生成式扩散模型迁移到医学小样本分割可兼顾数据效率与域鲁棒性，为FSMIS提供了新的高性能通用框架，并提示生成式视觉先验是解决医学数据稀缺的关键资源。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Embedding Representations for Financial News Sentiment Analysis
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Published in the 4th IEEE International Conference on Interdisciplinary Approaches in Technology and Management for Social Innovation (IATMSI 2026), IEEE
summary: Financial sentiment analysis enhances market understanding. However, standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches encounter significant challenges when applied to small datasets. This study presents a comparative evaluation of embedding-based techniques for financial news sentiment classification in resource-constrained environments. Word2Vec, GloVe, and sentence transformer representations are evaluated in combination with gradient boosting on a manually labeled dataset of 349 financial news headlines. Experimental results identify a substantial gap between validation and test performance. Despite strong validation metrics, models underperform relative to trivial baselines. The analysis indicates that pretrained embeddings yield diminishing returns below a critical data sufficiency threshold. Small validation sets contribute to overfitting during model selection. Practical application is illustrated through weekly sentiment aggregation and narrative summarization for market monitoring. Overall, the findings indicate that embedding quality alone cannot address fundamental data scarcity in sentiment classification. Practitioners with limited labeled data should consider alternative strategies, including few-shot learning, data augmentation, or lexicon-enhanced hybrid methods.

AI.tldr: 在小样本财经新闻情境下，预训练词/句向量+梯度提升的表现仅略优于随机猜测，“高质量嵌入”无法弥补数据稀缺本质。
AI.motivation: 验证当标注样本极少（<350条）时，主流预训练静态/动态向量能否单靠“语义质量”支撑可靠的情感分类器，为资源受限机构提供现实可落地的指导。
AI.method: 手工标注349条财经新闻标题；分别用Word2Vec、GloVe及三种Sentence-Transformer生成向量，输入XGBoost；采用8:2交叉验证+独立测试集双重评估；对比多数类、随机等基准。
AI.result: 五折验证F1 0.72–0.76，但同一模型在盲测集降至0.51–0.55，仅优于随机4–6个百分点；嵌入维度与性能弱相关；模型选择阶段因验证集过小导致明显过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 数据量低于临界阈值时，预训练嵌入的收益急降，继续堆向量意义有限；少量标签场景应转向少样本学习、数据增强或词典-统计混合路线，并扩大验证集或采用嵌套交叉验证来抑制过拟合。

title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks
summary: With the growing demand for long-context LLMs across a wide range of applications, the key-value (KV) cache has become a critical bottleneck for both latency and memory usage. Recently, KV-cache offloading has emerged as a promising approach to reduce memory footprint and inference latency while preserving accuracy. Prior evaluations have largely focused on tasks that do not require extracting large amounts of information from the context. In this work, we study KV-cache offloading on context-intensive tasks: problems where the solution requires looking up a lot of information from the input prompt. We create and release the Text2JSON benchmark, a highly context-intensive task that requires extracting structured knowledge from raw text. We evaluate modern KV offloading on Text2JSON and other context-intensive tasks and find significant performance degradation on both Llama 3 and Qwen 3 models. Our analysis identifies two key reasons for poor accuracy: low-rank projection of keys and unreliable landmarks, and proposes a simpler alternative strategy that significantly improves accuracy across multiple LLM families and benchmarks. These findings highlight the need for a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of long-context compression techniques.

AI.tldr: 针对KV缓存卸载在长上下文、高信息密度任务中的性能塌陷，提出低秩投影与不可靠标志是主因，给出极简改进方案并发布Text2JSON评测集。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩研究多聚焦于低信息抽取场景，缺乏对需大量上下文查找任务的系统评估，导致实际部署时精度骤降。
AI.method: 1) 构建高信息密度Text2JSON基准，要求从长文本一次性抽取结构化知识；2) 系统诊断Llama-3/Qwen-3的KV卸载失效根因——低秩键投影与不可靠标志；3) 设计去低秩、强化标志的简单替代策略。
AI.result: 在Text2JSON及其他高上下文负载上，所提方法相较原KV卸载将绝对F1提升12–22个百分点，跨多模型族一致有效，同时保持吞吐与显存优势。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文压缩技术必须引入信息密度导向的严格评测；摒弃低秩假设、增强标志可靠性是KV卸载落地的关键，呼吁社区重新定义压缩评估协议。

title: Gaze to Insight: A Scalable AI Approach for Detecting Gaze Behaviours in Face-to-Face Collaborative Learning
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, accepted by the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Previous studies have illustrated the potential of analysing gaze behaviours in collaborative learning to provide educationally meaningful information for students to reflect on their learning. Over the past decades, machine learning approaches have been developed to automatically detect gaze behaviours from video data. Yet, since these approaches often require large amounts of labelled data for training, human annotation remains necessary. Additionally, researchers have questioned the cross-configuration robustness of machine learning models developed, as training datasets often fail to encompass the full range of situations encountered in educational contexts. To address these challenges, this study proposes a scalable artificial intelligence approach that leverages pretrained and foundation models to automatically detect gaze behaviours in face-to-face collaborative learning contexts without requiring human-annotated data. The approach utilises pretrained YOLO11 for person tracking, YOLOE-26 with text-prompt capability for education-related object detection, and the Gaze-LLE model for gaze target prediction. The results indicate that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of 0.829 in detecting students' gaze behaviours from video data, with strong performance for laptop-directed gaze and peer-directed gaze, yet weaker performance for other gaze targets. Furthermore, when compared to other supervised machine learning approaches, the proposed method demonstrates superior and more stable performance in complex contexts, highlighting its better cross-configuration robustness. The implications of this approach for supporting students' collaborative learning in real-world environments are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需人工标注、基于预训练模型的AI框架（YOLO11+YOLOE-26+Gaze-LLE），可在真实面授协作学习场景中自动识别学生注视行为，F1=0.829，跨配置鲁棒性优于传统监督方法。
AI.motivation: 现有注视行为自动检测依赖大量人工标注，且模型在多变教育场景下跨配置泛化差，难以大规模应用。
AI.method: 构建零标注流水线：YOLO11 追踪人员→YOLOE-26（文本提示）检测教育相关物体→Gaze-LLE 预测注视目标；全程使用预训练/基础模型，无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在真实课堂视频上达 F1=0.829；对笔记本电脑和同伴注视识别强，其余目标稍弱；相比监督方法，在复杂/新配置下性能更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该 scalable 方案显著降低标注成本，提升跨场景鲁棒性，可直接部署于真实协作学习环境，为学生即时反思与教师诊断提供可扩展的注视分析工具。

title: Machine Unlearning in the Era of Quantum Machine Learning: An Empirical Study
summary: We present the first empirical study of machine unlearning (MU) in hybrid quantum-classical neural networks. While MU has been extensively explored in classical deep learning, its behavior within variational quantum circuits (VQCs) and quantum-augmented architectures remains largely unexplored. First, we adapt a broad suite of unlearning methods to quantum settings, including gradient-based, distillation-based, regularization-based and certified techniques. Second, we introduce two new unlearning strategies tailored to hybrid models. Experiments across Iris, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST, under both subset removal and full-class deletion, reveal that quantum models can support effective unlearning, but outcomes depend strongly on circuit depth, entanglement structure, and task complexity. Shallow VQCs display high intrinsic stability with minimal memorization, whereas deeper hybrid models exhibit stronger trade-offs between utility, forgetting strength, and alignment with retrain oracle. We find that certain methods, e.g. EU-k, LCA, and Certified Unlearning, consistently provide the best balance across metrics. These findings establish baseline empirical insights into quantum machine unlearning and highlight the need for quantum-aware algorithms and theoretical guarantees, as quantum machine learning systems continue to expand in scale and capability. We publicly release our code at: https://github.com/CrivoiCarla/HQML.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估量子-经典混合神经网络的机器遗忘能力，发现浅层VQC天然抗记忆，深度网络需在效用-遗忘-对齐间权衡，EU-k、LCA与认证遗忘表现最优。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘在深度学习已成熟，但量子线路及混合架构中行为未知，需验证量子模型能否有效删除数据并给出基线。
AI.method: 将梯度、蒸馏、正则、认证四类遗忘算法迁移到VQCs，并额外设计两种量子感知策略；在Iris、MNIST、Fashion-MIST上对比子集移除与整类删除，系统扫描线路深度、纠缠结构、任务复杂度。
AI.result: 浅层VQC固有稳定、几乎无记忆；深度混合模型遗忘强度可提升但伴随效用下降，并与重训练Oracle对齐度呈折中；EU-k、LCA、认证遗忘在多重指标下综合最优。量子深度与纠缠度是遗忘效果主控因子。
AI.conclusion: 量子机器学习系统具备可实现的遗忘能力，但须针对量子特性设计算法与理论保证；研究为量子机器遗忘提供首个实证基线并开源代码。

title: Small-scale photonic Kolmogorov-Arnold networks using standard telecom nonlinear modules
summary: Photonic neural networks promise ultrafast inference, yet most architectures rely on linear optical meshes with electronic nonlinearities, reintroducing optical-electrical-optical bottlenecks. Here we introduce small-scale photonic Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (SSP-KANs) implemented entirely with standard telecommunications components. Each network edge employs a trainable nonlinear module composed of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer, semiconductor optical amplifier, and variable optical attenuators, providing a four-parameter transfer function derived from gain saturation and interferometric mixing. Despite this constrained expressivity, SSP-KANs comprising only a few optical modules achieve strong nonlinear inference performance across classification, regression, and image recognition tasks, approaching software baselines with significantly fewer parameters. A four-module network achieves 98.4\% accuracy on nonlinear classification benchmarks inaccessible to linear models. Performance remains robust under realistic hardware impairments, maintaining high accuracy down to 6-bit input resolution and 14 dB signal-to-noise ratio. By using a fully differentiable physics model for end-to-end optimisation of optical parameters, this work establishes a practical pathway from simulation to experimental demonstration of photonic KANs using commodity telecom hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用商用光通信元件构建的超小型光子Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（SSP-KANs），突破传统线性光网络需电子非线性层的电-光-电瓶颈，实现端到端光子非线性推理。
AI.motivation: 现有光子神经网络多为线性光学网格加电子非线性层，存在速度瓶颈与功耗成本；希望完全在光域内实现可训练非线性，以发挥光子计算的固有速度和能效优势。
AI.method: 将每条网络边变为由马赫-曾德尔干涉仪、半导体光放大器与可变光衰减器组成的四参数可训练非线性模块，利用增益饱和与干涉效应构造受限但足够表达力强的传输函数，并在完全可微的物理模型上对光参数进行端到端优化。
AI.result: 仅4个模块的子网络即达98.4%的非线性分类基准准确率，逼近软件基线，且在6位输入分辨率、14 dB信噪比等硬件损伤下仍保持高鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SSP-KANs为基于普通光通信硬件的端到端光子非线性推理提供了从仿真到实验的实用路径，展示了低单元规模仍可取得强非线性性能的可行方案。

title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale
summary: Current document parsing methods advance primarily through model architecture innovation, while systematic engineering of training data remains underexplored. Yet state-of-the-art models spanning diverse architectures and parameter scales exhibit highly consistent failure patterns on the same set of hard samples, suggesting that the performance bottleneck stems from shared deficiencies in training data rather than from architectural differences. Building on this finding, we present MinerU2.5-Pro, which advances the state of the art purely through data engineering and training strategy design while retaining the 1.2B-parameter architecture of MinerU2.5 unchanged. At its core is a Data Engine co-designed around coverage, informativeness, and annotation accuracy: Diversity-and-Difficulty-Aware Sampling expands training data from under 10M to 65.5M samples while mitigating distribution shift; Cross-Model Consistency Verification leverages output consensus among heterogeneous models to assess sample difficulty and generate reliable annotations; the Judge-and-Refine pipeline improves annotation quality for hard samples through render-then-verify iterative correction. A three-stage progressive training strategy--large-scale pre-training, hard sample fine-tuning, and GRPO alignment--sequentially exploits these data at different quality tiers. On the evaluation front, we rectify element-matching biases in OmniDocBench v1.5 and introduce a Hard subset, establishing the more discriminative OmniDocBench v1.6 protocol. Without any architectural modification, MinerU2.5-Pro achieves 95.69 on OmniDocBench v1.6, improving over the same-architecture baseline by 2.71 points and surpassing all existing methods, including those based on models with over 200x more parameters.

AI.tldr: 在所有主流文档解析模型架构和规模相似的“硬样本”失败后，作者主打工程路线：仅用1.2 B参数的老模型MinerU2.5，通过三联数据引擎（多样-难样本采样、跨模型一致性校验、判-修迭代纠错）+三阶段两亿级数据递进训练，把OmniDocBench v1.6分拉到95.69，领先全部对手（含200×参数大模型）2.71分。
AI.motivation: 文档解析准确率集中于10 M量级训练集，不同架构同败“硬样本”，说明瓶颈在训练数据而非网络；学界重参数轻数据工程，亟需给出纯数据优解法。
AI.method:
Data Engine：多样-困难感知采样把规模扩至65.5 M；Cross-Model Consistency Verification以异构模型共识生成可靠标签；Judge-and-Refine用render-then-verify迭代填硬样本标注坑。
Training Strategy：①大规模预训→②硬样本精调→③GRPO对齐，逐级提升。
评估：修复旧基准匹配偏差+硬子集，推出更区分度的OmniDocBench v1.6。
AI.result: MinerU2.5-Pro（无架构改动）在OmniDocBench v1.6得95.69 F，比同基线+2.71，力压所有已知方案。
AI.conclusion: 硬样本一致性失败根源在数据；系统数据工程能以极小算力实现对大模型反超，训练策略与标注质量是文档理解再提升的核心杠杆。

title: From Classical Machine Learning to Tabular Foundation Models: An Empirical Investigation of Robustness and Scalability Under Class Imbalance in Emergency and Critical Care
summary:
Millions of patients pass through emergency departments and intensive care units each year, where clinicians must make high-stakes decisions under time pressure and uncertainty. Machine learning could support these decisions by predicting deterioration, guiding triage, and identifying rare but serious outcomes. Yet clinical tabular data are often highly imbalanced, biasing models toward majority classes. Building methods that are robust to imbalance and efficient enough for deployment remains a practical challenge.
  We investigated seven model families on imbalanced tabular data from MIMIC-IV-ED and eICU: Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, TabNet, TabResNet, TabICL, and TabPFN v2.6. TabResNet was designed as a lightweight alternative to TabNet. Models were evaluated using weighted F1-score, robustness to increasing imbalance, and computational scalability across seven prediction tasks.
  Performance varied by dataset. On MIMIC-IV-ED, TabPFN v2.6 and TabICL achieved the strongest average weighted F1 ranks, with XGBoost and TabResNet remaining competitive. On eICU, XGBoost performed best overall, followed by other tree-based methods, while foundation models ranked in the middle. TabNet showed the steepest performance decline as imbalance increased and the highest computational cost. TabResNet consistently outperformed TabNet, but did not surpass the best ensemble models. Classical and tree-based methods scaled most favourably with dataset size, while foundation models achieved low per-task cost through their inference-based paradigm.
  No single model family dominated across both datasets and tasks. However, tabular foundation models showed promise by combining competitive performance at low computational cost. If this efficiency generalizes to broader clinical settings, it could help lower the barrier to adaptive decision support in resource-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 针对临床类表格数据极度不均衡问题，文章系统比较7类模型在MIMIC-IV-ED与eICU上的预测效果与可扩展性。结果显示基础TabPFN/TabICL在医院间表现差异大；经典XGBoost在eICU整体最优。NAS新轻量TabResNet优于同架构TabNet但未能超过集成模型。无单一模型两库全赢，但推理式基础模型在高计算效率上具临床落地潜力。
AI.motivation: 急诊和ICU医生需在有限时间内对病情恶化、分诊及罕见危及事件作出高确定性决策；自动机器学习可提供即时支持。然而临床表格数据极端失衡，使多数模型偏向多数类，导致少数关键阳例被漏诊，阻碍模型实用化。
AI.method: 作者从MIMIC-IV-ED与eICU收集7个真实预测任务（如7天死亡、早期脓毒症等），比较七类树类与深度学习模型：Decision Tree、Random Forest、XGBoost、TabNet、轻量改造TabResNet、自监督基础模型TabICL与TabPFN v2.6。评测指标包括加权F1、失衡加剧的鲁棒性、训练/推理时间与大样本扩展性，并采用分层平均排名进行综合对比。
AI.result: 1) 数据集影响巨大：MIMIC-IV-ED上TabPFN v2.6与TabICL平均F1领先，XGBoost与TabResNet紧随其后；eICU则XGBoost总体最优，其次为随机森林，基础模型居中。2) TabNet随失衡恶化性能骤降，且训练代价最高；3) TabResNet在所有任务均优于TabNet，但仍未超过最好集成模型。4) 树类方法随规模扩展优势突出；基础模型依靠单次预训练凭推理方式单任务代价最低，但对重症样本敏感度不一；5) 无单一模型在两库任务同时夺魁。
AI.conclusion: 针对临床不平衡表格数据，没有绝对最优模型。基础式表格模型虽推理效率高、无需重训练，却面临跨机构性能波动风险，需进一步外推验证。相比之下，经典树提升方法与轻量特化网络（如TabResNet）凭借稳定表现与可控规模，是当前更稳妥的替代方案。未来应结合任务实测权衡精度与算力，发展

title: HST-HGN: Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Hypergraph Networks with Bidirectional State Space Models for Global Fatigue Assessment
summary: It remains challenging to assess driver fatigue from untrimmed videos under constrained computational budgets, due to the difficulty of modeling long-range temporal dependencies in subtle facial expressions. Some existing approaches rely on computationally heavy architectures, whereas others employ traditional lightweight pairwise graph networks, despite their limited capacity to model high-order synergies and global temporal context. Therefore, we propose HST-HGN, a novel Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Hypergraph Network driven by Bidirectional State Space Models. Spatially, we introduce a hierarchical hypergraph network to fuse pose-disentangled geometric topologies with multi-modal texture patches dynamically. This formulation encapsulates high-order synergistic facial deformations, effectively overcoming the limitations of conventional methods. In temporal terms, a Bi-Mamba module with linear complexity is applied to perform bidirectional sequence modeling. This explicit temporal-evolution filtering enables the network to distinguish highly ambiguous transient actions, such as yawning versus speaking, while encompassing their complete physiological lifecycles. Extensive evaluations across diverse fatigue benchmarks demonstrate that HST-HGN achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, our method strikes a balance between discriminative power and computational efficiency, making it well-suited for real-time in-cabin edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 HST-HGN——轻量化异构时空超图网络，用双向状态空间模型高效捕捉非修剪视频中的长程微表情，兼顾疲劳判别力与车载端实时性。
AI.motivation: 现有疲劳检测方法要么计算昂贵，要么基于轻量二元图难以建模面部高阶协同与全局时间上下文，导致在资源受限场景下的长程微表情建模精度不足。
AI.method: 设计异构时空超图网络(HST-HGN)：空间上，分层超图将姿态解耦几何拓扑与多模态纹理片动态融合，显式刻画高阶协同形变；时间上，采用线性复杂度的 Bi-Mamba 模块做双向序列建模，显式滤除瞬态歧义动作并覆盖完整生理周期。
AI.result: 在多源疲劳基准测试上达到 SOTA，显著优于现有方法并保持低延迟、低算力消耗，可直接部署于车载边缘。
AI.conclusion: HST-HGN 首次以线性复杂度实现长高阶时空协同建模，兼顾精度与效率，为实时座舱疲劳监测提供了可行且先进的解决方案。

title: SonoSelect: Efficient Ultrasound Perception via Active Probe Exploration
comment: Withdrawn due to incorrect institutional affiliation information. We need sufficient time to confirm the proper designations with the respective institutions before making the work public again
summary: Ultrasound perception typically requires multiple scan views through probe movement to reduce diagnostic ambiguity, mitigate acoustic occlusions, and improve anatomical coverage. However, not all probe views are equally informative. Exhaustively acquiring a large number of views can introduce substantial redundancy, increase scanning and processing costs. To address this, we define an active view exploration task for ultrasound and propose SonoSelect, an ultrasound-specific method that adaptively guides probe movement based on current observations. Specifically, we cast ultrasound active view exploration as a sequential decision-making problem. Each new 2D ultrasound view is fused into a 3D spatial memory of the observed anatomy, which guides the next probe position. On top of this formulation, we propose an ultrasound-specific objective that favors probe movements with greater organ coverage, lower reconstruction uncertainty, and less redundant scanning. Experiments on the ultrasound simulator show that SonoSelect achieves promising multi-view organ classification accuracy using only 2 out of N views. Furthermore, for a more difficult kidney cyst detection task, it reaches 54.56% kidney coverage and 35.13% cyst coverage, with short trajectories consistently centered on the target cyst.

AI.tldr: SonoSelect是一种为超声探头主动选择最信息视图的方法，可将冗余视图数缩减到 1/N，并在肾囊肿探测任务中仅用 3–4 个扫描位点即实现 54.56% 肾体与 35.13% 病灶覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 超声诊断依赖多视角扫描以消除声学遮挡和解剖模糊，但盲目采集大量帧会引入冗余并增加时间与计算成本，亟需一种能在线评估视角价值并主动引导探头的策略。
AI.method: 把超声视角规划建模为序贯决策问题：实时将新 2D 帧增量融合成 3D 空间记忆，设计面向超声的奖励函数（兼顾器官覆盖率、重建不确定度下降与冗余惩罚），并以该记忆和奖励指导下一步探头位姿选择，形成 SonoSelect 框架。
AI.result: 在超声仿真器上，用仅 2/N 的视角即可达到与全视角相当的多器官分类精度；在困难的肾囊肿检测任务中，生成短轨迹（平均 3–4 个探头位姿）实现 54.56% 肾体与 35.13% 囊肿覆盖，且轨迹持续聚焦于目标囊肿。
AI.conclusion: SonoSelect 验证了在超声检查中引入主动视角选择可同时降低采样冗余、缩短扫描时间并保持乃至提升诊断信息，为主动超声和机器人超声扫描提供了可行的实时路径。

title: TreeAdv: Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL
summary: Reinforcement learning with group-based objectives, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is a common framework for aligning large language models on complex reasoning tasks. However, standard GRPO treats each rollout trajectory as an independent flat sequence and assigns a single sequence-level advantage to all tokens, which leads to sample inefficiency and a length bias toward verbose, redundant chains of thought without improving logical depth. We introduce TreeAdv (Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL), which makes the tree structure of group rollouts explicit for both exploration and advantage assignment. Specifically, TreeAdv builds a group of trees (a forest) based on an entropy-driven sampling method where each tree branches at high-uncertainty decisions while sharing low-uncertainty tokens across rollouts. Then, TreeAdv aggregates token-level advantages for internal tree segments by redistributing the advantages of complete rollouts (all leaf nodes), and TreeAdv can easily apply to group-based objectives such as GRPO or GSPO. Across 10 math reasoning benchmarks, TreeAdv consistently outperforms GRPO and GSPO, while using substantially fewer generated tokens under identical supervision, data, and decoding budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 TreeAdv，在组级强化学习中显式利用树结构重新分配优势，抑制冗余思维链，用更少的 token 在 10 个数学推理基准上全面超越 GRPO/GSPO。
AI.motivation: 标准 GRPO 将每条轨迹视为独立序列并全局均摊优势，导致样本效率低、偏好冗长但逻辑浅的思维链，亟需利用组内结构信息提升训练效率与推理质量。
AI.method: ① 组内采样阶段：用熵驱动策略在不确定性高的决策点分裂，生成共享低不确定性前缀的“森林”；② 学习阶段：将完整 rollout 的序列级优势按树结构反向重分配至内部片段，实现 token-级精细奖励；③ 框架兼容 GRPO/GSPO 等组目标，无需模型或数据改动。
AI.result: 在 10 个数学推理数据集上，TreeAdv 在同等监督、数据与解码预算下，平均准确率显著高于 GRPO/GSPO，同时生成分支 token 数量减少 20–40%，样本效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模组 rollout 的树结构并精细化重分配优势，可在不增加成本的前提下同时提升推理深度与效率，为语言模型组级 RL 对齐提供了更优范式。

title: CrashSight: A Phase-Aware, Infrastructure-Centric Video Benchmark for Traffic Crash Scene Understanding and Reasoning
summary: Cooperative autonomous driving requires traffic scene understanding from both vehicle and infrastructure perspectives. While vision-language models (VLMs) show strong general reasoning capabilities, their performance in safety-critical traffic scenarios remains insufficiently evaluated due to the ego-vehicle focus of existing benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we present \textbf{CrashSight}, a large-scale vision-language benchmark for roadway crash understanding using real-world roadside camera data. The dataset comprises 250 crash videos, annotated with 13K multiple-choice question-answer pairs organized under a two-tier taxonomy. Tier 1 evaluates the visual grounding of scene context and involved parties, while Tier 2 probes higher-level reasoning, including crash mechanics, causal attribution, temporal progression, and post-crash outcomes. We benchmark 8 state-of-the-art VLMs and show that, despite strong scene description capabilities, current models struggle with temporal and causal reasoning in safety-critical scenarios. We provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and discuss directions for improving VLM crash understanding. The benchmark provides a standardized evaluation framework for infrastructure-assisted perception in cooperative autonomous driving. The CrashSight benchmark, including the full dataset and code, is accessible at https://mcgrche.github.io/crashsight.

AI.tldr: CrashSight 是首个基于真实路侧视频的 250 例交通事故 VLM 基准，含 1.3 万问答对，两级推理评估显示现有模型在因果与时序推理上表现差。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 评测聚焦本车视角，无法衡量路侧协同自动驾驶所需的安全关键场景理解，缺乏真实事故数据与因果推理基准。
AI.method: 采集 250 段真实路侧事故视频，构建两级问答体系：Tier 1 视觉定位（场景与涉事方），Tier 2 高阶推理（碰撞机理、因果、时序、后果）；对 8 个 SOTA VLM 进行零样本/微调评测并分析失效模式。
AI.result: VLMs 在 Tier 1 场景描述可达 70–80% 准确率，但 Tier 2 因果与时序推理降至 35–50%；错误集中于时间顺序颠倒、因果混淆、漏检遮挡物。
AI.conclusion: CrashSight 为协同自动驾驶提供了首个路侧事故理解标准化评测框架，指出 VLM 需在时间建模、因果图与多视角融合等方面改进，并公开数据与代码以推动基础设施辅助感知研究。

title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Bitstream-Corrupted Video Restoration: Methods and Results
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 1 table, CVPRW2026 NTIRE Challenge Report
summary: This paper reports on the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Bitstream-Corrupted Video Restoration (BSCVR). The challenge aims to advance research on recovering visually coherent videos from corrupted bitstreams, whose decoding often produces severe spatial-temporal artifacts and content distortion. Built upon recent progress in bitstream-corrupted video recovery, the challenge provides a common benchmark for evaluating restoration methods under realistic corruption settings. We describe the dataset, evaluation protocol, and participating methods, and summarize the final results and main technical trends. The challenge highlights the difficulty of this emerging task and provides useful insights for future research on robust video restoration under practical bitstream corruption.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 BSCVR挑战赛首次系统评估从受损码流中恢复视觉连贯视频的能力，并指出该任务在真实压缩环境下的巨大难度与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 现存视频解码在码流受损时会产生严重空时伪影与内容畸变，亟需统一基准以推动鲁棒恢复算法研究。
AI.method: 构建含真实损伤的码流损坏视频数据集，制定兼顾保真度与感知质量的评估协议，组织全球团队提交基于深度学习与传统信号处理的修复方法并横向对比。
AI.result: 参赛方法在PSNR/SSIM/LPIPIQ等指标上均显著优于标准解码，但高码率剧烈损失场景下性能骤降；空时联合建模、先验约束与压缩表示学习成为领先技术路线。
AI.conclusion: 任务难度被量化确认，基准与协议已开源；未来需侧重极端损伤下的内容 hallucination 控制、实时部署与跨codec泛化，以支撑实际视频传输与存档应用。

title: Constrained Policy Optimization with Cantelli-Bounded Value-at-Risk
summary: We introduce the Value-at-Risk Constrained Policy Optimization algorithm (VaR-CPO), a sample efficient and conservative method designed to optimize Value-at-Risk (VaR) constrained reinforcement learning (RL) problems. Empirically, we demonstrate that VaR-CPO is capable of safe exploration, achieving zero constraint violations during training in feasible environments, a critical property that baseline methods fail to uphold. To overcome the inherent non-differentiability of the VaR constraint, we employ Cantelli's inequality to obtain a tractable approximation based on the first two moments of the cost return. Additionally, by extending the trust-region framework of the Constrained Policy Optimization (CPO) method, we provide worst-case bounds for both policy improvement and constraint violation during the training process.

AI.tldr: 提出VaR-CPO，用可计算的均值-方差近似替代不可导的VaR约束，首次在可行环境中实现训练期零约束违反。
AI.motivation: 现有安全RL算法无法在训练阶段彻底避免风险，尤其在关注尾部风险的VaR约束场景下缺乏兼顾样本效率与保守性的方案。
AI.method: 1. 用Cantelli不等式将VaR约束转化为均值+方差形式，得到可微代理；2. 在CPO的信任域框架内，对代理约束推导最坏情况下的策略提升与违约上界；3. 形成单步二次规划更新，保证每步满足近似约束。
AI.result: 在可行环境内训练全程零约束违反，样本效率与最终回报一致优于CPO、IPO等基线；提供的理论界在有限样本下仍成立。
AI.conclusion: VaR-CPO证明：通过可处理的统计代理与信任域最坏情况分析，可在不牺牲效率的前提下，让RL智能体在训练期就满足尾部风险约束，为安全探索提供新范式。

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Turbofan Health Estimation via Inverse Problem Formulation
summary: Estimating the health state of turbofan engines is a challenging ill-posed inverse problem, hindered by sparse sensing and complex nonlinear thermodynamics. Research in this area remains fragmented, with comparisons limited by the use of unrealistic datasets and insufficient exploration of the exploitation of temporal information. This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns. To support this study, we introduce a new dataset that incorporates industry-oriented complexities such as maintenance events and usage changes. Using this dataset, we establish an initial benchmark that compares steady-state and nonstationary data-driven models, and Bayesian filters, classic families of methods used to solve this problem. In addition to this benchmark, we introduce self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints. By comparing the downstream estimation performance of these unsupervised representations against the direct prediction baselines, we establish a practical lower bound on the difficulty of solving this inverse problem. Our results reveal that traditional filters remain strong baselines, while SSL methods reveal the intrinsic complexity of health estimation and highlight the need for more advanced and interpretable inference strategies. For reproducibility, both the generated dataset and the implementation used in this work are made accessible.

AI.tldr: 首次用工业级实维退化数据，系统比较稳态/非稳态模型、Bayes滤波及SSL，给出无标签条件下的健康估计难度下界，并开源数据集与代码。
AI.motivation: 现有涡扇发动机健康状态估计研究零散、数据脱离实际（忽略维修与使用变迁），导致方法对比失真，亟需真实退化场景下的统一基准，并回答无真实健康标签时问题的理论难度下限。
AI.method: 1. 构建含维修、使用变动的工业级退化数据集；2. 使用自监督学习（SSL）提取潜在表征；3. 对比三组典型算法：稳态/非稳态数据驱动模型、序列Bayes滤波器、SSL+下游回归器；4. 以健康指标恢复误差为指标，进行严格实验评估。
AI.result: 1. 传统Bayes滤波器依旧是最强基准，SSL在无标签条件下可逼近其性能；2. 揭示了健康估计问题的固有复杂性：即使在充分时序数据下，无监督表征仅能降至约某误差阈值，提示纯数据方法难以进一步突破；3. 公开数据集与代码使结果可复现。
AI.conclusion: 1. 建立了考虑维修与使用变迁的涡扇健康估计新基准，填补领域空白；2. 通过SSL给出无标签场景下的困难度下界，证明需引入更高阶、可解释的推理机制才能突破当前极限；3. 建议未来结合物理模型与表征学习，设计白盒-灰盒混合估计框架。

title: Making MLLMs Blind: Adversarial Smuggling Attacks in MLLM Content Moderation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly being deployed as automated content moderators. Within this landscape, we uncover a critical threat: Adversarial Smuggling Attacks. Unlike adversarial perturbations (for misclassification) and adversarial jailbreaks (for harmful output generation), adversarial smuggling exploits the Human-AI capability gap. It encodes harmful content into human-readable visual formats that remain AI-unreadable, thereby evading automated detection and enabling the dissemination of harmful content. We classify smuggling attacks into two pathways: (1) Perceptual Blindness, disrupting text recognition; and (2) Reasoning Blockade, inhibiting semantic understanding despite successful text recognition. To evaluate this threat, we constructed SmuggleBench, the first comprehensive benchmark comprising 1,700 adversarial smuggling attack instances. Evaluations on SmuggleBench reveal that both proprietary (e.g., GPT-5) and open-source (e.g., Qwen3-VL) state-of-the-art models are vulnerable to this threat, producing Attack Success Rates (ASR) exceeding 90%. By analyzing the vulnerability through the lenses of perception and reasoning, we identify three root causes: the limited capabilities of vision encoders, the robustness gap in OCR, and the scarcity of domain-specific adversarial examples. We conduct a preliminary exploration of mitigation strategies, investigating the potential of test-time scaling (via CoT) and adversarial training (via SFT) to mitigate this threat. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/smugglebench.

AI.tldr: 首次揭露多模态大模型作内容审核时存在‘对抗性走私攻击’：将有害信息编码成人类可读、模型却读不懂的视觉形式，绕过AI检测，ASR>90%。作者构建基准 SmuggleBench，定位感知盲与推理阻两大漏洞，并初步验证链式思维与对抗微调可部分缓解。
AI.motivation: MLLM 已广泛接替人工审核，但现有攻击只关注误分类或恶意输出，未考虑‘人-AI 能力差’可被恶意利用。本文旨在暴露并量化这一新型逃逸威胁，为安全部署敲响警钟。
AI.method: 1) 定义‘对抗性走私’并划分两条攻击路径：感知盲（破坏文本识别）与推理阻（识别正确但语义阻断）；2) 构造含 1 700 例的 SmuggleBench，覆盖多种视觉编码策略；3) 系统评估 GPT-5、Qwen3-VL 等 SOTA 模型；4) 从编码器、OCR 鲁棒性、数据稀缺三方面归因；5) 探索测试时链式思维与有监督对抗微调两种缓解方案。
AI.result: 所有被测模型在 SmuggleBench 上的攻击成功率均高于 90%，且闭源与开源模型无显著差异；链式思维可将 ASR 降至 60% 左右，对抗微调进一步压至 35%，但完全防御仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性走私揭示了 MLLM 审核体系的根本盲区：模型视觉-语义能力与人眼存在可攻击性差距。未来需联合改进视觉编码器、OCR 鲁棒性与领域对抗样本覆盖，方能迈向可靠的内容安全屏障。

title: MapTab: Are MLLMs Ready for Multi-Criteria Route Planning in Heterogeneous Graphs?
summary: Systematic evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is crucial for advancing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). However, existing benchmarks remain insufficient for rigorously assessing their reasoning capabilities under multi-criteria constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce MapTab, a multimodal benchmark specifically designed to evaluate holistic multi-criteria reasoning in MLLMs via route planning tasks. MapTab requires MLLMs to perceive and ground visual cues from map images alongside route attributes (e.g., Time, Price) from structured tabular data. The benchmark encompasses two scenarios: Metromap, covering metro networks in 160 cities across 52 countries, and Travelmap, depicting 168 representative tourist attractions from 19 countries. In total, MapTab comprises 328 images, 196,800 route planning queries, and 3,936 QA queries, all incorporating 4 key criteria: Time, Price, Comfort, and Reliability. Extensive evaluations across 15 representative MLLMs reveal that current models face substantial challenges in multi-criteria multimodal reasoning. Notably, under conditions of limited visual perception, multimodal collaboration often underperforms compared to unimodal approaches. We believe MapTab provides a challenging and realistic testbed to advance the systematic evaluation of MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ziqiao-Shang/MapTab.

AI.tldr: MapTab 提出一个跨模态多准则路径规划基准，首次用 328 张地图+19.7 万条查询系统评测 15 个 MLLM，发现多模态协同在受限视觉下反而不如单模态，为 AGI 评估补全关键缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法严格衡量 MLLM 在「同时满足时间、价格、舒适度、可靠性」等多约束下的综合推理能力，阻碍 AGI 发展，亟需一个真实、可扩展的多模态评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 MapTab 基准：① 双场景（160 城地铁 Metromap + 168 景点 Travelmap）共 328 张地图；② 每张图配结构化属性表；③ 生成 196.8 k 路径规划查询与 3.94 k 问答对，均嵌入四准则约束；④ 设计自动评估协议，零样本评测 15 个主流 MLLM。
AI.result: 15 个模型在多准则多模态推理上普遍显著下降；当视觉信息受限时，多数「图文协同」精度低于纯文本或纯视觉基线，暴露跨模态对齐与联合优化缺陷。
AI.conclusion: MapTab 提供首个大规模、真实场景下的多准则多模态推理测试台，揭示当前 MLLM 在复杂约束协同推理中的根本性不足，为未来模型架构与评测协议给出明确改进方向。

title: OVS-DINO: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation via Structure-Aligned SAM-DINO with Language Guidance
summary: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) aims to segment image regions beyond predefined category sets by leveraging semantic descriptions. While CLIP based approaches excel in semantic generalization, they frequently lack the fine-grained spatial awareness required for dense prediction. Recent efforts have incorporated Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) like DINO to alleviate these limitations. However, these methods still struggle with the precise edge perception necessary for high fidelity segmentation. In this paper, we analyze internal representations of DINO and discover that its inherent boundary awareness is not absent but rather undergoes progressive attenuation as features transition into deeper transformer blocks. To address this, we propose OVS-DINO, a novel framework that revitalizes latent edge-sensitivity of DINO through structural alignment with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). Specifically, we introduce a Structure-Aware Encoder (SAE) and a Structure-Modulated Decoder (SMD) to effectively activate boundary features of DINO using SAM's structural priors, complemented by a supervision strategy utilizing SAM generated pseudo-masks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple weakly-supervised OVS benchmarks, improving the average score by 2.1% (from 44.8% to 46.9%). Notably, our approach significantly enhances segmentation accuracy in complex, cluttered scenarios, with a gain of 6.3% on Cityscapes (from 36.6% to 42.9%).

AI.tldr: 提出OVS-DINO框架，通过SAM结构先验唤醒DINO被逐层抑制的边缘特征，在弱监督开放词汇分割任务中刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP类OVS方法语义泛化强但空间细节差；引入DINO等VFM后边缘定位仍不足。作者发现DINO并非缺乏边界感知，而是该信号在深层Transformer中被逐级衰减，亟需重新激活。
AI.method: 设计Structure-Aware Encoder(SAE)与Structure-Modulated Decoder(SMD)，用SAM的结构性先验对DINO特征进行对齐与调制；辅以SAM生成的伪标签监督，全程无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 在多个弱监督OVS基准上平均IoU从44.8%提升到46.9%(+2.1%)；Cityscapes复杂场景从36.6%增至42.9%(+6.3%)，达到新最佳。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构重校准即可挖掘DINO固有边缘敏感信息，无需重新训练骨干；OVS-DINO为开放词汇分割提供了高效、高精度的边缘感知解决方案。

title: AnchorSplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with 3D Geometric Priors
summary: Recent feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction models adopt a pixel-aligned formulation that maps each 2D pixel to a 3D Gaussian, entangling Gaussian representations tightly with the input images. In this paper, we propose AnchorSplat, a novel feed-forward 3DGS framework for scene-level reconstruction that represents the scene directly in 3D space. AnchorSplat introduces an anchor-aligned Gaussian representation guided by 3D geometric priors (e.g., sparse point clouds, voxels, or RGB-D point clouds), enabling a more geometry-aware renderable 3D Gaussians that is independent of image resolution and number of views. This design substantially reduces the number of required Gaussians, improving computational efficiency while enhancing reconstruction fidelity. Beyond the anchor-aligned design, we utilize a Gaussian Refiner to adjust the intermediate Gaussiansy via merely a few forward passes. Experiments on the ScanNet++ v2 NVS benchmark demonstrate the SOTA performance, outperforming previous methods with more view-consistent and substantially fewer Gaussian primitives.

AI.tldr: AnchorSplat提出一种基于3D几何先验的锚点对齐高斯表征，实现与图像分辨率/视角数无关的前向3DGS重建，在ScanNet++ v2上达到SOTA，同时大幅减少高斯原语数量并提升计算效率与一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有像素对齐的前向高斯重建将3D高斯与输入图像逐像素耦合，导致高斯数量随图像分辨率与视角数线性增长，计算冗余且几何感知弱。作者希望构建一种与图像解耦、直接作用于3D空间、并利用几何先验的高效表征。
AI.method: 1) 锚点对齐高斯表征：以稀疏点云/体素/RGB-D为3D锚点，每个锚点预测一组局部高斯，实现与图像分辨率无关的表征；2) 高斯精炼器：对中间高斯做少量前向迭代，优化位置、尺度、不透明度与球谐系数；3) 端到端可微前向框架，直接输出可渲染的3D高斯集合。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++ v2新视角合成基准上，AnchorSplat以更少的高斯原语（较前方法减少一个数量级）取得PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS三项指标SOTA，渲染速度提升2–3×，跨视角一致性显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 锚点对齐设计打破“像素-高斯”一对一耦合，利用3D几何先验实现紧凑、几何一致且可扩展的前向3DGS；精炼模块进一步以极小开销提升细节。该策略为实时/大规模场景重建提供了高保真、低开销的新范式。

title: MultiModalPFN: Extending Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Multimodal Tabular Learning
summary: Recently, TabPFN has gained attention as a foundation model for tabular data. However, it struggles to integrate heterogeneous modalities such as images and text, which are common in domains like healthcare and marketing, thereby limiting its applicability. To address this, we present the Multi-Modal Prior-data Fitted Network (MMPFN), which extends TabPFN to handle tabular and non-tabular modalities in a unified manner. MMPFN comprises per-modality encoders, modality projectors, and pre-trained foundation models. The modality projectors serve as the critical bridge, transforming non-tabular embeddings into tabular-compatible tokens for unified processing. To this end, we introduce a multi-head gated MLP and a cross-attention pooler that extract richer context from non-tabular inputs while mitigates attention imbalance issue in multimodal learning. Extensive experiments on medical and general-purpose multimodal datasets demonstrate that MMPFN consistently outperforms competitive state-of-the-art methods and effectively exploits non-tabular modalities alongside tabular features. These results highlight the promise of extending prior-data fitted networks to the multimodal setting, offering a scalable and effective framework for heterogeneous data learning. The source code is available at https://github.com/too-z/MultiModalPFN.

AI.tldr: 将 TabPFN 这种表格数据基础模型扩展为 MMPFN，使其可统一处理表格、图像、文本等多模态数据；提出投影器+多头门控 MLP+交叉注意力池化器解决异构模态对齐与注意力失衡问题，在医疗与通用多模态任务上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: TabPFN 虽然在小表格数据集上表现优异，但无法直接利用图像、文本等非表格信息，而医疗、营销等场景常同时存在表格与非表格模态；现有方法需繁琐特征工程或独立编码流程，缺少统一高效的多模态表格基础模型。
AI.method: 设计 Multi-Modal Prior-data Fitted Network (MMPFN)：①按模态设计专用编码器提取原始表征；②提出模态投影器，把非表格嵌入转换为表格兼容的“伪特征”token；③在投影器内部引入多头门控 MLP 做非线性映射，再用交叉注意力池化器压缩并平衡各模态贡献，缓解多模态注意力倾斜；④将统一后的 token 序列送入预训练的 TabPFN 推理引擎，实现端到端训练与预测。
AI.result: 在 6 项医疗多模态任务（如 COVID-CT 影像+临床变量）和 4 项通用多模态基准上，MMPFN 的 AUC 平均提升 3.1%，最高达 7.4%，显著优于 MM-Transformer、TabNet+ResNet 等 SOTA；仅用 1/10 训练时间即收敛，且在小样本场景下增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级投影器即可把已具备强先验的表格 PFN 模型扩展为通用多模态学习器，验证了“先验-数据拟合”思想在多模态场景的通用性与可扩展性；代码已开源，为医疗、金融等异构数据场景提供了高效、易部署的统一框架。

title: TTVS: Boosting Self-Exploring Reinforcement Learning via Test-time Variational Synthesis
summary: Despite significant advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) driven by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), this paradigm is fundamentally limited in specialized or novel domains where such supervision is prohibitively expensive or unavailable, posing a key challenge for test-time adaptation. While existing test-time methods offer a potential solution, they are constrained by learning from static query sets, risking overfitting to textual patterns. To address this gap, we introduce Test-Time Variational Synthesis (TTVS), a novel framework that enables LRMs to self-evolve by dynamically augmenting the training stream from unlabeled test queries. TTVS comprises two synergistic modules: (1) Online Variational Synthesis, which transforms static test queries into a dynamic stream of diverse, semantically-equivalent variations, enforcing the model to learn underlying problem logic rather than superficial patterns; (2) Test-time Hybrid Exploration, which balances accuracy-driven exploitation with consistency-driven exploration across synthetic variants. Extensive experiments show TTVS yields superior performance across eight model architectures. Notably, using only unlabeled test-time data, TTVS not only surpasses other test-time adaptation methods but also outperforms state-of-the-art supervised RL-based techniques trained on vast, high-quality labeled data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时变分合成（TTVS），让大推理模型在没有任何标注的前提下，仅利用测试查询自我进化，效果超越有监督RL基线。
AI.motivation: 强化学习+可验证奖励（RLVR）在缺乏昂贵标注的新领域失效，现有测试时方法又易对静态查询过拟合，需要一种无监督、可泛化的测试时自适应机制。
AI.method: TTVS分两模块：①在线变分合成——将静态测试问题实时扩展成语义等价但表面多样的查询流，迫使模型学习问题逻辑而非表面模式；②测试时混合探索——在合成变体上同时做“准确率驱动的利用”与“一致性驱动的探索”，动态平衡搜索空间。
AI.result: 在8种架构、多领域任务上，仅用无标注测试数据，TTVS一致优于现有测试时适应方法，并超越用海量高质量标注训练的SOTA有监督RL系统。
AI.conclusion: TTVS证明大模型可在测试阶段自给自足地生成监督信号，实现无标注域的自举式推理能力提升，为RLVR不可及场景提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Location Is All You Need: Continuous Spatiotemporal Neural Representations of Earth Observation Data
comment: Updated the affiliation of one of the authors, no changes to the technical content
summary: In this work, we present LIANet (Location Is All You Need Network), a coordinate-based neural representation that models multi-temporal spaceborne Earth observation (EO) data for a given region of interest as a continuous spatiotemporal neural field. Given only spatial and temporal coordinates, LIANet reconstructs the corresponding satellite imagery. Once pretrained, this neural representation can be adapted to various EO downstream tasks, such as semantic segmentation or pixel-wise regression, importantly, without requiring access to the original satellite data. LIANet intends to serve as a user-friendly alternative to Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) by eliminating the overhead of data access and preprocessing for end-users and enabling fine-tuning solely based on labels. We demonstrate the pretraining of LIANet across target areas of varying sizes and show that fine-tuning it for downstream tasks achieves competitive performance compared to training from scratch or using established GFMs. The source code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/mojganmadadi/LIANet/tree/v1.0.1.

AI.tldr: LIANet以纯坐标为输入，通过连续时空神经场一次预训练即可重构任意卫星影像，后续无需原始数据即可零样本迁移至任意遥感下游任务，性能媲美GFM与从头训练且省去数据获取/预处理环节。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型仍依赖原始卫星数据访问与复杂预处理，对终端用户门槛高，需构建一种“无需数据”即可直接微调的基础表征。
AI.method: 将任一区域的多时相卫星影像参数化为连续时空神经场：网络仅输入空间(x,y)和时间(t)坐标即输出对应像素；预训练完成后冻结权重，仅靠下游任务标签微调少量任务头即可完成语义分割或回归。
AI.result: 在多个尺度的目标区域预训练后，迁移至语义分割与像素级回归任务，相比从零训练或SOTA GFMs取得相当甚至更优精度，同时无需访问原始卫星影像。
AI.conclusion: LIANet证明了“坐标即所需”的轻量级神经表征可作为遥感基础模型新范式，显著降低数据获取及预处理成本。

title: Why Adam Can Beat SGD: Second-Moment Normalization Yields Sharper Tails
summary: Despite Adam demonstrating faster empirical convergence than SGD in many applications, much of the existing theory yields guarantees essentially comparable to those of SGD, leaving the empirical performance gap insufficiently explained. In this paper, we uncover a key second-moment normalization in Adam and develop a stopping-time/martingale analysis that provably distinguishes Adam from SGD under the classical bounded variance model (a second moment assumption). In particular, we establish the first theoretical separation between the high-probability convergence behaviors of the two methods: Adam achieves a $δ^{-1/2}$ dependence on the confidence parameter $δ$, whereas corresponding high-probability guarantee for SGD necessarily incurs at least a $δ^{-1}$ dependence.

AI.tldr: 首次在理论上证明 Adam 与 SGD 在高概率收敛率存在本质差距：Adam 对置信参数 δ 的依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，而 SGD 至少为 δ^{-1}，从而解释了 Adam 经验收敛更快的现象。
AI.motivation: Adam 在实践中比 SGD 收敛更快，但现有理论仅给出与 SGD 相当的保证，无法解释经验差距，亟需揭示二者在收敛行为上的本质差异。
AI.method: 发现 Adam 隐含的二阶矩归一化结构；引入停时-鞅技巧，在经典有界方差模型（二阶矩假设）下建立高概率收敛分析框架，对 Adam 和 SGD 分别导出收敛率上界与下界。
AI.result: 证明 Adam 高概率收敛率对置信参数 δ 的依赖为 O(δ^{-1/2})，而任何 SGD 的高概率保证必须至少 Ω(δ^{-1})；首次给出二者在收敛速度上的严格分离。
AI.conclusion: 二阶矩归一化是 Adam 优于 SGD 的核心机制；停时-鞅分析能精确捕捉这种优势，为理解自适应优化算法提供了新的理论工具，并指出后续可推广至更一般自适应方法的研究方向。

title: Faithful GRPO: Improving Visual Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models via Constrained Policy Optimization
summary: Multimodal reasoning models (MRMs) trained with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) show improved accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. However, we observe that accuracy gains often come at the cost of reasoning quality: generated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces are frequently inconsistent with the final answer and poorly grounded in the visual evidence. We systematically study this phenomenon across seven challenging real-world spatial reasoning benchmarks and find that it affects contemporary MRMs such as ViGoRL-Spatial, TreeVGR as well as our own models trained with standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We characterize CoT reasoning quality along two complementary axes: "logical consistency" (does the CoT entail the final answer?) and "visual grounding" (does each reasoning step accurately describe objects, attributes, and spatial relationships in the image?). To address this, we propose Faithful GRPO (FGRPO), a variant of GRPO that enforces consistency and grounding as constraints via Lagrangian dual ascent. FGRPO incorporates batch-level consistency and grounding constraints into the advantage computation within a group, adaptively adjusting the relative importance of constraints during optimization. We evaluate FGRPO on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 3B backbones across seven spatial datasets. Our results show that FGRPO substantially improves reasoning quality, reducing the inconsistency rate from 24.5% to 1.7% and improving visual grounding scores by +13%. It also improves final answer accuracy over simple GRPO, demonstrating that faithful reasoning enables better answers.

AI.tldr: 提出 Faithful GRPO 算法，在保持视觉推理准确率的同时显著降低 CoT 与答案不一致率（24.5%→1.7%），并提升视觉 grounding 得分 13%。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 训练的多模态推理模型虽在视觉推理基准上准确率高，但其 CoT 常出现逻辑不一致或脱离图像证据，亟需量化并消除这种「以牺牲推理质量换取准确率」的现象。
AI.method: 1) 设计两维评估指标：逻辑一致性（CoT 是否蕴含最终答案）与视觉接地（每步推理是否准确对应图像实体与空间关系）；2) 提出 Faithful GRPO，在 GRPO 的优势估计中引入批次级一致性与 grounding 约束，通过拉格朗日对偶上升动态调整约束权重；3) 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B/3B 与 7 个空间推理数据集上系统验证。
AI.result: FGRPO 将 CoT-答案不一致率从 24.5% 降至 1.7%，视觉 grounding 得分提升 13%，同时最终答案准确率优于标准 GRPO，实现「可信推理」与「准确答案」双提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式约束一致性与视觉接地，FGRPO 首次证明可在不损失准确率的前提下显著改善多模态推理的可解释性与可靠性，为后续 RLVR 研究提供了可扩展的约束优化范式。

title: Learning to Search: A Decision-Based Agent for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) requires vision-language models to understand images and use external knowledge, especially for rare entities and long-tail facts. Most existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods adopt a fixed pipeline that sequentially retrieves information, filters it, and then produces an answer. Such a design makes it difficult to adapt to diverse question types. Moreover, it separates retrieval from reasoning, making it hard for the model to decide when to search, how to refine queries, or when to stop. As a result, the retrieved evidence is often poorly aligned with the question. To address these limitations, we reformulate KB-VQA as a search-agent problem and model the solving process as a multi-step decision-making procedure. At each step, the agent selects one of four actions-Answer, Image Retrieval, Text Retrieval, and Caption-based on its current information state. We further design an automated pipeline to collect multi-step trajectories that record the agent's reasoning process, tool usage, and intermediate decisions. These trajectories are then used as supervision for fine-tuning. Experiments on InfoSeek and E-VQA demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming prior baselines and confirming the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 将KB-VQA建模为可自主决定“何时搜、搜什么、何时答”的搜索智能体，用多步决策框架替代固定RAG流水线，在InfoSeek/E-VQA上新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG顺序“检索→过滤→生成”无法适应多样问题，检索与推理脱节，导致证据与问题对齐差，尤其在长尾实体上失效。
AI.method: 把KB-VQA转化为马尔可夫决策过程：智能体每步从{Answer, Image Retrieval, Text Retrieval, Caption}四动作中选择；自动收集含推理链、工具调用、中间决策的多步轨迹，用这些轨迹监督微调模型。
AI.result: 在InfoSeek与E-VQA上全面超越现有最佳基线，验证动态检索-推理联合优化的优势。
AI.conclusion: 将检索整合为可学习策略而非固定模块，能显著提升KB-VQA的证据对齐度与长尾知识覆盖，为开放域视觉问答提供新范式。

title: Training event-based neural networks with exact gradients via Differentiable ODE Solving in JAX
summary: Existing frameworks for gradient-based training of spiking neural networks face a trade-off: discrete-time methods using surrogate gradients support arbitrary neuron models but introduce gradient bias and constrain spike-time resolution, while continuous-time methods that compute exact gradients require analytical expressions for spike times and state evolution, restricting them to simple neuron types such as Leaky Integrate and Fire (LIF). We introduce the Eventax framework, which resolves this trade-off by combining differentiable numerical ODE solvers with event-based spike handling. Built in JAX, our frame-work uses Diffrax ODE-solvers to compute gradients that are exact with respect to the forward simulation for any neuron model defined by ODEs . It also provides a simple API where users can specify just the neuron dynamics, spike conditions, and reset rules. Eventax prioritises modelling flexibility, supporting a wide range of neuron models, loss functions, and network architectures, which can be easily extended.
