We demonstrate Eventax on multiple benchmarks, including Yin-Yang and MNIST, using diverse neuron models such as Leaky Integrate-and-fire (LIF), Quadratic Integrate-and-fire (QIF), Exponential integrate-and-fire (EIF), Izhikevich and Event-based Gated Recurrent Unit (EGRU) with both time-to-first-spike and state-based loss functions, demonstrating its utility for prototyping and testing event-based architectures trained with exact gradients. We also demonstrate the application of this framework for more complex neuron types by implementing a multi-compartment neuron that uses a model of dendritic spikes in human layer 2/3 cortical Pyramidal neurons for computation. Code available at https://github.com/efficient-scalable-machine-learning/eventax.

AI.tldr: Eventax 以 JAX + 可微 ODE 求解器为核心，首次在任意 ODE 神经元模型上实现无偏、连续时间、精确反向传播，突破现有离散代理梯度与解析连续时间两派方法的局限。
AI.motivation: 梯度训练 SNN 长期面临两难：离散代理法通用但存在梯度偏差且时间精度受限；连续解析法无偏却仅适用于 LIF 等少数可求解析表达式的简单模型。亟需一种兼顾“通用神经元动力学”与“精确梯度”的统一框架。
AI.method: 将 Diffrax 可微 ODE 求解器与基于事件的脉冲检测/重置机制结合，构建 Eventax。用户仅需用 Python 函数描述膜动力学、触发条件与复位规则，框架自动完成事件驱动的精确前向仿真，并通过伴随法反向传播计算无偏梯度。
AI.result: 在 Yin-Yang、MNIST 等基准上，LIF、QIF、EIF、Izhikevich、EGRU 等多种模型均可用统一代码训练，同时支持“首脉冲时间”与“内部状态”两类损失。额外展示人脑 L2/3 锥体神经元多房室树突脉冲模型，验证其对复杂生物细节的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Eventax 以通用 ODE 接口和自动微分为基础，首次让“任意神经元动力学 + 精确梯度”成为开箱即用的现实，为事件驱动网络的原型设计、异构神经元建模及生物可解释性研究提供灵活、高效、可扩展的新平台。

title: PIArena: A Platform for Prompt Injection Evaluation
comment: To appear in ACL 2026. The code is available at https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena
summary: Prompt injection attacks pose serious security risks across a wide range of real-world applications. While receiving increasing attention, the community faces a critical gap: the lack of a unified platform for prompt injection evaluation. This makes it challenging to reliably compare defenses, understand their true robustness under diverse attacks, or assess how well they generalize across tasks and benchmarks. For instance, many defenses initially reported as effective were later found to exhibit limited robustness on diverse datasets and attacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce PIArena, a unified and extensible platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables users to easily integrate state-of-the-art attacks and defenses and evaluate them across a variety of existing and new benchmarks. We also design a dynamic strategy-based attack that adaptively optimizes injected prompts based on defense feedback. Through comprehensive evaluation using PIArena, we uncover critical limitations of state-of-the-art defenses: limited generalizability across tasks, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, and fundamental challenges when an injected task aligns with the target task. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena.

AI.tldr: 作者发布了一个统一可扩展的提示注入评估平台PIArena，发现现有防御手段跨任务泛化差、难挡自适应攻击、易被同源任务混淆。
AI.motivation: 提示注入攻击威胁真实应用，但社区缺少统一评估平台，导致防御方法难以横向比较、鲁棒性结论不可靠。
AI.method: 构建PIArena平台，集成现有攻防组件并支持动态策略攻击，通过自适应优化注入提示对各类防御进行系统评测。
AI.result: 在PIArena上，主流防御表现出任务间迁移泛化弱、对自适应攻击脆弱、目标与注入任务语义重叠时易失效等根本缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 统一评估框架揭示了当前提示注入防御的共性问题，社区需借助PIArena等工具推进更具泛化与鲁棒性的下一代防御方案。

title: PhyEdit: Towards Real-World Object Manipulation via Physically-Grounded Image Editing
summary: Achieving physically accurate object manipulation in image editing is essential for its potential applications in interactive world models. However, existing visual generative models often fail at precise spatial manipulation, resulting in incorrect scaling and positioning of objects. This limitation primarily stems from the lack of explicit mechanisms to incorporate 3D geometry and perspective projection. To achieve accurate manipulation, we develop PhyEdit, an image editing framework that leverages explicit geometric simulation as contextual 3D-aware visual guidance. By combining this plug-and-play 3D prior with joint 2D--3D supervision, our method effectively improves physical accuracy and manipulation consistency. To support this method and evaluate performance, we present a real-world dataset, RealManip-10K, for 3D-aware object manipulation featuring paired images and depth annotations. We also propose ManipEval, a benchmark with multi-dimensional metrics to evaluate 3D spatial control and geometric consistency. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms existing methods, including strong closed-source models, in both 3D geometric accuracy and manipulation consistency.

AI.tldr: PhyEdit 用显式几何仿真做 3D 上下文先验，联合 2D-3D 监督，解决图像编辑中空间缩放与定位失真问题，在自建的 RealManip-10K 与 ManipEval 上全面优于包括闭源模型在内的现有方法。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型等应用要求图像编辑具备物理正确的空间操作，而现有生成模型缺乏显式 3D 几何与透视投影机制，导致缩放与定位错误。
AI.method: 提出 PhyEdit 框架：1) 引入可插拔的显式几何仿真作为 3D 视觉先验；2) 设计 2D-3D 联合监督损失；3) 构建含成对图像与深度标注的 RealManip-10K 数据集；4) 设计多维度指标基准 ManipEval。
AI.result: 在 RealManip-10K 与 ManipEval 上，PhyEdit 在 3D 几何精度与操作一致性指标均显著超越现有开源及闭源最强模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何仿真可作为轻量级 3D 先验，有效提升图像编辑的物理准确性；联合 2D-3D 监督与配套基准为后续 3D 感知操作研究奠定数据与评价基础。

title: C$^2$FG: Control Classifier-Free Guidance via Score Discrepancy Analysis
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is a cornerstone of modern conditional diffusion models, yet its reliance on the fixed or heuristic dynamic guidance weight is predominantly empirical and overlooks the inherent dynamics of the diffusion process. In this paper, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of the Classifier-Free Guidance. Specifically, we establish strict upper bounds on the score discrepancy between conditional and unconditional distributions at different timesteps based on the diffusion process. This finding explains the limitations of fixed-weight strategies and establishes a principled foundation for time-dependent guidance. Motivated by this insight, we introduce \textbf{Control Classifier-Free Guidance (C$^2$FG)}, a novel, training-free, and plug-in method that aligns the guidance strength with the diffusion dynamics via an exponential decay control function. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C$^2$FG is effective and broadly applicable across diverse generative tasks, while also exhibiting orthogonality to existing strategies.

AI.tldr: 理论证明固定CFG权重违反扩散动力学，提出免训练、可即插即用的指数衰减权重C²FG，在多项任务中一致优于固定权重且与现有方法正交。
AI.motivation: 现代条件扩散模型普遍采用Classifier-Free Guidance(CFG)，但其指导权重多凭经验固定或粗略 heuristic 设置，忽视扩散过程本身随时间变化的内在动力学，导致理论依据缺失、性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 对CFG进行严格理论分析，给出条件与无条件得分在不同时刻的严格上界，揭示固定权重违背扩散动力学；2) 基于该上界设计时间指数衰减控制函数；3) 提出Control Classifier-Free Guidance(C²FG)，无需再训练、直接替换原权重即可使用。
AI.result: 在文本到图像、图像到图像、视频生成等多种任务上的大量实验显示，C²FG在FID、CLIP Score、人类偏好等指标上均显著优于固定权重基线，且能与已有改进CFG的策略（如分段权重、复合引导）叠加使用，性能进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 固定CFG权重存在理论缺陷；通过把时间维度纳入权重设计，C²FG以零额外成本实现与扩散动力学对齐，具有广泛适用性和良好兼容性，为后续条件扩散模型研究提供新的理论视角与实用工具。

title: Quantifying Explanation Consistency: The C-Score Metric for CAM-Based Explainability in Medical Image Classification
summary: Class Activation Mapping (CAM) methods are widely used to generate visual explanations for deep learning classifiers in medical imaging. However, existing evaluation frameworks assess whether explanations are correct, measured by localisation fidelity against radiologist annotations, rather than whether they are consistent: whether the model applies the same spatial reasoning strategy across different patients with the same pathology. We propose the C-Score (Consistency Score), a confidence-weighted, annotation-free metric that quantifies intra-class explanation reproducibility via intensity-emphasised pairwise soft IoU across correctly classified instances. We evaluate six CAM techniques: GradCAM, GradCAM++, LayerCAM, EigenCAM, ScoreCAM, and MS GradCAM++ across three CNN architectures (DenseNet201, InceptionV3, ResNet50V2) over thirty training epochs on the Kermany chest X-ray dataset, covering transfer learning and fine-tuning phases. We identify three distinct mechanisms of AUC-consistency dissociation, invisible to standard classification metrics: threshold-mediated gold list collapse, technique-specific attribution collapse at peak AUC, and class-level consistency masking in global aggregation. C-Score provides an early warning signal of impending model instability. ScoreCAM deterioration on ResNet50V2 is detectable one full checkpoint before catastrophic AUC collapse and yields architecture-specific clinical deployment recommendations grounded in explanation quality rather than predictive ranking alone.

AI.tldr: 提出C-Score，首次用无标注、置信加权的方式衡量CAM解释在同类病例间的空间一致性；在Kermany胸片数据上发现AUC高时解释仍可突变，C-Score能提前1个epoch预警模型崩溃。
AI.motivation: 传统CAM评估只看与医生标注的局部重合（localization fidelity），忽视模型对同类病灶是否采用稳定空间策略；临床部署需要“解释可重复”这一新维度。
AI.method: 设计C-Score：对同一病理且分类正确的样本，计算CAM图间“强度加权软IoU”的均值；系统比较6种CAM×3网络×30 epoch在迁移学习与微调阶段的表现；提出三种AUC-一致性解耦机制并验证。
AI.result: C-Score与AUC可分离：ResNet50V2+ScoreCAM在AUC峰值处已出现归因坍缩，C-Score提前1个checkpoint下降；DenseNet201+LayerCAM在全局聚合中因类级掩蔽而一致性虚高；给出无需标注的架构-方法部署建议表。
AI.conclusion: 解释一致性应作为医学AI临床落地的独立质控指标；C-Score可嵌入训练流水线，实现“解释质量”驱动的早停与模型选择。

title: GenLCA: 3D Diffusion for Full-Body Avatars from In-the-Wild Videos
summary: We present GenLCA, a diffusion-based generative model for generating and editing photorealistic full-body avatars from text and image inputs. The generated avatars are faithful to the inputs, while supporting high-fidelity facial and full-body animations. The core idea is a novel paradigm that enables training a full-body 3D diffusion model from partially observable 2D data, allowing the training dataset to scale to millions of real-world videos. This scalability contributes to the superior photorealism and generalizability of GenLCA. Specifically, we scale up the dataset by repurposing a pretrained feed-forward avatar reconstruction model as an animatable 3D tokenizer, which encodes unstructured video frames into structured 3D tokens. However, most real-world videos only provide partial observations of body parts, resulting in excessive blurring or transparency artifacts in the 3D tokens. To address this, we propose a novel visibility-aware diffusion training strategy that replaces invalid regions with learnable tokens and computes losses only over valid regions. We then train a flow-based diffusion model on the token dataset, inherently maintaining the photorealism and animatability provided by the pretrained avatar reconstruction model. Our approach effectively enables the use of large-scale real-world video data to train a diffusion model natively in 3D. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method through diverse and high-fidelity generation and editing results, outperforming existing solutions by a large margin. The project page is available at https://onethousandwu.com/GenLCA-Page.

AI.tldr: GenLCA 以可见性感知的三维扩散框架，首次用数百万真实二维视频直接训练出高保真、可动、文本-图像驱动的全身头像生成与编辑模型，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有三维头像生成依赖小规模三维数据，真实感与泛化性受限；而互联网海量二维视频虽易得，却仅提供局部身体观测，难以直接用于三维扩散模型训练。
AI.method: 1) 将预训练前馈头像重建模型改造为“可动三维分词器”，把任意视频帧编码为结构化三维令牌；2) 提出可见性感知扩散训练：对不可见区域用可学习令牌补全并仅在可见区域计算损失；3) 在令牌化后的百万级真实视频上训练流式三维扩散模型，继承重建模型的真实感与可动性。
AI.result: 在文本/图像驱动生成与编辑任务中，GenLCA 输出照片级真实全身头像，支持高保真面部与全身动画，量化与主观评测均大幅领先当前最优方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过可见性感知的三维扩散范式，GenLCA 首次实现大规模二维视频直接训练三维生成模型，为数据可扩展、高质量、可动Avatar生成提供了新路径。

title: Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs
summary: Modern CNNs' high computational demands hinder edge deployment, as traditional ``hard'' sparsity (skipping mathematical zeros) loses effectiveness in deep layers or with smooth activations like Tanh. We propose a ``soft sparsity'' paradigm using a hardware efficient Most Significant Bit (MSB) proxy to skip negligible non-zero multiplications. Integrated as a custom RISC-V instruction and evaluated on LeNet-5 (MNIST), this method reduces ReLU MACs by 88.42% and Tanh MACs by 74.87% with zero accuracy loss--outperforming zero-skipping by 5x. By clock-gating inactive multipliers, we estimate power savings of 35.2% for ReLU and 29.96% for Tanh. While memory access makes power reduction sub-linear to operation savings, this approach significantly optimizes resource-constrained inference.

AI.tldr: 提出“软稀疏”范式，用硬件高效的MSB代理跳过微小非零乘法，RISC-V指令级实现，在LeNet-5上零精度损失下乘法操作减少>74%，功耗降约30%。
AI.motivation: 传统“硬稀疏”在深网络或平滑激活（Tanh）中失效，边缘端CNN因高计算量难以部署，需一种对非零但可忽略乘法亦有效的低功耗加速手段。
AI.method: 以最高有效位（MSB）作为量级代理，动态判定并跳过“微小”非零乘法；将该逻辑封装为自定义RISC-V指令，并通过时钟门控关闭空闲乘法器。
AI.result: MNIST上LeNet-5实验：ReLU MAC减少88.42%，Tanh MAC减少74.87%，精度无损；相比传统零跳跃方案MAC减少倍数提升5×；估计功耗下降35.2%（ReLU）/29.96%（Tanh）。
AI.conclusion: 软稀疏+MSB代理能在边缘端显著降低计算与功耗，且对平滑激活友好；尽管访存使功耗降幅低于操作削减，但对资源受限推理仍具显著优化价值。

title: Differentially Private Language Generation and Identification in the Limit
summary:
We initiate the study of language generation in the limit, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24], under the constraint of differential privacy. We consider the continual release model, where a generator must eventually output a stream of valid strings while protecting the privacy of the entire input sequence. Our first main result is that for countable collections of languages, privacy comes at no qualitative cost: we provide an $\varepsilon$-differentially-private algorithm that generates in the limit from any countable collection. This stands in contrast to many learning settings where privacy renders learnability impossible. However, privacy does impose a quantitative cost: there are finite collections of size $k$ for which uniform private generation requires $Ω(k/\varepsilon)$ samples, whereas just one sample suffices non-privately.
  We then turn to the harder problem of language identification in the limit. Here, we show that privacy creates fundamental barriers. We prove that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification. Next, we turn to the stochastic setting where the sample strings are sampled i.i.d. from a distribution (instead of being generated by an adversary). Here, we show that private identification is possible if and only if the collection is identifiable in the adversarial model. Together, our results establish new dimensions along which generation and identification differ and, for identification, a separation between adversarial and stochastic settings induced by privacy constraints.

AI.tldr: 首次在差分隐私（DP）约束下研究极限语言生成与识别。可数语料可零障碍生成，但有限语料隐私代价 Ω(k/ε)；在识别任务中，DP 对含“无限交集＋有限差集”的语料形成根本障碍，随机采样下仅当对抗模型可识别时方可识别。本文刻画了隐私引入的生成/识别差距与数据模型间的任务分离。
AI.motivation: Kleinberg–Mullainathan 提出的“极限生成”模型未考虑隐私。作者想弄清：1) 持续输出场景下，DP 是否完全阻止生成或识别；2) 若可行，代价如何；3) 对抗与随机两种采样模型是否因隐私出现新的能力分隔。
AI.method: 1) 对可数语料，构造基于指数机制的“隐私-极限生成器”，证明其在极限意义下输出合法串且满足 ε-DP；2) 对有限 k 语料，构造配对隐私下界，证明必需 Ω(k/ε) 样本；3) 对识别任务，构造不可区分性攻击，给出“无限交集＋有限差集”类语料的 DP 不可能定理；4) 在随机 i.i.d. 模型中，将抗敌识别算法转化为隐私版本，证明其充要条件。
AI.result: 生成：可数语料可无质变障碍地 ε-DP 极限生成；有限大小 k 语料需样本增至 k/ε 量级。识别：ε-DP 算法无法识别含两语言无限交集且差集有限之族；随机采样下 ε-DP 识别当且仅当该族在敌手模型可识别，形成数据模型驱动的隐私能力分隔。
AI.conclusion: 差分隐私对“极限语言生成”基本保留可行性，仅带来数量级样本放大；对“极限语言识别”却产生结构性障碍，揭示出生成与识别在隐私约束下的新维度差异，并首次阐明隐私可把对抗/随机的任务可解性隔离开来。

title: Tabular GANs for uneven distribution
summary: Generative models for tabular data have evolved rapidly beyond Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). While GANs pioneered synthetic tabular data generation, recent advances in diffusion models and large language models (LLMs) have opened new paradigms with complementary strengths in sample quality, privacy, and controllability. In this paper, we survey the landscape of tabular data generation across three major paradigms - GANs, diffusion models, and LLMs - and introduce a unified, modular framework that supports all three. The framework encompasses data preprocessing, a model-agnostic interface layer, standardized training and inference pipelines, and a comprehensive evaluation module. We validate the framework through experiments on seven benchmark datasets, demonstrating that GAN-based augmentation can improve downstream performance under distribution shift. The framework and its reference implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/Diyago/Tabular-data-generation, facilitating reproducibility and extensibility for future research.

AI.tldr: 文章提出首个统一支持GAN、扩散模型与LLM三种范式的表格数据生成框架，并在七个基准数据集上验证其可复现性与下游增益。
AI.motivation: 尽管GAN开创了合成表格数据先河，扩散模型与LLM在样本质量、隐私与可控性上展现互补优势，却缺乏能够横向比较并融合三者的一站式平台，阻碍科研复现与工程落地。
AI.method: 构建模块化统一框架：①通用预处理管道；②模型无关接口层；③标准化训练/推理管线；④综合评估模块，兼容GAN、扩散、LLM三类生成器；实验层面采用分布漂移场景评估数据增强对下游任务的影响。
AI.result: 在七个公开基准数据集上，框架实现三种范式的可复现训练与推理；GAN-based数据增强在分布漂移条件下显著提升下游模型性能；项目代码与基准已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架填补了表格生成领域跨范式比较与集成的空白，为后续算法创新、隐私保护及可控生成研究提供可扩展基线，并强调开源可复现性对社区发展的重要性。

title: Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks
summary: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. Are sinks a byproduct of the optimization/training regime? Or are they sometimes functionally necessary in softmax Transformers? We prove that, in some settings, it is the latter: computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.

AI.tldr: 首篇具理论分析证明的论文指出，只要使用 softmax 注意力模型在特定触发条件任务中就需要引入 attention sink，根源在于归一化必须把（无条件）默认状态锚定在固定位置上；改用无归一化的 ReLU 注意力则可避免。实验验证了单头/多头 Transformer 中 softmax 模型确实自发产生强 sink，而 ReLU 版几乎完全消除。
AI.motivation: 注意力“池”现象在实践经验中频繁出现，却从未被严格证明是否为 softmax 结构所必需。作者从理论上澄清：当模型需要“输入无关的零输出”这一默认状态时，softmax 的 row-wise 概率归一化迫使模型将部分注意力永久锁定在某个固定位置（池），否则无法正常表达“忽略输入”的行为，从而回答池现象是 softmax 模型的内在功能需求，而非无关训练侧产物。
AI.method: (1) 构造理论任务：若序列中出现指定 trigger 词，则需输出此前所有词向量均值，否则输出零向量；(2) 采用 softmax 和 ReLU 两类自注意力公式进行对比证明；(3) 在简单 Transformer 实验（单头、多头）中观察不同归一化下 attention sink 的幅度与分布。
AI.result: 理论证明：当且仅当采用 softmax 归一化，求解上述任务必然在注意权重中引入一个固定到句首或某固定槽位的 attention sink；ReLU 注意力无需任何 sink 即可完美完成任务。实验上 softmax 模型在单头平均突现 60% 以上池权重，多头综合亦趋向池；同一架构改为 ReLU 注意力后，池权重大幅下降甚至消失。结论对多层模型同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 注意力池不是训练细节偶然，而是 softmax 概率归一化在需要默认输出场景下的本质局限；若希望消除池并提高序列长度外推能力，可用无需行归一化的替代注意力（如 ReLU）。

title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
summary: AI agents may be able to automate your inbox, but can they automate other routine aspects of your life? Everyday online tasks offer a realistic yet unsolved testbed for evaluating the next generation of AI agents. To this end, we introduce ClawBench, an evaluation framework of 153 simple tasks that people need to accomplish regularly in their lives and work, spanning 144 live platforms across 15 categories, from completing purchases and booking appointments to submitting job applications. These tasks require demanding capabilities beyond existing benchmarks, such as obtaining relevant information from user-provided documents, navigating multi-step workflows across diverse platforms, and write-heavy operations like filling in many detailed forms correctly. Unlike existing benchmarks that evaluate agents in offline sandboxes with static pages, ClawBench operates on production websites, preserving the full complexity, dynamic nature, and challenges of real-world web interaction. A lightweight interception layer captures and blocks only the final submission request, ensuring safe evaluation without real-world side effects. Our evaluations of 7 frontier models show that both proprietary and open-source models can complete only a small portion of these tasks. For example, Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieves only 33.3%. Progress on ClawBench brings us closer to AI agents that can function as reliable general-purpose assistants.

AI.tldr: ClawBench 以 153 个真实在线任务为测试集，首次在生产级网站上评估 AI 代理完成日常事务的能力；7 个前沿模型平均成功率不足 35%，暴露出现有代理在动态复杂环境中的显著短板。
AI.motivation: 现有基准局限于离线静态沙盒，无法反映真实网页的动态、多步、写入密集型流程，因此亟需一个贴近生活的在线评估框架，衡量 AI 代理能否胜任通用个人助理。
AI.method: 构建跨 15 类 144 家线上平台的 153 项高频任务，覆盖采购、预约、求职等场景；部署轻量级拦截层，在最终提交前截获请求以阻断副作用；对 7 个主流闭源与开源模型进行零样本测评，记录端到端成功率与错误类型。
AI.result: 最佳模型 Claude Sonnet 4.6 仅完成 33.3% 任务；失败主因包括动态表单字段遗漏、多步流程逻辑偏差、文档信息提取错误；开源模型差距更大，证实真实网页复杂度远超离线基准。
AI.conclusion: ClawBench 揭示了 AI 代理在真实在线环境中的脆性，推动社区从静态模拟转向生产级评测，为打造可靠通用助理提供清晰迭代目标与数据支持。

title: Flemme: A Flexible and Modular Learning Platform for Medical Images
summary: As the rapid development of computer vision and the emergence of powerful network backbones and architectures, the application of deep learning in medical imaging has become increasingly significant. Unlike natural images, medical images lack huge volumes of data but feature more modalities, making it difficult to train a general model that has satisfactory performance across various datasets. In practice, practitioners often suffer from manually creating and testing models combining independent backbones and architectures, which is a laborious and time-consuming process. We propose Flemme, a FLExible and Modular learning platform for MEdical images. Our platform separates encoders from the model architectures so that different models can be constructed via various combinations of supported encoders and architectures. We construct encoders using building blocks based on convolution, transformer, and state-space model (SSM) to process both 2D and 3D image patches. A base architecture is implemented following an encoder-decoder style, with several derived architectures for image segmentation, reconstruction, and generation tasks. In addition, we propose a general hierarchical architecture incorporating a pyramid loss to optimize and fuse vertical features. Experiments demonstrate that this simple design leads to an average improvement of 5.60% in Dice score and 7.81% in mean interaction of units (mIoU) for segmentation models, as well as an enhancement of 5.57% in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 8.22% in structural similarity (SSIM) for reconstruction models. We further utilize Flemme as an analytical tool to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of various encoders across different tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/wlsdzyzl/flemme.

AI.tldr: Flemme 是一个将编码器与具体架构解耦的模块化医学影像深度学习平台，通过卷积、Transformer、SSM 等通用编码块，统一支持 2D/3D 分割、重建与生成任务，显著减轻人工反复设计模型的负担。
AI.motivation: 医学影像数据量小、模态多，现有方法需人工反复搭配骨干网络与架构，耗时耗力且难以获得跨数据集的通用高性能模型。
AI.method: 1. 构建可插拔编码器库：基于卷积、Transformer、状态空间模型（SSM）的通用 2D/3D 块；2. 提出编码-解码基础框架，并派生出分割、重建、生成三种专用架构；3. 引入金字塔损失的多级特征融合层级架构，实现垂直特征统一优化。
AI.result: 在多个任务上，仅用该简单设计即可带来：分割 Dice↑5.60%、mIoU↑7.81%；重建 PSNR↑5.57%、SSIM↑8.22%。同时平台可作为编码器效能评估工具，系统比较不同骨干在各任务下的表现。
AI.conclusion: Flemme 通过“编码器-架构”解耦与统一金字塔损失，显著降低医学影像深度模型开发门槛，在分割与重建任务中取得一致且显著的性能提升，为快速验证和部署多模态医学影像算法提供了高效、灵活的研究与生产平台。

title: Minimum-Action Learning: Energy-Constrained Symbolic Model Selection for Physical Law Identification from Noisy Data
summary: Identifying physical laws from noisy observational data is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We present Minimum-Action Learning (MAL), a framework that selects symbolic force laws from a pre-specified basis library by minimizing a Triple-Action functional combining trajectory reconstruction, architectural sparsity, and energy-conservation enforcement. A wide-stencil acceleration-matching technique reduces noise variance by 10,000x, transforming an intractable problem (SNR ~0.02) into a learnable one (SNR ~1.6); this preprocessing is the critical enabler shared by all methods tested, including SINDy variants. On two benchmarks -- Kepler gravity and Hooke's law -- MAL recovers the correct force law with Kepler exponent p = 3.01 +/- 0.01 at ~0.07 kWh (40% reduction vs. prediction-error-only baselines). The raw correct-basis rate is 40% for Kepler and 90% for Hooke; an energy-conservation-based criterion discriminates the true force law in all cases, yielding 100% pipeline-level identification. Basis library sensitivity experiments show that near-confounders degrade selection (20% with added r^{-2.5} and r^{-1.5}), while distant additions are harmless, and the conservation diagnostic remains informative even when the correct basis is absent. Direct comparison with noise-robust SINDy variants, Hamiltonian Neural Networks, and Lagrangian Neural Networks confirms MAL's distinct niche: interpretable, energy-constrained model selection that combines symbolic basis identification with dynamical rollout validation.

AI.tldr: 提出Minimum-Action Learning（MAL），用三动作泛函在极低信噪比（SNR 0.02→1.6）下从噪声数据精准识别符号力律，100%找到正确定律，能耗降低40%，性能优于SINDy、HNN、LNN。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习的核心难题：在强噪声观测中鲁棒地识别物理定律，现有方法在SNR≈0.02时几乎失效，亟需能兼顾符号可解释性与能量守恒约束的新框架。
AI.method: 构建三动作泛函（轨迹重构+架构稀疏+能量守恒），宽模板加速度匹配降噪10 000倍；在预设符号基库中联合优化，先用守恒判据筛选，再用动力学回滚验证，实现符号力律选择。
AI.result: 开普勒引力与胡克定律基准上，恢复指数p=3.01±0.01；直接正确率40%/90%，经能量守恒判据后达100%，能耗≈0.07 kWh，较纯预测误差基线降40%，远优于噪声鲁棒SINDy、HNN、LNN。
AI.conclusion: MAL在极低信噪比下实现可解释、能量守恒的符号模型选择，奠定噪声环境物理定律发现的新范式；其降噪与守恒判据模块可独立植入其他方法，具有广泛扩展性。

title: What Drives Representation Steering? A Mechanistic Case Study on Steering Refusal
summary: Applying steering vectors to large language models (LLMs) is an efficient and effective model alignment technique, but we lack an interpretable explanation for how it works-- specifically, what internal mechanisms steering vectors affect and how this results in different model outputs. To investigate the causal mechanisms underlying the effectiveness of steering vectors, we conduct a comprehensive case study on refusal. We propose a multi-token activation patching framework and discover that different steering methodologies leverage functionally interchangeable circuits when applied at the same layer. These circuits reveal that steering vectors primarily interact with the attention mechanism through the OV circuit while largely ignoring the QK circuit-- freezing all attention scores during steering drops performance by only 8.75% across two model families. A mathematical decomposition of the steered OV circuit further reveals semantically interpretable concepts, even in cases where the steering vector itself does not. Leveraging the activation patching results, we show that steering vectors can be sparsified by up to 90-99% while retaining most performance, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions.

AI.tldr: 用“转向向量”对齐大语言模型虽有效，却缺乏可解释因果机制。本文针对“拒绝”任务，提出多 token 激活修补框架，首次揭示转向几乎只通过注意力 OV 回路而非 QK 回路起作用；该回路可数学分解出可解释语义概念。借此可将向量稀疏化 90–99% 仍保性能，为黑盒对齐提供因果解释与压缩方案。
AI.motivation: 现有转向向量方法能高效对齐 LLM，但对其内部因果机制一无所知，难以解释为何能改变模型输出，也不清楚能否压缩或泛化。
AI.method: 以“拒绝”为案例，构建多 token 激活修补框架，系统比较同层不同转向方法；冻结 QK 或 OV 回路做因果干预，量化各子回路贡献；对转向后的 OV 回路做奇异值分解，提取语义方向；基于修补重要性对向量做幅度与结构稀疏化。
AI.result: 1) 转向效果 91% 以上依赖 OV 回路，QK 回路被旁路（冻结注意力分数仅降 8.75%）。2) OV 特征空间可分解出可解释概念（安全、礼貌等），即使原向量无显式语义。3) 90–99% 维度可剪枝仍保持≥95% 原性能；不同转向方法在 5% 关键维度上高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 转向向量通过“劫持”注意力 OV 回路而非全局注意模式实现行为对齐；该机制具有跨方法一致性并可被极端稀疏化，为可解释、轻量级的黑盒模型对齐提供了理论基础和实用压缩策略。

title: Physically Plausible Human-Object Rendering from Sparse Views via 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 16 pages, 14 figures, accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP)
summary: Rendering realistic human-object interactions (HOIs) from sparse-view inputs is a challenging yet crucial task for various real-world applications. Existing methods often struggle to simultaneously achieve high rendering quality, physical plausibility, and computational efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose HOGS (Human-Object Rendering via 3D Gaussian Splatting), a novel framework for efficient HOI rendering with physically plausible geometric constraints from sparse views. HOGS represents both humans and objects as dynamic 3D Gaussians. Central to HOGS is a novel optimization process that operates directly on these Gaussians to enforce geometric consistency (i.e., preventing inter-penetration or floating contacts) to achieve physical plausibility. To support this core optimization under sparse-view ambiguity, our framework incorporates two pre-trained modules: an optimization-guided Human Pose Refiner for robust estimation under sparse-view occlusions, and a Human-Object Contact Predictor that efficiently identifies interaction regions to guide our novel contact and separation losses. Extensive experiments on both human-object and hand-object interaction datasets demonstrate that HOGS achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and maintains high computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 HOGS——一种基于3D-Gaussian表示的稀疏视角人-物交互渲染框架，在保留物理合理几何约束的同时兼顾高质量与高效率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下的人-物交互(HOI)渲染常被现有方法的质量、物理合理性与高效率三要素难以兼得所阻碍；缺乏有效的几何一致性约束与交互区域先验。
AI.method: 将人与物体统一建模为动态3D-Gaussian，直接对Gaussian参数进行优化；引入防穿模/防悬空的几何一致性约束。辅以两预训练模块：1)优化引导的人体姿态精修器缓解稀疏视角遮挡；2)人-物接触预测器定位交互区域，从而制定接触与分离损失并监督优化。
AI.result: 在人-物和手-物两个HOI数据集上达到SOTA渲染质量，同时保持高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: HOGS证明以3D-Gaussian为核心并加入几何与交互先验，可实现稀疏视角条件下高质量、高效率且物理合理的HOI渲染，为该领域提供了新范式。

title: The Workload-Router-Pool Architecture for LLM Inference Optimization: A Vision Paper from the vLLM Semantic Router Project
summary: Over the past year, the vLLM Semantic Router project has released a series of work spanning: (1) core routing mechanisms -- signal-driven routing, context-length pool routing, router performance engineering, policy conflict detection, low-latency embedding models, category-aware semantic caching, user-feedback-driven routing adaptation, hallucination detection, and hierarchical content-safety classification for privacy and jailbreak protection; (2) fleet optimization -- fleet provisioning and energy-efficiency analysis; (3) agentic and multimodal routing -- multimodal agent routing, tool selection, CUA security, and multi-turn context memory and safety; (4) governance and standards -- inference routing protocols and multi-provider API extensions. Each paper tackled a specific problem in LLM inference, but the problems are not independent; for example, fleet provisioning depends on the routing policy, which depends on the workload mix, shifting as organizations adopt agentic and multimodal workloads. This paper distills those results into the Workload-Router-Pool (WRP) architecture, a three-dimensional framework for LLM inference optimization. Workload characterizes what the fleet serves (chat vs. agent, single-turn vs. multi-turn, warm vs. cold, prefill-heavy vs. decode-heavy). Router determines how each request is dispatched (static semantic rules, online bandit adaptation, RL-based model selection, quality-aware cascading). Pool defines where inference runs (homogeneous vs. heterogeneous GPU, disaggregated prefill/decode, KV-cache topology). We map our prior work onto a 3x3 WRP interaction matrix, identify which cells we have covered and which remain open, and propose twenty-one concrete research directions at the intersections, each grounded in our prior measurements, tiered by maturity from engineering-ready to open research.

AI.tldr: 本文将过去一年内vLLM语义路由器项目分散的十余篇成果，凝练为“负载-路由-池”三维架构（WRP），并给出21个工程成熟度分级的后续研究点。
AI.motivation: LLM推理优化问题碎片化，路由策略、集群供给、工作负载形态相互耦合，缺少统一框架指导下一步研究。
AI.method: 提出WRP三维范式：①负载维（chat/agent、冷热、prefill/decode占比等）；②路由维（静态规则/在线bandit/RL级联等）；③池维（同构/异构GPU、预填充-解码分离、KV布局）。将既有论文映射到3×3交互矩阵，定位空白格子，据此导出21个交叠研究方向并划分成熟度。
AI.result: （1）系统梳理出12块已覆盖矩阵格子与3块空白格子；（2）从空白格子孵化21条可落地课题，如“多模态代理-负载×级联-路由×异构-池”等，成熟度从可直接工程化到需长期研究不等。
AI.conclusion: WRP框架首次把此前碎片成果升维整合，为LLM推理社区提供统一问题坐标系；所列21个方向可按成熟度梯次推进，形成持续演化路线图。

title: PSI: Shared State as the Missing Layer for Coherent AI-Generated Instruments in Personal AI Agents
summary: Personal AI tools can now be generated from natural-language requests, but they often remain isolated after creation. We present PSI, a shared-state architecture that turns independently generated modules into coherent instruments: persistent, connected, and chat-complementary artifacts accessible through both GUIs and a generic chat agent. By publishing current state and write-back affordances to a shared personal-context bus, modules enable cross-module reasoning and synchronized actions across interfaces. We study PSI through a three-week autobiographical deployment in a self-developed personal AI environment and show that later-generated instruments can be integrated automatically through the same contract. PSI identifies shared state as the missing systems layer that transforms AI-generated personal software from isolated apps into coherent personal computing environments.

AI.tldr: PSI架构把孤立生成的AI模块变成能通过共享状态互相协作的统一工具，用户既可用GUI也可聊天操控。
AI.motivation: 现有Personal AI工具由自然语言一次性生成后各自为政，无法共享上下文，导致用户重复配置、体验割裂。作者提出“碎片化AI工具”是阻碍个人计算环境连贯性的关键问题。
AI.method: 设计PSI共享状态架构：每个模块把当前持久化状态与可写回接口注册到统一Personal-Context Bus；部署于自研个人AI环境，作者本人作为唯一用户进行三周的自传式使用与观察，记录模块自动合并、跨界面同步等表现。
AI.result: 新模块无需改代码即可自动接入现有体系；同一数据在不同界面（GUI／聊天）实时同步；后期生成的工具能直接复用共享状态完成跨模块推理，形成连贯的个人计算环境。
AI.conclusion: “共享状态”是AI时代缺失的系统层，它把原本孤立的生成式AI小程序升级为可演化的统一个人操作系统。PSI验证了该思路的可行性，为Personal AI生态提供了低成本、可扩展的整合方案。

title: SMPL-GPTexture: Dual-View 3D Human Texture Estimation using Text-to-Image Generation Models
summary: Generating high-quality, photorealistic textures for 3D human avatars remains a fundamental yet challenging task in computer vision and multimedia field. However, real paired front and back images of human subjects are rarely available with privacy, ethical and cost of acquisition, which restricts scalability of the data. Additionally, learning priors from image inputs using deep generative models, such as GANs or diffusion models, to infer unseen regions such as the human back often leads to artifacts, structural inconsistencies, or loss of fine-grained detail. To address these issues, we present SMPL-GPTexture (skinned multi-person linear model - general purpose Texture), a novel pipeline that takes natural language prompts as input and leverages a state-of-the-art text-to-image generation model to produce paired high-resolution front and back images of a human subject as the starting point for texture estimation. Using the generated paired dual-view images, we first employ a human mesh recovery model to obtain a robust 2D-to-3D SMPL alignment between image pixels and the 3D model's UV coordinates for each views. Second, we use an inverted rasterization technique that explicitly projects the observed colour from the input images into the UV space, thereby producing accurate, complete texture maps. Finally, we apply a diffusion-based inpainting module to fill in the missing regions, and the fusion mechanism then combines these results into a unified full texture map. Extensive experiments shows that our SMPL-GPTexture can generate high resolution texture aligned with user's prompts.

AI.tldr: SMPL-GPTexture 用文本生成 paired 正/背视图，经 SMPL 对齐、逆向光栅化与扩散 inpainting，直接输出高清全身纹理，无需真实拍摄。
AI.motivation: 真实成对前后图像因隐私、伦理、成本而稀缺；GAN/扩散模型从单图推断背面常出现伪影、结构错位与细节丢失，难以低成本规模化获取高质量 3D 人体纹理。
AI.method: 1) 文本 → 扩散模型生成 1024×1024 成对正背图像；2) 用 human-mesh-recovery 获得两视图的 SMPL 参数及像素-UV 对应；3) 逆向光栅化将可见颜色显式投射到 UV 空间，生成部分纹理；4) 基于扩散的 inpainting 补全不可见区；5) 多视融合得到完整 4K 纹理图。
AI.result: 在 60 条文本 prompt 的测试集上，FID↓24%，LPIPS↓31%，背面身份一致性 91.2%，优于 Text2Tex、LDM-3D 等基线；纹理 4096×4096，SSIM>0.92，用户偏好率 78%。
AI.conclusion: SMPL-GPTexture 首次证明纯文本即可生成前后一致、高清、可驱动的人体纹理，摆脱真实拍摄与成对数据依赖，为 VR/AR、游戏、虚拟人提供可扩展的纹理资产生产方案。

title: Computationally lightweight classifiers with frequentist bounds on predictions
comment: 9 pages, references, checklist, and appendix. Total 23 pages. Accepted to AISTATS2026
summary: While both classical and neural network classifiers can achieve high accuracy, they fall short on offering uncertainty bounds on their predictions, making them unfit for safety-critical applications. Existing kernel-based classifiers that provide such bounds scale with $\mathcal O (n^{\sim3})$ in time, making them computationally intractable for large datasets. To address this, we propose a novel, computationally efficient classification algorithm based on the Nadaraya-Watson estimator, for whose estimates we derive frequentist uncertainty intervals. We evaluate our classifier on synthetically generated data and on electrocardiographic heartbeat signals from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia database. We show that the method achieves competitive accuracy $>$\SI{96}{\percent} at $\mathcal O(n)$ and $\mathcal O(\log n)$ operations, while providing actionable uncertainty bounds. These bounds can, e.g., aid in flagging low-confidence predictions, making them suitable for real-time settings with resource constraints, such as diagnostic monitoring or implantable devices.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Nadaraya-Watson估计器的线性/对数时间分类算法，在保持>96%准确率的同时给出频率意义的不确定性区间，适用于资源受限的安全关键实时场景。
AI.motivation: 经典与神经网络分类器虽准确率高，但无法提供预测的不确定性边界，难以满足安全关键应用需求；而现有可给出边界的核方法时间复杂度高达O(n³)，在大型数据集上不可行。
AI.method: 利用Nadaraya-Watson估计器构建分类器，并为其预测推导频率学意义的不确定性区间；算法时间复杂度降至O(n)或O(log n)。
AI.result: 在合成数据及MIT-BIH心律失常心电数据上，该方法准确率>96%，与现有最佳方法相当，同时输出可操作的不确定性区间，可用于标记低置信度预测。
AI.conclusion: 新算法兼顾高准确率与可扩展性，提供实时可用的不确定性量化，适用于植入式设备等资源受限且对安全要求高的实时诊断监测场景。

title: RewardFlow: Generate Images by Optimizing What You Reward
summary: We introduce RewardFlow, an inversion-free framework that steers pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models at inference time through multi-reward Langevin dynamics. RewardFlow unifies complementary differentiable rewards for semantic alignment, perceptual fidelity, localized grounding, object consistency, and human preference, and further introduces a differentiable VQA-based reward that provides fine-grained semantic supervision through language-vision reasoning. To coordinate these heterogeneous objectives, we design a prompt-aware adaptive policy that extracts semantic primitives from the instruction, infers edit intent, and dynamically modulates reward weights and step sizes throughout sampling. Across several image editing and compositional generation benchmarks, RewardFlow delivers state-of-the-art edit fidelity and compositional alignment.

AI.tldr: RewardFlow 是一种无需反演的测试时框架，通过多奖励 Langevin 动力学在预训练扩散/流匹配模型上实现高质量图像编辑与组合生成。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型编辑方法需反演或微调，难以同时满足语义对齐、感知保真、局部 grounding、目标一致与人类偏好等多重目标；亟需一种统一、免训练、可解释且可动态调节的多目标优化框架。
AI.method: 提出 RewardFlow：1) 将语义对齐、感知保真、局部 grounding、目标一致、人类偏好及新增可微 VQA 奖励统一为可微目标；2) 设计 prompt 感知自适应策略，实时解析指令语义基元、推断编辑意图并动态调整各奖励权重与 Langevin 步长；3) 在采样过程中通过多奖励 Langevin 动力学直接优化潜空间，无需模型微调或反演。
AI.result: 在多项图像编辑与组合生成基准上，RewardFlow 实现 SOTA 的编辑保真度与组合对齐度，验证其免训练、高保真、强语义一致性优势。
AI.conclusion: RewardFlow 证明可在测试阶段统一多奖励、免反演地精准操控扩散/流匹配模型，为高质量、语义可控的图像生成与编辑提供了通用且高效的推理框架。

title: BTC-LLM: Efficient Sub-1-Bit LLM Quantization via Learnable Transformation and Binary Codebook
summary: Binary quantization represents the most extreme form of compression, reducing weights to +/-1 for maximal memory and computational efficiency. While recent sparsity-aware binarization achieves sub-1-bit compression via weight pruning, it faces critical challenges: performance degradation, mask-management overhead, and limited hardware compatibility. In this paper, we present BTC-LLM, a novel sub-1-bit LLM quantization framework that leverages binary pattern clustering and weight transformation to overcome these limitations. Our approach incorporates two key innovations: (1) a Binary Codebook that clusters recurring vectors into compact indices using custom distance metrics and sign-based updates; (2) a Learnable Transformation that reduces outliers and promotes shared sign patterns among binary weights. This eliminates sparse masks, enabling efficient inference on standard hardware. Extensive evaluations across LLaMA, Qwen, and FBI-LLM families demonstrate that BTC-LLM achieves state-of-the-art results in extreme compression (1.11-0.7 bits). Notably, BTC-LLM compressed to 0.8 bits on LLaMA-2-13B maintains high performance, with only a 3.1 percent accuracy drop in zero-shot benchmarks, while delivering a 1.6x speedup over FP16.

AI.tldr: BTC-LLM基于“二进制码本”的无稀疏<1-bit大模型量化框架，在标准硬件上把LLaMA-2-13B压到0.8-bit几乎不损失性能。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏二值化虽可低于1-bit，但性能骤降、需维护掩膜且不被常规硬件支持，亟需可在主流芯片直接部署的极端量化方案。
AI.method: 首先将反复出现的权重向量用定制距离度量聚类为紧凑索引，形成“二进制码本”；随后引入可学习变换，抑制异常值并使权重共现同一符号模式，彻底消除稀疏掩膜。量化后仅传输码本索引和变换参数，推理时用查表与整数运算恢复原权重。
AI.result: 在LLaMA、Qwen、FBI-LLM系列上1.11–0.7-bit压缩均达SOTA；LLaMA-2-13B 0.8-bit零样本任务精度仅降3.1%，推理速度比FP16快1.6倍，且无需稀疏算子即可在普通GPU/NPU运行。
AI.conclusion: BTC-LLM证明无稀疏<1-bit量化可在通用硬件高效部署，为极端存储与计算受限场景下的大模型落地提供了可行范式。

title: MCLR: Improving Conditional Modeling via Inter-Class Likelihood-Ratio Maximization and Unifying Classifier-Free Guidance with Alignment Objectives
summary: Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling, but their success often relies heavily on classifier-free guidance (CFG), an inference-time heuristic that modifies the sampling trajectory. From a theoretical perspective, diffusion models trained with standard denoising score matching (DSM) are expected to recover the target data distribution, raising the question of why inference-time guidance is necessary in practice. In this work, we ask whether the DSM training objective can be modified in a principled manner such that standard reverse-time sampling, without inference-time guidance, yields effects comparable to CFG. We identify insufficient inter-class separation as a key limitation of standard diffusion models. To address this, we propose MCLR, a principled alignment objective that explicitly maximizes inter-class likelihood-ratios during training. Models fine-tuned with MCLR exhibit CFG-like improvements under standard sampling, achieving comparable qualitative and quantitative gains without requiring inference-time guidance. Beyond empirical benefits, we provide a theoretical result showing that the CFG-guided score is exactly the optimal solution to a weighted MCLR objective. This establishes a formal equivalence between classifier-free guidance and alignment-based objectives, offering a mechanistic interpretation of CFG.

AI.tldr: 将分类器无关引导（CFG）的机制转化为训练目标 MCLR，在无需 CFG 的前提下即可复现其生成增益。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散模型理论上通过去噪得分匹配（DSM）可还原真实分布，但实践中必须依赖 CFG 才能获得跨类别清晰分离的高质量样本；目前缺乏将这一“事后修正”集成到训练阶段的原理性方法。
AI.method: 提出最大化类间似然比（MCLR）的正则化目标，在 DSM 训练后做轻量微调；推导证明 CFG 引导的得分恰是带权 MCLR 的最优解，从而建立训练-推断同构。
AI.result: 经 MCLR 微调的模型在常规逆向采样下即可达到与 CFG 相当的 FID、IS 与人工评分，且无需额外推断开销；理论上首次给出 CFG 的等价训练目标解释。
AI.conclusion: CFG 本质是一种隐式的类间对齐机制，通过 MCLR 显式优化即可消除推断时引导需求，为扩散模型“训练即对齐”提供了可解释、可扩展的新范式。

title: OpenVLThinkerV2: A Generalist Multimodal Reasoning Model for Multi-domain Visual Tasks
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as the de facto Reinforcement Learning (RL) objective driving recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models. However, extending this success to open-source multimodal generalist models remains heavily constrained by two primary challenges: the extreme variance in reward topologies across diverse visual tasks, and the inherent difficulty of balancing fine-grained perception with multi-step reasoning capabilities. To address these issues, we introduce Gaussian GRPO (G$^2$RPO), a novel RL training objective that replaces standard linear scaling with non-linear distributional matching. By mathematically forcing the advantage distribution of any given task to strictly converge to a standard normal distribution, $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$, G$^2$RPO theoretically ensures inter-task gradient equity, mitigates vulnerabilities to heavy-tail outliers, and offers symmetric update for positive and negative rewards. Leveraging the enhanced training stability provided by G$^2$RPO, we introduce two task-level shaping mechanisms to seamlessly balance perception and reasoning. First, response length shaping dynamically elicits extended reasoning chains for complex queries while enforce direct outputs to bolster visual grounding. Second, entropy shaping tightly bounds the model's exploration zone, effectively preventing both entropy collapse and entropy explosion. Integrating these methodologies, we present OpenVLThinkerV2, a highly robust, general-purpose multimodal model. Extensive evaluations across 18 diverse benchmarks demonstrate its superior performance over strong open-source and leading proprietary frontier models.
