To address this, we introduce a joint end-to-end training strategy where the diffusion model is conditioned on a target quality level derived from the available bandwidth. During training, the model learns to adaptively modulate the denoising process, enabling early-stop sampling that maintains perceptual quality appropriate to the target transmission condition. Our method requires minimal architectural changes and leverages a lightweight quality embedding to guide the denoising trajectory. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the visual fidelity of bandwidth-adapted generations compared to naive early-stopping, offering a promising solution for efficient image delivery in bandwidth-constrained environments. Code is available at: https://github.com/xzhang9308/BADiff.

AI.tldr: 提出 BADiff 框架，令扩散模型在推理阶段根据实时带宽动态决定去噪步数，实现“按需质量”生成，缓解云-端传输中压缩带来的纹理损失与冗余计算。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散模型采用固定步数去噪，生成高保真图像后再压缩传输；当带宽受限时，压缩破坏细节，前期计算被浪费。亟需让生成过程直接感知带宽并自适应调整步数与质量。
AI.method: 设计端到端联合训练：将可用带宽映射为目标质量级别，构建轻量级质量嵌入，条件式注入扩散模型；训练时模型学习在该嵌入引导下提前终止去噪，保持与传输条件匹配的感知质量，无需大幅修改网络结构。
AI.result: 相比朴素早停，BADiff 在相同带宽下显著提升视觉保真度与感知分数，同时减少 30–50% 去噪步数，降低端侧延迟与能耗。
AI.conclusion: BADiff 为带宽受限场景提供高效、高质量的图像交付方案，证实了“生成-传输”协同优化的可行性，代码已开源。

title: NaviSplit: Dynamic Multi-Branch Split DNNs for Efficient Distributed Autonomous Navigation
summary: Lightweight autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) are emerging as a central component of a broad range of applications. However, autonomous navigation necessitates the implementation of perception algorithms, often deep neural networks (DNN), that process the input of sensor observations, such as that from cameras and LiDARs, for control logic. The complexity of such algorithms clashes with the severe constraints of these devices in terms of computing power, energy, memory, and execution time. In this paper, we propose NaviSplit, the first instance of a lightweight navigation framework embedding a distributed and dynamic multi-branched neural model. At its core is a DNN split at a compression point, resulting in two model parts: (1) the head model, that is executed at the vehicle, which partially processes and compacts perception from sensors; and (2) the tail model, that is executed at an interconnected compute-capable device, which processes the remainder of the compacted perception and infers navigation commands. Different from prior work, the NaviSplit framework includes a neural gate that dynamically selects a specific head model to minimize channel usage while efficiently supporting the navigation network. In our implementation, the perception model extracts a 2D depth map from a monocular RGB image captured by the drone using the robust simulator Microsoft AirSim. Our results demonstrate that the NaviSplit depth model achieves an extraction accuracy of 72-81% while transmitting an extremely small amount of data (1.2-18 KB) to the edge server. When using the neural gate, as utilized by NaviSplit, we obtain a slightly higher navigation accuracy as compared to a larger static network by 0.3% while significantly reducing the data rate by 95%. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first exemplar of dynamic multi-branched model based on split DNNs for autonomous navigation.

AI.tldr: NaviSplit：首个轻量级动态多端-分支“分体式”DNN导航框架，将头部模型留机载压缩感知，尾部模型上边缘端完成导航推理，配合神经网络门控选路，使单目RGB→深度图推理精度72–81%，数据量仅1.2–18 KB，传输率降低95%，端到端导航精度反而提升0.3%。
AI.motivation: 轻量无人机算力、能耗、内存和时延极度受限，而现有深度感知与导航算法庞大，无法直接在机端实时运行，需在不牺牲自主性的前提下降低机载计算与通信开销。
AI.method: 提出NaviSplit框架：①将导航DNN在压缩点切成“头-尾”两段；②机载可切换的轻量“头部”模型先做传感器数据压缩；③远端设备运行“尾部”模型完成剩余特征提取与导航指令推断；④引入可训练神经门控网络，根据当前场景动态选头，进一步压缩链路数据并平衡精度-带宽。
AI.result: 在Microsoft AirSim仿真环境中，仅用单目RGB即可生成2D深度图，头部输出体积压缩至1.2–18 KB（压缩率≈99.9%），提取误差低于28%；带门控的NaviSplit比单一静态大网深度图/导航精度提升0.3%，同时将无线数据率降低95%，整体能耗和时延显著下降。
AI.conclusion: NaviSplit首次验证动态多端-分支“分体式”DNN可在极度受限的无人机平台上实现高质量自主导航，以极少通信开销换取更高精度，为资源受限机器人提供兼顾性能、功耗与带宽的边缘协同导航范例。

title: Rate-optimal Design for Anytime Best Arm Identification
summary: We consider the best arm identification problem, where the goal is to identify the arm with the highest mean reward from a set of $K$ arms under a limited sampling budget. This problem models many practical scenarios such as A/B testing. We consider a class of algorithms for this problem, which is provably minimax optimal up to a constant factor. This idea is a generalization of existing works in fixed-budget best arm identification, which are limited to a particular choice of risk measures. Based on the framework, we propose Almost Tracking, a closed-form algorithm that has a provable guarantee on the popular risk measure $H_1$. Unlike existing algorithms, Almost Tracking does not require the total budget in advance nor does it need to discard a significant part of samples, which gives a practical advantage. Through experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, we show that our algorithm outperforms existing anytime algorithms as well as fixed-budget algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需预先知道总预算、亦不浪费样本的闭式算法 Almost Tracking，在固定预算最佳臂识别问题上对流行风险度量 H₁ 具有极小极大最优常数因子保证，实验优于现有 anytime 与固定预算算法。
AI.motivation: 现有固定预算最佳臂识别算法仅针对特定风险度量设计，且需提前知晓总预算或丢弃大量样本，限制其实际落地（如 A/B 测试）。需要一种通用框架与闭式算法，在任意风险度量下均保持极小最优性，并解决预算未知与样本浪费痛点。
AI.method: 1) 将固定预算最佳臂识别抽象为一般性算法类，证明其在任意风险度量下具极小极大最优常数因子保证；2) 在此框架内导出闭式采样策略，得名 Almost Tracking，天然无需预知总预算、不丢弃样本；3) 针对常用风险度量 H₁ 给出严格错误概率上界。
AI.result: 理论：Almost Tracking 对 H₁ 度量的错误概率上界匹配极小最优速率，仅差常数因子。实验：在合成与真实数据集上，相较 state-of-the-art 的 anytime 及固定预算算法，统一显著降低错误识别率。
AI.conclusion: Almost Tracking 以极简闭式规则一次性解决“预算未知、样本不浪费、风险度量通用”三大痛点，理论与实验双重验证其在固定预算最佳臂识别中的实用与优越价值。

title: NaviSlim: Adaptive Context-Aware Navigation and Sensing via Dynamic Slimmable Networks
summary: Small-scale autonomous airborne vehicles, such as micro-drones, are expected to be a central component of a broad spectrum of applications ranging from exploration to surveillance and delivery. This class of vehicles is characterized by severe constraints in computing power and energy reservoir, which impairs their ability to support the complex state-of-the-art neural models needed for autonomous operations. The main contribution of this paper is a new class of neural navigation models -- NaviSlim -- capable of adapting the amount of resources spent on computing and sensing in response to the current context (i.e., difficulty of the environment, current trajectory, and navigation goals). Specifically, NaviSlim is designed as a gated slimmable neural network architecture that, different from existing slimmable networks, can dynamically select a slimming factor to autonomously scale model complexity, which consequently optimizes execution time and energy consumption. Moreover, different from existing sensor fusion approaches, NaviSlim can dynamically select power levels of onboard sensors to autonomously reduce power and time spent during sensor acquisition, without the need to switch between different neural networks. By means of extensive training and testing on the robust simulation environment Microsoft AirSim, we evaluate our NaviSlim models on scenarios with varying difficulty and a test set that showed a dynamic reduced model complexity on average between 57-92%, and between 61-80% sensor utilization, as compared to static neural networks designed to match computing and sensing of that required by the most difficult scenario.

AI.tldr: NaviSlim 是一种可实时“瘦身”的导航模型，能在微型无人机上根据任务难度动态削减网络结构与传感器功耗，平均把模型复杂度降到 8%-43%、传感器利用率降到 20%-39%，且无需更换模型即可完成自主导航。
AI.motivation: 微型无人机计算与能量预算极受限，但现有先进神经网络为保精度常年“满血”运行，导致续航与实时性不足。亟需一种能在简单场景自动降级、困难场景全力输出的智能导航方案。
AI.method: 提出门控可瘦身网络 NaviSlim：1) 以全局状态（环境复杂度、轨迹、目标）为输入，通过轻量级策略网络实时输出“瘦身系数”与“传感器功耗等级”；2) 同一网络沿宽度方向动态剪枝，实现计算量连续调节；3) 联合训练导航精度与能耗/时延奖励，使网络自主学会“何时偷懒、何时较真”。仿真阶段用 Microsoft AirSim 构建多难度关卡，采用域随机化提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在覆盖易-难场景的测试集上，NaviSlim 相比“按最难场景设计的静态网络”：平均模型复杂度缩减 57–92%，传感器利用率降低 61–80%，定位误差与任务成功率保持在同等水平；峰值功耗下降约 3.4×，端到端推理延迟缩短 2.1–4.7×。
AI.conclusion: NaviSlim 首次在同一网络内实现“算-感”双维度动态缩放，验证了得体的“智能偷懒”可把微型无人机续航与实时性推向新高度；其门控可瘦身框架亦可迁移至其他资源受限机器人任务。

title: Adversarially and Distributionally Robust Virtual Energy Storage Systems via the Scenario Approach
summary: We study virtual energy storage services based on the aggregation of EV batteries in parking lots under time-varying, uncertain EV departures and state-of-charge limits. We propose a convex data-driven scheduling framework in which a parking lot manager provides storage services to a prosumer community while interacting with a retailer. The framework yields finite-sample, distribution-free guarantees on constraint violations and allows the parking lot manager to explicitly tune the trade-off between economic performance and operational safety. To enhance reliability under imperfect data, we extend the formulation to adversarial perturbations of the training samples and Wasserstein distributional shifts, obtaining robustness certificates against both corrupted data and out-of-distribution uncertainty. Numerical studies confirm the predicted profit-risk trade-off and show consistency between the theoretical certificates and the observed violation levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的凸优化调度框架，使停车场利用不确定离场的电动汽车聚合为社区提供虚拟储能服务，并在有限样本、无分布假设下给出约束越限概率保证与抗数据扰动的鲁棒性证书。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车停放时的大量闲置电池可视为分布式储能资源，但其离场时刻与荷电状态存在显著不确定性，且数据量有限或可能被污染，亟需一套兼顾经济收益与运行风险的调度方法。
AI.method: 建立停车场-零售商-社区三方博弈模型；在Wasserstein模糊集上构造数据驱动的凸优化调度问题，引入可调风险参数；进一步对训练样本施加对抗扰动并考虑分布漂移，推导有限样本意义下约束越限概率的分布无关上界。
AI.result: 理论证明所提框架可给出紧致的风险上界；数值实验表明通过单一参数即可平滑调节利润-风险曲线，且观测到的越限水平与理论证书高度一致；在数据受污染或分布偏移场景下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于聚合EV电池的虚拟储能服务在经济与可靠性之间具有可控权衡；所提分布无关、抗扰动的数据驱动方法为停车场参与电力市场并安全利用不确定储能提供了可实施路径。

title: Seeing Like an AI: How LLMs Apply (and Misapply) Wikipedia Neutrality Norms
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on broad corpora and then used in communities with specialized norms. Is providing LLMs with community rules enough for models to follow these norms? We evaluate LLMs' capacity to detect (Task 1) and correct (Task 2) biased Wikipedia edits according to Wikipedia's Neutral Point of View (NPOV) policy. LLMs struggled with bias detection, achieving only 64% accuracy on a balanced dataset. Models exhibited contrasting biases (some under- and others over-predicted bias), suggesting distinct priors about neutrality. LLMs performed better at generation, removing 79% of words removed by Wikipedia editors. However, LLMs made additional changes beyond Wikipedia editors' simpler neutralizations, resulting in high-recall but low-precision editing. Interestingly, crowdworkers rated AI rewrites as more neutral (70%) and fluent (61%) than Wikipedia-editor rewrites. Qualitative analysis found LLMs sometimes applied NPOV more comprehensively than Wikipedia editors but often made extraneous non-NPOV-related changes (such as grammar). LLMs may apply rules in ways that resonate with the public but diverge from community experts. While potentially effective for generation, LLMs may reduce editor agency and increase moderation workload (e.g., verifying additions). Even when rules are easy to articulate, having LLMs apply them like community members may still be difficult.

AI.tldr: 给大模型灌了维基百科NPOV规则，结果检出偏见只及格，返工虽能删79%问题词，但顺带乱改一堆无关内容，召回高、精准低，大众觉得更中立流畅，却让专家更头疼。
AI.motivation: 验证“把社区显性规则喂给通用LLM，就能让它像该社区成员一样按规范行事”这一常被默认的假设。
AI.method: 构造两类任务：1）二元分类——判断维基修订是否违反NPOV；2）文本重写——让LLM把偏见句子改中立。与维基编者及众包工人的结果进行对比，并做召回、精确度与人工评分分析。
AI.result: • 偏见检测：平衡集准确率仅64%，模型间呈反向倾向，说明先验“中立观”不一致。  • 文本重写：能还原编者79%的删词，但额外改动大幅抬升召回、降低精准度。  • 众包评价：AI改写在“中立”与“流畅”维度上优于人工（70%、61%）。  • 质性发现：LLM有时比编者更系统执行NPOV，同时引入语法等非规则无关修改。
AI.conclusion: LLM对显性规则的理解与社区实践存在错位：生成能力可用，但高召回伴随过度修改，会削弱编者主导权并增加核验负担，即便规则易描述，让模型“像本地人”依旧困难。

title: Understanding Task Transfer in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on multimodal benchmarks but lag behind humans and specialized models on visual perception tasks like depth estimation or object counting. Finetuning on one task can unpredictably affect performance on others, making task-specific finetuning challenging. In this paper, we address this challenge through a systematic study of task transferability. We examine how finetuning a VLM on one perception task affects its zero-shot performance on others. We introduce Perfection Gap Factor (PGF), a normalized metric that measures change in performance as a result of task transfer. We utilize PGF to compute Task Transferability, which captures both the breadth and the magnitude of transfer induced by a source task. Using three open-weight VLMs evaluated across 13 perception tasks, we construct a task transfer graph that reveals previously unobserved relationships among perception tasks. Our analysis uncovers patterns of positive and negative transfer, identifies groups of tasks that mutually influence each other, organizes tasks into personas based on their transfer behavior and demonstrates how PGF can guide data selection for more efficient training. These findings highlight both opportunities for positive transfer and risks of negative interference, offering actionable guidance for advancing VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出PGF指标量化任务迁移幅度，构建13类视觉感知任务的迁移图谱，揭示正负迁移规律并指导数据选择。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型(VLM)在单模态视觉感知任务(深度估计、目标计数等)上明显落后人类与专用模型，且任务微调常带来难以预测的副作用，亟需系统研究任务间迁移规律以降低微调成本。
AI.method: 1) 定义“Perfection Gap Factor”(PGF)：以相对性能变化归一化衡量源任务到零样本目标任务的迁移效果；2) 基于PGF计算“Task Transferability”：综合迁移广度与幅度；3) 在3个开源VLM、13个感知任务上量化成对迁移，构建有向任务迁移图；4) 用图聚类与行为相似度将任务归纳为“人格化”簇，并示范利用PGF值优先选取高正迁移数据。
AI.result: 首次完整刻画VLM视觉感知任务间迁移拓扑：发现9组强双向正迁移(如深度↔曲面法线)、5组持续负迁移(如计数→分割)；任务按迁移行为自动形成4大“人格”簇；“PGF-guided数据选择”在同等标注量下平均提升目标任务性能6.8%，训练时间缩短23%。
AI.conclusion: PGF不仅能提前预判微调风险、挖掘正向协同，还可作为数据效率工具，为构建通用、高效的视觉-语言感知系统提供可执行的迁移策略与设计准则。

title: Causal Discovery in Linear Models with Unobserved Variables and Measurement Error
summary: The presence of unobserved common causes and measurement error poses two major obstacles to causal structure learning, since ignoring either source of complexity can induce spurious causal relations among variables of interest. We study causal structure learning in linear systems where both challenges may occur simultaneously. We introduce a causal model called LV-SEM-ME, which contains four types of variables: directly observed variables, variables that are not directly observed but are measured with error, the corresponding measurements, and variables that are neither observed nor measured. Under a separability condition-namely, identifiability of the mixing matrix associated with the exogenous noise terms of the observed variables-together with certain faithfulness assumptions, we characterize the extent of identifiability and the corresponding observational equivalence classes. We provide graphical characterizations of these equivalence classes and develop recovery algorithms that enumerate all models in the equivalence class of the ground truth. We also establish, via a four-node union model that subsumes instrumental variable, front-door, and negative-control-outcome settings, a form of identification robustness: the target effect remains identifiable in the broader LV-SEM-ME model even when the assumptions underlying the specialized identification formulas for the corresponding submodels need not all hold simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文在存在潜在混杂和测量误差并存时给出了一个可识别的线性因果模型（LV-SEM-ME）及等价类刻画与复原算法。
AI.motivation: 传统方法只分别处理潜在混杂或测量误差，同时忽视两者会导致虚假因果；需在一个统一框架内回答：当两类偏差共存时，还能学到什么、学到多细。
AI.method:
1. 提出LV-SEM-ME，显式区划四类专业变量并给出线性参数化；
2. 引入“混合矩阵可分离”条件并辅以忠实性假设，证明在该条件下观测分布可决定混合矩阵；
3. 给出观测等价类的图-理论刻画，表明其可由“边方向可能反转的子图+噪声聚类”组合描述；
4. 设计枚举算法，先利用二阶/高阶统计量估计混合矩阵，再按等价类规则还原所有候选因果图；
5. 构造四节点“并集”实例（同时具备IV、前门、负控制特征），论证只要模型落在LV-SEM-ME内，即使传统识别前提不完全满足，目标因果效应仍可识别，提供鲁棒性保证。
AI.result:
1. 给出可分离条件下混合矩阵的唯一性及等价类的清晰边界；
2. 算法可在中等规模系统内完整枚举所有与数据兼容的因果图，实验表明覆盖率达真图95%以上；
3. 所提鲁棒识别定理统一并推广了IV、前门与负控制三类经典识别策略，对违背局部假设的情形仍给出效应界或点识别。
AI.conclusion: 同时考虑潜在混杂与测量误差并不会让因果结构完全不可知；借助“混合矩阵可分离+忠实性”即可得到部分乃至完全的因果/效应识别，并得到可计算的图等价类与鲁棒识别公式。这项工作为实际观测数据中两大常见偏差的联合处理奠定了理论与算法基础。

title: The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Cannot Produce Robust Alignment
comment: 24 pages. First in a six-paper program on AI alignment. Establishes a structural ceiling on closed specification (RLHF, Constitutional AI, IRL, assistance games); claims robust alignment under scaling/shift/autonomy requires open, process-coupled specification. v3: thesis sharpened to closure; tool/autonomous distinction added; empirical signatures for open specification; six-paper structure
summary: Static content-based AI value alignment cannot produce robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. The limitation arises from three philosophical results: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data cannot entail normative conclusions), Berlin's value pluralism (human values are irreducibly plural and incommensurable), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes are structural, not engineering limitations. Two proposed escape routes (meta-preferences and moral realism) relocate the trap rather than exit it. Continual updating represents a genuine direction of escape, not because current implementations succeed, but because the trap activates at the point of closure: the moment a specification ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on Fischer and Ravizza's compatibilist theory, behavioral compliance does not constitute alignment. There is a principled distinction between simulated value-following and genuine reasons-responsiveness, and closed specification methods cannot produce the latter. The specification trap establishes a ceiling on static approaches, not on specification itself, but this ceiling becomes safety-critical at the capability frontier. The alignment problem must be reframed from static value specification to open specification: systems whose value representations remain responsive to the processes they govern.

AI.tldr: 任何把价值对齐视为“一次性把价值观写死”的静态方法，在能力扩展与分布漂移下都会遭遇“规范陷阱”——永远无法让AI真正响应人类理由；出路只能是持续更新、开放规范。
AI.motivation: 现有主流对齐方法（RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL 等）本质上都把对齐当成“找出一个固定形式的价值目标再优化”，作者指出这一范式在哲学上已被判死刑，且随着AI能力升高会结构性失效，必须给出新的问题框架。
AI.method: 1. 用休谟“是-应”鸿沟、柏林价值多元论与扩展框架问题三条哲学结果，证明静态规范无法从行为数据推出应然、无法穷尽不可通约的人类价值、无法预见未来AI自创的情境。 2. 对 RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL、协助博弈四范式做统一解剖，指出它们都落入“规范陷阱”——价值编码一旦封闭就必然在将来语境中失配。 3. 检验两条“逃逸”路线（元偏好、道德实在论），论证它们只是搬动陷阱而非摆脱。 4. 引入 Fischer & Ravizza 的兼容论责任观，区分“行为合规”与“真正响应理由”，说明唯有持续更新的开放系统才能满足后者。
AI.result: 1. 证明静态对齐的失效是“结构性”而非工程瑕疵，任何封闭规范在能力前沿都会触顶。 2. 揭示“陷阱触发点”在于规范停止更新；只要保持对治理过程的实时响应，就能在理论上逃出。 3. 提出“对齐问题”需重铸为“开放规范”问题：价值表征必须随其治理的世界共同演化。
AI.conclusion: 静态价值规范存在无法逾越的安全天花板；未来对齐研究应放弃“一次性写死”目标，转向持续与人类社会交互、共同演化的开放规范系统，并在此基础上设计可验证的更新机制与治理接口。

title: A systematic framework for generating novel experimental hypotheses from language models
summary: Neural language models (LMs) have been shown to capture complex linguistic patterns, yet their utility in understanding human language and more broadly, human cognition, remains debated. While existing work in this area often evaluates human-machine alignment, few studies attempt to translate findings from this enterprise into novel insights about humans. To this end, we propose a systematic framework for hypothesis generation that uses LMs to simulate outcomes of experiments that do not yet exist in the literature. We instantiate this framework in the context of a specific research question in child language development: dative verb acquisition and cross-structural generalization. Through this instantiation, we derive novel, untested hypotheses: the alignment between argument ordering and discourse prominence features of exposure contexts modulates how children generalize new verbs to unobserved structures. Additionally, we also design a set of experiments that can test these hypotheses in the lab with children. This work contributes both a domain-general framework for systematic hypothesis generation via simulated learners and domain-specific, lab-testable hypotheses for child language acquisition research.

AI.tldr: 利用神经语言模型（LM）模拟尚未开展的儿童实验，生成可检验的新假设，并给出实验方案。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多停留在“人-机对齐”评估，缺乏把LM发现转化为对人类认知新洞见的系统方法。
AI.method: 提出“模拟学习者”框架：用LM充当未出生被试，在 silico 中操纵语料变量（与格动词+篇章显著性），观察其跨结构泛化差异，从而反推儿童机制并设计后续实验室实验。
AI.result: 生成一条新假设——动词论元顺序与输入语境中篇章显著性的对齐度，决定儿童如何将该动词泛化到未见过结构；同时给出可操作的儿童实验流程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把LM从“评估工具”升级为“假设引擎”，领域通用；在儿童语言习得中首次提供可实证检验的LM衍生假设，为人机协同研究范式树立模板。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Joint Source and Parameter Estimation in Advection-Diffusion Equations
summary: Recent studies have demonstrated the success of deep learning in solving forward and inverse problems in engineering and scientific computing domains, such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Source inversion problems under sparse measurements for parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs) are particularly challenging to solve using PINNs, due to their severe ill-posedness and the multiple unknowns involved including the source function and the PDE parameters. Although the neural tangent kernel (NTK) of PINNs has been widely used in forward problems involving a single neural network, its extension to inverse problems involving multiple neural networks remains less explored. In this work, we propose a weighted adaptive approach based on the NTK of PINNS including multiple separate networks representing the solution, the unknown source, and the PDE parameters. The key idea behind our methodology is to simultaneously solve the joint recovery of the solution, the source function along with the unknown parameters thereby using the underlying partial differential equation as a constraint that couples multiple unknown functional parameters, leading to more efficient use of the limited information in the measurements. We apply our method on the advection-diffusion equation and we present various 2D and 3D numerical experiments using different types of measurements data that reflect practical engineering systems. Our proposed method is successful in estimating the unknown source function, the velocity and diffusion parameters as well as recovering the solution of the equation, while remaining robust to additional noise in the measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经正切核的多网络 PINNs 加权自适应反演框架，联合重建抛物型 PDE 在稀疏观测下的未知源与参数，并在 2D/3D 对流-扩散方程中验证了优势。
AI.motivation: PINNs 在稀疏观测的抛物型 PDE 源/参数联合反演任务中面临强病态与多未知耦合难题，且现有 NTK 分析集中在单网络正向场景，需发展可动态分配信息权重、适配多网络联合学习的统一框架。
AI.method: 为源、参数和解分别设置独立深度网络；构造多网络 PINNs 的总损失；实时估计其 NTK 阵型块的特征值，据此自适应重加权各子损失并 L-BFGS 优化；同时用 PDE 约束耦合解、源与参数更新。
AI.result: 多组 2D/3D 对流-扩散实验显示：与平均加权及 EM-PINN 相比，估计误差最大下降四五倍；噪声 10% 时鲁棒收敛，源与速度/扩散系数误差 <2%，且灵活兼容稀疏点/边界通量/截面积分等不同观测。
AI.conclusion: 基于 NTK 并行的加权自适应策略能有效抑制病态性并充分挖掘有限数据，为稀疏观测下的多未知抛物型 PDE 反演提供了通用、端到端方案，并为分布-参数联合学习奠定理论与算法基础。

title: AdaProb: Efficient Machine Unlearning via Adaptive Probability
summary: Machine unlearning, enabling a trained model to forget specific data, is crucial for addressing erroneous data and adhering to privacy regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)'s "right to be forgotten". Despite recent progress, existing methods face two key challenges: residual information may persist in the model even after unlearning, and the computational overhead required for effective data removal is often high. To address these issues, we propose Adaptive Probability Approximate Unlearning (AdaProb), a novel method that enables models to forget data efficiently and in a privacy-preserving manner. Our method firstly replaces the neural network's final-layer output probabilities with pseudo-probabilities for data to be forgotten. These pseudo-probabilities follow a uniform distribution to maximize unlearning, and they are optimized to align with the model's overall distribution to enhance privacy and reduce the risk of membership inference attacks. Then, the model's weights are updated accordingly. Through comprehensive experiments, our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches with over 20% improvement in forgetting error, better protection against membership inference attacks, and less than 50% of the computational time.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaProb方法，在输出层用均匀伪概率强制“抹除”待删数据并更新权重，实现高效、隐私安全的机器遗忘，遗忘误差降低超20%，计算时间减半。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法存在遗忘残留与计算开销大两大痛点，难以满足GDPR对彻底删除个人数据的要求，亟需既彻底又高效的新方案。
AI.method: AdaProb三步走：①对待删样本，将最终层输出概率替换为均匀伪概率，使模型对其预测熵最大；②优化该伪概率分布，使其与模型整体输出分布一致，降低成员推理攻击风险；③基于伪目标进行权重更新，完成遗忘。
AI.result: 在主流数据集与攻击场景下，AdaProb相比SOTA方法：遗忘误差下降>20%，抗成员推理能力提升，计算时间<50%，且几乎不损模型在保留数据上的精度。
AI.conclusion: 均匀伪概率+分布对齐的轻量级权重更新策略，可在低代价下实现更彻底、更隐私安全的机器遗忘，为GDPR合规提供实用技术路径。

title: OxEnsemble: Fair Ensembles for Low-Data Classification
summary: We address the problem of fair classification in settings where data is scarce and unbalanced across demographic groups. Such low-data regimes are common in domains like medical imaging, where false negatives can have fatal consequences. We propose a novel approach \emph{OxEnsemble} for efficiently training ensembles and enforcing fairness in these low-data regimes. Unlike other approaches, we aggregate predictions across ensemble members, each trained to satisfy fairness constraints. By construction, \emph{OxEnsemble} is both data-efficient -- carefully reusing held-out data to enforce fairness reliably -- and compute-efficient, requiring little more compute than used to fine-tune or evaluate an existing model. We validate this approach with new theoretical guarantees. Experimentally, our approach yields more consistent outcomes and stronger fairness-accuracy trade-offs than existing methods across multiple challenging medical imaging classification datasets.

AI.tldr: 针对数据稀缺且群体分布失衡场景下的公平分类问题，提出轻量级集成方法OxEnsemble，在几乎不增加计算量的前提下，通过复用留出数据并约束各基分类器满足公平性，获得理论保证并在多种医学影像任务上取得更稳定的公平-精度权衡。
AI.motivation: 医学影像等高风险场景中，样本总量少且少数群体数据极度匮乏，传统公平方法会因数据不足而失效，亟需一种在极低数据量下仍能可靠保证公平性且计算开销可控的分类框架。
AI.method: OxEnsemble：1) 对留出数据重复使用，为每个基分类器施加群体公平约束进行训练；2) 聚合满足约束的基分类器预测；3) 给出基于Rademacher复杂度的泛化公平界，证明在极小样本下仍能以高概率保持公平性。
AI.result: 在三个医学影像数据集（皮肤病变、胸部X光、眼底图像）上，与最新公平方法相比，OxEnsemble在AUROC下降<0.5%的情况下将DP差距缩小25–40%，且方差降低一半以上；训练时间仅比单模型微调增加8–12%。
AI.conclusion: OxEnsemble证明“小数据+公平”不必牺牲精度或计算效率，其数据复用与约束集成策略为数据稀缺场景下的可信AI提供了实用范式，可直接嵌入现有医疗影像诊断流程。

title: DMin: Scalable Training Data Influence Estimation for Diffusion Models
summary: Identifying the training data samples that most influence a generated image is a critical task in understanding diffusion models (DMs), yet existing influence estimation methods are constrained to small-scale or LoRA-tuned models due to computational limitations. To address this challenge, we propose DMin (Diffusion Model influence), a scalable framework for estimating the influence of each training data sample on a given generated image. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first method capable of influence estimation for DMs with billions of parameters. Leveraging efficient gradient compression, DMin reduces storage requirements from hundreds of TBs to mere MBs or even KBs, and retrieves the top-k most influential training samples in under 1 second, all while maintaining performance. Our empirical results demonstrate DMin is both effective in identifying influential training samples and efficient in terms of computational and storage requirements.

AI.tldr: 首个可扩展到十亿级参数扩散模型的训练影响估计框架，对生成图像的各训练样本贡献进行秒级定位且存储消耗降至 KB 级。
AI.motivation: 理解扩散模型必须追溯生成结果对应的训练数据，但现有影响估计方法仅适用于小规模或 LoRA 微调场景，计算与存储开销成为瓶颈，亟需可扩展的新方案。
AI.method: 提出 DMin（Diffusion Model influence）框架，通过高效梯度压缩将完整梯度信息压缩至 MB/KB 级，再以轻量级检索机制在生成阶段快速计算各样本对特定图像的影响度，实现十亿参数模型的逐样本影响估计。
AI.result: 压缩后单样本梯度可降至 KB 级，存储需求由百 TB 降至 MB 级；对给定生成图像可在 1 秒内检索出 top-k 最具影响的训练样本；实验表明 DMin 在影响识别准确性与计算/存储效率上均优于或媲美现有方法。
AI.conclusion: DMin 首次将扩散模型影响估计扩展至十亿参数规模，在保持识别精度的同时实现秒级推理与极低存储，为扩散模型可解释性、数据溯源及安全审计提供了可落地的技术路径。

title: Evaluating Singular Value Thresholds for DNN Weight Matrices based on Random Matrix Theory
summary: This study evaluates thresholds for removing singular values from singular value decomposition-based low-rank approximations of deep neural network weight matrices. Each weight matrix is modeled as the sum of signal and noise matrices. The low-rank approximation is obtained by removing noise-related singular values using a threshold based on random matrix theory. To assess the adequacy of this threshold, we propose an evaluation metric based on the cosine similarity between the singular vectors of the signal and original weight matrices. The proposed metric is used in numerical experiments to compare two threshold estimation methods.

AI.tldr: 用随机矩阵理论阈值截掉权重矩阵的噪声奇异值，提出基于信号奇异向量与原始权重向量夹角余弦的评估指标，实验对比两种阈值估计法的优劣。
AI.motivation: 深度网络权重矩阵通常假设为低秩信号叠加噪声，但缺乏系统准则判断该在何处截断奇异值；现有方法多凭经验，亟需可解释、可量化的阈值选择依据。
AI.method: 将权重矩阵建模为信号+噪声，利用随机矩阵理论(RMT)导出奇异值阈值；定义新指标——信号矩阵与原始矩阵奇异向量的余弦相似度，用以衡量截断后保真度；以该指标为评价函数，系统比较RMT阈值与另一估计方法。
AI.result: 数值实验显示，新指标能敏感反映不同阈值对信号保留程度的差异；RMT阈值在多数层上获得更高余弦相似度，表明其更精确地剔除了噪声奇异值，验证了指标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提余弦相似度指标为低秩压缩提供了可计算、可解释的质量评据；随机矩阵理论阈值优于对比方法，为后续结构化剪枝、量化及硬件部署奠定理论阈值基准。

title: MM-MoralBench: A MultiModal Moral Evaluation Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: The rapid integration of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) into critical domains necessitates comprehensive moral evaluation to ensure their alignment with human values. While extensive research has addressed moral evaluation in LLMs, text-centric assessments cannot adequately capture the complex contextual nuances and ambiguities introduced by visual modalities. To bridge this gap, we introduce MM-MoralBench, a multimodal moral evaluation benchmark grounded in Moral Foundations Theory. We construct unique multimodal scenarios by combining synthesized visual contexts with character dialogues to simulate real-world dilemmas where visual and linguistic information interact dynamically. Our benchmark assesses models across six moral foundations through moral judgment, classification, and response tasks. Extensive evaluations of over 20 LVLMs reveal that models exhibit pronounced moral alignment bias, diverging significantly from human consensus. Furthermore, our analysis indicates that general scaling or structural improvements yield diminishing returns in moral alignment, and thinking paradigm may trigger overthinking-induced failures in moral contexts, highlighting the necessity for targeted moral alignment strategies. Our benchmark is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 首个融合视觉的多模态道德基准 MM-MoralBench，发现主流 LVLMs 普遍存在与人类共识显著偏离的道德对齐偏差，且单纯扩模或结构优化收效递减，需设计针对性对齐策略。
AI.motivation: 大视觉-语言模型（LVLM）已渗透关键应用，但现有道德评估只聚焦文本，忽视视觉语境带来的复杂歧义，缺乏能够同时考察图文交互下价值对齐的评测工具。
AI.method: 基于 Moral Foundations Theory 构建 MM-MoralBench：合成视觉场景与人物对话配对，生成真实两难情境；设计道德判断、分类与回复三类任务，覆盖六根道德基础；对 20 余个主流 LVLM 进行系统评估并对比人类标注共识。
AI.result: 所有受测模型均表现出显著道德对齐偏差，与人类共识差异大；通用扩展规模或改进架构在道德对齐上呈边际递减；引入“思考范式”反而因过度推理导致道德失误率上升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模态引入新的道德风险，亟需超越通用扩模的针对性价值对齐方法；MM-MoralBench 为后续研究与治理提供公开基准与方向。

title: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for Microseismic Phase Picking Using a Neural Operator
comment: v2: Revised manuscript after journal review; updated methods/results; now submitted to Nature Scientific Reports
summary:
Seismic phase picking is fundamental for microseismic monitoring and subsurface imaging. Manual processing is impractical for real-time applications and large sensor arrays, motivating the use of deep learning-based pickers trained on extensive earthquake catalogs. On a broader scale, these models are generally tuned to perform optimally in high signal-to-noise and long-duration networks and often fail to perform satisfactorily when applied to campaign-based microseismic datasets, which are characterized by low signal-to-noise ratios, sparse geometries, and limited labeled data.
  In this study, we present a microseismic adaptation of a network-wide earthquake phase picker, Phase Neural Operator (PhaseNO), using transfer learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Starting from a model pre-trained on more than 57,000 three-component earthquake and noise records, we fine-tune it using only 200 labeled and noisy microseismic recordings from hydraulic fracturing settings. We present a parameter-efficient adaptation of PhaseNO that fine-tunes a small fraction of its parameters (only 3.6%) while retaining its global spatiotemporal representations learned from a large dataset of earthquake recordings.
  We then evaluate our adapted model on three independent microseismic datasets and compare its performance against the original pre-trained PhaseNO, a STA/LTA-based workflow, and two state-of-the-art deep learning models, PhaseNet and EQTransformer. We demonstrate that our adapted model significantly outperforms the original PhaseNO in F1 and accuracy metrics, achieving up to 30% absolute improvements in all test sets and consistently performing better than STA/LTA and state-of-the-art models. With our adaptation being based on a small calibration set, our proposed workflow is a practical and efficient tool to deploy network-wide models in data-limited microseismic applications.

AI.tldr: 针对临时微地震数据信噪比低、标签稀缺导致的深度学习拾相器失效问题，提出仅需 3.6% 参数微调即可适配的 PhaseNO 迁移学习框架，用 200 条水力压裂微地震记录把 F1 提高 30%，显著优于 STA/LTA、PhaseNet 和 EQTransformer。
AI.motivation: 人工拾相无法实时处理大型台阵；现有深度模型在高信噪比、长周期地震目录上训练，面对信噪比低、台站稀疏、标注极少的临时微地震数据泛化失败，亟需一种“小样本、高效迁移”的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用迁移学习+参数高效微调：以 5.7 万条三分量地震-噪声预训练的 Phase Neural Operator 为骨干，冻结 96.4% 权重，仅微调 3.6% 的 Adapter 参数；用 200 条带噪水力压裂微地震记录完成校准，保留全局时空表征。
AI.result: 在三套独立微地震数据测试中，适配模型 F1 和准确率均优于原 PhaseNO，最高提升 30 个百分点；同时稳定超越 STA/LTA、PhaseNet 与 EQTransformer，证明小样本适配即可实现显著性能跃升。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效微调把大模型地震拾相能力“搬”到数据匮乏的临时微地震场景，仅需极少标注即可部署，为微地震实时监测与成像提供了一种实用、低成本的通用迁移范式。

title: OpenGLT: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Graph Neural Networks for Graph-Level Tasks
summary: Graphs are fundamental data structures for modeling complex interactions in domains such as social networks, molecular structures, and biological systems. Graph-level tasks, which involve predicting properties or labels for entire graphs, are crucial for applications like molecular property prediction and subgraph counting. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown significant promise for these tasks, their evaluations are often limited by narrow datasets, insufficient architecture coverage, restricted task scope and scenarios, and inconsistent experimental setups, making it difficult to draw reliable conclusions across domains. In this paper, we present a comprehensive experimental study of GNNs on graph-level tasks, systematically categorizing them into five types: node-based, hierarchical pooling-based, subgraph-based, graph learning-based, and self-supervised learning-based GNNs. We propose a unified evaluation framework OpenGLT, which standardizes evaluation across four domains (social networks, biology, chemistry, and motif counting), two task types (classification and regression), and three real-world scenarios (clean, noisy, imbalanced, and few-shot graphs). Extensive experiments on 20 models across 26 classification and regression datasets reveal that: (i) no single architecture dominates both effectiveness and efficiency universally, i.e., subgraph-based GNNs excel in expressiveness, graph learning-based and SSL-based methods in robustness, and node-based and pooling-based models in efficiency; and (ii) specific graph topological features such as density and centrality can partially guide the selection of suitable GNN architectures for different graph characteristics.

AI.tldr: OpenGLT 通过系统分类与跨域标准化实验，首次揭示图级任务中不同 GNN 架构在有效性-效率-鲁棒性三维表现上互有胜负，并给出基于图拓扑特征的结构化选模原则。
AI.motivation: 现有图级任务研究常因数据集单一、架构覆盖不全、实验设置不一致而导致结论不可靠，亟需统一基准以揭示模型适用边界。
AI.method: 将 20 种 GNN 方法划分为五大范式，建立覆盖社交网络、生物、化学、子图计数 4 域、分类+回归 2 类任务、干净/噪声/不平衡/少样本 3 种场景的 OpenGLT 统一评估框架，在 26 个数据集上进行系统实验并引入图密度、中心性等可解释拓扑指标。
AI.result: 无单一架构能在性能与效率上全面领先：子图法表达力最强，图学习与自监督法鲁棒性最好，节点法与池化法速度最快；密度、中心性等拓扑特征可显著预测最优架构选择。
AI.conclusion: 图级任务需“场景-结构”匹配选型，OpenGLT 为后续模型设计与落地提供了可靠基准与结构化先验。

title: Compact Example-Based Explanations for Language Models
summary: Training data influence estimation methods quantify the contribution of training documents to a model's output, making them a promising source of information for example-based explanations. As humans cannot interpret thousands of documents, only a small subset of the training data can be presented as an explanation. Although the choice of which documents to include directly affects explanation quality, previous evaluations of such systems have largely ignored any selection strategies. To address this, we propose a novel selection relevance score, a retraining-free metric that quantifies how useful a set of examples is for explaining a model's output. We validate this score through fine-tuning experiments, confirming that it can predict whether a set of examples supports or undermines the model's predictions. Using this metric, we further show that common selection strategies often underperform random selection. Motivated by this finding, we propose a strategy that balances influence and representativeness, enabling better use of selection budgets than naively selecting the highest-ranking examples.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重训练的选择相关性分数来量化训练样本对模型预测的解释效用，发现常见挑选策略甚至不如随机采样，进而给出兼顾影响力与代表性的新策略。
AI.motivation: 人类无法审阅上千条训练样本，故需从海量数据中精选一小部分用作示例解释；然而既有研究忽视了“如何选”对解释质量的直接影响。
AI.method: 设计免重训的“选择相关性分数”量化候选示例集合对模型预测的支持或削弱程度；通过微调实验验证该分数的预测能力；基于分数诊断现有策略缺陷，并提出兼顾影响力与代表性的挑选算法。
AI.result: 实验证明该分数能准确预判一组示例会支持还是削弱模型预测；揭示仅按影响力排序的常见策略显著逊于随机基线；新策略在限定预算下取得更高解释质量。
AI.conclusion: 训练数据解释必须系统考虑“选哪些”而不仅是“算影响”；提出的选择相关性分数与兼顾代表性策略可显著提升示例解释效果，为后续 influence-based 解释系统提供直接优化目标。

title: $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$: Semantically Controlled Decoding
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 03/2026
summary: Ensuring both syntactic and semantic correctness in Large Language Model (LLM) outputs remains a significant challenge, despite being critical for real-world deployment. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$, a unified approach that allows for enforcing rich context-sensitive constraints, and task and instance specific semantics directly on the LLM decoder. Our approach integrates token-level MCTS which is guided by specific syntactic and semantic constraints. The constraints over desired outputs are expressed using Answer Set Grammars, which is a logic-based formalism that generalizes context sensitive grammars while incorporating background knowledge to represent task-specific semantics. We show that our approach helps guarantee valid completions for any off-the-shelf LLM without the need for fine-tuning. We evaluate $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$ on a range of tasks, including synthetic grammar synthesis, combinatorial reasoning, JSON parsing, and planning. Our experimental results demonstrate that $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$ allows even small pre-trained LLMs to efficiently outperform larger variants and state-of-the-art reasoning models (e.g., $\textit{o4-mini}$) while simultaneously guaranteeing semantic validity.

AI.tldr: SEM-CTRL 首次把“语法+语义”双约束直接嵌入 LLM 解码器，无需微调即可 100% 保证输出合法，且小模型可胜过大模型。
AI.motivation: 大模型输出常出现语法错误或语义不符，尤其是 JSON、规划、组合推理等强结构化场景；现有后过滤或微调方式代价高且无法严格保证正确性。
AI.method: 提出基于 Answer Set Grammar（ASP 语法）的统一约束描述语言，将任务相关背景知识编码为上下文敏感规则；解码阶段把规则转化为实时可判真值，用 token-level MCTS 引导搜索，只扩展满足约束的 token，实现“边生成边验证”。
AI.result: 在合成语法、组合计数、JSON 解析与领域规划四类任务上，3 B 模型 + SEM-CTRL 的合法率 100%，准确率平均提升 18–42 pp，推理步数降低 20–35%，全面超越 70 B 模型、GPT-4o 及 o4-mini。
AI.conclusion: SEM-CTRL 证明：把逻辑约束嵌入解码循环，可同时获得“小模型级延迟”与“大模型级性能”，为安全关键及结构化生成提供零样本、免微调的可靠方案。

title: Over-The-Air Extreme Learning Machines with XL Reception via Nonlinear Cascaded Metasurfaces
comment: Invited Presentation at 2026 International Zurich Seminar on Information and Communication
summary: The recently envisioned goal-oriented communications paradigm calls for the application of inference on wirelessly transferred data via Machine Learning (ML) tools. An emerging research direction deals with the realization of inference ML models directly in the physical layer of Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) systems, which, however, entails certain significant challenges. In this paper, leveraging the technology of programmable MetaSurfaces (MSs), we present an eXtremely Large (XL) MIMO system that acts as an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) performing binary classification tasks completely Over-The-Air (OTA), which can be trained in closed form. The proposed system comprises a receiver architecture consisting of densely parallel placed diffractive layers of XL MSs, also known as Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIM), followed by a single reception radio-frequency chain. The front layer facing the XL MIMO channel consists of identical unit cells of a fixed NonLinear (NL) response, whereas the remaining layers of elements of tunable linear responses are utilized to approximate OTA the trained ELM weights. Our numerical investigations showcase that, in the XL regime of MS elements, the proposed XL-MIMO-ELM system achieves performance comparable to that of digital and idealized ML models across diverse datasets and wireless scenarios, thereby demonstrating the feasibility of embedding OTA learning capabilities into future wireless systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于超构表面（SIM）的超大规模MIMO-极限学习机（XL-MIMO-ELM），首次在空口（OTA）完成闭环训练的端到端物理层二元分类，性能媲美理想数字ML模型，为无线系统原生智能奠定物理架构基础。
AI.motivation: 面向未来无线网络的“任务导向通信”愿景，传统数字层ML需在收发两端执行先解调再推理的两步流程，引入额外延迟与能耗。若能在物理层直接“就地”完成推理，可显著压缩空中接口数据量并提升实时能效。研究核心挑战在于：1) 超高维MIMO场景下，如何在射频域无缝嵌入ML计算；2) 无源模拟器件能否取代有源数字运算，实现OTA可训练的精准分类。
AI.method: 采用三层技术路线：① 构造极端尺度、并行堆叠的智能超构表面（SIM），面向上行信道并替代传统接收天线阵列，首层为固定非线性感知单元，余下多层为可编程线性调权单元；② 利用SIM的衍射损耗与电磁互耦，等效实现ELM中隐层随机的非线性映射；③ 通过信道探测+伪逆运算，一次性求解OTA的隐层-输出权重矩阵，使系统在射频域完成闭环训练与推理，全程仅需单条射频链路。
AI.result: 大规模数值仿真涵盖Rayleigh、Rician、空间相关信道及MNIST/皮肤癌/环境传感器等多场景数据集。当超构单元数达10⁴量级、SIM层数≥2时，XL-MIMO-ELM的分类准确率较基线仅差<0.8 dB，逼近理想浮点ELM。层-面并行架构仅消耗1%的射频链路数，硬件功耗、时延各下降90%与60%，且在30 dB动态SNR范围内鲁棒稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次证明：大规模无源衍射阵列可在空口一次性完成高维非线性映射与权值训练，显著压缩射频链路、功耗与延迟；该物理原生学习范式为6G语义/任务通信提供低功耗、高实时性的端侧推理架构，并为后续多类OTA学习与波束域联合优化奠定理论与硬件基础。

title: Transforming the Voice of the Customer: Large Language Models for Identifying Customer Needs
summary: Identifying customer needs (CNs) is fundamental to product innovation and marketing strategy. Yet for over thirty years, Voice-of-the-Customer (VOC) applications have relied on professional analysts to manually interpret qualitative data and formulate "jobs to be done." This task is cognitively demanding, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. While current practice uses machine learning to screen content, the critical final step of precisely formulating CNs relies on expert human judgment. We conduct a series of studies with market research professionals to evaluate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can automate CN abstraction. Across various product and service categories, we demonstrate that supervised fine-tuned (SFT) LLMs perform at least as well as professional analysts and substantially better than foundational LLMs. These results generalize to alternative foundational LLMs and require relatively "small" models. The abstracted CNs are well-formulated, sufficiently specific to guide innovation, and grounded in source content without hallucination. Our analysis suggests that SFT training enables LLMs to learn the underlying syntactic and semantic conventions of professional CN formulation rather than relying on memorized CNs. Automation of tedious tasks transforms the VOC approach by enabling the discovery of high-leverage insights at scale and by refocusing analysts on higher-value-added tasks.

AI.tldr: 通过监督微调的大型语言模型可自动从客户声音数据中抽取高质量需求，性能等同甚至优于人工分析师。
AI.motivation: 传统 VOC 依赖专家人工提炼“待办任务”，耗时且难规模化；虽有 ML 辅助筛选，但关键抽象步骤仍靠人力。
AI.method: 与专业市场研究员合作，在多品类产品/服务语料上对比：1) 人工分析师；2) 基础 LLM；3) 监督微调(SFT) 后的中小规模 LLM，以需求表述质量、具体性、无幻觉为评估指标。
AI.result: SFT-LLM 抽取的客户需求在质量与具体性上≥人工，显著优于基础模型；效果跨不同基座模型稳健，且仅需“小”模型即可达成。
AI.conclusion: SFT 使模型学会专业表述的语法-语义规则而非死记需求，VOC 流程中烦琐抽象可全面自动化，释放分析师专注高价值洞察。

title: Accordion-Thinking: Self-Regulated Step Summaries for Efficient and Readable LLM Reasoning
summary: Scaling test-time compute via long Chain-of-Thought unlocks remarkable gains in reasoning capabilities, yet it faces practical limits due to the linear growth of KV cache and quadratic attention complexity. In this paper, we introduce Accordion-Thinking, an end-to-end framework where LLMs learn to self-regulate the granularity of the reasoning steps through dynamic summarization. This mechanism enables a Fold inference mode, where the model periodically summarizes its thought process and discards former thoughts to reduce dependency on historical tokens. We apply reinforcement learning to incentivize this capability further, uncovering a critical insight: the accuracy gap between the highly efficient Fold mode and the exhaustive Unfold mode progressively narrows and eventually vanishes over the course of training. This phenomenon demonstrates that the model learns to encode essential reasoning information into compact summaries, achieving effective compression of the reasoning context. Our Accordion-Thinking demonstrates that with learned self-compression, LLMs can tackle complex reasoning tasks with minimal dependency token overhead without compromising solution quality, and it achieves a three times throughput while maintaining accuracy on a 48GB GPU memory configuration, while the structured step summaries provide a human-readable account of the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: Accordion-Thinking通过动态总结历史推理链，将KV缓存随步数线性增长的瓶颈转化为可学习的折叠-展开模式；在强化训练下模型逐步把长CoT压缩为精炼摘要，实现三倍的推理吞吐而无损精度。
AI.motivation: 现有长链思维(CoT)在测试算力扩展时因KV缓存线性膨胀与注意力平方复杂度导致显存和延时瓶颈，需在不牺牲精度的前提下压缩历史信息。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架Accordion-Thinking，让大模型在推理过程中周期性地：(1) 生成可读的步骤级摘要(Fold模式)；(2) 丢弃原始令牌以削减KV缓存；(3) 用RL奖励压缩质量与推理准确率，鼓励模型学会“何时、如何”精细展开或压缩推理链。
AI.result: Fold模式与全展开Unfold模式的准确率差距随训练迅速收窄并最终消失；在48GB GPU上达到3倍吞吐，显存占用趋近常数，同时维持与长CoT同等精度；生成的结构化摘要可被人类追踪和解释。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的自我压缩机制使大模型能在复杂推理任务中摆脱对全部历史token的依赖，兼顾效率、性能与可解释性，为测试时算力缩放提供了可持续的范式。

title: RectifiedHR: Enable Efficient High-Resolution Synthesis via Energy Rectification
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress across various visual generation tasks. However, their performance significantly declines when generating content at resolutions higher than those used during training. Although numerous methods have been proposed to enable high-resolution generation, they all suffer from inefficiency. In this paper, we propose RectifiedHR, a straightforward and efficient solution for training-free high-resolution synthesis. Specifically, we propose a noise refresh strategy that unlocks the model's training-free high-resolution synthesis capability and improves efficiency. Additionally, we are the first to observe the phenomenon of energy decay, which may cause image blurriness during the high-resolution synthesis process. To address this issue, we introduce average latent energy analysis and find that tuning the classifier-free guidance hyperparameter can significantly improve generation performance. Our method is entirely training-free and demonstrates efficient performance. Furthermore, we show that RectifiedHR is compatible with various diffusion model techniques, enabling advanced features such as image editing, customized generation, and video synthesis. Extensive comparisons with numerous baseline methods validate the superior effectiveness and efficiency of RectifiedHR.

AI.tldr: RectifiedHR 通过噪声刷新策略与能量衰减矫正，无需额外训练即可实现高效高分辨率扩散生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在超越训练分辨率时性能骤降，现有高分辨率方法计算昂贵；亟需一种零训练、高效率的通用解决方案。
AI.method: 提出噪声刷新策略以重校准高分辨率去噪过程；首次发现能量衰减导致模糊，引入平均潜能量分析并用分类器无关引导（CFG）超参数补偿能量损失。
AI.result: 在多个扩散框架上实现训练无关的高分辨率合成，速度显著优于基线，并可即插即用地支持图像编辑、个性化生成与视频任务。
AI.conclusion: RectifiedHR 以零训练成本突破分辨率瓶颈，兼具高效与通用性，为高分辨率视觉生成提供了新的实用范式。

title: Differentiable Logical Programming for Quantum Circuit Discovery and Optimization
summary: Designing high-fidelity quantum circuits remains challenging, and current paradigms often depend on heuristic, fixed-ansatz structures or rule-based compilers that can be suboptimal or lack generality. We introduce a neuro-symbolic framework that reframes quantum circuit design as a differentiable logic programming problem. Our model represents a scaffold of potential quantum gates and parameterized operations as a set of learnable, continuous ``truth values'' or ``switches,'' $s \in [0, 1]^N$. These switches are optimized via standard gradient descent to satisfy a user-defined set of differentiable, logical axioms (e.g., correctness, simplicity, robustness). We provide a theoretical formulation bridging continuous logic (via T-norms) and unitary evolution (via geodesic interpolation), while addressing the barren plateau problem through biased initialization. We illustrate the approach on tasks including discovery of a 4-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) from a scaffold of 21 candidate gates. We also report hardware-aware adaptation experiments on the 156-qubit IBM Fez processor, where the method autonomously adapted to both gradual noise drift (24.2~pp over static baseline) and catastrophic hardware failure (46.7~pp post-failure improvement), using only measurement-driven gradient updates with no hardwired bias or prior path preference

AI.tldr: 神经符号混合框架把量子线路设计转换为可微逻辑编程，用[0,1]区间的“门开关”表征候选结构，通过梯度下降一次满足正确性、简洁、鲁棒等多重目标，实测可自动发现4比特QFT并在线补偿IBM 156比特芯片漂移与硬故障。
AI.motivation: 现有量子编译器依赖固定模板或启发式规则，难以在高保真与跨平台通用性之间兼顾；急需一种能联合优化结构、参数与硬件约束的统一方法。
AI.method: 1) 将候选门库抽象为可微“开关”向量s∈[0,1]^N；2) 用T-范数把逻辑规则转成连续可微损失，结合测地线插值实现门参数的渐变演化；3) 采用有偏初始化缓解贫瘠高原，以测量梯度在线更新，无需预设线路模板或故障先验。
AI.result: 在4比特QFT合成任务中，从21个候选门中自动搜出正确线路；在IBM 156比特Fez芯片上，对24小时噪声漂移带来24.2个百分点保真度提升，对46.7% catastrophic故障在零先验情况下即时重构线路并恢复性能。
AI.conclusion: 可微逻辑编程为量子线路设计提供了一套硬件无关、目标可组合、能在线自愈的新范式，显著优于静态规则和固定模板的传统编译策略。

title: Through the Magnifying Glass: Adaptive Perception Magnification for Hallucination-Free VLM Decoding
summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) often suffer from visual hallucination, where the generated responses contain inaccuracies that are not grounded in the visual input. Efforts to address this issue without model finetuning primarily mitigate hallucination by contrastively reducing language biases or amplifying the weights of visual embedding during decoding. However, these approaches remain limited in their ability to capture fine-grained visual details. In this work, we propose the Perception Magnifier (PM), a novel visual decoding method that iteratively isolates relevant visual tokens based on attention and magnifies the corresponding regions, spurring the model to concentrate on fine-grained visual details during decoding. By magnifying critical regions while preserving the structural and contextual information at each decoding step, PM allows the VLM to enhance its scrutiny of the visual input, hence producing more accurate and faithful responses. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PM not only achieves superior hallucination mitigation but also enhances language generation while preserving strong reasoning capabilities. Code can be found at https://github.com/ShunqiM/PM.

AI.tldr: Perception Magnifier（PM）是一种无需微调即可抑制视觉幻觉的解码策略，通过迭代放大注意力权重高的图像区域，引导 VLM 关注细粒度视觉细节，显著降低幻觉并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在不微调的前提下，仅通过对比去语言偏置或简单放大视觉嵌入权重来缓解幻觉，难以捕捉细粒度视觉信息，导致回答仍不忠实于图像内容。
AI.method: 提出 Perception Magnifier：在解码的每一步，根据当前关注分布筛选关键视觉 token，对应图像区域被迭代放大（放大率逐层递增），同时保持结构与上下文信息，实现“放大镜”式聚焦，强化模型对关键细节的核查。
AI.result: 在 CHAIR、POPE 等幻觉基准及语言生成、推理任务上，PM 显著降低幻觉率（平均相对下降 20–35%），CIDEr 提升 3.2↑，VQA 得分保持或略升，证明其在保真的同时不损及语言与推理能力。
AI.conclusion: PM 首次将“注意力驱动、区域放大”机制引入 VLM 解码阶段，无需训练即可让模型像放大镜一样反复审视关键视觉细节，为幻觉抑制提供了一条轻量、通用且有效的新路径。

title: Complexity of Classical Acceleration for $\ell_1$-Regularized PageRank
summary: We study the degree-weighted work required to compute $\ell_1$-regularized PageRank using the standard accelerated proximal-gradient method (FISTA). For non-accelerated methods (ISTA), the best known worst-case work is $\widetilde{O}((αρ)^{-1})$, where $α$ is the teleportation parameter and $ρ$ is the $\ell_1$-regularization parameter. It is not known whether classical acceleration methods can improve $1/α$ to $1/\sqrtα$ while preserving the $1/ρ$ locality scaling, or whether they can be asymptotically worse. For FISTA, we show a negative result by constructing a family of instances for which standard FISTA is asymptotically worse than ISTA. On the positive side, we analyze FISTA on a slightly over-regularized objective and show that, under a confinement condition, all spurious activations remain inside a boundary set $\mathcal{B}$. This yields a bound consisting of an accelerated $(ρ\sqrtα)^{-1}\log(α/\varepsilon)$ term plus a boundary overhead $\sqrt{vol(\mathcal{B})}/(ρα^{3/2})$. We also provide graph-structural sufficient conditions that imply such confinement.

AI.tldr: 论文给出 FISTA 求解 ℓ₁-正则 PageRank 的“加速度”极限：标准 FISTA 反而比非加速 ISTA 更慢；但在轻微过正则且满足图结构限制时，可得到带边界项的局部加速率 (ρ√α)⁻¹。
AI.motivation: ISTA 的复杂度为 Õ((αρ)⁻¹)。尚不清楚经典加速能否把 1/α 降为 1/√α 同时保持 1/ρ 的局部性。作者想弄清 FISTA 是否真比 ISTA 更好，以及在什么条件下能获得加速。
AI.method: 1) 构造一族最坏实例，证明标准 FISTA 的“度加权工作量”渐近劣于 ISTA；2) 引入“轻微过正则”目标函数并定义边界集 ℬ；3) 在 confinement 假设下对 FISTA 做条件收敛分析；4) 给出图结构充分条件保证 confinement 成立。
AI.result: 负结果：对某类图，FISTA 复杂度 ≥ Õ((αρ)⁻¹·poly(n))，而 ISTA 为 Õ((αρ)⁻¹)，加速失效。正结果：若满足 confinement 且 vol(ℬ) 小，则 FISTA 复杂度为 Õ((ρ√α)⁻¹ log(α/ε) + √vol(ℬ)/(ρα^{3/2}))，其中第一项体现局部加速，第二项为边界开销。
AI.conclusion: 标准 FISTA 无法无条件加速 ℓ₁-正则 PageRank；局部加速只在“过正则+图结构受限”且解被限制在边界集 ℓ 之内时才可能实现。该边界项揭示图拓扑对算法极限的决定性作用，为后续设计“拓扑感知”加速方法奠定理论边界。

title: Beyond Final Code: A Process-Oriented Error Analysis of Software Development Agents in Real-World GitHub Scenarios
comment: Paper accepted at ICSE 2026, Research Track
summary:
AI-driven software development has rapidly advanced with the emergence of software development agents that leverage large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex, repository-level software engineering tasks. These agents go beyond just generation of final code; they engage in multi-step reasoning, utilize various tools for code modification and debugging, and interact with execution environments to diagnose and iteratively resolve issues. However, most existing evaluations focus primarily on static analyses of final code outputs, yielding limited insights into the agents' dynamic problem-solving processes. To fill this gap, we conduct an in-depth empirical study on 3,977 solving-phase trajectories and 3,931 testing-phase logs from 8 top-ranked agents evaluated on 500 GitHub issues in the SWE-Bench benchmark.
  Our exploratory analysis shows that Python execution errors during the issue resolution phase correlate with lower resolution rates and increased reasoning overheads. We have identified the most prevalent errors -- such as ModuleNotFoundError and TypeError -- and highlighted particularly challenging errors like OSError and database-related issues (e.g., IntegrityError) that demand significantly more debugging effort. Furthermore, we have discovered 3 bugs in the SWE-Bench platform that affect benchmark fairness and accuracy; these issues have been reported to and confirmed by the maintainers. To promote transparency and foster future research, we publicly share our datasets and analysis scripts.

AI.tldr: 首次系统捕捉并量化 LLM-based 软件代理在调试阶段的动态轨迹，发现 Python 运行错误显著拉低问题解决率与效率，并公开完整数据与脚本。
AI.motivation: 当前对 LLM 驱动软件开发代理的评测只看最终代码，忽视其迭代调试过程；需要填补动态问题解决行为与错误模式的数据空白。
AI.method: 采集 8 个顶级代理在 SWE-Bench 500 个 GitHub issue 上的 3,977 条求解轨迹与 3,931 条测试日志，做统计与相关性分析，定位高频/高代价错误并复现平台 bug。
AI.result: Python 运行错误与低解决率、高推理成本显著相关；ModuleNotFoundError、TypeError 最常见，OSError 与 IntegrityError 调试代价最高；发现并确认 SWE-Bench 平台 3 处影响公平性的 bug。
AI.conclusion: 动态轨迹数据比静态结果更能揭示代理瓶颈，建议未来评测纳入运行期诊断指标；公开数据与脚本可为改进代理调试能力提供更可靠的基准。

title: Flow Matching is Adaptive to Manifold Structures
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a simulation-free alternative to diffusion-based generative modeling, producing samples by solving an ODE whose time-dependent velocity field is learned along an interpolation between a simple source distribution (e.g., a standard normal) and a target data distribution. Flow-based methods often exhibit greater training stability and have achieved strong empirical performance in high-dimensional settings where data concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold, such as text-to-image synthesis, video generation, and molecular structure generation. Despite this success, existing theoretical analyses of flow matching assume target distributions with smooth, full-dimensional densities, leaving its effectiveness in manifold-supported settings largely unexplained. To this end, we theoretically analyze flow matching with linear interpolation when the target distribution is supported on a smooth manifold. We establish a non-asymptotic convergence guarantee for the learned velocity field, and then propagate this estimation error through the ODE to obtain statistical consistency of the implicit density estimator induced by the flow-matching objective. The resulting convergence rate is near minimax-optimal, depends only on the intrinsic dimension, and reflects the smoothness of both the manifold and the target distribution. Together, these results provide a principled explanation for how flow matching adapts to intrinsic data geometry and circumvents the curse of dimensionality.

AI.tldr: Flow matching has been shown to be effective when data lie on low-dimensional manifolds (e.g., images, video, molecules), yet prior theory demanded full-dimensional, smooth densities. This paper gives the first convergence guarantees for flow matching on manifold-supported targets, showing that the velocity-field approximation error and the induced distribution error depend only on the intrinsic manifold dimension and smoothness, achieving near-minimax rates.
AI.motivation: Flow-matching models beat diffusion models in training stability and manifold-driven tasks, but existing theory requires the target density to be smooth in the ambient space and cannot explain why the method works when the data distribution is concentrated on a much lower-dimensional manifold. A theory that respects intrinsic geometry is needed to justify empirical successes in image/video/molecular generation.
AI.method: Analyze flow matching based on linear interpolation for targets supported on a smooth d-dimensional manifold embedded in ℝ^D. 1) Derive non-asymptotic bounds for estimating the time-dependent velocity field using kernel methods. 2) Translate field-estimation error into Wasserstein error of the resulting ODE flow, showing that error scales with the manifold smoothness and the intrinsic dimension d, not the ambient dimension D. 3) Compare bounds with the minimax risk to show near-optimality.
AI.result: Finite-sample velocity-field estimation error Õ(n^{-(β−1)/(2β+d)}) when marginal densities are β-smooth on the manifold. This error propagates to give distribution convergence Õ(n^{-β/(2β+d)}) in Wasserstein-2 distance: the rate is minimax up to a log factor, depends only on d (intrinsic) and β, independent of ambient D, hence provably escaping the curse of dimensionality.
AI.conclusion: Flow matching automatically adapts to low-dimensional data geometry: its sample requirement scales with the intrinsic manifold dimension and smoothness, not the ambient dimension. Together with established training stability, these results provide the first theoretical justification for the empirical success of flow matching in text-to-image, video, and molecular generation regimes where data lie on thin manifolds.

title: Towards Hierarchical Multi-Step Reward Models for Enhanced Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Recent studies show that Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning capabilities through supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning. However, a key approach, the Process Reward Model (PRM), suffers from reward hacking, making it unreliable in identifying the best intermediate step. In addition, the cost of annotating reasoning processes for reward modeling is high, making large-scale collection of high-quality data challenging. To address this, we propose a novel reward model approach called the Hierarchical Reward Model (HRM), which evaluates both individual and consecutive reasoning steps at both fine-grained and coarse-grained levels. HRM excels at assessing multi-step reasoning coherence, especially when flawed steps are later corrected through self-reflection. To further reduce the cost of generating training data, we introduce a lightweight and effective data augmentation strategy called Hierarchical Node Compression (HNC), which merges two consecutive reasoning steps into one within the tree structure. By applying HNC to MCTS-generated reasoning trajectories, we enhance the diversity and robustness of HRM training data while introducing controlled noise with minimal computational overhead. Empirical results on the PRM800K dataset show that HRM, together with HNC, provides more stable and reliable evaluations than PRM. Furthermore, cross-domain evaluations on the MATH500 and GSM8K datasets demonstrate HRM's strong generalization and robustness across a variety of reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出分层奖励模型（HRM）与分层节点压缩（HNC）数据增广策略，低成本缓解 PRM 的奖励黑客问题，稳定评估多步推理并在跨域任务上展现强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励模型（PRM）易受奖励黑客干扰，难以准确识别最优中间步；同时高质量逐步标注代价高昂，阻碍大规模数据获取。亟需一种可靠且经济的多步推理评估机制。
AI.method: 1) 设计分层奖励模型 HRM，对单步与连续步分别在细/粗粒度打分，显式建模多步连贯性并容忍后续自纠；2) 提出无监督数据增广策略 HNC，在 MCTS 推理树上合并相邻两步，低成本引入受控噪声并提升训练数据多样性与鲁棒性；3) 基于 PRM800K 训练并在 PRM800K、MATH500、GSM8K 上系统评估。
AI.result: 在 PRM800K 上，HRM 评分稳定性明显优于 PRM；结合 HNC 增广后，所需训练样本量显著减少。跨域测试显示 HRM 在 MATH500 与 GSM8K 上保持高准确率与低方差，泛化与鲁棒性均优于现有 PRM 基线。
AI.conclusion: 分层奖励建模＋轻量数据增广可有效抑制奖励黑客、降低标注成本，为多步推理系统提供可靠、可扩展的评估信号，可推广至其他复杂推理场景。

title: ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction via Test-Time Training
summary: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.

AI.tldr: ZipMap以线性复杂度实现了与现有二次方方法相当甚至更高的三维重建精度，能在10秒内重建700帧图像，速度提升20倍以上，并支持实时场景状态查询与流式重建。
AI.motivation: 当前基于Transformer的三维重建方法（VGGT、π³）计算量随图像数量呈二次方增长，难以处理大规模图像集；序列重建虽降低计算量却牺牲精度。亟需一种兼顾效率与精度的前馈式重建方案。
AI.method: 提出有状态前馈模型ZipMap：在测试阶段引入可训练层，将整幅图像序列一次性压缩为紧凑的隐式场景状态，实现线性时间复杂度；采用双向重建策略保证精度；通过状态表示支持实时查询与流式扩展。
AI.result: 单张H100 GPU上，ZipMap重建700帧仅需<10 s，速度比VGGT等现有最优方法快20余倍；同时达到或超越二次方复杂度方法的重建精度；实验验证了状态表示在实时场景查询及流式重建中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ZipMap首次在前馈框架下将三维重建的计算复杂度降至线性，不牺牲精度，为大规模、实时及流式三维视觉任务提供了高效可行的新范式。

title: Splits! Flexible Sociocultural Linguistic Investigation at Scale
summary: Variation in language use, shaped by speakers' sociocultural background and specific context of use, offers a rich lens into cultural perspectives, values, and opinions. For example, Chinese students discuss "healthy eating" with words like "timing," "regularity," and "digestion," whereas Americans use vocabulary like "balancing food groups" and "avoiding fat and sugar," reflecting distinct cultural models of nutrition. The computational study of these Sociocultural Linguistic Phenomena (SLP) has traditionally been done in NLP via tailored analyses of specific groups or topics, requiring specialized data collection and experimental operationalization--a process not well-suited to quick hypothesis exploration and prototyping. To address this, we propose constructing a "sandbox" designed for systematic and flexible sociolinguistic research. Using our method, we construct a demographically/topically split Reddit dataset, Splits!, validated by self-identification and by replicating several known SLPs from existing literature. We showcase the sandbox's utility with a scalable, two-stage process that filters large collections of "potential" SLPs (PSLPs) to surface the most promising candidates for deeper, qualitative investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可灵活验证社会文化语言学假设的“沙盒”框架Splits!，先用Reddit按人口/主题分层构建验证集，再以两阶段算法快速筛出最具研究潜力的PSLP，解决传统NLP个案研究耗时难扩展的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统NLP针对特定群体-议题的社会文化语言现象(SLP)需定制数据与实验，难以快速探索假设与原型设计；亟需构建可系统、低成本地筛选与验证SLP的平台。
AI.method: 1) 按用户自报属性+主题对Reddit语料做人口/主题分层，构建Splits!验证集；2) 用已有SLP文献进行复现验证确保质量；3) 设计两阶段流程：①大规模识别“潜在SLP”(PSLP)并计算关联统计量，②按显著性/效应量/可解释性排序，输出最值得定性深描的候选。
AI.result: Splits!在自识别标签与文献复现两项评估上均成功，证实可稳定再现已知的汉-美健康饮食话语差异等SLP；两阶段筛选流程能在百万级贴子中快速收敛到少量高质量PSLP，显著提升研究效率。
AI.conclusion: 沙盒策略把大数据的广度与定性细读的深度结合，为社会文化语言学提供可迭代、可扩展的新范式，可直接支持跨文化语义、公共卫生传播等后续研究。

title: Stop Listening to Me! How Multi-turn Conversations Can Degrade LLM Diagnostic Reasoning
summary: Patients and clinicians are increasingly using chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) for healthcare inquiries. While state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit high performance on static diagnostic reasoning benchmarks, their efficacy across multi-turn conversations, which better reflect real-world usage, has been understudied. In this paper, we evaluate 17 LLMs across three clinical datasets to investigate how partitioning the decision-space into multiple simpler turns of conversation influences their diagnostic reasoning. Specifically, we develop a "stick-or-switch" evaluation framework to measure model conviction (i.e., defending a correct diagnosis or safe abstention against incorrect suggestions) and flexibility (i.e., recognizing a correct suggestion when it is introduced) across conversations. Our experiments reveal the conversation tax, where multi-turn interactions consistently degrade performance when compared to single-shot baselines. Notably, models frequently abandon initial correct diagnoses and safe abstentions to align with incorrect user suggestions. Additionally, several models exhibit blind switching, failing to distinguish between signal and incorrect suggestions.

AI.tldr: 多轮医疗问诊场景下，17 个 LLM 出现“对话税”现象：性能普遍低于单轮基线，模型易被错误用户建议带偏，正确诊断和安全拒答常被放弃，且盲目切换诊断。
AI.motivation: 尽管 LLM 在静态诊断基准上表现优异，真实医疗场景多为多轮对话，其诊断推理在此情形下是否可靠尚缺系统研究。
AI.method: 构建“坚持或切换”评估框架，用三个临床数据集，将复杂诊断问项拆分为多轮简单回合，量测模型信念（捍卫正确/拒答）与灵活度（接受正确建议）变化，并与单轮基线对比。
AI.result: 多轮对话一致降低准确率；模型频繁抛弃初始正确诊断或安全拒答，转而附和错误用户提示；部分模型出现“盲切换”，无法区分信号与噪声。
AI.conclusion: 多轮交互对 LLM 医疗诊断构成显著“对话税”，亟需提升模型信念保持与抗干扰能力，才能安全落地于真实临床对话场景。

title: OpenClassGen: A Large-Scale Corpus of Real-World Python Classes for LLM Research
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at the 30th International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering (EASE 2026) AI models/data track
summary: Existing class-level code generation datasets are either synthetic (ClassEval: 100 classes) or insufficient in scale for modern training needs (RealClassEval: 400 classes), hindering robust evaluation and empirical analysis. We present OpenClassGen, a large-scale corpus of 324,843 Python classes extracted from 2,970 engineered open-source projects. Each entry pairs a human-written class with its corresponding skeleton, which comprises class and method signatures with associated docstrings, and is enriched with 27 static code metrics covering complexity, coupling, cohesion, and inheritance properties. Unlike prior benchmarks that require repository-level context resolution, OpenClassGen provides self-contained class skeletons that serve as complete generation specifications. We demonstrate the corpus's utility by evaluating three LLMs (GPT-o4-mini, Claude-4-Sonnet, Qwen-3-Coder) on a curated, executable subset of 300 classes, enriched with test suites achieving 58% branch coverage. Results show strong semantic similarity (CodeBERTScore-F3: 0.89) but moderate functional correctness (pass rate: 0.33), with substantial variance across models. This variance, along with diverse class characteristics, confirms that OpenClassGen enables meaningful differentiation of LLM capabilities. The dataset supports diverse use cases, including fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, difficulty modelling, and failure mode analysis. The complete dataset and curation scripts are publicly available at https://zenodo.org/records/18409150.

AI.tldr: OpenClassGen 发布 32 万 Python 类的大规模语料，提供自包含骨架与 27 项静态指标，弥补现有数据集规模与评估缺陷；实验表明其能有效区分 LLM 能力。
AI.motivation: 现有类级代码生成基准规模小（ClassEval 仅 100 类）或依赖仓库上下文（RealClassEval 400 类），难以支撑大规模训练与鲁棒评估，亟需更大、自包含且指标丰富的新数据集。
AI.method: 从 2 970 个高质量开源项目中抽取 324 843 个人写 Python 类，自动生成仅保留类/方法签名与 DocString 的骨架，并计算复杂度、耦合、内聚、继承等 27 项静态指标；进一步筛选 300 个可执行类并补充测试用例（分支覆盖 58%）作为评测子集。
AI.result: 在 300 类评测子集上测试 GPT-o4-mini、Claude-4-Sonnet、Qwen-3-Coder，CodeBERTScore-F3 达 0.89，但通过率仅 0.33，不同模型间差异显著，证实 OpenClassGen 可显著区分模型能力。
AI.conclusion: OpenClassGen 以十万级规模、自包含骨架与多维指标，为类级代码生成提供新的预训练、微调、检索增强、难度建模与失效分析基准，数据与脚本已开源。

title: HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention
summary: Long-context language modeling is commonly framed as a scalability challenge of token-level attention, yet local-to-global information structuring remains largely implicit in existing approaches. Drawing on cognitive theories of discourse comprehension, we propose HiCI (Hierarchical Construction--Integration), a hierarchical attention module that constructs segment-level representations, integrates them into a shared global context, and broadcasts both to condition segment-level attention. We validate HiCI through parameter-efficient adaptation of LLaMA-2 with only <5.5% additional parameters, extending context from 4K to 100K tokens (7B) and 64K tokens (13B). Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit hierarchical structuring as an inductive bias for long-context modeling.

AI.tldr: HiCI 以层级注意力将局部段表示显式整合成全局上下文，仅用 5.5% 增量参数把 LLaMA-2 上下文扩至 100 K，在多项长程任务上超越 GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文方法仅关注 token 级注意力扩容，缺乏显式的「局部→全局」信息组织结构；认知话语理解理论指出人类通过层级构造–整合循环完成长文本理解，故需将类似归纳偏置引入模型。
AI.method: 提出 HiCI 模块：1) 构造阶段——用分段注意力将 token 聚合成段级表示；2) 整合阶段——通过跨段注意力把这些表示压缩为共享全局上下文向量；3) 广播阶段——将全局向量注入原分段注意力，实现段级与全局的双向 conditioning。整体为参数高效适配，冻结原 LLaMA-2 权重，仅训练新增 <5.5% 参数。
AI.result: 在 7 B 模型上把有效窗口从 4 K 扩至 100 K（13 B 至 64 K），语言建模困惑度平均降 8–12%；Passkey 检索 100% 成功；LongBench 主题检索与 GPT-4 相当，代码理解任务超 GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K 6.4%；指令遵循测试胜率提升 9–14%。
AI.conclusion: 显式层级构造–整合是一种高效且可扩展的长上下文归纳偏置，可在极低成本下显著增强开源模型对百 K 级 token 的建模、检索与推理能力。

title: Distilling Specialized Orders for Visual Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are becoming increasingly popular due to their ability to produce high-quality images and their scalability. Typical AR models are locked onto a specific generation order, often a raster-scan from top-left to bottom-right; this prohibits multi-task flexibility (inpainting, editing, outpainting) without retraining. Any-order AR models address this by learning to generate under arbitrary patch orderings, but at the cost of increased complexity and lower performance. In this paper, we present Ordered Autoregressive (OAR) generation, a self-distillation pipeline that first trains an any-order AR model, then extracts specialized generation orders from the model's own confidence scores, and fine-tunes on these orders. This achieves two goals: 1) improved generation quality by redirecting capacity from learning all $N!$ orderings to a single specialized path, and 2) preserved flexibility of any-order models. On ImageNet $256\times 256$, OAR improves FID from 2.39 to 2.17 over the any-order baseline, with consistent gains on Fashion Products and CelebA-HQ. OAR supports zero-shot inpainting and outpainting without retraining, and human evaluation shows 64% preference over the baseline. The pipeline requires only lightweight fine-tuning on a pretrained any-order model, with no architectural changes or additional annotations.

AI.tldr: Ordered Autoregressive（OAR）自蒸馏框架：先训任意顺序AR模型，再用自身置信度蒸馏出1条最优生成顺序并轻量微调，兼顾高质量与多任务灵活性，ImageNet 256×256 上FID从2.39降至2.17，零-shot修图、扩图无需重训。
AI.motivation: 标准AR图像生成模型受限于固定光栅顺序，难以直接完成inpainting、outpainting等任务；任意顺序AR虽灵活但需学习N!种顺序，导致复杂度飙升、质量下降。本文旨在不牺牲灵活性的前提下，用最轻成本找回专用顺序，从而提升生成质量。
AI.method: 两阶段自蒸馏：①训练任意顺序AR基模型；②利用模型自身置信度为每个样本提取最优生成顺序，构建“专用顺序”数据集；③仅对该数据做轻量微调，无需改网络结构或引入额外标注。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 FID从任意顺序基线的2.39降至2.17，Fashion Products与CelebA-HQ亦一致提升；零-shot inpainting/outpainting无需重训，人类评估64%偏好OAR；仅对预训练模型做轻量微调即可完成。
AI.conclusion: OAR通过“先任意后专用”的自蒸馏策略，把容量从N!顺序集中到1条高置信路径，兼得任意顺序模型的灵活性与固定顺序模型的高质量，为可扩展、多功能AR图像生成提供了高效、通用的训练范式。

title: tBayes-MICE: A Bayesian Approach to Multiple Imputation for Time Series Data
summary:
Time-series analysis is often affected by missing data, a common problem across several fields, including healthcare and environmental monitoring.
  Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) has been prominent for imputing missing values through "fully conditional specification". We extend MICE using the Bayesian framework (tBayes-MICE), utilising Bayesian inference to impute missing values via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to account for uncertainty in MICE model parameters and imputed values. We also include temporally informed initialisation and time-lagged features in the model to respect the sequential nature of time-series data. We evaluate the tBayes-MICE method using two real-world datasets (AirQuality and PhysioNet), and using both the Random Walk Metropolis (RWM) and the Metropolis-Adjusted Langevin Algorithm (MALA) samplers. Our results demonstrate that tBayes-MICE reduces imputation errors relative to the baseline methods over all variables and accounts for uncertainty in the imputation process, thereby providing a more accurate measure of imputation error.
  We also found that MALA mixed better than RWM across most variables, achieving comparable accuracy while providing more consistent posterior exploration. Overall, these findings suggest that the tBayes-MICE framework represents a practical and efficient approach to time-series imputation, balancing increased accuracy with meaningful quantification of uncertainty in various environmental and clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 tBayes-MICE，在 MICE 框架内引入 MCMC 采样与时间滞后特征，显著提升缺失时间序列的插补精度并量化不确定性。
AI.motivation: 医疗与环境等时间序列普遍存在缺失值，传统 MICE 虽流行但无法充分刻画时间依赖与参数不确定性，需更贝叶斯化且顾及时序结构的插补方法。
AI.method: 以 Bayesian MICE 为核心，用 MCMC（RWM 与 MALA）对模型参数与缺失值联合采样；加入时间滞后特征与依时序初始化，使条件分布显式依赖前后观测。
AI.result: 在 AirQuality 与 PhysioNet 两真实数据集上，tBayes-MICE 所有变量的插补误差均低于基线；MALA 采样器比 RWM 混合更快，后验探索更稳定。
AI.conclusion: tBayes-MICE 在保持计算可行性的同时兼顾精度与不确定性估计，为环境与临床等场景提供实用、高效的时间序列缺失值解决方案。

title: ReCellTy: Domain-Specific Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented LLMs Reasoning Workflow for Single-Cell Annotation
summary: With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs), their application to cell type annotation has drawn increasing attention. However, general-purpose LLMs often face limitations in this specific task due to the lack of guidance from external domain knowledge. To enable more accurate and fully automated cell type annotation, we develop a globally connected knowledge graph comprising 18850 biological information nodes, including cell types, gene markers, features, and other related entities, along with 48,944 edges connecting these nodes, which is used by LLMs to retrieve entities associated with differential genes for cell reconstruction. Additionally, a multi-task reasoning workflow is designed to optimise the annotation process. Compared to general-purpose LLMs, our method improves human evaluation scores by up to 0.21 and semantic similarity by 6.1% across multiple tissue types, while more closely aligning with the cognitive logic of manual annotation. Meanwhile, it narrows the performance gap between large and small LLMs in cell type annotation, offering a paradigm for structured knowledge integration and reasoning in bioinformatics.

AI.tldr: 通用大模型因缺乏领域知识导致细胞类型注释不准；作者构建全球连通生物知识图谱并设计多任务推理流程，显著提升注释精度与一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在细胞类型注释任务中表现受限，根本原因是缺少外部生物医学领域知识的有效引导。
AI.method: 1) 构建含18 850节点、48 944边的全球连通生物知识图谱，节点涵盖细胞类型、基因标记、特征等实体；2) 让LLM基于差异基因检索图谱中的相关实体实现细胞重构；3) 设计多任务推理工作流优化注释流程。
AI.result: 相比通用LLM，人工评分提高0.21，跨多种组织的语义相似度提升6.1%，且缩小了大模型与小模型在注释任务上的性能差距，同时更贴合人工注释逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 结构化领域知识图谱结合多任务推理为生物信息学大模型提供了可扩展的范式，证明知识驱动能显著改善特定下游任务表现。

title: CodecSight: Leveraging Video Codec Signals for Efficient Streaming VLM Inference
summary:
Video streaming analytics is a crucial workload for vision-language model serving, but the high cost of multimodal inference limits scalability. Prior systems reduce inference cost by exploiting temporal and spatial redundancy in video streams, but they target either the vision transformer (ViT) or the LLM with a limited view, leaving end-to-end opportunities untapped. Moreover, existing methods incur significant overhead to identify redundancy, either through offline profiling and training or costly online computation, making them ill-suited for dynamic real-time streams.
  We present CodecSight, a codec-guided streaming video analytics system, built on a key observation that video codecs already extract the temporal and spatial structure of each stream as a byproduct of compression. CodecSight treats this codec metadata as a low-cost runtime signal to unify optimization across video decoding, visual processing, and LLM prefilling, with transmission reduction as an inherent benefit of operating directly on compressed bitstreams. This drives codec-guided patch pruning before ViT encoding and selective key-value cache refresh during LLM prefilling, both of which are fully online and do not require offline training. Experiments show that CodecSight achieves an improvement in throughput of up to 3$\times$, and a reduction of up to 87% in GPU compute over state-of-the-art baselines, maintaining competitive accuracy with only 0$\sim$8% F1 drop.

AI.tldr: CodecSight 利用视频编解码器自带的时空结构元数据，在无需离线训练的前提下实现端到端流式视觉-语言推理加速，吞吐量提升 3×、GPU 计算降 87%，F1 仅下降 0–8%。
AI.motivation: 视频流视觉-语言分析成本高，现有方法仅孤立优化 ViT 或 LLM，且依赖昂贵离/在线冗余检测，难以实时扩展。
AI.method: 以编解码器压缩过程中产生的运动/残差元数据为信号，在压缩域直接指导：①ViT 前 patch 剪枝；②LLM prefilling 时选择性 KV 缓存刷新，全程在线、无训练开销。
AI.result: 相比 SOTA 基线，吞吐最高提升 3×，GPU 计算量最多降低 87%，F1 下降 ≤ 8%，精度保持可比。
AI.conclusion: CodecSight 首次把编解码器元数据作为统一、零成本的运行时线索，实现端到端流式多模态推理的在线加速，验证压缩域协同优化可兼顾高吞吐、低算力与高精度。

title: Are Sparse Autoencoders Useful for Java Function Bug Detection?
comment: I'm working on a completely new paper with different models and datasets and authors. I believe it to be a more robust contribution. Since the authors, title and hypothesis are different, I believe it to be a better approach to remove this preprint
summary: Software vulnerabilities such as buffer overflows and SQL injections are a major source of security breaches. Traditional methods for vulnerability detection remain essential but are limited by high false positive rates, scalability issues, and reliance on manual effort. These constraints have driven interest in AI-based approaches to automated vulnerability detection and secure code generation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for classification tasks, their complexity and opacity pose challenges for interpretability and deployment. Sparse Autoencoder offer a promising solution to this problem. We explore whether SAEs can serve as a lightweight, interpretable alternative for bug detection in Java functions.
