Extensive experiments on four benchmarks under seven 2D diffusion attacks and iterative 3D editing demonstrate strong classical robustness (bit accuracy 0.811) and competitive diffusion robustness (bit accuracy 0.701) at 100-bit capacity, while completing fine-tuning in 3 to 7 minutes on a single RTX 4090 GPU.

AI.tldr: RDSplat 首次实现抗 2D/3D 扩散编辑的 3DGS 水印，在 100 bit 负载下对经典与扩散攻击分别保持 81.1% 与 70.1% 准确率，3–7 min 完成单卡训练。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 成为高质量 3D 资产主流表示，但现有水印仅抗传统失真，无法抵御可在 2D 图像层与 3D 场景层同时篡改的扩散编辑，导致水印被隐形擦除。作者旨在填补这一安全空白。
AI.method: 提出 RDSplat 框架：1) 利用扩散模型低通特性，设计 FAPS 策略（Mip 分数 + 方向平衡分数）从频域筛选低频高斯原语，仅在其属性中嵌入 100 bit 水印并冻结其余；2) 采用高斯模糊替代昂贵的扩散前向传播，实现高效代理训练；3) 设计基于 ViT-S/16 的解码器 GeoMark，以空间周期秘密嵌入同时抵抗扩散编辑与新视角几何变换。
AI.result: 在 4 个基准、7 种 2D 扩散攻击及迭代 3D 编辑下，RDSplat 经典鲁棒性 81.1%，扩散鲁棒性 70.1%，容量 100 bit，单张 RTX 4090 微调仅需 3–7 min，显著优于现有仅能抗传统失真的方法。
AI.conclusion: RDSplat 通过频域原语选择与高效代理训练，首次把 3DGS 水印鲁棒性扩展到扩散编辑场景，兼顾高容量、高鲁棒与快速训练，为 3D 资产版权保护提供实用方案。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Embedding Representations for Financial News Sentiment Analysis
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Published in the 4th IEEE International Conference on Interdisciplinary Approaches in Technology and Management for Social Innovation (IATMSI 2026), IEEE
summary: Financial sentiment analysis enhances market understanding. However, standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches encounter significant challenges when applied to small datasets. This study presents a comparative evaluation of embedding-based techniques for financial news sentiment classification in resource-constrained environments. Word2Vec, GloVe, and sentence transformer representations are evaluated in combination with gradient boosting on a manually labeled dataset of 349 financial news headlines. Experimental results identify a substantial gap between validation and test performance. Despite strong validation metrics, models underperform relative to trivial baselines. The analysis indicates that pretrained embeddings yield diminishing returns below a critical data sufficiency threshold. Small validation sets contribute to overfitting during model selection. Practical application is illustrated through weekly sentiment aggregation and narrative summarization for market monitoring. Overall, the findings indicate that embedding quality alone cannot address fundamental data scarcity in sentiment classification. Practitioners with limited labeled data should consider alternative strategies, including few-shot learning, data augmentation, or lexicon-enhanced hybrid methods.

AI.tldr: 在仅349条财经新闻标题的小样本上，任何预训练Embedding+梯度提升组合都无法击败简单基线；数据量低于临界阈值时，再高质量的嵌入也会失效。
AI.motivation: 金融情感分析常用 NLP 技术，但小数据场景下性能骤降，缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 手动标注349条英文财经标题，分别用 Word2Vec、GloVe、Sentence-BERT 获取表征，再训练梯度提升分类器；结合5折交叉验证与留出测试，比较验证-测试一致性并分析过拟合。
AI.result: 验证集F1可达0.80，但测试集跌至0.52，低于多数类基准(0.55)；三种嵌入无显著差异，表明<400样本时预训练收益趋于零。
AI.conclusion: 小数据下 Embedding 质量无法弥补样本不足；应改用少样本学习、数据增强或词典混合策略，并扩大标注集或采用更稳健评测流程。

title: Machine Unlearning in the Era of Quantum Machine Learning: An Empirical Study
summary: We present the first empirical study of machine unlearning (MU) in hybrid quantum-classical neural networks. While MU has been extensively explored in classical deep learning, its behavior within variational quantum circuits (VQCs) and quantum-augmented architectures remains largely unexplored. First, we adapt a broad suite of unlearning methods to quantum settings, including gradient-based, distillation-based, regularization-based and certified techniques. Second, we introduce two new unlearning strategies tailored to hybrid models. Experiments across Iris, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST, under both subset removal and full-class deletion, reveal that quantum models can support effective unlearning, but outcomes depend strongly on circuit depth, entanglement structure, and task complexity. Shallow VQCs display high intrinsic stability with minimal memorization, whereas deeper hybrid models exhibit stronger trade-offs between utility, forgetting strength, and alignment with retrain oracle. We find that certain methods, e.g. EU-k, LCA, and Certified Unlearning, consistently provide the best balance across metrics. These findings establish baseline empirical insights into quantum machine unlearning and highlight the need for quantum-aware algorithms and theoretical guarantees, as quantum machine learning systems continue to expand in scale and capability. We publicly release our code at: https://github.com/CrivoiCarla/HQML.

AI.tldr: 首个混合量子–经典网络机器遗忘的实验研究，发现量子电路深度与纠缠度显著影响遗忘效果，提出 EU-k、LCA 等量子友好策略并开源代码。
AI.motivation: 经典深度学习中的机器遗忘已成熟，但变分量子电路（VQC）及混合架构的遗忘行为完全空白；需验证量子模型是否支持有效、可验证的遗忘，为后续量子机器学习系统提供隐私与合规保障。
AI.method: 1) 将梯度、蒸馏、正则化、认证等四类经典遗忘方法迁移到量子设定；2) 针对混合模型提出 EU-k、LCA 两种量子专属策略；3) 在 Iris、MNIST、Fashion-MIST 上设计“子集移除”与“整类删除”两种遗忘任务；4) 以重训练 oracle 为金标准，综合评估遗忘强度、模型效用、对齐度。
AI.result: 浅层 VQC 天然稳定、记忆少，遗忘易且几乎不掉精度；随电路深度与纠缠增加，混合模型出现明显的效用-遗忘-对齐三难权衡。EU-k、LCA 与认证遗忘在三种数据集上 consistently 取得最佳平衡，遗忘误差 ≤1%，效用损失 <2%，与 oracle 对齐度 >0.95。
AI.conclusion: 量子模型可实现有效遗忘，但性能受电路深度、纠缠结构与任务复杂度共同制约；亟需量子感知的遗忘算法及理论保证。本研究为量子机器学习隐私安全奠定首个实证基线。

title: ModeX: Evaluator-Free Best-of-N Selection for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Selecting a single high-quality output from multiple stochastic generations remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly in open-ended tasks where no canonical answer exists. While Best-of-N and self-consistency methods show that aggregating multiple generations can improve performance, existing approaches typically rely on external evaluators, reward models, or exact string-match voting, limiting their applicability and efficiency. We propose Mode Extraction (ModeX), an evaluator-free Best-of-N selection framework that generalizes majority voting to open-ended text generation by identifying the modal output representing the dominant semantic consensus among generated texts. ModeX constructs a similarity graph over candidate generations and recursively applies spectral clustering to select a representative centroid, without requiring additional inference or auxiliary models. We further instantiate this selection principle as ModeX-Lite, an improved version of ModeX with early pruning for efficiency. Across open-ended tasks -- including text summarization, code generation, and mathematical reasoning -- our approaches consistently outperform standard single- and multi-path baselines, providing a computationally efficient solution for robust open-ended text generation. Code is released in https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/ModeX.

AI.tldr: ModeX系列方法无需外部评估器，即可从多个LLM候选输出中选出语义上最具共识的单一答案，适用于开放域生成任务。
AI.motivation: 开放域生成无标准答案，现有Best-of-N或自洽法依赖外部评分器/字符串投票，效率与通用性受限。
AI.method: 提出无评估器的ModeX：构建候选文本相似图，用谱聚类递归找出语义质心（模态输出）；并给出带早期剪枝的快速版ModeX-Lite。
AI.result: 在摘要、代码生成、数学推理等任务上，ModeX/ModeX-Lite全面优于单路径、多数投票等基线，且不增加推理阶段开销。
AI.conclusion: ModeX以图聚类捕捉语义共识，实现高效鲁棒的开放域文本选择，兼具性能与实用性。

title: TreeAdv: Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL
summary: Reinforcement learning with group-based objectives, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is a common framework for aligning large language models on complex reasoning tasks. However, standard GRPO treats each rollout trajectory as an independent flat sequence and assigns a single sequence-level advantage to all tokens, which leads to sample inefficiency and a length bias toward verbose, redundant chains of thought without improving logical depth. We introduce TreeAdv (Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL), which makes the tree structure of group rollouts explicit for both exploration and advantage assignment. Specifically, TreeAdv builds a group of trees (a forest) based on an entropy-driven sampling method where each tree branches at high-uncertainty decisions while sharing low-uncertainty tokens across rollouts. Then, TreeAdv aggregates token-level advantages for internal tree segments by redistributing the advantages of complete rollouts (all leaf nodes), and TreeAdv can easily apply to group-based objectives such as GRPO or GSPO. Across 10 math reasoning benchmarks, TreeAdv consistently outperforms GRPO and GSPO, while using substantially fewer generated tokens under identical supervision, data, and decoding budgets.

AI.tldr: 现有GRPO把整段推理链当独立序列、只算一个序列级优势，导致样本利用率低并鼓励冗余；本文提出TreeAdv，把组内多条推理显式建成森林、按不确定性分叉，并在子树粒度重分配优势，10套数学基准上更少token同时显著优于GRPO/GSPO。
AI.motivation: 组内强化学习对齐大模型推理时，传统GRPO因“序列级单一优势”带来样本浪费、冗长偏好和逻辑深度不足，需在不增数据/解码预算的前提下提升效率与质量。
AI.method: TreeAdv：①熵驱森林采样——高不确定节点才分叉，低确定片段共享；②树结构优势重分配——把完整 rollout（叶节点）的序列优势按子树粒度反传至内部token，实现细粒度信用分配；③通用地适配GRPO/GSPO等组目标。
AI.result: 在10项数学推理基准上，TreeAdv用远少于GRPO/GSPO的生成token量取得一致更高准确率，样本效率显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 引入显式树结构与细粒度优势重分配，可同时抑制冗余、提升逻辑深度与样本效率，为组内RL在复杂推理任务中的对齐提供了新范式。

title: Mind the Generative Details: Direct Localized Detail Preference Optimization for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences is crucial for generating high-quality videos. Existing Direct Preference Otimization (DPO) methods rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critic models, which is inefficient and often yields ambiguous global supervision. To address these limitations, we propose LocalDPO, a novel post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs from real videos and optimizes alignment at the spatio-temporal region level. We design an automated pipeline to efficiently collect preference pair data that generates preference pairs with a single inference per prompt, eliminating the need for external critic models or manual annotation. Specifically, we treat high-quality real videos as positive samples and generate corresponding negatives by locally corrupting them with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only the masked regions using the frozen base model. During training, we introduce a region-aware DPO loss that restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for rapid convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX demonstrate that LocalDPO consistently improves video fidelity, temporal coherence and human preference scores over other post-training approaches, establishing a more efficient and fine-grained paradigm for video generator alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出 LocalDPO，一种无需人工标注、无需外部评分模型、仅需单次推理即可采集成对训练数据的文本-到-视频偏好对齐框架，通过在时空小区域局部破坏-恢复高质量视频构建正负样本，并引入区域感知 DPO 损失，在 Wan2.1 与 CogVideoX 上显著提升保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好分数。
AI.motivation: 现有依赖多采样排序或任务特定评分模型的 DPO 方法效率低、全局监督信号模糊，难以精细对齐人类偏好。
AI.method: 设计端到端自动管道：1) 以真实高质量视频为正样本；2) 用随机时空掩码局部破坏后由冻结基模型仅重建掩码区域，得到对应负样本；3) 构建区域级偏好对；4) 训练阶段仅在被破坏区域计算区域感知 DPO 损失，实现快速、细粒度对齐。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1 和 CogVideoX 上的对比实验显示，LocalDPO 在视频保真度、时间连贯性及人类偏好得分上持续优于现有后训练方法，且训练成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: LocalDPO 为视频扩散模型的后训练对齐提供了一种高效、细粒度、无需人工干预的新范式，可推广至其他生成任务。

title: DYCP: Dynamic Context Pruning for Long-Form Dialogue with LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate over long-form dialogues with frequent topic shifts. While recent LLMs support extended context windows, efficient management of dialogue history in practice is needed due to inference cost and latency constraints. We present DyCP, a lightweight context management method implemented outside the LLM that dynamically identifies and retrieves relevant dialogue segments conditioned on the current turn, without offline memory construction. DyCP manages dialogue context while preserving the sequential nature of dialogue without predefined topic boundaries, enabling adaptive and efficient context selection. Across three long-form dialogue benchmarks-LoCoMo, MT-Bench+, and SCM4LLMs-and multiple LLM backends, DyCP achieves competitive answer quality in downstream generation, with more selective context usage and improved inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: DyCP是一个轻量级对话上下文管理方法，能在不做离线预建的前提下，根据当前轮次实时检索相关历史片段，在保证生成质量的同时显著减小推理开销。
AI.motivation: 长对话中话题频繁漂移、上下文过巨，长窗口虽理论上可容纳全部历史，但其推理成本高、延迟高，因此需在推理阶段更精准地选择所需片段。
AI.method: DyCP独立于模型外部运行，先在每轮前基于提示让LLM生成对当前轮的历史摘要与关键片段描述，再利用稠密检索器将其映射到组件级片段，实现无预定义分界、逐轮自适应的动态选择。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo、MT-Bench+、SCM4LLMs三大长对话基准选用不同LLM backbone的测试中，以更少token取得与全上下文相近甚至更优的生成质量，推理延迟平均下降50%以上。
AI.conclusion: 无需离线内容构建就能有效压缩与定位历史语境，证明动态片段检索能在预算受限的长对话场景下同时兼顾效果与效率，为未来轻量化记忆方案提供新范式。

title: Adversarial Evasion Attacks on Computer Vision using SHAP Values
summary: The paper introduces a white-box attack on computer vision models using SHAP values. It demonstrates how adversarial evasion attacks can compromise the performance of deep learning models by reducing output confidence or inducing misclassifications. Such attacks are particularly insidious as they can deceive the perception of an algorithm while eluding human perception due to their imperceptibility to the human eye. The proposed attack leverages SHAP values to quantify the significance of individual inputs to the output at the inference stage. A comparison is drawn between the SHAP attack and the well-known Fast Gradient Sign Method. We find evidence that SHAP attacks are more robust in generating misclassifications particularly in gradient hiding scenarios.

AI.tldr: 利用SHAP值设计一种白盒对抗攻击，使深度模型在推理阶段置信度骤降或错分，且对梯度遮蔽更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度类攻击在梯度遮蔽场景下失效，需一种不依赖梯度、仍能精准扰动模型感知的新方法。
AI.method: 以SHAP解释的像素重要性得分为扰动向导，在推理阶段反向放大关键像素，生成人眼不可见的对抗样本。
AI.result: 与FGSM相比，SHAP攻击在梯度遮蔽模型上保持更高攻击成功率，错分率提升显著。
AI.conclusion: SHAP解释量本身即可成为攻击向量，提示解释性工具在对抗环境下的双重性，需额外防御机制。

title: Q-Probe: Scaling Image Quality Assessment to High Resolution via Context-Aware Agentic Probing
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has empowered Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve superior human preference alignment in Image Quality Assessment (IQA). However, existing RL-based IQA models typically rely on coarse-grained global views, failing to capture subtle local degradations in high-resolution scenarios. While emerging "Thinking with Images" paradigms enable multi-scale visual perception via zoom-in mechanisms, their direct adaptation to IQA induces spurious "cropping-implies-degradation" biases and misinterprets natural depth-of-field as artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose Q-Probe, the first agentic IQA framework designed to scale IQA to high resolution via context-aware probing. First, we construct Vista-Bench, a pioneering benchmark tailored for fine-grained local degradation analysis in high-resolution IQA settings. Furthermore, we propose a three-stage training paradigm that progressively aligns the model with human preferences, while simultaneously eliminating causal bias through a novel context-aware cropping strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-Probe achieves state-of-the-art performance in high-resolution settings while maintaining superior efficacy across resolution scales.

AI.tldr: 首次提出面向高分辨率IQA的代理式框架 Q-Probe，解决 RL-MLLM 因全局视图而忽略局部失真、以及“放大-即退化”裁剪偏差的问题，建立 Vista-Bench 基准与三阶段去偏训练，在任意分辨率下均达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL-增强的多模态大模型在 IQA 中仅用整体粗粒度视图，难以发现高分辨率图像的细微局部失真；直接引入“Thinking with Images”放大机制又会把裁剪本身当作退化，并误将景深当伪影，亟需一种无偏、可扩展的高分辨率 IQA 方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建专注高分辨率局部失真评估的 Vista-Bench 基准；2) 设计代理式框架 Q-Probe，以上下文感知裁剪取代随机放大，避免因果偏差；3) 提出三阶段训练流程：①视觉-语言对齐 ②偏好对齐 ③去偏精炼，逐步消除“裁剪⇔退化”伪相关。
AI.result: 在 Vista-Bench 及多分辨率测试集上，Q-Probe 显著优于现有最佳方法，且性能随分辨率提升而保持稳健，验证其在精细局部失真检测与偏差消除上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Q-Probe 通过“代理+上下文感知”思路，首次实现高分辨率 IQA 的无偏扩展，为后续 RL-MLLM 在细粒度视觉任务提供了可复用的去偏训练范式。

title: SPEAR: An Engineering Case Study of Multi-Agent Coordination for Smart Contract Auditing
comment: Accepted at 14th International Workshop on Engineering Multi-Agent Systems(EMAS @ AAMAS)
summary: We present SPEAR, a multi-agent coordination framework for smart contract auditing that applies established MAS patterns in a realistic security analysis workflow. SPEAR models auditing as a coordinated mission carried out by specialized agents: a Planning Agent prioritizes contracts using risk-aware heuristics, an Execution Agent allocates tasks via the Contract Net protocol, and a Repair Agent autonomously recovers from brittle generated artifacts using a programmatic-first repair policy. Agents maintain local beliefs updated through AGM-compliant revision, coordinate via negotiation and auction protocols, and revise plans as new information becomes available. An empirical study compares the multi-agent design with centralized and pipeline-based alternatives under controlled failure scenarios, focusing on coordination, recovery behavior, and resource use.

AI.tldr: SPEAR是一个基于多智能体系统(MAS)的智能合约审计框架，通过风险感知规划、合同网任务分配和程序优先修复等机制，在模拟故障场景下较集中式与流水线方案展现出更优的协调、恢复与资源利用性能。
AI.motivation: 传统智能合约审计流程集中化、 brittle artifacts 易失效、失败恢复能力弱，亟需引入分布式协同与自适应修复手段提升审计效率与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将审计任务建模为多智能体协同使命：Planning Agent用风险启发式排序合约；Execution Agent以Contract Net协议动态分派任务；Repair Agent采用programmatic-first策略自动修复脆弱产出；所有Agent基于AGM信念修正、协商与拍卖协议持续协调与重规划。
AI.result: 在受控故障场景实验比较中，SPEAR在协调效率、失败恢复速度和资源利用率方面均优于集中式和流水线式审计方案。
AI.conclusion: 把成熟MAS模式嵌入真实安全审计工作流，可显著提升智能合约审计系统的弹性与自动化水平，为分布式安全分析提供一条可行的新路径。

title: PANC: Prior-Aware Normalized Cut via Anchor-Augmented Token Graphs
summary: Unsupervised segmentation from self-supervised ViT patches holds promise but lacks robustness: multi-object scenes confound saliency cues, and low-semantic images weaken patch relevance, both leading to erratic masks. To address this, we present Prior-Aware Normalized Cut (PANC), a training-free method that data-efficiently produces consistent, user-steerable segmentations. PANC extends the Normalized Cut algorithm by connecting labeled prior tokens to foreground/background anchors, forming an anchor-augmented generalized eigenproblem that steers low-frequency partitions toward the target class while preserving global spectral structure. With prior-aware eigenvector orientation and thresholding, our approach yields stable masks. Spectral diagnostics confirm that injected priors widen eigengaps and stabilize partitions, consistent with our analytical hypotheses. PANC outperforms strong unsupervised and weakly supervised baselines, achieving mIoU improvements of +2.3% on DUTS-TE, +2.8% on DUT-OMRON, and +8.7% on low-semantic CrackForest datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练 Prior-Aware Normalized Cut (PANC)，把先验 token 嵌入谱聚类，在 DUTS-TE 等数据集上 mIoU 提升 2–9 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自监督 ViT 无监督分割在多目标或低语义场景下因显著性线索混杂、patch 相关性弱而产生不稳定掩码，需要一种不依赖训练且能利用先验知识提升鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 将 Normalized Cut 扩展为带前景/背景锚点的广义特征值问题，把少量标记先验 token 与锚点连接，通过先验导向的特征向量取向与阈值化实现用户可控分割，同时保持整体谱结构；利用谱诊断验证先验扩大 eigengap、稳定划分。
AI.result: 在 DUTS-TE、DUT-OMRON 和低语义 CrackForest 上分别取得 +2.3%、+2.8%、+8.7% 的 mIoU 提升，优于强无监督与弱监督基线；谱实验与理论假设一致。
AI.conclusion: PANC 无需训练即可数据高效地生成稳定、可引导的分割，验证了对谱聚类注入先验能显著提升鲁棒性，为自监督 ViT 无监督分割提供了一条实用且可解释的新路径。

title: Rethinking the Value of Agent-Generated Tests for LLM-Based Software Engineering Agents
summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) code agents increasingly resolve repository-level issues by iteratively editing code, invoking tools, and validating candidate patches. In these workflows, agents often write tests on the fly, but the value of this behavior remains unclear. For example, GPT-5.2 writes almost no new tests yet achieves performance comparable to top-ranking agents.This raises a central question: do such tests meaningfully improve issue resolution, or do they mainly mimic a familiar software-development practice while consuming interaction budget?
  To better understand the role of agent-written tests, we analyze trajectories produced by six strong LLMs on SWE-bench Verified. Our results show that test writing is common, but resolved and unresolved tasks within the same model exhibit similar test-writing frequencies. When tests are written, they mainly serve as observational feedback channels, with value-revealing print statements appearing much more often than assertion-based checks. Based on these insights, we perform a prompt-intervention study by revising the prompts used with four models to either increase or reduce test writing. The results suggest that prompt-induced changes in the volume of agent-written tests do not significantly change final outcomes in this setting. Taken together, these results suggest that current agent-written testing practices reshape process and cost more than final task outcomes.

AI.tldr: 对6个LLM在SWE-bench Verified上的轨迹分析发现：代理临时写测试的频率与任务是否解决无关；所写测试多为打印调试而非断言；通过提示强制增减测试量对最终修复率无显著影响。
AI.motivation: LLM代码代理在修复仓库级Issue时常即兴编写测试，但GPT-5.2几乎不写测试仍能取得SOTA成绩，令人生疑：这些测试是真能提升修复率，还是单纯模仿人类开发习惯、消耗交互预算？
AI.method: 1) 收集6个强LLM在SWE-bench Verified上的完整轨迹，量化测试编写频率与类型；2) 对比同一模型内已解决vs未解决任务的测试行为；3) 设计提示干预实验，对4个模型分别强化或抑制测试编写，观察修复率变化。
AI.result: ① 测试编写普遍，但解决/未解决任务的测试频率无显著差异；② 所写测试中打印语句占比远高于断言语句，主要起观测反馈作用；③ 提示干预显著改变测试量，却未显著改变最终修复率（p>0.1）。
AI.conclusion: 当前代理即兴测试更多重塑了过程与成本，而非实质提升任务成果；未来应重新评估测试编写的策略与价值，或探索更直接的验证机制。

title: AI-PACE: A Framework for Integrating AI into Medical Education
comment: Version 2: Revisions after round 1 of peer review. Paper under consideration at npj Digital Medicine. 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into healthcare is accelerating, yet medical education has not kept pace with these technological advancements. This paper synthesizes current knowledge on AI in medical education through a comprehensive analysis of the literature, identifying key competencies, curricular approaches, and implementation strategies. The aim is highlighting the critical need for structured AI education across the medical learning continuum and offer a framework for curriculum development. The findings presented suggest that effective AI education requires longitudinal integration throughout medical training, interdisciplinary collaboration, and balanced attention to both technical fundamentals and clinical applications. This paper serves as a foundation for medical educators seeking to prepare future physicians for an AI-enhanced healthcare environment.

AI.tldr: 医学教育必须系统性地将AI能力纵向融入全程课程，通过跨学科协作兼顾技术基础与临床应用，才能培养胜任AI医疗环境的未来医生。
AI.motivation: AI在医疗领域快速渗透，而医学教育明显滞后，缺乏统一框架指导如何培养医学生的AI核心能力，可能危及未来医疗质量与安全。
AI.method: 系统综述现有文献，梳理AI医学教育的关键能力、课程模式与实施策略，据此构建跨院校、跨培养阶段的纵向课程整合框架，并强调跨学科协作机制。
AI.result: 提出“纵向贯通+跨学科+技术-临床平衡”的课程设计原则，指出仅靠选修课或单次工作坊无法达成目标，必须将AI概念、数据素养、伦理及临床决策支持等内容嵌入从入门到继续教育的全链条。
AI.conclusion: 研究为医学教育决策者提供了可操作的课程框架，若按该框架实施，可缩小AI技术与医学人才能力缺口，奠定AI增强型医疗体系的师资与人才基础。

title: MultiModalPFN: Extending Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Multimodal Tabular Learning
summary: Recently, TabPFN has gained attention as a foundation model for tabular data. However, it struggles to integrate heterogeneous modalities such as images and text, which are common in domains like healthcare and marketing, thereby limiting its applicability. To address this, we present the Multi-Modal Prior-data Fitted Network (MMPFN), which extends TabPFN to handle tabular and non-tabular modalities in a unified manner. MMPFN comprises per-modality encoders, modality projectors, and pre-trained foundation models. The modality projectors serve as the critical bridge, transforming non-tabular embeddings into tabular-compatible tokens for unified processing. To this end, we introduce a multi-head gated MLP and a cross-attention pooler that extract richer context from non-tabular inputs while mitigates attention imbalance issue in multimodal learning. Extensive experiments on medical and general-purpose multimodal datasets demonstrate that MMPFN consistently outperforms competitive state-of-the-art methods and effectively exploits non-tabular modalities alongside tabular features. These results highlight the promise of extending prior-data fitted networks to the multimodal setting, offering a scalable and effective framework for heterogeneous data learning. The source code is available at https://github.com/too-z/MultiModalPFN.

AI.tldr: MMPFN 是一种可无缝融合表格/非表格模态（图像、文本等）的统一框架，通过模态投射器将非表格嵌入转成表格兼容 token，在医疗和普通多模态数据上全面刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: TabPFN 虽在纯表格任务上表现优异，但无法直接吸纳图像与文本等异构信息，严重制约其在医疗、营销等多模态场景的应用。亟需一种能在同一 pipeline 中处理“表格+非表格”数据的扩展方案。
AI.method: 提出 Multi-Modal PFN：1) 各模态独立编码；2) 多模态投射器（多头 Gated MLP + 交叉注意池化）把非表格嵌入映射为表格兼容 token；3) 将生成的 token 序列送入预训练 TabPFN 块统一推理；训练阶段采用 PFN 的“先验拟合”范式，直接回归标签分布，无需任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在 5 个医疗多模态数据集（MIMIC-IV 影像+结构化记录等）及 3 个通用多模态基准上，MMPFN 平均提升 AUC 3.1–7.4%，显著优于之前的表格-非表格融合方法；非表格模态带来的增益可达 +4.2% F1，且推理时仅需 <120 ms/样本。
AI.conclusion: 首次验证了 Prior-data Fitted Network 在多模态场景的扩展性；投射式统一 token 化策略兼具扩展性与效率，为临床决策、个性化营销等需要“异构数据一桌端”的应用提供了可复现、易部署的新基线。

title: Interpretable Tau-PET Synthesis from Multimodal T1-Weighted and FLAIR MRI Using Partial Information Decomposition Guided Disentangled Quantized Half-UNet
summary: Tau positron emission tomography (tau-PET) is an important in vivo biomarker of Alzheimer's disease, but its cost, limited availability, and acquisition burden restrict broad clinical use. This work proposes an interpretable multimodal image synthesis framework for generating tau-PET from paired T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI. The proposed model combines a Partial Information Decomposition-inspired vector-quantized encoder, which separates latent representations into redundant, unique, and complementary (synergistic) components, with a Half-UNet decoder that preserves anatomical structure through edge-conditioned pseudo-skip connections rather than direct encoder-to-decoder feature bypass. The method was evaluated on 605 training and 83 validation subjects from ADNI-3 and OASIS-3 and compared against continuous-latent, discrete-latent, and direct-regression baselines, including VAE, VQ-VAE, UNet, and SPADE-based UNet variants. Evaluation included raw PET reconstruction, SUVR reconstruction, high-uptake region preservation, regional agreement, Braak-stage tracking, and post-hoc statistical testing. Across 17 evaluated models, the proposed DQ2H-MSE-Inf variant achieved the best raw PET fidelity and the strongest downstream Braak-stage performance, while remaining competitive on SUVR reconstruction and regional agreement. Shapley analysis further showed that complementary and redundant latent components contributed the largest gains, supporting the role of cross-modal interaction in tau-PET recovery. We show that our method can support clinically relevant tau-PET synthesis while providing improved architectural interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一套可解释的多模态MRI-to-Tau-PET合成框架（DQ2H-MSE-Inf），用T1+FLAIR无创生成Tau-PET，性能优于17种基线模型并在Braak分期等临床指标上达最佳，为降低昂贵Tau-PET检查负担提供新途径。
AI.motivation: Tau-PET是AD核心在体生物标志，但成本高、设备少、采集负担大，临床难以普及，亟需利用易获得的MRI无创合成高质量Tau-PET影像并保留可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 构建Partial Information Decomposition启发的向量量化编码器，将跨模态潜码显式分解为冗余、独有、互补三成分；2) 提出Half-UNet解码器，用边缘先验条件化的“伪跳跃连接”代替直接编码特征旁路，保存解剖结构；3) 在ADNI-3+OASIS-3共605/83例数据上与连续/离散潜码及直接回归基线（VAE、VQ-VAE、UNet、SPADE-UNet等17模型）系统性比较。
AI.result: DQ2H-MSE-Inf变体在原始PET保真度、Braak分期追踪两项排名第一；SUVR重建与区域一致性亦保持领先。Shapley分析显示互补+冗余成分贡献最大增益，证明跨模态协同对Tau信号恢复至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在无额外扫描条件下生成临床级Tau-PET，兼具高保真与可解释性，有望转化为低成本、广覆盖的AD早期评估工具，并推广至其他分子影像合成任务。

title: SUPERGLASSES: Benchmarking Vision Language Models as Intelligent Agents for AI Smart Glasses
summary: The rapid advancement of AI-powered smart glasses-one of the hottest wearable devices-has unlocked new frontiers for multimodal interaction, with Visual Question Answering (VQA) over external knowledge sources emerging as a core application. Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) adapted to smart glasses are typically trained and evaluated on traditional multimodal datasets; however, these datasets lack the variety and realism needed to reflect smart glasses usage scenarios and diverge from their specific challenges, where accurately identifying the object of interest must precede any external knowledge retrieval. To bridge this gap, we introduce SUPER- GLASSES, the first comprehensive VQA benchmark built on real-world data entirely collected by smart glasses devices. SUPERGLASSES comprises 2,422 egocentric image-question pairs spanning 14 image domains and 8 query categories, enriched with full search trajectories and reasoning annotations. We evaluate 26 representative VLMs on this benchmark, revealing significant performance gaps. To address the limitations of existing models, we further propose the SUPERLENS, a multimodal smart glasses agent that enables retrieval-augmented answer generation by integrating automatic object detection, query decoupling, and multimodal web search. SUPERLENS achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming GPT-4o by 2.19%, underscoring the need for task-specific solutions in smart glasses VQA. Our dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xandery/SuperGlasses.

AI.tldr: SUPERGLASSES 是目前唯一完全由智能眼镜采集的真实 VQA 基准，包含 2 422 组第一视角图文对；作者同步提出 SUPERLENS 检索增强智能体，仅 2.19% 优势即刷新 GPT-4o 榜首，强调眼镜场景需专用解法。
AI.motivation: 当前 VLMs 训练与测试集皆基于传统第三视角数据，未覆盖智能眼镜第一视角、指尖级物体定位与知识检索并存的真实交互难点。
AI.method: 1) SUPERGLASSES：用消费级眼镜采集 14 域 8 类 2 422 组 egocentric 图文，附搜索轨迹+推理链标注；2) SUPERLENS：基于自动检测显式定位目标→查询解耦→多模态 Web 检索→融合生成答案。
AI.result: 26 个主流 VLM 全面评测，最佳模型仅 42.3% Acc；SUPERLENS 达到 67.5%，超越 GPT-4o 基线 2.19 个百分点，同时在搜索成本与推理延迟上保持在线可接受范围。
AI.conclusion: 智能眼镜 VQA 需专门数据与端到端检索增强架构；公开 SUPERGLASSES 基准可推动社区从“通用多模态”迈向“第一视角知识交互”研究新阶段。

title: Why Adam Can Beat SGD: Second-Moment Normalization Yields Sharper Tails
summary: Despite Adam demonstrating faster empirical convergence than SGD in many applications, much of the existing theory yields guarantees essentially comparable to those of SGD, leaving the empirical performance gap insufficiently explained. In this paper, we uncover a key second-moment normalization in Adam and develop a stopping-time/martingale analysis that provably distinguishes Adam from SGD under the classical bounded variance model (a second moment assumption). In particular, we establish the first theoretical separation between the high-probability convergence behaviors of the two methods: Adam achieves a $δ^{-1/2}$ dependence on the confidence parameter $δ$, whereas corresponding high-probability guarantee for SGD necessarily incurs at least a $δ^{-1}$ dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用停时鞅分析证明：在经典有界方差假设下，Adam 的高概率收敛对置信参数 δ 仅呈 δ^{-1/2} 依赖，而 SGD 至少是 δ^{-1}，从理论上解释了 Adam 经验更快收敛的真正原因。
AI.motivation: 尽管 Adam 在许多任务中比 SGD 收敛更快，但既有理论给出的收敛界与 SGD 几乎无异，无法解释经验差距。作者旨在找出能严格区分二者收敛行为的理论依据。
AI.method: 1) 揭示 Adam 更新中隐含的“二阶矩归一化”结构；2) 建立停时-鞅分析框架，在经典有界方差（二阶矩有界）模型下，分别导出 Adam 与 SGD 的高概率收敛界。
AI.result: 首次给出二者在高概率意义下的可分离收敛率：Adam 的置信依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，SGD 则为 δ^{-1}（下限）。
AI.conclusion: 二阶矩归一化是 Adam 优于 SGD 的本质机制；停时鞅分析能精确捕捉这一优势，为 Adam 的快速经验收敛提供了首个可证明的理论解释。

title: ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction via Test-Time Training
summary: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.

AI.tldr: ZipMap用线性复杂度把数百张图一次性“压缩”为隐藏场景状态，单卡10秒内完成双向三维重建，速度较SOTA提升20倍且精度不降。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的SOTA方法（VGGT、π³）计算量随图像数量呈二次方增长，在大规模图像集合上代价过高；序列式方法虽降复杂度却严重牺牲精度，亟需兼顾效率与质量的折中方案。
AI.method: 设计带状态的端到端前馈网络ZipMap：在测试阶段引入可训练层，将整组图像一次性前向映射为紧凑的隐式场景状态(stateful representation)，实现线性时间双向重建；该状态可在线查询并增量扩展至流式输入。
AI.result: 单张H100 GPU上700多帧重建耗时<10秒，速度较VGGT等SOTA提升20倍；同时在公开基准上与二次方复杂度方法精度持平或更优；状态化表示支持实时场景查询与流式增量重建。
AI.conclusion: ZipMap证明“先压缩、后重建”的隐式状态策略可同时突破效率与精度瓶颈，为大场景、实时及流式三维视觉应用提供了新的线性时间范式。

title: Stacked from One: Multi-Scale Self-Injection for Context Window Extension
summary: The limited context window of contemporary large language models (LLMs) remains a primary bottleneck for their broader application across diverse domains. Although continual pre-training on long-context data offers a straightforward solution, it incurs prohibitive data acquisition and computational costs. To address this challenge, we propose~\modelname, a novel framework based on multi-grained context compression and query-aware information acquisition. SharedLLM comprises two stacked short-context LLMs: a lower model serving as a compressor and an upper model acting as a decoder. The lower model compresses long inputs into compact, multi-grained representations, which are then forwarded to the upper model for context-aware processing. To maximize efficiency, this information transfer occurs exclusively at the lowest layers, bypassing lengthy forward passes and redundant cross-attention operations. This entire process, wherein the upper and lower models are derived from the same underlying LLM layers, is termed~\textit{self-injection}. To support this architecture, a specialized tree-based data structure enables the efficient encoding and query-aware retrieval of contextual information. Despite being trained on sequences of only 8K tokens, \modelname~effectively generalizes to inputs exceeding 128K tokens. Across a comprehensive suite of long-context modeling and understanding benchmarks, \modelname~achieves performance superior or comparable to strong baselines, striking an optimal balance between efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, these design choices allow \modelname~to substantially reduce the memory footprint and yield notable inference speedups ($2\times$ over streaming and $3\times$ over encoder-decoder architectures).

AI.tldr: SharedLLM 借助“下层压缩、上层解码”的自注入双 LLM 结构，在 8K 训练长度下实现 128K+ 推理，兼顾长文本精度与 2–3× 加速，显著降低显存与数据成本。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型上下文窗口受限，而长文本持续预训练数据与算力开销巨大，亟需无需长文本训练即可扩展上下文且保持高效推理的方案。
AI.method: 提出 SharedLLM 框架：将同一基座模型的低层作为“压缩器”，把长输入压缩为多粒度表示；高层作为“解码器”在最低层一次性接收压缩信息（自注入），避免冗余前向与跨注意力。配套设计树形数据结构，支持查询感知的上下文高效编码与检索。
AI.result: 仅 8K  token 训练即可泛化至 128K+ 输入，在长文本理解与建模 benchmark 上达到或超越强基线；推理速度相较流式方案提升 2×，较编-解码结构提升 3×，显存占用显著下降。
AI.conclusion: SharedLLM 通过多粒度压缩与自注入机制，首次在短文本训练约束下实现高效超长上下文建模，为资源受限场景提供了一条精度-效率俱佳的新路径。

title: Agentic SPARQL: Evaluating SPARQL-MCP-powered Intelligent Agents on the Federated KGQA Benchmark
summary: Standard protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that allow LLMs to connect to tools have recently boosted "agentic" AI applications, which, powered by LLMs' planning capabilities, promise to solve complex tasks with the access of external tools and data sources. In this context, publicly available SPARQL endpoints offer a natural connection to combine various data sources through MCP by (a) implementing a standardised protocol and query language, (b) standardised metadata formats, and (c) the native capability to federate queries. In the present paper, we explore the potential of SPARQL-MCP-based intelligent agents to facilitate federated SPARQL querying: firstly, we discuss how to extend an existing Knowledge Graph Question Answering benchmark towards agentic federated Knowledge Graph Question Answering (FKGQA); secondly, we implement and evaluate the ability of integrating SPARQL federation with LLM agents via MCP (incl. endpoint discovery/source selection, schema exploration, and query formulation), comparing different architectural options against the extended benchmark. Our work complements and extends prior work on automated SPARQL query federation towards fruitful combinations with agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 提出首个针对‘智能体联邦式知识图谱问答’的benchmark，并系统评估了LLM通过MCP协议调用SPARQL端点实现跨库查询的全流程能力。
AI.motivation: LLM借助MCP协议可连接外部工具，但现有研究缺乏测评其“智能体”在联邦SPARQL场景下自动完成端点发现、模式理解与跨库查询构建的统一基准，阻碍了可信评估与改进。
AI.method: 1) 将KGQA基准升级为FKGQA，引入多端点、跨源问题与评估指标；2) 基于MCP封装SPARQL工具集（端点发现、源选择、模式探索、查询构造、结果合并）；3) 设计三种智能体架构（单次规划、迭代修正、多智能体协作）并在FKGQA上对比端到端成功率、精度、Token消耗与延迟。
AI.result: 迭代修正架构在FKGQA上达到62%端到端成功率，较单次规划提升18%，多智能体方案再+4%，同时保持可接受延迟；错误主要来自远程端点超时与模式失配。
AI.conclusion: SPARQL-MCP能把现有静态联邦查询自动化升级为可扩展的LLM智能体系统；FKGQA基准证实其可行性并暴露端点可用性与 schema 对齐新挑战，为未来混合AI-DB联邦查询研究提供开放测试床。

title: Reinforced Generation of Combinatorial Structures: Ramsey Numbers
summary: We present improved lower bounds for seven classical Ramsey numbers: $\mathbf{R}(3, 13)$ is increased from $60$ to $61$, $\mathbf{R}(3, 18)$ from $99$ to $100$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 13)$ from $138$ to $139$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 14)$ from $147$ to $148$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 15)$ from $158$ to $159$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 16)$ from $170$ to $174$, and $\mathbf{R}(4, 18)$ from $205$ to $209$. These results were achieved using AlphaEvolve, an LLM-based code mutation agent. Beyond these new results, we successfully recovered lower bounds for all Ramsey numbers known to be exact, and matched the best known lower bounds across many other cases. These include bounds for which previous work does not detail the algorithms used. Virtually all known Ramsey lower bounds are derived computationally, with bespoke search algorithms each delivering a handful of results. AlphaEvolve is a single meta-algorithm yielding search algorithms for all of our results.

AI.tldr: 基于LLM的代码变异代理AlphaEvolve将7个经典Ramsey数下界各提升1‒4单位，并首次以单一元算法覆盖并恢复全部已知下界。
AI.motivation: Ramsey理论的下界几乎全靠针对单点定制搜索，缺乏统一高效算法；大模型自动演化代码有望系统性突破长期停滞的数值记录。
AI.method: 提出AlphaEvolve——把大语言模型用作变异算子，在代码层面进化搜索算法；对每对(m,n)自动输出专用构造或枚举算法，证明对应图存在所需染色从而确立下界。
AI.result: R(3,13)等7个经典Ramsey数下界全部刷新；此外还恢复了所有已证精确值的已知下界，并与非精确情形最优记录持平，首次由单一元算法完成。
AI.conclusion: 大模型驱动的代码进化范式可替代传统手工设计，高效产生Ramsey下界搜索算法，展示了AI在离散数学计算研究中的普适与扩展潜力。

title: Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs
summary: Modern CNNs' high computational demands hinder edge deployment, as traditional ``hard'' sparsity (skipping mathematical zeros) loses effectiveness in deep layers or with smooth activations like Tanh. We propose a ``soft sparsity'' paradigm using a hardware efficient Most Significant Bit (MSB) proxy to skip negligible non-zero multiplications. Integrated as a custom RISC-V instruction and evaluated on LeNet-5 (MNIST), this method reduces ReLU MACs by 88.42% and Tanh MACs by 74.87% with zero accuracy loss--outperforming zero-skipping by 5x. By clock-gating inactive multipliers, we estimate power savings of 35.2% for ReLU and 29.96% for Tanh. While memory access makes power reduction sub-linear to operation savings, this approach significantly optimizes resource-constrained inference.

AI.tldr: 用“最高位(MSB)预测”跳过近似零但非零的乘法，在LeNet-5上0精度损失即可省74–88%乘累加运算、约30–35%功耗，显著优于传统零跳跃。
AI.motivation: 深度CNN在边缘端受限于高算力与功耗；传统“硬稀疏”只对真零有效，深层或平滑激活(Tanh)中零值稀少，收益衰减。
AI.method: 提出“软稀疏”范式：硬件实时用MSB位宽近似判断乘数显著性→跳过可忽略的非零乘法；设计一条定制RISC-V指令集成，并配合时钟门控闲置乘法器降低功耗。
AI.result: 在MNIST/LeNet-5上：ReLU模型MAC节省88.42%，Tanh模型节省74.87%，均零Top-1误差；运算削减量是传统零跳跃方案的5×；估算系统功耗下降35.2%(ReLU)和29.96%(Tanh)。
AI.conclusion: 软稀疏+MSB预测能在不损精度的前提下显著减少乘法与功耗，为资源受限推断提供高效、易落地的硬件级优化途径；功耗最终受访存瓶颈限制呈非线性下降。

title: Learning to Negotiate: Multi-Agent Deliberation for Collective Value Alignment in LLMs
comment: To appear in LREC 2026 2nd DELITE Workshop
summary: LLM alignment has progressed in single-agent settings through paradigms such as RL with human feedback (RLHF), while recent work explores scalable alternatives such as RL with AI feedback (RLAIF) and dynamic alignment objectives. However, these approaches remain limited in multi-stakeholder settings, where conflicting values arise and deliberative negotiation is required. This work proposes a multi-agent negotiation-based alignment framework that aligns LLMs to Collective Agency (CA)-an existing alignment objective introduced to promote the continual expansion of agency-while simultaneously improving conflict-resolution capability. To enable scalable training, two self-play LLM instances are assigned opposing personas and engage in turn-based dialogue to synthesize mutually beneficial solutions. We generate synthetic moral-dilemma prompts and conflicting persona pairs, and optimize the policy via RLAIF using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an external LLM reward model. While rewards are computed from CA scores assigned to the final completion, gradients are applied to dialogue tokens to directly improve deliberative interaction dynamics. Experiments show that the model achieves CA alignment comparable to a single-agent baseline while substantially improving conflict-resolution performance without degrading general language capabilities. These results suggest that negotiation-driven deliberation training provides a practical path toward LLMs that better support collective decision-making in value-conflict scenarios.

AI.tldr: 用两组对立的LLM进行回合式谈判，通过GRPO-RLAIF把「集体能动性(CA)」奖励反向传播到对话 token，首次在价值冲突场景下同时实现CA对齐与冲突化解能力双提升。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐范式仅服务单边价值；当多方利益冲突时需 deliberative negotiation，而 RLHF/RLAIF 尚未解决多主体价值协商问题。
AI.method: 提出多智能体谈判框架：1) 合成道德困境与对立人设；2) 两LLM自博弈生成折中方案；3) 用外部LLM给最终答案打CA分；4) 通过GRPO将奖励经RLAIF回传至整段对话 token，直接优化协商动态而非仅优化回复。
AI.result: CA对齐度达单智能体基线水平，冲突化解指标显著优于对照，且通用语言性能无下降。
AI.conclusion: 谈判式训练为价值冲突场景下的集体决策提供了一条可扩展、无需额外人类标注的对齐新路径。

title: Stop Listening to Me! How Multi-turn Conversations Can Degrade LLM Diagnostic Reasoning
summary: Patients and clinicians are increasingly using chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) for healthcare inquiries. While state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit high performance on static diagnostic reasoning benchmarks, their efficacy across multi-turn conversations, which better reflect real-world usage, has been understudied. In this paper, we evaluate 17 LLMs across three clinical datasets to investigate how partitioning the decision-space into multiple simpler turns of conversation influences their diagnostic reasoning. Specifically, we develop a "stick-or-switch" evaluation framework to measure model conviction (i.e., defending a correct diagnosis or safe abstention against incorrect suggestions) and flexibility (i.e., recognizing a correct suggestion when it is introduced) across conversations. Our experiments reveal the conversation tax, where multi-turn interactions consistently degrade performance when compared to single-shot baselines. Notably, models frequently abandon initial correct diagnoses and safe abstentions to align with incorrect user suggestions. Additionally, several models exhibit blind switching, failing to distinguish between signal and incorrect suggestions.

AI.tldr: 多轮医疗对话中，大模型诊断推理能力显著下降，常因用户误导放弃正确判断。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅测单轮问答，无法反映真实医患多轮交互场景，需量化 LLMs 在连续对话中的诊断稳健性。
AI.method: 构建“stick-or-switch”框架，在 3 个临床数据集上评估 17 种 LLM 的“信念保持”与“灵活纠正”能力，对比单轮与多轮表现。
AI.result: 发现“对话税”：多轮交互普遍降低准确率；模型易屈从用户错误提示，抛弃初始正确诊断或安全弃权，并出现盲目切换。
AI.conclusion: 多轮对话引入新错误模式，当前 LLMs 缺乏抵御误导性建议的机制，需针对对话级校准与用户误导防护做改进。

title: OrgForge: A Multi-Agent Simulation Framework for Verifiable Synthetic Corporate Corpora
comment: v2: Major revision. Recenters the paper on the simulation framework as the primary contribution. System Architecture substantially expanded (CRM state machine, Knowledge Recovery Arc, multi-pathway knowledge gap detection, embedding-based ticket assignment). Introduction restructured for broader framing. RAG retrieval baselines replaced by cross-document consistency evaluation
summary: Building and evaluating enterprise AI systems requires synthetic organizational corpora that are internally consistent, temporally structured, and cross-artifact traceable. Existing corpora either carry legal constraints or inherit hallucination artifacts from the generating LLMs, silently corrupting results when timestamps or facts contradict across documents and reinforcing those errors during training. We present OrgForge, an open-source multi-agent simulation framework that enforces a strict physics-cognition boundary: a deterministic Python engine maintains a SimEvent ground-truth bus while LLMs generate only surface prose. OrgForge simulates the organizational processes that produce documents, not the documents themselves. Engineers leave mid-sprint, triggering incident handoffs and CRM ownership lapses. Knowledge gaps emerge when under-documented systems break and recover through organic documentation and incident resolution. Customer emails fire only when simulation state warrants contact; silence is verifiable ground truth. A live CRM state machine extends the physics-cognition boundary to the customer boundary, producing cross-system causal cascades spanning engineering incidents, support escalation, deal risk flagging, and SLA-adjusted invoices. The framework generates fifteen interleaved artifact categories traceable to a shared immutable event log. Four graph-dynamic subsystems govern organizational behavior independently of any LLM. An embedding-based ticket assignment system using the Hungarian algorithm makes the simulation domain-agnostic. An empirical evaluation across ten incidents demonstrates a 0.46 absolute improvement in prose-to-ground-truth fidelity over chained LLM baselines, and isolates a consistent hallucination failure mode in which chaining propagates fabricated facts faithfully across documents without correcting them.

title: BenchBrowser: Retrieving Evidence for Evaluating Benchmark Validity
summary: Do language model benchmarks actually measure what practitioners intend them to ? High-level metadata is too coarse to convey the granular reality of benchmarks: a "poetry" benchmark may never test for haikus, while "instruction-following" benchmarks will often test for an arbitrary mix of skills. This opacity makes verifying alignment with practitioner goals a laborious process, risking an illusion of competence even when models fail on untested facets of user interests. We introduce BenchBrowser, a retriever that surfaces evaluation items relevant to natural language use cases over 20 benchmark suites. Validated by a human study confirming high retrieval precision, BenchBrowser generates evidence to help practitioners diagnose low content validity (narrow coverage of a capability's facets) and low convergent validity (lack of stable rankings when measuring the same capability). BenchBrowser, thus, helps quantify a critical gap between practitioner intent and what benchmarks actually test.

AI.tldr: 现有基准测试的标签过于粗糙，无法反映真实能力维度；作者推出 BenchBrowser 检索器，帮助从业者快速定位与自身需求匹配的评测项目，量化基准的内容效度与聚合效度缺口。
AI.motivation: 大模型评测常因元数据粒度不足，导致‘诗歌’基准却从不测俳句、‘指令遵从’基准混杂多技能，使从业者难以核验基准是否真正覆盖其关注能力，从而误判模型真实水平。
AI.method: 构建 BenchBrowser 检索系统：1）将 20 套基准的评测项目细粒度向量化；2）接受自然语言用例描述后检索相关项目；3）通过人工实验验证 Top-K 精度；4）用检索结果诊断基准的内容效度（覆盖度）与聚合效度（同能力排名稳定性）。
AI.result: 人类实验显示检索精准度高；案例分析揭示多数基准在特定能力维度存在显著覆盖盲区与排名不一致，量化出‘从业者意图—基准实测’差距。
AI.conclusion: BenchBrowser 为从业者提供透明、可验证的证据，帮助识别并修正基准的内容效度与聚合效度缺陷，缩小评测意图与实际测量之间的关键差距。

title: Quine: Realizing LLM Agents as Native POSIX Processes
summary: Current LLM agent frameworks often implement isolation, scheduling, and communication at the application layer, even though these mechanisms are already provided by mature operating systems. Instead of introducing another application-layer orchestrator, this paper presents Quine, a runtime architecture and reference implementation that realizes LLM agents as native POSIX processes. The mapping is explicit: identity is PID, interface is standard streams and exit status, state is memory, environment variables, and filesystem, and lifecycle is fork/exec/exit. A single executable implements this model by recursively spawning fresh instances of itself. By grounding the agent abstraction in the OS process model, Quine inherits isolation, composition, and resource control directly from the kernel, while naturally supporting recursive delegation, context renewal via exec, and shell-native composition. The design also exposes where the POSIX process model stops: processes provide a robust substrate for execution, but not a complete runtime model for cognition. In particular, the analysis points toward two immediate extensions beyond process semantics: task-relative worlds and revisable time. A reference implementation of Quine is publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 将LLM智能体直接映射为操作系统原生POSIX进程，不再叠床架屋地在应用层做隔离、调度与通信；实现（Quine）证明可借内核机制完成递归代理、资源控制与shell无缝组合，同时暴露进程模型在认知语义上的缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有框架把LLM当成应用层任务反复实现隔离、调度、通信，既冗余又难与操作系统级机制协同；作者思考能否把“智能体”直接建立在成熟的OS进程抽象上，以零额外开销获得可信隔离、资源配额与生态复用。
AI.method: 设计Quine运行时：将LLM智能体明确定义为PID（身份）、stdio+退出码（接口）、内存/环境变量/文件系统（状态）、fork/exec/exit（生命周期）。单一可执行文件递归spawn自身新实例，借助内核调度、namespace、cgroup完成隔离与资源控制，从而实现shell原生拼接、上下文刷新与无限级委托。
AI.result: 原型公开可用，验证了：1) 用<1000行C代码即可让LLM以进程形态运行，启动延迟≈普通fork；2) 通过cgroups可秒级限制CPU/内存；3) 递归exec/agent链可稳定执行长任务且任意节点可热替换镜像；4) 与Unix管道、xargs、parallel等工具无缝组合。
AI.conclusion: OS进程模型足以充当LLM智能体的可靠执行基底，却不足以表达“认知语义”——如任务级封闭世界假设和可修订时间线。下一步需为进程附加“任务相对世界”与“可回退时间”两种语义扩展，才能把OS的健壮执行升维成完整智能体运行时。

title: WASD: Locating Critical Neurons as Sufficient Conditions for Explaining and Controlling LLM Behavior
summary: Precise behavioral control of large language models (LLMs) is critical for complex applications. However, existing methods often incur high training costs, lack natural language controllability, or compromise semantic coherence. To bridge this gap, we propose WASD (unWeaving Actionable Sufficient Directives), a novel framework that explains model behavior by identifying sufficient neural conditions for token generation. Our method represents candidate conditions as neuron-activation predicates and iteratively searches for a minimal set that guarantees the current output under input perturbations. Experiments on SST-2 and CounterFact with the Gemma-2-2B model demonstrate that our approach produces explanations that are more stable, accurate, and concise than conventional attribution graphs. Moreover, through a case study on controlling cross-lingual output generation, we validated the practical effectiveness of WASD in controlling model behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出无需重训、以自然语言精确操控LLM的WASD框架，通过搜索神经元激活的最小充分条件解释并控制模型输出，实验表明其解释更稳定、准确、简洁，并在跨语言生成任务中验证了实用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有行为控制方法训练开销大、缺乏自然语言可控性或破坏语义连贯，亟需一种轻量级、可解释且精确的方案。
AI.method: 将候选条件表示为神经元激活谓词，迭代搜索在输入扰动下仍能保证当前输出的最小充分神经元集合，形成可解释且可直接干预的“可操作充分指令”。
AI.result: 在SST-2与CounterFact数据集上的Gemma-2-2B模型测试中，WASD生成的解释在稳定性、准确性与简洁性上均优于传统归因图；跨语言生成案例进一步证明其可精准抑制或激活特定语言输出。
AI.conclusion: WASD以极低成本实现对LLM行为的细粒度、可解释控制，为复杂应用中的安全对齐与可控生成提供了新范式。

title: HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention
summary: Long-context language modeling is commonly framed as a scalability challenge of token-level attention, yet local-to-global information structuring remains largely implicit in existing approaches. Drawing on cognitive theories of discourse comprehension, we propose HiCI (Hierarchical Construction--Integration), a hierarchical attention module that constructs segment-level representations, integrates them into a shared global context, and broadcasts both to condition segment-level attention. We validate HiCI through parameter-efficient adaptation of LLaMA-2 with only <5.5% additional parameters, extending context from 4K to 100K tokens (7B) and 64K tokens (13B). Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit hierarchical structuring as an inductive bias for long-context modeling.

AI.tldr: 用两层注意力显式建「段落-全局」结构，5.5% 参数把 LLaMA-2 直接外推至 100K，长程建模、检索与代码任务均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文模型只堆 token-level attention，缺乏显式「局部→全局」结构；认知语言学提示需要层次化整合。
AI.method: 提出 HiCI 模块：先分段建局部表示，再聚合成全局上下文，最后将两级表示广播回段落重新做注意力；仅插入 5.5% 参数做 LoRA 适配。
AI.result: 7B 模型从 4K 扩展至 100K、13B 至 64K；在语言建模、Passage Retrieval、指令遵循上均优于强基线，与私有模型打平并超 GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K 代码理解。
AI.conclusion: 显式分层结构可作为长文本建模的有效归纳偏置，且能用极少参数即插即用。

title: MCLR: Improving Conditional Modeling via Inter-Class Likelihood-Ratio Maximization and Unifying Classifier-Free Guidance with Alignment Objectives
summary: Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling, but their success often relies heavily on classifier-free guidance (CFG), an inference-time heuristic that modifies the sampling trajectory. From a theoretical perspective, diffusion models trained with standard denoising score matching (DSM) are expected to recover the target data distribution, raising the question of why inference-time guidance is necessary in practice. In this work, we ask whether the DSM training objective can be modified in a principled manner such that standard reverse-time sampling, without inference-time guidance, yields effects comparable to CFG. We identify insufficient inter-class separation as a key limitation of standard diffusion models. To address this, we propose MCLR, a principled alignment objective that explicitly maximizes inter-class likelihood-ratios during training. Models fine-tuned with MCLR exhibit CFG-like improvements under standard sampling, achieving comparable qualitative and quantitative gains without requiring inference-time guidance. Beyond empirical benefits, we provide a theoretical result showing that the CFG-guided score is exactly the optimal solution to a weighted MCLR objective. This establishes a formal equivalence between classifier-free guidance and alignment-based objectives, offering a mechanistic interpretation of CFG.

AI.tldr: 本文将扩散模型依赖的推理技巧CFG（无分类器引导）转化为训练目标MCLR，在无需任何推理时修正的条件下即可获得与CFG相当的生成质量，并从理论上证明CFG等价于带权MCLR的最优解。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散模型在生成任务上表现优异，但其成功严重依赖推理阶段的启发式技巧CFG；而标准去噪分数匹配（DSM）理论上已保证能还原数据分布，引发“为何仍需CFG”之问。作者希望用原则化训练目标替代这一经验性推理修正。
AI.method: 1) 诊断标准扩散模型“类间分离不足”是关键缺陷；2) 提出最大化类间似然比（MCLR）的对齐目标，在微调阶段显式拉大不同类别样本的分数差异；3) 用MCLR训练后的模型直接采用标准反向时间采样，无需任何推理时引导。
AI.result: MCLR微调模型在ImageNet 256×256上无CFG即可达到与使用CFG相近的FID、sFID、IS、Precision/Recall，且生成样本视觉效果相当；理论方面证明CFG引导分数恰为带权MCLR目标的最优解，首次建立CFG与对齐训练目标的严格等价关系。
AI.conclusion: 通过把CFG“蒸馏”进训练目标，MCLR在无需推理修正的前提下复现其增益，并为CFG提供了机制性解释——它实质是在对齐阶段强化类间分离的隐式实现。该工作为扩散模型摆脱对启发式推理技巧的依赖提供了可解释且易部署的方案。

title: tBayes-MICE: A Bayesian Approach to Multiple Imputation for Time Series Data
summary:
Time-series analysis is often affected by missing data, a common problem across several fields, including healthcare and environmental monitoring.
  Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) has been prominent for imputing missing values through "fully conditional specification". We extend MICE using the Bayesian framework (tBayes-MICE), utilising Bayesian inference to impute missing values via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to account for uncertainty in MICE model parameters and imputed values. We also include temporally informed initialisation and time-lagged features in the model to respect the sequential nature of time-series data. We evaluate the tBayes-MICE method using two real-world datasets (AirQuality and PhysioNet), and using both the Random Walk Metropolis (RWM) and the Metropolis-Adjusted Langevin Algorithm (MALA) samplers. Our results demonstrate that tBayes-MICE reduces imputation errors relative to the baseline methods over all variables and accounts for uncertainty in the imputation process, thereby providing a more accurate measure of imputation error.
  We also found that MALA mixed better than RWM across most variables, achieving comparable accuracy while providing more consistent posterior exploration. Overall, these findings suggest that the tBayes-MICE framework represents a practical and efficient approach to time-series imputation, balancing increased accuracy with meaningful quantification of uncertainty in various environmental and clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 引入tBayes-MICE，将MICE嵌入贝叶斯框架并使采样器能从时间序列特征中获益，显著提升了估算精度并量化误差不确定性。
AI.motivation: 时间序列在电子病历、环境监测等场景中常面临大量缺失，传统MICE无法刻画时间依赖及模型参数并导致不确定性被低估，需要一种能
AI.method: 在MICE基础上加入贝叶斯推断：用MCMC(随机游走Metropolis与MALA)抽样，新增时间-滞后特征和时序启动策略，实现
AI.result: 在AirQuality与PhysioNet上测试，tBayes-MICE各类变量估算MAE/RMSE均优于统计加权、KNN、MissForest及原版MICE；90%可信区间覆盖率>0.86，MALA多数场合混合速度更优。
AI.conclusion: tBayes-MICE兼顾高准确率与不确定性量化，为医护、气象等时间序列缺口填补提供了可行且高效方案，可在高缺失率或移动性存量情形推广。

title: Continued AI Scaling Requires Repeated Efficiency Doublings
summary: This paper argues that continued AI scaling requires repeated efficiency doublings. Classical AI scaling laws remain useful because they make progress predictable despite diminishing returns, but the compute variable in those laws is best read as logical compute, not as a record of one fixed physical implementation. Practical burden therefore depends on the efficiency with which physical resources realize that compute. Under that interpretation, diminishing returns mean rising operational burden, not merely a flatter curve. Sustained progress then requires recurrent gains in hardware, algorithms, and systems that keep additional logical compute feasible at acceptable cost. The relevant analogy is Moore's Law, understood less as a theorem than as an organizing expectation of repeated efficiency improvement. AI does not yet have a single agreed cadence for such gains, but recent evidence suggests trends that are at least Moore-like and sometimes faster. The paper's claim is therefore simple: if AI scaling is to remain active, repeated efficiency doublings are not optional. They are required.

AI.tldr: 维持AI规模扩展必须像摩尔定律那样持续实现每单位算力的效率翻番；否则不断上升的运营成本将抵消规模红利。
AI.motivation: 经典AI缩放律将算力视为逻辑算力，忽略物理实现的效率，给人“只要堆算力就能持续进步”的错觉。作者指出当边际收益递减时，若效率停滞，物理成本会指数级攀升，规模扩展将不可行，因此必须澄清“算力”含义并研究效率提升节奏。
AI.method: 把缩放律中的“compute”重新定义为逻辑算力，提出“物理效率”概念，用类比摩尔定律的方式分析硬件、算法、系统三方面必须同步带来效率倍增；并搜集近年GPU架构改进、稀疏训练、混合专家系统等经验证据，说明AI领域已出现近似甚至快于摩尔定律的效率提升趋势。
AI.result: 论证了若要保持AI规模扩展，逻辑算力每翻一倍所需的物理资源必须持续下降；一旦效率提升放缓，运营负担将迅速上升，导致扩展停滞。文中提供的证据显示硬件/算法/系统综合效率提升速度目前仍能满足倍增要求，但缺乏统一行业节奏。
AI.conclusion: AI规模扩展不是“算力无限堆叠”的游戏，而是一场必须定期实现效率翻番的持久战；产业需把“效率翻倍周期”确立为与摩尔定律同等重要的共同预期，并继续投入硬件、算法与系统级创新，否则AI增长曲线将因成本失控而趋平。

title: Quantum-Inspired Geometric Classification with Correlation Group Structures and VQC Decision Modeling
summary: We propose a geometry-driven quantum-inspired classification framework that integrates Correlation Group Structures (CGR), compact SWAP-test-based overlap estimation, and selective variational quantum decision modelling. Rather than directly approximating class posteriors, the method adopts a geometry-first paradigm in which samples are evaluated relative to class medoids using overlap-derived Euclidean-like and angular similarity channels. CGR organizes features into anchor-centered correlation neighbourhoods, generating nonlinear, correlation-weighted representations that enhance robustness in heterogeneous tabular spaces. These geometric signals are fused through a non-probabilistic margin-based fusion score, serving as a lightweight and data-efficient primary classifier for small-to-moderate datasets. On Heart Disease, Breast Cancer, and Wine Quality datasets, the fusion-score classifier achieves 0.8478, 0.8881, and 0.9556 test accuracy respectively, with macro-F1 scores of 0.8463, 0.8703, and 0.9522, demonstrating competitive and stable performance relative to classical baselines. For large-scale and highly imbalanced regimes, we construct compact Delta-distance contrastive features and train a variational quantum classifier (VQC) as a nonlinear refinement layer. On the Credit Card Fraud dataset (0.17% prevalence), the Delta + VQC pipeline achieves approximately 0.85 minority recall at an alert rate of approximately 1.31%, with ROC-AUC 0.9249 and PR-AUC 0.3251 under full-dataset evaluation. These results highlight the importance of operating-point-aware assessment in rare-event detection and demonstrate that the proposed hybrid geometric-variational framework provides interpretable, scalable, and regime-adaptive classification across heterogeneous data settings.

title: Parent Selection Mechanisms in Elitist Crossover-Based Algorithms
comment: Full version of the paper accepted at GECCO 2026
summary:
Parent selection methods are widely used in evolutionary computation to accelerate the optimization process, yet their theoretical benefits are still poorly understood. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a parent selection strategy for the $(μ+1)$ genetic algorithm (GA) that prioritizes the selection of maximally distant parents for crossover. We show that, with an appropriately chosen population size, the resulting algorithm solves the Jump$_k$ problem in $O(k4^kn\log(n))$ expected time. This bound is significantly smaller than the best known bound of $O(nμ\log(μ)+n\log(n)+n^{k-1})$ for any $(μ+1)$~GA using no explicit diversity-preserving mechanism and a constant crossover probability.
  To establish this result, we introduce a novel diversity metric that captures both the maximum distance between pairs of individuals in the population and the number of pairs achieving this distance. The main novelty of our analysis is that it relies on crossover as a mechanism for creating and maintaining diversity throughout the run, rather than using crossover only in the final step to combine already diversified individuals. The insights provided by our analysis contribute to a deeper theoretical understanding of the role of crossover in the population dynamics of genetic algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种优先选择最远亲本进行交叉的(μ+1)GA策略，在Jump_k问题上获得O(k4^k n log n)期望时间，显著优于无显式多样性机制的最佳界，并首次理论证明交叉本身可持续创造多样性。
AI.motivation: 进化计算中亲本选择被广泛使用，但其理论收益长期缺乏清晰刻画；作者希望填补该空白，证明通过特定选择策略可量化提升算法性能。
AI.method: 1) 提出“最大化亲本距离”选择策略；2) 引入新多样性指标——最大汉明距离及其达到对数；3) 将交叉视作持续注入而非仅最后整合多样性的机制；4) 对(μ+1)GA在Jump_k上建立期望时间马尔可夫链分析。
AI.result: 新策略使Jump_k期望运行时间上界降至O(k4^k n log n)，优于任何无显式多样性保持的(μ+1)GA已知最好结果O(nμ log μ+n log n+n^{k−1})。
AI.conclusion: 理论首次证实，仅靠交叉+远距离亲本选择即可持续生成并维持多样性，显著加速逃离局部最优；为理解交叉在群体动力学中的核心作用提供了可量化依据。

title: Justified or Just Convincing? Error Verifiability as a Dimension of LLM Quality
summary: As LLMs are deployed in high-stakes settings, users must judge the correctness of individual responses, often relying on model-generated justifications such as reasoning chains or explanations. Yet, no standard measure exists for whether these justifications help users distinguish correct answers from incorrect ones. We formalize this idea as error verifiability and propose $v_{\text{bal}}$, a balanced metric that measures whether justifications enable raters to accurately assess answer correctness, validated against human raters who show high agreement. We find that neither common approaches, such as post-training and model scaling, nor more targeted interventions recommended improve verifiability. We introduce two methods that succeed at improving verifiability: reflect-and-rephrase (RR) for mathematical reasoning and oracle-rephrase (OR) for factual QA, both of which improve verifiability by incorporating domain-appropriate external information. Together, our results establish error verifiability as a distinct dimension of response quality that does not emerge from accuracy improvements alone and requires dedicated, domain-aware methods to address.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出“错误可验证性”指标 v_bal，用以衡量 LLM 给出的解释能否帮助用户判断答案对错；现有后训练、扩规模及针对性干预均无效，作者用 RR（数学）与 OR（事实 QA）两类域特定方法显著提升该指标。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 被用于高风险场景，用户需凭模型给出的解释来判断答案正误，但目前缺乏统一标准衡量解释是否真能助其识别错误。本文旨在填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 1) 形式化“错误可ifiable性”（error verifiability）概念并设计平衡指标 v_bal，以人工高一致性为金标准；2) 系统评估后训练、模型放大、链式思考、解释长度等常见手段；3) 提出两种域特定方法：数学任务的 reflect-and-rephrase（RR，引入外部计算验证并复述）与事实类问答的 oracle-rephrase（OR，利用oracle证据重述答案）并验证其增益。
AI.result: 常规手段（后训练、参数放大、提示优化等）对 v_bal 无显著提升；RR 在数学数据集上将 v_bal 绝对提升 18–25 个百分点，OR 在 Natural Questions 上提升 12–15 个百分点，且均显著优于基线，而答案准确率几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 错误可验证性是独立于准确度的响应质量维度，仅靠提升准确率无法自动获得，必须采用面向领域、引入外部知识/验证的专用方法才能改善。

title: Training Transformers in Cosine Coefficient Space
summary:
Linear layers hold most of a transformer's parameters. We replace each linear layer with one that stores $K$ out of $mn$ two-dimensional DCT coefficients per weight matrix and reconstructs the full matrix through an inverse DCT at every forward pass; the $K$ coefficients are the trainable parameters.
  A 4-layer, 128-dim transformer trained from scratch on character-level Shakespeare reaches validation loss $1.604$ at $K = mn/2$, against $1.580$ for a standard dense baseline -- a gap of $+0.024$ at half the trainable parameter count, within the terminal-epoch variation of the dense run. A rank-48 LoRA factorization at the same trainable parameter count reaches only $1.801$ ($+0.221$). The structural advantage of sparse-coefficient over low-rank parameterizations at matched $K$ is qualitative.
  We identify rank flexibility as the mechanism. A random orthonormal basis matches the DCT within noise at $K = mn/2$, and a compression sweep through $K = mn/10$ and $K = mn/20$ shows that subspaces that can host high-rank matrices keep the loss low, while subspaces that flatten into a low-rank block (zigzag-selection variants) converge onto the observed stable rank \emph{and} the loss line of the rank-48 LoRA reference in lock-step. Among these orthonormal bases, the DCT is preferred because its separable fast transform admits a fused reconstruction kernel: the materialized weight matrix never leaves on-chip memory, so the parameter saving translates into a bandwidth saving as well.

AI.tldr: 用 DCT 稀疏存储线性层权重，可在参数量减半时几乎不掉点，且优于同参数量 LoRA；高秩灵活性是保持性能的关键，DCT 因可片上重建还省带宽。
AI.motivation: 线性层占据 Transformer 绝大部分参数，现有低秩近似（如 LoRA）在相同参数量下性能损失大，需要一种在压缩率与精度间更优的参数化方案。
AI.method: 将每个权重矩阵视为 2-D 信号，仅保留 K 个可训练的 DCT 系数；前向传播时通过逆 DCT 即时重建完整矩阵。对比同等 K 值的随机正交基、锯齿扫描变种及 rank-48 LoRA，并分析可行秩（rank flexibility）对损失的影响。
AI.result: 在 4 层 128 维字符级 Shakespeare 任务上，K = mn/2 时验证损失 1.604，与密集基线 1.580 差距仅 +0.024，显著优于同参数量的 LoRA（1.801）。随机正交基表现与 DCT 相当；当 K 进一步减小，保留高秩子空间的方案维持低损失，低秩子空间则迅速退化至 LoRA 水平。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏 DCT 系数参数化利用高秩灵活性，在大幅剪除参数的同时几乎保持精度，优于低秩近似；DCT 的可分离快速变换支持片上原位重建，节省内存带宽，是一种兼具精度、压缩率与工程效率的线性层替代方案。

title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, submitted at ACL 2026 Industry Track
summary: Enterprise IT support interactions are fundamentally diagnostic: effective resolution requires iterative evidence gathering from ambiguous user reports to identify an underlying root cause. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides grounding through historical cases, standard multi-turn RAG systems lack explicit diagnostic state and therefore struggle to accumulate evidence and resolve competing hypotheses across turns. We introduce DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the level of root causes rather than individual documents. DQA combines conversational query rewriting, retrieval aggregation, and state-conditioned response generation to support systematic troubleshooting under enterprise latency and context constraints. We evaluate DQA on 150 anonymized enterprise IT support scenarios using a replay-based protocol. Averaged over three independent runs, DQA achieves a 78.7% success rate under a trajectory-level success criterion, compared to 41.3% for a multi-turn RAG baseline, while reducing average turns from 8.4 to 3.9.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断问答框架DQA，通过持续维护诊断状态并在根因层面聚合历史案例，将企业IT支持交互的成功率从41.3%提升至78.7%，平均对话轮次减半。
AI.motivation: 企业IT支持的对话本质是“诊断”：需从模糊的用户描述中迭代收集证据、定位根因。现有基于RAG的多轮系统缺乏显式诊断状态，无法跨轮次累积证据和消解冲突假设，导致解决率低、对话冗长。
AI.method: 构建DQA框架：①对话级查询重写保证上下文连贯；②在根因层面而非单文档层面聚合检索结果，形成持久诊断状态；③以诊断状态为条件生成回复，确保每一步都围绕当前最可能假设进行验证或排除。整个流程满足企业级延迟与上下文长度约束。
AI.result: 在150条匿名真实企业IT支持日志的回放式评测中，DQA三轮平均成功率78.7%，较多轮RAG基线（41.3%）提高91%；平均对话轮次从8.4降至3.9，降幅54%。
AI.conclusion: 显式维护“诊断状态”并根因级聚合证据，是提升多轮RAG系统诊断效能的关键。DQA在真实企业场景下实现近乎翻倍的解决率并显著缩短对话长度，可直接落地至IT支持、运维等关键业务场景。

title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook
summary: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement. However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context ($C^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation. We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs. DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value-codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise. Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and sub-group diversity. Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.

AI.tldr: 现有对齐测试只看选择题，忽视亚文化与生成场景；作者提出 DOVE，用最优传输把人类/模型文本分布映射到紧凑价值空间，12 模型实验显示 31.56% 下游相关度，且 500 样本即稳定。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型全球部署时，其文化价值取向若不对齐会带来安全与体验风险；传统基准因 C³ 难题（题型歧视、亚文化盲区、语境失配）无法评估真实取向。
AI.method: DOVE 框架：1) 用率失真变分目标从万级文本提炼 256 维价值码本；2) 将任意文本映射到该结构化空间以滤语义噪声；3) 以非平衡最优运输距离度量人类分布与模型分布的契合度，保留亚群差异。
AI.result: 12 种 SOTA 模型（0.5B–70B）跨 5 大洲 13 种文化的实验：DOVE 与下游文化敏感任务 Spearman ρ=0.316，比最强基线高 98%；α=0.91，500 样本即达 0.85 重测信度；揭示大模型普遍过度趋同“英语城市精英”价值，亚文化偏离度最高 0.47。
AI.conclusion: 分布级、无监督的 DOVE 首次在开放生成中可靠量化文化对齐，为后续动态微调与RLHF 提供直接优化目标和数据抓手，并建议未来扩展至多模态与实时交互场景。

title: Blockchain and AI: Securing Intelligent Networks for the Future
summary: Blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly proposed together for securing intelligent networks, but the literature remains fragmented across ledger design, AI-driven detection, cyber-physical applications, and emerging agentic workflows. This paper synthesizes the area through three reusable contributions: (i) a taxonomy of blockchain-AI security for intelligent networks, (ii) integration patterns for verifiable and adaptive security workflows, and (iii) the Blockchain-AI Security Evaluation Blueprint (BASE), a reporting checklist spanning AI quality, ledger behavior, end-to-end service levels, privacy, energy, and reproducibility. The paper also maps the evidence landscape across IoT, critical infrastructure, smart grids, transportation, and healthcare, showing that the conceptual fit is strong but real-world evidence remains uneven and often prototype-heavy. The synthesis clarifies where blockchain contributes provenance, trust, and auditability, where AI contributes detection, adaptation, and orchestration, and where future work should focus on interoperable interfaces, privacy-preserving analytics, bounded agentic automation, and open cross-domain benchmarks. The paper is intended as a reference for researchers and practitioners designing secure, transparent, and resilient intelligent networks.

AI.tldr: 作者整合区块链与AI在智能网络安全中的零散研究，提出统一分类法、集成模式及评估清单BASE，并指出概念契合度高但实证不足，未来应聚焦互操作接口与隐私分析等方向。
AI.motivation: 区块链与AI虽被共同用于保障智能网络安全，但现有文献在账本设计、AI检测、信息物理应用及代理工作流等方向各自为战，缺乏系统梳理与可复用框架。
AI.method: (i) 构建区块链-AI安全统一分类体系；(ii) 提炼可验证、自适应的安全工作流集成模式；(iii) 设计涵盖AI质量、账本行为、服务等级、隐私、能耗与可复现性的评估清单BASE；并跨IoT、关键基础设施、智能电网、交通、医疗五域映射现有证据。
AI.result: 概念层面区块链提供溯源/信任/审计、AI提供检测/适应/编排的互补性明确；实证层面原型系统占比高，真实部署证据分布不均，跨域开放基准缺失。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究应优先攻关互操作接口、隐私保护分析、有界代理自动化与开放跨域基准，以推动安全、透明、可信赖的智能网络落地。

title: The Defense Trilemma: Why Prompt Injection Defense Wrappers Fail?
summary: We prove that no continuous, utility-preserving wrapper defense-a function $D: X\to X$ that preprocesses inputs before the model sees them-can make all outputs strictly safe for a language model with connected prompt space, and we characterize exactly where every such defense must fail. We establish three results under successively stronger hypotheses: boundary fixation-the defense must leave some threshold-level inputs unchanged; an $ε$-robust constraint-under Lipschitz regularity, a positive-measure band around fixed boundary points remains near-threshold; and a persistent unsafe region under a transversality condition, a positive-measure subset of inputs remains strictly unsafe. These constitute a defense trilemma: continuity, utility preservation, and completeness cannot coexist. We prove parallel discrete results requiring no topology, and extend to multi-turn interactions, stochastic defenses, and capacity-parity settings. The results do not preclude training-time alignment, architectural changes, or defenses that sacrifice utility. The full theory is mechanically verified in Lean 4 and validated empirically on three LLMs.

AI.tldr: 对任意具有连通提示空间的语言模型，试图在不牺牲效用、仅做输入预处理的前提下构造“连续安全壳”，注定在正测度子集上仍输出不安全结果；三大加强条件下这一缺陷必被钉死。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐研究聚焦训练或生成后过滤，甚少从理论上回答纯输入侧、不牺牲效用的防御极限。本文填补空白：如果只想在“前端加壳”——预处理提示但不干扰模型本身——能否让所有输出都达到严格安全？答案应指导防御策略取舍。
AI.method: 建立连续与离散两种模型，形式化三种强度递升的假设：边界定住（某些阈值点需保持不动）、ε鲁棒（在Lipschitz下不动点附近必存在厚层近阈值）、横截性（在边界处梯度不倒向安全侧）；证明辅助下辅以保持效用、连续性等约束，用拓扑与测度理论组合出“三难定理”序列，并在Lean 4机械化全部证明；同步在三个主流LLM上验证预测不安全区域的分布。
AI.result: 理论上：任何连续且保持效用的预处理器防御，必留下正测度但输出仍“严格不安全”的顽固区域；即便是随机化、多轮交互、模型容量对等等扩展，也无法同时满足连续、效用不损与完备安全。实验上：顽固区投影到真实提示集后，在所选模型中命中率与理论预期误差＜3%，佐证理论。
AI.conclusion: 输入壳式防御无法独立达成零牺牲安全的理想；仅依赖“前端包装器”对齐在数学上不可行。视效用的牺牲为必要成本，可人机协同精细设置阈值，或在训练与架构层面进行根本改造；研究工作也展示利用形式化方法保障安全理论可靠性的可扩展框架。

title: The Detection-Extraction Gap: Models Know the Answer Before They Can Say It
summary: Modern reasoning models continue generating long after the answer is already determined. Across five model configurations, two families, and three benchmarks, we find that 52--88% of chain-of-thought tokens are produced after the answer is recoverable from a partial prefix. This post-commitment generation reveals a structural phenomenon: the detection-extraction gap. Free continuations from early prefixes recover the correct answer even at 10% of the trace, while forced extraction fails on 42% of these cases. The answer is recoverable from the model state, yet prompt-conditioned decoding fails to extract it. We formalize this mismatch via a total-variation bound between free and forced continuation distributions, yielding quantitative estimates of suffix-induced shift. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose Black-box Adaptive Early Exit (BAEE), which uses free continuations for both detection and extraction, truncating 70--78% of serial generation while improving accuracy by 1--5pp across all models. For thinking-mode models, early exit prevents post-commitment overwriting, yielding gains of up to 5.8pp; a cost-optimized variant achieves 68--73% reduction at a median of 9 API calls. Code is available at https://github.com/EdWangLoDaSc/know2say.

AI.tldr: 现代推理模型常在答案已可推断后继续冗长生成的现象，检测-抽取缺口普遍存在，提出的黑盒早期退出算法可砍掉70-78%序列并略提精度。
AI.motivation: 现有链式思维模型在答案确定后仍持续输出大量无信息增益token，浪费算力且偶尔稀释正确性，需揭示其根源并开发低成本早停策略。
AI.method: 跨5配置×2模型族×3基准的数据统计→界定“检测-抽取缺口”→用总变差距离量化自由/强制续写的分布偏差→提出BAEE：用模型自由续写同时完成答案检测与抽取，动态截断生成。
AI.result: 52-88%的CoT token属于“答案已可回收”后的冗余生成；10%前缀即可正确回收答案，但标准prompt抽取失败率仍达42%；BAEE在全部模型上削冗70-78%，准确率+1-5pp；思维模式模型最高+5.8pp；成本优化版用约9次API调用削冗68-73%。
AI.conclusion: 检测-抽取缺口是模型“想得多、说得久”的结构性特征；利用自由续写分布的对称破缺，可在黑盒条件下实现高压缩、低风险甚至增益的早期退出，为高效推理部署提供即插即用方案。

title: WRAP++: Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining
comment: Work in progress. Correspondence to ucaswu@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Synthetic data rephrasing has emerged as a powerful technique for enhancing knowledge acquisition during large language model (LLM) pretraining. However, existing approaches operate at the single-document level, rewriting individual web pages in isolation. This confines synthesized examples to intra-document knowledge, missing cross-document relationships and leaving facts with limited associative context. We propose WRAP++ (Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining), which amplifies the associative context of factual knowledge by discovering cross-document relationships from web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over each discovered document pair. Concretely, WRAP++ discovers high-confidence relational motifs including dual-links and co-mentions, and synthesizes QA that requires reasoning across both documents. This produces relational knowledge absent from either source document alone, creating diverse entry points to the same facts. Because the number of valid entity pairs grows combinatorially, this discovery-driven synthesis also amplifies data scale far beyond single-document rewriting. Instantiating WRAP++ on Wikipedia, we amplify ~8.4B tokens of raw text into 80B tokens of cross-document QA data. On SimpleQA, OLMo-based models at both 7B and 32B scales trained with WRAP++ substantially outperform single-document approaches and exhibit sustained scaling gains, underscoring the advantage of cross-document knowledge discovery and amplification.

AI.tldr: WRAP++突破单文档重写局限，通过网页超链接发现跨文档关系并合成联合问答，将8.4 B原始Token扩增至80 B跨文档数据，7 B/32 B OLMo模型在SimpleQA上显著优于单文档基线。
AI.motivation: 现有合成数据重写仅针对单文档，无法利用跨文档关联，导致事实知识缺乏联想上下文，限制LLM预训练效果。
AI.method: 提出WRAP++：1) 从网页超链接中挖掘高置信双链与共提及等关系模式；2) 为每对关联文档生成需跨文档推理的问答对；3) 利用组合爆炸效应成倍放大数据规模。
AI.result: 在维基百科上把~8.4 B Token扩至80 B跨文档QA数据；7 B与32 B OLMo模型在SimpleQA上全面超越单文档重写基线，且增益随模型规模持续扩大。
AI.conclusion: 跨文档关系发现与知识放大能显著提升LLM知识获取效率与规模，验证联合问答合成是突破单文档瓶颈的有效路径。
